text: My husband had heard about this ice cream shop from a coworker, and he wanted to try it out. The shop is a small older building that is located under a bridge. text: ¡Me encanta Sprinkles en Las Vegas! La ubicación es realmente lo mejor de este lugar. Está situada justo frente al High Roller (una enorme atracción tipo noria, ubicada a las afueras de la Strip de Las Vegas). ¡Aquí se pueden tomar fotos increíbles! Además, hay una fuente justo afuera, lo que crea un ambiente muy agradable, especialmente en climas más cálidos. Se puede sentar junto a la fuente y disfrutar de los postres. Por supuesto, los cupcakes y el helado de Sprinkles son deliciosos. Se puede esperar la misma calidad que en cualquier otro lugar de Sprinkles. El servicio siempre ha sido rápido y amable, y la tienda siempre ha estado limpia. Si estás en esta zona y buscas un postre rápido, fácil y consistente, Sprinkles es un lugar ideal para conseguir uno.
text_en: I love Sprinkles in Las Vegas! The location is truly the best part of this place. It’s right in front of the High Roller—a huge roller coaster located outside the Las Vegas Strip. You can take amazing photos here! Additionally, there’s a fountain right outside, which creates a very pleasant atmosphere, especially in warmer weather. You can sit by the fountain and enjoy the desserts. Of course, the cupcakes and ice cream from Sprinkles are delicious. You can expect the same quality as anywhere else at Sprinkles. The service has always been fast and friendly, and the store has always been clean. If you’re in this area and looking for a quick, easy, and reliable dessert option, Sprinkles is the perfect place to get one.
original: I love Sprinkles Las Vegas! The location is really the best part about this spot. It's located directly in front of the High Roller (a GIANT ferris wheel type ride just off the Vegas strip). You can get awesome photos here! Plus, there's a fountain just outside, which makes the atmosphere really nice, especially in warmer weather. You can sit on the fountain and enjoy your treats. Of course Sprinkles cupcakes and ice cream are delicious! You can expect the same quality here as you could from any other Sprinkles location. The service has always been quick and friendly when I've visited, and the store has always been clean. If you're in this area and looking for a quick, easy, and consistent treat, Sprinkles is a great place to pick one up!

text: Eu vim aqui ontem à noite para celebrar meu aniversário, já que é o meu lugar favorito para comer sorvete em Charlotte! Eles têm uma grande variedade de sabores para escolher! O melhor é que você pode pedir um "flight" com 3 sabores diferentes, ou até mais, para experimentar um pouco de vários dos seus sabores favoritos. Eu escolhi o sorvete de creme puff, framboesa e queijo de cabra com cerejas. Todos estavam deliciosos! A equipe é muito simpática e conhece bem cada sabor, e eles permitem que você experimente quantos quiser! Se você for no seu aniversário, o sorvete também é grátis! Às vezes, ficam cheios e há uma fila longa, mas vale a pena esperar! Eles também têm cones de waffle feitos na hora, que têm um cheiro e sabor deliciosos! Mal posso esperar para voltar.
text_en: I came here last night to celebrate my birthday, as it’s my favorite place in Charlotte to eat ice cream! They have a wide variety of flavors to choose from! The best part is that you can order a “flight” of 3 different flavors, or even more, so you can try a few of your favorite flavors. I chose vanilla, raspberry, and goat cheese with cherries ice cream. All of them were delicious! The staff is very friendly and knows each flavor well, and they allow you to try as many as you want! If you visit on your birthday, the ice cream is also free! Sometimes they get crowded and there’s a long line, but it’s worth waiting! They also have waffle cones made right away, which have a great smell and taste! I can’t wait to come back.
original: I came here last night for my birthday since they are my favorite ice cream spot in Charlotte! They are a ton of different flavors to chose from! The best part is that you can get a flight of 3 different scoops, or even more so you can get a little bit of a few of your favorite flavors. I got the cream puff, bramble berry, and goat cheese with cherries. They were all delicious! The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable about each flavor as they will allow you to sample as many as you'd like! If you go on your birthday, your ice cream is free too! Sometimes they get crowded and have a long line, but it is worth every second to wait! They have fresh made waffle cones as well that smell and taste delicious! I cannot wait to go back.

text: Compré un pastel de cumpleaños para mi madre aquí y a todos nos encantó. ¡El mejor pastel que he probado! También probamos sus cannolis y estaban deliciosos. Planeamos comprar algo aquí para la Nochebuena. ¡Recomiendo encarecidamente visitar este lugar!

original: Got a birthday cake here for my mother and we all loved it!! Best cake ever. We also got their cannolis and they were delicious. We plan on picking something up from here for Christmas Eve. Highly recommend going here!!

text: Considerando a fama desse lugar, eu precisava experimentar. Na verdade, já havia tentado há dois anos e não me impressionei muito. Então, precisei tentar novamente, porque minha esposa gostou. Tínhamos uma grande variedade de itens: croissant de amêndoa com chocolate, pain au raisin (pão doce com passas), croissant de morango, croissant de chocolate, beignet (bolinho frito), rolo de nozes e alguns outros que não consigo lembrar. As únicas coisas que realmente gostei foram o croissant de morango, que tinha uma cobertura crocante, e o beignet. Achei que tudo o mais tinha um sabor um pouco seco. Aliás, o latte estava muito bom. No geral, os preços não eram ruins, considerando que estamos dentro de um cassino em Las Vegas e tudo é mais caro. Achei que a maioria dos doces era melhor do que a média, mas não tão boa quanto qualquer padaria simples em uma estação de trem em Paris. Não acho que eu faria um esforço para ir lá, mas pararia se estivesse no caminho. Para ser sincero, a padaria de croissants perto da minha casa faz um croissant mais leve, fofo e saboroso, mas o café deles é péssimo. Depois de ler alguns dos outros comentários, gostaria de ter comprado um macaron, mas não justifiquei pagar $3,50 por um. Há uma padaria italiana em Little Italy, em São Francisco, que faz e vende esses doces por menos de $1, e são perfeitos. Embora sejam um pouco menores.
text_en: Considering the reputation of this place, I really wanted to try it out. Actually, I had tried it two years ago and wasn’t very impressed. So, I decided to try it again, because my wife liked it. There was a wide variety of items: almond chocolate croissants, wine grapes bread (a sweet bread with raisins), strawberry croissants, chocolate croissants, beignets (fried pastries), walnut rolls, and some other things I can’t remember. The only things I really liked were the strawberry croissants, which had a crunchy topping, and the beignets. I felt that everything else had a slightly dry taste. By the way, the latte was really good. Overall, the prices weren’t bad, considering we’re in a casino in Las Vegas where everything is more expensive. I thought most of the desserts were better than average, but not as good as any simple bakery in a train station in Paris. I don’t think I would go there, but I might stop by if I’m on my way. To be honest, the croissant bakery near my house makes croissants that are lighter, softer, and more flavorful, but their coffee is terrible. After reading some of the other comments, I wanted to buy a macaron, but I didn’t see any reason to pay $3.50 for one. There’s an Italian bakery in Little Italy, in San Francisco, that makes and sells these desserts for less than $1, and they’re perfect. Although they’re a bit smaller.
original: Given their reputation I had to try it. Actually I tried it 2 years ago and I wasn't really impressed. So I had to try it again, cause my wife liked it. We got a wide selection of items: chocolate almond croissant, pain au raisin, strawberry croissant, chocolate croissant, beignet, pecan roll, and a few others that I can't remember. The only things that I really liked were the strawberry croissant that had a streusel on top and the beignet. I thought everything else tasted a little dry. BTW the latte was really good. Overall the prices weren't bad considering you're inside a casino in Vegas and everything is more expensive. I thought the majority of the pastries were better than average but not as good as any basic pastry shop in a Paris train stop. I don't think I would go out of my way to stop there, but would stop if it was on my way. Frankly the croissant shop around the corner from my house makes a lighter, fluffier and tastier croissant, but their coffee sucks. After reading some if the other posts, I wish I would have gotten a macaroon but I couldn't justify paying $3.50 for one. There's an italian bakery in San Francisco's little italy that makes these and sells them for less than a $1 a piece and they're perfect. Although they're a little smaller.

text: Minus 2 stars for the absolutely horrible in store service. We were the only ones in the store and there were at least 4 employees, including the manager Priscilla, who was the absolute worst of the bunch. Right when we began to order, some employee (named Kat?) seemed utterly confused and annoyed that we wanted two separate orders. Is that such a difficult request? After she takes both our orders to the register, she gets confused and asks us if we want to pay together. I said no, and once again, I'm met with a confused look. After a bit of commotion, another employee asks ME what is in the box, and after I tell her I'm not sure, she throws the box back down and proceeds to leave. I'm not asking to be treated like a princess, but if you don't know what's in the box, can't you just open it and check if it's my order or not?! Now I was actually getting annoyed at this point so I asked for the manager. Turns out the woman who was too lazy to check what was in my box WAS the manager. Not sure if I caught them on a bad day or if they were too lazy to work, but thankfully there was one competent employee (blonde haired, tall male named Aaron?) who took the time to apologize for something he didn't even do. I would've just left without any macarons after all that attitude and sass, but since they are soo good, I had to suck it up and stay. Delicious treats, but horrible employees (minus Aaron).

They’re open until late, so even if you’re strolling after dinner, it would be great to get some Madeline cookies or a cake and just watch the people go by, or simply enjoy a quiet moment. It’s a small part of Paris, right in the heart of Italy!

text: Finalmente, 85C ha llegado a Las Vegas, lo cual era largamente esperado. Si eres un aficionado a los postres y panes de estilo asiático (más ligeros, esponjosos y menos dulces), este es el lugar ideal para ti. Prepárate para hacer fila en el futuro, ya que es un establecimiento recientemente inaugurado. Cuando fuimos por la noche, la fila probablemente duró unos 20 minutos. Aunque muchas de las exhibiciones de panes estaban casi vacías o con poca cantidad, las vitrinas con pasteles y porciones de pastel estaban bastante llenas. Estaban trabajando duro para ser eficientes, y había un empleado en medio de la fila que estaba empaquetando cada artículo de pan en bolsas de plástico individuales antes de que llegaran al mostrador. Descarga la aplicación de 85C para obtener recompensas y recibir un café gratis simplemente por registrarte. Probamos algunos productos, pero el pastel de "Black Forest" realmente destacó. Excelente, delicioso, húmedo y no demasiado dulce. Ofrecen una gran variedad de panes y pasteles para satisfacer casi cualquier gusto, así que no dudes en visitar 85C si buscas un postre menos dulce pero igualmente delicioso. Hay algunas mesas en el interior para sentarse, pero, dado lo concurrido que está, probablemente deberías planear llevarte la comida para comer allí.
text_en: Finally, 85C has arrived in Las Vegas—something that had been long awaited. If you’re a fan of Asian-style desserts and breads (light, fluffy, and not too sweet), this is the perfect place for you. Be prepared to wait in line, as it’s a newly opened establishment. When we went there tonight, the line lasted about 20 minutes. Although many of the bread displays were almost empty or had few items, the display cases with cakes and pastries were quite full. They were working hard to be efficient, and there was an employee in the middle of the line who packed each bread item into individual plastic bags before it reached the counter. Download the 85C app to earn rewards and get free coffee just by registering. We tried some products, but the “Black Forest” cake really stood out. Excellent, delicious, moist, and not too sweet. They offer a wide range of breads and pastries to satisfy almost any taste, so don’t hesitate to visit 85C if you’re looking for a less sweet but still delicious dessert. There are some tables inside, but given how busy it is, it’s probably better to bring your own food to eat there.
original: Finally 85C has come to Vegas which is long overdue. If you're a fan of Asian-style desserts (lighter, fluffier, less sweet) and breads then this is the place for you. Expect lines for the immediate future since it is newly-opened. When we visited in the evening the line was probably about 20 minutes. Many of the bread displays were running low and/or empty though the cases with the cakes and cake slices were quite full. They were trying hard to be efficient and had a staff member mid-way through the line who was packaging everyone's bread items into individual plastic bags before they reached the register. Download their 85C app to earn rewards and receive a complimentary coffee just for signing up. We tried a few items, but the black forest cake really stood out. Excellent, delicious, moist, and not too sweet. They have a vast variety of breads and cakes to suit just about any taste, so by all means visit 85C if you want a less sweet dessert that's still plenty delicious! There are a few tables inside for seating, but given how busy it has been you should probably plan to take things to go for the time being.

text: This rating is for those of you gluten free types like my wife who has celiac disease. I get it, this place might be overhyped for some people. Yes, great dessert exists other places. Yeah, cereal milk ice cream might sound a little gimmicky (still delicious though), blah blah blah... Listen hipsters, you're the reason places like this exist and then you're the reason it's ends up having a mediocre 3 1/2 stars on Yelp a year or two later. You get bored and cynical, I get it. I probably got a lil hipster in my blood too. But man, if you are gluten free and you bite into the gf version of a succulent, dense, delicious, moist, piece of Christina Tosi's utterly magnificent birthday cake creation, you will understand why there's a big friggin line up to the counter most hours of the day. It really is that good. And I'm gonna go out on a logic limb here and say that the gluten version of the birthday cake is probably even better. But I didn't even feel the need to go there since the gf version was just THAT good. The wife ordered a big ol slice of cake twice over the two days we were there, and like any good gluten free girl on vacation in Las Vegas, she ate a lot of that cake for breakfast. There's other gf options on the menu besides the birthday cake too, and methinks it's probably a good idea for all you gf kids to try them all.
text_en: This rating is for those of you gluten free types like my wife who has celiac disease. I get it, this place might be overhyped for some people. Yes, great dessert exists other places. Yeah, cereal milk ice cream might sound a little gimmicky (still delicious though), blah blah blah... Listen hipsters, you're the reason places like this exist and then you're the reason it's ends up having a mediocre 3 1/2 stars on Yelp a year or two later. You get bored and cynical, I get it. I probably got a lil hipster in my blood too. But man, if you are gluten free and you bite into the gf version of a succulent, dense, delicious, moist, piece of Christina Tosi's utterly magnificent birthday cake creation, you will understand why there's a big friggin line up to the counter most hours of the day. It really is that good. And I'm gonna go out on a logic limb here and say that the gluten version of the birthday cake is probably even better. But I didn't even feel the need to go there since the gf version was just THAT good. The wife ordered a big ol slice of cake twice over the two days we were there, and like any good gluten free girl on vacation in Las Vegas, she ate a lot of that cake for breakfast. There's other gf options on the menu besides the birthday cake too, and methinks it's probably a good idea for all you gf kids to try them all.

text: Pedimos o chocolate malt. Foi uma bebida razoável. Tinha gosto de chocolate, com pedaços que lembravam massa de biscoito/pedaços de chocolate. O malt poderia ter sido mais pronunciado. Por 10 dólares, eu esperava algo especial. Acho que o preço é devido à localização do local. O malt que faço em casa é muito melhor do que o que eles nos deram. Não voltaria.
text_en: We ordered the malt chocolate. It was a decent drink. It tasted like chocolate, with pieces that resembled cookie dough or chocolate chunks. The malt flavor could have been more pronounced. For $10, I expected something special. I think the price is due to the location of the place. The malt I make at home is much better than what they served us. I wouldn’t go back.
original: We got the chocolate cake malt. It was an okay drink. It tasted like chocolate with chunks of like a cookie dough/chocolate chip chunks in it. The malt could've also have been more prominent. For 10$ I was expecting something special. I guess the price is just because the place is on the strip. The malt I make at home are much better than what they gave us.I would not go back.

text: Summer in a take out box. So yummy and insanely hip part of Phoenix's late infill project to reclaim the downtown.
text_en: Summer in a take out box. So yummy and insanely hip part of Phoenix's late infill project to reclaim the downtown.

Pick a flavor that you love and you can't go wrong. Expect long waits in the evenings. My only complaint every visit was that there was no outside menu to help me decide which delicious treat I was going to indulge in. text: Na minha primeira experiência com a Sprinkles, eu tinha grandes expectativas para este lugar. Os cupcakes são bons, mas não são os melhores, talvez porque eu prefiro que o recheio não seja tão doce. O bolo é ótimo, mas se o recheio fosse mais de creme de manteiga, seria perfeito!
text_en: In my first experience with Sprinkles, I had high expectations for this place. The cupcakes are good, but not the best—maybe because I prefer the filling to be less sweet. The cake is great, but if the filling were more like buttercream, it would be perfect!
original: First time trying Sprinkles, I had high expectations for this place. The cupcakes are good but not the best, maybe because I prefer the frosting to be not so sweet. The cake is great but if the frosting was more of a butter cream, it would be perfect!

text: Como he vivido aquí más de 20 años, he visitado todas las antiguas ubicaciones de Mary Coyles. ¡Qué bueno que alguien compró este negocio local a los dueños originales para que podamos seguir disfrutando! La última ubicación de MC en Central está más cerca de mí, ¡y eso me hace muy feliz! He estado allí dos veces en las últimas dos semanas, y en ambas ocasiones, los empleados han sido muy amables, han seguido los protocolos de seguridad y han servido los deliciosos postres caseros de MC. La última vez, vine con una amiga: pedí un helado con forma de cono de menta. ¡Delicioso y refrescante! Mi amiga pidió un cono con licorice negro - un sabor inusual, ¡así que las gracias!, pero podría haber sido aún más intenso. La segunda vez, vine sola y pedí un vaso de helado de chocolate y menta. ¡Un sabor excelente porque es refrescante Y está lleno de trozos de chocolate, no de trocitos o migajas de chocolate, sino de VERDADEROS trozos! ¿Cuál es su sabor más popular? Caramelo salado con nueces. Nunca me habría imaginado eso... ¡así que tendré que probarlo la próxima vez! Aquí hay algunas medidas que están tomando para garantizar una experiencia segura para los empleados y los clientes, durante los tiempos de la pandemia: * Los empleados usan mascarillas y guantes * Todas las personas que entraban (tres personas diferentes, más yo, usaban mascarillas) * Las áreas de asientos están separadas para garantizar el distanciamiento social, excepto por una mesa individual que está disponible. Hay muchas opciones de estacionamiento: 1) Gire en Encanto y hay espacios DETRÁS de la tienda. 2) Estacionamiento en la calle en Encanto 3) Estacionamiento en la calle justo al norte de Mary Coyle, en West Vernon. Allí está la cafetería Birdhaus... ¡Mucho agradecimiento por la sencilla experiencia de compartir helado con amigos o familiares en Mary Coyle ahora mismo!
text_en: Having lived here for over 20 years, I’ve visited all the old locations of Mary Coyle’s shop. It’s great that someone bought this local business from the original owners so we can continue to enjoy it! The last location of MC in Central is closer to me, and that makes me very happy! I’ve been there twice in the past two weeks, and both times, the staff were very kind, followed safety protocols, and served delicious homemade desserts from MC. The last time, I came with a friend: I ordered a mint cone ice cream. It was delicious and refreshing! My friend ordered a black licorice cone – an unusual flavor, so thank you! But it could have been more intense. The second time, I came alone and ordered a chocolate and mint ice cream. It was an excellent flavor because it was refreshing and full of real chocolate chunks, not just pieces or crumbs. What’s your most popular flavor? Salty caramel with nuts. I never expected that… so I’ll have to try it next time! Here are some measures being taken to ensure a safe experience for both staff and customers during the pandemic: * Staff wear masks and gloves * All people who enter use masks (three different people, plus me) * Seating areas are separated to ensure social distancing, except for one private table available. There are many parking options: 1) Turn into Encanto and there are spaces behind the store. 2) Parking on the street in Encanto. 3) Parking just north of Mary Coyle in West Vernon. There’s the Birdhaus café there… Thank you very much for providing such a simple way to share ice cream with friends or family at Mary Coyle right now!
original: Since I've lived here 20+ years, I've been to all Mary Coyles' former locations. Thank goodness someone bought this local biz from the original owners so we can still indulge. MC's latest location on Central is closer to me so I'm thrilled about that fact! I've been here twice in the last two weeks & both times employees have been super nice, followed safety protocols & served up MC's usual homemade deliciousness. Last time I came with a friend: I got a cake cone with Peppermint Ice Cream. Creamy & refreshing! My friend got a waffle cone with Black Licorice - unusual flavor so mad props on that, but could have been more licorice-y. Second time, I came solo & got a cup of Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream. Superb flavor because refreshing AND studded with semi sweet chocolate chips, NOT chocolates flakes or itty bitty pieces of chocolate, but full on CHIPS. What's their most popular flavor? Salted Caramel with Cashews. Never would've guessed that one...so gotta git it next go round! Here's how they're ensuring a safe experience for employees & customers, during Covid-19 times: * workers wear masks & gloves * everyone that came in (three different people + me wore masks) * seating areas are blocked off so social distancing is enforced, except for one booth that is available Plenty of parking options: 1) Turn on Encanto & there are spaces BEHIND the shop. 2) Street parking on Encanto 3) Street parking on street just north of Mary Coyle's, West Vernon. That's where Birdhaus Coffee shop is... Much appreciation for the simple experience of sharing ice cream with friends or family at Mary Coyle's right now!

text: Visited Twice. At the first time, the macarons were amazing. During the second time, the butter cookie macarons were too dry. These are expensive!
text_en: Visited Twice. At the first time, the macarons were amazing. During the second time, the butter cookie macarons were too dry. These are expensive!

text: O atendimento foi bom e a equipe foi simpática. Experimentei um pedaço do bolo de chocolate com pretzel e caramelo, e embora a cobertura e o recheio fossem excelentes, o próprio bolo quase se desfez na minha boca, e não de uma forma agradável. Acabei comendo ao redor dele, o que foi decepcionante, considerando a fama dos bolos deste lugar e o preço de US$ 14 por fatia.
text_en: The service was good, and the staff were friendly. I tried a piece of chocolate cake with pretzels and caramel. Although the topping and filling were excellent, the cake itself almost broke apart in my mouth—not in a pleasant way. I ended up eating around it, which was disappointing, considering the reputation of these cakes and the $14 price per piece.
original: Service was good and staff friendly - I got a slice of the caramel pretzel chocolate cake and while the frosting and fillings were excellent the cake itself nearly dissolved in my mouth and not in a good way. So I ended up eating around it which was disappointing considering the hype around the cakes here and the $14/slice price tag.

text: Aquí no puedes equivocarte. Recientemente probé el sándwich de galletas y ¡guau! Las galletas rellenas de chocolate con sal, acompañadas del helado de café vietnamita, fueron una verdadera delicia. Ya sea verano, invierno, lluvia o calor extremo, este lugar es espectacular y ofrece algo que todo el mundo va a amar.
text_en: You can’t make a mistake here. Recently, I tried the cookie sandwich, and wow! The chocolate-filled cookies, paired with Vietnamese coffee ice cream, were absolutely delicious. Whether it’s summer, winter, rainy weather, or extreme heat, this place is spectacular and offers something everyone will love.
original: You cannot go wrong here! I recently tried the cookie sandwich and WOW. Salted chocolate chunk with the Vietnamese coffee ice cream was a total treat. Summer, winter, rain or high heat, this place is to die for and has a treat everyone will absolutely love.

text: ¡Sigue siendo la mejor heladería de Ohio City! Me encanta su noche de ramen y sus nuevos sabores: sésamo negro, flan, almendra y tarta de lima!
text_en: Still the best ice cream shop in Ohio City! I love their ramen night and its new flavors: black sesame, flan, almond, and lime cake!
original: Still the best ice cream shop in Ohio City! Loving their ramen nites and their new flavors! Black Sesame, Flan, Marzipan and Key Lime Pie!

text: Experimentei o sorvete de "crack pie" e uma fatia do bolo. A porção é bem generosa. No entanto, é excessivamente doce, e eu tenho uma grande predileção por doces. Fiquei um pouco decepcionado com as opções disponíveis, talvez porque o Pinterest o divulgou um pouco demais. O atendimento também foi excelente.
text_en: I tried the “crack pie” ice cream and a slice of cake. The portion is quite generous. However, it’s overly sweet, and I really prefer sweet things. I was a little disappointed with the options available; maybe because Pinterest has promoted it too much. The service was also excellent.
original: got a crack pie soft serve and a slice of crack pie. You get a pretty huge serving of ice cream. It's way to sweet however and I have the ultimate sweet tooth. I was disappointed in the options available I suppose Pinterest hyped it up a bit to much. great service also

text: Such a cool spot in the NoDa area! If you don't mind waiting in line, this place is perfect for a pastry or maybe a breakfast sandwich. It was recommend to me by a local & since we were near by, we decided to check it out. They have plenty of pastries, sweets & sandwiches to choose from. I went simple and ordered a Sausage, Egg, Swiss & Egg Croissant. It was extremely fresh filled me right up. Although the line is long, it moves pretty quick and they bring you your food within minutes. The decor is unique. Nothing matches, yet looks so well together. Plenty of seating and space to study, bring a friend or a group and munch out. Deff a favorite of mine in Charlotte and I will be returning again!

text: Eles tinham um estoque um pouco limitado na quinta-feira à tarde, mas conseguimos os cupcakes com cobertura de chocolate, caramelo salgado e recheio de "red velvet". Esses cupcakes têm uma ótima proporção de recheio e são muito macios. Experimente o mini cupcake para ter uma amostra!
text_en: They had a somewhat limited stock on Thursday afternoon, but we managed to get the chocolate-covered cupcakes, salty caramel, and “red velvet” filling. These cupcakes have an excellent ratio of filling, and they’re very soft. Try the mini cupcake to get a sample!
original: They were a little low in inventory on a Thursday afternoon, but we were able to get the sprinkle, dark chocolate, salted caramel, and red velvet. These cupcakes have great frosting ratios, and very moist. Try the little mini shot one for a sample!

text: Prices seemed fair. 2 cannoli and two iced mochas were under around $10. The wait was very long despite how many employees were there it seemed only a few were actually getting anything done. One woman helped our group of 4 and when I tried getting a young mans attention to add to our order he told me that I would need to talk to the woman helping us. The cannoli was amazing though and so was the iced mocha. Everything in the place looked fantastic. If I ever find myself back in Cleveland I will surely spend more time in little Italy.

text: Excelente atendimento e sorvete delicioso. Adorei o sorvete com pão de mel (sanduíche de sorvete com pão de mel). Voltarei!
text_en: Excellent service and delicious ice cream. I really liked the ice cream with honey bread (ice cream sandwich with honey bread). I will come back!
original: Great customer service and good ice cream. Loves the yummy bun (donut ice cream sandwich). I'll be back!

text: Com certeza, um ótimo lugar para ir e experimentar sorvetes de alta qualidade. Sabores únicos e interessantes, além de serem ecologicamente corretos. Talvez até eu goste mais do que o Bi-Rite em San Francisco. Estou muito feliz por morar aqui! Algumas pessoas disseram que o preço é alto, mas realmente, pense na qualidade dos ingredientes que você está recebendo. Na verdade, o preço é muito bom. Se você está disposto a pagar $3 a $5 por um café ruim no Starbucks, você está sendo enganado e certamente não pode reclamar do preço no Sweet Republic. Aqui, você recebe qualidade a um preço excelente. É evidente que eles se preocupam com a qualidade do sorvete. Parabéns por serem tão conscientes em relação ao meio ambiente. Isso é sempre um ponto positivo para mim.
text_en: Sure, it’s a great place to go and try high-quality ice cream. Unique and interesting flavors, and they’re also eco-friendly. Maybe I even prefer it over Bi-Rite in San Francisco. I’m very happy to live here! Some people say the price is high, but really, think about the quality of the ingredients you get. In fact, the price is quite good. If you’re willing to pay $3 to $5 for a bad coffee at Starbucks, you’re being misled—and you certainly can’t complain about the price at Sweet Republic. Here, you get quality at an excellent price. It’s clear that they care about the quality of the ice cream. Congratulations on being so environmentally conscious. That’s always a positive thing for me.
original: Definitely a great quality IC place to go to. Interesting unique flavors and Eco friendly. I may even like it better than bi-rite in San Fran. So glad I live here! Some people have said the price is high but really - think about the good quality you're getting in their ingredients. It's actually a really good price. If you're willing to pay $3-$5 for crap coffee at Starbucks, you're getting robbed and sure as heck cant complain about the price at Sweet Republic. Here you get quality at a great price. You can tell they care about their ice cream. Thumbs up for being so eco-conscious. Always a plus in my book.

text: La mejor panadería y cafetería en Charlotte. Es una lástima que la ubicación en el centro haya cerrado.
text_en: The best bakery and café in Charlotte. It’s a pity that its location in the center has closed.
original: Best bakery and coffee shop in Charlotte. It's a pity that the uptown location closed.

text: The staff is great, the doughnuts look great, and I got there at 11am...That being said I have read all the hype of this place and purchased two doughnuts...Well...I tried them and tossed them in the garbage...It is not that they are bad they are just not good...I got blueberry and meyer lemon and it had no real lemon flavor. So, one small taste and in the garbage. I tried the Butterfinger and Chocolate and one taste in the garbage. I will try it again to get more of the classic flavors. But, to date, I have tried all the doughnuts in Vegas and there are much better choices I believe.

So, one small taste and in the garbage. I tried the Butterfinger and Chocolate and one taste in the garbage. I will try it again to get more of the classic flavors. But, to date, I have tried all the doughnuts in Vegas and there are much better choices I believe.

text: QUE EXPERIÊNCIA INCRÍVEL E TRANSFORMATIVA!! Embora o almoço no Momofuku ao lado não tenha sido das melhores experiências, o conceito de sobremesas do Momofuku, a Milk Bar, foi um sucesso! Solicitei amostras tanto da torta "crack" quanto dos sorvetes de leite com cereais. A torta "crack" era deliciosa e muito saborosa, mas um pouco doce demais para o meu gosto, então optei pelo sorvete de leite com cereais, que é, de qualquer forma, uma das sobremesas mais famosas do local. No entanto, a melhor decisão que tomei durante toda a viagem foi pedir um affogato de leite com cereais - sorvete de leite com cereais servido com um shot de café expresso despejado sobre ele. Isso elevou o já excelente sorvete de leite com cereais a uma experiência digna de êxtase! A intensidade amarga do café expresso combinou DIVINAMENTE com a doçura, riqueza e cremosidade do sorvete. Fiquei tão feliz – consegui minha dose de café e ainda ganhei um sorvete de Milk Bar! O melhor investimento de $5 que já fiz!! Por fim, não sei por que as pessoas estão reclamando dos preços aqui. Você está em Las Vegas, em um resort de luxo na Strip, em um dos melhores estabelecimentos de sobremesas nos EUA. Existem muitas coisas para reclamar quando se trata de Las Vegas (talvez o preço dos clubes, por exemplo?!); sei que vocês, amantes da festa, conseguem gastar $7 em sorvete.
text_en: What an incredible and transformative experience!! Although the lunch at Momofuku next door wasn’t the best, Momofuku’s dessert concept, the Milk Bar, was a success! I requested samples of both the “crack” cake and the milk ice cream with cereal. The “crack” cake was delicious and flavorful, but a little too sweet for my taste. So I chose the milk ice cream with cereal—it’s, after all, one of the most famous desserts at this place. However, the best decision I made during the whole trip was ordering an affogato with cereal—milk ice cream served with a shot of espresso poured over it. This turned the already excellent milk ice cream into an experience worth celebrating! The bitter intensity of the espresso perfectly complemented the sweetness, richness, and creaminess of the ice cream. I was so happy—I got my share of coffee and also a piece of Milk Bar ice cream! The best $5 investment I’ve ever made!! Finally, I don’t understand why people complain about the prices here. You’re in Las Vegas, in a luxury resort on the Strip, in one of the best dessert places in the US. There are many things to complain about when it comes to Las Vegas (maybe the prices of clubs, for example?!). I know that you, party lovers, can spend $7 on ice cream.
original: WHAT A FREAKIN LIFE CHANGING EXPERIENCE!! While my lunch at Momofuku next door left much to be desired, Momofuku's dessert concept Milk Bar was a smash hit!! I asked for samples of both their crack pie and cereal milk soft serves. The crack pie was delicious and decadent but slightly too sweet for my taste, so I opted for the cereal milk, which is probably their most well known dessert anyways. The best decision I made that entire trip, however, was getting a cereal milk affogato - cereal milk soft serve served with a shot of espresso poured over it. That pleasantly elevated the already superb cereal milk ice cream to a foodgasm worthy experience!! The bitter potency of the pulled espresso shot balanced DIVINELY with the sweet, rich, milky creaminess of the ice cream. I was so so so happy - got my coffee fix and had Milk Bar cherry popped in one! Best $5 I've ever spent!! Lastly, not sure why people are complaining about the prices here, btw. You're in Vegas, at a luxury resort on the strip, at one of the most renowned dessert joints in the US. There are plenty of things to be complaining about when it comes to Vegas (maybe the price of clubs, for starters?!); I know you party people can shell out $7 for ice cream.

text: Siempre busco helados de alta calidad y con sabores únicos, y afortunadamente, Churn existe en Phoenix para satisfacer mis antojos. Vine aquí una noche de jueves con mi novia, y había una fila larga. Cuando finalmente fue nuestro turno, probé algunos sabores y, al final, decidí probar el helado de galletas y menta. Estaba en duda entre este y el café vietnamita, pero al final elegí el de galletas y menta. ¡Estaba delicioso! Sin duda, uno de los mejores helados de menta que he probado. Mi amiga también se llevó el helado de galletas y menta. Saben que es realmente bueno cuando no pedimos dos sabores para compartir y terminamos pidiendo lo mismo. La textura del helado era suave y cremosa, no demasiado helada ni arenosa. De verdad, me gustaría vivir más cerca de aquí. Pero, por otro lado, quizás sea una bendición que no viva aquí, porque si lo hiciera, estaría aquí todo el tiempo...
text_en: I always look for high-quality ice creams with unique flavors. Thankfully, Churn exists in Phoenix to satisfy my cravings. I came here one Thursday night with my girlfriend, and there was a long line. When it was finally our turn, I tried several flavors, and in the end, I decided to try the cookie and mint ice cream. I was unsure between this and the Vietnamese coffee ice cream, but in the end, I chose the cookie and mint one. It was delicious! Without a doubt, one of the best mint ice creams I’ve ever tried. My friend also got the cookie and mint ice cream. You know it’s really good when we don’t order two different flavors and end up ordering the same thing. The texture of the ice cream was soft and creamy—not too cold or gritty. Really, I wish I lived closer to here. But on the other hand, maybe it’s a blessing that I don’t live here, because if I did, I would be here all the time…
original: I'm always fiending for some quality and unique ice cream, and thankfully, Churn exists in Phoenix to satisfy my cravings. I came here on a Thursday night with a girlfriend, and the line was out the door. When it was finally our turn, I sampled a few flavors and ultimately ended up going with the cookies and mint ice cream. It was a close call between that and the Vietnamese coffee though. The cookies and mint flavor...oh man, SO GOOD. Hands down, one of the best mint flavors I've had for ice cream. My friend ended up getting the cookies and mint flavor also. You know it's freaking good when we don't get two flavors to share and end up getting the same thing. Ice cream texture was smooth and creamy, not too overly icy or grainy. I seriously wish I lived closer to here. But then again, maybe it's a blessing I don't or else I'd be here all the time...

text: Entramos en la tienda y nadie nos recibió. Esperamos en la fila durante 30 minutos, y solo había una persona delante de nosotros, además, nadie nos dirigió la palabra. Con 6 empleados visibles, no hay ninguna razón por la que debiéramos haber experimentado esto... terminamos saliendo sin nada. Desearía saber si los cupcakes/helado eran buenos.
text_en: We entered the store, but no one greeted us. We waited in line for 30 minutes, and there was only one person in front of us. No one even said a word to us. With only 6 employees visible, there’s no reason for us to have experienced this… we just left without getting anything. I wonder if the cupcakes/sweets were good.
original: Four of us walked in and were greeted by no one. Stood in line for 30 minutes with ONLY 1 party ahead of us and no one even acknowledged us. With 6 visible employees there is no reason why we should have experienced this...we ended us leaving empty handed. Wish I knew if the cupcakes/ice cream was even good.

text: Estaba muy decepcionado con los cupcakes que compré anoche. Compré 4 grandes y 2 pequeños, por un precio de alrededor de 20 dólares. Comí los pequeños en el camino al coche, estaban bien. Aunque tuve que quitar algo de glaseado, incluso en los pequeños, el glaseado es bastante dulce. Compré los grandes para la cena de hoy y no pude terminar ni un solo cupcake. Estaban tan secos que me sorprendió. Y la proporción entre el glaseado y el bizcocho era demasiado alta. ¡Demasiado dulce! O quizás el bizcocho, que estaba seco y sin sabor, era el problema. Pensé que este producto era de buena calidad, ¡pero no es así! Por el precio, definitivamente no volveré a comprar.
text_en: I was very disappointed with the cupcakes I bought last night. I bought 4 large ones and 2 small ones, for about $20. I ate the small ones on the way to the car; they were okay. Although I had to remove some frosting, even from the small ones, the frosting was still quite sweet. I bought the large ones for tonight’s dinner, but I couldn’t finish even one cupcake. They were so dry that it surprised me. And the ratio of frosting to cake was too high. Too sweet! Or maybe the dry and flavorless cake was the problem. I thought this product was of good quality, but it isn’t! For the price, I definitely won’t buy it again.
original: Soooooooo disappointed in the cupcakes I bought last night. Bought 4 large and 2 mini about $20+. Ate the mini's on the way to the car, they were fine. Although I had to remove some of the frosting, even on the small ones it is pretty sweet. Got the big one's out for dessert tonight and could NOT finish a whole cupcake. They were so dry I was shocked. And the frosting to cake ratio was for me off. To SWEET! Or maybe it was the dry flavorless cake that was the problem. I thought this product was baked on sight!? Needless to say for the price I wont be going back!

text: Um delicioso matcha latte e um lugar muito charmoso por dentro. Com certeza voltarei, para passar um tempo neste ambiente agradável.
text_en: A delicious matcha latte and a very charming interior. I will definitely come back to spend some time in this pleasant environment.

text:
He estado en Las Vegas varias veces, pero nunca antes había buscado un lugar para desayunar o comprar donuts. Por alguna razón, lo hice esta vez, ¡y probablemente fue la mejor decisión de mi vida! Probablemente los mejores donuts (de alta calidad) que he probado. Están ubicados en el centro, cerca de la calle Fremont (en inglés). Cuando llegamos allí un sábado por la mañana, alrededor de las 9 de la mañana, parece que su famoso pastel de fresas o lo que fuera se había agotado :(, pero pudimos probar algunos donuts increíbles.
1. Crème brûlée: Intentan recrear el postre original, y no defraudan. Normalmente no me gustan los donuts con relleno de crema, pero este era ligero y dulce a la vez.
2. Oreo / Pastel de cumpleaños: Tenían exactamente el sabor que indican.
3. Un tipo de donut relleno de fresas.
Los tres eran increíbles, viniendo de alguien que suele preferir los donuts de chocolate y con glaseado. Lo más asombroso es que solo costaban alrededor de 2-3 dólares, así que espero que no suban los precios, ¡porque es una oferta increíble! Hay otros donuts de mayor calidad cerca de donde vivo, y definitivamente no se comparan con Donut Bar. ¡Probablemente se convertirá en uno de mis lugares favoritos en Las Vegas!
text_en:
I’ve been to Las Vegas several times, but never before I looked for a place to have breakfast or buy donuts. For some reason, I did it this time—and it was probably the best decision of my life! They were probably the best donuts (of high quality) I’ve ever tried. They’re located in the center, near Fremont Street (in English). When we arrived there on a Saturday morning, around 9 a.m., it seemed that their famous strawberry cake or whatever it was had run out :(, but we could still try some amazing donuts.

1. Crème brûlée: They try to recreate the original dessert, and they don’t disappoint. Usually, I don’t like donuts with cream filling, but this one was light and sweet at the same time.
2. Oreo/Christmas cake: They had exactly the flavor they claim.
3. A type of donut filled with strawberries.

All three were incredible, coming from someone who usually prefers chocolate donuts with glaze. What’s most surprising is that they only cost about 2-3 dollars each, so I hope the prices won’t go up—because it’s an incredible deal! There are other higher-quality donuts nearby where I live, but they definitely can’t compare to Donut Bar. It’s likely going to become one of my favorite places in Las Vegas!

text: I was so excited to go to Milk from all of the pictures i see on social media. I got 3 things at Milk. First since I am a cake lover I got a slice of Birthday Cake which is a vanilla rainbow cake, rainbow cake crumbs, sprinkles, vanilla frosting. The cake was moist and and the frosting did have a big vanilla taste but as far as cakes go it was a little underwhelming. Really nothing special with that slice of cake. The second thing I ordered was the Crunchy Cereal Shake which was made with milk, cornflakes, brown sugar and a pinch of salt. It did taste like cereal like I expected but all I really did was pay $9 to drink cereal, nothing special there either. The last thing I ordered which was the best thing was the Crack Pie. I can see why this is there fan favorite because it is addicting as if you were doing crack. Haha. The Crack Pie has a toasted oat crust and a gooey butter filling. So you get that crunch of the crust with that creamy gooey filling. This is the one thing you must have at Milk, but overall this place was pricey and not as exciting as it has been made out to be. BrandonFitFoodie

text: Have you really been to Charlotte if you haven't been to AMELIE'S?! Amelie's sits perfectly into NoDa and is a definitive part of Charlotte's Art District. Walking in, you are welcomed with friendly staff and tons of quirky decor. Mismatched furniture adds to its fun vibes and makes an overall welcoming and great place to hang out, relax, or get some work done. Of course, the desserts and other edibles and drinks are always a delight and the vast arrangement is extremely pleasing to the eye and will make you want to buy more desserts than your body could take. The macarons are always a classic and I have bought tons for a party before and they are definitely a crowd pleaser! The salted caramel brownie is a classic favorite and one of my new favorites. The tarts are amazing and the espresso cake has the perfect dash of coffee. They also make cakes when you need one for a big event and the prices aren't too bad! If you haven't been to Amelie's and you live in the Charlotte area or you are visiting and don't know where to go, well girllllllll (and guys), this is it!

text: Siempre he sido un gran fan de Jack Frost. Sus donuts son deliciosos y hermosos. Desafortunadamente, mi experiencia reciente no fue buena. El fin de semana pasado, intenté comprar donuts para dos eventos. El primero era un pedido de donuts de cannoli para una fiesta de cumpleaños, y el segundo era un pastel de donuts. Intenté realizar estos pedidos varias veces. Mis llamadas telefónicas no fueron contestadas, y cuando iba a hacer el pedido, la tienda estaba cerrada o ya no tenían donuts disponibles. Cuando finalmente llegué y encontré la tienda abierta, me dijeron que no podía hacer un pedido de pastel. Tendría que llamar al gerente. Realmente hice el pedido de los donuts de cannoli y pagué por ellos con anticipación. Varias horas después, el gerente me llamó y confirmé el pedido del pastel, pagándolo por teléfono como se solicitaba. Cuando llegué unos días después, me entregaron el pastel y me informaron que nunca había realizado el pedido de los donuts de cannoli. La mujer que me había dicho esto era la misma que había tomado mi pedido en persona y a quien había pagado. Intentó enviar un mensaje al gerente, quien nuevamente no estaba en la tienda. El gerente no contestó. Luego encontró el pedido y me dijo que no los habían hecho. Me dieron dos docenas de donuts, que no eran del tipo que quería, y me dijeron que el gerente me llamaría. He esperado una semana completa para escribir esta reseña, con la esperanza de que Jack Frost solucionara este problema, que al menos me llamaran y que ofrecieran hacer los donuts de cannoli. Hasta ahora, no me han contactado y, sinceramente, dudo que lo hagan. Aunque los donuts de Jack Frost son hermosos y deliciosos, no creo que vuelva a comprar allí. Su servicio al cliente es pésimo. Estoy realmente decepcionado con ellos.
text_en: I’ve always been a big fan of Jack Frost. Their donuts are delicious and beautiful. Unfortunately, my recent experience wasn’t good. Last weekend, I tried to order donuts for two events. The first was a request for cannoli donuts for a birthday party, and the second was a cake made of donuts. I tried making these orders several times. My calls weren’t answered, and when I went to place the order, the store was closed or there were no donuts available. When I finally got there and found the store open, they said I couldn’t place an order for the cake. I had to call the manager. I actually ordered the cannoli donuts and paid for them in advance. Several hours later, the manager called me and confirmed the order for the cake, paying by phone as requested. A few days later, I received the cake, but they told me that they never made the cannoli donuts order. The woman who said this was the same person who took my order in person and paid for it. She tried to send a message to the manager, but he wasn’t in the store. The manager didn’t answer. Then he found the order and said they hadn’t made it. They gave me two dozen donuts, which weren’t the type I wanted, and said the manager would call me. I waited a whole week to write this review, hoping that Jack Frost would resolve this issue, at least call me and offer to make the cannoli donuts. So far, they haven’t contacted me, and honestly, I doubt they will. Although Jack Frost’s donuts are beautiful and delicious, I don’t think I’ll buy from them anymore. Their customer service is terrible. I’m really disappointed with them.

Last weekend I attempted to purchase donuts for two events. The first was a order of cannoli donuts for a birthday party and the second was a donut cake. I attempted to place these orders several times. My repeated phone calls went unanswered and when I'd stop in to place the order, the shop would be sold out and closed. When I finally went there and found them open, I was told that I could not place a cake order. The manager would have to call me. I did place the order for the cannoli donuts and paid for them in advance. Several hours later the manager called me and I placed the cake order, paying for it over the phone as required. When I arrived a few days later, they gave me the cake and informed me that I had never placed the order for the cannoli donuts. The woman who had told me this was the same one who had taken my order in person and who I had paid. She attempted to text the manager who was once again not in the shop. The manager did not answer. She then found the order and told me they weren't made. She gave me two dozen donuts, which were not the type I wanted, and told me the manager would call me. I've waited an entire week to write this review, hoping that Jack Frost would correct this issue, that I'd at least get a call from the manager and that they'd offer to make me the cannoli donuts. They have not contacted me and at this point, I doubt they will. While Jack Frost's donuts are beautiful and delicious, I don't see myself returning. Their customer service is terrible. I'm truly disappointed in them.

Es un café muy agradable en Little Italy, ideal para ir con amigos, en una cita, o incluso solo para trabajar.

Truthfully, I don’t really enjoy eating much, but I usually go to this bakery for its bread, cakes, and cookies. It’s a very pleasant coffee spot in Little Italy—ideal for going out with friends, for a date, or even just for working.

text: Uno de los mejores lugares para comer helado en el valle y posiblemente en todo el estado de Arizona. Yo pedí helado de miel y lavanda, y mi esposo pidió uno de chocolate y sorbete de acai. Cada porción también incluye una galleta de azúcar con forma de waffle, que es un detalle adicional. No sé cómo explicarlo, pero su helado es simplemente fresco, cremoso y perfecto. El encargado del mostrador es amable y atento con cada cliente, a pesar de que las colas suelen ser largas. Podría agilizar las transacciones, pero no lo hace. Y no se preocupe, no tendrá que esperar mucho. Simplemente vaya a Novel cuando quiera comer helado o postre, ¡y no dude!
text_en: One of the best places to eat ice cream in the valley—and possibly throughout all of Arizona. I ordered honey and lavender ice cream, while my husband chose chocolate and acai sorbet. Each serving also includes a waffle-shaped sugar cookie—a nice extra detail. I don’t know how to describe it, but their ice cream is simply fresh, creamy, and perfect. The staff at the counter is friendly and attentive to every customer, even though the lines are often long. They could speed up the transactions, but they don’t do so. And don’t worry—you won’t have to wait long. Just go to Novel whenever you want to eat ice cream or dessert, and don’t hesitate!
original: One of the best ice cream spots in the valley and possibly the state of Arizona. I had the honey lavender ice cream and my husband had the chocolate and the acai sorbet. Each cup comes with a complimentary little waffle sugar cookie, too. I can't explain it - their ice cream is just fresh and creamy and perfect. The guy running the cashier is friendly and welcoming to each and every customer, even though their lines are quite long! He could rush through each transaction, but he doesn't. And that's not to say you'll be waiting long. Just go to Novel when you want ice cream or dessert, and do not hesitate!

text: Vine aquí para decir la "frase secreta" que encontré en Facebook para obtener un cupcake gratis. Pensé que sería un proceso rápido, así que me fui de Yardhouse para ver si la frase funcionaba. Había una fila de unas 3 personas delante de mí, así que decidí esperar. Mientras la pareja delante de mí estaba haciendo su pedido, pensé que el siguiente empleado disponible podría ayudarme. Ella dijo que podía ayudar, pero no podía empaquetar mi pedido. Otro supervisor o gerente dijo que podía ponerse guantes y ayudarme, así que le dije la frase secreta del día y me dieron un cupcake gratis. El proceso aún tomó más tiempo de lo que pensaba. Tal vez esto se deba a que es un negocio relativamente nuevo y todavía están en fase de aprendizaje. He pasado por Sprinkles en varias ocasiones y ver la fila me desanima, la fila comienza afuera y continúa adentro. Creo que después de mi última experiencia y esperar mucho tiempo por un solo cupcake con solo 3 personas delante de mí, no me atrevería a esperar de nuevo. El cupcake estaba delicioso (era un chai latte) y sabía exactamente como un chai latte con glaseado de queso crema, no demasiado dulce. También me gusta cómo sirven el helado, algo que nunca he visto en ninguna otra sucursal de Sprinkles. Sin embargo, volveré, pero no quiero esperar en una larga fila con barreras como si fuera a entrar a un club. Entiendo que hay que esperar por cosas que son muy demandadas, pero estos son cupcakes, y ya están hechos. Los cupcakes son como el helado y las galletas, una vez que los ves, quieres o los quieres de inmediato. Intentaré el "dispensador de cupcakes", quizás sea más mi estilo, cupcakes rápidos y fáciles de obtener! *Excelente ubicación, muchos restaurantes y bares a su alrededor, y Sprinkles es una excelente manera de terminar el día/noche.
text_en: I came here to share the “secret phrase” I found on Facebook that allows me to get a free cupcake. I thought it would be a quick process, so I left Yardhouse just to see if it worked. There was a line of about 3 people in front of me, so I decided to wait. While the couple in front of me made their order, I thought maybe another employee could help me. She said she could help, but couldn’t pack my order. Another supervisor or manager said they could put on gloves and help me, so I told them the secret phrase for the day, and they gave me a free cupcake. However, the process took longer than I expected. Maybe it’s because it’s a relatively new business and they’re still learning the ropes. I’ve been to Sprinkles several times, and seeing the line really discourages me—the line starts outside and goes inside. After my last experience and waiting so long for just one cupcake with only 3 people in front of me, I wouldn’t dare wait again. The cupcake was delicious (it was a chai latte), and it tasted exactly like a chai latte with cream cheese frosting—not too sweet. I also like how they serve ice cream; something I’ve never seen anywhere else at Sprinkles. However, I will go back, but I don’t want to wait in a long line with barriers like entering a club. I understand you have to wait for things that are very popular, but these are just cupcakes—they’re already ready. Cupcakes are like ice cream and cookies—once you see them, you want them right away. I’ll try the “cupcake dispenser” – maybe that’s more my style: quick and easy to get cupcakes! *Great location, with many restaurants and bars around, and Sprinkles is a great way to end the day/evening.*

text: I was excited when it was announced that Sprinkles was coming to Vegas. I used to frequent their Newport Beach location when I lived in California, and thought they were the best cupcakes ever!! So we waited a few months before coming here. I had heard from a few people that the lines were ridiculously long and that the cupcakes were not very good. I thought ok, maybe they just need some time to get their sh!t together. My husband and I finally stopped in after eating dinner at the Yard House and riding the High Roller. When you walk in, you will notice that cupcakes are on the left and ice cream is on the right. I ended up buying 4 cupcakes, but was kind of disappointed when I ate them at home. The cake wasn't as moist and the frosting wasn't as tasty as I remember. :( However, my husband ordered the sprinkles sundae, which was actually pretty good! Ok, so its just a cupcake cut in half with a scoop of ice cream in the middle. I don't know if the milk chocolate cupcakes were just fantastic that day, or if ice cream just makes them that much better. But I highly recommend the sundae if you are going to spend your $ here! Overall, I am disappointed that they are not as good as I remember. Customer service on the ice cream side needs improvement since none of them were greeting customers and it basically seemed like they didn't care. Plus, the location is inconvenient for us locals who don't really spend time on the strip!
