Existem muitos lugares para comer sobremesas em Las Vegas, e o Sprinkles é, sem dúvida, o melhor. Com certeza voltarei lá. **Esta avaliação foi escrita por meu filho de 8 anos.**
text_en: I highly recommend Sprinkles for desserts, as they offer many options for cupcakes and ice cream. My sister and I love them. There are many places to eat desserts in Las Vegas, and Sprinkles is undoubtedly the best. I will definitely go back there. **This review was written by my 8-year-old son.**
original: I would really recommend sprinkles for dessert they have so many choices of cupcakes and ice cream me and my sister loved it. There are so many dessert places in Vegas sprinkles is the best one for sure I will definitely be there again **This review was written by my 8 year old

text: Estaba buscando una panadería en la zona y esta apareció. Pasaba por este lugar muchas veces, pero nunca supe que existía. Este lugar tiene una selección muy original (en cuanto a sabores) de cupcakes, pasteles, parfaits, postres horneados y brownies. Adoro sus diseños de crema de mantequilla modernos y rústicos. También aprecio que ofrezcan opciones sin gluten. Si buscas un sabor simple de vainilla, este lugar no es para ti. Compré 6/7 artículos aquí. Ofrecen una buena variedad de cupcakes, tartas y brownies. La crema de mantequilla de los cupcakes es deliciosa. No es demasiado dulce, pero sí muy ligera. Si te gustan las arándanos, prueba su crumble de avena y arándanos. De lo contrario, no te equivocarás con sus brownies de chocolate. ¡Es uno de los mejores brownies que he probado!
text_en: I was looking for a bakery in the area, and this one appeared. I passed by this place many times, but never knew it existed. This place has a very unique selection of cupcakes, cakes, parfaits, baked desserts, and brownies. I love their modern yet rustic buttercream designs. I also appreciate that they offer gluten-free options. If you're looking for a simple vanilla flavor, this place isn’t for you. I bought 6/7 items here. They have a wide variety of cupcakes, tarts, and brownies. The buttercream on the cupcakes is delicious. It’s not too sweet, but it’s very light. If you like raisins, try their oat and raisin crumble. Otherwise, you won’t go wrong with their chocolate brownies. It’s one of the best brownies I’ve ever tried!
original: Was scrambling to look for a bakery in the area and this popped up. Been driving pass this place so many times and never knew that they existed. This place has a very unique selection (in terms of flavors) of cupcakes, cakes, parfait, baked pastries and brownies. I adore their modern and rustic buttercream designs. I also appreciate that they offer gluten free options. I gotta say, if you're looking for plain vanilla, this place is not for you. I got 6/7 items from here. They're a good mix of cupcakes, pies and brownies. The buttercream on the cupcakes are delicious! Not overly sweet yet very light. If you're a fan of blueberries, try their blueberry oatmeal crumble. Otherwise, you won't go wrong with their chocolate brownies. It's one of the best brownies I've tasted!

text: Whenever I go to the LINQ, I always have to stop by Sprinkles. I didn't realize how much I went to this place until I saw how many photos I had of the same cupcake. I always get a "Sprinkles Sundae" with their dark chocolate or sprinkle cupcake & dark chocolate or triple chocolate ice cream. I personally don't get anything more than that. It's expensive & I wouldn't buy a dozen, but if I want a quick sweet treat at the LINQ, it's good. They have a schedule for what flavors they have on each day so if you want something in particular, be sure to go on a day that it's there.
text_en: Whenever I go to the LINQ, I always have to stop by Sprinkles. I didn't realize how much I went to this place until I saw how many photos I had of the same cupcake. I always get a "Sprinkles Sundae" with their dark chocolate or sprinkle cupcake & dark chocolate or triple chocolate ice cream. I personally don't get anything more than that. It's expensive & I wouldn't buy a dozen, but if I want a quick sweet treat at the LINQ, it's good. They have a schedule for what flavors they have on each day so if you want something in particular, be sure to go on a day that it's there.

text: This place has so many flavors, it puts DQ to shame. So cheap, great vintage feel, outdoor seating. Short drive off campus.
text_en: This place has so many flavors, it puts DQ to shame. So cheap, great vintage feel, outdoor seating. Short drive off campus.

text: Sempre gelatos deliciosos e eles têm opções que meus filhos, que são exigentes, adoram. Um lugar muito agradável para comer gelatos em Old Brooklyn, perto de Cleveland. Delicioso!
text_en: Always delicious ice cream, and they have options that my demanding children love. A very pleasant place to eat ice cream in Old Brooklyn, near Cleveland. Delicious!
original: Always good ice cream & they have something my choosy kids love. A very nice ice cream place in Old Brooklyn, close to Cleveland. Delicious!

text: He escuchado en varias ocasiones que "Sprinkles Cupcakes es solo una moda pasajera", "no son muy buenos", "son otra cadena más". Bueno, lo siento, pero si alguien te dice eso, elimínalo de tus amigos. No necesitas ese tipo de negatividad en tu vida. ESTOS CUPCAKES ERAN DELICIOSOS. Húmedos, frescos, la cantidad perfecta de glaseado. Además, son muy bonitos a la vista. Me presentaron estos cupcakes por dos hombres grandes y corpulentos. ¡Eso tiene que significar algo! Y el hecho de que puedas hacer un helado con un cupcake es un cambio radical. Disculpe mientras busco un local de Sprinkles cerca de mí, ¡ahora mismo!
text_en: I’ve heard several times that “Sprinkles Cupcakes is just a passing trend”, “they’re not very good”, “it’s just another chain”. Well, I’m sorry, but if someone says that to you, remove them from your friends list. You don’t need that kind of negativity in your life. THESE CUPCAKES WERE DELICIOUS. Wet, fresh, with just the right amount of frosting. Plus, they look really nice. I was introduced to these cupcakes by two tall and muscular men. That must mean something! And the fact that you can make ice cream with a cupcake is a real innovation. Sorry, I need to find a Sprinkles store near me right now!
original: I've heard on more than one occasion that "Sprinkles Cupcakes is just a fad" "They're not that good" "Just another chain" Um, I'm sorry but if someone's says that to you, unfriend them. You don't need that kind of negativity in your life. THESE CUPCAKES WERE TO DIE FOR. Moist. Fresh. Perfect amount of frosting. Not to mention pretty to look at. I was introduced to these cupcakes by two big burly men. That has GOT to say something! And the fact you can make a cupcake ice cream sundae is a freakin' game changer. Excuse me while I locate a Sprinkes location near me like, now.

text: Not too impressed with the prices or quality of this semi new ice cream place. The lone asian women behind the counter was nice, but this shop immediately reminded me of one of those asian donut shops you see in every city. The donuts in those places are not usually good and the ice cream here was less than memorable as well. First off, make the size of the sundae bigger or lower the $6.50 price of that sundae. It's not even a sundae technically because it has no syrup. You get two small scoops of bad ice cream (i needed to try 5 flavors to find decent one), two stale macaroons and that "famous" toasted marshmallow. One person with me had a bad aftertaste for at least an hour after the nutella. My flavor was cinnamon toast crunch, which like many flavors, are just vanilla with cereal tossed inside. If your gonna overpay for ice cream, go to creamistry. BTW , If you go non sundae, prices are normal.
text_en: Not too impressed with the prices or quality of this semi new ice cream place. The lone asian women behind the counter was nice, but this shop immediately reminded me of one of those asian donut shops you see in every city. The donuts in those places are not usually good and the ice cream here was less than memorable as well. First off, make the size of the sundae bigger or lower the $6.50 price of that sundae. It's not even a sundae technically because it has no syrup. You get two small scoops of bad ice cream (i needed to try 5 flavors to find decent one), two stale macaroons and that "famous" toasted marshmallow. One person with me had a bad aftertaste for at least an hour after the nutella. My flavor was cinnamon toast crunch, which like many flavors, are just vanilla with cereal tossed inside. If your gonna overpay for ice cream, go to creamistry. BTW , If you go non sundae, prices are normal.

text: Um estabelecimento muito agradável, exatamente o que eu procurava: um lugar acolhedor, com sorvete aprovado pela "vovó italiana". Quebre sua dieta e experimente o marshmallow grelhado, pedi a Lana, a simpática senhora responsável pela "fornalha poderosa". Ela concordou, e o resultado foi simplesmente fantástico.
text_en: A very pleasant establishment—exactly what I was looking for: a warm and welcoming place, with ice cream approved by the “Italian grandmother”. Break your diet and try the grilled marshmallows. Ask Lana, the friendly woman in charge of the “powerful oven”, to prepare them. She agreed, and the result was simply fantastic.
original: Very nice establishment, just what I wanted, a homey establishment with Italiana nonna approved gelato. Break your diet and get the torched marshmallow, I asked Lana, the sweet lady that holds power of the mighty torch to burnt it a little well done, she obliged and the result is F`a`n`t`a`s`t`i`c`a`l`.

text: Me alegra que hayan vuelto a la zona. El joven que nos atendió fue muy amable. Sigue siendo el mismo helado delicioso.
text_en: I’m glad they’ve returned to the area. The young person who served us was very kind. It’s still the same delicious ice cream.
original: Glad they are back in the neighborhood. The young man who waited on us was very friendly. Still the same great ice cream.

text: Eu amo comida e a satisfação de saber que cada prato é preparado diariamente, o que garante um excelente atendimento ao cliente. Também gosto de ver a qualidade dos alimentos, que são provenientes da região leste dos Estados Unidos.
text_en: I love food, and I enjoy the satisfaction of knowing that each dish is prepared daily, which ensures excellent customer service. I also appreciate the quality of the ingredients, which come from the eastern part of the United States.
original: I love food and the detest that I pay every time the are made fresh every day so the customer service is always good and love see in the windows also that we know what we are revive good quality food from back east coast

text: Eu experimento diferentes sabores de sorvete em cada estado que visito. O Handel's é delicioso. Gosto muito do sabor de Nutter Butter. Não gosto muito dos sabores de torta que eles oferecem. Vale a pena visitar! Acho que eles têm promoções às terças-feiras.
text_en: I try different flavors of ice cream in each state I visit. Handel’s is delicious. I really like the Nutter Butter flavor. I don’t like the cake flavors they offer very much. It’s worth visiting! I think they have promotions on Tuesdays.
original: I try ice cream in every state I visit. Handel's is delicious. I really like the Nutter Butter flavor. I do not like their pie flavors. Worth a visit! I think they have specials on Tuesdays.

text: Sin duda, ¡el mejor helado de la ciudad! La cola es bastante larga, pero se mueve rápido. Tanto el helado de chocolate como el de chips de menta estaban deliciosos.
text_en: Without a doubt, the best ice cream in the city! The cone is quite long, but it moves quickly. Both the chocolate ice cream and the mint chip ice cream were delicious.
original: Hands down the best ice cream in town! Long line moves quite quickly. Chocolate and the mint chip were both delicious!

text: This place is just the bomb!!! Love all different flavors and Tuesday specials!!! Everyone is friendly
text_en: This place is just the bomb!!! Love all different flavors and Tuesday specials!!! Everyone is friendly

text: O que mais se pode dizer, além de que este pequeno lugar oferece sorvetes deliciosos e criativos, que valem a pena experimentar! Eu sempre peço duas porções (já que são bem grandes) e é importante experimentar vários sabores antes de escolher. Na minha última visita, experimentei sorvete de amêndoa com manteiga e de batata doce com marshmallow caramelizado. Ambos estavam excelentes, mas o de manteiga de amêndoa foi o melhor. Além disso, não se esqueça do sorvete no cone de waffle, pois tanto o cheiro quanto o sabor são deliciosos. Mesmo com o inverno se aproximando, pretendo voltar aqui em breve.
text_en: What else can be said? This little place offers delicious and creative ice creams that are worth trying! I always order two portions (since they’re quite large), and it’s important to try several flavors before choosing one. During my last visit, I tried almond butter ice cream with butter, and sweet potato ice cream with caramelized marshmallows. Both were excellent, but the almond butter ice cream was the best. Also, don’t forget the ice cream in waffle cones—both the smell and taste are delightful. Even as winter approaches, I plan to come back here soon.
original: What can you say except this awesome little place serves up some great and creative ice cream flavors that are worth checking out! I always go for the two half scoops (as they are huge) and be sure to get several samples before selecting your flavors. My last trip there I got brown butter almond brittle and sweet potato with torched marshmellows. Both were solid with the brown butter taking the cake. Also be sure not to sleep on the waffle cone as they both smell and taste delicious. Even now when winter is coming, I'll expect to stop back by here sometime soon.

text: Adoro este lugar! É um ótimo local para relaxar, ler, estudar, conversar ou simplesmente navegar na internet no computador ou iPad. A comida é excelente, e a única reclamação é que às vezes fica muito cheio, mas isso é apenas prova de quão bom é o lugar! Está aberto 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, o que foi de grande ajuda, já que sou mãe solteira e estava cursando enfermaria!
text_en: I love this place! It’s an excellent spot for relaxing, reading, studying, chatting, or just browsing the internet on a computer or iPad. The food is great, and the only complaint is that it can get very crowded sometimes. But that just proves how great this place is! It’s open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, which was very helpful since I’m a single mother and were studying nursing!
original: Love this place! Great place to relax and read or study or chat or just surf the web on your computer or iPad. Food is great only gripe is how crowded it gets but that's just testimony to how good the place is! It's open 24/7 which was a tremendous help being a single mom who was in nursing school!

text: Fuimos por primera vez el fin de semana pasado. Probé el postre de chocolate oscuro con cerezas. ¡Estaba delicioso! Además, el ambiente es muy agradable.
text_en: We went for the first time last weekend. I tried the dark chocolate dessert with cherry pie. It was delicious! Moreover, the atmosphere is very pleasant.
original: We went here for the first time last weekend. I had the dark chocolate, cherry bread pudding. It was amazing. The atmosphere is great too.

text: I had the Canoli Cake the small one and it was pretty good as well as the triple chocolate chip cookie and some nut bar. The treats were quite delicious, but I think that for the price it's not really worth it. You're paying for the name of who's on it more than what you're getting.
text_en: I had the Canoli Cake the small one and it was pretty good as well as the triple chocolate chip cookie and some nut bar. The treats were quite delicious, but I think that for the price it's not really worth it. You're paying for the name of who's on it more than what you're getting.

text: Sus pasteles siempre son frescos y crujientes. Los sabores y tipos son únicos. Ideales para un desayuno especial o un postre para celebrar.
text_en: Their pastries are always fresh and crispy. The flavors and types are unique. Perfect for a special breakfast or a dessert to celebrate.
original: Their pastries are alway fresh and flakey. The flavors and type are unique. Great for that special brunch or dessert to celebrate with

text: No se podría imaginar que una heladería pequeña y sencilla funcione en Las Vegas, ya que hace tanto calor que la gente intenta evitar el sol... pero sí que funciona. La mejor heladería de la ciudad.
text_en: It’s hard to imagine a small and simple ice cream shop operating in Las Vegas, as it’s so hot that people try to avoid the sun… but it does work. It’s the best ice cream shop in the city.
original: You wouldn't think that a walk up ice cream shop would work in Las Vegas because it's SO HOT people are trying to get out of the heat... but it does. Best ice cream in town.

text: Love this place. Their taro ice cream is amazing! My boyfriend loves their halo halo. Definitely recommend this spot for a sweet treat.
text_en: Love this place. Their taro ice cream is amazing! My boyfriend loves their halo halo. Definitely recommend this spot for a sweet treat.

text: Un lugar agradable para visitar. Me encantó el arte en el baño. El personal es muy amable y tienen unos donuts deliciosos. El dispensador de leche es una gran novedad. Recomiendo el donut de tostadas francesas. Además, es un lugar ideal para familias con niños. A mi hijo le encantó su donut de Capitán América. 5/5, ¡lo recomiendo!
text_en: A pleasant place to visit. I loved the art in the bathroom. The staff are very friendly, and they have delicious donuts. The milk dispenser is a great addition. I recommend the French toast donut. It’s also an ideal place for families with children. My son loved his Captain America donut. 5/5, I highly recommend it!
original: Just a fun place to visit. Really enjoyed the art in the bathroom. They are so friendly and have great donuts. The milk on tap is pretty cool. Would recommend the French toast donut. They are very kid friendly as well. My son loved his Captain America donut. 5/5 would recommend.

text: The ice cream here is pretty good, but what ice cream place has bad ice cream when you really think about it? Definitely worth going to if the line isn't out the door, but if it's longer than 10 people out the door I would not say it's worth waiting for, unless you're really hell-bent on having ice cream.
text_en: The ice cream here is pretty good, but what ice cream place has bad ice cream when you really think about it? Definitely worth going to if the line isn't out the door, but if it's longer than 10 people out the door I would not say it's worth waiting for, unless you're really hell-bent on having ice cream.

text: Solo he estado aquí dos veces hasta ahora, y ya es una de mis heladerías locales favoritas. Las donas y el helado ya son una combinación perfecta, ¡y es aún mejor con las donas recién horneadas y los sabores artesanales de Novel! Además, una encantadora casita rosa en el centro de Phoenix, ¡y listo! Elegir un sabor es realmente difícil para mí, y siempre tienen muchísimas opciones. El sabor a miel y lavanda es increíble, pero siempre tendré un lugar especial en mi corazón para el chai. Afortunadamente, se pueden combinar dos sabores en una dona. Todos los demás sabores que he probado también han sido deliciosos. De verdad, no hay nada como un helado y una dona con glaseado. La única desventaja es que el helado se derrite muy rápido, especialmente si vas durante el día en verano. Brandon y su esposa son tan amables y entusiastas con el negocio, y estoy muy contenta de que hayan traído Novel y los helados en forma de donas a Phoenix. ¡Definitivamente los traeré a mis amigos cada vez que tengamos antojo de helado (que siempre)! Helado fresco, donas deliciosas y personas increíbles detrás del negocio, ¿qué más se puede pedir? ¡Apoyemos un negocio local! ¡Recomiendo encarecidamente este lugar!
text_en: I’ve only been here twice so far, but it’s already become one of my favorite local ice cream shops. The donuts and ice cream together make a perfect combination—and it’s even better with freshly baked donuts and the handcrafted flavors from Novel! Plus, there’s a lovely pink house in the center of Phoenix—that’s it! Choosing a flavor is really difficult for me, but they always have plenty of options. The honey and lavender flavor is incredible, but I’ll always have a special place in my heart for the chai flavor. Thankfully, two flavors can be combined in one donut. All the other flavors I’ve tried were also delicious. There’s really nothing like ice cream with donuts and frosting. The only downside is that the ice cream melts very quickly, especially during summer days. Brandon and his wife are very kind and enthusiastic about the business, and I’m glad they brought Novel and donut-style ice cream to Phoenix. I’ll definitely bring them to my friends whenever we feel like having ice cream (which happens all the time!). Fresh ice cream, delicious donuts, and amazing people behind the business—what more could you ask for? Let’s support local businesses! I highly recommend this place!
original: I've only been here twice so far and it's already one of my favorite local ice cream shops! Doughnuts and ice cream are already a match made in heaven - it's even more amazing with Novel's freshly baked donuts and artisan ice cream flavors! Add a cute little pink house in downtown Phoenix and you're set! Choosing a flavor is honestly so hard for me, and they always have so many to choose from. The honey lavender flavor is amazing, but I'll always have a special place in my heart for chai. Luckily, you can put two flavors in your donut!! Every other flavor I've sampled has been delicious as well. You just really can't go wrong with ice cream and a glazed donut! The only real downside is that the ice cream melts so quickly, especially if you go during the day in the summer! Brandon and his wife are SO sweet and enthusiastic about the business and I'm so, so glad they brought Novel and donut ice cream sandwiches to Phoenix!! Definitely bringing friends here anytime we're craving ice cream (which is always!) Fresh ice cream, delicious donuts, and some amazing people behind the olace, what more could you want?! Support a local business!! Highly, highly recommend this place!!

text: Este lugar é excelente. Os desertos são ótimos, e os sanduíches também. Tem um estilo industrial e rústico muito interessante. É um lugar amplo e movimentado. Gostaria que tivesse uma filial em Boston, provavelmente em Somerville, Allston ou Cambridge.
text_en: This place is excellent. The deserts are great, and the sandwiches too. It has a very interesting mix of industrial and rustic styles. It’s a spacious and busy location. I would like to see a branch in Boston, probably in Somerville, Allston, or Cambridge.
original: This place is the best. Deserts are great and the sandwiches also. Very artsy industrial and raw. Plenty of space and busy. Wish they had one Boston, prob in Somerville, Allston or Cambridge.

text: Precisamos de atendimento mais eficiente! Esperei por 10 minutos e precisei perguntar para outros clientes o que eles queriam. Domingo à noite... Precisa de ajuda! Um sistema de filas ou números seria uma ótima solução!
text_en: We need more efficient service! I waited for 10 minutes and had to ask other customers what they wanted. Sunday night… We need help! A queue or number system would be a great solution!
original: Need a little smarter girls working in here!!! Waited for 10 min and kept going to friends to see what they wanted!!!! Sunday night... Needs help!!!!! A line or number system would be a smart move!!!

text: Chegamos por volta das 21h e o lugar ainda estava cheio, com um público mais composto por jovens estilosos, com um senso de estilo único. Pedimos uma fatia de bolo de chocolate para dividir, que estava muito bom, mas não valia a pena voltar por mais. Minha esposa pediu chá, que acabou sendo chá preto, eu esperava algo mais diferente, mas ela disse que estava bom. Eu, por outro lado, pedi um café expresso pequeno, que tinha um gosto horrível. É um lugar legal, mas eu não recomendaria para um amigo.
text_en: We arrived at around 9 PM, and the place was still full. The audience consisted mainly of stylish young people with a unique style. We ordered a slice of chocolate cake to share, which was very good, but it wasn’t worth coming back for more. My wife asked for tea, which turned out to be black tea. I expected something different, but she said it was fine. As for me, I ordered a small espresso, which tasted awful. It’s a nice place, but I wouldn’t recommend it to a friend.
original: Came in around 9pm and the place was still busy, more of a quiet hipster crowd with a unique sense of style. We got a piece if chocolate cake to share which was very good, nothing to run back for but good. My wife got tea which ended up being tazo tea, I thought it would be something more non commercial but she said it was good. I on the other hand got a small french press coffee that tasted gross. It's a cool little place but I wouldn't tell my friend you have to try it.

text: Their croissant was delish!! And their coffee was great too. Solid bakery for early morning bites when restaurants haven't opened yet.
text_en: Their croissant was delish!! And their coffee was great too. Solid bakery for early morning bites when restaurants haven't opened yet.

text: This location is very small with only a handful of selections. There were 6 different macaroons to choose from. I got the coffee & pistachio, both had a great smell & taste. However, the texture was not the same. This place was not appetizing at all. Yountville, CA location definitely has everything to perfection & the selection is limitless.
text_en: This location is very small with only a handful of selections. There were 6 different macaroons to choose from. I got the coffee & pistachio, both had a great smell & taste. However, the texture was not the same. This place was not appetizing at all. Yountville, CA location definitely has everything to perfection & the selection is limitless.

text: Este lugar era realmente increíble. Te sirven el helado en un tipo de caja para llevar estilo chino, con una galleta de la suerte encima. Los sabores son diferentes. Pedí uno de mantequilla de cacahuete y mermelada, o simplemente mantequilla de cacahuete. No recuerdo exactamente, pero por alguna razón no me di cuenta de que habría mermelada y no me gustó. Aunque no soy muy fan de la mermelada, así que no te fíes de eso. Fuera de mi aversión a la mermelada, el helado estaba realmente delicioso. La tienda es pequeña y encantadora. Definitivamente tiene un ambiente diferente al que estoy acostumbrado. ¡Todo el mundo debería probar este lugar al menos una vez! Lo probé durante el "First Friday" de febrero. ¡Definitivamente está muy concurrido durante ese tiempo!
text_en: This place was really incredible. They serve ice cream in a Chinese-style carry-on box, with a lucky cookie on top. The flavors are different. I ordered one with peanut butter and jam, or just peanut butter alone. I don’t remember exactly, but for some reason I didn’t realize there would be jam, and I didn’t like it. Although I’m not really a fan of jam, so don’t rely on that. Other than my aversion to jam, the ice cream was really delicious. The store is small and charming. It definitely has a different atmosphere compared to what I’m used to. Everyone should try this place at least once! I visited it during February’s “First Friday.” It’s definitely very crowded during that time!
original: This place was pretty darn awesome. They put your ice cream in a Chinese to go box type deal with a fortune cookie on top. The flavors are different. I got ether pb and j or peanut butter. I don't remember but for some reason I didn't realize there was going to be jelly in there and I didn't like that. I'm not a big fan of jelly though so don't go off of that. Outside of me not liking jelly, it was really good. There store is small and cute. Definitely a different vibe than I'm used to. Everyone should try this place at least once! I tried it while at first Friday in February. It's definitely buzzing during that time!

text: Eu estava com vontade de tomar um milkshake, então decidi experimentar o Milk Bar em vez de ir a um dos outros lugares que costumo frequentar. Experimentei o milkshake "Birthday Cake" e estava delicioso! Recomendo muito. Não havia fila, então foi rápido e fácil. A única coisa que eu diria é que seria bom se a pessoa que estava atendendo tivesse sido um pouco mais simpática. Acho que ela não disse nenhuma palavra para mim, e definitivamente não sorriu.
text_en: I really wanted to have a milkshake, so I decided to try the Milk Bar instead of going to one of the other places I usually go. I tried the “Birthday Cake” milkshake, and it was delicious! I highly recommend it. There wasn’t a line, so it was quick and easy. The only thing I would say is that it would be better if the person serving us had been a little more friendly. I don’t think she said anything to me, and definitely didn’t smile.
original: I was craving a milkshake so decided to try Milk Bar instead of going to one of the other shake/ice cream places I normally go to. I had the Birthday Cake shake, and it was delicious! Highly recommend. There was no line so it was quick and easy. The only thing I'd say is it would be nice if the woman taking my order would have been a bit friendlier. I don't think she said 2 words to me, and she certainly didn't smile.

text: Sorvete caseiro, local e de qualidade. Este lugar é muito charmoso, e a equipe é sempre muito simpática. Há uma variedade de doces de estilo antigo, o que confere um charme retrô e vintage à sua visita. O sorvete é sempre excelente, assim como o delicioso cobertura de caramelo salgado, que já ganhou prêmios. (Uma cobertura rica e cremosa... preciso dizer mais?!) Há estacionamento limitado, mas há várias opções nas proximidades. Acho que todos podemos caminhar um quarteirão para pegar um sorvete... 😉 E se não, peça para alguém ir buscar! Não há mesas dentro, apenas ao ar livre na frente e atrás. Se você aprecia o charme local e está procurando por sorvetes, milkshakes, maltes ou biscoitos deliciosos, pare no Churn. P.S.: O sorvete de nozes com caramelo salgado é um dos meus favoritos!
text_en: Homemade ice cream, local and of good quality. This place is very charming, and the staff is always very friendly. There’s a variety of old-fashioned desserts, which adds a retro and vintage charm to your visit. The ice cream is always excellent, as is the delicious salty caramel topping, which has won awards. (A rich and creamy topping… do I need to say more?) There’s limited parking, but there are several options nearby. I think we can all walk just one block to get some ice cream… 😉 And if not, ask someone to come get it for you! There are no tables inside; only outdoor areas in front and behind. If you appreciate the local charm and are looking for ice cream, milkshakes, maltes, or delicious cookies, stop by Churn. P.S.: Walnut ice cream with salty caramel is one of my favorites!
original: Homemade, local, honest ice cream. This place is super cute, and the staff is always very friendly. There is an assortment of older style candy, brining in a nice retro-vintage-esque to your visit. The ice cream is always superb, as is their award winning salted caramel topping. (Rich, thick drizzle...need I say more?!) There is limited parking, but plenty nearby. I think we can all handle walking a block for ice cream ;).. And if not, have someone run in and grab it! There is no indoor seating, just outside in front and in back. If you appreciate local charm and are looking for some great ice cream, shakes, malts or cookies, make a pit stop at Churn. P.s. Butter Pecan & salted caramel topping is one of my favs!

text: I was originally just going to get one donut because my pastry threshold is usually one but after stepping inside Donut Bar you quickly realize how hard it is to just buy one. That's why we have two hands right, to double fist in morning sugar rushes? I ended up getting their signature Creme Brulee and a Nutella bar with a Cold Brew. If the donuts didn't do me in, the coffee did because it rocked my Friday morning. It was all so good I bought a round back for my co-workers to share the wealth. TIP: This cute, cramped donut shop is literally always popping so make sure you strategically find parking beforehand!

text: I've heard a lot about Milk Bar, which is a thought of David Chang of Momofuku fame. The interpretation is of the last milk from your favorite cereal in an ice cream format. We tried a sample, but had no room after a big dinner. I did buy an egg and cheddar with bacon breakfast muffin and a bagel bomb in a croissant like finish. The next day, the breakfast sandwiches only required a slight microwaving to get it deliciously hot. The menu was overwhelming, and I've seen lines all the way to the escalator. I have to admit I'm a David Chang fan, so just had to try this place out!

text: After thinking about getting ice cream for hours, while sitting in the couch and watching John Oliver, I decided to turn to Yelp and investigate my neighborhood options. As it turns out, there is quite the burgeoning ice cream scene here in Phoenix. Obviously, coming from ho-dunk Tucson, I was shocked to learn this. Though most of my shock was really pleasant surprise, I was quickly overcome by an overwhelming fear of making the wrong choice. Chrurn, being the highest rated was very alluring, but unfortunately, it didn't convincingly seem to be the most novel or hip. Other options looked like they were on the cutting edge. One even boasted a nitrogen infused shake. As I continued my yelpagation (yelp investigation) I eventually became paralyzed by the fear of picking another mediocre wannabe ice cream shop. Thus, as I write this review, I remain on the couch and have yet to actually endeavor out. Thanks yelp, for saving me from me another painful disappointment. Maybe one day I'll eventually work up the courage to try this hot spot that's really all rage. Until then, Stay calm yelpers and yelp-on.

text: Se você quer que sua sobremesa cremosa permaneça congelada, venha em fevereiro. Aqui, a sobremesa derrete assim que você a toca, e como alguém que detesta sorvete derretido, isso me parece bastante irritante. A variedade de sabores é grande, mas eles são um pouco avaros com os acompanhamentos. Novamente, essas sobremesas deveriam ser algo especial, mas na verdade são apenas sorvete com um pouco de leite. O preço por isso é um pouco alto. Se você gosta de sobremesas cremosas e saborosas, opte pela Culver's. Caso contrário, vá à Coldstone e compre um sorvete normal. O único ponto positivo é que ele manteve sua decoração e ambiente originais, o que é muito charmoso! Também adoro que seja um ponto de encontro para os moradores durante as noites quentes de verão. É definitivamente um lugar para visitar, mas talvez apenas uma vez.
text_en: If you want your creamy dessert to stay frozen, come in February. Here, the dessert melts as soon as you touch it, and since I hate melted ice cream, that’s quite annoying. There’s a wide variety of flavors, but they are a bit reluctant to offer any toppings. Again, these desserts should be special, but in reality, they’re just ice cream with some milk. The price is a bit high for that. If you like creamy and tasty desserts, go to Culver’s. Otherwise, go to Coldstone and buy regular ice cream. The only positive thing is that they kept their original decor and atmosphere, which is very charming! I also love that it’s a place where residents gather during hot summer nights. It’s definitely a place worth visiting, but maybe just once.
original: If you want your frozen custard to stay frozen, come in February. The custard here melts as soon as you breathe on it, and as someone who hates melted ice cream, I find this quite annoying. The variety of the snowstorms is plentiful but they are a bit stingy on the toppings. Again, these are supposed to be something of a Frosty but are actually just borderline sugar milk. The price for that is a bit hefty. If you like thick, flavorful custard, stick to Culver's. Otherwise just go to Coldstone and get freaking ice cream. The one redeeming point though is that it kept its vintage decor and feel, and that's super cute! I also love how its a central hubbub for townies during warm summer nights. It's definitely a place to visit, but maybe just once.

text: Experimentei o sabor "biscoito e hortelã", e fui informado de que é um dos mais populares. Entendo o porquê! Normalmente, não sou muito fã de sorvete de hortelã, mas o "biscoito e hortelã" definitivamente valeu a pena experimentar (e comprar)!
text_en: I tried the “cookie and mint” flavor, and I was told it’s one of the most popular ones. I understand why! Usually, I’m not very fond of mint ice cream, but the “cookie and mint” flavor definitely worth trying (and buying)!
original: Got the cookies n' mint, I was told it is one of their most well known flavors - I can see why! I'm usually not a fan of mint ice cream but the cookies n' mint was definitely worth trying (and getting)!

text: Apenas para complementar os ótimos comentários. Recomendo muito! Pessoas atenciosas, sorvete delicioso e momentos agradáveis. Presença de gatos de rua.
text_en: Just to add to the great comments. I highly recommend it! The people are attentive, the ice cream is delicious, and the time was pleasant. There were also street cats around.
original: Just adding to the great reviews. 11/10 recommend. Good people. Good ice cream. Good times. Outdoor cats.

text: Sorvete de morango com pimenta! A cor era rosa, como esperado, com um aroma característico de morango de verão. O primeiro sabor era predominantemente de morango, com uma textura cremosa e rica. Em seguida, a picância da pimenta chegou, o suficiente para ser saborosa, mas não tão forte a ponto de queimar ou exigir água. Um bom sorvete começa na cozinha, e a paixão deste chef pelo ofício se refletiu no meu cono de waffle. De resto, esses caras sabem fazer sorvete! A Mitchell's criou uma ótima lembrança para nossa viagem a Cleveland.
text_en: Strawberry ice cream with chili! It was pink in color, as expected, with a distinctive summer strawberry flavor. The first taste was mainly strawberry, with a creamy and rich texture. Then came the spiciness of the chili—enough to be tasty, but not so strong that it caused burning or required water. Good ice cream starts in the kitchen, and this chef’s passion for the craft is reflected in my waffle cone. Anyway, these guys really know how to make ice cream! Mitchell’s created a great memory for our trip to Cleveland.
original: Strawberry-jalapeno ice cream! The color was pink as expected, with a summer-strawberry aroma. The first taste was fruit-forward, all strawberry with a full-bodied creamy mouth-feel. Then the quick bite of jalapeno hit, just enough to be fully spicy, but not so much as to burn and grab for water. A great ice cream starts in the kitchen, and this chef's passion for the craft played out in my waffle cone. All kidding aside, these guys can make ice cream! Mitchell's created a great memory for our trip to Cleveland.

text: Um pouco difícil de encontrar, então fique de olho em um Carl's Jr., ele fica logo atrás! Ao lado de uma loja de tintas, não parece haver nada, mas assim que o encontrar, você terá os melhores macarons e sanduíches de sorvete que já experimentou! Além disso, o atendimento é excelente! Amei!

text: SEE ATTACHED PHOTOS!! Cleveland HOMEMADE Ice-Cream. I LOVE Honey Hut Ice-Cream. I visited the State Road location with my friend Lesly N. in early September 2019. Não é nada ruim. Os doces eram realmente ótimos e tínhamos muitas opções. Os preços eram altos. Mas é um lugar de propriedade local e estou mais disposto a pagar um pouco mais para apoiar os negócios locais. Senti que fui pressionado ao fazer o meu pedido. Não tinha ideia do que queria e precisei de tempo para analisar as opções. Nem sequer vi a opção vegetariana que eles ofereciam, o que seria exatamente o que eu preferia. Voltarei se algum dia voltar a Charlotte. Agora sei o que pedir.
text_en: We had a Thanksgiving dinner here… intentionally. We were driving through the city and thought it would be a good idea to try something different and local. I like the food; it’s not bad at all. The desserts were really great, and we had many choices. The prices were high, but it’s a place owned by locals, so I’m more willing to pay a little more to support local businesses. I felt pressured when making my order. I had no idea what I wanted, and I needed time to consider my options. I didn’t even see the vegetarian option they offered, which would have been exactly what I preferred. I’ll come back if I ever visit Charlotte again. Now I know what to order.

text: Acordamos tarde e fomos para essa festa na piscina sem comer nada. Foi tão divertido que nem pensei em comida. Depois de cinco horas sob o sol forte e caminhando pela Strip, minha irmã literalmente desmaiou no chão. Corri rapidamente (também com fome, não consegui correr) até o Bouchon e pedi um sanduíche de queijo grelhado e suco de laranja. O suco estava fresco e tenho certeza de que não adicionaram açúcar. Estava delicioso. O sanduíche de queijo estava bem untado e deve ter algum ingrediente secreto, porque estava incrível – ou talvez eu estivesse pensando assim por causa da fome. Minha irmã se recuperou rapidamente depois de beber o suco :)
text_en: We arrived late and went to that pool party without eating anything. It was so fun that I didn’t even think about food. After five hours under the strong sun and walking along the Strip, my sister literally fainted on the ground. I rushed quickly (also because I was hungry; I couldn’t run) to Bouchon and ordered a grilled cheese sandwich and orange juice. The juice was fresh, and I’m sure they didn’t add sugar. It was delicious. The grilled cheese was well coated with butter, and there must be some secret ingredient, because it was amazing—or maybe I just thought so because I was hungry. My sister recovered quickly after drinking the juice :)
original: We woke up late and went to this pool party without eating anything. Too much fun to think of food and then, after five hours under the hot sun, walking on the Strip, my sister literally collapsed on the ground. I walked fast (also hungry, couldn't run) to Bouchon and got a nice grilled cheese sandwich and orange juice. The juice was fresh and I am sure they didn't add any sugar. It was delicious. The grilled cheese was properly buttered and there must be an extra ingredient because that thing was the bomb - or maybe I thought so because I was starving. My sister recuperated quickly after drinking the juice :)

text_en: I consider myself an “expert” in donuts, and these are undoubtedly my favorites! From the fun and diverse flavors to the freshness, Jack Frost is unrivaled. Even regular donuts are simply amazing. But be careful! Go early to get the best selection, and although the parking might be a bit limited, it’s definitely worth it!
original: I would consider myself a donut snob and these are by far my favorite donuts! From all the fun and different flavors to the freshness, Jack Frost reigns supreme. Even just their normal donuts will totally rock your socks off. Just beware! Get there early to get the best selection and parking can be a bit tight but it's totally worth it!

text: Mi primera visita a Jarling's fue un sábado por la noche, después de una comida excelente en Thara Thai, también ubicada en Champaign. De hecho, había pasado por aquí en una ocasión anterior, mientras estaba en la zona de Champaign, pero no había parado. Investigué algunas opciones para postres en la zona, y parecía que Jarling's era muy popular. Al ir a Jarling's, sabía que quería pedir un "snowstorm" (similar al mezclador de concreto de Culver's, o el blizzard de DQ). También quería probar su famoso "chocolate frío", que es chocolate fundido, pero está frío y no derrite la crema (me lo explicó una chica que trabajaba allí). En cualquier caso, decidí pedir el "snowstorm" con la base de "tortuga". Al principio, me dieron el helado de tortuga, que debería haber empezado a comer, pero lo devolví. Supongo que se confundieron porque pregunté qué era el "chocolate frío", y el "chocolate frío" normalmente viene en los helados, pero de todas formas. Rápidamente lo cambiaron por un "snowstorm" con la base de "tortuga". También pedí una taza de helado con la base de pastel. Una "taza de oso" en Jarling's es una porción (equivalente a una cucharada) con 6 galletas de jengibre y una cereza. Una porción costaría 1,75, pero la "taza de oso" costaba 2,25. En mi opinión, no valía la pena. Para ser honesto, estaba un poco confundido con mi "snowstorm". Decía que era helado de crema de vainilla, aunque parecía que era de chocolate. La base de "tortuga" supuestamente tiene "chocolate frío", almendras y caramelo. Cuando trajeron el helado de tortuga equivocado, era helado de vainilla con una cobertura de "chocolate frío". Para mi "snowstorm", era de otro color, así que me confundí. Tampoco probé el caramelo, lo cual era lo que más esperaba. Fui aquí con mi hermano, y él pidió la misma "taza de oso", así como un "snowstorm" de "macaroon". Probé un poco del suyo, y estaba mucho mejor que el mío. Creo que se equivocaron con mi pedido, pero de todas formas, el helado estaba muy bueno. El helado con base de pastel no era nada especial, para ser honesto. No había trozos de pastel, ni ningún tipo de cobertura. Tienen una oferta semanal de sabores, junto con sus opciones habituales (ver su nuevo sitio web actualizado). Solo un comentario: llegamos a las 20:45 un sábado por la noche, y estaba bastante lleno. Hay varias mesas dentro, así como un servicio de comida para llevar. Decidimos pedir y ir a mi coche, que estaba aparcado en uno de los espacios de acceso. Mientras comíamos, dos camiones de bomberos de Wonder Lake se detuvieron a ambos lados de nosotros. Una chica que bajó de uno de los camiones decidió abrir la puerta de su coche en mi parte exterior, y ni siquiera se molestó en revisar nada. No estoy seguro de querer que respondiera a un incendio (nada contra Jarling's, pero ocurrió allí). 15 dólares por nuestros 4 platos. No estoy seguro de si pediré un "snowstorm" o un helado en mi próxima visita, pero volveré. Creo que la próxima vez debería haber pedido algo con coco, mantequilla de cacahuete o chocolate. Para ser honesto, me decepcionó mi "tortuga", pero volveré porque me encantan los postres, y preferiría este lugar a DQ, cualquier lugar de yogur o McD. De hecho, lo compararía con Culver's, pero me gusta apoyar a los negocios locales, y me gustaría saber si puedo mejorar mi experiencia.
text_en: My first visit to Jarling’s was on a Saturday night, after having an excellent meal at Thara Thai, which is also located in Champaign. In fact, I had been here before while in Champaign, but I didn’t stay long. I looked up some dessert options in the area, and it seemed that Jarling’s was very popular. When I went to Jarling’s, I knew I wanted to order a “snowstorm” – similar to the concrete mixer at Culver’s, or the blizzard at DQ. I also wanted to try their famous “cold chocolate,” which is melted chocolate, but it’s cold and doesn’t melt the cream (a girl who works there explained it to me). Anyway, I decided to order the “snowstorm” with a “turtle” base. At first, they gave me the turtle ice cream, which I should have started eating, but I returned it. I guess they got confused because I asked what the “cold chocolate” was; normally, cold chocolate comes with ice cream, but still. They quickly replaced it with a “snowstorm” with a “turtle” base. I also ordered a cup of ice cream with a cake base. A “polar bear cup” at Jarling’s is a portion equivalent to a spoonful, containing 6 ginger cookies and a cherry. One portion costs $1.75, but the “polar bear cup” costs $2.25. In my opinion, it wasn’t worth it. To be honest, I was a little confused about my “snowstorm.” I thought it was vanilla ice cream, but it seemed to be chocolate. The “turtle” base supposedly has cold chocolate, almonds, and caramel. When they brought back the wrong turtle ice cream, it was vanilla ice cream with a layer of cold chocolate on top. For my “snowstorm,” it was a different color, so I got confused. I didn’t even try the caramel, which I was really looking forward to. I went here with my brother, and he ordered the same “polar bear cup” as well as a “macaron snowstorm.” I tasted a little of his, and it was much better than mine. I think they got my order wrong, but still, the ice cream was very good. The ice cream with a cake base wasn’t anything special, to be honest. There were no pieces of cake or any kind of topping. They have a weekly menu of flavors, along with their usual options (check their updated website). Just one comment: we arrived at 8:45 PM on a Saturday night, and it was pretty full. There were several tables inside, as well as a takeout service. We decided to order and go to my car, which was parked in one of the access areas. While we were eating, two fire trucks from Wonder Lake stopped next to us. A girl who got out of one of the trucks decided to open the door of her car in my area, and she didn’t even bother checking anything. I’m not sure if I want her to respond to a fire (nothing against Jarling’s, but it happened there). $15 for our 4 dishes. I’m not sure if I’ll order a “snowstorm” or ice cream next time I visit, but I will come back. I think next time I should have ordered something with coconut, peanut butter, or chocolate. To be honest, my “turtle” was disappointing, but I will come back because I love desserts, and I prefer this place over DQ, any yogurt place, or McD. In fact, I would compare it to Culver’s, but I like to support local businesses, and I’d like to see if I can improve my experience.
original: My first visit to Jarling's was on a Saturday night after a great meal at Thara Thai, also located in Champaign. I'd actually driven past here on a previous occasion while in the Champaign area, but did not stop by. I did some research for dessert options in the area, and Jarling's seemed to be very popular. Going to Jarling's, I knew I wanted to get a snowstorm (similar to Culver's concrete mixer, DQ's blizzard). I also wanted to try their famous 'cold fudge,' which is hot fudge, but it's cold, and does not melt the custard (explanation given to me by a girl working there). Anyways, I decided to go with the Tortoise snowstorm. At first, the girl gave me the tortoise sundae, which i should have started eating, but I gave it back instead. I guess she was confused because I asked what cold fudge was, and cold fudge usually comes on the sundaes, but whatever. It was quickly corrected to a Tortoise snow storm. I also ordered a teddy cup of the cake batter ice cream. A teddy cup at Jarling's is a dip (equvalent to a scoop) with 6 teddy grahams and a cherry. A dip would have been 1.75, but the T cup was 2.25. Not really worth it in my opinion. I was a bit confused by my snowstorm, to be honest. It said it was vanilla custard, although it came out looking like chocolate. The tortoise is supposed to feature cold fudge, almonds, and butterscotch. When the incorrect tortoise sundae was brought out, it was vanilla custard with a fudge topping. For my snowstorm, it was a different color, so I was confused. I also did not taste any butterscotch, which I was really looking forward to. I went here with my bro, and he ordered the same teddy cup, as well as a Macaroon snowstorm. I had a bit of his, and it was much better than mine. I think they may have mixed up my order, but either way, the custard was still very good. The cake batter custard was nothing special, to be honest. No pieces of cake batter, or any sprinkles.They have a weekly special of flavors, along with their regular (see their new updated website). Just a side note, we came here at 845 on a Saturday night, and it was pretty crowded inside. There are multiple benches inside, as well as a drivethru. We decided to order and head to my car, which was parked in one of the angle spots. While eating, 2 wonderlake fire dept trucks pulled on both sides of us. A girl who got out of one of the trucks decided to open her car door on my exterior, and didn't even bother to check anything. Not sure I'd want her responding to a fire of mine (nothing against jarling's, but it did happen there). 15 dollars for our 4 dishes. I'm not sure if I will be getting a snowstorm or a sundae on my next trip, but I will be back! I think I should have gone with something coconut, PB, or chocolate chip based next time. I'll be honest, I was disappointed in my Tortoise, but I will go back because I love dessert, and I'd prefer this place over DQ, any frozen yogurt place, or McD. I'd actually put it on par with Culver's, but I love local business, and I'd like to see if my experience coudl be improved.

text: Después de pasar de Lawn Gnome a Jobot y luego a La Bodega – en agosto – *yo* estaba exhausto. Vi este lugar por el rabillo del ojo y decidí entrar (aunque no como helado!). Me encantó encontrar una variedad de sorbetes deliciosos. Dos palabras: sorbete de pepino. Quizás la cosa más refrescante que he probado en mi vida. Además, los dueños son muy amables. Adorables, locales y deliciosos. ¿Qué más se podría pedir?
text_en: After switching from Lawn Gnome to Jobot, and then to La Bodega in August, *I* was completely exhausted. I saw this place by chance and decided to enter (even though I didn’t go for ice cream!). I loved finding so many delicious sorbets. Two words: cucumber sorbet. Perhaps it’s the most refreshing thing I’ve tried in my life. Plus, the owners are very kind. Adorable, local, and wonderful. What more could one ask for?
original: After meandering from Lawn Gnome to Jobot to La Bodega - in August - *I* was melting. I saw this place out of the corner of my eye and decided to poke inside (even though I don't eat ice cream!). I was delighted to find a variety of delicious sorbets. Two words: Cucumber sorbet. Maybe the most refreshing thing I've ever eaten. Plus, the owners are super nice! Adorable, local, and delicious. What more could you ask for?

text: Mmmmmm, delicioso! Foi um lanche noturno, por volta das 12 da meia-noite, então saímos do nosso quarto de hotel e fomos até este lugar. Aqui, eles oferecem sorvete de leite de cereal, e tinha o mesmo sabor que o leite teria em um prato de cereal! Era gostoso (mas com um sabor bem leve) e simplesmente para satisfazer a vontade. Sim, o preço é um pouco alto, então espero que haja alguma redução?
text_en: Mmmmmm, delicious! It was a night snack around midnight. So we left our hotel room and went to this place. Here, they serve cereal milk ice cream—it had the same taste as milk in a cereal dish! It was tasty (but with a very light flavor), just enough to satisfy the craving. Yes, the price is a bit high, so I hope there’s some discount available?
original: mmmmm Yummy in my tummy!! This was a late night snack at like 12 am so we walked down from our hotel room and walked to this place. The cereal milk soft serve is featured here and it tasted like what milk would taste like in your cereal bowl LOL! It was tasty(but a really light taste) and just something to satisfy the cravings. Yea the price is a little high so hopefully there's a price reduction?

text: This sprinkles has the worst cupcakes we have ever had from a Sprinkles location. The cupcakes at the Beverly Hills location and the La Jolla location taste nothing like these disgusting cupcakes they are serving in Las Vegas. I can't even believe that they are allowed to serve whatever this concoction considered and put Sprinkles name on any of it. Save your money and go to the ones in California.
text_en: This sprinkles has the worst cupcakes we have ever had from a Sprinkles location. The cupcakes at the Beverly Hills location and the La Jolla location taste nothing like these disgusting cupcakes they are serving in Las Vegas. I can't even believe that they are allowed to serve whatever this concoction considered and put Sprinkles name on any of it. Save your money and go to the ones in California.

text: Os melhores donuts que já comi, e isso inclui aqueles de PDX, ATX e LAX. Vá cedo, pois cheguei às 9 horas no dia de Ano Novo e já estavam esgotados.
text_en: The best donuts I’ve ever eaten—including those from PDX, ATX, and LAX. Go early, because I arrived at 9 a.m. on New Year’s Day, and they were already sold out.
original: The best donuts I've ever had and that includes PDX, ATX and LAX. Go early because I showed up at 9 on New Year's day and they were SOLD OUT.

text: Excelente servicio, ambiente agradable y deliciosos refrescos de boba. Aquí trabajan duro y preparan bebidas increíbles. ¡Totalmente recomendado :)
text_en: Excellent service, pleasant atmosphere, and delicious bubble tea drinks. They work hard here and prepare amazing beverages. Highly recommended :)
original: Great service, pretty atmosphere & delicious boba drinks. They're hardworking here and make amazing drinks! Totally recommend :)

text: O cupcake de cenoura estava gostoso, mas não foi o melhor que já experimentei. Procurei em uma máquina de cupcakes e consegui um para levar para o meu quarto de hotel. Sim, é um lugar típico para turistas, mas decidi experimentar a máquina, já que nem sempre é possível comprar um cupcake em uma máquina? Além disso, a embalagem não é danificada na máquina, então ele sai intacto. Não é obrigatório experimentar em Las Vegas, mas se você estiver com fome e na área, por que não?
text_en: The carrot cupcake was delicious, but it wasn’t the best one I’ve ever tried. I looked for a cupcake machine and managed to get one to take back to my hotel room. Yes, it’s a typical tourist-friendly place, but I decided to try using the machine, since it’s not always possible to buy a cupcake from a regular store. Moreover, the packaging isn’t damaged during the machine process, so the cupcake comes out intact. It’s not necessary to try it in Las Vegas, but if you’re hungry and in the area, why not?
original: Carrot cake cupcake was tasty but not the best I've had. I hit the cupcake ATM and got a cupcake to have back in my hotel room. Yep it's a total tourist trap but figured I'd give the ATM a shot since how often can you buy a cupcake at an ATM? Also, doesn't get crushed in the ATM so it comes out good as new. Not a must try in Vegas but if you're hungry and in the area, why not?

text: Un descubrimiento excelente: estaba tan bueno que lo comimos dos veces en una semana. La porción de waffle con forma de pescado es un toque delicioso.
text_en: A great discovery: it was so good that we ate it twice in one week. The fish-shaped waffle portion is a delicious touch.
original: An expected new find -- it was so good that we went twice in one week! The fish-shaped waffle on top is a delicious touch.

text: Esta panadería es una de las mejores de Las Vegas. Está ubicada en el nivel del casino del Venetian. Ofrecen una amplia variedad de productos dulces, incluyendo enormes macarrones. Los croissants son de buen tamaño y el precio es razonable para Las Vegas. También tienen opciones de desayuno para llevar, como sándwiches de croissant. Además, ofrecen ofertas de desayuno que incluyen café para grupos más grandes. La cola puede formarse temprano en la mañana, pero el servicio es rápido. Mi favorito fue el croissant sencillo.
text_en: This bakery is one of the best in Las Vegas. It’s located on the same level as the Venetian casino. They offer a wide variety of sweet products, including huge macarons. The croissants are of good size, and the prices are reasonable for Las Vegas. They also have takeaway breakfast options, such as croissant sandwiches. Additionally, they offer breakfast deals that include coffee for larger groups. Lineups can form early in the morning, but service is quick. My favorite was the simple croissant.
original: This bakery is among the best in Las Vegas. It is located at the casino level of Venetian. They have a wide variety of sweet items including huge macaroons. The croissants are good size and price is reasonable for Las Vegas. They have grab and go breakfast items like croissant sandwiches. They also have breakfast deals that include coffee for larger groups. The line can form early in the morning but it moves fast. The plain croissant was my favorite.

text: 3 estrelas... Este lugar foi recomendado por amigos locais, então tínhamos certeza de não querer perdê-lo. Havia uma fila curta para entrar, então tínhamos altas expectativas. Eu pedi o Nutella e minha esposa pediu o caramelo salgado. Ambos estavam bons e eram donuts grandes. O ambiente é o de um café em um shopping, o atendimento foi amigável e os preços estão um pouco acima do esperado. Não estamos certos de que escolhermos a melhor opção, então, à primeira vista, este lugar não está no nosso top, mas definitivamente voltaremos na próxima vez que visitarmos! Voltaremos!
text_en: 3 stars… This place was recommended by local friends, so we were sure we wouldn’t want to miss it. There was a short line to enter, so we had high expectations. I ordered Nutella, and my wife asked for salted caramel. Both were good, and they were big donuts. The atmosphere is like a coffee shop in a mall; the service was friendly, but the prices are a bit higher than expected. We’re not sure if this is the best choice, so at first glance, it isn’t on our top list. But definitely we’ll come back next time we visit! We will come back!
original: 3 stars... This place was recommended by local friends so we were sure not to miss it. There was a short line to get into the joint so we had high expectations. I got the Nutella and my wife got the salted caramel. Both were good and were large donuts. Ambiance is stripmall cafe, service was friendly, and prices are slightly above expectation. Not sure we picked the best of show, so at first glance this joint does not make the list, but we will definitely give them another shot next time we visit! We will be back!!

text: Fiquei muito feliz ao descobrir que este lugar correspondeu às expectativas! Comida: 5/5. Estes donuts são incríveis. A massa é macia e fofa, quase como brioche! Os sabores são únicos e deliciosos, mas nenhum era excessivamente doce. Além disso, estão lindamente decorados, sem excesso de glacê ou bagunça. Fiquei surpreso ao descobrir que são veganos, pois não conseguiria adivinhar pelo sabor e textura. Recomendo fortemente o bolo de morango e o creme de biscoito! Serviço: 4/5. Fiquei cerca de 40 minutos na fila, após chegar no horário de abertura (9h, um domingo)! Mas os funcionários foram muito simpáticos, e seguem a política de distanciamento social, permitindo apenas uma pessoa por vez dentro da loja e exigindo o uso de máscaras. O lugar estava impecável e muito limpo. Com certeza voltarei. Os melhores donuts que já experimentei em Cleveland!
text_en: I was very happy to find out that this place met my expectations! Food: 5/5. These donuts are incredible. The dough is soft and fluffy, almost like brioche! The flavors are unique and delicious, but none were overly sweet. Additionally, they’re beautifully decorated, with no excess glaze or mess. I was surprised to learn they’re vegan, as I couldn’t guess from the taste and texture. I highly recommend the strawberry cake and cookie cream! Service: 4/5. I waited about 40 minutes in line, after arriving at opening time (9 a.m., a Sunday!). But the staff were very friendly, and they follow social distancing policies, allowing only one person at a time inside the store and requiring masks. The place was impeccable and very clean. I will definitely come back. The best donuts I’ve tried in Cleveland!
original: I was happily surprised this place lived up to its hype!! Food 5/5 These donuts are FIRE. The dough is loose and fluffy, almost like brioche!! The flavors are unique and tasteful, but none were too sweet at all! They also are cleanly decorated, not overflowing with icing or messy at all. I'm shook that these are vegan I would never have guessed by their taste and texture. Highly recommend strawberry shortcake and cookie butter! Service 4/5 Line took about 40min after getting there at opening time (9am on a Sunday)! But the employees were super nice, and they have social distancing policy of only allowing one party into the store at a time and masks required! The place was pristine and very clean. Will definitely be back. Best donuts in cleveland yet!

text: Mi mejor amiga y yo vinimos aquí para dar un capricho después de la cena y lo logramos. Ella había estado aquí antes y estaba encantada, y yo entendía por qué. Cuando entramos, había una fila pequeña, y cuando llegamos a la cola, uno de los dueños estaba atendiendo y se notaba que no solo tenía conocimientos, sino también pasión por su negocio. Ofrecen deliciosos postres, como helado dentro de un donut. Yo opté por tomar mi capricho en un vaso. ¡Fue fantástico! Al final, pedí el mimosa, que estaba increíble. Me encantaría volver a pedirlo, pero desafortunadamente no vivo en Phoenix, pero cada vez que estoy en la ciudad... ¡definitivamente haré una parada aquí! Tienen mesas al aire libre, pero no dentro. Este es un negocio excelente y un lugar perfecto para una cita o para reunirse con un amigo o alguien querido.
text_en: My best friend and I came here for a special treat after dinner, and we succeeded. She had been here before and was thrilled; I understood why. When we entered, there was a small line, and when we reached the end of the line, one of the owners was serving customers. It was clear that he not only had knowledge but also a passion for his business. They offer delicious desserts, like ice cream inside a donut. I chose to have my treat in a glass. It was fantastic! In the end, I ordered the mimosa, which was incredible. I would love to order it again, but unfortunately, I don’t live in Phoenix. But every time I’m in the city… I definitely will stop by here! They have outdoor tables, but not inside. This is an excellent business, and a perfect place for a date or to meet a friend or someone special.
original: My best friend and I came here for a treat after dinner and we got just that. She had been here before and was raving about it and I could see why. When we walked in there was a a small one and when we made it to the line. One of the owners was serving and you could tell he was not only well versed but passionate about his business. They have great treats like ice cream in a donut. I opted to getting my treat in a cup. It was great! I ended up getting the mimosa servers which was amazing. I want it now but unfortunately I don't live in Phoenix but anytime I'm in town.... I'm making a stop here! There is outdoor seating but not indoor seating. This is a great business and a great place for a date or catching up and hangout with a friend or loved one.

text: This ice cream is about as good as it gets. The Spanish peanuts and tin roof is my favorite.
text_en: This ice cream is about as good as it gets. The Spanish peanuts and tin roof is my favorite.

text: Os donuts da Jack Frost são deliciosos, com um design atraente e preços razoáveis. Experimentei o donut de bacon com calda de maple, que era feito com bacon fresco picado e cozinhado, sobre uma base de calda de maple. Definitivamente saboroso e com preço acessível, não há como errar aqui. Minha empresa adora e eu também.
text_en: Jack Frost’s donuts are delicious, with an attractive design and reasonable prices. I tried the bacon donut with maple syrup—it was made from fresh chopped bacon cooked over a base of maple syrup. It’s definitely tasty and affordable; there’s no way to go wrong here. My company loves them, and so do I.
original: Jack Frost donuts are wonderfully created reasonably priced designer donuts. I had the fresh made maple bacon donut. Bacon was chopped and fresh cooked sprinkled over a maple glaze donut. Certainly tasty reasonably priced you can not go wrong here. My office loves them and I do too.

text: Such a great addition to Lakewood! These donuts always taste fresh and I love the fun flavors they come up with. I'm not a vegan but haven't really been able to tell the difference in most flavors. Everything is good, service is quick, and they really know what they're doing here!! A must go.
text_en: Such a great addition to Lakewood! These donuts always taste fresh and I love the fun flavors they come up with. I'm not a vegan but haven't really been able to tell the difference in most flavors. Everything is good, service is quick, and they really know what they're doing here!! A must go.

text: We ordered a cake for my granddaughters birthday. We paid $80 for a dry cake that no one would eat. We ended up throwing it away. The pastries are fabulous, but the cake was overpriced and very inedible.
text_en: We ordered a cake for my granddaughters birthday. We paid $80 for a dry cake that no one would eat. We ended up throwing it away. The pastries are fabulous, but the cake was overpriced and very inedible.

text: Absolutely delicious gluten free cupcakes and cookies. The GF red velvet cupcake is moist and the GF chocolate chip cookie is soft and delectable! Can't even tell they are gluten free! I also love their frosting shots, since I am an icing lover. Always a dependable place to grab a gluten free treat -- The only con is that you may wait in line for an obscene amount of time.
text_en: Absolutely delicious gluten free cupcakes and cookies. The GF red velvet cupcake is moist and the GF chocolate chip cookie is soft and delectable! Can't even tell they are gluten free! I also love their frosting shots, since I am an icing lover. Always a dependable place to grab a gluten free treat -- The only con is that you may wait in line for an obscene amount of time.

text: Showed up and the one attendant they had working was sweeping while not wearing a mask or gloves. Then went straight to the register when a customer arrived (who also was not wearing a mask) and began to take his order, take his money, scoop his ice cream, and serve him without even washing his hands first, using hand sanitizer, or putting gloves or any kind of mask on. My girlfriend and I just walked away and drove off.....I'd rather pick up some Thrifty's ice cream than support a business that doesn't care enough about their customers or society as a whole to even just wash their hands, let alone at least wear a mask.
