text: Really cute. I was a bit disappointed to find out that all the yummy baked goods they have on their website are rotated in and out, but really enjoyed what we did get!
text_en: Really cute. I was a bit disappointed to find out that all the yummy baked goods they have on their website are rotated in and out, but really enjoyed what we did get!

text: Uma pequena sorveteria charmosa e aconchegante. Oferecem um excelente atendimento ao cliente e são muito simpáticos, sociáveis e prestativos. Seus sorvetes são absolutamente deliciosos, e você pode pedir para colocar o sorvete dentro de um donut. Fiquei surpreso com o quão macio e fresco estava o donut, e o sorvete era deliciosamente doce e tão cremoso que quase não derreteu dentro do donut!
text_en: A charming and cozy small ice cream shop. They offer excellent customer service and are very friendly, sociable, and helpful. Their ice creams are absolutely delicious, and you can ask to have the ice cream placed inside a donut. I was surprised by how soft and fresh the donut was; the ice cream was so sweet and creamy that it hardly melted inside the donut!
original: Cute little low key ice cream shop. They have great customer service and are super friendly, sociable, and helpful. Their ice cream is absolutely delicious and you can get the ice cream stuffed into a donut. I was pleasantly surprised how warm and fresh the donut was and the ice cream was deliciously sweet and so thick it hardly melted inside of the donut!

text: Fui a Somisomi en Henderson y, al entrar, me pidieron dónde estaba mi mascarilla. Así que salí. Desde la ventana, a unos cuatro pies de la recepcionista, había un grupo de clientes sin mascarilla comiendo helado. ¿Por qué necesito una mascarilla si el resto del restaurante no las usa? ¿Los gérmenes no se acercan al lado izquierdo del restaurante? ¡Idiotas.
text_en: I went to Somisomi in Henderson, and when I entered, they asked where my mask was. So I left. From the window, about four feet away from the receptionist, there was a group of customers who weren’t wearing masks, eating ice cream. Why do I need a mask if everyone else in the restaurant doesn’t wear them? Don’t germs avoid the left side of the restaurant? Idiots.
original: Went to Somisomi in Henderson and counter asked where my mask was. So I walked out. I watched from the window four feet from her was a crowd of unmasked customers eating ice cream. Why in the hell do I need a mask for when the rest of the restaurant is unmasked. Do germs stay away from the left side of the restaurant? Idiots.

text: Unbelievable dessert and their salted caramel brownie is to die for! Expect a line, that is how good they are!
text_en: Unbelievable dessert and their salted caramel brownie is to die for! Expect a line, that is how good they are!

text: ¡Helado de Earl Grey! ¡Ahora imaginen que esté entre dos churros recién hechos! El sándwich es lo suficientemente resistente para que se pueda tomar una foto digna de Instagram, pero después se vuelve un desastre debido al calor. Los churros se calientan justo antes de prepararlos, lo que hace que el helado se derrita demasiado rápido. Recomiendo pedir que se sirvan aparte o que no estén tan calientes. También probé el sándwich de macaron. El Earl Grey combina mucho mejor con los churros que con el macaron. La dueña fue muy amable y se tomó su tiempo para explicar todos los sabores y la historia de su tienda. ¡Otra californiana! Desafortunadamente, ninguno de los otros sabores me llamó la atención, aparte del Earl Grey.
text_en: Earl Grey ice cream! Now imagine it between two freshly made churros! The sandwich is sturdy enough to be photographed nicely for Instagram, but it becomes a disaster due to the heat. The churros are heated just before serving, which causes the ice cream to melt too quickly. I recommend serving it separately or not keeping it too hot. I also tried the macaron sandwich. Earl Grey pairs much better with churros than with macarons. The owner was very kind and took her time to explain all the flavors and the history of her shop. Another Californian! Unfortunately, none of the other flavors caught my attention, except for Earl Grey.
original: Earl. Grey. Ice. Cream! Now imagine that sandwiched between two piping hot churros! The sandwich holds up just enough so that you get a instagram-worthy photo- but it's a hot mess after that. The churros are heated up when it's ordered so the heat from it melts the ice cream way too soon. I would suggest asking them to give it to you on the side or have them not heated up. I also tried the macaron sandwich. Earl grey definitely meshes better with the churro than the macaron. The owner was super friendly and took her time to explain all of the flavors and the development of their store. Fellow Californian! Unfortunately- none of the other flavors caught my attention besides the earl grey.

text: Os melhores donuts da região!!!!!!! Eles têm bolos fritos que são as coisas mais deliciosas que já experimentei. A única desvantagem é que, quando acabam, acabam. Então, se você quiser uma boa variedade, precisa ir o mais rápido possível.
text_en: The best donuts in the area!!!!!!! They have fried doughs that are the most delicious things I’ve ever tasted. The only downside is that they run out when they’re ready. So, if you want a good variety, you need to go there as quickly as possible.
original: Best donuts around!!!!!!! They have fry cakes that are the most amazing things I have ever tasted. Only thing is once they're out they're out. So you have to get there ASAP if you want a good selection.

text: Walking into dripps I instantly felt refreshed. The space is bright and vibrant. It's small but just big enough to seat a moderate amount of ice cream eaters. Dripps produces Instagram worthy treats that are catered to cereal addicts. But the don't only have cereal as a topping. You can easily choose from several different candy bars or melty drizzles. There is something for everyone. I ordered a milkshake. Not just any milk shake but a snickers crushed and infused melody of crunchy vanilla goodness. It was delish. My bf ordered a sundae with Capitain crunch and my mom ordered a surprisingly delicious vanilla cone chucked full of strawberry flavor and snicker dust on top (copy cat). We all enjoyed our treats and sat at a cute table near the window. This place gets busy pretty quick but the line seems to move rather quickly. I don't enjoy giving Reviews that are under 5 stars if I enjoyed my experience at a restaurant or establishment. In fact it's annoying to see someone give a rave review under a 4 star rating. *rolls eyes* I'm giving 4 stars because although I enjoyed my experience I was pretty shocked to see how small the ice cream cup was that my bf received. It literally looked like a kids serving. And that in itself costs $6. My milkshake was huge and the cone was huge. I looked around and saw others with larger servings as well. Maybe they messed up the order? Idk. I'll be back again but I don't suggest ordering a cup of ice cream. Get a milkshake or cone.
text_en: Walking into dripps I instantly felt refreshed. The space is bright and vibrant. It's small but just big enough to seat a moderate amount of ice cream eaters. Dripps produces Instagram worthy treats that are catered to cereal addicts. But the don't only have cereal as a topping. You can easily choose from several different candy bars or melty drizzles. There is something for everyone. I ordered a milkshake. Not just any milk shake but a snickers crushed and infused melody of crunchy vanilla goodness. It was delish. My bf ordered a sundae with Capitain crunch and my mom ordered a surprisingly delicious vanilla cone chucked full of strawberry flavor and snicker dust on top (copy cat). We all enjoyed our treats and sat at a cute table near the window. This place gets busy pretty quick but the line seems to move rather quickly. I don't enjoy giving Reviews that are under 5 stars if I enjoyed my experience at a restaurant or establishment. In fact it's annoying to see someone give a rave review under a 4 star rating. *rolls eyes* I'm giving 4 stars because although I enjoyed my experience I was pretty shocked to see how small the ice cream cup was that my bf received. It literally looked like a kids serving. And that in itself costs $6. My milkshake was huge and the cone was huge. I looked around and saw others with larger servings as well. Maybe they messed up the order? Idk. I'll be back again but I don't suggest ordering a cup of ice cream. Get a milkshake or cone.

text: Existe uma razão para que este lugar tenha mais de 600 avaliações, com quase todas elas sendo 5 estrelas. É simplesmente INCRÍVEL! Nossa família parou no Novel Ice Cream durante uma viagem de fim de semana a Phoenix. Alguns lugares têm muita fama, mas não correspondem às expectativas... Isso não é o caso do Novel Ice Cream. Ele está localizado em um local próximo a outras lojas, restaurantes e bares. A loja é relativamente pequena, sem assentos internos, mas há bastante espaço ao ar livre. Além disso, há um parque nas proximidades. O estacionamento no local é limitado, mas dirigimos algumas quadras e conseguimos encontrar vagas na rua. Depois de uma curta caminhada, chegamos. Como era por volta das 18h30 em um dia de semana, a fila não era muito longa. Aposto que é muito maior nos fins de semana e mais tarde à noite. Eles nos ofereceram todas as amostras que queríamos, e aproveitamos essa oferta. O proprietário estava lá e foi muito prestativo, explicando os diferentes sabores e todos os ingredientes. Eles já ganharam vários prêmios pelo seu sorvete. Nós fazemos sorvete em casa, e isso me inspirou a melhorar. Meus filhos escolheram o "Cookie Monster" e o "Butter Pecan". Eu pedi o "Dough Melt" (sorvete entre um donut quente e coberto), com o chocolate premiado deles. Esqueço o que minha esposa pediu, mas ela adorou. O preço é mais alto do que nos lugares como o "Thrifty's" ou o "McDonald's", mas a qualidade é muito superior, e não faz sentido comparar. Claro, houve o famoso "sugar rush" e a consequente queda de energia, mas nós adoramos este lugar. Perguntei se eles poderiam abrir uma loja em Tucson, mas talvez seja bom que ainda não tenham feito isso.
text_en: There’s a reason why this place has over 600 reviews, and almost all of them are 5 stars. It’s simply amazing! Our family stopped at Novel Ice Cream during a weekend trip to Phoenix. Some places are well-known, but they don’t meet expectations… But Novel Ice Cream is different. It’s located near other stores, restaurants, and bars. The store is relatively small, with no indoor seating, but there’s plenty of space outdoors. Additionally, there’s a park nearby. The parking space is limited, but we drove a few blocks and found spots on the street. After a short walk, we arrived. Since it was around 6:30 p.m. on a weekday, the line wasn’t very long. I bet it’s much longer on weekends and later in the evening. They offered all the samples we wanted, and we took advantage of that offer. The owner was there and was very helpful, explaining the different flavors and all the ingredients. They’ve won several awards for their ice cream. We make ice cream at home, and that inspired me to improve my skills. My kids chose “Cookie Monster” and “Butter Pecan”. I ordered “Dough Melt”—ice cream between a warm donut and a covering—with their special chocolate flavor. I forget what my wife ordered, but she loved it. The price is higher than at places like “Thrifty’s” or “McDonald’s”, but the quality is much better, and it makes no sense to compare. Of course, there was that famous “sugar rush” and the resulting energy drop, but we really enjoyed this place. I asked if they could open a store in Tucson, but maybe it’s better that they haven’t done so yet.
original: there's a reason this place has 600+ reviews with almost all of them being 5 stars. it's AWESOME SAUCE! our family stopped by novel ice cream while we were in phoenix for a weekend vacation. some places have a lot of hype, but don't deliver... that is not the case with novel ice cream. it's located in and among some others stores, restaurants, bars. the shop is pretty small with no indoor seating, but there are plenty of outside seating. there's even a park down the street as well. the parking on site is limited, but we just drove down the street a few blocks and was able to find street parking. after a short walk we arrived. since it was around 6:30p on a weeknight the line was pretty short. i bet it's much longer on the weekend and later in the evening. they offered us all the samples we wanted and we took them up on their offer. the owner was there and super helpful in explaining the different flavors and all the ingredients in them. they've won multiple awards for their ice cream. we make ice cream at home and they've inspired me to up my game. my kids ended up choosing the cookie monster and butter pecan. i got the dough melt (ice cream sandwiched between a warm glazed donut) with their award winning chocolate. i forgot what my wife ordered, but she loved it. the price point is higher than you're going to pay at thrifty's or mc donalds, but the quality is so much higher, it's not even fair to compare. there was definitely the standard sugar rush and subsequent crash, but we loved this place. i asked them to open a store in tucson, but maybe it's a good thing they haven't done that quite yet.

text: Você nunca pode errar com o sabor de manteiga e nozes. O sorvete tem o sabor de sorvete caseiro e é extremamente fresco e rico em sabor. Eles oferecem todos os clássicos tradicionais e também alguns sabores mais divertidos.
text_en: You can never go wrong with the flavor of butter and nuts. The ice cream has the taste of homemade ice cream, and it’s extremely fresh and rich in flavor. They offer all the classic traditional flavors, as well as some more fun flavors too.
original: You can never go wrong with butter pecan. Their ice cream taste like homemade ice cream and it's extremely fresh and rich in flavor. They have all of the homestyle classics and they also have some of the more fun flavors too.

text: Best macaroons EVER. Love this place. Haven't been back since the management changed a while back but it is still my favorite for it's lavender macaroons. Ps. Will have to pop by one of these days.
text_en: Best macaroons EVER. Love this place. Haven't been back since the management changed a while back but it is still my favorite for it's lavender macaroons. Ps. Will have to pop by one of these days.

text: Disfrutamos de s'mores y helados de bizcocho con fresas, y fue increíble... El personal fue muy amable y atento. ¡Ya quiero volver a disfrutar de s'mores!
text_en: We enjoyed s’mores and strawberry cake ice cream, and it was amazing… The staff were very kind and attentive. I really want to enjoy s’mores again!
original: Had S'mores and strawberry shortcake sundaes and it was super awesome.... Staffs were super cool and friendly... Can't wait to have s'mores again.

text: 4.5 estrellas... Tuve que aumentar la calificación. El brownie de caramelo es DIVINO. Estoy aquí comiéndome un trozo porque es demasiado bueno para comerlo todo de golpe y sentirme mal después de acabarlo. Pruébalo al menos una vez, en serio.
text_en: 4.5 stars… I had to increase the rating. The caramel brownie is divine. I’m here eating a piece because it’s too good to eat all at once and feel bad after finishing it. Try it at least once, really.
original: 4.5 stars... Had to bump this rating up. The caramel brownie is DIVINE! I'm sitting here nibbling on it since its too good to eat all at once and wallow in misery after finishing it. Try at least once, seriously.

text: Si vienes a Charlotte, este lugar es imprescindible. He oído muchas cosas buenas sobre este sitio, y cumplió con todas mis expectativas. El helado de matcha y el latte tenían un sabor de matcha muy intenso. El helado de ube también era muy rico y combinaba muy bien con el matcha. El parfait tenía una capa de pastel de matcha, bolas de mochi, cereales y gelatina de jengibre. De verdad, es un postre maravilloso y completo. Quiero repetirlo: si vienes a Charlotte, este es un lugar que no te puedes perder!
text_en: If you come to Charlotte, this place is essential. I’ve heard many good things about it, and it met all my expectations. The matcha ice cream and latte had a very strong matcha flavor. The ube ice cream was also very delicious and complemented the matcha perfectly. The parfait had a layer of matcha cake, mochi balls, cereals, and ginger jelly. Really, it’s a wonderful and complete dessert. I want to try it again: if you come to Charlotte, this is a place you definitely shouldn’t miss!
original: If you're coming to Charlotte, this is a must try. I've heard so much about this place and it lived up to all my expectations. The matcha soft serve and latte had such a rich matcha flavor. The ube soft serve was also very rich and paired beautifully with the matcha. The parfait had a layer of matcha cake, mochi balls, cereal, and grass jelly. Really a wonderful treat and a all-in-one dessert. I will say this again, if you come to Charlotte, this is a must visit location!

text: The doughnuts are pretty good! The chocolate milk was so disgusting!!! I don't think it's worth the hype.
text_en: The doughnuts are pretty good! The chocolate milk was so disgusting!!! I don't think it's worth the hype.

text: Tenho certeza disso – é uma pequena amostra da cultura de sobremesas japonesa em Carolina do Norte, e vale a pena! Não entendo como comentários tão negativos apareceram nesta página do Yelp, mas, sendo justo, o estabelecimento pode ter melhorado após a sua abertura. Posso apenas falar sobre o especial Maiko. O ambiente e a personalidade do café são adoráveis, e a equipe me lembra do atendimento japonês. O matcha tem um sabor autêntico, e a combinação do especial Maiko não é excessivamente doce. O bolo é úmido e combina bem com feijão azuki, mochi, geleia, flocos de milho e castanhas. Experimente diferentes sabores de sobremesas aqui!
text_en: I’m sure of it – it’s just a small sample of the Japanese dessert culture in North Carolina, and it’s worth it! I don’t understand how so negative reviews appeared on this Yelp page, but, fairly speaking, the establishment might have improved since its opening. I can only talk about the Maiko special. The atmosphere and staff are lovely, and they remind me of Japanese service. The matcha has a genuine taste, and the combination of the Maiko special isn’t overly sweet. The cake is moist and goes well with azuki beans, mochi, jam, cornflakes, and nuts. Try different dessert flavors here!
original: Best believe it -- it's a little bit of Japan food dessert culture in NC and it's worrrrth! I don't understand how these less than satisfied comments made it on this yelp page, to be fair the business might've improved after their soft opening. I can only speak to the signature Maiko special. The cafe style and personality is adorable, the staff reminds me of the service in Japan, too. The matcha tastes OG, the blend of their Maiko special is not overbearingly sweet. The cake is moist and goes well with the adzuki beans, mochi, jelly, cornflakes and chestnut. Diversify your dessert taste buds here!

text: Mientras estábamos en Las Vegas, decidimos realizar una prueba de macarons. Bouchon fue uno de nuestros favoritos. Probamos los sabores de fresa y chocolate. No quiero arruinar las opiniones de otros, pero sin duda, Bouchon tiene los mejores macarons que he probado. Tenían el tamaño perfecto: suficientes para enamorarte y querer más, sin ser excesivos. Ligeros y crujientes, con un relleno dulce. Aunque me encanta el chocolate, mi favorito aquí es el de fresa!
text_en: While we were in Las Vegas, we decided to try some macarons. Bouchon was one of our favorites. We tried the strawberry and chocolate flavors. I don’t want to ruin others’ opinions, but undoubtedly, Bouchon has the best macarons I’ve ever tasted. They were the right size—enough to make you fall in love with them and want more, yet not too much. Light and crispy, with a sweet filling. Although I love chocolate, my favorite here is the strawberry one!
original: While in Vegas, we decided to embark on a macaron taste test. Bouchon was one of our contenders. Tried the Strawberry and Chocolate flavors. I don't want to spoil the other reviews but hands down, Bouchon has the best macarons ever! They were the right size - just enough to make you fall in love and want more without going overboard. Light and flaky with a sweet filling. As much as I love chocolate, my favorite here is the Strawberry!

text: Sorvete muito bom. Ótimo atendimento. Gostaria de dar 5 estrelas, mas eles não tinham o sabor que eu estava procurando naquele dia. E gostaria que eles trouxessem de vez em quando alguns sabores antigos (como o de bagel).
text_en: Very good ice cream. Excellent service. I would give 5 stars, but they didn’t have the flavor I was looking for that day. I would also like them to occasionally serve some old flavors (like bagel flavor).
original: Very good ice cream. Great service. I would love to give them 5 stars but they didn't have the flavor I was looking for that day AND I wish they'd bring back some flavors from time to time (think Bagel )

text: Estive lendo todas as ótimas avaliações sobre este lugar. Fui lá por volta das 10h. Os donuts que pedimos estavam horríveis. A cobertura/recheio estava muito seca. Parecia que os donuts estavam lá desde o dia anterior. Meu marido pediu o donut com bacon e maple. O bacon não estava sequer totalmente cozido! A gordura não tinha derretido! O maple estava tão seco que estava rachado e ressecado! Foi decepcionante, depois de ler o quão incrível era.
text_en: I’ve read all the great reviews about this place. I went there around 10 a.m. The donuts we ordered were terrible. The filling was very dry. It seemed like the donuts had been there since the previous day. My husband ordered a donut with bacon and maple syrup. The bacon wasn’t even fully cooked! The fat hadn’t melted at all! The maple syrup was so dry that it was cracked and dried out! It was disappointing after reading how amazing it was.
original: I've been reading all the rave reviews about this place. Went there around 10am. Our donuts were awful. The glaze/frosting on the tops were so dried out. It seemed like the donuts had been out since the day before. My husband ordered the maple bacon. The bacon in top wasn't even cooked all the way! The fat wasn't even rendered out of it! The maple was so dry it was cracked and caked off! Disappointing after reading how amazing it was.

text_en: I tried the cup ice cream, and it was as delicious as it looked. Vanilla ice cream with cinnamon, along with a strawberry macaron and a layer of toasted meringue. I highly recommend it, and the owner was very kind.
original: Got the cookie cup and it was as awesome tasting as it looked. Cinnamon toast ice cream with a fruity pebble macaron topped with toasted marshmallow. Highly recommend and the owner was so friendly.

text: Café vietnamita com creme de marshmallow tostado: Delicioso! O café é o meu sabor de sorvete favorito, e adoro o café vietnamita. Frequentemente peço um quando estou em restaurantes vietnamitas, devido ao meu desejo constante por "pho". O sabor desse sorvete realmente lembra um sorvete de café vietnamita, com seu sabor rico e intenso. Além disso, não é muito doce, o que geralmente é um fator que me impede de experimentar outros sabores. Como eu estava com vontade de comer marshmallow tostado, adicionei isso por um dólar a mais. A combinação do sorvete de café vietnamita com o marshmallow tostado foi divina! O marshmallow doce e fofo complementou o sabor cremoso e mais amargo do sorvete. Além disso, o marshmallow era enorme – provavelmente maior do que uma porção única de sorvete. Inicialmente, pensei que conseguiria comer partes iguais de sorvete e marshmallow e terminar tudo, mas estava errado. O marshmallow era tão grande que acabei jogando uma parte fora, o que foi uma pena. Mas eu adorei essa combinação, e definitivamente voltaria aqui para o mesmo ou para outra coisa! Serviço: Havia uma fila que ia para fora, mas o atendimento foi muito rápido. Os funcionários foram simpáticos, pegaram nossos pedidos rapidamente e nos atenderam rapidamente. Ambiente: O interior da loja é relativamente pequeno, e, pelo que vi, não há mesas dentro. Também há muitos doces à venda ao redor da loja, o que foi divertido de observar. Há assentos ao ar livre, na parte de trás da loja, com algumas mesas e cadeiras pequenas. No geral, gostei do ambiente divertido e alegre, com uma parede revestida de fitas cassete!
text_en: Vietnamese coffee with roasted marshmallow cream: Delicious! This coffee is my favorite ice cream flavor, and I really love Vietnamese coffee. I often order it when I’m at Vietnamese restaurants, because I always crave “pho”. The flavor of this ice cream really resembles Vietnamese coffee ice cream—rich and intense. Plus, it isn’t too sweet, which usually prevents me from trying other flavors. Since I wanted to eat roasted marshmallow, I added it for an extra dollar. The combination of Vietnamese coffee ice cream and roasted marshmallow was amazing! The sweet and fluffy marshmallow complemented the creamy, more bitter taste of the ice cream. Moreover, the marshmallow was huge—probably bigger than a whole portion of ice cream. At first, I thought I could eat equal parts of ice cream and marshmallow and finish everything, but I was wrong. The marshmallow was so big that I ended up throwing some away—which was a pity. But I loved this combination, and I would definitely come back for the same or something else! Service: There was a line going out, but the service was very quick. The staff were friendly, quickly took our orders, and served us promptly. Atmosphere: The interior of the store is relatively small, and there aren’t any tables inside. There are also many sweets available around the store, which was interesting to see. There are seating areas outside, at the back of the store, with some small tables and chairs. Overall, I liked the fun and cheerful atmosphere, with walls covered with cassette tapes!
original: Vietnamese coffee with toasted marshmallow fluff: Yum! Coffee is my favorite flavor of ice cream, and I love Vietnamese coffee and frequently order one when I'm in Vietnamese restaurants for my persistent pho cravings. The flavor of this really tastes like an ice cream version of Vietnamese coffee with its rich, strong coffee flavor. It is also not too sweet, which is often a factor that deters me from other flavors. Since I was craving a toasted marshmallow, I added that on for an extra dollar. The combination of the Vietnamese coffee ice cream with the toasted marshmallow was divine! The sweet, fluffy roasted marshmallow complemented the creamy, more bitter coffee flavor of the ice cream. The marshmallow was also huge -- probably bigger than my single scoop of ice cream. I initially thought I could eat equal parts ice cream and marshmallow and finish everything, but I was wrong. The marshmallow was so large that I ended up throwing a part of it away, sadly. But I absolutely loved this combination, and I would definitely come here again for this same combo or something else! Service: There was a line that went out the door, but it moved very quickly. The staff was friendly, quickly took our orders, and served us very quickly. Atmosphere: The inside of the store is quite small, and there is actually no indoor seating from what I saw. There is also a lot of various candies for sale around the store, which was fun to look at. There is seating outside at the back of the store with some small tables and chairs. Overall, I enjoyed the fun, bright atmosphere complete with a cassette wall!

text: I was out of hope looking for a nice bakery in Charlotte to get my pastry fix when I stumbled on this one in the Noda district. Walking through the door you're greeted with an eclectic decor that I the only way I might be able to describe would be chic french hipster. They have an interesting and varied selection of pastries and chocolates that were fun to look at and delicious as well! I went for lunch with a friend and she had the ginger rice soup, and I had the asparagus leek soup. I'm not a fan of ginger so her soup was ok, but the asparagus leek soup was excellent! Creamy and smooth it was a dream. We also split a croque monsieur and it was done perfectly. Greasy, a little crisp on the outside, with the mustard giving a nice kick to the sandwich. Now for the dessert portion we had a strawberry and chocolate croissant, salted caramel brownie, and creme brulee with a small french press. I feel like the strawberry and chocolate croissants could have used a little more filling but they were quite good. The salted caramel brownie I really needed more salt to cut through the creamy sugar of the caramel, but then again I tend to like my snacks a bit less sweet. The creme brulee was the winner of the dessert round. Nice and crisply caramelized top with a not too sweet center. Amelie's was a great find in the Noda area and offers free wifi, a nice place to relax, and a varied crowd with pastry choices for everyone. It's now on my list of places to visit frequently!

Assim que vi o sundae (um cupcake com sua cobertura e uma bola de sorvete), soube que precisava prová-lo. Escolhi um cupcake de morango e um sorvete de massa de biscoito. Estava delicioso. Além disso, as porções são bem generosas, mesmo na opção padrão. Recomendo dividir com alguém ou optar pela opção mini, caso você, como eu, não consiga comer grandes quantidades de doces de uma vez. Espero que a unidade na minha cidade não feche, porque adoraria visitá-la, como amanhã. :/ Com certeza voltarei na minha próxima visita a Las Vegas!
text_en: While walking around Linq, I had a craving for sweets and decided to try Sprinkles! As soon as I saw the sundae—a cupcake with its topping and a ice cream ball—I knew I had to try it. I chose a strawberry cupcake and cookie dough ice cream. It was delicious. Moreover, the portions are quite generous, even with the standard option. I recommend sharing it with someone or choosing the mini option, if you can’t eat a lot of sweets at once, like I can. I hope the store in my city doesn’t close, because I’d love to visit it, just like tomorrow. :/ I will definitely return when I visit Las Vegas next time!
original: While on The Linq promenade, I built up a sweet tooth and decided to give Sprinkles a try! The moment I saw their sundae (cupcake of your choice with a scoop of ice cream) I knew I had to have it. I got a strawberry cupcake and cookie dough ice cream. So good. The portion sizes are also huge for their regular sized option. I suggest splitting it with someone or opting for their mini option if you're like me and can't eat a lot of sugary foods at once. Wish the one in my hometown didn't close because I'd give them a visit, like tomorrow. :/ For sure I will be back on my next visit to Vegas!

text: ¡Guau, he estado aquí unas 4 veces en las últimas 2 semanas. No ayuda que la primera vez trajimos a todos los niños y ahora el mayor me pide literalmente cada noche si podemos volver. Los sabores son increíbles. La primera noche probé el chocolate blanco con frambuesa y el sabor a café (ya no recuerdo exactamente cómo se llaman). Estaban deliciosos. Los sabores son muy intensos y tienen un sabor real. El café sabía a un excelente café con crema y azúcar. Y la frambuesa tenía un sabor fuerte y natural, mientras que el chocolate blanco no dominaba los demás sabores. Mi esposo probó el helado de sandía y sabía exactamente como tomar una rodaja fresca de sandía directamente del congelador. La segunda vez, añadí un malvavisco casero a mi sundae y estaba delicioso. Al principio, el olor es un poco intenso debido al azúcar quemada, pero el sabor era fantástico. Recomiendo encarecidamente buscar este pequeño lugar. También tienen sabores estándar, así como opciones creativas (mi favorito hasta ahora es "Netflix and Chill"). Conozco a ambos dueños y parece que realmente disfrutan de lo que hacen y de las personas que conocen.
text_en: Wow, I’ve been here about 4 times in the last 2 weeks. It doesn’t help that the first time we brought all the kids, and now the oldest asks me every night if we can go back. The flavors are incredible. On my first night, I tried white chocolate with raspberry and coffee flavor (I don’t remember exactly what they’re called). They were delicious. The flavors are very strong and authentic. The coffee tasted like excellent coffee creamer with sugar. The raspberry had a strong, natural taste, while the white chocolate didn’t overpower the other flavors. My husband tried the watermelon ice cream; it tasted just like taking a fresh slice of watermelon directly from the freezer. The second time, I added homemade malvavisco to my sundae, and it was delicious. At first, the smell is a bit strong due to burnt sugar, but the taste was fantastic. I highly recommend checking out this little place. They also have standard flavors, as well as creative options (my favorite so far is “Netflix and Chill”). I know both owners, and it seems like they really enjoy what they do and the people they meet.
original: Wow, I've been here about 4 times in 2 weeks. Doesn't help that we took all the kids the first time and now the oldest literally asks every night if we can go back. The flavors are amazing. The first night I had the white chocolate raspberry and the coffee flavor (I forget now what they call it exactly). They were terrific. The flavors are very strong and taste real. The coffee tasted like a terrific cup of coffee with cream and sugar. And the raspberry was a strong, natural taste, while the white chocolate did not over power the rest. My husband had the watermelon sorbet and it tasted just like taking a fresh slice of watermelon out of the freezer. The second time I had a homemade roasted marshmallow on top of my sundae and it was divine. The smell is a little intense at first with the burning sugar, but the flavor was terrific. I would highly recommend seeking out this tiny gem. They have standard flavors as well as creative ones (my favorite name so far is the Netflix and Chill). I've met both owners and they really seem to enjoy what they do and the people they meet.

text: Existem problemas que apenas o sorvete pode resolver. O Melt está localizado em uma área artística e peculiar no centro de Phoenix, conhecida como Roosevelt Row. A área é repleta de galerias de arte, lojas vintage e livrarias, e vale a pena uma visita apenas para conhecer o lugar, caso você esteja na área. Ao entrarmos no Melt, fomos recebidos, perguntado se era nossa primeira visita e oferecidos o máximo de amostras que desejávamos. O Melt possui uma vitrine com 18 sabores de sorvete, todos produzidos localmente na Superstition Farmin em Mesa. O Melt oferece os sabores tradicionais e muitos sabores criativos, como "Fruity Pebbles". A seleção de sabores no Melt está sempre mudando, então sempre há algo novo para experimentar. Na minha primeira visita, experimentei o "Super Farm", chocolate e avelãs, com Nutella misturada. O sorvete estava delicioso e com o ponto perfeito de doçura. E o tamanho das porções é generoso. No Melt, você pode escolher ter seu sorvete servido em caixas de "takeout" chinesas e com uma "fortune cookie" (biscoito com previsão), entre dois biscoitos, ou em um cone de waffle feito em casa. Os preços são razoáveis, o atendimento é excelente e, o mais importante, o sorvete é delicioso. Se você estiver com vontade de um sorvete realmente bom, experimente o Melt, você não vai se arrepender.
text_en: There are problems that only ice cream can solve. The Melt is located in an artistic and unique area in the center of Phoenix, known as Roosevelt Row. The area is full of art galleries, vintage stores, and bookstores—it’s worth a visit just to experience the place, if you’re in the area. When we entered the Melt, we were greeted, asked if it was our first time there, and given as many samples as we wanted. The Melt has a display with 18 flavors of ice cream, all made locally at Superstition Farm in Mesa. The Melt offers traditional flavors as well as many creative ones, like “Fruity Pebbles”. The selection of flavors changes constantly, so there’s always something new to try. On my first visit, I tried “Super Farm”, chocolate and almonds mixed with Nutella. The ice cream was delicious, with the perfect level of sweetness. And the portion sizes are generous. At the Melt, you can choose to have your ice cream served in Chinese “takeout” boxes, along with a “fortune cookie” (a cookie with a prediction), between two cookies, or in a homemade waffle cone. The prices are reasonable, the service is excellent, and most importantly, the ice cream is delicious. If you’re looking for really good ice cream, try the Melt—you won’t regret it.
original: There are problems only ice cream can fix. Melt is located in a artsy and quirky part of downtown Phoenix, that is refered to as Roosevelt Row. The area is filled with art galleries, vintage shops, and book stores, it's worth a stop just to look around if you're in the area. As we walked into Melt we were greeted, asked if it was our first visit, and given as many samples as we wanted. Melt has all the standard flavors and lots of creative flavors, like fruity pebbles. The flavor selection at Melt is always rotating so there is always something new. On my first visit I had the super farm, chocolate, hazelnuts, with nutella swirled in. The ice cream was delicious and perfecy sweet. And the scoop.size is large. At Melt you can choose to have your ice cream served in Chinese takeout boxes and topped with a fortune cookie, between two cookies, or in a house-made waffle cone. The prices are reasonable, the customer service is great, and most importantly the ice cream is delicious. If your in the mood for really good ice cream give Melt a try you won't be dissapointed.

text: Vaya, qué excelente servicio al cliente. Soy dueño de un negocio y he llegado incluso a trabajar hasta tarde, como propietario, para asegurarme de que mis clientes estuvieran contentos. Llegué y ya eran casi las 11, la hora en que se supone que cierran los sábados, y casi todo el helado ya estaba guardado. Me dijeron: "Lo siento, ya he guardado todo y no voy a hacerte helado". A las 10:52, cuando llegué, ya no era la hora de cerrar, y en mi opinión, en el sector de servicios, el cliente siempre tiene la razón. No importa si quieres cerrar un poco antes. Tu trabajo es, literalmente, esperar hasta las 11 para recoger todo. Vengo aquí desde que abrieron y he notado una ligera disminución en el cuidado del trabajo cada vez. Me da pena ver mi heladería con los malvaviscos encima. También entiendo que hay buenos y malos momentos, y que todos deben estar contentos. Ahora mismo, no estoy contento. Simplemente me alegro de que mi esposa no esté embarazada esta vez. Supongo que la próxima vez, iré a las 4 de la tarde y esperaré hasta las 11 para comer. Gracias de nuevo, Jeremy.
text_en: Wow, what great customer service! I own a business and even worked late as a owner, just to make sure my customers were satisfied. I arrived around 11 o’clock, which is supposed to be the closing time on Saturdays, and almost all the ice cream had already been stored away. They said, “I’m sorry, I’ve already put everything away and won’t make any more ice cream for you.” At 10:52, when I arrived, it wasn’t yet closing time. In my opinion, in the service industry, the customer always has the right to expect something. It doesn’t matter if you want to close a little earlier. Your job is simply to wait until 11 o’clock to collect everything. I’ve been here since they opened, and I’ve noticed a slight decline in the quality of work over time. It’s sad to see my ice cream shop with debris everywhere. I understand that there are good and bad times, and everyone should be happy. Right now, I’m not happy. I’m just glad my wife isn’t pregnant this time. I guess next time, I’ll go at 4 p.m. and wait until 11 o’clock to eat. Thanks again, Jeremy.
original: Wow what customer service. I own a business and i have even stayed late as the business owner making sure that my customers were happy. I show up it's not 11 o'clock the time when it's supposed to close on a Saturday almost all the ice cream is put away and I'm awarded with a notation of sorry man I've already put everything away and I'm not going to make you ice cream. 10:52 the time it was when I got there is not closing time and as far as I am concerned in the service industry the customer is always right and it doesn't matter that you want to get out a little early. It's your job quite literally to wait until 11 to pack it up. I've been coming here since they've opened and have seen a slight bit steady decline in caring about the job every time. I'm sad to see my ice cream shop with the mallow on top I also understand you take the good with the bad so everyone is happy. Right now I'm not happy. I'm just glad my wife isn't pregnant this time. I guess next time I'll get it a 4 pm and wait till 11 to eat it. Thanks again Jeremy

text: Sorvete delicioso. Eu pedi o sabor "Cookies N Cream". Era muito cremoso! Gostei da apresentação, que veio em uma caixa de take-away chinesa, com a fatia de biscoito da sorte. Demorei um pouco para encontrar o lugar, circulei o prédio, mas encontrei dentro da loja de conveniência/cafeteria.
text_en: Delicious ice cream. I ordered the “Cookies N Cream” flavor. It was very creamy! I liked the presentation—it came in a Chinese take-out box, with a piece of cookie on top. It took me a while to find the place; I walked around the building, but I finally found it inside a convenience store/café.
original: Yummy ice cream. I got the Cookies N Cream. It was so creamy! I liked the presentation in the Chinese takeout box with the fortune cookie. It did take me a while to find the place, I circled the building, but I found it inside the corner store/coffee shop.

text: Meh, sinceramente, já experimentei sorvetes melhores. Talvez eu esteja acostumado com a qualidade dos sorvetes em Los Angeles. Não havia tanta variedade como eu esperava para um lugar de sorvete em Las Vegas. Experimentei o sorvete de leite com cereais e adicionei granulado, mas me cansei dos sabores rapidamente. Isso raramente acontece com sorvetes para mim. No geral, superestimado e caro :(
text_en: Meh, honestly, I’ve tried better ice cream before. Maybe I’m just used to the quality of ice cream in Los Angeles. There wasn’t as much variety as I expected from a ice cream place in Las Vegas. I tried the milk ice cream with cereals and added granola, but I got tired of the flavors quickly. That rarely happens with ice cream for me. Overall, it’s overpriced and overrated :(
original: Mehhh, I've seriously experienced better. Maybe I've been spoiled by all the good ice cream in LA already. There wasn't much variety as I was hoping for for an ice cream spot..in Vegas. I had the Cereal Milk with sprinkles added and got bored of the flavors real quick. That rarely happens with ice cream for me. Overall, overhyped and overpriced :(

text: Last time I visited this place was in 2015, and I had a cannoli and hot chocolate after the Rock n Roll Las Vegas half marathon! This time, I got a slice of the strawberry frosting rainbow cake, and UGH. This is what an excellent frosting-to-cake ratio looks like! It's a large slice, so it makes an extra special treat when you want something sweet. I gave four stars because I think the packaging could be nicer (shift from plastic to paper/cardboard).
text_en: Last time I visited this place was in 2015, and I had a cannoli and hot chocolate after the Rock n Roll Las Vegas half marathon! This time, I got a slice of the strawberry frosting rainbow cake, and UGH. This is what an excellent frosting-to-cake ratio looks like! It's a large slice, so it makes an extra special treat when you want something sweet. I gave four stars because I think the packaging could be nicer (shift from plastic to paper/cardboard).

text: Nossa, este lugar era incrível! Adorei os sabores do sorvete e a loja era agradável, com jogos de tabuleiro para jogar. Com certeza eles precisarão mudar para um espaço maior!
text_en: Wow, this place was amazing! I loved the flavors of the ice cream, and the store was pleasant, with board games for playing. They definitely need to move to a larger space!
original: Wow, this place was great! Loved the ice cream flavors and the shop was nice with board games to play. They will definitely need to move to bigger place!

text: Fantástico. Meu lugar favorito para cupcakes/doces. Sempre tem fila, mas o atendimento é rápido. É impossível passar pela Sprinkles sem fazer uma visita. Você vai se arrepender se não for.
text_en: Fantastic. My favorite place for cupcakes and desserts. There’s always a line, but service is quick. It’s impossible not to visit Sprinkles. You’ll regret it if you don’t go.
original: Fantastic. My favorite cupcake/shop. Theres always a line, but it moves pretty quick. You can't pass Sprinkles without stopping in. You'll be missing out if you do.

text: Siempre he sido fan de Milk desde mi primera visita a Nueva York. Me esforcé por visitar la tienda ubicada dentro del hotel Cosmopolitan. Quería llevarme un pastel de "Crack" y probar su helado. Las opciones de helado eran Milk (con cereal) y Compost cookie. Se pueden añadir toppings como copos de maíz y chispas. Resultado: Kathy V. Aprobado.
text_en: I’ve always been a fan of Milk since my first visit to New York. I tried hard to visit the store located inside the Cosmopolitan Hotel. I wanted to buy a “Crack” cake and try their ice cream. The ice cream options were Milk (with cereal) and Compost cookie. You can add toppings like corn kernels and sparkles. Result: Kathy V. Approved.
original: Always been a fan of Milk ever since my 1st time in NYC. I made efforts to pay a visit located inside the Cosmopolitan hotel. I wanted to bring home some Crack pie and try out their soft serve. Choices of soft serve were Milk cereal and Compost cookie serve. You can choose toppings such as cornflakes and sprinkles. Outcome: Kathy V. I approved.

text: El precio es bueno, y el donut de cheesecake con arándanos es delicioso.
text_en: The price is good, and the cheesecake donut with raisins is delicious.
original: Price is good and blueberry cheesecake donut is to die for.

text: Solo compré un croissant de chocolate y zumo de naranja aquí, pero ambos estaban deliciosos. La ubicación es una bendición y una maldición: está justo en la base de los ascensores para los huéspedes, lo que facilita el acceso por la mañana... pero también significa que suele estar muy concurrido. Afortunadamente, mi esposo y yo logramos entrar antes de que llegara un grupo de 30 personas. Me sentí mal por las personas que estaban detrás, ¡tenían que esperar mucho tiempo!
text_en: I only bought a chocolate croissant and orange juice here, but both were delicious. The location is both a blessing and a curse: it’s right at the bottom of the elevators for guests, which makes it easy to get in in the morning… but it also means it’s usually very crowded. Fortunately, my husband and I managed to get in before a group of 30 people arrived. I felt bad for those people behind us—they had to wait for a long time!
original: I only got a chocolate croissant and orange juice here, but both were very yummy! The location of it is a blessing and a curse: it's right at the base of the guest elevators, so it makes it easy to get to in the morning... but that also makes it crowded. Luckily, my husband and I were able to get in line before a group of 30 people descended on the place. I felt bad for the people behind them, they were going to have a very long wait!

text: Um lugar incrível para comer donuts! Recomendo o donut de pasta de amendoim e geleia, bem como os donuts de bolo de morango. Pessoas simpáticas e donuts deliciosos!
text_en: An amazing place to eat donuts! I recommend the peanut butter and jam donut, as well as the strawberry cake donuts. The people are friendly, and the donuts are delicious!
original: Awesome place for donuts!!! I would recommend the pb&j donut as well as the strawberry cake donuts. Friendly people and big delicious donuts!

text: Afterward Windsor, step next door and have a handmade ice cream or sorbet from Churn. You'll like the old-fashioned candy store feel and you can have tastes from Sebastian, one of the happiest guys that I've ever met. I personally get the Peanut Butter w/ Hot Fudge or even add in some Butter Pecan. My wife loves their Mint Chocolate Chip, it is tasty. Careful on your timing though, there may be a line out the door!
text_en: Afterward Windsor, step next door and have a handmade ice cream or sorbet from Churn. You'll like the old-fashioned candy store feel and you can have tastes from Sebastian, one of the happiest guys that I've ever met. I personally get the Peanut Butter w/ Hot Fudge or even add in some Butter Pecan. My wife loves their Mint Chocolate Chip, it is tasty. Careful on your timing though, there may be a line out the door!

text: Estoy muy contento de que finalmente hayan traído 85° al área de Las Vegas. Los pasteles y los postres aquí son deliciosos y aportan un toque asiático a nuestra pequeña ciudad turística. Desde el pan de queso con jalapeño hasta el pan de taro, pasando por los bollos de leche y las tartaletas, realmente no puedes equivocarte cuando vienes aquí. Si te gusta la sal, quizás quieras probar el café con sal marina, pero normalmente opto por un americano con hielo. Lo mejor es que empaquetan todo en bolsas individuales, lo que permite que se mantengan frescos y conservan el sabor. Si tienes un cumpleaños próximo, también tienen pasteles muy buenos y un delicioso tiramisú. Normalmente, aquí suele estar muy concurrido y ruidoso, ya que es tan bueno, así que te recomendaría que tengas en cuenta que es posible que encuentres todas las mesas ocupadas si quieres sentarte. Si aún no has venido, deberías hacerlo. Está en el nuevo centro comercial Shanghai, cerca de algunos restaurantes interesantes. Obviamente, con la situación actual, todo es principalmente para llevar, pero aún así, te sentirás muy contento de dejar este delicioso establecimiento.
text_en: I’m very happy that they finally brought 85° to the Las Vegas area. The cakes and desserts here are delicious, adding an Asian touch to our small tourist town. From cheese bread with jalapeño to taro bread, and from milk buns to cupcakes, you really can’t go wrong when you come here. If you like salt, you might want to try the sea salt coffee, but usually I prefer an American coffee with ice. The best thing is that they pack everything in individual bags, which helps keep them fresh and preserves their flavor. If you have a birthday coming up, they also have great cakes and delicious tiramisu. Usually, it’s very crowded and noisy here because everything is so good, so I recommend considering that all tables might be occupied if you want to sit down. If you haven’t been there yet, you should go. It’s located in the new Shanghai shopping center, near some interesting restaurants. Of course, given the current situation, everything is mainly for taking home, but still, you’ll be very happy to leave this delicious place.
original: I am so happy that they finally brought 85° into the Las Vegas area. The pastries and cakes here are so delicious and bring a hint of Asia to our little tourist town. From their jalapeno cream cheese bread to the taro bread to the milk buns and egg tarts, You can't really go wrong when you come here. If you like salt then maybe you want to try the sea salt coffee but I normally go with an iced Americano. What's even better is that they box everything up and put them in individual little bags which allow them to stay fresher and keeps the taste! If you have a birthday coming up they have some pretty sweet cakes too and delicious tiramisu! It's kind of loud and packed here normally because it's so good so I would caution you that you might find all the tables occupied if you're looking to sit down. If you haven't been here you probably should and it's in the new Shanghai plaza with some cool little restaurants nearby. Obviously with what's going on now everything is pretty much take out and you'll still be happy leaving this delicious establishment.

text: Cappuccino's here are so tasty and so are the desserts. This is a fun trendy cafe to hit after a dinner in Charlotte. The decor is fun to look at and their little gift shop is cute too.
text_en: Cappuccino's here are so tasty and so are the desserts. This is a fun trendy cafe to hit after a dinner in Charlotte. The decor is fun to look at and their little gift shop is cute too.

text: Mitchell's é uma instituição em Cleveland e um lugar imperdível! Qualquer amante de sorvete vai adorar o Mitchell's e apreciar a qualidade dos ingredientes utilizados em cada sabor. Eu escolhi o sorvete de coco com pedaços de chocolate, já que sou um grande fã de coco, e também o sorvete "smores". Recentemente, experimentei vários sorvetes "smores" que não foram tão bons, mas o Mitchell's conseguiu capturar todos os elementos desse doce e realmente te fez sentir como se estivesse comendo sorvete ao redor de uma fogueira. Recomendo muito experimentar os pequenos potes, que permitem provar vários sabores, pois pode ser difícil escolher apenas um se você não estiver procurando algo específico. É ótimo poder observar e conhecer a fábrica de sorvetes enquanto se saboreia um delicioso sorvete.
text_en: Mitchell’s is an institution in Cleveland—a must-visit place! Any fan of ice cream will love Mitchell’s, and appreciate the quality of the ingredients used in each flavor. I chose the coconut ice cream with chocolate chunks, as I’m a big fan of coconut, and also the “smores” ice cream. Recently, I tried several “smores” flavors that weren’t very good, but Mitchell’s managed to capture all the elements of this dessert and really made you feel like you were eating ice cream around a fire. I highly recommend trying the small containers, which allow you to try multiple flavors—it can be difficult to choose just one if you’re not looking for something specific. It’s great to observe and get to know the ice cream factory while enjoying a delicious ice cream.
original: Mitchell's is a Cleveland staple and a must! Any ice cream fan will love Mitchell's and appreciate the quality ingredients that go into every ice cream. I opted for the coconut chocolate chip is a big coconut fan as well as the smore ice cream. I've had several smore ice creams lately that really missed the mark but Mitchell's did a great job of capturing every element of a smore and really made you feel like you were eating ice cream around a campfire. I highly recommend getting the taster scoops which allow you to try several kinds of ice creams because it will be hard to choose only one if you're not looking for too much. It's nice to be able to watch and check out their ice cream factory while enjoying ice cream.

text: How cute is this place! Beautiful location. The hipster behind the corner is the perfect touch too. Great creamy Ice cream. I got the winter flavor. It was bomb as hell! I will be back! A single is like 4$ and double like 8$ which is huge!!! Worth every penny. There is parking near by and seating outside. They accept card and cash. No need to go to the ATM or scramble around for cash. Your ice cream gets served in a Chinese takeout container with a fortune cookie. Don't be a dummy like me and almost eat the fortune inside the cookie. Anyway delicious place.
text_en: How cute is this place! Beautiful location. The hipster behind the corner is the perfect touch too. Great creamy Ice cream. I got the winter flavor. It was bomb as hell! I will be back! A single is like 4$ and double like 8$ which is huge!!! Worth every penny. There is parking near by and seating outside. They accept card and cash. No need to go to the ATM or scramble around for cash. Your ice cream gets served in a Chinese takeout container with a fortune cookie. Don't be a dummy like me and almost eat the fortune inside the cookie. Anyway delicious place.

text: Decidimos experimentar este lugar enquanto estávamos em Las Vegas. As filas eram longas e demorou um tempo para fazer nosso pedido. Compramos um mini cannoli e uma lagosta. O cannoli não estava encharcado e estava delicioso. A lagosta também estava excelente. Eu realmente gostei do recheio cremoso da lagosta. O único problema que tive com este lugar é que parece que ele é administrado de forma muito ineficiente. Não vejo o Cake Boss há muito tempo, então não sei se o local original é administrado da mesma forma. Não deveria levar tanto tempo para atender um cliente, pegar os itens e colocá-los em uma sacola/caixa. Não ficou claro para mim por que o processo de pedido, retirada e pagamento leva tanto tempo.
text_en: We decided to try this place while we were in Las Vegas. The lines were long, and it took a while for our order to be processed. We bought a mini cannoli and a lobster. The cannoli weren’t soggy at all, and they were delicious. The lobster was also excellent. I really liked the creamy filling in the lobster. The only problem with this place is that it seems to be managed very inefficiently. It’s been a long time since I’ve seen Cake Boss, so I don’t know if the original location is managed in the same way. It shouldn’t take so long to serve a customer, pick up the items, and put them in a bag or box. It’s not clear to me why the process of ordering, picking up, and paying takes so long.
original: We decided to check this place out while we were in Vegas. The lines were long and it took a while to get our order placed. We purchased a mini cannoli and a lobster tail. The cannoli was not soggy and was delicious. The lobster tail was excellent as well. I really enjoyed the cream filling in the lobster tail. The only issue I had with this place is that it seems to be run in a very inefficient manner. I have not seen Cake Boss in a long time so I don't know if the original location is run in a similar manner. It should not be that time consuming to take a customer's order, get the items out of the case, and put the items in a bag/box. It was not clear to me why the ordering/picking up/paying process takes so long.

text: I love the variety of flavors. They have a fun twist on desserts, I have come here for everything from cookies to soft serve to birthday cake. I love it all, it's nice to have something different and unique. I recommend it for anyone who can think outside the box and can appreciate different flavors. I have recommended it to family and friends who have enjoyed it as well.
text_en: I love the variety of flavors. They have a fun twist on desserts, I have come here for everything from cookies to soft serve to birthday cake. I love it all, it's nice to have something different and unique. I recommend it for anyone who can think outside the box and can appreciate different flavors. I have recommended it to family and friends who have enjoyed it as well.

text: Estoy encantado con los "menús de helados" y los donuts rellenos de helado en esta pequeña joya en el centro de Phoenix. Brandon, quien comparte la propiedad de NIC con su esposa, hizo que cualquier persona que entrara en la tienda se sintiera bienvenida de inmediato, al servir helado artesanal con una docena de toppings divertidos, muchos de los cuales tienen nombres inspirados en programas de televisión. Y para rematar, se me ha dicho que sus donuts elaborados con ingredientes locales han sido nombrados como uno de los 50 mejores donuts de Estados Unidos y el mejor donut de Arizona.
text_en: I’m thrilled with the “ice cream menus” and ice cream-filled donuts at this little gem in the heart of Phoenix. Brandon, who shares the NIC property with his wife, makes anyone who enters the store feel welcome right away—he serves handmade ice cream with a dozen fun toppings, many of which are named after TV shows. And to top it all off, I was told that his locally-sourced ingredients used in the donuts have been named one of the 50 best donuts in the United States, and the best donut in Arizona.
original: I'm swooning for the ice cream flights and ice cream filled donuts at this little gem in downtown Phoenix. Brandon, who co-owns NIC with his wife, instantly made anyone that came through the door feel welcome as he dished up hand turned ice cream with half a dozen fun toppings, many of which are playfully named after TV shows. As if that's not enough excitement, I've been told their locally sourced donuts were named one of the 50 best donuts in America and the best donut in Arizona.

text: Uma experiência incrível em todos os aspectos! A equipe foi extremamente atenciosa, simpática e experiente; os doces eram frescos, deliciosos e saborosos; os pratos principais, especialmente o waffle com frango, foram uma verdadeira alegria para o paladar! Recomendo muito!
text_en: An incredible experience in every aspect! The team was extremely attentive, friendly, and experienced; the desserts were fresh, delicious, and tasty; the main dishes, especially the chicken waffle, were a real delight for the taste buds! I highly recommend it!
original: Amazing overall experience! The staff were totally attentive, pleasant and knowledgeable; the pastries were fresh, Devine and tasty; the entrees, especially the Waffle & Chicken were a pure culinary joy! Highly recommend!

text: ¡Un pastel de cumpleaños fabuloso de Bouchon! Delicioso y jugoso. ¡Muy bien decorado - volveremos!
text_en: A fantastic birthday cake from Bouchon! Delicious and juicy. Very well decorated – we’ll be back!
original: Fabulous bday cake by Bouchon !!! Delicious and moist ! Beautifully decorated - we will return

text: The girl who helped us is an evil, seductive temptress with her ice cream scoop. Here's the deal, I'm wicked lactose intolerant, I had just eaten a bunch of Mac and cheese and was already seriously regretting my life decisions. So of course, instead of just calling it a day, I suggest wandering over to Churn. Ya know, I hadn't been there before and I only want to LOOK. What's the harm in browsing? And then this girl, this adorably sweet and friendly girl behind the ice cream counter is all "oh, just try them! Here.. Have a sample of every flavor we have". So I do, I try them all. And then I order a brownie, and then shes all sweetly saying "why don't I top this off with a scoop of vanilla? And whipped cream with chocolate sauce? You cant just have a plain brownie.. That's just not right." And I'm like putty in her hands. I nod my head weakly in agreement, mumbling something like "no you can't have a plain brownie." And then I buy a bag of mini gummy bears, because, well because they're there.

text: What a nice find for ice cream! I visited with my wife and parents on Sunday and was happily surprised to see they had fall seasonal flavors. The pumpkin roll arctic twist was amazing and came with a slice of pumpkin roll on top. I can't wait to visit again soon!
text_en: What a nice find for ice cream! I visited with my wife and parents on Sunday and was happily surprised to see they had fall seasonal flavors. The pumpkin roll arctic twist was amazing and came with a slice of pumpkin roll on top. I can't wait to visit again soon!

text: This is my favorite ice cream place in Cleveland's west side. My most recent visit was specifically to try the ube ice cream. I also got taro so I could taste the difference between the two. I prefer ube, which was more flavorful and sweeter to me. Also, it is a pretty shade of purple! There are many other unique flavors here, and it changes weekly. Vegan flavors are available too. The best way to keep up with the ever changing menu is to follow their Instagram. I'm hoping they bring back the green tea soft serve soon. The shop is small, with outdoor seating and no indoor seating. Parking only has about five spaces, so it is easier to park on the street. The shop itself is super cute and has artwork of dogs eating ice cream on the wall and on the cups. It's just a perfect spot to hang out at during the summer.

text: Helado delicioso y muchas opciones sin gluten. Un poco caro, pero una experiencia muy agradable. ¡Además, la tienda es muy encantadora!
text_en: Delicious ice cream with many gluten-free options. A little expensive, but a very pleasant experience. Also, the store is really charming!
original: Great ice cream and lots of gluten free options! A little pricey but such a nice treat. Super cute store too!!

text: Foi muito decepcionante e não corresponde aos padrões do Bouchon! Minha família e eu já visitamos a padaria Bouchon em Yountville, Califórnia, muitas vezes, e esta unidade em Las Vegas é inferior. Não entendemos completamente por que eles não estão mantendo um controle de qualidade adequado, mas, depois de nos esforçarmos para comprar doces lá em nosso único dia em Las Vegas, sentimos a obrigação de escrever uma avaliação. Compramos croissants com manteiga e croissants de amêndoa, e ambos estavam rançosos e ruins. Pareciam ter pelo menos um dia de idade. Além de termos visitado a padaria Bouchon em California várias vezes, também já comemos no Bouchon Bistro em Yountville em diversas ocasiões especiais. Nunca fomos decepcionados lá e sempre adoramos nossas refeições. Talvez a padaria Bouchon em Las Vegas seja administrada por outra pessoa?
text_en: It was very disappointing—it doesn’t meet the standards of Bouchon! My family and I have visited the Bouchon bakery in Yountville, California, many times, and this location in Las Vegas is inferior. We don’t fully understand why they don’t maintain proper quality control. But after trying to buy sweets there on our only day in Las Vegas, we felt it was necessary to write a review. We bought butter croissants and almond croissants, and both were stale and bad. They seemed to be at least a day old. In addition to having visited the Bouchon bakery in California several times, we’ve also eaten at the Bouchon Bistro in Yountville on various special occasions. We’ve never been disappointed there, and we always loved our meals. Maybe the Bouchon bakery in Las Vegas is managed by someone else?
original: So very disappointing and not up to Bouchon standards! My family and I have been to Bouchon Bakery in Yountville California many many times, and this Las Vegas location is inferior. We are not quite sure why they aren't keeping up with quality control, but after going out of our way to get pastries there on our one day in Vegas, we felt obligated to write a review. We had butter croissants and almond croissants, and they were all stale and awful. They seemed to be day old at least. We have not only been to Bouchon Bakery many times in California, but we have also eaten at Bouchon Bistro in Yountville for various special occasions. We have never been disappointed there, and have always loved our meals. Perhaps the Bouchon Bakery in Vegas is under different ownership?

text: Experimentei com a torta de nozes e a maioria dos sabores de biscoitos. A torta não era o que eu esperava e tinha um sabor apenas ok... recheio muito rico, denso e feito com manteiga... não coma toda a fatia de uma vez... não acredito no preço astronômico de uma torta inteira... acima de 50... os biscoitos estavam medíocres... gostei mais do de milho.
text_en: I tried the nut cake and most of the cookie flavors. The cake wasn’t what I expected; it had just an okay taste… the filling was very rich and thick, made with butter… don’t eat the whole slice at once… I can’t believe the astronomically high price of a whole cake… over 50… the cookies were mediocre… I preferred the corn ones more.
original: Tried crack pie and most cookie flavors. Pie wasn't what I expected and tasted just ok.... very rich dense butter solid filling ...don't eat the entire slice in one sitting...can't believe the astronomical cost for a whole pie...over 50+... cookies were meh......liked the corn one best

text: Eu realmente gostei da criatividade de algumas opções, como "PB&J" e "Captain Crunch Berry". Isso me lembra dos anos 80 e 90, quando todas as crianças cresceram e estão relembrando todos os cereais que consumíamos quando éramos crianças. E agora eles estão colocando esses cereais em sorvete. É genial. O sorvete de café estava delicioso, e o "Captain Crunch" manteve o sabor original. No entanto, não entendo a inclusão dos biscoitos de sorte na caixa de comida chinesa, como se fosse parte do recipiente...
text_en: I really liked the creativity of some of the options, like “PB&J” and “Captain Crunch Berry”. It reminds me of the 80s and 90s, when all the kids grew up and are remembering all the snacks we ate as children. And now they’re putting those snacks in ice cream. It’s great. Coffee ice cream was delicious, and “Captain Crunch” kept its original taste. However, I don’t understand why cookies are included in the Chinese food box, as if they’re part of the container…
original: I really liked the creativity in some of the options like PB&J and Captain Crunch Berry. It reminds me of the 80s and 90s, like all the kids grew up and are reminiscing about all the cereals we used to have growing up. And now they put them in ice cream. It's genius. The coffee ice cream was awesome, and the captain crunch was true to flavor. However I don't get the fortune cookie in Chinese takeout box as the cup...

text: Experimentei os donuts neste lugar depois de ouvir recomendações de um colega de trabalho, e valeu muito a pena. Sem dúvida, são os melhores donuts que já provei. Recomendo este lugar com certeza.
text_en: I tried the donuts at this place after hearing recommendations from a coworker, and it was well worth it. undoubtedly, they are the best donuts I’ve ever tasted. I definitely recommend this place.
original: I've tried Donuts at this place after hearing about them from my co-worker and it was totally worth it. These are by far the best Donuts I've tasted. I definitely recommend this place.

text: took a trip to Jack Frost for a classmate's birthday... it was a little out of the way but the donuts looked too BOMB on yelp not to go. I came here around 7:00am and surprisingly there was a little line- a good sign! I ended up ordering a dozen for about $15. The donuts- I would guess they probably had 30 + different flavors when I was there. They had a variety of cake and yeast donuts, but it seemed like more cake donuts. Some flavors that I remember include salted caramel (counter lady said it was the best selling), maple bacon, german chocolate, pumpkin cheesecake, apple cinnamon, samoa, s'mores, fruity pebbles and captain crunch cereal covered donuts. The donuts are really well made. The texture of the cake itself is good, but the toppings were incredible and super fresh! Like people have said before, I have to take a star off for the unlabeled donuts. I would at least have a list or a sign. It got super tedious having to ask the worker what each donut was, and i noticed that customers in front of me just opted for a variety box where you don't choose what you get.

text: Eu gostaria que abrissem uma filial da Sweet Republic no Vale do Sudoeste. Eu não costumo ir para o Norte de Scottsdale, mas vale a pena o deslocamento! O sorvete "Toffee Banofi" é DELICIOSO!!! É o tamanho perfeito para duas pessoas dividirem em um encontro de sobremesa. Recomendo muito! Por favor, venham para Gilbert!
text_en: I would like them to open a branch of Sweet Republic in the Southwest Valley. I don’t usually go to North Scottsdale, but the travel is worth it! The “Toffee Banoffi” ice cream is DELICIOUS!!! It’s the perfect size for two people to share during a dessert date. I highly recommend it! Please come to Gilbert!
original: I wish they would open a Sweet Republic in the Southeast Valley. I'm rarely in North Scottsdale, but this is worth the drive! The Toffee Banofi Sundae is DELICIOUS!!! It's a perfect size for two people to share on a dessert date. Highly recommend! Please come to Gilbert!

text: Esta es, sin duda, la mejor heladería que he probado. Estábamos buscando helados y lo buscamos en nuestras aplicaciones de mapas, y este lugar apareció. Yo pedí el sándwich de gofres con "Cookie Monster" (¡DELICIOSO!) y mi novio pidió el sándwich de gofres con helado de chocolate (¡TAMBIÉN DELICIOSO!). Nuestro apartamento está a solo unos minutos y habíamos terminado completamente nuestros helados antes de llegar a casa. ¡Es una visita obligada en Phoenix! Lo recomiendo encarecidamente.
text_en: This is undoubtedly the best ice cream shop I’ve ever tried. We were looking for ice creams and searched through our map apps, and this place came up. I ordered the waffle sandwich with “Cookie Monster” ice cream (DELICIOUS!) and my boyfriend ordered the waffle sandwich with chocolate ice cream (ALSO DELICIOUS!). Our apartment is just a few minutes away, and we finished our ice creams before even getting home. It’s a must-visit in Phoenix! I highly recommend it.
original: This is seriously the best Ice cream I've ever had. We were looking for ice cream and typed it in to our maps and this place popped up. I got the Cookie Monster waffle sandwich (YUMMM) and my boyfriend got the chocolate ice cream waffle sandwich (ALSO YUM). Our apartment is only a few minutes away and we had completely finished our ice creams before we got home. This is a MUST TRY in Phx!! I highly recommend it!

text: A localização é o maior desafio, mas a execução dos deliciosos doces é perfeita. Comecei a segui-los nas redes sociais e todas as suas criações parecem impecáveis. O local é um pouco escondido em um pequeno e sem graça centro comercial, com sinalização ruim, mas isso deve ser superado para que você possa experimentar o que há de melhor. Experimentei apenas um doce, sem pensar duas vezes. Escolhi o "urkkel" (?). Qualquer coisa relacionada a assuntos familiares da década de 1990 é imperdível. Estava perfeito. Adicionei um macaron de frutas que não era a minha primeira escolha, mas eles não tinham o caramelo. Eles colocaram um marshmallow tostado que assaram na hora, e eu entrei em êxtase. Meu acompanhante escolheu uma pequena porção de "Netflix e relaxar". Nós dois votamos no meu como o melhor, mas o doce de pipoca dela era diferente e divertido.
text_en: The location is the biggest challenge, but the execution of the delicious sweets is perfect. I started following them on social media, and all their creations seem impeccable. The place is a bit hidden in a small and unimpressive shopping center, with poor signage, but that can be overcome so you can experience what’s best. I tried just one sweet, without hesitation. I chose the “urkkel” (?). Anything related to family topics from the 1990s is worth trying. It was perfect. I added a fruit macaron that wasn’t my first choice, but they didn’t have caramel. They put in a toasted marshmallow that was cooked right away, and I was thrilled. My companion chose a small portion of “Netflix and Relax”. We both voted for mine as the best, but her popcorn candy was different and fun.
original: The location is their biggest struggle but the execution of delicious desserts is spot on. Started following hem on social media and all their concoctions look too notch. It's slightly tucked away in a small pointless shopping enter with bad signage but that must be overcome so your mouth and tummy can get a taste of what's going on here. Didn't taste anything just dove straight in. Went with the urkkel(sp?). Anything related to family matters circa 1995 is a must try. It was perfect. Added a fruity pebble macaroon which wasn't my first choice but they were out of the caramel. They threw on a toasted marshmallow that they brÃ»lÃ©ed right there and I was off to dessert nirvana. My counterpart went with a small scoop of Netfix and chill. We both voted mine to be the champ but her popcorn treat was different and fun.

text: My favorite ice cream place in Pittsburgh... they have over a dozen varieties of soft serve... caramel, coconut, peach, pineapple, peanut butter... and I can never decide which to get. They're all yummy. I've never tried the food, but who cares, it's all about the soft serve!
text_en: My favorite ice cream place in Pittsburgh... they have over a dozen varieties of soft serve... caramel, coconut, peach, pineapple, peanut butter... and I can never decide which to get. They're all yummy. I've never tried the food, but who cares, it's all about the soft serve!

text: O milkshake estava delicioso, o sorvete era rico, alguns dos cupcakes estavam secos e outros eram excelentes. Gostaria de agradecer a uma funcionária muito simpática, que nos deu ótimas sugestões sobre cada um dos cupcakes, a Jenelle foi excelente. Devem dar um aumento para ela. UM GRANDE AGRADECIMENTO A JENELLE.
text_en: The milkshake was delicious, the ice cream was rich, some of the cupcakes were dry while others were excellent. I would like to thank a very kind employee who gave us great suggestions about each cupcake. Jenelle was outstanding. They should give her a raise. A huge thank you to Jenelle.
original: The Shake was tasty, the ice cream was rich, some of the cupcakes were dry and some of the cupcakes were excellent. Shout out to a very friendly employee who gave us her reviews on each of the cupcakes excellent recommendations, Jenelle was great. Give her a raise. SHOUT OUT TO JENELLE
