text: Probé los cupcakes de Sprinkles en Las Vegas. Compré uno de vainilla, y estaba denso y seco. Tenía mucha cobertura, pero a nadie le gustó. También probé el cupcake de canela y azúcar, que estaba aún más seco que el de vainilla y tenía la consistencia de un panqueque de maíz. Era muy difícil de tragar. Todavía tengo los de red velvet y plátano que probar, pero después de los dos primeros, no estoy muy entusiasmado. El de red velvet tampoco era nada especial, estaba seco de nuevo. El pastel de plátano estaba húmedo, pero era muy pesado. Mejor ahorrar mi dinero, ya que puedo hacer pasteles mejores que estos.
text_en: I tried the Sprinkles cupcakes in Las Vegas. I bought one with vanilla flavor, but it was dense and dry. It had a lot of frosting, but no one liked it. I also tried the cinnamon and sugar cupcake; it was even drier than the vanilla one, and its texture was like a corn muffin. It was very hard to swallow. I still have the red velvet and banana cupcakes left to try, but after the first two, I’m not very excited. The red velvet cupcake wasn’t special either—it was dry again. The banana cake was wet, but it was very heavy. It’s better to save my money, since I can make better cakes than these.
original: Tried Sprinkles in Las Vegas. got a vanilla cupcake, was dense and dry..lots of icing..no one liked it..also tried the cinnamon sugar cupcake..was drier than the vanilla and had the consistency of a corn muffin..very hard to swallow..still have red velvet and banana to try but not looking forward to them after the first two red velvet was nothing spectacular..dry again..the banana cake was moist but was very heavy.. will save my money..I can make better cakes than these

text: Estaba muy decepcionado. Pedí la tarta con galletas. Era como una porción de galleta dura. No entendí la idea de este producto. 6 dólares. ¡No vale la pena! Mejor que te compres un helado.
text_en: I was very disappointed. I ordered the tart with cookies. It was just a portion of hard cookies. I didn’t understand what this product was for. $6. It’s not worth it! It’s better to buy a ice cream instead.
original: So disappointed. Had the crack pie. It was like a pie slice of hard cookie. Didn't see what the idea of this item was suppose to be. $6. Not worth it! Get some gelato instead.

text: Sou um grande apreciador de sorvete e o Chin está na minha lista de lugares para visitar. Espere ter que esperar na fila. Não se preocupe, vale a pena. Adoro o "Sunday S'mores", mas até mesmo uma bola de sorvete deles, sem os acompanhamentos, é deliciosa. Bônus: um lugar legal, cheio de objetos que remetem à sua infância.
text_en: I’m a big fan of ice cream, and Chin is on my list of places to visit. Just be prepared to wait in line. Don’t worry, it’s worth it. I love “Sunday S’mores”, but even a single scoop of their ice cream, without any toppings, is delicious. Bonus: it’s a great place with lots of items that remind you of your childhood.
original: I'm an ice cream aficionado and chin is pretty high on the list of places to go. Expect a wait in line here. Don't worry, it's well worth it. I love the smores Sunday, but even a scoop of their ice cream without all the toppings holds up by itself. Bonus: cool place with lots of niknaks from your childhood.

text: Magníficos donuts! Tenho comprado os donuts deles desde que eram uma loja temporária. São realmente frescos, com uma grande variedade, deliciosos e com donos muito simpáticos. Os melhores donuts veganos (ou de qualquer tipo) que já experimentei!!
text_en: Great donuts! I’ve been buying their donuts since they were just a temporary store. They’re really fresh, with a wide variety, delicious, and the owners are very friendly. The best vegan donuts (or any type) I’ve ever tried!!
original: Awesome donuts! Been getting their donuts since they were a popup. Really fresh, great variety, delicious, and super nice owners. Best vegan (or any) donuts ever!!

text: O cannoli do "Caffepalermo" no "Vegas Cigar" estava muito próximo de ser perfeito. Nota final: A. Um dos melhores cannolis que já experimentei. A Itália é a minha primeira escolha, o "Caffepalermo" a segunda, e agora o "Carlo's Bakery" ocupa a terceira posição. Parabéns! Se você estiver em Las Vegas e gostar de cannolis como eu, este é o lugar certo.
text_en: The Cannoli from “Caffepalermo” at “Vegas Cigar” was very close to being perfect. Final note: One of the best cannoli I’ve ever tasted. Italy is my top choice, “Caffepalermo” comes second, and now “Carlo’s Bakery” takes third place. Congratulations! If you’re in Las Vegas and enjoy cannoli as I do, this is the right place.
original: Cannoli was very close to #caffepalermo NYC no Vegas Cigar. Final Grade : A. The best cannoli in a long time. Italy is my #1, Caffepalermo #2 and now #3 Carlo's Bakery. Congrats. If visiting Vegas and you love cannoli's like me, this is it.

text: The ice cream and smoothies are delicious. The only reason I rated them so long its because they have really bad customer service. The person who "helped" me out had an attitude the whole time. He acted like he was there against his will or something. I would not go back because I didn't feel welcomed at all.

text: Eu adoro este lugar! O "banana split" é incrível. Três porções do sabor que você preferir, duas fatias de pão de banana torrado e a sua escolha de creme de amendoim ou Nutella. Sério, é demais. Sou cliente frequente e pretendo continuar sendo por muito tempo. Parabéns, equipe!
text_en: I love this place! The “banana split” is amazing. Three portions of your favorite flavor, two slices of toasted banana bread, and your choice of peanut butter or Nutella cream. Seriously, it’s great. I’m a regular customer and plan to stay that way for a long time. Congratulations, team!
original: I love this place! The banana split is out of this world. Three scoops of your choice, two slices of toasted banana bread and your choice of pb or Nutella whipped cream. I mean, come on. I am a repeat customer and plan to be that way for a long time to come. Bravo masons, bravo.

text: Experimentei o novo local na semana passada e ele é tão bom quanto o local em NoDa. A única ressalva que tenho é que, para obter o seu primeiro café gratuito no local em Carmel, você precisa voltar para a fila e esperar que alguém atrás do balcão complete seu copo. Um pequeno preço a pagar por alguns dos melhores doces e pães de Charlotte. O café também é excelente. Um ótimo lugar para um sanduíche de café da manhã ou um sanduíche leve para o almoço (excelente patê) ou sopa.
text_en: I tried the new location last week, and it’s just as good as the one in NoDa. The only thing I have to mention is that, to get your first free coffee at the Carmel location, you need to wait in line and wait for someone behind the counter to fill your cup. It’s a small price to pay for some of the best desserts and bread from Charlotte. The coffee is also excellent. It’s a great place for a breakfast sandwich or a light lunch sandwich (excellent paté), or for soup.
original: Tried their new place last week and it is just as good as their NoDa place. The only nit pick I have is that to get your one free refill of coffee at their Carmel place you need to get back in line for someone behind the counter to refill your cup. Small price to pay for some of the best pastries and bread in Charlotte. Their coffee is also excellent. Great place for a breakfast sandwich or a light lunch sandwich (great pate) or soup.

text: This review is based on the kouign mann...I came here for croissant and i stumbled upon the display of Kouign amann!! OMGOMG!! I bought 4! It was like honey and crispy on the outside and super flaky on the inside. I think it's rare to stumble upo Kouign amann, for it's not widely made in most bakeries. text_en: Ready for something quick to eat while visiting with friends. I was impressed by the wide variety of authentic and delicious options to satisfy any sweet craving. The prices are good, and the food is excellent too!
original: Stopped in for a snack while in town with friends. I was overwhelmed with good authentic option to crave any sweet tooth desires! Good prices and even better food!

text: I am a huge fan of cheesecake, so don't take this lightly....this is easily one of the best pieces of cheesecake I've ever had. Would recommend 10/10. Friendly staff too.
text_en: I am a huge fan of cheesecake, so don't take this lightly....this is easily one of the best pieces of cheesecake I've ever had. Would recommend 10/10. Friendly staff too.

text: He ido a esta pequeña heladería desde que estaba en la escuela secundaria, y es uno de mis lugares favoritos para ir con mis amigos. Nunca me decepciona ninguna de las opciones de helados que ofrecen, ¡y el personal es fantástico! Siempre recomiendo su helado de fresa, es realmente el mejor que he probado.
text_en: I’ve been going to this small ice cream shop since I was in high school, and it’s one of my favorite places to go with my friends. The ice creams they offer never disappoint me, and the staff are fantastic! I always recommend their strawberry ice cream – it’s truly the best one I’ve ever tried.
original: I've been going to this little ice cream shop since I was in high school and it has been one of my favorite spots to go visit with my friends. I'm never disappointed with any of their ice cream selections they offer and the staff is fantastic! I always recommend their strawberry ice cream, it's legitimately the best I've ever had.

text: El helado de Handel es excelente. Nos gustan todos los sabores que hemos probado y regresamos con frecuencia. Hoy, le di a este negocio una valoración de 1 estrella porque el empleado que servía helado y cobraba el dinero NO llevaba mascarilla. Esto es inaceptable y nosotros, junto con otros clientes que estaban esperando, nos fuimos sin comprar helado. No estoy seguro de si volveré a este negocio, ya que parece que no están tomando las precauciones necesarias contra el COVID. Me encanta su helado, pero prefiero ir a otra tienda donde los empleados y los clientes sí llevan mascarillas.
text_en: Handel’s ice cream is excellent. We like all the flavors we have tried, and we often go back again. Today, I gave this store a 1-star rating because the employee who served the ice cream and collected money did NOT wear a mask. This is unacceptable, and along with other customers who were waiting, we left without buying any ice cream. I’m not sure if I’ll go back to this store, as it seems they aren’t taking the necessary precautions against COVID. I love their ice cream, but I prefer going to another store where employees and customers do wear masks.
original: Handel's ice cream is great. We love all the flavors we have tried and frequently go back for more. I gave this business a 1-star review today because the employee serving ice cream and taking payments was NOT WEARING A MASK. This is unacceptable and we, along with other customers in line, walked away without getting ice cream. Not sure if I will be back to this business which does not seem to be taking the necessary covid precautions. I do love their ice cream, but I'll just go to the store instead where the employees and customers are wearing masks.

text: A Charlotte ice cream staple and a must go to stop for ice cream! Jeni's has tons of unique flavors that you can't find in your typical grocery store! Today I tried the Whiskey and Pecan flavor for the first time and I loved it!!! The whiskey flavor was subtle and added the perfect touch to the ice cream!

O sorvete é excelente e está disponível em muitos sabores deliciosos. As porções são muito generosas. Embora existam outras sorveterias menores na área, esta é definitivamente mais voltada para a família.
text_en: First time here in this new location. It’s still a ice cream shop with a more traditional style, but much smaller than the previous location. The ice cream is excellent, and there are many delicious flavors available. The portions are very generous. Although there are other smaller ice cream shops in the area, this one is definitely more family-friendly.

Very generous portions. While there are other small ice cream shops in the area, this one is definitely more family frien

text_en: The best donuts you will ever eat. A little piece of heaven! I recommend Jack Frost to everyone!!!

text: Tenho sido fã da Christina Tosi/Momofuku/Milk Bar há algum tempo. Finalmente consegui experimentar tudo, já que estou em Las Vegas, e tudo ficou exatamente como eu esperava. Pedیدم os itens mais populares (biscoito de composto, torta "crack", trufas de aniversário e leite de cereal). O leite de cereal estava ok. Não me impressionou tanto. Estava realmente esperando que o sorvete fosse mais cremoso. As trufas de aniversário foram, provavelmente, as minhas favoritas – um bolo de aniversário úmido, polvilhado com chocolate branco. Era muito cremoso e delicioso. E a torta "crack" estava incrível. É realmente única. Ainda não experimentei o biscoito de composto, mas até agora estou muito animada. A equipe foi extremamente informativa, atenciosa e simpática. Com certeza sou uma verdadeira fã!
text_en: I’ve been a fan of Christina Tosi/Momofuku/Milk Bar for some time now. Finally, I got to try everything, since I’m in Las Vegas, and everything was exactly as I expected. I ordered the most popular items—compost cookies, “crack” cake, birthday truffles, and cereal milk. The cereal milk was okay; it didn’t impress me much. I really expected the ice cream to be more creamy. The birthday truffles were probably my favorites—a moist birthday cake covered with white chocolate. It was very creamy and delicious. And the “crack” cake was amazing. It’s truly unique. I haven’t tried the compost cookies yet, but so far I’m very excited. The staff was extremely informative, attentive, and friendly. Definitely a true fan!
original: I've been a fan of Christina Tosi/Momofuku/Milk Bar for a while. I finally got to try it all since I'm here in Vegas, and it's everything I pretty much expected milk bar to be. I ordered the greatest hits (compost cookie, crack pie, birthday truffles, and cereal milk) The cereal milk was okay. It didn't really blow my mind. Was kind of hoping the ice cream would be more creamier. Birthday truffles were probably my favorite-- just moist birthday cake sprinkled with white chocolate. It was so creamy and addicting. and the crack pie was amazing. It's one of a kind for sure. Still haven't tried the compost cookie but so far I'm excited. The staff was extremely informative, kind, and sweet. I'm definitely a true fan!

text: Já visitei a Jeni's duas vezes e o sorvete é delicioso. A razão para as baixas estrelas é que, nas duas vezes em que fui, a equipe me fez sentir que estava incomodando-os por estar lá. É muito estranho. Na minha primeira visita, fui "recebido" com uma expressão de desdém e um olhar de reprovação. Eu nem sequer quis pedir uma amostra, por ser tão desconfortável. Na minha segunda visita, foi a mesma coisa. Levei minha irmã e ela também comentou sobre o atendimento. Pedimos o trio e fomos sentar ao ar livre. Logo percebi que nos deram um sabor errado, mas não quis voltar para a loja e lidar com a equipe, nem ela. Tenho receio de voltar devido à minha experiência desagradável nas duas vezes.
text_en: I’ve been to Jeni’s twice, and the ice cream is delicious. The reason for the low stars is that, during both visits, the staff made me feel like I was bothering them by being there. It’s very awkward. During my first visit, I was “received” with a disdainful expression and a reprimanding look. I didn’t even want to ask for a sample because it was so uncomfortable. During my second visit, it was the same. I brought my sister along, and she also commented on the service. We ordered the three-piece set and sat outside. Soon, I realized they gave us the wrong flavor, but I didn’t want to go back to the store and deal with the staff, nor did she. I’m afraid to go back due to my unpleasant experience during those two visits.
original: I've been to Jeni's twice now and they have delicious ice cream. The reason for the low stars is because both times I have visited, the staff have made me feel like I have inconvenienced them by being there. It's incredibly awkward. My first visit I was "greeted" with a frown and eye roll. I didn't even want to ask for a sample because it was that awkward. My second visit was just the same. I took my sister there and she even made a comment on the service. We ordered the trio and went to sit outside. I soon realized we were given a wrong flavor but did not want to go back into the store and deal with the staff and neither did she. I am wary to go back because of my unpleasant experience both times.

original: I used sprinkles cupcake ATM. The line inside didn't seem to be moving very fast. text: Este lugar foi absolutamente incrível. Minha irmã já tinha visto fotos nas redes sociais e, por isso, decidimos experimentar. They were eager to let us try as many flavors as we wanted and they were super helpful in making the final ice cream decision. text:
¿En serio? ¿Estoy realmente viendo esto? He alcanzado el paraíso del síndrome premenstrual. Esta amante de la cultura francesa ha encontrado un paraíso gastronómico. Mi querida amiga/compañera adicta a la comida, los zapatos y los libros, y yo, disfrutamos de nuestra primera visita a "Amelie's" durante la noche del viernes, y quedamos sorprendidos por la energía, la eficiencia del personal (¡mantuvieron la cola en movimiento!), la decoración original y los deliciosos manjares. Probamos algunos postres y aquí está lo bueno, lo malo y lo feo:

Lo bueno: Los "Creme Puffs" rellenos con una rica, dulce y espesa crema. Aquí no hay nata aguada. ¡Me encantó! El "Brownie de caramelo salado". Si hubiera estado con alguien más que con ella, seguramente habrían intentado probar esta deliciosa y pegajosa delicia, y les habría clavado el tenedor en la mano. Hay casi un centímetro de caramelo sobre este brownie, y la adición de una pizca de sal evita que sea demasiado dulce. Los "Tea Cakes" son muy húmedos. La frambuesa tiene un sabor más intenso que el limón. La cola se mueve rápido.

Lo malo: Bueno, en realidad no era tan malo, pero mi esposo y yo probamos el "Petit Gateau", y aunque el "ganache" era rico y suave (justo como me gustan los hombres, jaja), el pastel en sí era bastante seco. La cola se mueve tan rápido que es posible que no tenga la oportunidad de ver todos los postres. Me gusta analizar mis opciones; las calorías son valiosas y no quiero desperdiciarlas en snacks mediocres. Hay muchas bandejas vacías. Independientemente de lo rápido que trabajen, parece que estamos perdiendo algunas buenas opciones.

Lo feo: La casi pelea por los últimos "eclairs" y la extraña maniquí que literalmente se inclina sobre tu hombro mientras esperas en la cola. Soy Leo, y necesito mi espacio, y aunque suena loco, esa cosa me daba un poco de miedo. En general, es un lugar favorito instantáneo y una razón para visitar Charlotte con más frecuencia.
text_en:
Really? Am I really seeing this? I’ve reached the paradise of premenstrual syndrome. This lover of French culture has found a culinary paradise. My dear friend/companion, who is obsessed with food, shoes, and books, and I, we enjoyed our first visit to “Amelie’s” on Friday night. We were surprised by the energy, the efficiency of the staff (they kept things moving!), the original decorations, and the delicious dishes. We tried some desserts, and here’s what’s good, bad, and ugly:

**What’s good:** The “Creme Puffs” are filled with rich, sweet, and thick cream. There’s no watery cream here. I loved it! The “Salt Caramel Brownie”. If I had been with someone other than her, they would definitely have tried this delicious and sticky treat, and I would have stuck my fork in their hand. There’s almost a centimeter of caramel on this brownie, and a little salt prevents it from being too sweet. The “Tea Cakes” are very wet. The cranberry has a stronger flavor than lemon. The line moves quickly.

**What’s bad:** Well, actually it wasn’t that bad, but my husband and I tried the “Petit Gateau”. Although the “ganache” was rich and smooth (just like I like men, haha), the cake itself was quite dry. The line moves so fast that it’s possible I won’t get to try all the desserts. I like to analyze my options; calories are valuable, and I don’t want to waste them on mediocre snacks. There are many empty tables. No matter how fast they work, it seems like we’re losing some good options.

**What’s ugly:** There was almost a fight over the last “eclairs”, and that strange dummy that literally leans over your shoulder while you wait in line. I’m Leo, and I need my space. Although it sounds crazy, that thing scared me a little. Overall, it’s a favorite quick place to go, and a reason to visit Charlotte more often.
original: Seriously? Am I really seeing this? I have reached PMS nirvana. This Francophile has found sweet gastronomic heaven. My dear friend/fellow food/shoe/book junkie and I popped our Amelie's cherry(tart) late on Friday night and were pleasantly surprised by the high energy, efficiency of the staff (they kept that line mooooving!), funky decor and sinful eye candy. We had ourselves a little sampling and here's the good, the bad and the ugly: Good: Creme Puffs filled with rich, sweet, thick custard. No wimpy whipped cream here. My toes curled. The Salted Caramel Brownie. If I'd been w/anyone other than her, they would've been gotten stabbed in the hand w/my fork had they tried to sample this gooey confection. There is close to 1/4 inch of caramel atop this chewey brownie and the addition of a pinch of salt saves this from being too sweet. The Tea Cakes are very moist. The raspberry has a stronger flavor than the lemon. The line moves quickly. The bad: Okay, it really wasn't bad, but my hubby and I tried the Petit Gateau and, while the gnache was rich and smooth (just how I like my men, lol) the cake was actually pretty dry. The line moves so fast, you may not have a chance to see all the goodies. I like to weigh my options; calories are precious and I can't waste'em on so-so snacks. Lotsa empty trays. No matter how fast they work, they can't keep up w/demand so it seems like we may have missed some good options. The Ugly: The near cat-fight over the last eclairs and the creepy mannequin that literally leans over your shoulder as you wait in line. I'm a Leo, I like my space and crazy as it sounds, that thing was giving me the heebies. Overall, an instant favorite and a reason to haul our tushies down to Charlotte more often.

text: I have been the Vegas many times and every time we went by Carlos Bakery there was a huge line and even though I love sweets I couldn't stomach the line. Since we are staying at the Venetian it is now just a 5 minute walk away. This is a Thursday night and the wait was 10 minutes. We tried a little of everything and it was all very yummy. They have a lobster claw which is a cream filled pastry and it was great. I also tried the chocolate filled cream puff, the cannoli and two different cupcakes. Everything was fresh and delicious. They wrap everything up for you in a nice box with a gift-like presentation, very classy. The price point is such that everyone can afford to try "something" as most of the items are in the $3 to $5 each and I paid $11.00 for a chili dog earlier so in comparison this place is a deal. I still have 3 more days here in and I am certain I will be stopping by again to try some other delightful goodness. Update. I'm back several months later and this place is still rocking the sweets!! Make sure to add this to your list of must do's in Vegas! Enjoy!

text_en: I tried the salty caramel smoothie, and it was delicious! It wasn’t too sweet or too salty.
original: Had the salted Carmel milkshake and it was soo good! Not too sweet and not too salty!

text: No geral: grande variedade, donuts fofinhos, ambiente agradável. Este lugar fica bem próximo à sorveteria onde tomamos café da manhã, então decidimos parar aqui para um lanche depois. Eles têm uma grande variedade de donuts e sabores únicos, como o de creme brûlée. Pedimos o donut de blueberry e limão, e o de creme brûlée. O donut de creme brûlée tinha uma camada de açúcar caramelizado e um recheio de creme de baunilha. Estava delicioso! O donut tinha uma textura perfeita e fofa, e o recheio era muito cremoso, e o açúcar caramelizado tinha uma crocância agradável. O donut de blueberry e limão também estava ótimo. Percebo que, às vezes, os donuts de bolo podem ser densos, mas este foi perfeitamente fofo e tinha a quantidade perfeita de cobertura, então não era excessivamente doce. Para completar, o banheiro deles tem murais adoráveis de Homer Simpson e seu donut com cobertura rosa!
text_en: In general: a wide variety of donuts, soft and delicious, pleasant atmosphere. This place is close to the ice cream shop where we had breakfast, so we decided to stop here for a snack afterwards. They have a great range of donuts and unique flavors, like the cream brûlée version. We ordered the blueberry-lemon donut and the cream brûlée donut. The cream brûlée donut had a layer of caramelized sugar and a vanilla cream filling. It was delicious! The donut had the perfect soft texture, and the filling was very creamy. The caramelized sugar gave a nice crunchy flavor. The blueberry-lemon donut was also excellent. I notice that sometimes cake donuts can be dense, but this one was perfectly soft, with just the right amount of filling—so it wasn’t overly sweet. To finish, their bathroom has adorable murals of Homer Simpson and his donut with pink frosting!
original: Overall: great variety, fluffy donuts, great atmosphere This place is right by the smoothie place we went to for breakfast, so we decided to stop here for a treat after. They have a great variety of donuts and unique flavors like creme brulee. We got the blueberry lemon cake donut and the creme brulee donut. The creme brulee donut had a bruleed sugar top and a vanilla pastry cream filling. It was amazing! The donut was a perfect fluffy texture, and the filing was very creamy, and the bruleed sugar had a nice crunch. The blueberry lemon donut was great as well. I find that sometimes cake donuts can be dense, but this one was perfectly fluffy and had the perfect amount of icing on the top, so it was not overly sweet and sugary. To top it off, their bathroom has the cutest murals of Homer Simpson and his pink sprinkle donut!

text: El postre de "S'mores" con helado de café vietnamita es increíble.
text_en: The “S’mores” dessert with Vietnamese coffee ice cream is incredible.
original: The S'mores sundae with Vietnamese Coffee ice cream is amazing!

text: Este lugar não era ruim. Os cupcakes são um pouco doces, mas são saborosos. Eles tinham uma boa variedade para escolher, e também são um pouco caros. A única coisa que não gostei é o fato de que eles usam produtos químicos para colorir, em vez de ingredientes naturais para obter a cor. A fila de espera se movimentava rapidamente e eu não me importaria de voltar para experimentar outros tipos de cupcakes.
text_en: The place wasn’t bad. The cupcakes are a little sweet, but they taste good. There was a good variety to choose from, and they’re also a bit expensive. The only thing I didn’t like is that they use chemical substances to color them, instead of natural ingredients for getting the color. The waiting line moved quickly, and I wouldn’t mind going back to try other types of cupcakes.
original: This place wasn't bad, the cupcakes are little on the sweet side but were quite tasty. They had a decent selection to choose from, they are a little on the pricey side as well. The only thing I didn't like are how they are using chemicals for coloring instead of using natural foods to derive color from. The long line moved pretty quickly and I wouldn't mind returning trying some other types of cupcakes.

text: ADORO este lugar. Antes de me mudar para Las Vegas, eu costumava vir aqui sempre que visitava a cidade. Adoro o sorvete de leite com cereais. Também experimentei todos os seus biscoitos e adoro presenteá-los. O preço é um pouco alto, mas, afinal, você está em Las Vegas, em um hotel, e isso é esperado. Antes, eles tinham outros sabores, como "red velvet" e sua "torta de biscoito", mas devido à pandemia, eles só estão servindo sorvete de leite com cereais, o que não me incomoda, pois é tudo o que encontro. Subtraí uma estrela devido à inconsistência. Às vezes, os funcionários são simpáticos, e às vezes a pessoa que está trabalhando é rude e não está no clima. A consistência do sorvete também é variável. O sorvete que tirei fotos nesta visita tinha uma consistência derretida, então não estava muito bom. Mas recomendo experimentar, é incrível como o sorvete de leite com cereais pode ser tão gostoso! Adoro a Milk Bar e adoro o Cosmo!
text_en: I love this place. Before I moved to Las Vegas, I used to come here every time I visited the city. I really enjoy the milk ice cream with cereal. I’ve also tried all their cookies, and I love giving them as gifts. The price is a bit high, but after all, you’re in Las Vegas, in a hotel, and that’s expected. Previously, they had other flavors like “red velvet” and their “cookie cake,” but due to the pandemic, they’re only serving milk ice cream with cereal, which doesn’t bother me, because that’s all I can find. I deduct one star due to inconsistency. Sometimes the staff are friendly, and sometimes the person working there is rude and not in the right mood. The consistency of the ice cream also varies. The ice cream I took photos of during my visit had a melted consistency, so it wasn’t very good. But I recommend trying it—it’s amazing how delicious milk ice cream with cereal can be! I love the Milk Bar and I love Cosmo too!
original: LOVE THIS PLACE. Before I moved to Vegas, I would come here EVERY single time I visited Vegas. I love their cereal milk soft serve. I have also tried all their cookies and love gifting them. The price point is a little high, but hey you're in Vegas in a hotel, it's expected. Before they had other flavors like red velvet and their crack pie but because of COVID they are only serving cereal milk which I'm fine with cause that's all I get. I subtracted one star due to inconsistency. Sometimes the employees are nice and sometimes the person who is working is rude and not in the mood. The consistency of the soft serve is also hit or miss. The one I posted pictures of this visit had a melty consistency so it wasn't very good. But I recommend trying it, it's crazy how cereal milk tasting soft serve would be so good! Love love love milk bar and love cosmo!

text: Fui a Sprinkles durante sus primeros meses y estaba emocionado debido a la publicidad, pero cuando recibí mi cupcake, me decepcioné mucho. Era asqueroso. No sé si fue simplemente porque no habían estado abiertos mucho tiempo y aún estaban aprendiendo, pero mi cupcake de chocolate doble estaba extremadamente seco y carecía de todo sabor. El glaseado era mejor que el propio cupcake, y eso es una lástima. Mi cupcake sabía más a pan de maíz que a un cupcake. Absolutamente no vale la pena los $3+. Preferiría ir a Ghirardelli, que está al otro lado, y gastar más, para obtener un postre mejor. Simplemente está demasiado sobrevalorado.
text_en: I went to Sprinkles during its first months, and I was excited due to the advertising. But when I received my cupcake, I was very disappointed. It was disgusting. I don’t know if it was just because they hadn’t been open for long and were still learning, but my double-chocolate cupcake was extremely dry and lacked any flavor. The icing was better than the cupcake itself, and that’s a shame. My cupcake tasted more like cornmeal than a real cupcake. It’s absolutely not worth the $3+. I would rather go to Ghirardelli, which is across the street, and spend more money for a better dessert. It’s just overpriced.
original: I went to Sprinkles during it's first month or so of opening and was excited because of the hype and when I got my cupcake I was so disssappointed. It was disgusting. I don't know if it was just because they hadn't been open for long and were still getting the hang of things, but my double chocolate cupcake was extremely dry and lacking all the flavor. The icing was better than the actual cupcake and that's sad. My cupcake tasted more like cornbread than a cupcake. Totally not worth $3+. I'd rather go to ghiradelli across and spend more, and get better dessert. It's just simply way too overhyped.

text_en: Comfortable seats outside, and the lemon cream dessert is perfect for summer! ($1.97 per individual portion). However, the menu above is overwhelming and looks a bit outdated.

Los sándwiches y las sopas son un poco caros y las porciones son pequeñas, sin embargo, saben de maravilla y valen la pena pedir de vez en cuando. Definitivamente, merece la pena visitarlo si nunca lo has hecho.
text_en: I mean, this is definitely one of my favorite places. The atmosphere and decor are very unique, and that’s why I love it so much. It’s an ideal place for a romantic date or for spending time with friends. I really appreciate that it’s open 24 hours a day. The coffee is excellent, and all the bakery products are of top quality. The sandwiches and soups are a bit expensive, and the portions are small, but they taste fantastic and are worth ordering from time to time. Definitely worth visiting if you’ve never been there.
original: I have to say that this is one of my favorite places to go period. The atmosphere and decor are very unique and that is one of the reasons I love it so much. It is a great place to go for a cute date with your honey and a fun place to hang with your friends. I love that they are open 24/7. The coffee is great and all of the bakery items are top of the line. The sandwiches and soups are a bit pricey and small portioned, however, they taste incredible and are worth getting every so often. Definitely worth checking out if you have never been here.

text: Grande variedade de cupcakes. Eu experimentei os sabores de morango, coco, limão com mirtilo e red velvet.
text_en: A wide variety of cupcakes. I tried the strawberry, coconut, lemon with raspberry, and red velvet flavors.
original: Great variety of cupcakes. I had strawberry, coconut, lemon blueberry, and red velvet.

text: Pedí un halo-halo y estaba delicioso. ¡Definitivamente lo recomiendo, sabía exactamente como en casa! Además, es un negocio filipino y los dueños son muy amables.
text_en: I ordered a halo-halo, and it was delicious. I definitely recommend it—I knew exactly how it tasted like at home! Moreover, it’s a Filipino business, and the owners are very kind.
original: I got halo halo and it was so good! Definitely recommend, tasted exactly like how it does back home. It's also Filipino-owned and the owners are super sweet!

text: I love ice-cream and absolutely love going to an ice-cream parlor to bond with loved ones. I was visiting my mother from California and wanted to treat her to ice-cream, so I yelped and found this place. I got the caramel apple pie float which was good. I tried my mother's cherry cola float and liked hers better. She said she liked mines better so we switched. It was in the later evening and a little chilly, so we both were really happy about the heat lamps outside.
text_en: I love ice-cream and absolutely love going to an ice-cream parlor to bond with loved ones. I was visiting my mother from California and wanted to treat her to ice-cream, so I yelped and found this place. I got the caramel apple pie float which was good. I tried my mother's cherry cola float and liked hers better. She said she liked mines better so we switched. It was in the later evening and a little chilly, so we both were really happy about the heat lamps outside.

text: Este não é um café comum, é uma experiência. Honestamente, desde o momento em que você entra, é um lugar diferente. Eles têm bolos incríveis, mas o croissant de presunto e queijo, que na verdade é mais parecido com uma torta salgada, é simplesmente delicioso. É sempre o meu prato favorito por lá. O limonada de lavanda deles é incrível e refrescante, e a equipe é super simpática. Você pede os bolos primeiro e depois as bebidas. Adorei ver o quão acolhedor este lugar é; me senti bem-vindo desde o momento em que entrei, e mesmo que a equipe estivesse treinando um novo membro, eles foram muito pacientes e atenciosos. Este se tornará um lugar que frequentaremos sempre que visitarmos Charlotte.
text_en: It’s not just a regular coffee shop—it’s an experience. Honestly, from the moment you enter, it feels like a completely different place. They have amazing cakes, but the ham and cheese croissant, which is more like a dry cake, is simply delicious. It’s always my favorite dish there. Their lavender lemonade is incredible and refreshing, and the staff are really friendly. You order the cakes first, and then the drinks. I loved seeing how welcoming this place is; I felt welcome from the moment I entered. Even though the staff were training a new member, they were very patient and attentive. This will become a place we’ll always visit when we go to Charlotte.
original: This is not your regular bakery, this is an experience. Honestly from the moment you walk in is a different world. They have amazing pastries but their ham and cheese croissant which is not really a croissant more like a quiche was mind blowing. Is always my favorite thing to eat there. Their lavender lemonade is amazing and fresh and the staff is super friendly. You order first your pastries and then your drinks. I loved to see how inclusive this place is, I felt welcomed from the moment I walked in and their staff even though they were training a new member, were really patient and nice. This will be a new go to every time we go to Charlotte.

text: Adoro Milk y todo lo relacionado con Christina Tosi; esta ubicación en el Cosmopolitan es fundamental. El tiempo de espera es muy corto (especialmente en comparación con las ubicaciones en el Village), si solo tuvieran volcanes, ¡sería perfecto! P.D.: sirvan volcanes.
text_en: I love Milk and everything related to Christina Tosi; this location at Cosmopolitan is essential. The waiting time is very short (especially compared to the locations in the Village). If there were volcanoes, it would be perfect! P.S.: Serve volcanoes.
original: I adore Milk and all things Christina Tosi, this location at the Cosmopolitan is crucial, the wait time is super short (especially in contrast to their Village locations), if only they had volcanos, it would be perfect. PS: serve volcanos.

text: Nossa, todos nós fomos atraídos pelos seus deliciosos doces italianos e pela variedade de pães, bolos e sobremesas! Estávamos um pouco cheios depois do almoço, mas sempre há espaço para nós, especialmente para sobremesas irresistíveis. Pedimos o "Ciccio" (bolinho de creme com creme de leite $7,90), o "Baba Al Limoncello" (bolo de esponja embebido em limão, recheado com creme de limão $7,90) e o "Terracotta" (mousse de chocolate ao leite com recheio de caramelo de manteiga $7,90) e um latte (esqueci o preço?). Todos os doces estavam deliciosos (5 estrelas para os doces!). O preço era um pouco elevado, e gastamos cerca de $36 no total, em 3 doces e um latte. No entanto, definitivamente voltaria lá, pois eles oferecem opções de doces de alta qualidade e deliciosas.
text_en: Wow, we were all tempted by their delicious Italian desserts and the variety of breads, cakes, and desserts! We were a little full after lunch, but there’s always room for us, especially for those irresistible desserts. We ordered “Ciccio” (a cream-filled pastry at $7.90), “Baba Al Limoncello” (a lemon-soaked sponge cake filled with lemon cream at $7.90), and “Terracotta” (chocolate mousse with butter caramel filling at $7.90). Also, we got a latte (I forgot the price?). All the desserts were delicious! 5 stars for the desserts! The price was a bit high; we spent about $36 in total, for 3 desserts and a latte. However, I would definitely go back, as they offer high-quality and delicious desserts.
original: wow, we were all attracted by their authentic Italian pastries and their selection of pastries, bread and cakes were amazing! We were kind of full after having lunch but there's always room for us especially for eye-catching desserts. We ordered the Ciccio (cream puff with chan Tully cream $7.90), Baba Al Limoncello (pallini limoncello soaked sponge cake filled with lemon cream $7.90), and Terracotta (milk chocolate mousse filled with butter caramel $7.90) and a latte (forgot how much?). All the desserts tasted heavenly (5 stars to the pastries). The price was pricey and we spent around $36 total on 3 pastries and a cup of latte. However, I would definitely go back there again because they have top notch delicious sweet choices.

text: ¡Delicioso! Mis sabores favoritos aquí son los clásicos, especialmente el de fresa. Nos encanta venir aquí para tomar un postre después de cenar en la zona. ¡Es una delicia! Churn es una pequeña tienda y, sin duda, siempre tendrá una fila de clientes esperando si vas durante el fin de semana. ¡No hay problema! La fila se mueve rápido y la espera vale la pena. Los clásicos helados nunca pasan de moda.
text_en: Delicious! My favorite flavors here are the classic ones, especially the strawberry flavor. We really enjoy coming here to enjoy a dessert after dinner in this area. It’s absolutely wonderful! Churn is a small store, and definitely there will always be a line of customers waiting if you go during the weekend. No problem! The line moves quickly, and the wait is worth it. Classic ice creams never go out of style.
original: Yum! My favorites here have to be the classic flavors, especially strawberry. We love coming here for dessert after grabbing dinner in the area. It's such a treat! Churn is a small little shop and without a doubt will always have a line of customers out front if you're there on a weekend. No worries, though! The line goes by fast and the wait is worth it. Good old classic ice cream cones never get old!

text: Helado excelente, pero con un servicio poco amigable. Tenía un ambiente similar al episodio de la sopa de Seinfeld. Disfruté mucho del helado, pero el servicio fue bastante rígido. Por favor, sean más amables. El helado debe ser divertido.
text_en: Excellent ice cream, but the service is not very friendly. The atmosphere was similar to an episode of Seinfeld. I really enjoyed the ice cream, but the service was quite rigid. Please be more friendly. The ice cream should be fun.
original: Excellent ice cream unfriendly service. It had vibes like the soup episode from Seinfeld. I thoroughly enjoyed the ice cream but the service was quite stiff. Please lighten up. It's ice cream supposed to be fun.

text: Adoro os biscoitos, embora sejam um pouco caros, já que são uma atração turística em Las Vegas. No entanto, eles valem a pena, são deliciosos e combinam muito bem com uma xícara de café.
text_en: I love those cookies, even though they’re a bit expensive, as they’re a tourist attraction in Las Vegas. However, they’re worth it—they’re delicious and go well with a cup of coffee.
original: I love the biscotti it is pricey as this is vegas and tourist attraction. The Biscotti is well worth it though very lovely with a nice cup of coffee.

text: Este es el mejor lugar para postres, café y ¡café! Siempre recomiendo este lugar a todo el mundo.
text_en: This is the best place for desserts, coffee, and more coffee! I always recommend this place to everyone.
original: This is the best place for desserts, coffee, and coffee!!! I constantly recommend this place to everyone.

text: Fui el sábado por la noche. Estaban muy ocupados. Es una tienda pequeña, así que es posible que tengas que esperar afuera si hay una fila dentro. Ahora entiendo por qué hay tanto revuelo, ¡porque este lugar es realmente excelente! Pedí el helado de chocolate y estaba delicioso. Han ganado premios por algunos de sus sabores de helado. Los dos chicos que estaban atendiendo (creo que son los dueños) fueron muy amables y muy atentos.
text_en: I went there on Saturday night. They were very busy. It’s a small store, so you might have to wait outside if there’s a line inside. Now I understand why there’s so much fuss—this place is really excellent! I ordered chocolate ice cream, and it was delicious. They’ve won awards for some of their ice cream flavors. The two guys who were serving customers (I think they’re the owners) were very kind and attentive.
original: Visited on a Saturday night. They were very busy. It's a small shop so you might have to wait outside if there's a line inside. I now know what the hype is all about because damn this place is good! I got the chocolate ice cream and it was so good! They won awards for some of their ice cream flavors. The two guys who were working (I think maybe their do-owners?) were so friendly and very personable.

text: I finally had my first Mitchell's Ice Cream experience. Many of my Cleveland friends have bragged about their ice cream, so I had some high expectations...and they were definitely met! My first time there I ordered the Caramel Sea Salt (caramelized brown sugar and sea salt). It was delicious. The prices are a bit steep for a scoop of ice cream ($3.35) but when you get to the front of the line and see how big the scoop is and how tasty it is, it's not such a bad price after all. My second time there I ordered chocolate peanut butter cup, again a heaping scoopful. The chocolate ice cream itself wasn't anything special from any other high end ice cream, but there were so many big chunks of peanut butter cup, enough for every bite. My boyfriend ordered the chocolate malt ($4.95) both times (btw he tends to consider himself a malt aficionado). The first time they gave him a chocolate shake by mistake. It was good, but it was made with chocolate ice cream (I guess chocolate malts are not made with chocolate ice cream) and wasn't the malt he'd ordered...so he was disappointed. The second time we finally got the malt (this time made with vanilla ice cream and chocolate syrup). He said he liked it, although not the best. To me the malt flavoring wasn't very noticeable and I think Sweet Moses makes better malts. Mitchell's put more malt flavoring in your malts! They use Hartzler's milk, I have never had their milk, but their egg nog is to die for (save that for another review) so I can only assume their milk is something special. Also it seems that most of the premium ice cream shops in Cleveland tend to use their milk. The store and building itself is also pretty impressive. You can go upstairs and view the entire kitchen from above, watching them make ice cream is cool. Also you know there's no funny stuff going on in there if you can see everything. Be warned, the lines can be long and seem impossible to get to the front in any reasonable time, but rest assured, there are a lot of people working the counter and those lines move really fast. Oh and they also let me bring my dog in with me to order my ice cream. I love places that are dog friendly! So many more flavors of ice cream still to try...a few blocks from home...I will be down there a lot this summer. Let's just hope my waistline can take all these visits.

text: Os produtos assados estavam apenas "ok", e o atendimento foi muito ruim. Os clientes não eram atendidos e a equipe estava vagando, fazendo várias tarefas aleatórias e conversando entre si. Uma grande decepção.
text_en: The grilled products were just “okay”, but the service was very poor. Customers weren’t served properly, and the staff was idle, doing various random tasks and talking to each other. A huge disappointment.
original: Baked good just okay and the service was very poor. Customers weren't acknowledged and the staff was wandering around doing various odd jobs and talking and chatting among themselves. BIG disappointment.

text: O sorvete de ube é simplesmente delicioso!!! Adoro a castanha que eles oferecem, mas apenas UMA castanha estava um pouco cara, ha ha! Se eu soubesse, teria pedido mais castanhas. Lugar muito limpo, e com bastante estacionamento. Não há serviço de refeição devido à pandemia, mas há mesas ao ar livre – 4 cadeiras e duas pequenas mesas de café. Um café charmoso, e você pode experimentar o sorvete antes de decidir o que comprar.
text_en: The ube ice cream is simply delicious!!! I love the nuts they offer, but just ONE nut was a bit expensive, haha! If I had known, I would have ordered more nuts. The place is very clean, and there’s plenty of parking. There’s no dining service due to the pandemic, but there are outdoor tables – 4 chairs and two small coffee tables. It’s a charming coffee shop, and you can try out the ice cream before deciding what to buy.
original: The ube ice cream is sooooo good!!! I love the chestnut that they gave, but only ONE chestnut was a little cheap LOL if i knew, I would have added extra chestnuts. Very clean place, and plenty of parking. No dine in due to the pandemic but there outdoor sitting - 4 chairs and two small little coffee table. Cute little cafe, and you can try the ice cream first before deciding what to get.

text: My boyfriend & I actually got lost trying to find this place lol. It was worth it :) Not only are the macarons huge, but they were light & delicious. Unfortunately my raspberry didn't taste light & delicious, but my favorites are pistachio & lemon! If you're ever in the Venetian or if you're a macacron lover, you should stop by here before leaving Vegas!

Unfortunately my raspberry didn't taste light & delicious, but my favorites are pistachio & lemon! If you're ever in the Venetian or if you're a macacron lover, you should stop by here before leaving Vegas!

text: Paramos para tomar un pequeño desayuno. Pedimos sus baguettes, ya que siempre eran buenas. Sin embargo, hubo una pequeña decepción, parece que algo ha cambiado. Ya no tienen la corteza crujiente que solían tener, y están más blandas que las baguettes francesas típicas, sin mantequilla real. Esto no significa que las baguettes sean malas, simplemente no son del estilo francés tradicional. El café estaba bien.
text_en: We stopped to have a quick breakfast. We ordered their baguettes, as they were always good. However, there was a slight disappointment—it seems something has changed. They no longer have that crispy crust they used to have, and they’re softer than typical French baguettes, without real butter. This doesn’t mean the baguettes are bad; it’s just that they aren’t in the traditional French style. The coffee was okay.
original: We Stopped by for a little breakfast. Ordered their Baguettes as they were always good. Bit of a disappointment, something has changed. No longer crunchy crust and more doughy than french baguettes typically are with no real butter. That isn't to say the baguettes are bad just not real french style. Coffee was good.

text: No importa cuántas veces vaya, siempre hay algo nuevo que probar. Los sabores son muy originales (lavanda, rosa, higos, etc.). La única desventaja es que es caro y no hay mucho espacio para sentarse (ni enchufes si se quiere trabajar).
text_en: No matter how many times I go, there’s always something new to try. The flavors are very unique—lavender, rose, dates, etc. The only drawback is that it’s expensive, and there isn’t much space to sit down (no outlets either, if you want to work).
original: No matter how many times I go here there's always something new to try! The flavors are so unique (lavender, rose, figs, etc.). The only downside is it's pricy and there's not a lot of room to sit (nor outlets if you're trying to do work).

text: Very cute little spot just off of Roosevelt. I love the presentation of the ice cream in Chinese take out boxes, complete with fortune cookies. Love the flights, a sampling of five flavors plus fortune cookies presented in a muffin pan ($7.50). Love the dog friendly outdoor seating. And, most importantly, love the ice cream. My favorite ice cream flavor this visit? Peanut butter & jelly. Not the most juvenile flavor we ordered believe it or not. Those were Captain Crunch-berry and Lucky Charm based flavors ordered by the kids. Fear not. There are numerous choices for the adult palate as well.

text: SUPER!!! Já estive aqui 3 vezes e adoro. Não tinha certeza se sorvete e cereal seriam uma combinação boa, mas é excelente! Nunca tive problemas com a equipe ou o atendimento, mesmo quando estão ocupados. Com certeza voltarei :)
text_en: SUPER!!! I’ve been here 3 times already, and I love it. I wasn’t sure if ice cream and cereal would be a good combination, but it’s excellent! I never had any problems with the staff or service, even when they were busy. I will definitely come back :)
original: SO GOOD!!! Been here 3 times already and love it. Wasn't sure if ice cream and cereal would be a great combo but it is excellent! Never had an issue with staff or service even when they are busy. Will definitely be back :)

text: Hoje visitei o Villani pela segunda vez. Planejava comprar um bagel da Poppy's na Teeter, mas depois lembrei que este estava bem perto. Também comprei um bialy pela segunda vez. Desta vez, o "Everything" (com tudo). Na última vez, comprei o "Sea Salt" (com sal marinho). Adoro os dois levemente tostados. As bordas ficam crocantes o suficiente e o centro permanece macio. Acho que é um ótimo bagel, sem buraco, e o tamanho é perfeito. Eles oferecem dezenas de sabores de macarons lindos, que são exibidos em uma vitrine, como joias preciosas! Também têm bolo em fatias, muffins, rolinhos de canela, biscoitos (que não são tão duros como alguns podem ser), scones como um de queijo e maçã, croissants e biscoitos. Tenho certeza de que estou esquecendo algo. Então, o biscoito com gotas de chocolate é especial. É quase como um scone ou biscoito, e digo isso porque ele é bem alto, fofo, mas crocante por fora, e se você o abrir, pode ver um pouco de massa que parece ter aproveitado ao máximo o forno. Verifique as minhas fotos. Só para avisar, há uma pequena mesa do lado de fora para sentar e, acredito, algumas mesas dentro. É um lugar para entrar e sair rapidamente. Isso me agrada. Assim, eles têm mais espaço para assar. Outros usuários do Yelp escreveram que é mais caro do que outras padarias, mas acho que os preços são justos, considerando todo o trabalho envolvido. Se fosse mais barato, eu estaria mais gordo!
text_en: Today, I visited Villani for the second time. I was planning to buy a bagel from Poppy’s at Teeter, but then I remembered that it was right nearby. I also bought a bialy for the second time. This time, I got the “Everything” version—with everything inside. Last time, I chose the “Sea Salt” version—with sea salt. I really like those slightly toasted ones. The edges are crispy enough, while the center remains soft. It’s a great bagel, without any holes, and the size is perfect. They offer dozens of beautiful macarons in various flavors, displayed like precious jewels in a window display! They also have slices of cake, muffins, cinnamon rolls, cookies (not as hard as some might think), scones like cheese and apple scones, croissants, and more. I’m sure I’m missing something. The chocolate-dusted cookie is special. It’s almost like a scone or cookie—it’s tall, fluffy, but crispy on the outside. When you open it, you can see some dough that seems to have been used to its best advantage by the oven. Check out my photos. Just to let you know, there’s a small table outside where you can sit, and I believe there are some tables inside too. It’s a place where you can come in and out quickly. That’s what I like about it. So, they have more space for baking. Other Yelp users said it’s more expensive than other bakeries, but I think the prices are fair considering all the effort involved. If it were cheaper, I would be fatter!
original: Today I visited Villani's for the 2nd time. Was going to get a Poppy's bagel from Teeter but then remembered this was right near by. I got a bialy for the 2nd time too. This time, the Everything. Last time, the Sea Salt. Love them both lightly toasted. The edges get just crisp enough and the middle stays soft. Think a great bagel with no hole and the size is perfect. They offer dozens of flavors of beautiful macarons which are displayed in a case much like precious jewels! They have cake by the slice, muffins, cinnamon rolls, biscotti (which are not as hard as a rock like some can be), scones like a cheddar apple, croissants and cookies. I'm sure I'm missing something. So the chocolate chip cookie is special. It's almost scone or biscuit like and I say that because it's mounded high, is airy but is crunchy on the outside and if cut open you can see a bit of doughiness that seemed to have got the best of the oven. Check my pics. Just a heads up that there is one outside bench for seating and I think a table or two inside. It's a pop in and go back home kinda place. Fine with me. Leaves them with more room to bake. Other Yelpers have written that it is pricier than other bakeries but I think the prices are on point considering all the hard work. If it was cheaper, I'd be fatter!

text: You need to try either the chocolate crescent or the traditional crescent. It's AMAZINGLY hot and flaky. We have only been for breakfast/bunch and are always happy with our meals
