text: Como sempre, está ótimo. Seria interessante ter mais funcionários e uma fila exclusiva para bebidas, para agilizar o atendimento.
text_en: As always, it’s great. It would be interesting to have more staff and a dedicated queue for drinks, so that service can be handled more efficiently.
original: Good as always. They could use more cashiers and a drinks only line to expedite the process

text: Tive muita sorte e cheguei em um dia em que só havia 2 pessoas à minha frente na fila! De qualquer forma, a padaria é encantadora! Localizada no bairro de Veneza, demorou um pouco para encontrá-la (paramos em um estacionamento e caminhamos pelas lojas à beira do canal). Mas a caminhada para encontrá-la nos levou por áreas que nunca teríamos visto de outra forma! Mas era muito charmosa! Há grandes janelas para observar os bolos sendo decorados (mas não havia ninguém lá quando fomos)... É fácil entender por que as pessoas ficam frustradas com a espera – é um lugar pequeno e as pessoas tendem a ser indecisas e fazer muitas perguntas... Quando finalmente chegou nossa vez no caixa, pedimos 2 cannolis cobertos de chocolate, 4 biscoitos "Rainbow/Venetian/7 camadas" e um "lobster tail" (rabo de lagosta) original. O valor total ficou em pouco menos de $35!!! Não costumo ir a padarias, mas nunca gastei tanto em 5 bolos e 4 biscoitos! Mas vou dizer o seguinte – estavam realmente, realmente deliciosos!!! Os cannolis aqui são enormes e bem recheados. As cascas eram mais grossas do que o habitual, mas aguentaram muito bem durante a viagem de volta para casa! Os biscoitos eram exatamente como eu me lembrava... Costumava comprar esses em uma pequena padaria italiana no meu bairro quando era criança e raramente os encontro mais – esses estavam deliciosos! Mas o "lobster tail" – foi incrível e valeu cada centavo ($5,50!!!)!!! Fui informada de que o creme continha bourbon, mas não pensei que o saberia, mas definitivamente estava presente! Secretamente, fez meu marido e eu ficarem felizes por não termos que compartilhá-lo com as crianças (LOL)!!! Definitivamente vale a pena visitar uma vez, se você for fã da série ou estiver procurando por doces italianos. Provavelmente não voltarei, mas fico feliz por ter experimentado!
text_en: I was very lucky and ended up in a day when there were only 2 people in line behind me! Anyway, the bakery is absolutely charming! Located in the Venice neighborhood, it took some time to find it—we stopped at a parking lot and walked through the shops along the canal. But the walk to get there took us to places we would never have seen otherwise! It was really lovely. There are big windows where you can watch the cakes being decorated (but no one was there when we went…). It’s easy to understand why people get frustrated waiting—it’s a small place, and people tend to be hesitant and ask too many questions… When finally it was our turn at the counter, we ordered 2 cannoli covered in chocolate, 4 “Rainbow/Venetian/7-layered” cookies, and an original “lobster tail”. The total cost was just under $35!!! I don’t usually go to bakeries, but I’ve never spent so much on just 5 cakes and 4 cookies! But let me say this—they were really, really delicious!!! The cannoli here are huge and well-filled. The shells were thicker than usual, but they survived the trip back home! The cookies were exactly as I remembered them… I used to buy them from a small Italian bakery in my neighborhood when I was a child, and I rarely see them anymore—these were amazing! But the “lobster tail”—it was incredible and worth every penny ($5.50!!!). I was told that the cream contained bourbon, but I didn’t think I would recognize it, but it definitely was there! Secretly, it made my husband and me happy that we didn’t have to share it with the kids (LOL)!!! Definitely worth visiting once, if you’re a fan of the series or looking for Italian desserts. Probably I won’t go back, but I’m glad I tried it!
original: Got SUPER lucky & came on a day where there were only 2 people ahead of me in line! Anywho, the bakery is adorable! Located in the Venetian, it took forever to find (we parked @ self- park & walked through the shops by the Canal). But the trek to find it took us through areas we would have never seen otherwise! But it was so cute! There's big windows to watch cakes being decorated (but no one was in there while we were there)... Can definitely understand why people get aggro over the wait- it's pretty small & people tend to be indecisive and ask TONS of questions... When it was finally our turn at the cashier we ordered 2 chocolate covered cannolis, 4 Rainbow/Venetian/7 Layer Cookies, & an original Lobster Tail. The grand total camr out to just under $35??!!! I don't go to bakeries often, but I've never spent that much on 5 single baked goods & 4 Cookies?! But I will say this- they were REALLY, really good!!! The Cannolis here HUGE & generously filled. The shells were thicker than I'm used to, but they held up very well on our car ride home! The cookies were just like I remembered them... I used to get them from a little Italian bakery in my neighborhood growing up & rarely find them anymore- these were delicious! But the Lobster Tail- that was AMAZING & worth the $5.50!!! I was told the cream has bourbon in it but didn't think I would taste it, but it was definitely in there! It secretly made my husband and I happy that we didn't have to share it with the kiddos (LOL)!!! Definitely worth stopping by once if you're a fan of the show or looking for some Italian baked treats. I probably won't ever come back again but I'm glad I tried it once!

text: No soy un gran fan de los donuts, pero ¡wow, me impresionó! Para una tienda tan pequeña, tienen una gran variedad de sabores y toppings. Los empleados fueron muy amables e incluso nos regalaron un cupcake para el cumpleaños de mi hermano. Si vuelvo a estar en la ciudad, definitivamente volveré a visitar este lugar.
text_en: I’m not a big fan of donuts, but wow, I was impressed! For such a small store, they have a wide variety of flavors and toppings. The staff were very friendly and even gave us a cupcake for my brother’s birthday. If I’m in the city again, I’ll definitely visit this place again.
original: Not a big donut fan but wow I was impressed! For a small little shop they have such a wide variety of flavors and toppings! The workers were very friendly and even gave us a free cupcake for my bro's bday. If I'm ever in town again I will definitely visit here again!!!

text: Muito popular e sempre cheio. Fui à unidade em Dillworth. Tive que esperar um pouco. Mas valeu a pena. O sanduíche de croquet com Monsieur foi um sanduíche de presunto e queijo excelente. Os macarons tinham um sabor e textura perfeitos.
text_en: Very popular and always full. I went to the restaurant in Dillworth. I had to wait a little, but it was worth it. The croquette sandwich with Monsieur was an excellent sandwich made of ham and cheese. The macarons had the perfect taste and texture.
original: Very popular and very busy went to the one in Dillworth. Had quite a wait. But worth it. The Monsieur croquet sandwich was a master ham and cheese sandwich. The macaroons were perfect taste and texture.

text: O sorvete mais delicioso da região! Adoro o sabor especial da semana deles! A equipe é sempre muito simpática e o atendimento costuma ser bastante rápido!
text_en: The most delicious ice cream in the region! I love the special flavor of their product this week! The staff is always very friendly, and service is usually quite fast!
original: Best ice cream in the area! I love their featured flavor of the week! The staff is always very friendly and the service is generally pretty fast!

text: Após assistir ao episódio de Christina Tosi em "Chef's Table" e experimentar o leite de cereal em Nova York, eu queria experimentar a torta de "crack" ou o biscoito "compost". O biscoito "compost" conquistou meu coração. Localização: dentro do hotel Cosmopolitan, ao lado do Momofuku, experimentei: - Sorvete com sabores de leite e "crack". Eles nos ofereceram amostras para que pudéssemos escolher entre os dois. O sorvete com sabor de leite foi melhor que o "crack". - Biscoito "compost": um biscoito embalado por $4. No geral, o sorvete (6 dólares) com flocos de milho foi apenas razoável. Nada de excepcional. No entanto, o biscoito "compost" é provavelmente o melhor (e o mais caro) que já experimentei. Acabei de comer todo o biscoito de 80g e 340 calorias. Lamento não ter comprado mais. O recheio contém: café, manteiga de caramelo e pedaços de chocolate, pretzels e batatas fritas. Que combinação salgada e doce! Vou ter certeza de experimentar mais biscoitos na próxima vez.
text_en: After watching the episode of Christina Tosi on “Chef’s Table” and trying the cereal milk in New York, I wanted to try the “crack” cake or the “compost” biscuit. The “compost” biscuit won my heart. Located inside the Cosmopolitan Hotel, next to Momofuku, I tried: – Ice cream with milk and “crack” flavors. They offered samples so we could choose between the two. The milk ice cream was better than the “crack” flavor. – “Compost” biscuit: a biscuit wrapped for $4. Overall, the ice cream (6 dollars) with corn flakes was just okay. Nothing special. However, the “compost” biscuit is probably the best (and most expensive) one I’ve ever tried. I ended up eating all 80g of the 340-calorie biscuit. I regret not buying more. The filling contains: coffee, caramel butter, chunks of chocolate, pretzels, and fried potatoes. What a salty-sweet combination! I’m sure I’ll try more biscuits next time.
original: After watching Christina Tosi's episode on Chef's Table and trying the cereal milk in New York, I wanted to get my hands on some crack pie or the compost cookie. The compost cookie stole my heart. Location: inside the Cosmopolitan hotel, next to Momofuku I tried: -Soft serve in milk and crack pie flavors. They were nice to offer us samples so we could decide between the two. Milk tasted better than crack pie. -Compost cookie: a packaged cookie for $4 Overall, the soft serve ($6) topped with corn flakes was just okay. Nothing mind blowing. The compost cookie however is probably the best (and most expensive) cookie I've ever tasted. I just finished the whole 80g, 340 calorie cookie. I regret not buying more. Inside of it is: coffee, butterscotch and chocolate chips, pretzels and potato chips. What a salty sweet combo! I'll make sure to try more cookies next time.

text: Actualización: Para comprender mejor por qué los productos horneados que compré en Carlo's Bake Shop estaban rancias y secos, volví a esta tienda, apenas unos minutos antes de que cerraran para la noche, para confirmar mi comprensión de sus prácticas comerciales. Resulta que, al cierre, las estanterías de Carlo's Bake Shop estaban casi llenas de productos horneados que no se habían vendido ese día, y no había ningún descuento por "cierre", como es común en otras panaderías de alta calidad y recién hechas. Cuando la tienda cerraba, los productos seguían vendiéndose al precio original, y cuando cerraban las puertas para la noche, las estanterías permanecían llenas de productos para que se sequen durante la noche y pierdan su sabor y textura frescos. ¡Es una vergüenza para los propietarios de este establecimiento permitir la venta de productos del día anterior a los clientes desprevenidos! Dada la exorbitante cantidad de precios que se cobran en este establecimiento, ¿no es razonable suponer que se están comprando productos que fueron horneados ese mismo día? Las panaderías de alta calidad tratan los productos que se dejan durante la noche como "productos del día anterior". Si estos productos no se venden con descuento antes del cierre, o simplemente se desechan, se retiran de las estanterías principales para venderlos en estanterías especiales con descuento en otras zonas de la tienda. No se aplica esta práctica en Carlo's Bake Shop, donde se ofrece una selección de productos antiguos mezclados con productos nuevos, y depende de la suerte si se obtiene un producto fresco al comprar aquí. En cuanto a las numerosas reseñas de cinco estrellas que se enumeran aquí, una explicación benigna sería que se trata de clientes que no saben mejor. Sin embargo, me cuesta creer que tantos de estos reseñadores nunca hayan estado en una panadería francesa de alta calidad que solo vende productos recién horneados. No es como si no hubiera muchas panaderías frescas en el área de Las Vegas (y en muchas otras ciudades), así que me desconcierta la gran cantidad de reseñas positivas para esta tienda. Aún no se recomienda.
text_en: Update: To better understand why the baked goods I bought from Carlo’s Bake Shop were stale and dry, I returned to this store just a few minutes before it closed for the night, in order to confirm my understanding of their business practices. It turns out that, at the time of closing, the shelves at Carlo’s Bake Shop were almost full of baked goods that hadn’t been sold that day. There was no “close sale” discount, as is common in other high-quality, freshly baked bakeries. When the store closed, the products continued to be sold at their original price. And when the doors closed for the night, the shelves remained filled with products that had to dry out overnight, losing their fresh taste and texture. It’s shameful for the owners of this store to allow customers to buy products from the previous day! Given the exorbitant prices charged here, isn’t it reasonable to assume that the products are actually baked on the same day? High-quality bakeries treat products left over overnight as “products from the previous day”. If these products aren’t sold at a discount before closing, or are simply thrown away, they’re removed from the main shelves and sold at discounted prices in other areas of the store. This practice isn’t applied at Carlo’s Bake Shop, where a selection of old products is combined with new ones. It depends on luck whether you get a fresh product when buying here. As for the numerous five-star reviews listed here, a reasonable explanation would be that they’re customers who don’t know better. However, it’s hard to believe that so many reviewers have never been to a high-quality French bakery that only sells freshly baked products. It’s not like there aren’t many fresh bakeries in the Las Vegas area (and many other cities), so I’m surprised by the large number of positive reviews for this store. It’s not yet recommended.
original: Update: To gain a better understanding of why the baked goods we purchased at Carlo's Bake Shop were stale and dried out, I visited this shop again, just a few minutes before they closed for the evening, to confirm my understanding of their business practices. Lo and behold, at closing time, the shelves in Carlo's Bake Shop were nearly full of baked goods that had not been sold off that day, and there was no "closing time" discount as is the practice at other fine, fresh bakeries. As the shop closed, items were still being sold at full price - and as they closed the doors for the evening, the shelves were left full of items to dry out over night and lose their fresh taste and texture! Shame on the owners of this establishment for permitting day-old items to be sold the next day to unsuspecting customers! Given the exorbitant prices charged at this property, isn't it reasonable to assume that one is buying goods that were baked fresh the same day? Fine bakeries treat goods left overnight as "day old" - if these items are not sold off at a discount before closing, or simply discarded, they remove those goods from their main shelves to be sold on special discount shelves elsewhere in the shop. No such practice is used at Carlo's Bake Shop, where you are provided a selection of old items mixed in with new, and it's the luck-of-the-draw whether you are getting a fresh item when you shop here. As for the many five-star reviews listed here, a charitable explanation would be that these are customers who don't know any better. But I find it hard to believe so many of these reviewers have never been in a fine French bakery that only sells fresh-baked goods. It's not as if there aren't a number of fresh bakeries in the Las Vegas area (and in many other cities), so I'm baffled by the large number of positive reviews for this shop. Still not recommended.

text: Me gustaría que ofrecieran una opción de cupcake sin gluten para que pudiera probarla, pero sí disfruté mucho de mi batido. Y el grupo con el que estaba se encantó con sus helados con chispas!
text_en: I would like to have a gluten-free cupcake option so I can try it, but I really enjoyed my smoothie. And the group I was with loved their sparkle ice cream!
original: I wish they had a gluten free cupcake option so I could of tried one but I did really enjoy my shake! And the group I was with were in love with their sprinkle sundaes!!

text: Esta es una de las pocas ocasiones en que la frase "los snozzberries saben a snozzberries" se aplica, aunque quizás no tuvieran snozzberries, yo sí probé el helado de palomitas de maíz, y sabía exactamente a algo maravilloso: untuoso, salado y perfecto en todos los sentidos.
text_en: This is one of the few times when the phrase “Snozzberries taste like Snozzberries” applies—even though they might not have had any Snozzberries. I did try the popcorn ice cream, and it tasted exactly like something wonderful: creamy, salty, and perfect in every way.
original: This is one of the few time where the qoute "the snozzberries taste like snozzberries" were they may not have had snozzberries but I did try the popcorn ice-cream and that is exactly what it tastes like a wonderful buttery, salty, and complete perfection.

text: Nós chegamos também ao meio-dia, e também notamos que não havia fila. Estávamos ansiosos para experimentar, e ficamos agradavelmente surpresos ao ver que tinham várias opções de donuts veganos. E havia a promoção de "compre um, leve outro de graça", então gastamos menos de $4. Os donuts eram muito, muito doces. Sei que os donuts devem ser doces, mas este elevou a experiência a outro nível. Meus dentes ficaram um pouco sensíveis, então retirei a parte de cima e joguei o restante fora. Meu marido disse que também teve que fazer o mesmo. Dito isto, chegamos um pouco tarde, então tínhamos poucas opções. Talvez, se tivéssemos chegado mais cedo, tivéssemos mais escolhas?
text_en: We also arrived at noon, and noticed that there was no queue. We were eager to try them out, and were pleasantly surprised to see that they had several vegan donut options. There was also a promotion: “Buy one, get another free,” so we spent less than $4. The donuts were very, very sweet. I know donuts should be sweet, but this elevated the experience to another level. My teeth became a little sensitive, so I removed the top part and threw the rest away. My husband said he had to do the same. Anyway, we arrived a bit late, so we had few choices. Maybe if we had arrived earlier, we would have more options?
original: We got here at noon also, and also found there to be no line. We were excited to try it, and pleasantly surprised that they had several vegan donut choices. And it was buy one get one free, so we were out of there for under $4. The donuts were very very sweet. I know donuts are supposed to be sugary but this took it to a new level. My teeth hurt a little, so I picked the fruit off of the top and threw the rest away. My husband said that he had to do the same with his. That said, we did arrive late so we had slim pickings. Perhaps if we got there earlier, we would have had more choices?

text: Como muitos clientes relataram: Cupcakes secos e com sabor básico. Sou um grande fã do "Cake Boss", então fiquei um pouco decepcionado depois de ter esperado tanto tempo para conseguir um. O atendimento não é dos melhores: inicialmente, eu e meu noivo fomos tratados de forma rude pela funcionária da fila (ela parecia mais preocupada em acabar com o expediente do que em ser útil e fazer seu trabalho). Além disso, quando solicitei um cannoli (eu nunca tinha provado antes), perguntei se tinha chocolate, pois meu noivo tem alergia, e ela disse que não. Estávamos prestes a comer quando a funcionária nos informou que havia chocolate. Resumindo, vou continuar indo às padarias da minha cidade. É preciso dizer que alguns biscoitos estavam bons, mas, novamente, como é possível errar um biscoito?
text_en: As many customers have reported, the cupcakes are dry and have a basic flavor. I’m a big fan of “Cake Boss,” so I was a little disappointed after waiting so long to get one. The service isn’t very good either: initially, me and my fiancé were treated rudely by the queue attendant (she seemed more focused on finishing her shift than on being helpful and doing her job properly). Additionally, when I asked for cannoli (I had never tried them before), I asked if there was chocolate, since my fiancé has an allergy, and she said no. Just as we were about to eat, the attendant told us that there was chocolate. In short, I’ll continue going to bakeries in my city. It must be said that some cookies were good, but again, how can you possibly make a mistake with a cookie?
original: As many people have reported: Dry, basic tasting cupcakes. I am a huge fan of Cake Boss so this was a bit distressing after having waited in a line for so long to get it. The staff is not the best: First me and my fiance were treated rudely by the lady working the line( she clearly was more concerned about getting off work than being helpful and doing her job. Then when ordering (I've never had a cannoli) I asked if the connoli had chocolate because my fiance is allergic and he said no. We were nearly about to chow down when the worker advised us that there was chocolate. Long story short I will stick with the bakeries out in my city. I do have to say some of the cookies were nice but then again how do you mess up a cookie.

text: Soy estudiante de Artes de la Repostería, así que quizás sea más exigente que un cliente promedio. Cuando llegué por primera vez a Charlotte, me encantó, pero con el tiempo he notado que la calidad de los productos ha disminuido un poco. Sin duda, el brownie de caramelo salado es increíble y siempre es mi postre favorito. Nunca es malo, nunca decepciona, y siempre es satisfactorio. Recientemente he estado probando otros postres que se ofrecen, y estoy un poco decepcionado. A mis amigos que no son chefs les encanta, pero puedo ver que algunos de los productos podrían ser realmente espectaculares. Por ejemplo, los croissants no cumplen con mis expectativas. El personal es excelente, la ubicación es fantástica, y la cantidad de asientos es maravillosa. Incluso si no encuentras un lugar en el edificio principal, también hay asientos adicionales fuera, así como en el atrio en la parte trasera. He ido en diferentes momentos del día y siempre encuentro un lugar. Le doy 3 estrellas porque no puedo superar la calidad de los postres. Sin embargo, la comida podría ser la parte más infravalorada del restaurante. La sopa es deliciosa, especialmente la de zanahoria y jengibre, y las cremas de queso son increíbles. Para terminar, no puedo olvidarme de mencionar que está abierto las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana. Es un lugar increíble para visitar en grupo o solo. Es importante observar a la gente en diferentes momentos del día, ya que la cantidad de gente varía según la hora.
text_en: I’m a student in baking arts, so maybe I’m more demanding than an average customer. When I first came to Charlotte, I really loved it, but over time I’ve noticed that the quality of the products has somewhat declined. undoubtedly, the salty caramel brownies are incredible—they’re always my favorite dessert. They’re never bad, never disappointing, and always satisfying. Recently, I’ve been trying other desserts that are offered, and I’m a little disappointed. My friends who aren’t chefs love them, but I can see that some of the products could be really great. For example, the croissants don’t meet my expectations. The staff is excellent, the location is fantastic, and the number of seats is wonderful. Even if you can’t find a seat in the main building, there are extra seats outside, as well as in the courtyard at the back. I’ve gone at different times of day, and I always find a seat. I give it 3 stars because I can’t surpass the quality of the desserts. However, the food might be the most underrated part of the restaurant. The soup is delicious, especially the one with carrots and ginger, and the cheese creams are amazing. Finally, I can’t forget to mention that it’s open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. It’s an incredible place to visit in groups or alone. It’s important to observe people at different times of day, as the number of people varies depending on the hour.
original: I am a Pastry Arts Major, so I might be more critical than an average customer. I was overwhelmed when I first arrived to Charlotte and I loved it, but over the years I have realized the quality of the goods are bit slacking. By far, the salted caramel brownie is amazing and is always my go to dessert. It is never bad, never slacking, and always satisfying. Recently I have been exploring some other treats in the display cabinet and I am a bit disappointed. All my non-culinary friends love it, but I can see that some of the products could be amazing. For example the croissants are just not reaching the standard for my liking. The employees are amazing, the location is amazing, and the amount of seating is wonderful. Even if you can't find seating in the main building, there is extra seating outside as well as in the atrium in the back. I have been at many different times of the day and always can find a seat. I give it 3 stars because I can't get past the quality of the desserts .The food, however, may be the most underestimated part of the restaurant. The soup is to die for, especially the carrot ginger, and the cheese spread are amazing. To end I can't forget to mention that it is open 24 hours, 7 days a week. It is an amazing place to visit with a group or by yourself. You must people watch at different parts of the day because the crowd changes depending on what time you are there.

text: ¿Cómo es que no he visitado este lugar antes, considerando que suelo pasar por aquí cuando estoy en la zona de Matthews/Ballentyne? ¡Esta es una experiencia que no te puedes perder si estás en Charlotte! Bueno, este lugar es increíble y definitivamente debes visitarlo para probar su helado de matcha y otras opciones de postre. Es un pequeño café con capacidad limitada debido a la pandemia, pero son muy amables y se esfuerzan al máximo, lo cual aprecio. El helado de matcha es, sin duda, lo que más se debe probar para los visitantes, ya que es cremoso, delicioso y, además, muy fiel a los sabores de matcha que he probado en Japón. El helado de vainilla con matcha es una buena opción si no estás acostumbrado al sabor amargo del matcha, pero esta combinación es excelente en cualquier caso. También probé hojicha (¿té de matcha tostado?), sésamo negro (de temporada) y ube (de temporada), y todos son muy buenos. El hojicha sigue siendo uno de mis favoritos, junto con el helado de matcha. El sésamo negro también es una buena opción si está disponible. El ube es mucho más ligero de lo que esperaba, así que si estás buscando el sabor intenso que se encuentra en los restaurantes filipinos, es posible que debas moderar un poco tus expectativas. Solo he probado el otro helado de matcha con todos los toppings, y también recomiendo probarlo si tienes hambre o quieres compartir. Lo he probado varias veces en Japón, y este lugar cumple con las expectativas para esta opción de postre. El estacionamiento es bastante fácil y hay muchas opciones de comida en la zona. O, si prefieres boba, Kung Fu Tea está a poca distancia, ya que mi madre prefería el boba al helado, así que hay espacio para todos :D Recomiendo que lo visites si estás en la zona sur de Charlotte/Matthews/Ballantyne, pero de verdad, si estás en Charlotte, este es un lugar que debes visitar. Es único y deja una impresión muy positiva.
text_en: Why haven’t I visited this place before, considering that I usually pass by here when I’m in the Matthews/Ballentyne area? It’s an experience you shouldn’t miss if you’re in Charlotte! This place is amazing, and you definitely need to try its matcha ice cream and other desserts. It’s a small café with limited seating due to the pandemic, but the staff are very kind and do their best, which I appreciate. The matcha ice cream is undoubtedly the must-try item for visitors—it’s creamy, delicious, and truly reflects the flavors of matcha I’ve tasted in Japan. Vanilla matcha ice cream is a good option if you’re not used to the bitter taste of matcha, but this combination is excellent anyway. I also tried hojicha (toasted matcha tea?), black sesame (seasonal), and ube (seasonal)—all of them are great. Hojicha remains one of my favorites, along with the matcha ice cream. Black sesame is also a good choice if available. Ube is much lighter than I expected, so if you’re looking for the intense flavor found in Filipino restaurants, you might need to adjust your expectations a bit. I’ve only tried the other matcha ice cream with all the toppings, and I recommend trying it if you’re hungry or want to share. I’ve tried it several times in Japan, and this place meets expectations as a dessert option. Parking is easy, and there are many food options nearby. Or, if you prefer boba, Kung Fu Tea is just a short distance away—my mother preferred boba over ice cream, so there’s plenty for everyone :D I recommend visiting this place if you’re in the southern part of Charlotte/Matthews/Ballantyne, but really, if you’re in Charlotte, it’s a place you should definitely visit. It’s unique and leaves a very positive impression.
original: How have I not already reviewed this place considering how often I try to drop by when I'm in the matthews/ballentyne area! This is a MUST TRY if you're in Charlotte. Okay so this place is amazing and you absolutely need to visit to get your matcha ice cream and other dessert options as well! It's a small cafe with much-limited capacity due to COVID but they're accomodating and doing their best which I appreciate! The ice cream is definitely the must get item for 1st timers since it's creamy and delicious as well as pretty accurate to the matcha flavors I've had in Japan. The vanilla with matcha is a good match if you're not used to the bitter taste of matcha that can be acquired, but that combination is great no matter what! I've also had hojicha (burnt matcha?), black sesame (seasonal), and ube (seasonal) and all those are great as well! Hojicha is still one of my favorites with match ice cream. The black sesame is good as well if it's an option. The ube is a lot lighter than I expected so if you're expecting that rich flavor you've had a Filipino places, you might have to curb your expectations a little bit. I've only had the other matcha ice cream with all the toppings that I forget the name of and I'd also recommend that if you're in a hungry mood or want to share! I've had that several times in Japan and this place is up to par for this dessert option! Parking is pretty easy and there's a lot of food options in the area. Or if you want boba, kung fu tea is also a short walk down because my mom wanted boba more than ice cream so there's room for everyone :D I'd say drop by if you're in the south charlotte/Matthews/Ballantyne area, but really if you're in Charlotte this is a MUST STOP AREA you have to try. It's unique and leaves a lasting great impression.

text: Em todas as vezes que fui a Las Vegas, nunca consegui visitar a Bouchon Bakery quando estava aberta. A placa "fechado" é a pior notícia, especialmente quando tudo o que se deseja é saborear uma delícia comestível, como um macaron. Mas não se preocupem... desta vez, fiz questão de vir para experimentar essa iguaria. O caramelo salgado estava incrivelmente doce e saboroso.
text_en: Every time I went to Las Vegas, I never managed to visit Bouchon Bakery when it was open. The “closed” sign is the worst news, especially when all you want is to taste a delicious edible treat like a macaron. But don’t worry… this time, I made sure to come here to try this delicacy. The salty caramel was incredibly sweet and flavorful.
original: For the many times I've been to Vegas, I never made it to Bouchon Bakery when it was open. The "closed" sign is the worst when all you want to do is sink your mouth into an edible delight that is a macaroon. Fear not...as I made it a point to get here for a tasty treat this time around. The salted caramel was extra caramel-y and sweet but oh-so-delish.

text: Helado fantástico, sabores interesantes – ¡demasiados! Es difícil elegir. Personal extremadamente amable que se tomó su tiempo para atendernos. ¡Ojalá hubiera uno en Dallas!
text_en: Fantastic ice cream, interesting flavors – too many! It’s hard to choose. The staff is extremely friendly and took their time to serve us. I wish there was one in Dallas!
original: Fantastic ice cream, interesting flavors - too many! Hard to choose. Extremely friendly staff who really took time with us. Wish there was one in Dallas!

text: O jovem que estava trabalhando hoje à tarde é muito simpático. E o macaron rosa estava delicioso!
text_en: The young person who was working this afternoon is very friendly. And the pink macarons were delicious!
original: The young guy who was working this afternoon is very nice. & The pink Macaroon was yummy!

text: ¡Valió la pena la espera! He estado deseando probar Batch House desde que abrieron. Fui el día de Halloween y, aunque había una larga cola, lo haría de nuevo sin dudarlo. El latte helado de tres leches era INCREÍBLE (¡solo desearía que vendieran más tamaños para poder tomar aún más!). Compré dos tipos de brownies, una galleta y una tarta de manzana. Todo estaba delicioso y duró muy poco en mi casa. Los empleados fueron amables y muy conscientes de las medidas de seguridad contra el COVID.
text_en: It was worth the wait! I’ve been eager to try Batch House since it opened. I went on Halloween, and although there was a long line, I would go again without hesitation. The three-flavor ice cream latte was amazing (I just wish they had more sizes so I could have even more)! I bought two types of brownies, a cookie, and an apple tart. Everything was delicious, and it didn’t last long in my house. The staff were friendly and very aware of the safety measures against COVID.
original: Worth the wait! I've been dying to try Batch House ever since they opened. Went on Halloween and even though the line was long I would do it all over again. The draft tres leche iced latte was AMAZING (I only wish they'd sold more sizes so I could've gotten even more)! I got 2 types of brownies, a cookie, and an apple pie. Everything was delicious and didn't last long in my home. The employees were friendly and very conscious of COVID safety!

text: O Presti's é incrível! Moro praticamente ao lado e adoro comprar cannolis e café au lait quando quero relaxar e colocar o papo em dia com um amigo. Não tenho a oportunidade de ver muitos amigos, mas quando encontro, sempre vamos para o Presti's. Às vezes, o lugar fica muito cheio, mas nunca perdemos a chance de ver bebês fofos e saborear deliciosos doces! O stromboli também é maravilhoso! A conveniência também é muito apreciada, pois já tivemos uma noite em que todos queríamos biscoitos. Felizmente, além de ser conveniente, também é delicioso!
text_en: Presti’s is amazing! I live right next to it, and I love buying cannoli and coffee au lait when I want to relax and catch up with a friend. I don’t get to see many friends often, but whenever we do meet, we always go to Presti’s. Sometimes the place gets very crowded, but we never miss the chance to see cute babies and taste delicious desserts! The stromboli is also fantastic! The convenience is also highly appreciated, as we once had a night where everyone wanted cookies. Fortunately, besides being convenient, it’s also delicious!
original: Presti's is awesome! I live essentially right next door to the place and love to get cannolis and cafe au laits when I just want to relax and catch up with a friend. I don't get to see one of my friends much, but when I do, we ALWAYS go to Presti's. At times, we get overwhelmed with the crowd there, but we never fail to see cute babies and indulge in some fantastic desserts! The stromboli is amazing as well! The convenience is also incredibly appreciated, as there was once a wine filled evening when we all wanted some cookies. Luckily, they're not only convenient, but delicious too!

text: El lugar era muy encantador por dentro, con muchos objetos decorativos para ver. El menú era bastante amplio, aunque como vegetariano, terminé pidiendo un sándwich de ensalada de huevo. No había nada particularmente destacable, ya que era una comida bastante básica. Los sabores del helado no eran muy emocionantes y solo tenían algunos. La carta de bebidas con helado era extensa. Pedimos una y estaba bastante buena. Recomendaría este lugar solo por el helado, probablemente no por la comida, a menos que busques comida típica de un restaurante sencillo.
text_en: The interior of the place was very charming, with many decorative items to see. The menu was quite extensive, but as a vegetarian, I ended up ordering an egg salad sandwich. There wasn’t anything particularly standout, as it was a rather basic meal. The flavors of the ice cream weren’t very appealing, and there were only a few options. The drink menu with ice cream was quite long. We ordered one, and it was pretty good. I would recommend this place just for the ice cream—probably not for the food, unless you’re looking for traditional dishes from a simple restaurant.
original: This place was very cute inside, lots of tchotchkes to look at. The menu was actually pretty large, though as a vegetarian I ended up getting an egg salad sandwich. Nothing notable about it, as it is a pretty basic meal. The ice cream flavors were not exciting and they only had a few. The ice cream soda drink list itself was extensive. We ordered one of them and it was pretty good! I'd recommend this place for the ice cream soda alone, probably not the food unless you're looking for basic diner food.

text: I love the cake boss show and all of their spin off Shows as well. It's been a long time that I've been waiting to try Buddie's bakery goods, specially their red velvet cupcake as Carlos so many times teaches other bakers how to master it and it's staple cream cheese frosting. So, after 20 minutes in line my husband and I finally got to the ordering panel. By the time we got there, there was no tiramisu. So my husband ordered a strawberry short cake. I ordered the oh so famous red velvet cupcake. After another 15 minutes waiting for our order, we finally got our goods. Everything was just ok. I was NOT expecting just ok! The red velvet cupcake looked like a cupcake I can get at traders joe's. Tasted ok, nothing woow! My husbands strawberry short cake was tasty, but not tasty enough for that price. Even an amazing dessert at a fancy place is slightly cheaper!!!! I wanted to love this place! But, not impressed at all!

text: Este é um novo lugar escondido que você vai adorar. Certifique-se de pedir o copo com biscoito, você não vai se arrepender! Os preços são mais do que justos e você vai adorar a arte.
text_en: This is a new, hidden place you’ll love. Be sure to order the cup with cookies – you won’t regret it! The prices are more than fair, and you’ll enjoy the art very much.
original: This is a hidden new spot that you'll love. Make sure to get the cookie cup, you won't regret it! Prices are more than reasonable and you'll love the artwork

text: Excelente atendimento, muito rápido e eficiente. O cardápio é o melhor e o atendente é muito prestativo, especialmente quando você está indeciso! Recomendo sem hesitar.
text_en: Excellent service, very fast and efficient. The menu is the best, and the staff is very helpful, especially when you’re unsure about your choices! I highly recommend it without hesitation.
original: Great service, very fast and efficient. Their menu is the best and the cashier is super helpful when you're trying to decide! Definitely recommend

text: Antes de comenzar esta reseña, quiero decir que Donut Bar afirma tener las mejores donas de cualquier lugar. Yo puedo confirmar que tienen razón, después de visitarlos por primera vez, probar sus donas (de diferentes tipos) y tomar un espresso. ¡Son mejores que Voodoo Donuts! ¿Por qué digo eso? 1. Las recetas son frescas y caseras. Puedo notar la diferencia. No utilizan masa prefabricada, ni ningún tipo de condicionador para la masa. Simplemente, donas puras y deliciosas. ¡Delicioso! 2. Excelente servicio al cliente. No recuerdo el nombre de la persona que me atendió, que preparó mis donas y me sirvió el espresso, pero fue muy amable, alegre y servicial, y ese espresso fue realmente bueno. 3. Ese espresso fue realmente excelente. Volveré. Cinco estrellas.
text_en: Before starting this review, I would like to say that Donut Bar claims to have the best donuts anywhere. I can confirm that they’re right—after visiting them for the first time, trying their various types of donuts, and enjoying an espresso. They are better than Voodoo Donuts! Why do I say that? 1. The recipes are fresh and homemade. I can tell the difference. They don’t use pre-made dough or any kind of dough conditioner. Just pure, delicious donuts. Delicious! 2. Excellent customer service. I don’t remember the name of the person who prepared my donuts and served me the espresso, but they were very friendly, cheerful, and helpful. And the espresso was really good. 3. That espresso was truly excellent. I will return. Five stars.
original: Let's preface this review to say that Donut Bar claims to have the best donuts anywhere. I'll say that they're right, after visiting them for the first time, trying their donuts (multiple kinds) and a shot of their Espresso. Better than Voodoo Donuts! Why do I say that? 1. The recipes are fresh and homemade. I can taste it. No pre-made dough, no dough conditioners. Just pure, tasty donuts. Yum. 2. Great customer service. I didn't catch the name of the person who assisted me, served my donuts and pulled my espresso shot, but she was so friendly and peppy and happy and that was such a good espresso shot. 3. That was a really good espresso shot. I'll be back. Five Stars.

text: It was ok. I was disappointed that they only had two non dairy options that were both sorbet. Other places also have a dairy free frozen yogurt or a tart. The prices are much higher than I would expect, parking was tough. They did have a bunch of cool candy treats which was cool. It wasn't bad. It I likely won't go back.
text_en: It was ok. I was disappointed that they only had two non dairy options that were both sorbet. Other places also have a dairy free frozen yogurt or a tart. The prices are much higher than I would expect, parking was tough. They did have a bunch of cool candy treats which was cool. It wasn't bad. It I likely won't go back.

text: My boyfriend took me there as a late night date and it was one of the best ice creams I've had !! You can't Go wrong with this !! I recommend trying
text_en: My boyfriend took me there as a late night date and it was one of the best ice creams I've had !! You can't Go wrong with this !! I recommend trying

text: Já visitei este local várias vezes durante minhas visitas a Las Vegas. Os cupcakes e o sorvete são sempre deliciosos. Normalmente, peço sorvete de "red velvet" em um cone de "red velvet". O atendimento é excelente. Gostaria de agradecer especialmente à Karina, que trabalha na área de sorvete. Sou membro do programa "Sprinkles Perks" e ganhei um benefício gratuito, que foi a escolha de um menu à minha disposição. A Karina foi muito paciente comigo enquanto eu decidia o que queria. Decidi pedir um "Sprinkles Sundae", que consiste em uma bola de sorvete e um cupcake. A Karina me permitiu personalizar meu pedido, adicionando mais bolas e coberturas. Como meu pedido era para levar, ela cuidou de colocar as coberturas de lado, para que não se derretissem durante o caminho de volta para o hotel. Ela foi muito prestativa e agradeço a atenção que teve com meu pedido.
text_en: I have visited this place several times during my visits to Las Vegas. The cupcakes and ice cream are always delicious. Usually, I order “red velvet” ice cream in a “red velvet” cone. The service is excellent. I would like to especially thank Karina, who works in the ice cream department. I’m a member of the “Sprinkles Perks” program, and I received a free benefit—the ability to choose from a menu at my disposal. Karina was very patient with me as I decided what I wanted. I chose a “Sprinkles Sundae,” which consists of a ball of ice cream and a cupcake. Karina allowed me to customize my order by adding more ice cream balls and toppings. Since my order needed to be taken away, she made sure the toppings were placed aside so they wouldn’t melt on the way back to the hotel. She was very helpful, and I appreciate the attention she paid to my order.
original: I've been to this location many times while visiting Vegas. The cupcakes and ice cream are always good. I usually get red velvet ice cream in a red velvet cone. The service is great. I want to give a special shout out to Karina who works on the ice cream side. I'm a Sprinkles Perks member and I earned a free perk which was a free menu of my choice. Karina was very patient with me as I decided on what I wanted. I decided to get a Sprinkles Sundae which is one scoop of ice cream plus one cupcake. Karina allowed me to customize my order by letting me add more scoops and toppings. Since my order was to-go she took care of putting the toppings on the side so it could survive my walk back to the hotel. She was so helpful and I appreciated her thoughtfulness with my order.

text: Estava muito decepcionado com o sabor dos doces, que custavam US$ 59. As medidas de segurança contra a COVID eram praticamente inexistentes, além do uso de máscaras. A atmosfera estava muito agitada e superlotada, o que tornou a experiência muito frustrante.
text_en: I was very disappointed with the taste of the desserts, which cost $59 each. The safety measures against COVID were virtually non-existent, aside from wearing masks. The atmosphere was very chaotic and overcrowded, making the experience very frustrating.
original: Heart broken at the taste of the pastries for $59 dollars. The covid precautions were non existent besides wearing masks, everyone was one on top of another, so disappointing.

text: Os melhores cupcakes da região. Se você for, peça por Bridget. ELA É A MELHOR! Meus sabores favoritos são red velvet, snicker doodle e chocolate. O bolo é muito úmido (eu realmente detesto cupcakes secos) e não é excessivamente doce.
text_en: The best cupcakes in the area. If you go, ask for Bridget. SHE IS THE BEST! My favorite flavors are red velvet, snickerdoodle, and chocolate. The cake is very moist (I really hate dry cupcakes), and it’s not overly sweet.
original: Best cupcakes on the strip. If you ever go, ask for Bridget. SHE IS THE BEST! My favorite flavors were red velvet, snicker doodle, and chocolate. The cake is so moist (I absolutely hate dry cupcakes) and not too sweet.

text: Um bom lugar para comer sorvete em um dia agradável. A fila pode ficar bem longa, mas geralmente o atendimento é rápido.
text_en: A great place to eat ice cream on a pleasant day. The line can be quite long, but the service is usually quick.
original: Good place for ice cream on a nice day. The line can get pretty long, but it typically moves quickly.

text: Tudo muito exagerado. Os biscoitos eram crocantes, mas tinham uma textura estranha. O sorvete/milkshakes não era nada de especial. Não voltaria a este lugar.
text_en: It was all way over-the-top. The cookies were crunchy, but they had a strange texture. The ice cream/milkshakes weren’t anything special either. I wouldn’t go back there again.
original: All hype. The cookies were crunchy and had a weird texture. The ice cream/milkshakes were nothing special. I'm would not go back there.

text: ¡Delicioso y excelente servicio! Probé el helado de Cheerios con miel y nueces, con mantequilla de galletas, y me encantó. ¡Definitivamente lo recomiendo, y mi novia y yo volveremos!
text_en: Delicious and excellent service! I tried the Cheerios ice cream with honey and nuts, along with cookie butter, and I loved it. I definitely recommend it, and my girlfriend and I will go back!
original: Enjoyable and great service! I had the Honey Nut Cheerios ice cream with the cookie butter and it made my heart melt. Definitely recommend and me and my girlfriend will be back again! Keep it up

text: Donuts caseiros, no seu melhor. O glacê é incrível. Cada um é uma obra de arte. Depois de experimentar o "Jack Frost", você nunca mais voltará a comprar donuts em lojas!
text_en: Home-made donuts, at their best. The glaze is incredible. Each one is a work of art. After trying “Jack Frost,” you will never buy donuts from stores again!
original: Homemade donuts at their finest. The icing is amazing. Each one is a work of art. Once you try Jack Frost, you can never go back to box store donuts again!

text: Como sempre, ambiente acolhedor, fila de espera longa e comida deliciosa! Sempre parece um lugar especial. No entanto, 14 dólares por uma fatia de bolo, sem lugar para sentar, é um pouco exagerado. Eu preferiria os outros itens do cardápio.
text_en: As always, a welcoming atmosphere, a long waiting line, and delicious food! It always seems like a special place. However, $14 for a slice of cake, with no seating available, is a bit excessive. I would prefer the other items on the menu.
original: Friendly as always, long line as always and good eats, too! Always feels like something special. However 14$ for a slice of cake with nowhere to sit is a bit bonkers. I'd stick with the other items.

text: Man, this place is good. I was in town for a conference at the Sands Expo, and I met a friend for a quick breakfast before the show started that day. I had a chocolate croissant ($4ish) and I bought a birthday cake macaron ($3.50) for later too. The macaron was HUGE and I wish I bought more. So good. I returned the next day, again for breakfast, and got a ham and brie croissant ($7ish) and that was amazing also - they warm it up for you too. Their croissants might even better than the ones at Paris Vegas. Definitely coming back here next time I'm in town! Quick and mostly inexpensive meals.
text_en: Man, this place is good. I was in town for a conference at the Sands Expo, and I met a friend for a quick breakfast before the show started that day. I had a chocolate croissant ($4ish) and I bought a birthday cake macaron ($3.50) for later too. The macaron was HUGE and I wish I bought more. So good. I returned the next day, again for breakfast, and got a ham and brie croissant ($7ish) and that was amazing also - they warm it up for you too. Their croissants might even better than the ones at Paris Vegas. Definitely coming back here next time I'm in town! Quick and mostly inexpensive meals.

text: Diseños y decoraciones muy bonitos tanto en el exterior como en el interior de la tienda. A diferencia de la Sprinkles local en Houston, Texas, que solo ofrece cupcakes, este lugar en la fabulosa Las Vegas también ofrece helado. ¡Increíble! Es la primera vez que pruebo el helado de Sprinkles. Mi pareja y yo probamos los sabores de red velvet, café y pistacho, y decidimos compartir un helado de pistacho. Los tres sabores que probamos son ricos y deliciosos, pero el de pistacho no es demasiado dulce y es el ganador. El personal es amable y servicial.
text_en: The designs and decorations are very beautiful, both inside and outside the store. Unlike the Sprinkles location in Houston, Texas, which only sells cupcakes, this place in fantastic Las Vegas also offers ice cream. Amazing! It’s the first time I’ve tried Sprinkles’ ice cream. My partner and I tried the red velvet, coffee, and pistachio flavors, and we decided to share a pistachio ice cream. All three flavors were rich and delicious, but the pistachio flavor wasn’t too sweet—it was the winner. The staff are friendly and helpful.
original: Very cute designs and decors on both the outside and interior of the shop. Unlike the local Sprinkles in Houston, TX that serves only cupcakes, this location in the fabulous Las Vegas serves ice cream as well! WOW this is the very first time I have ever tried the Sprinkles ice cream wheeeeeeeee! The boyfriend and I have sampled the red velvet, coffee and pistachio flavors and settled on sharing a Pistachio ice cream float. All three flavors that we have sampled are rich and delicious but the Pistachio is not too sweet and wins the game! The staff is friendly and helpful.

text: I was honestly disappointed. Maybe I set my expectations high because it's Buddy, but the pastries were expensive. I got the strawberry cheesecake and lobster tail and they were ok. The lobster tail was hard and crunchy. While the strawberry cheesecake tasted like the ones that you buy at the grocery store.
text_en: I was honestly disappointed. Maybe I set my expectations high because it's Buddy, but the pastries were expensive. I got the strawberry cheesecake and lobster tail and they were ok. The lobster tail was hard and crunchy. While the strawberry cheesecake tasted like the ones that you buy at the grocery store.

text: LOVE THIS PLACE !! The staff is always so friendly and helpful! They have unique flavors and ideas for making some pretty cool dessert creations. There are some cute walls to take photos in front of, plus a patio area in the back. Windsor and Churn connect to each other so they share a back patio. The patio isn't super large though and can fill up, especially around the time after dinner ! I always come here and can't wait to return :)

text: Personal extremadamente grosero. Muy grosero. Mi amiga que estaba detrás de mí ni siquiera pidió nada después de ver lo groseros que eran. Además, la crêpe estaba tan mala que la tiré. Nunca volveré a perder mi tiempo o mi dinero aquí.
text_en: Extremely rude behavior. Very rude. My friend behind me didn’t even ask for anything after seeing how rude they were. Moreover, the crepe was so bad that I threw it away. I will never waste my time or money here again.
original: Extremely rude staff. Super rude. My friend behind me didn't even order after she saw how rude they are. Plus the crepe was so bad I threw it out. I won't ever waste my time or money here.

text: Eu não tinha ideia do que esperar dessa padaria. Minha esposa faz bolos como presentes e eu a vejo assistindo a "Cake Boss", mas devo admitir que não estou muito familiarizado com todos os detalhes da série sobre a padaria. A padaria parece ser uma réplica da de Hoboken, Nova Jersey. O interior é muito limpo, mas pequeno. A fila estava longa, mas, considerando que o lugar acabou de abrir e há muita expectativa em torno dele, não vou reclamar da fila, mas foi difícil para um homem que só queria um cannoli ou um biscoito. Foi uma das coisas que fiz para minha esposa, e ver o quão divertida ela e suas sobrinhas estavam, tornou tudo valeu a pena. Compramos algumas caixas de doces, e minha esposa encomendou uma caixa especial para mim, para que ela e as meninas pudessem experimentar os doces, e eu pudesse ter os meus. Ela sabia que essa ida não era do meu agrado, então foi muito atenciosa. Provei alguns cannolis que foram recheados na hora. Eles têm opções pré-embaladas e também conchas de cannoli vazias, então basta dizer se você quer que sejam recheados ou não. Acho que as pessoas que escolhem as opções pré-embaladas e não perguntam se podem ser recheadas acabarão com um resultado encharcado. Provei um cupcake de cenoura que estava úmido e delicioso. A lagosta é incrível, e só posso imaginar como deve ser a versão XL da "Buddy V's", que fica do outro lado da rua! O meu "cream puff" foi a melhor coisa, depois da lagosta. Só queria que fosse maior. Gostei de tudo, mas achei estranho quando minha esposa me mostrou a caneca com o nome "Carlo's". Ela tinha essa inscrição. Mas, como? Estamos em Las Vegas! Por favor, comprem canecas que realmente digam "Las Vegas". Faz todo o sentido!
text_en: I had no idea what to expect from this bakery. My wife makes cakes as gifts, and I see her watching “Cake Boss,” but I must admit I’m not very familiar with all the details of the show related to the bakery. The bakery seems to be a replica of the one in Hoboken, New Jersey. The interior is very clean, but small. The line was long, but considering the place just opened and there’s a lot of anticipation around it, I won’t complain about the line. It was difficult for someone who just wanted a cannoli or a cookie. It was one of the things I bought for my wife, and seeing how fun she and her granddaughters were made it all worth it. We bought some boxes of sweets, and my wife ordered a special box for me, so she and the girls could try the sweets, and I could get mine. She knew this trip wasn’t what I wanted, so she was very thoughtful. I tried some cannolis that were filled on the spot. They have pre-packaged options, as well as empty cannoli shells, so you just say whether you want them filled or not. I think those who choose the pre-packaged option and don’t ask if they can be filled will end up with wet results. I tried a carrot cupcake that was wet and delicious. The lobster is amazing, and I can only imagine how the XL version of “Buddy V’s” must be—it’s across the street! My “cream puff” was the best thing after the lobster. I just wish it were bigger. I liked everything, but it seemed strange when my wife showed me the mug with “Carlo’s” written on it. But how? We’re in Las Vegas! Please buy mugs that really say “Las Vegas.” That makes sense!
original: I had no idea what to expect from this bakery. My wife decorates cakes as gifts and I see her watching "Cake Boss" but I have to admit I'm not too familiar with all the TV show stuff surrounding the bakery. The bakery is supposed to be some replication of their Hoboken, NJ bakery. Inside is very clean but small. The wait in line was brutal but given that this place just recently opened and all the hype around it I am not going to complain about the line but it was brutal being a guy who just wanted a cannoli or cookie. This was one of those things I did for my wife and seeing how much fun she and her nieces had made it worth it. We had a few boxes of treats and my wife had a special box made for me so that she and the girls could sample their treats and I could have my own. She knew this outing wasn't my cup of tea so that was thoughtful lol. I had a couple cannolis that were filled fresh in front of us. Thy have some pre-made and also empty cannoli shells so you just have to tell them if you want it filled fresh or not. I think the people who pick the pre-made ones and don't know better to ask for it filled will end up with a soggy mess. I had a carrot cupcake that was moist and tasted good. The lobster tail is out of this world and I can only imagine with the one here being the regular size what the XL version across the way at Buddy V's is like! My cream puff was the best thing next to the lobster tail I just wish it were bigger. I liked everything I had but I did think that it was wierd when my wife showed me the Carlo's mug she purchased. It said "Hoboken" on it. WTH? This is Las Vegas! Please get some mugs that actually say Las Vegas on them. It just makes sense!

text: Good assortment of pastries, as well as a solid sandwich lineup makes this place a good spot for breakfast OR lunch. The large , cozy interior creates a laid back experience as well. The fact that it's open 24/7 , which for a business in Charlotte is a rarity ensures a good late-night java joint also.
text_en: Good assortment of pastries, as well as a solid sandwich lineup makes this place a good spot for breakfast OR lunch. The large , cozy interior creates a laid back experience as well. The fact that it's open 24/7 , which for a business in Charlotte is a rarity ensures a good late-night java joint also.

text: O melhor atendimento ao cliente que já experimentei! Adoro que seus sorvetes não sejam muito doces. Com seus sorvetes ou qualquer outra bebida que servem, é possível realmente sentir os sabores. É diferente de qualquer outro doce, onde o açúcar predomina e você só sente isso. Sinto que este lugar é muito subestimado e merece mais atenção. A textura dos seus boba também era muito boa. Macia e não muito mastigável, mas com uma textura elástica. A senhora na frente, que nos ajudou, foi muito simpática! Ela nos deu amostras de sorvetes e se certificou de que estávamos satisfeitos. O sorvete de gergelim preto e banana era delicioso! Na minha opinião, o sorvete de taro (um tipo de batata doce) deles tinha um sabor melhor do que o sorvete de taro que vendem nas lojas asiáticas. Definitivamente recomendarei esta loja para meus amigos e familiares.
text_en: The best customer service I’ve ever experienced! I really like that their ice creams aren’t too sweet. With their ice creams or any other drinks they serve, you can truly taste the flavors. It’s different from any other dessert where sugar dominates and you just feel it. I feel that this place is underrated and deserves more attention. The texture of their boba was also very good. Soft and not very chewy, but with an elastic texture. The woman in front who helped us was very kind! She gave us samples of ice creams and made sure we were satisfied. The black sesame and banana ice cream was delicious! In my opinion, their taro ice cream (a type of sweet potato) had a better flavor than the taro ice cream sold in Asian stores. I definitely recommend this store to my friends and family.
original: The greatest customer service I've ever experienced!! I love that their ice cream aren't too sweet. With their ice cream or any drinks they serve, you can really taste the flavors. It's unlike any other dessert where the sugars over powering and that's all you taste. I feel this place is so underrated and deserves more attention. The texture of their boba was really good too. Soft and not overly chewy but bouncy. The lady up front who helped us was really nice! She gave us samples of ice creams and made sure we were satisfied. Their black sesame and banana ice cream was to die for! Their taro ice cream in my opinion tasted better than the magnolia taro ice cream they sell at the Asian stores. Will definitely recommend this shop to my friends and family.

text: Como uma loja de chocolate e sorvete famosa e de excelente qualidade poderia receber uma avaliação de 1 estrela? Leia o resto... Tínhamos vontade de experimentar o sundae com brownie e o bolo de chocolate derretido. Já havíamos vindo aqui antes, então não hesitamos em vir por este caminho, a partir de onde estávamos hospedados. Estávamos errados. Após uma espera MUITO longa (apenas um caixa atendendo), fomos informados de que não tinham brownies há 2 semanas e que não tinham mais bolo de chocolate derretido (apesar de terem uma foto dele na parede). Pedimos o sundae normal, que costuma ser muito bom. Mas desta vez não foi o mesmo. Algo estava errado. Entendo a situação causada pela Covid e os desafios que isso tem apresentado para os empregadores, mas a atitude dos funcionários foi horrível. Após fazer o pedido e esperar, fizemos algumas compras de chocolates. Compramos alguns doces em grandes quantidades – a embalagem que usamos não fechou corretamente. Perguntamos ao funcionário e a resposta foi: "Sim, sabemos que essas embalagens não fecham bem, mas temos uma etiqueta." Duvidei que uma etiqueta pudesse manter uma embalagem de plástico fechada, então perguntei se poderíamos usar outra embalagem. Ela disse que sim, mas cobrariam por outra embalagem! Então, eles estão conscientemente distribuindo embalagens defeituosas e, em seguida, querem cobrar por outra embalagem? O que??? Acho que é outra forma de gerar receita, como as taxas de bagagem despachada nas companhias aéreas ou as taxas de resort nos hotéis. Então, passei e esperei para pagar e precisei voltar à fila, pois eles não conseguiam (não queriam) me atender no balcão de "presentes". Após mais 20 minutos na fila, consegui os doces e, felizmente, coloquei-os em um saco... Por que felizmente, você pergunta? Bem, a etiqueta não segurou, e os doces saíram da embalagem de plástico defeituosa e entraram no saco. Não sei o que aconteceu desta vez neste local, mas teremos receio de voltar. Moradores e turistas, fiquem atentos!
text_en: How could a famous and high-quality chocolate and ice cream store receive a 1-star rating? Read on… We really wanted to try the sundae with brownies and the melted chocolate cake. We had been here before, so we didn’t hesitate to come this way, from where we were staying. But we were wrong. After a very long wait (just one cashier serving customers), we were told that there were no brownies for two weeks, and no more melted chocolate cake either (even though there was a photo of it on the wall). We ordered the regular sundae, which is usually very good. But this time it wasn’t the same. Something was wrong. I understand the situation caused by COVID and the challenges it poses for employers, but the staff’s attitude was horrible. After making our order and waiting, we bought some chocolates. We bought a lot of candies in large packages—the packaging didn’t seal properly. We asked the staff, and their response was, “Yes, we know these packages don’t seal well, but we have a label.” I thought a label couldn’t keep a plastic package sealed, so I asked if we could use another package. They said yes, but it would cost extra. So they are deliberately distributing defective packages and then trying to charge for another package? What??? I think it’s another way of generating revenue, like the fees for express baggage services in airlines or resort fees in hotels. So I went over and waited to pay, but I had to go back to the line because they wouldn’t serve me at the “gifts” counter. After another 20 minutes in line, I got the candies, and fortunately, I put them in a bag… Why “fortunately”? Well, the label didn’t hold, and the candies fell out of the defective plastic package and into the bag. I don’t know what happened here, but we won’t be back. Residents and tourists, be careful!
original: How can a famous and really good Chocolate and Ice Cream shop possibly get a 1 star review? Read on... We had a craving for the brownie sundae and a lava cake. We had been here before so there was no hesitation to come out this way from where we were staying. We were wrong. After a LONG wait (only 1 cashier open), we were informed they have been out of brownies for 2 weeks and they no longer have lava cake (even though they have a picture of it on the wall. We got the regular sundae, which is normally really good. Not so much this time. Something is off. I understand Covid and the issues it has presented to employers, but the attitude by the employees was awful. After ordering, and while waiting, we did some shopping for the chocolates. We purchased some bulk nonpareils-The container we used did not close properly. We asked the employee and her response was, "yes, we know those don't close properly, but we have a sticker." I doubted a sticker would keep a plastic container closed, so I asked if we could use another container. She said yes, but they would charge me for another container! So they knowingly give out defective containers and then want to charge for another container? What??? I guess it is another revenue stream, sort of like checked baggage fees at the airline or resort fees at the hotels. So I passed and waited to pay and I had to stand in line again, as they couldn't (wouldn't) ring me up at the "gift" register. After another 20 min wait in line, got the nonpareils and thankfully, put them in a bag... Why thankfully, you ask? well, the sticker didn't hold, and the candies went out of the aforementioned defective plastic container, and into the bag. Not sure what happened this time at this location, but we will be hesitant to return. Locals and Tourists beware!

text: Heard rave reviews about this place so we decided to check it out. To our surprise, this place is open 24/7/365! We went in around 10:30pm on a Saturday night and there was a line about 30 people long! Luckily the line moved quickly and I ordered a cappuccino and a chocolate mousse cup with a chocolate covered strawberry on top! Absolutely delicious! Seating can be a challenge as it seems they're constantly busy, but we were able to find somewhere to sit and enjoy our drinks and pastries! Love this place!

text: Let me start by saying, THEIR ICE CREAM IS NOT SWEET. It's this weird salty sour concoction that I think is supposed to taste like corn flakes... don't make the mistake I did and make sure you go in knowing that. Now that we got that out of the way. I got the greatest hits sampler which included a slice of crack pie, compost cookie, 3 birthday truffles, and a small portion of their "cereal" ice cream. Compost cookie was interesting, pie was cold which was a bummer, ice cream was interesting once you get over the fact that it's not sweet, but the truffles... the truffles were pretty stinking good. If you come here for anything please get the birthday truffles. All in all, definitely come here for pastries. I feel like this place is overhyped and I really wish I had lower expectations coming here. People are friendly! Interesting experience. Definitely want to try the famous birthday cake but a 6 inch cake comes with a hefty price tag of $56.
