Compré un croissant de chocolate y estaba tan crujiente, tan untuoso, y los trozos de chocolate combinaban perfectamente. Voy a pedir a mi hermana que me traiga algo cuando vaya a Las Vegas esta semana. También venden sándwiches, pero no parecían tan apetitosos, y el precio era un poco elevado para algo tan pequeño.
text_en: Why have I never heard of Bouchon before??? Wow, this place is really great! I’m really eager to try their macarons. I bought a chocolate croissant—it was so crispy and rich, and the chocolate pieces paired perfectly with it. I’ll ask my sister to bring me something from there when I go to Las Vegas this week. They also sell sandwiches, but they didn’t seem very appetizing, and the price was a bit too high for such a small item.
original: Why have I never heard of Bouchon!!!??? OMG, this place is soooooooooooo good! I'm craving their macaroons right now! I got a chocolate croissant and it was so buttery, so flaky and the chocolate chips complimented it just perfectly. I'm making my sister bring me back treats since she's going to Vegas this week. They sell sandwitches too but it didn't look that appetizing and they were a bit pricey for something that skinny and small.

text: Após várias visitas a Las Vegas e hospedagens na Strip, meu marido e eu finalmente visitamos esta unidade da Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. Um desejo repentino por sorvete nos atingiu durante a estadia em um hotel do The Linq, e, após pesquisar rapidamente o que estava aberto durante a noite de terça-feira, descobrimos a Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. Definitivamente, estávamos perdendo essa oportunidade, pois nossos sorvetes foram simplesmente incríveis! Localizada na Promenade do The Linq, a loja era facilmente acessível a pé do hotel. Conforme nos aproximávamos da Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop, vimos vários grupos de amigos, famílias e casais caminhando com sorvetes deliciosos. Apesar de visitarmos após as 22h em um dia de semana, a fila para fazer o pedido era quase do lado de fora. Quem sabia que a Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop era o lugar perfeito para ir à noite? Meu marido e eu pedimos nossos próprios sorvetes: o "World Famous Hot Fudge Sundae" e o "Gold Rush Sundae", respectivamente. Ambos eram incrivelmente saborosos e deliciosos. O "Gold Rush" combinava todos os meus sabores favoritos em um único sorvete: doce, salgado, caramelo e chocolate branco. É uma ótima opção para quem, como eu, não é muito fã de chocolate e também gosta do contraste entre o doce e o salgado. Recomendo muito. Só para avisar, os preços podem ser um pouco mais altos devido à localização direta na Strip. Saiba que você não terá problemas com seu pedido, e, para ser honesto, esses mini sorvetes podem ser compartilhados com outra pessoa. Além disso, nossa visita foi muito positiva e merece cinco estrelas.
text_en: After several visits to Las Vegas and staying at hotels on the Strip, my husband and I finally visited this branch of Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. A sudden craving for ice cream struck us while we were staying at a hotel on The Linq. After quickly checking what was open during Tuesday night, we found Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. We really had missed out on this opportunity, as our ice creams were simply amazing! Located on The Linq’s Promenade, the store was easily accessible on foot from the hotel. As we approached Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop, we saw various groups of friends, families, and couples walking around with delicious ice creams. Even though we visited after 10 p.m. on a weekday, the line to order was almost just outside the store. Who would have thought that Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop was the perfect place to go at night? My husband and I ordered our own ice creams: the “World Famous Hot Fudge Sundae” and the “Gold Rush Sundae,” respectively. Both were incredibly tasty and delicious. The “Gold Rush” combined all my favorite flavors in one ice cream: sweet, salty, caramel, and white chocolate. It’s a great option for those who aren’t very fond of chocolate and also enjoy the contrast between sweet and salty flavors. I highly recommend it. Just a note: the prices may be a bit higher due to its location right on the Strip. Don’t worry about ordering; honestly, these mini ice creams can be shared with someone else. In any case, our visit was very positive and deserves five stars.
original: After numerous visits to Las Vegas and staying on the strip, my husband and I finally made our first visit to this location of the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. A late night ice cream craving creeped up on us while we were staying a night at The Linq and, after doing a preliminary search of what was open in the later hours of a Tuesday night, we stumbled upon the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop. We definitely have been snoozing on this place as our ice cream concoctions were nothing short from amazing! Located in The Linq Promenade, it was a brief and easy walk from the hotel to the shop. As we drew closer and closer to the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop, we saw multiple groups of friends, families, and couples walking by us with a smile and their decadent ice cream treats. Despite us visiting after 11pm on a weeknight, the line to order was almost out the door. Who knew the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop was the poppin late night spot? My husband and I each ordered our own separate sundae: the World Famous Hot Fudge Sundae and Gold Rush Sundae, respectively. Both were extra rich (in all the right ways) and oh so tasty. The Gold Rush captured all of my favorite things in one treat: sweet, salty, caramel, and white chocolate. It is a great choice for anyone who may be like me and isn't a big fan of chocolate and who also likes that stark contrast of sweet and salty. I couldn't recommend it more. Just as a heads up so no one experiences sticker shock, the prices are a little elevated I'm guessing due to its location directly on the strip. Know that you can't go wrong with your order and to be honest, those mini sundaes could be shared with someone else. Other than that, our visit was positive and a solid five stars.

text: Nossa. Este lugar é limpo e moderno. As pessoas na balcão são incrivelmente educadas, pacientes e amigáveis! Experimentei quase todos os sabores, sem cerimônia. Aqui estão alguns destaques: Chocolate Branco com Morango: sorvete de chocolate branco no mesmo pote que o sorbete de morango. Delicioso e cremoso, combinando doçura e acidez... dois sabores por um preço! Eu realmente gostei, mas quem não gosta de chocolate branco pode não apreciar tanto. Caramelo Salgado: a atendente disse que este era o sabor mais popular, então, obviamente, eu precisava experimentar. Era delicioso, rico e cremoso, com o sabor perfeito de caramelo! Tartar de Castanha: sorvete delicioso com a irresistível lasanha caseira. Estou com água na boca. Rosas Brancas: puro e doce. Que sensação! Limão (Basis Lime): este foi realmente surpreendente! Doce, azedo e incrivelmente refrescante! Duas opções de queijo: Este é incrivelmente cremoso. No início, tem um sabor doce e amanteigado, com as tâmaras, e depois o sabor do queijo se destaca. No começo, achei um pouco estranho, mas depois de algumas mordidas, me apaixonei! Brownie com Sorvete: Não há como errar com brownies! Esta versão gourmet caseira superou o clássico! A lasanha e os cones caseiros estavam todos frescos e saborosos! Minha irmã pegou um sanduíche de sorvete com sorvete de chocolate, que eu experimentei. Estava fantástico. Mal posso esperar para voltar!
text_en: Wow. This place is clean and modern. The people at the counter are incredibly polite, patient, and friendly! I tried almost all the flavors without any fuss. Here are some highlights: White Chocolate with Strawberry: White chocolate ice cream in the same container as strawberry sorbet. Delicious and creamy, combining sweetness and acidity… two flavors for one price! I really liked it, but those who don’t like white chocolate might not appreciate it as much. Salty Caramel: The staff said this was the most popular flavor, so obviously I had to try it. It was delicious, rich, and creamy, with the perfect caramel taste! Walnut Tartar: Delicious ice cream with irresistible homemade lasagna. I’m craving it now. White Roses: Pure and sweet. What a feeling! Lemon (Basis Lime): This was truly surprising! Sweet, tart, and incredibly refreshing! Two cheese options: This one is incredibly creamy. At first, it has a sweet, caramel-like taste with almonds, and then the cheese flavor stands out. At first, I thought it was a bit strange, but after a few bites, I fell in love with it! Brownie with Ice Cream: There’s no way to go wrong with brownies! This gourmet version is better than the classic! The homemade lasagna and cones were all fresh and tasty! My sister ordered a sandwich with ice cream and white chocolate, which I tried. It was fantastic. I can’t wait to go back!
original: WOW. This place is clean and trendy. The people behind the counter are incredibly polite and patient and friendly! I sampled nearly every flavor quite shamelessly. Here are a few standouts: White Chocolate Raspberry: white chocolate ice cream in the same tub as raspberry sorbet. delicious and creamy combined with sweet and tart...two flavors for the price of one! i really loved this, but those who aren't a fan of white chocolate may not as much. Salted Caramel: the lady said this was their most popular flavor, so of course I had to have some. it was delicious and rich and creamy with perfect caramel flavor! Cashew Turtle: Delicious ice cream with their yummy homemade brittle. i'm salivating right now. White Roses: pure and sweet. what a sensation. Basis Lime: this was a real kick in the pants! sweet and tart and incredibly refreshing! Cheese Course Duo: This is incredibly creamy. At first it tastes sweet and nutty with the dates, then the cheese flavor kicks in. i found it pretty disconcerting at first, but after a few bites i was hooked! Brownie Swirl: you can't go wrong with brownies! this homemade gourmet version just knocked the classic out of the park for me! The housemade brittle and cones were all fresh and tasty! my sister got an ice cream sandwich with chocolate ice cream, which i nibbled. it was fantastic. i can't wait to come here again!

text: A loja estava um pouco suja e desorganizada. Ao entrar, não havia nada que realmente chamasse a atenção ou fosse impressionante. Tive a oportunidade de experimentar uma das massas de biscoito comestíveis, e fico feliz por ter feito isso, pois eu pretendia comprar algumas. Talvez seja porque esperava que estivessem refrigeradas, mas a textura estava um pouco arenosa. No final, comprei um pretzel coberto de chocolate, que, para minha surpresa, custou US$ 5. Um pouco caro, mas aceitável. O que realmente tornou a experiência negativa foi o cabelo que estava no chocolate, como mostrado na foto. Sem dúvida, depois disso, desisti de comer o restante.
text_en: The store was a bit dirty and disorganized. When I entered, there was nothing really striking or impressive. I had the chance to try one of the edible biscuits, and I’m glad I did, as I had intended to buy some. Maybe it’s because I expected them to be cold, but the texture was a bit sandy. In the end, I bought a chocolate-covered pretzel, which, to my surprise, cost $5. A bit expensive, but acceptable. What really made the experience negative was the hair in the chocolate, as shown in the photo. Without a doubt, after that, I gave up eating the rest.
original: Store was a bit dirty and unorganized. When you walk in, there wasn't anything that really stood out or was impressive. I got to sample one of the edible cookie doughs which I'm glad I did because I was originally intending on buying some. Maybe it's because I was expecting it to be refrigerated but the texture was a bit chalky. I ended up buying a chocolate covered pretzel which surprisingly cost $5. A little high but ok. What really turned it into a negative experience was the hair that was in the chocolate as pictured. Needless to say I ended up just throwing the rest of it away after that.

text: Quase 8 dólares por um croissant simples e suco de laranja que não é feito na hora? Isso é exagero.
text_en: Almost $8 for a simple croissant and orange juice that isn’t made right away? That’s an exaggeration.
original: Almost $8 for a plain croissant and orange juice that's NOT freshly squeezed? Come on.

text: Este lugar estava bastante movimentado para o horário do jantar de segunda-feira. Dica: pegue um número para o atendimento! Eu perdi o número quando entrei e pensei que ia perder a chance de comer um cannoli. Felizmente, consegui pegar um cannoli e um crème brûlée. O cannoli estava muito doce e parecia seco ao comer. O crème brûlée surpreendeu-me por não ser tão doce (o que é uma boa coisa!). A desvantagem do crème brûlée é que percebo que ele está lá há algum tempo, pois a parte de cima não queima tão bem quando é aquecida. Foi ok, eu não voltaria a este lugar. Outra dica: mínimo de US$ 5 para uso de cartão de crédito.
text_en: It was quite busy at this place during Monday dinner time. Tip: get a number for customer service! I lost my number when I entered, and thought I’d miss out on eating a cannoli. Fortunately, I managed to get a cannoli and a crème brûlée. The cannoli was very sweet, but seemed dry when eaten. The crème brûlée surprised me—it wasn’t as sweet (which is good!). The downside of the crème brûlée is that it seems to have been sitting there for a while; the top part doesn’t cook as well when heated. It was okay, but I wouldn’t go back here again. Another tip: minimum $5 required for credit card payment.

text_en: It’s relatively expensive, but the location is excellent, especially if you’re staying at Cosmopolitan. They are open until 2 a.m. every day, which is great. My girlfriend ordered the “White Russian” – a kind of adult-style milkshake – and she loved it, even though it’s sweet. All the ingredients are of high quality, and the place is very clean.

text: No hay un café más bueno que este en Las Vegas. Además, sus deliciosos pasteles (¡ay, me encantan los macarons!), lo convierten en el lugar perfecto para tomar un respiro por la tarde. También tienen sándwiches, lo que lo convierte en una buena opción para el almuerzo (especialmente si estás de viaje de negocios y tienes que desplazarte rápidamente). En mi última visita, probé un latte con sabor a arce que no puedo olvidar. Tenía un equilibrio perfecto, no era demasiado dulce, y tenía la cantidad justa de arce. Si te gusta el latte de especias de calabaza de Starbucks, no compres este: después de probar lo que realmente puede ser un buen café, es posible que nunca más quieras beber en Starbucks. Este café puede ser un poco difícil de encontrar. Está ubicado en el Venetian, cerca del Phantom Theatre. No lo verás hasta que estés muy cerca. Pero sigue caminando hasta encontrarlo, porque merece la pena visitarlo.
text_en: There’s no better coffee in Las Vegas than this one. Moreover, its delicious pastries—oh, I love macarons!—make it the perfect place to take a break in the afternoon. They also have sandwiches, so it’s a good option for lunch, especially if you’re on a business trip and need to move around quickly. During my last visit, I tried an applewood-flavored latte that I’ll never forget. It had the perfect balance of flavors; not too sweet, with just the right amount of apple flavor. If you like Starbucks’ pumpkin spice latte, don’t buy this one—after trying what truly great coffee is possible, you might never want to drink at Starbucks again. This coffee might be a bit hard to find. It’s located in the Venetian, near the Phantom Theatre. You won’t see it until you get very close. But keep walking until you find it, because it’s worth visiting.
original: There isn't a better latte to be found in Las Vegas. Add in their delectable pastries (oh, how I love the macarons) and you've got a perfect afternoon pick-me-up. They also have sandwiches, which also makes it a pretty good lunch option (especially if you're there on business and thus sprinting around trying to get somewhere on time). On my last visit, they had a maple spice latte that I can't get out of my head. It was nicely balanced, not too sweet, with just the right amount of maple. Don't buy this if you like the pumpkin spice latte at Starbucks: you'll never be able to drink Starbucks again after experiencing what a great coffee can really taste like. This can be a little bit hard to find. It's tucked away in the Venetian, near the Phantom Theatre. You can't see it until you're nearly on top of it. But keep on walking until you find it, because it's totally worth the visit.

text: Sorveteria em Las Vegas! É uma pequena loja dentro do Cosmopolitan, localizada ao lado da nova filial do Momofuku. Aqui você encontra todos os clássicos, desde os biscoitos até o sorvete cremoso. Se você nunca experimentou um biscoito de milho, corra para lá o mais rápido possível e experimente um. O biscoito de mirtilo e creme também é delicioso. Os preços não são exagerados e o sorvete de leite de cereal é cremoso e divinamente saboroso.
text_en: A ice cream shop in Las Vegas! It’s a small store inside Cosmopolitan, located next to the new branch of Momofuku. Here you can find all the classic items—from cookies to creamy ice cream. Prices aren't super crazy and that cereal milk soft serve is creamy and heavenly.

text_en: We discovered this place while exploring the Cosmopolitan, and we were very happy to stop by and try the milk shake—it was delicious! Never had a milk shake like that before and the other stuff on their menu looked so interesting especially the golden knights inspired desserts! text_en: It’s a small and charming store in a shopping center, with excellent ice creams. My mother and I tried the chocolate ice cream with peanut butter, and it was delicious. We would like to go back and try the various types of ice creams they offer.
original: This is a cute little shop in a strip mall with excellent ice cream. My mom and I both had the chocolate peanut butter and it was great. We want to come back and try the ice cream flights next since there were other flavors I wanted to try.

text: After visit #2, I'm still not sure why this place is rated as high as it is. The decor, location and staff is 5 star, but the ice cream is just not that good. The first visit I sampled three different ice creams before deciding not to purchase any, since the flavors were not my favorite. However, my mother purchased the chocolate and it was just meh. We ended up throwing half of it out. I decided to give them another shot since we came at an odd time. My husband and I both got some ice cream. text: Oh man!! This place is SO good! It's a little ice cream shop near downtown phx. It's a cute cozy place. The owner, Brandon, is super nice, and very helpful. You could tell he loved his shop. He gave my boyfriend and I suggestions, and told us what exactly was in each flavor. There's eight total flavors, half is limited, while the other half their signature flavors. I had a limited flavor which was the Black Raspberry Cashew, boy do I tell you, it is the BEST ice cream I've had in awhile! I was contemplating on getting it in a warm glazed donut until the Leslie Knope (love the name by the way) caught my eye. It's a warm waffle sandwich. You also get a free topping with it, so I got the basic sprinkle (boring I know) but it was so good! Thinking about it now makes me wish I had one. My boyfriend had the Leslie Knope as well but with the Cookie Monster flavor (one of their signatures). That was also delicious! It is definitely a must try! You will not regret it!

text: Uau... Uau... Uau... Se este lugar não é o sonho de qualquer amante de sorvete, não sei onde mais. text_en: Wow… This place is truly a dream for anyone who loves ice cream. I have no idea where else it could be. It’s simply amazing—with excellent flavors and a great taste. They make sure there’s plenty of ingredients in each flavor (like strawberries, lemon cookies, brownies, etc.). We really love it so much that we went back twice. I highly recommend it, but be patient, as the lines can get long.

Highly recommend but be patient as the lines can get long.

text: Eu costumava ir à Mary Coyle há muitos anos e adorava. Experimentei esta nova Mary Coyle, e foi a maior decepção de todas. Primeiro, não havia cardápios para consultar. text_en: I used to go to Mary Coyle many years ago and loved it. I tried this new Mary Coyle now, and it was the greatest disappointment of all. First of all, there were no menus to refer to. I had to use my phone to look up the menu before ordering. I ordered a sundae with hot chocolate sauce. The chocolate sauce wasn’t hot at all; it seemed like it had been taken from the bottom of a burnt pot. It was horrible. When I asked about the chocolate sauce, the only employee said, “That’s all we have.” It’s obvious I won’t go there again, and I wouldn’t recommend Mary Coyle to any of my friends either.

text: Os cupcakes da Sprinkles são, em geral, deliciosos. Alguns sabores são significativamente melhores do que outros. Na maioria das vezes, os cupcakes são bem macios, o que é sempre um ponto positivo, especialmente se você prefere não usar glacê. O glacê tem um bom sabor e não é excessivamente doce ou amanteigado. Ambos seriam falhas graves, na minha opinião. Fiquei realmente impressionado com os sabores de chocolate com pasta de amendoim, marshmallow de chocolate e coco. O de chocolate com pasta de amendoim é, sem dúvida, o melhor. Sem dúvida. Fiquei desapontado com os sabores de preto e branco e chocolate com caramelo (este era um sabor não disponível no cardápio). O ambiente da loja de cupcakes é muito divertido! Embora, na maioria das vezes, haja mais opções de sabores dentro da loja. Mas vale a pena comprar pelo menos um cupcake na loja, pelo menos uma vez!
text_en: Sprinkles’ cupcakes are generally delicious. Some flavors are significantly better than others. Most of the time, the cupcakes are very soft, which is always a positive point, especially if you prefer not to use glaze. Glaze has a good taste and isn’t overly sweet or sticky. Both would be serious flaws in my opinion. I was really impressed with the chocolate with peanut butter, chocolate marshmallow, and coconut flavors. The chocolate with peanut butter is undoubtedly the best. Definitely. I was disappointed with the black and white flavors and chocolate with caramel (this was a flavor not available on the menu). The atmosphere in the cupcake shop is very fun! Although, most of the time, there are more flavors available inside the shop. But it’s worth buying at least one cupcake from the shop, at least once!
original: Sprinkles cupcakes are for the most part super good. Some of the flavors are significantly better than others. For the most part the cupcakes are pretty moist, which is always a plus if you're a "skip the icing" type of person. The icing has good flavor and isn't too sweet or too buttery. Which either of those is a serious flaw in my opinion. I was really impressed by the peanut butter chocolate, chocolate marshmallow and coconut. The peanut butter one is by far the best one. BY FAR. I was underwhelmed by the black & white and caramel chocolate (this was an off the menu item). The cupcake atm is really fun! Although most of the time there are more cupcake flavors available inside the store. But it's worth it to buy one from the atm at least once!

text: DRIPPS is my answered prayer and biggest blessing to the Chandler area this year. I'm not kidding when I say I come here at least once a week. When they first opened in September, it was even more than that, taking advantage of their soft opening and grand opening discount and BOGO. They are an awesome company, from the owners over at Pokitrition. The star here is CEREAL INFUSED SOFT SERVE. And no, it is not just some cereal just sprinkled into the ice cream. It is generous amounts of cereal of your choice literally DRILLED in and it is the best cereal ice cream in the world. I am a huge fan of Christina Tosi's Milkbar cereal ice cream, but Dripps takes it to a whole other level. I can assure you your favorite childhood cereal is among their choices. They do have signature creations you could choose from and mix and match toppings, but what I love to do is just choose a cereal and use the same cereal as topping. Their "supporting actor" I would say is their matcha drinks. If you love matcha, you will be in heaven. They use real QUALITY matcha. Great flavor, good caffeine kick without the jitters. Next favorite is the rose milk tea. It's not too "flowery" it is more milky which I love. Their milk teas are good as well. The only one negative thing is the boba balls are not as soft as I would love them to be but I enjoy milk teas without boba so they get a pass. The whole concept is just amazing and I'll shout it from the rooftops if I could. I LOVE DRIPPS!

text: Mientras caminaba por la calle un día, mi olfato detectó un olor. ¿Podría ser un sándwich o un pastel? Pensé. ¡Ajá! Era el olor de un donut. Mis grandes pies de canguro me llevaron lo más rápido posible hasta la fuente del olor. Giré una esquina y lo vi: un gran edificio. Parecía cualquier otro, pero dentro sabía que había algo especial. Entré y me abrumaron olores como nunca antes. Tantos olores agradables en un solo lugar me dejaron sin aliento y grité y corrí. Finalmente, me armé de valor para volver ayer y me arrastré hasta el mostrador. Pedí y cuando probé mi primer bocado, grité tan fuerte que mi gato me oyó (ella me contó sobre ello más tarde) y, con un brinco, salí corriendo. Se necesita tiempo para ganar coraje, pero una vez que lo haces, vale la pena.
text_en: One day, as I walked down the street, my sense of smell detected a certain scent. Could it be a sandwich or a cake? I thought. Ah! It was the smell of a donut. My big kangaroo feet helped me get there as quickly as possible. I turned a corner and saw a large building. It looked like any other building, but inside, I knew there was something special. I entered and I was overwhelmed by smells I had never experienced before. So many pleasant smells in one place left me breathless; I screamed and ran away. Finally, I mustered up the courage to go back and crawled over to the counter. I ordered something, and when I tasted my first bite, I screamed so loudly that my cat heard me (she told me about it later). I jumped out in a hurry. It takes time to gain courage, but once you do, it’s worth it.

I rounded a corner and saw it. a big building. It looked like any other but inside I knew was something special. I pounced through the doors and was assaulted with smells like no other. so many good smells in one place overwhelmed me and I screeched and ran. text: O sorveteria tradicional do bairro, que oferece deliciosas (e acessíveis) porções, perfeitas para serem apreciadas ao ar livre. Finalmente tive a oportunidade de visitar este clássico de Cleveland, depois de esperar o inverno todo, já que só está aberto durante a primavera e o verão. Um dos principais atrativos – e, provavelmente, a razão pelo prêmio "Melhor Sorveteria de Cleveland" em 2016 – é o "Honey Hut", que evoca a nostalgia, e nada remete mais à antiguidade do que uma pequena cabana de madeira à beira da estrada. Felizmente, eles anteciparam a popularidade, com um estacionamento amplo (entrada pela Buechner Ave). O toldo sobre a cabana cobre apenas alguns metros, então, em dias de chuva ou sol forte, pode ser sensato levar um guarda-chuva para se proteger enquanto espera na fila. Quando cheguei, havia duas janelas para fazer pedidos, além de alguns funcionários dentro do espaço amplo, que cuidavam de pedidos mais elaborados, como smoothies, milkshakes e sundae. Quando chegou a minha vez, fiquei surpreso ao perceber que eu havia gasto tanto tempo escolhendo os sabores que não percebi que minhas duas porções generosas custavam apenas $3. Brincadeira, não é. Optei por me deliciar no pátio parcialmente coberto, mas saiba que, em caso de mau tempo, as fendas no telhado não proporcionarão muita proteção. O "Honey Pecan" parece ser o sabor tradicional aqui, então experimentei e gostei, mas fiquei um pouco decepcionado, pois era predominantemente de nozes e com pouquíssimo mel. Gostei mais do sabor sazonal "Dark Chocolate Cayenne", com seu leve toque picante no final. A consistência era densa, mas não a textura cremosa que eu esperava. Também não era tão cremosa quanto as oferecidas no Mitchell's e Piccadilly, e havia algumas áreas congeladas no meu sorvete. Sabores tradicionais e simples, sem muitos luxos, e eu ficaria feliz em gastar mais $3 por um cone confiável – embora não seja de primeira linha.
text_en: The traditional ice cream shop in the neighborhood offers delicious (and affordable) portions, perfect for enjoying outdoors. Finally, I got the chance to visit this classic in Cleveland after waiting all through winter—it’s only open during spring and summer. One of its main attractions—and probably the reason it won the “Best Ice Cream Shop in Cleveland” award in 2016—is the “Honey Hut,” which evokes nostalgia. Nothing is more reminiscent of the past than a small wooden cabin by the roadside. Fortunately, they anticipated popularity and have a large parking lot (entrance via Buechner Ave). The canopy over the cabin covers just a few meters, so on rainy or sunny days, it’s wise to bring an umbrella while waiting in line. When I arrived, there were two windows for ordering, along with some staff who handled more complex orders like smoothies, milkshakes, and sundae. When it was my turn, I was surprised to find that I had spent so much time choosing flavors, and I didn’t realize that my two generous portions cost only $3. It’s just a joke. I chose to enjoy myself in the partially covered patio, but keep in mind that if it rains or the weather is bad, the gaps in the roof won’t provide much protection. “Honey Pecan” seems to be the traditional flavor here, so I tried it and liked it, but I was a little disappointed because it was mostly nuts with very little honey. I preferred the seasonal flavor “Dark Chocolate Cayenne,” with its mild spicy taste at the end. The consistency was dense, but not the creamy texture I expected. It wasn’t as creamy as those offered at Mitchell’s and Piccadilly either, and there were some areas where the ice cream was frozen. Traditional and simple flavors, without many extras. I would be happy to spend an extra $3 for a reliable cone—although it isn’t top-tier.
original: The OG neighborhood ice cream joint providing satisfying (and cheap) scoops to be enjoyed outdoors. I finally got around to visiting this Cleveland staple after waiting all winter, since they're only open for the spring and summer months. A major selling point - and I suspect the cause of their Cleveland Scene Best Ice Cream 2016 Award - of Honey Hut is probably the nostalgia factor, and nothing screams old school like a whitewashed literal hut off the side of the road. Luckily, they at least anticipated their popularity with a sizable parking lot (enter off Buechner Ave). The awning over the hut only extends out a few feet or so, so in rain or extreme sunshine it might be wise to bring an umbrella to protect from the elements while waiting in line. There were two order windows in operation when I went, plus a few more staffers within the large space inside the stoop making the more effort-intensive orders like smoothies, shakes, and sundaes. When my turn came to order, I was shocked to realize that I had been agonizing so much over which flavors to choose that I didn't notice my two hefty scoops cost only $3. Jesting, I am not. I chose to treat myself under the semi-covered patio, but know that when bad weather hits the gaps in the cross-hatched roof won't provide much protection. The Honey Pecan seems to be the OG flavor here, so I tried and enjoyed, but was a bit disappointed that it was mostly pecan and barely there honey. I liked my Dark Chocolate Cayenne seasonal flavor more, with its subtle spicy buzz at the end. The consistency was thick but not the custard consistency I was expecting. It also wasn't as creamy as those served at Mitchell's and Piccadilly and there were some icy spots in my ice cream. Good old-fashioned flavors without too many frills, and I would happily spend another $3 for a dependable - if not first-rate - cone.

text: Ice cream sandwiches made with donuts? Throw in your favorite childhood cereal? The Spice Girls are playing on the radio? I'm done... Just done... And in the best way yall. I am obviously on a major dessert kick right now... along with Zinfandel. My wife sneakily snuck me to Ninety's Ice Cream and Sandwiches a few months back and I ashamed that I have not yet been back. I got their famous donut ice cream sandwich and added cookie crisp to it. Kids, let me tell you the amazing adventure that my taste buds went on here. They basically cook it in something that looks like a grilled-cheese sandwich cooker and out pops this softball sized icecream that is encased inside a donut. The warmth of the donut against the cool, firm, ice cream is just a great experience for your mouth. Not as messy as you would think either. However, I really don't let food sit around long enough to melt.

text: ¡Un servicio al cliente realmente excelente! Todo está hecho fresco y es realmente delicioso. La única queja es que estos donuts no duran más de un día. Después del primer día, el pan del donut se endurece y se vuelve rancio, y considerando el precio que cobran, siento que deberían durar más. Sin embargo, siguen siendo una excelente opción si van a comprar uno o dos y consumirlos el mismo día.
text_en: A truly excellent customer service! Everything is fresh and really delicious. The only complaint is that these donuts don’t last more than a day. After the first day, the dough of the donut becomes hard and smells bad. Considering the price they charge, I think they should last longer. However, they’re still a great option if you buy one or two and eat them on the same day.
original: Really good customer service! Everything is made fresh and is realllllly yummy. The only complaint is that these donuts won't last more than a day. After the first day the donut bread gets hard and stale, and for the price they charge i feel like they should last longer. Still really worth it if you're gonna get one or two and eat them the same day.

text: Eu e meus filhos fomos para o almoço. Embora eu tenha ficado um pouco decepcionada por não haver opções de refeição no local, presumo que seja devido à situação do COVID, a comida foi incrível! Todos nós pedimos um tipo de sanduíche com croissant – com presunto ou frango. Eu pedi o "Croque Monsieur" e recomendo muito! Depois, fomos à padaria... Gostaria apenas que pudéssemos ter ficado sentados e aproveitado o ambiente enquanto saboreávamos um café. Ótimo atendimento também!
text_en: My children and I went for lunch. Although I was a little disappointed that there were no food options on site, I assume it’s due to the COVID situation; the food was incredible! We all ordered some kind of sandwich with croissants—with ham or chicken. I ordered the “Croque Monsieur” and I highly recommend it! After that, we went to the bakery… I just wish we could have sat down and enjoyed the atmosphere while drinking coffee. The service was also great!
original: My children and I came for lunch. While I was a little disappointed there was no dining in options, guessing due to COVID, the food was amazing! We all had some type of croissant sandwich- ham or turkey. I had the Croque Monsier and I highly recommend!! Afterwards we had bakery... I only wish we could have sat and enjoyed the ambiance while sipping coffee after. Great service too!

text: PAGE'S SZN! Page's is located under the train tracks at the light on Carson Street/ Becks Run Road. There is plenty of parking in the lot under the tracks, alongside the building, and across the alley behind the business. And the ice cream, 10/10. We shared the banana split and were sure to order it with whipped cream and nuts. A very generous portion and the soft serve is some of the best. It's not just ice cream, but a wonderful experience - family, nostalgia, summer, all of the above. Take your family, take your date, take yourself - you won't regret it.

text: I have no idea why this place is rated so highly. Pretty much just a obnoxiously colorful sweet shop that seems incredibly overpriced mediocre ice cream. I got the Dole whip pineapple and nonfat chocolate soft serve, as well as a pecan scoop. A kiddie scoop will cost you $5.99+ tax and the regular is $6.99. these are incredibly small scoops and definitely not worth so much. I guess you end up paying expensive prices in Vegas, but at least make the food good. The service was pretty nonchalant and just rang us up. There's nowhere to sit as well so you have to walk around eating your ice cream.

text: No tienen muchas opciones de helado, pero las que ofrecen son fantásticas. Son muy sabrosas y tienen un precio razonable. Este lugar suele estar muy concurrido, y probablemente tendrás que esperar en una fila en la calle. El personal es amable.
text_en: They don’t have many ice cream options, but those they do have are fantastic. They’re very tasty and reasonably priced. This place is usually very crowded, and you might have to wait in a line on the street. The staff are friendly.
original: They don't have a lot of choices for ice cream but the ones they do have are amazing. Very flavorful at a reasonable price. This place gets very busy and you will be waiting in a line on the street most likely. The staff was friendly.

text: Me encantó el helado de leche de cereal. Cuando lo escuché por primera vez, no sabía qué esperar, pero cuando lo probé, literalmente sabía como la leche que se tiene justo después de haber comido todo el cereal del bol. ¡Jajaja! Estaba muy contento porque hacía mucho que no sentía ese sabor en mi boca. Tenía la cantidad perfecta de dulzor (no demasiado dulce, lo cual era ideal, y no quería tirarlo, así que seguía probándolo), y lo compré junto con los flakes de maíz, lo que añadió textura y lo hizo muy agradable de comer. De verdad, ahora mismo estoy deseando probarlo, por eso me ha llevado tanto tiempo escribir esta reseña. El personal fue muy informativo y amable cuando estuve allí. Por lo tanto, la atención al cliente fue 5/5 :)
text_en: I really liked the cereal milk ice cream. When I first heard about it, I had no idea what to expect, but when I tried it, it tasted exactly like the milk that comes right after eating all the cereal in the bowl. Jajaja! I was very happy because it’s been a long time since I’ve felt that flavor in my mouth. The amount of sweetness was just right—not too sweet, which was ideal, and I didn’t want to waste it, so I kept trying more. I bought it along with cornflakes, which added texture and made it very enjoyable to eat. Really, I’m eager to try it now, which is why it took me so long to write this review. The staff were very informative and friendly when I was there. So, customer service was 5/5 :)
original: I loved the cereal milk soft serve! Like when I first heard of it I didn't know what to expect, but when I had it, it literally tasted like the milk you'd have right after you finish eating all the cereal in the bowl. Haha I was so happy because I haven't had that taste in my mouth for a while. It was the perfect amount of sweetness (not too sweet which was perfect, like I didn't want to throw it away I just kept going at it) and I bought it with the corn flakes, so the crunch added texture and made it so pleasant to eat! I'm craving this right now tbh, which is why it has taking me so long to give a review, Staff members were super informative and sweet when I was there. So at that time service was 5/5 :)

text: Honestly nothing beats Mitchell's ice cream in terms of quality ingredients and amazing taste. I've been to several different locations but since I now live closest to this one it's great to have one right down the street (and dangerous to the waistline.) My favorite is the vegan salted caramel pecan but any of them I try I love. The staff is always very friendly as well.

text: Love this place. If you're a fan of ice cream and a fan of donuts why not try them together and bring your butt to Novel.
text_en: Love this place. If you're a fan of ice cream and a fan of donuts why not try them together and bring your butt to Novel.

text: I was so looking forward to this place. After eating at Momofuku next door, my sweet tooth was calling me out. Sadly to say, Milk was more than disappointing for me. 3 stars for the Birthday cake truffles alone. They were soft, buttery, doughey and sweet. The cereal milk soft serve didn't do a thing for me and I love ice cream. Sadly, it tasted bland and wasn't sweet at all-- even with a generous heaping of corn flakes on top to give it texture. I sampled all of the soft serve flavors as well and nothing stood out. Sorry Milk, but all the hype is just that- hype.

Sadly to say, Milk was more than disappointing for me. 3 stars for the Birthday cake truffles alone. They were soft, buttery, doughey and sweet. text: Paso por aquí (irónicamente, para ir al gimnasio!) y siempre he estado interesado en echar un vistazo. Parece encantador desde la ventana. Estábamos en esa zona por un asunto con el perro, así que mi esposo esperó con el can, mientras yo entraba. Mi esposo preguntó si quería algo para él o me advirtió que comería lo que yo comprara. Tomo nota. El café tiene un ambiente antiguo. Me recuerda a un café vienés. Me dirigí al mostrador y vi muchísimos pasteles hermosos. Lamentablemente, los pasteles no son prácticos para una compra rápida. Los brownies eran enormes y podrían encajar en las dimensiones de un postre para compartir. Luego, miré hacia arriba y vi lo que pensé eran "whoopie pies" (un tipo de pastel popular en Pensilvania). Leí más detenidamente y descubrí que son galletas rellenas de crema de mantequilla de cacahuete. ¡Perfecto! Nos sentamos en el banco de afuera y compartimos ese delicioso postre. La crema de mantequilla era ligera y combinaba muy bien con la galleta con chispas de chocolate. Era un poco difícil de comer, pero estaba delicioso. ¡Al perro también le encantó estar en el banco!
text_en: I pass by here (ironically, to go to the gym!) and I’ve always been interested in taking a look. It looks lovely from the window. We were in that area because of something related to the dog, so my husband waited with the dog while I went in. My husband asked if I wanted anything for him, or warned me that he would eat whatever I bought. I’ll keep that in mind. The café has an old-fashioned atmosphere. It reminds me of a Viennese café. I went to the counter and saw lots of beautiful pastries. Unfortunately, pastries aren’t very practical for a quick purchase. The brownies were huge and could fit into the size of a shared dessert. Then, I looked up and thought I saw “whoopie pies” (a type of pastry popular in Pennsylvania). I read more carefully and found out that they’re cookies filled with peanut butter cream. Perfect! We sat on the bench outside and shared that delicious dessert. The butter cream was light and matched well with the chocolate-chip cookie. It was a bit difficult to eat, but it was delicious. The dog also loved sitting on the bench!
original: I walk by here (ironically to get to the gym!) and have been curious to check out the spot. It looks charming from the window. We were down that way for an errand with the pup, so hubs waited with pupster, while I went in. Hubs asked for something of his own or forewarned me that he would eat whatever I got. Noted. The cafe has an old world feel. Think a dark Viennese cafe. I made my way to the counter and saw so many beautiful cakes. Alas, cakes aren't practical for grab and go errand type. The brownies were huge and would fit the size criteria of a shared treat. Then I looked up and saw what I thought were whoopie pies (gobs for Western Pennsylvanians). I read closer and they're cookies with peanut buttercream filling. Done! We sat on the bench outside and shared the tasty treat. The buttercream was light and greatly paired well with the chocolate chip cookie. It was a bit messy to eat, but so good. Pupster enjoyed hanging on the bench, too!

text: Comprei sem experimentar e adoro os sorvetes da Sloane quando estou na Flórida. Todos os sabores que eu estava interessado mostraram sinais de queimadura pelo congelador. Descarto os sorvetes do meu congelador quando apresentam essa marca. Não vou pagar um preço mais alto por isso.
text_en: I bought them without trying them out, and I love Sloane’s ice cream when I’m in Florida. All the flavors I was interested in showed signs of freezer burn. I throw away the ice creams from my freezer when they have that mark. I won’t pay a higher price for that.
original: Left without trying and i love sloans when i am in florida. All the flavors i was interested in showed freezer burn. I throw out the ice cream from my freezer when it has freezer burn. No way i pay premium for that.

text: The ladies who were there were so sweet, serving us at 7:59pm when they closed at 8. I really appreciated that! Also the prices were extremely reasonable. That being said... the chocolate on the bonbons were all cracked and bubbly, clearly not tempered right. I ordered an espresso bonbon which I did enjoy. It oozed a sweet espresso goo in the middle, though the sugar granuals were present, having not been melted when mixed. The rum-dipped dark chocolate bonbon was the real displeasure. It was clearly milk chocolate, and dry at that. And the inside was so disappointing I had to write something. The "rum filing" was a congealed sugar solid that tasted nothing of rum. I've never not wanted to finish a chocolate treat. Maybe they had been in the case for too long as the bonbons definitely varies depending on ingredients. Their cupcakes are out of this world, though.

text: ¡Toffee Banofi! El helado de vainilla de Madagascar es suave y cremoso. Las bananas, el toffee de almendras y la dulce salsa de caramelo se combinan para crear un helado espectacular.
text_en: Toffee Banofi! The vanilla ice cream from Madagascar is soft and creamy. Bananas, almond toffee, and sweet caramel sauce combine to create an amazing ice cream.
original: Toffee Banofi! The Madagascar vanilla ice cream Is smooth and creamy. Bananas, almond toffee, and the sweet caramel sauce all come together to make this an awesome sundae!

text: Quando percebi que estava hospedado no Venetian, soube imediatamente que precisava visitar este lugar e comprar alguns doces e macarons! Quando descobri que estava bem perto da entrada dos elevadores para os apartamentos, fiquei encantado! Que pena que fecham às 20h ou 21h, senão seria um ótimo lanche antes de sair para a balada. No entanto, fui de manhã, às 8h, e já havia uma fila enorme! Como estava indo embora naquele dia, esperei e consegui um bolo de passas, pudim de pão, 12 macarons (nas embalagens pré-prontas, então eram menores do que os vendidos individualmente) e um chá de chai! (Sim, tudo para mim, embora não tudo de uma vez! ha) O bolo de passas estava delicioso, mas era muito doce. Achei que o chá de chai combinaria bem com o bolo de passas, mas o chá de chai estava ainda MAIS doce. Definitivamente não vou pedir o chá de chai dela novamente. Quando cheguei em casa, experimentei o pudim de pão, e estava delicioso!!! E os macarons, IMPERDÍVEIS. Chegamos ao ponto.
text_en: When I realized I was staying at the Venetian, I immediately knew I needed to visit this place and buy some sweets and macarons! When I found out it was close to the elevator entrance for the apartments, I was thrilled! It’s a pity they close at 8 or 9 p.m.; otherwise, it would be a great snack before going to the bar. However, I went there in the morning at 8 a.m., and there was already a long line! Since I was leaving that day, I waited and managed to get a raisin cake, bread pudding, 12 macarons (they were in pre-packaged packages, so smaller than those sold individually), and a chai tea! (Yes, everything for me, though not all at once!) The raisin cake was delicious, but it was too sweet. I thought the chai tea would go well with the raisin cake, but the chai tea was even sweeter. Definitely won’t order her chai tea again. When I got home, I tried the bread pudding—it was delicious!!! And the macarons? Absolutely amazing. We’re done here.
original: When I realized I was staying at Venetian, I knew immediately I had to come to this place and get some pastries and macarons! When I realized that it was right next to the elevators access to the suites, I was in love!! Too bad they close at 8, or 9pm, or else this would be a good pre-clubbing dessert. However I went in the morning at 8am and the line was already super long! Since I was leaving that day, I waited it out and scored myself a sticky bun, bread pudding, 12 macarons ( in those prepackages sets, so they were smaller than the individually sold ones) and a chai latte! ( Yes all for myself, though not all in one sitting! ha) The sticky bun was delicious, but was very sweet. I thought the chai latte would complement the sticky bun well, but the chai latte was even SWEETER. Definitely will not get the chai latte from her again. When I got back home, I tried the bread pudding, and yummmmmm, it was delicious!!! And the macarons, A MUST TRY. Enough said.

text: Como gran aficionado al helado de té verde, este es un lugar imprescindible para visitar. Me gusta su diseño encantador dentro del café. Su helado de té verde es excelente, no demasiado dulce y muy auténtico. Puedes probarlo antes de pedirlo. También probé su parfait de té verde y estaba delicioso. Cada ingrediente era de alta calidad y, una vez mezclados, puedes disfrutar plenamente de su sabor único. También probé su latte de matcha y su latte de hojicha. En particular, me encanta su latte de hojicha, ya que tiene un sabor muy distintivo y tostado. La dueña fue muy amable y respondió a todas nuestras preguntas. Sin duda, volveremos a probar otros tés con cafeína además del café.
text_en: As a huge fan of green tea ice cream, this is an essential place to visit. I love its charming design inside the café. Their green tea ice cream is excellent—not too sweet and very authentic. You can try it before ordering. I also tried their green tea parfait, and it was delicious. Every ingredient is of high quality, and once mixed together, you can fully enjoy its unique flavor. I also tried their matcha latte and hōchiku latte. In particular, I love their hōchiku latte—it has a very distinctive, roasted flavor. The owner was very kind and answered all our questions. Without a doubt, we will try other caffeinated teas in addition to coffee.
original: As a big fan of green tea ice cream, this is a must place to check out. I like their cute design inside of the cafe. Their green tea ice cream is so good, not too sweet and very authentic. You can try before you order. Tried their signature matches parfait and it was so good. Each ingredient was all good and after you mix it, you can totally enjoy the mixed flavor of them. I also tried their hot matcha kinako latte and hojicha latte. Specially I like their hojicha latte as it is very unique roasted tea taste. The owner lady was very kind so she explained every question we asked. Definitely we will go back for caffeinated teas other than coffee!

text: Estuvo bien, pero para ser honesto, era demasiado caro. Creo que todos los heladerías y establecimientos de helado ahora cobran de más. Estoy cansado de pagar el precio de un galón de helado por una o dos bolas. No tiene sentido en esta situación económica tan difícil en la que nos encontramos. Lo hice porque mi pareja estaba conmigo.
text_en: It was good, but to be honest, it was too expensive. I think all ice cream shops and establishments now charge more. I’m tired of paying the price of one or two scoops of ice cream for a whole gallon. It makes no sense in this difficult economic situation we’re in. I did it because my partner was with me.
original: It was good but quite frankly, too expensive. I think every ice cream and gelato shop is overpriced anymore. I'm tired of paying the price of a gallon of ice cream for a scoop or two. Doesn't make sense in this economic disaster we are just touching the tip of. Did it because my GD was with me.

text: I love Jarling's Custard. Every time I try something new, I'm never disappointed. A smooth, buttery finish with strong flavors, this place always serves the best. I usually get the coconut seasonal custard, peach cobbler snowstorm, strawberry cheesecake snowstorm, coffee/espresso snowstorm or grasshopper (mint chocolate) snowstorm. Everything here tastes divine, so don't be afraid to experiment! Also, junior cups are huge, so order in moderation.
text_en: I love Jarling's Custard. Every time I try something new, I'm never disappointed. A smooth, buttery finish with strong flavors, this place always serves the best. I usually get the coconut seasonal custard, peach cobbler snowstorm, strawberry cheesecake snowstorm, coffee/espresso snowstorm or grasshopper (mint chocolate) snowstorm. Everything here tastes divine, so don't be afraid to experiment! Also, junior cups are huge, so order in moderation.

text: Fun little spot in Downtown Phoenix. Great ice cream with some interesting flavors.
text_en: Fun little spot in Downtown Phoenix. Great ice cream with some interesting flavors.

text: Meu Deus, que maravilha! E o bolo de farinha também! Adorei o cheesecake! O caranguejo não me agradou... nem o bolo de cenoura, nem o de veludo vermelho.
text_en: Oh my God, what a wonder! And the flour cake too! I loved the cheesecake! The crab wasn’t my favorite… neither was the carrot cake, nor the red velvet cake.
original: Holy Canoli! And crumb cake! Also loved the cheesecake! Lobster tail didn't do it for me...neither did the carrot cake or red velvet.

text: Quem pagaria US$ 4 por um biscoito acima da média? EU. O biscoito de compostagem foi muito recomendado. Eles o aqueceram para que fosse macio e pegajoso por dentro, mantendo uma borda crocante. No geral, estava delicioso, mas apenas "ok". O preço o tornou um pouco inviável. Se eu voltasse, provavelmente experimentaria o conjunto "melhor de todos", para poder experimentar um pouco de tudo. Além disso, eles abrem tarde, então, se você tiver vontade de comer doces, pule os biscoitos e vá à Milk Bar.
text_en: Who would pay $4 for a cookie that’s above average? Me. The composted cookies were highly recommended. They were heated so that they became soft and sticky on the inside, while still having a crispy edge. Overall, it was delicious, but just “okay”. The price makes it a bit unaffordable. If I went back, I would probably try the “best of all” set, so I can try a variety of things. Also, they open late, so if you want to eat sweets, skip the cookies and go to the Milk Bar instead.
original: Who pays $4 for an above average cookie? THIS GIRL. The compost cookie was highly recommended. They warmed it up so it was soft and gooey on the inside while maintaining a crispy outer edge. Overall, it was delicious but just OK. The price made it kind of not worth it. If I was to return, I'd probably try the all time best set so you can try a bit of everything. Also, they open late so if you have any sweet tooth cravings skip the bars and check out the Milk Bar.

text: No momento desta avaliação, este lugar surpreendentemente não tem fila de espera. Eles têm muitos itens excelentes aqui. Os meus favoritos foram o donut de bacon com maple, com uma massa super macia no meio, e o sorvete em cone de churro. Ambos foram incrivelmente deliciosos. Faça um favor a si mesmo e vá a Las Vegas por isso. Faça isso agora. Por favor.
text_en: At this time of the evaluation, surprisingly, there is no waiting line at this place. They have many excellent items here. My favorites were the bacon donut with maple syrup, with a super soft center, and the churro cone ice cream. Both were incredibly delicious. Please do yourself a favor and go to Las Vegas for this. Do it now. Please.

text: Fui à loja Sprinkles no dia da inauguração. Sinto-me muito sortudo(a) porque achei que a loja já estava aberta há algum tempo. Acredito que fiquei na fila por cerca de 20 minutos (talvez menos). Enquanto esperava na fila, havia funcionários prontos para entregar o cardápio de sabores e responder a quaisquer perguntas. Fui lá por volta das 14h (a Holly Madison estava presente para abrir a máquina de cupcakes). Conversei com cerca de 3 funcionários enquanto esperava na fila, e a fila não era muito longa. Tive a oportunidade de obter informações detalhadas sobre os sabores dos cupcakes, o que foi útil. Os funcionários são realmente simpáticos e prestativos. Esta foi a minha primeira vez em qualquer loja Sprinkles. Achei que a decoração, tanto dentro quanto fora do prédio, era agradável. Há uma área de descanso ao ar livre. Duas portas separadas: uma para quem deseja comprar cupcakes e outra para sorvetes. A fila para os cupcakes era mais longa do que a fila para os sorvetes. Gostei muito da ideia de receber o cardápio de sabores (consegui decidir quais sabores queria enquanto esperava). Comprei 4 cupcakes: Black & White, Morango, Limão com Coco e Baunilha. Eles têm itens com ou sem confeitos. Cada cupcake custa US$ 3,75. Se você comprar 4 cupcakes, o preço é US$ 15. Eles também vendem os cupcakes em dúzia, que custam US$ 24 (acho que é esse o preço). Antes de o funcionário anotar seu pedido, há uma vitrine com os itens que estão sendo vendidos naquele dia (o cardápio de sabores também informa quais itens estão disponíveis naquele dia, para que você não tenha expectativas excessivas). Adoro que o bolo não seja muito doce e que seja macio e úmido. Também não há muita cobertura, como em outros lugares que vendem cupcakes. Meu sabor favorito é o Limão com Coco: o bolo de limão e a cobertura de coco têm um sabor equilibrado; nenhum dos sabores é muito forte (adorei!). Se você gosta de limão, é definitivamente uma experiência que vale a pena. Também adoro que os sabores não sejam muito intensos, mas que você saiba que estão presentes. Um cupcake perfeito. Raramente digo isso sobre qualquer lugar que vende cupcakes ou sobremesas, pois eu mesmo(a) faço bolos e não gosto de sobremesas muito doces. Eles têm colheres e facas de madeira fofas que você pode comprar antes de sair da loja (AMEI!). Eles também vendem a mistura para fazer cupcakes e camisetas. Estava pensando em comprar a mistura de cupcakes enquanto esperava na fila, mas descobri rapidamente que cada mistura custa US$ 15. Acho que faz sentido, já que Sprinkles é praticamente uma marca. Decidi não comprar a mistura de cupcakes. Estacionei gratuitamente no Flamingo Casino, que fica a uma curta distância a pé do The Linq. Não tenho certeza se o The Linq tem sua própria garagem/estacionamento. Eles aceitam cartões de crédito, como na maioria dos locais de Las Vegas. Eles aceitam Amex.
text_en: I went to Sprinkles store on the opening day. I feel very lucky because I thought the store was already open for some time. I believe I waited in line for about 20 minutes (maybe less). While waiting in line, there were staff members who were ready to give me information about the flavors and answer any questions. I arrived around 2 p.m. (Holly Madison was there to start serving cupcakes). I talked with about 3 staff members while waiting, and the line wasn’t very long. I got detailed information about the cupcakes’ flavors, which was helpful. The staff are really friendly and helpful. This was my first time visiting any Sprinkles store. I thought the decor, both inside and outside the building, was nice. There’s an outdoor rest area. Two separate doors: one for buying cupcakes, and another for ice cream. The line for cupcakes was longer than the line for ice cream. I really liked getting to see the menu before ordering (I could decide which flavors I wanted while waiting). I bought 4 cupcakes: Black & White, Strawberry, Lemon with Coco, and Vanilla. They have options with or without frosting. Each cupcake costs $3.75. If you buy 4 cupcakes, it’s $15. They also sell cupcakes in sets of 12, which cost $24 (I think that’s the price). Before the staff writes down your order, there’s a display showing what’s being sold that day (the menu also indicates which items are available that day, so you won’t have too many expectations). I like that the cake isn’t too sweet and is soft and moist. There isn’t much frosting either, like in other places that sell cupcakes. My favorite flavor is Lemon with Coco: the lemon cake and coconut frosting have a balanced taste; none of the flavors are too strong (I love it!). If you like lemon, it’s definitely worth trying. I also like that the flavors aren’t too intense, but you know they’re there. A perfect cupcake. I rarely say this about any place that sells cupcakes or desserts, because I make cakes myself and don’t like very sweet desserts. They have cute wooden spoons and knives you can buy before leaving the store (I LOVE IT!). They also sell cupcake mix and t-shirts. I was thinking of buying the cupcake mix while waiting, but I quickly found out that each mix costs $15. I think it makes sense, since Sprinkles is basically a brand. I decided not to buy the cupcake mix. I parked free at Flamingo Casino, which is a short walk from The Linq. I’m not sure if The Linq has its own parking lot. They accept credit cards, like most places in Las Vegas. They also accept Amex.

text: Siempre comienzo mis reseñas informando a la gente que soy un chef y panadero con gran talento, así que conozco bien la buena comida, por eso decidí empezar a reseñar restaurantes. Amélie es una panadería completamente sobrevalorada, que ofrece pasteles y productos de panadería franceses. Lo que más me molesta es el precio de sus macarons, en particular. Como panadero, sé cuánto cuesta elaborarlos, y aun así, NO deberían costar más de 2,00 dólares la unidad. Eso es absurdo. Además, tienen muchos sabores, pero muy pocos de ellos tienen un sabor que vaya más allá del azúcar, lo que, para mí, significa que están escatimeando en los extractos y los ingredientes que dan sabor. Dicho esto, su tarta de lima es realmente muy buena, una de las mejores que he probado. También creo que sus pasteles también son bastante buenos. El resto, simplemente, está "bien".
text_en: I always start my reviews by telling people that I’m a talented chef and baker, so I know well about good food. That’s why I decided to start reviewing restaurants. Amélie is a bakery that’s completely overpriced; it offers French pastries and bakery products. What bothers me the most is the price of its macarons. As a baker, I know how much it costs to make them, and yet they shouldn’t cost more than $2.00 per unit. That’s absurd. Additionally, they have many flavors, but very few of them have a taste that goes beyond sugar. In my opinion, this means they’re cutting back on the extracts and ingredients that give them flavor. Still, their lime tart is really good—one of the best I’ve tried. I also think their pastries are pretty good too. The rest just isn’t great.

Now,I am a pastry chef and know the cost to make them and even still they should NOT BE over $2.00 a piece. That is absurd. In addition, they have many flavors but very few of them taste like anything more than sugar,which to me means they're skimping on the extracts and flavor associated ingredients. With that being said, Their key lime tart is really good, one of the best I've ever tasted. I believe their cake pastries are pretty good also. Everything else is "okay".

text: Only two stars, because the fact is that yes, I have experienced better than the pastries at the Las Vegas Bouchon Bakery. The best of what I sampled was the chocolate croissant: it had two ribbons of chocolate in it, which was quite nice. However, the pastry was just a bit too tough when it should have been tender, and it was too greasy. I also took tastes of four different macaron flavors: chocolate, vanilla, raspberry and lemon. The chocolate was far and away the best of the four, but it was more like a brownie than a macaron. The weakest were the raspberry and lemon, which had too much oozy filling. Worst of what I tried: the pain au raisin. Pain au raisin is supposed to be a custard raisin roll, not a raisin danish. Flat, extremely greasy... I will only grudgingly acknowledge that there were enough raisins and that they were soft and tender, but that couldn't salvage the thing. I don't know, maybe I'm holding this place to unfairly high standards, but I know that pastry can be better.
