text: Inicialmente, no me interesaba Donut Bar hasta que probé el donut de crema bruleé. Es vegano, y no lo sabía hasta que alguien me lo comentó la segunda o tercera vez que lo pedí. Ahora, suelo venir aquí desde mi oficina al menos una vez a la semana. Puede que necesite probar varios tipos, ya que tienen una gran variedad, pero seguro que encontraré al menos un donut que me encante. Lo que realmente me hace volver es el café. El café y los donuts son como el mantequilla de cacahuete y las mermeladas. Tienen café caliente de goteo que es excelente, y también ofrecen opciones de café frío de alta calidad.
text_en: Initially, I wasn’t interested in Donut Bar until I tried the melted cream donut. It’s vegan, and I didn’t know that until someone told me that the second or third time I ordered it. Now, I usually come here at least once a week from my office. Maybe I need to try several types, as they have a wide variety. But I’m sure I’ll find at least one donut that I really love. What really makes me return is the coffee. Coffee and donuts are like peanut butter and jams—they have excellent hot coffee that drips out, and they also offer high-quality cold coffee options.
original: I was indifferent towards Donut Bar until I tried the creme brulee donut. It's vegan and I had no idea until someone told me the second or third time I ordered it. I end up walking here from my office at least once a week now. It might take a few tries because there is such a large selection, but this place will have at least one donut you'll love. The coffee is what keeps me coming back though. Coffee & donuts are like peanut butter & jelly! There's hot self-serve drip coffee that is solid and the cold brews are on point.

text: Cada vez que estoy en Las Vegas, necesito conseguir sus raciones de langosta. Me enamoré de ellas en Nueva York, y desde entonces, cada vez que estoy en una ciudad que tenga la panadería de Carlos, no puedo resistirme a comprarlas, una, dos o incluso más... Son las mejores que he probado, la concha es muy crujiente y no tiene nada de dulce, así que combinan muy bien con el relleno de los pasteles, que es ligero y delicioso. No soy muy fan de sus cannolis ni de otros productos. Para mí, solo importa la ración de langosta. Es una delicia.
text_en: Every time I’m in Las Vegas, I need to get their lobster servings. I fell in love with them in New York, and since then, whenever I’m in a city that has Carlos’s bakery, I can’t help but buy them—one, two, or even more… They’re the best ones I’ve tried. The shell is very crispy and not sweet at all, so they go well with the light and delicious filling in the cakes. I’m not very fond of their cannoli or other products. For me, it’s just about the lobster servings. It’s a delight.
original: Every time I'm in Vegas, i need to get their lobster tails. I failed in love with them in NY and since then, whenever I'm in a city that has Carlos bakery, I can't resist to get one, or two or maybe more... These are the best I ever had, the shell is very crunchy and not sweet at all, so it goes very well with the pastry filling that is light and delicious. I'm not a fan of theirs cannolis and other items. For me it's just the lobster tail. It's a bomb.

text: ¡Guau, este helado es delicioso! Me encantan todas las opciones del menú. Las porciones son generosas y el personal es muy amable. ¡Definitivamente volveré!
text_en: Wow, this ice cream is delicious! I love all the options on the menu. The portions are generous, and the staff is very friendly. I will definitely come back!
original: OMG this ice cream is so delicious! Love all the menu options. Portions were nice and so were the employees! Definitely coming back here!

text: Já visitei esta padaria várias vezes e sempre estou satisfeito com o meu pedido. Gosto muito do ambiente do local, embora seria interessante ter mais vagas de estacionamento. Adoro o bolo de cenoura e os biscoitos de amendoim, assim como os scones.
text_en: I’ve visited this bakery several times, and I’m always satisfied with my orders. I really enjoy the atmosphere at the place, although it would be nice to have more parking spaces. I love the carrot cake, peanut cookies, and scones.
original: I've been to this bakery many times and I am always satisfied with my order. I really like the aesthetic of the location, however it could use some more parking. I really enjoy the carrot cake and peanut cookies as well as the scones.

text: He ido a Novel muchísimas veces, considerando que la tienda no lleva mucho tiempo abierta. Novel es una pequeña y deliciosa heladería/tienda de donuts, muy cerca de mi casa. Ofrecen una variedad decente de sabores que cambian con frecuencia. Su helado es realmente delicioso... incluso los sabores más sencillos son excelentes (el de vainilla es increíble... el de fresa sabe a fresas frescas). Mi sabor favorito es el "Fat Elvis": bacon y mantequilla de cacahuete, ¡una combinación deliciosa! Mi única preocupación es que no me dicen de dónde obtienen su helado... no elaboran ni el helado ni los donuts en la tienda, y cuando les preguntan, dicen que los compran a una persona local que no quiere revelar su identidad. Eso es un poco... extraño. Además, el helado es bueno... la masa de los donuts es increíblemente buena (y a mí, personalmente, no me gustan mucho los donuts)... A mi esposo le gustan los "Leslie Knops". Los precios son razonables (5 dólares por un "Leslie Knop", que incluye dos sabores de helado y un topping). He traído a muchos amigos aquí y recomiendo que también los prueben.
text_en: I’ve been to Novel many times, considering that the store hasn’t been open for very long. Novel is a small and delicious ice cream/donut shop, located very close to my house. They offer a decent variety of flavors that change frequently. Their ice cream is really delicious… even the simplest flavors are excellent (vanilla flavor is incredible… strawberry flavor tastes like fresh strawberries). My favorite flavor is “Fat Elvis”: bacon and peanut butter—a delicious combination! My only concern is that they don’t tell us where their ice cream comes from… they don’t make either the ice cream or the donuts in the store, and when asked, they say they buy them from a local person who doesn’t want to reveal their identity. That’s a bit… strange. Besides, the ice cream is good… the dough for the donuts is incredibly good too (and personally, I don’t really like donuts very much…). My husband likes “Leslie Knops”. The prices are reasonable (5 dollars for a “Leslie Knop”, which includes two ice cream flavors and a topping). I’ve brought many friends here, and I recommend they try it too.
original: I have been to Novel an embarrassing amount of times given that they have not been open very long. Novel is a dangerously tasty little ice cream/donut shop that is close to my house. They have a decent variety of flavors that change frequently. Their ice cream is super tasty...even their simple flavors are great (the vanilla is awesome....the strawberry tasted like fresh strawberries). My fave flavor is the fat Elvis.... Bacon and peanut butter wonderfulness. My one problem? They won't tell me who sources their ice cream...they don't make their ice cream or donuts in house and when asked they will report that they get them from a local person who does not want them to share their identity. That's a little..... weird. Beyond that, the ice cream is good....the dough melt is crazy good (and I don't even particularly like donuts).... The husband likes the Leslie knope.... The prices are fair (5$ for the dough melt in which you can get two different flavors of ice cream and a topping). I have brought many friends here and recommend you also give them a try.

text: ¡Por fin! Un lugar abierto las 24 horas en Charlotte. Me lo recomendó una amiga, y estoy muy contenta de que lo haya hecho. Vengo a Amelie's una vez a la semana para reunirme con amigas, tomar café y disfrutar de deliciosos (y contundentes) pasteles y postres. Me encanta que esté siempre abierto y que los empleados sean increíblemente amables y serviciales. Ofrecen una gran variedad de postres y pasteles recién horneados. También tienen pan, sándwiches y sopas. Hace unas semanas compré una baguette y, al día siguiente, ¡ya no estaba! Es un lugar realmente único y divertido para ir con amigas. Siempre están ocupados, así que prepárense para esperar en la fila, pero definitivamente vale la pena. Una advertencia: aunque todo se elabora en la panadería y está disponible las 24 horas, no todo es tan fresco como parece. Los pasteles se refrigeran para mantenerlos frescos y fríos, lo que puede dificultar su consumo y no siempre resultar muy agradable. Probablemente evitaría esos pasteles, a menos que vea que salen de la panadería y sepa que han sido hechos recientemente. Recomiendo los tartas y los pequeños pasteles. Ofrecen una gran variedad de postres pequeños, así que es fácil y económico probar muchas cosas a la vez sin sentir que se están excediendo. Amelies definitivamente vale la pena el viaje, incluso si solo se trata de detenerse para tomar un café.
text_en: Finally! A 24-hour open place in Charlotte. A friend recommended it to me, and I’m very glad she did. I go to Amelie’s once a week to meet up with friends, have coffee, and enjoy delicious (and hearty) cakes and desserts. I love that it’s always open, and that the staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. They offer a wide variety of freshly baked cakes and desserts. There’s also bread, sandwiches, and soups. A few weeks ago, I bought a baguette, but the next day, it wasn’t there anymore! It’s a really unique and fun place to visit with friends. They’re always busy, so be prepared to wait in line, but it’s definitely worth it. One warning: although everything is made in the bakery and available 24 hours a day, not all items are as fresh as they seem. The cakes are refrigerated to keep them fresh and cold, which may make it difficult to eat them right away and not always pleasant. I would probably avoid those cakes unless I see them coming out of the bakery and know they were made recently. I recommend the tarts and small cakes. They offer a lot of small desserts, so it’s easy and affordable to try many things at once without feeling overwhelmed. Amelie’s is definitely worth the trip, even if it’s just for a coffee break.
original: Finally! A 24 hour joint in Charlotte! I was introduced to Amelie's by a friend of mine and I am thrilled she did. I go to Amelie's once a week to catch up with girlfriends over coffee and delicious (and fattening) pastries and desserts. I adore the fact that it is always open and the employees are incredibly nice and helpful. They carry a wide variety of desserts and fresh pastries. They also carry breads, sandwiches and soups. I brought home a baguette a few weeks ago and by morning, it was no where to be found! It is a really unique and fun place to go with friends. They are constantly busy so be prepared to stand in line but it is definitely worth the wait. A word of caution: even though everything is made in the bakery and around the clock, not everything is as fresh as you think it might be. The cakes are refrigerated to keep fresh and cool which can make it difficult to eat and not always very enjoyable. I would probably stay away from those unless you see it come out and you know it was made recently. I recommend the tarts and the tea cakes. They offer quite a few mini desserts so it's easy and cheap to try many things at once without feeling like a gluttoness pig who just lost all their money. Amelies is definitely worth the trip even if it's just to stop in for a cup of coffee!

text: I heard about their cupcake ATM machine, and wanted to come here just to try it. But changed my mind when I saw that they had ice cream cookie sandwiches. I got the chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream in between two warmed up chocolate chip cookies, and it was wonderful.
text_en: I heard about their cupcake ATM machine, and wanted to come here just to try it. But changed my mind when I saw that they had ice cream cookie sandwiches. I got the chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream in between two warmed up chocolate chip cookies, and it was wonderful.

text: Um ótimo lugar para um primeiro encontro, com uma atmosfera externa incrível. Gosto do sorvete do Cookie Monster e do amplo espaço.
text_en: A great place for a first meeting, with an amazing external atmosphere. I like the ice cream of Cookie Monster and the spacious area.
original: Great place for a first date and has such an amazing outdoor vibe, I like the Cookie Monster ice cream and the big open area

text: Vi o jogo de "pular corda" no mercado de agricultores no ano passado e comprei mel de lavanda e bolo de bebê na sua barraca. Gostei do mel, mas não gostei do bolo de bebê. Agora, depois de um ano, pensei em experimentar novamente, pois descobri que a barraca ficava dentro de um mercado de arte. Comprei barra de caramelo de nozes, brownie, bolo de bebê com champanhe e bolo de manteiga pegajoso. Queria experimentar alguns antes de escrever uma avaliação. Minha avaliação de cada item é a seguinte: Barra de caramelo de nozes (2/5): não era excessivamente doce, o que eu gostei. Tinha uma boa quantidade de nozes. Mas, o sabor geral não era muito bom. Brownie (3/5): novamente, não era muito doce, tinha um sabor mais amargo. Gostei do caramelo por cima. No geral, estava bom. Bolo de bebê com champanhe (2/5): muito doce, não era úmido, parecia pesado. Bolo de manteiga pegajoso (1/5): extremamente doce. E essa era a única coisa que eu conseguia sentir. Não consegui comer mais do que uma mordida.
text_en: Last year, I saw the “rope skipping” game in the farmers’ market, and I bought lavender honey and baby cake from their tent. I liked the honey, but I didn’t like the baby cake. Now, after a year, I thought about trying it again, as I found out that the tent was located inside an art market. I bought nut caramel bars, brownies, baby cake with champagne, and sticky butter cake. I wanted to try some of them before writing a review. My rating for each item is as follows: Nut caramel bars (2/5): It wasn’t overly sweet, which I liked. There was a good amount of nuts. But the overall taste wasn’t very good. Brownies (3/5): Again, not very sweet; it had a more bitter taste. I liked the caramel on top. Overall, it was okay. Baby cake with champagne (2/5): Very sweet, not moist, seemed heavy. Sticky butter cake (1/5): Extremely sweet. And that was the only thing I could feel. I couldn’t eat more than one bite.
original: I saw hopscotch at farmer's market last year and bought lavender honeycomb and baby cake from their stall. I liked the honeycomb but did not like baby cake. Now, after a year, I thought of trying it again as I found it located inside art mart. I bought walnut caramel bar, brownie, champagne baby cake and gooey butter cake. I wanted to try a few before writing a review. My review of each item is as follow: Walnut caramel bar(2/5): it was not overly sweet, which I liked. Had good amount of walnut. But, the overall taste was not that good. Brownie(3/5): again not too sweet, was more on bitter side. Liked the caramel on top. Overall, good. Champagne baby cake(2/5): too sweet, was not moist, felt heavy. Gooey butter cake(1/5): extremely sweet. And that's the only thing I could taste. I couldn't eat it more than one bite.

text: Sorvete gostoso. A doçura estava um pouco mais intensa do que o habitual, mas o sabor e a textura eram excelentes.
text_en: Delicious ice cream. The sweetness was a bit stronger than usual, but the flavor and texture were excellent.
original: Good ice cream, our choice was a bit sweeter than what we usually like, but it was flavorful and creamy.

text: El pastel estaba muy seco y carecía de un sabor notable. Normalmente no escribo reseñas, pero ese día tenía mucha necesidad de un buen trozo de pastel y me había desplazado bastante con grandes expectativas. Tal vez el pastel es mejor cuando se come con café o té, pero definitivamente no es ideal para satisfacer el deseo de un pastel jugoso.
text_en: The cake was very dry and lacked any distinctive flavor. Usually, I don’t write reviews, but that day I really needed a good piece of cake—I had traveled a long distance with high expectations. Maybe the cake is better when eaten with coffee or tea, but it certainly isn’t ideal for satisfying the desire for a moist, delicious cake.
original: The cake was very dry and lacked notable flavor. I typically don't review but I was really craving a good slice of cake that day and drove pretty far with high hopes. Perhaps the cake is best when eaten with coffee or tea, but certainly not for a moist cake fix.

text: Really cool ice cream shop...I had the Vietnamese coffee and Cookies and Mint...pretty, pretty, pretty good...
text_en: Really cool ice cream shop...I had the Vietnamese coffee and Cookies and Mint...pretty, pretty, pretty good...

text: Agradeço quando as empresas se esforçam para entrar em contato com clientes insatisfeitos! Não quero que as pessoas pensem que o sorvete da Ghirardelli não é bom, pois é delicioso... Uma experiência ruim não deve impedir que outros experimentem a qualidade. Experimente o famoso sundae com calda de chocolate quente, e você não se arrependerá.
text_en: I appreciate when companies make efforts to contact dissatisfied customers! I don’t want people to think that Ghirardelli ice cream isn’t good, because it’s delicious… A bad experience shouldn’t prevent others from enjoying its quality. Try the famous sundae with hot chocolate sauce, and you won’t regret it.
original: I appreciate when companies take the time to reach out to unsatisfied customers! I don't want ppl to think ghirardelli ice cream isn't good, cause it is... one bad cone shouldn't stop others to check out the greatness. Get the famous hot fudge sundae you won't be disappointed.

text: Considero que este é o melhor sorvete de Las Vegas, mas hoje pedi sorvete para retirar e nenhum dos funcionários estava usando máscara.
text_en: I think this is the best ice cream in Las Vegas, but today I ordered ice cream to take away, and none of the staff were wearing masks.
original: Best ice cream in Vegas hand down but I ordered ice cream for pick up today and none of the employees were wearing a mask .

text: Muito barato, e ainda mais delicioso! Eu pedi um milkshake de café com um pedaço de bolo de aniversário, e para completar, o atendente perguntou se eu gostaria que a canudinha fosse mergulhada em chocolate, e, é claro, respondi sim. Foi o milkshake mais delicioso que já experimentei, e ainda ganhei três chocolates que também eram incríveis. No final, tudo custou apenas seis dólares, o que é inacreditável, não é?
text_en: Very cheap, and even more delicious! I ordered a coffee milkshake with a piece of birthday cake. To finish, the staff asked if I would like the straw to be dipped in chocolate. Of course, I said yes. It was the most delicious milkshake I’ve ever had, and I also got three chocolates that were also amazing. In total, it cost only six dollars—that’s incredible, right?
original: Very cheap but even more so delicious I had a coffee toffee milkshake with a scoop of birthday cake and on top of that the man asked me if I wanted my straw dipped in chocolate and the answer to that was of course YES. This was the most delicious shake I have ever had plus I got three chocolates with it that we're also amazing and in the end it was only six dollars, crazy right?

text: ¡Delicioso, delicioso, delicioso! No es broma, es mi helado favorito... tienen alrededor de un millón de sabores... algunos con nombres extraños y sin descripciones... así que eso es un poco decepcionante... ¿y qué tal el sabor de "spouse in the house"? Pero la estación de galletas Graham es increíble. Me gustan las galletas Graham, pero nunca habría pensado que me gustaría como sabor de helado... pero después de ver a tanta gente hablar de ello, tuve que probarlo... ¡Increíble!
text_en: Delicious, delicious, delicious! It’s not a joke—it’s my favorite ice cream… there are around a million flavors… some with strange names and no descriptions… so that’s a bit disappointing… how about the “spouse in the house” flavor? But the Graham cookies are amazing. I like Graham cookies, but I never thought I would enjoy them as an ice cream flavor… but after seeing so many people talk about it, I had to try it… incredible!
original: Yum Yum Yum. No joke my fave ice cream... they have about a million flavors... some with obscure names and no descriptions... so thats kinda a bummer... what does "spouse in the house taste like?" but the graham central station is to die for. I like a good gram cracker... but would never think I wanted it as an ice cream flavor... but after seeing so many yelpers talk about it I had to try... A-Maz_ing!!!

text: Eu adoro o Sprinkles em Nova York, então fiquei muito feliz quando vi que abriram até tarde em Las Vegas, justamente quando eu estava com vontade de comer um cupcake. Eles também têm biscoitos e sorvete! A fila estava longa quando fomos às 22h, mas valeu a pena esperar. Seus cupcakes são um pouco maiores do que os tradicionais. A proporção entre a cobertura e o bolo é ótima. Tudo estava delicioso. Eles até tinham uma opção de "red velvet" sem glúten!
text_en: I love Sprinkles in New York, so I was very happy to see that they opened late in Las Vegas, right when I wanted to eat a cupcake. They also have cookies and ice cream! The line was long when we went at 10 PM, but it was worth waiting. Their cupcakes are a bit larger than the traditional ones. The ratio of frosting to cake is great. Everything was delicious. They even had a “red velvet” option without gluten!
original: I loooove Sprinkles in NYC so I was THRILLED to see one open late in LV just when I had the craving for a cupcake. They have cookies and ice cream too! The line was long when we went at 11pm but worth the wait. Their cupcakes are a little larger than your standard cupcake. Good icing to cake ratio. Everything tasted great. They even had a gluten free red velvet option!

text: Carlo's Bakery es muy conocido gracias a los programas de televisión, donde Buddy Valastro es conocido como el "Pasteler". La cola para entrar ya no es tan larga como hace unos años. Una vez dentro, se ve que Carlo's Bakery está dividido en una parte de tienda de regalos y otra de pastelería. Muchos estantes están llenos de camisetas y tazas de cerámica. Durante mi visita, no encontré ninguna barra o pan, y en mi visita la mayoría de los productos horneados eran cupcakes, galletas y algunos dulces italianos como los cannoli y los rollos de langosta. Compartimos un rollo de langosta con avellanas. La masa era extremadamente crujiente, como espagueti crudo. El interior estaba relleno de crema. Aunque no se reconocía como avellana, sí era cremosa. Le di tres estrellas porque, en general, es una pastelería bastante mediocre.
text_en: Carlo’s Bakery is very well-known thanks to television programs, where Buddy Valastro is known as the “Pasteler”. The queue to enter isn’t as long anymore as it used to be a few years ago. Once inside, it seems that Carlo’s Bakery is divided into a gift shop section and a bakery section. Many shelves are filled with T-shirts and ceramic mugs. During my visit, I didn’t find any bread or rolls; most of the baked goods were cupcakes, cookies, and some Italian desserts like cannoli and lobster rolls. We shared a lobster roll with walnuts. The dough was extremely crispy, like raw spaghetti. The inside was filled with cream. Although it wasn’t clearly identified as walnuts, it was still creamy. I gave it three stars because, overall, it’s a rather mediocre bakery.
original: Carlo's Bakery is well known from reality TV starring Buddy Valastro as the "Cake Boss." The line to get in isn't terrible anymore like it a couple years back. Once inside you see that Carlo's Bakery is half a gift shop and half bakery. You will see many of the shelves are stacked with T-Shirts and ceramic mugs. On my visit I didn't see any rolls or breads for sale and on my visit most of the baked goods were cupcakes, cookies and a few Italian treats like cannoli and lobster rolls. We shared a hazelnut lobster roll. The pastry was shatteringly crisp just like raw spaghetti. The inside was filled with cream. It wasn't recognizable as hazelnut but it was creamy. I gave three stars because it is a very average bakery at best.

text: Este lugar é incrível, de verdade! Já experimentei outras sorveterias locais, mas a "Churn" é a minha favorita. O interior é muito charmoso e o pátio é muito agradável.
text_en: This place is incredible, really! I’ve tried other local ice cream shops before, but “Churn” is my favorite. The interior is very charming, and the courtyard is also very pleasant.
original: This place is amazing lol truly. I've tried some other local ice cream shops but churn is my favorite. The inside is super cute and the patio is very relaxing.

text: May be the best ice cream in Las Vegas. Butter pecan is the best I've ever had. Expect a line, especially on a hot summer night. Tuesday still offers the $2.50 special.
text_en: May be the best ice cream in Las Vegas. Butter pecan is the best I've ever had. Expect a line, especially on a hot summer night. Tuesday still offers the $2.50 special.

text: There are a variety of pastries that you can choose from. They bake it there at their bakery. All pastries are individually wrapped. You take a tray and grab whatever you want and place it on the tray. Then, you stand in line to pay for it. They also have drinks and whole cakes that you could buy as well. I got a marble taro bun, guava strudel, and a Hokkaido custard. All where amazing! The marble taro bun was very soft and chewy! On the inside there's a thick taro filling that tasted so comforting! It went so well with the bread! The guava strudel was very tasty! The guava filling was strong and the breading on the outside was very flaky, crunchy and not too sweet. I wish there was more guava filling! But, it was yummy! The Hokkaido custard was delicious! It tasted like a milk cheesecake! It was soft and creamy and the crust was baked to perfection. Soft and crunchy at the same time. I definitely would get these items again. I will be back here to try the other pastries!
text_en: There are a variety of pastries that you can choose from. They bake it there at their bakery. All pastries are individually wrapped. You take a tray and grab whatever you want and place it on the tray. Then, you stand in line to pay for it. They also have drinks and whole cakes that you could buy as well. I got a marble taro bun, guava strudel, and a Hokkaido custard. All where amazing! The marble taro bun was very soft and chewy! On the inside there's a thick taro filling that tasted so comforting! It went so well with the bread! The guava strudel was very tasty! The guava filling was strong and the breading on the outside was very flaky, crunchy and not too sweet. I wish there was more guava filling! But, it was yummy! The Hokkaido custard was delicious! It tasted like a milk cheesecake! It was soft and creamy and the crust was baked to perfection. Soft and crunchy at the same time. I definitely would get these items again. I will be back here to try the other pastries!

text: We've had a lot of great treats at The Batch House since they've opened. The Oatmeal Creme Pie is my favorite sweet treat in Charlotte. The Oreo truffle cookie is to die for, too. Somehow I made it this far and didn't mention the s'mores brownie. If you ever want a great drink, try their Tres Leches latte! Easily our favorite spot for sweets in Charlotte.
text_en: We've had a lot of great treats at The Batch House since they've opened. The Oatmeal Creme Pie is my favorite sweet treat in Charlotte. The Oreo truffle cookie is to die for, too. Somehow I made it this far and didn't mention the s'mores brownie. If you ever want a great drink, try their Tres Leches latte! Easily our favorite spot for sweets in Charlotte.

text: Após uma noite na cidade, este é o local perfeito para tomar café às 6 da manhã. Delicioso! O melhor café e pães. Mesmo com a fila (que diminuiu rapidamente), a equipe foi muito atenciosa e prestativa.
text_en: After spending a night in the city, this is the perfect place to have coffee at 6 a.m. Delicious! The best coffee and bread. Even though there was a queue (which quickly decreased), the staff were very attentive and helpful.
original: After a night on the town this is a perfect 6am spot. Yummy Yummy Yummy. The best coffee and pastries. Even with the long line(which went fast) the staff was extra friendly and accommodating.

text: A Jeni's é exatamente o que Charlotte precisava. Está localizada no South End de Charlotte, que é uma área excelente, pois há muitos moradores e é uma região popular da cidade. O sorvete é absolutamente cremoso e suave, refrescante, saboroso e realmente delicioso. Há uma grande variedade de sabores, e eles são únicos. É bem diferente dos outros lugares de sorvete em Charlotte. A Jeni's é um pouco cara, mas você paga pela qualidade, e eu acho que vale muito a pena. Os cones de waffle são incríveis e são feitos na hora. Meu sabor favorito é o Brambleberry Crisp – você precisa experimentar, especialmente se gosta de frutas vermelhas. Definitivamente, experimente a Jeni's se estiver na área e procurando uma sobremesa gelada e deliciosa.
text_en: Jeni’s is exactly what Charlotte needed. It’s located in South End, a great area with many residents and a popular spot in the city. The ice cream is absolutely creamy and smooth, refreshing, tasty, and really delicious. There’s a wide variety of flavors, and they’re all unique. It’s completely different from other ice cream places in Charlotte. Jeni’s is a bit expensive, but you pay for the quality, and I think it’s well worth it. The waffle cones are amazing and made right away. My favorite flavor is Brambleberry Crisp – you really should try it, especially if you like red fruits. Definitely go to Jeni’s if you’re in the area and looking for a cold, delicious dessert.
original: Jeni's is just what Charlotte needed. It's in South End of Charlotte which is such a great location as there are many locals and is a popular area of Charlotte. The ice cream is absolutely creamy and smooth, refreshing, flavorful and truly splendid. There are soo many to choose from and the flavors are unique as well. Very much different from other ice cream places in Charlotte. Jeni's is pricey, but you pay for the quality and I think it's definitely worth the price. The waffle cones are amazing and they're freshly made. My favorite flavor is the Brambleberry Crisp- you have to try this, especially if you love berries. Definitely try Jeni's if you're in the area and looking for a cold/sweet treat.

text: One of the best ice creams I've ever had in my life! I've only tried the banana cream pie and they are very generous with the scooping!! Also the interior is beautiful and bright.

text: Já não é tão impressionante. A Tosi se libertou do gerenciamento ativo do local? Nas últimas duas visitas, percebi que a qualidade dos biscoitos realmente caiu – parece que despencaram do abismo do sabor. Considerando o preço dos doces cobrados, eu esperaria algo de melhor... não doces secos e de má qualidade para levar para casa. Até mesmo o sorvete que experimentei, não foi muito bom. No máximo!
text_en: It’s not as impressive anymore. Has Tosi gotten rid of active management of the place? In the last two visits, I noticed that the quality of the cookies really has declined – it seems like their taste has dropped significantly. Considering the price of the sweets offered, I would expect something better… not dry and poor-quality sweets to take home. Even the ice cream I tried wasn’t very good. Just okay!
original: No longer so impressive. Has Tosi released herself from active management of the LV place? From the last two visits, I feel that the quality of the cookies have really taken a fall-- like off the cliff of deliciousness. For the price of the desserts charged, I would expect better offerings.... not dry, bad QC wrapped desserts for take home. Even the soft serve thing I tried, meh. At best!

text: Parei aqui hoje à noite e adorei! Experimentei um "dough-melt" com sorvete de "Cookie Monster" e "Fruity Pebbles" – estava delicioso. O local é bem charmoso, em um cantinho agradável no Third Space. Há bastante espaço ao ar livre para sentar.
text_en: I stopped here tonight and I loved it! I tried a “dough-melt” with Cookie Monster ice cream and Fruity Pebbles – it was delicious. The place is very charming, in a nice little spot at Third Space. There’s plenty of outdoor space to sit in.
original: Stopped here tonight and really enjoyed it! I got a dough-melt with cookie monster ice cream and fruity pebbles - so good. It's located in a cute little spot in Third Space. Lots of outdoor seating.

text: I came here pretty excited, you know reading the reviews and all. The parking lot is really small in front but there are more in the back. The ice cream shop is shared by a restaurant which is called the Windsor. The decoration is really beautiful and feels just like those old candy shops where they have sweets everywhere! Anyways I started sampling ice creams and they were just okay. Surprisingly I really didn't like any of them. They were creamy, sweet but the flavor just really wasn't there. I understand everyone's fascination with this place so I am definitely in the minority but I really didn't like this ice cream shop as much as I thought I would

text: Sorvete de goiaba e morango. Delicioso! Os morangos são tão frescos e saborosos que parecem ter sido colhidos diretamente do jardim hoje. O local está em um pequeno centro comercial tranquilo, mas fácil de encontrar, com estacionamento fácil e uma equipe muito atenciosa. Voltaremos!
text_en: Goiaba and strawberry ice cream. Delicious! The strawberries are so fresh and tasty—it seems like they were picked directly from the garden today. The place is in a quiet small shopping center, but it’s easy to find. There’s plenty of parking, and the staff is very attentive. We’ll come back!
original: Strawberry Guava Sorbet. Yum. The strawberry is so fresh and flavorful that it tastes like they were picked out of a garden today. The location is in a quiet small strip mall, but easily found, easy parking, super nice staff. We'll be back!

text: This was such a cute little ice cream place, although it was a little difficult to get to because there was construction on the nearby roads! I really liked the swirly mural on the exterior of the building. The interior isn't anything special and very tiny -- no places to sit inside (there were several outdoor tables though), which was disappointing because it was 110 degrees outside. The ice cream: The flavor selection was definitely varied and featured several unusual flavors, like Thai tea, fruity pebbles, and ricanelas. I got the fruity pebbles and red, white, and blue sky (I visited on July 5th -- it consisted of strawberry, blueberry, and lemon) flavors and both were awesome! I especially liked the fruity pebbles one because it reminded me of eating cereal as a kid. The red, white, and blue sky was also delicious and not overpoweringly fruity, which was nice. My mom said that the ricanelas and Thai tea flavors were good, although she was miffed because the female cashier gave her less ice cream than the male one did! Side note: The male server was very friendly! My dad got the blueberry muffin flavor, which wasn't anything special, and my brother got the chocolate and cherry flavors, which he said were good! Presentation: I thought it was cute how they serve ice cream in Chinese takeout containers with fortune cookies instead of the standard cup! I found it kept the ice cream from spilling as much as it does when it's in a cup and the servers can be more generous in portion sizes. Price: For a double scoop, it was $5.25, which isn't too bad for such cool flavors! I would definitely come back!

text: Este lugar prepara sorvete caseiro e fresco diariamente, com combinações únicas, além de cones de waffle feitos em casa. Cinco estrelas não são suficientes para descrever a experiência. Eu daria facilmente seis. Escolhi os sabores de taro e crumble de rabodelo. Eles também oferecem opções sem lactose (tiveram quatro disponíveis neste momento). Sou de Utah e só posso desejar que tivéssemos uma réplica deste lugar onde morava. Equipe muito simpática, atendimento ao cliente excelente, com Jesse (não o Jesse Mason), e transações fáceis. O sorvete é clássico e incrivelmente delicioso. Não é muito doce e tem o sabor certo para satisfazer o paladar. O ambiente combina elementos nostálgicos, tradicionais e modernos.
text_en: This place prepares homemade, fresh ice cream every day, with unique combinations, as well as homemade waffle cones. Five stars aren’t enough to describe the experience. I would easily give six stars. I chose the taro and crumble rabodelo flavors. They also offer lactose-free options (there were four available at this time). I’m from Utah, and I just wish we had a replica of this place where I used to live. The staff is very friendly, customer service is excellent—especially Jesse (not Jesse Mason), and transactions are easy. The ice cream is classic and incredibly delicious. It isn’t too sweet, and it has the right taste to satisfy the palate. The atmosphere combines nostalgic, traditional, and modern elements.
original: This place makes homemade fresh ice cream with unique blends everyday, along with homemade waffle cones. Five stars isn't enough of a rating. I'd easily give it six. I chose the Taro and Rhubarb Streusel flavors. They also serve dairy free options (they had four at this particular time). I'm from Utah and I can only wish that we had a replica of this place where I lived. Super friendly staff, superior customer service by Jesse (not the Mason Jesse), and easy transactions. The ice cream is classic and beyond delicious. It is not too sweet and has the right amount of flavor to satisfy your palette. The atmosphere is a combination of nostalgic, traditional, and trendy.

text: Um ótimo lugar para sorvete, com muitas opções de sabores. Também oferecem itens especiais como "banana splits", "milkshakes", "floats", "malts" e "showboats". O atendimento foi rápido e atencioso. O ambiente era limpo e agradável. Os preços são razoáveis e o sorvete estava delicioso!
text_en: A great place for ice cream, with many flavor options. They also offer special items like “banana splits,” “milkshakes,” “floats,” “malts,” and “showboats.” The service was quick and attentive. The atmosphere was clean and pleasant. The prices are reasonable, and the ice cream was delicious!
original: Great Ol' Fashion Ice Cream lots ice cream flavors to choose from. They also have specialty items like banana splits, shakes, floats, malts, and showboats. Service was fast and friendly. Dining area was clean and inviting. Prices are reasonable and ice cream was yummy!

text: The best ice cream I've ever had. Not sickeningly sweet, exquisitely creamy, and creative flavors to boot. It's a great place to stop on the way home out of the downtown area. The dough melt is a must-have.

text: Extrañaba mi donut favorito, uno simple relleno de crema de arce y con cobertura de chocolate. Después de leer todas las reseñas positivas sobre Jack Frost aquí, mi pareja y yo fuimos esta mañana a comprar una docena y disfrutar de nuestra "adicción" por el azúcar. Esperaba encontrar mi donut favorito perdido, pero, lamentablemente, no lo encontré. No etiquetan nada, lo cual era lo que esperaba, pero aunque no estaban muy concurridas, fueron muy rápidas y eficientes, lo que nos hizo sentir que querían nuestro pedido y que nos quisieran sacar rápidamente, así que no hicimos muchas preguntas. En resumen, estos donuts son buenos. No son excepcionales, pero son buenos. El único problema que tuvimos es que sus donuts "rellenos" no están realmente rellenos. Simplemente no hacen agujeros y no ponen relleno encima. Nosotros no somos fans. Yo pedí uno relleno de crema de arce, y efectivamente, estaba cubierto con crema blanca. Había tanta crema que tuve que quitar la mitad para poder comérmelo. El otro que me comí fue un donut de bizcocho con cobertura de chocolate, que era mi otro favorito, y estaba bueno, pero los que puedo conseguir en Sheetz son igual de buenos, al menos para mí. En cualquier caso, probablemente buscaremos otra panadería que se adapte mejor a nuestros gustos, pero son mejores que Dunkin, y además, tenemos más opciones.
text_en: I missed my favorite donut—a simple one filled with maple cream and topped with chocolate frosting. After reading all the positive reviews about Jack Frost here, my partner and I went shopping this morning to get a dozen of them and enjoy our “sugar addiction.” I hoped to find my favorite donut, but unfortunately, I didn’t find it. They don’t label anything, which was what I expected, but even though they weren’t very crowded, they were quick and efficient, which made us feel like they really wanted our order and wanted to get it out quickly. So we didn’t ask many questions. In short, these donuts are good. They’re not exceptional, but they’re fine. The only problem is that their “filled” donuts aren’t really filled at all. They just don’t make holes and don’t put any filling on top. We’re not fans of that. I ordered a donut filled with maple cream, and indeed, it was covered in white cream. There was so much cream that I had to remove half of it to be able to eat it. The other donut I ate was a chocolate-frosted cake donut, which is my other favorite. It was good, but the ones I can get at Sheetz are just as good, at least for me. Anyway, we might look for another bakery that suits our tastes better, but they’re better than Dunkin, and we have more options too.
original: I have been missing my favorite donut, a simple maple creme filled, chocolate iced. Seeing all the rave reviews about Jack Frost on here, the significant other and I headed over this morning to grab a dozen and enjoy our sugar comas, i was hoping to find my long lost favorite, but alas, i did not. They don't label anything which I was expecting but even though they really weren't busy, they were very brisk with us, making us feel like they wanted our order and to get us out, so we didn't ask more than one or two questions. Now, aside from that, these are good donuts. Nothing to write home about, but good donuts. The one big problem we had is that their "filled" donuts are not filled at all. They just don't punch holes in them and glob filling on top. We are not fans. I had a maple ceme filled, mind you it was maple frosted with white creme piled on top. So much cream I had to knock half of it off to be able to stomach it. The other I ate was a chocolate glazed cake donut, my other favorite, and it was good, but the ones I can get at sheetz are just as good IMO. Either way, we'll probably look for another donut shop that suits our tastes better, but they are better than dunkin and you really do have better choices as well.

text: Este pode ser o segredo mais bem guardado no centro de Phoenix! Meu filho nos levou lá e, desde então, voltamos várias vezes. Provavelmente já fomos mais de 10 vezes nas últimas 2 semanas. Eles afirmam ter um "chef de sorvete"... e eu acho que é verdade... o sorvete é extraordinário. É difícil descrever aqui... sugiro que você vá lá e experimente se estiver na região.
text_en: This might be the best-kept secret in Phoenix! My son took us there, and since then, we’ve gone several times. Probably we’ve been there more than 10 times in the past two weeks. They say they have a “ice cream chef”… and I think it’s true… the ice cream is amazing. It’s hard to describe here… I suggest you go there and try it if you’re in the area.
original: This may be the best kept secret downtown Phoenix! My son brought us over there and we've been hooked ever since. We've probably been back over 10 times now in the last 2 months. These guys claim they have an "ice cream chef" .. i sort of believe it...the ice cream is extraordinary. Its too hard to describe here...i suggest you just go there and check them out if you're in the area.

text: He venido aquí unas diez veces. Seis veces solo para tomar un café, y cuatro para comprar los donuts. No entiendo. Intento, intento, intento, pero no puedo emocionarme con ellos. Vimos aquí cuando abrieron por primera vez y pensé: "No tienen las temperaturas/medidas convertidas a la altitud de Las Vegas", ya que es una tienda con sede en San Diego, si no recuerdo bien. Si pides un donut simple, que no esté relleno ni con galleta, todos están secos:(. Lo peor es que son muy caros. Un donut simple cuesta $2. En cualquier otro lugar, un donut con glaseado cuesta 0,99 dólares o menos. Cuanto más "creativos" son, más caros se vuelven. El donut de tostadas francesas es realmente bueno, pero no necesita jarabe ni cobertura adicional de arándanos, ya que el donut ya está cubierto de azúcar en polvo Y glaseado. Cuando tienes mucha hambre, creo que es perfecto. El único otro punto a favor es su café Kona de avellanas, del que creo que encontré el mismo en línea, así que puedo evitar el viaje, el pago del estacionamiento y la decepción de los donuts secos.
text_en: He’s come here about ten times. Six times just to get a coffee, and four times to buy donuts. I don’t understand it. I try, but I can’t get excited about them. We saw this store when it opened for the first time, and I thought, “Their temperatures/measures aren’t adjusted for Las Vegas’ altitude.” After all, it’s a store based in San Diego, if I remember correctly. If you order a plain donut—one that isn’t filled or covered with cookie dough—all of them are dry:(. The worst part is that they’re very expensive. A plain donut costs $2. In any other place, a donut with frosting costs less than $0.99. The more “creative” the donut, the more expensive it gets. The French toast donut is actually good, but it doesn’t need syrup or extra raisin topping, since the donut already has powdered sugar and frosting on it. When you’re very hungry, it seems perfect. The only other advantage is their Kona hazelnut coffee—I think I found the same product online, so I can avoid the trip, paying for parking, and the disappointment of dry donuts.
original: I've been here about ten times. 6 for just a cup of coffee, 4 for the donuts. I don't get it. I try and try and try and I can't bring myself to get excited over them. We came here when they first opened and I thought "They don't have their temperatures/ measurements converted to the altitude of Vegas" as they're a shop based out of San Diego if I'm remembering correctly. If you order a plain donut that's not filled or stuffed with a cookie, they're all dry :(. The worst part is that they're so expensive. A single plain donut is $2. Anywhere else a single glazed donut is .99 cents or less. They only get more expensive the more "creative" they get. The French toast donut is really good but doesn't need the syrup or extra blueberry topping since the donut is already covered in powdered sugar AND glaze. When you're feeling extra gluttonous I think it hits the spot. The only other saving grace is their hazelnut Kona coffee which I think I found the same one online so I can save myself the trip, parking meter fee, and disappointment of dry donuts.

text: I like to think of myself as a cookie/baked goods connoisseur, so when I found out about The Batch Maker I couldn't wait to go. I stood in line opening morning with my twin boys and enjoyed my treat and Tres Leches coffee. Since then, my boys and I are weekly regulars for many reasons: 1) This is hands down the best treats I have ever consumed. The Smore's Brownie, Cookie Dough brownie, Oreo Truffle cookie and the pop tarts are all worth every penny. I still have many treats to try. 2) THE STAFF and CRIS- they make you feel at home, greet you with a smile and take time with each customer to ensure he/she gets exactly what they need. 3) Kid-friendly- There are definitely some coffee places that make you feel awkward when you roll in with two toddlers, but The Batch Maker welcomes kids with open arms. They have a kid cart, which includes toys, games and everything to keep your toddler busy while you enjoy your coffee/latte HOT. They also offer storytime on Saturdays in the space next door with additional treats. 4) Tres Leches Latte-get it! The Batch Maker is the highlight of our guests' trips to Charlotte. I always recommend our Airbnb guests to stop in, and when they do they rave about it... as I do. Kudos to Cris and her absolutely incredible team and staff for making The Batch Maker such a special place for our family to visit every week. It's our favorite place in Charlotte!

text: En nuestro último viaje a Las Vegas, descubrimos esta panadería, pero estábamos demasiado llenos para probar nada. Para este próximo viaje, quería asegurarme de probar al menos uno de los deliciosos pasteles que ofrecía esta panadería. Esta es la panadería de Buddy Valastro (el rostro del programa de televisión "Cake Boss"), pero eso no me importaba mucho. Lo que realmente me atrajo fueron los postres. Son llamativos y ofrecen una gran variedad. También me gustó la forma en que habían reinterpretado los postres clásicos, como el pastel de crema de Boston, que ofrecían en un pequeño molde circular en lugar de como una porción de pastel. Pedí el "Lobster Tail", que es lo que se especializan. Es un croissant con forma de cola de langosta, cubierto de azúcar glas y relleno de crema esponjosa. Me encantó, y me pareció la versión más extrema de un "cream puff". Mi esposo pidió el "Oreo cake tower". No estoy seguro de si estaba indicado en la descripción, pero resultó ser un pastel de queso, que a mi esposo NO le gusta. No tuve la oportunidad de probarlo, pero basándome en el tamaño del postre, un pastel de queso sería muy abundante. Tuvimos que esperar en una fila cuando llegamos, pero sé que esto no es inusual en este lugar. Lo que no me gustó fue la apariencia de los empleados, que parecían aburridos e indiferentes. Destruyeron por completo el ambiente divertido de este lugar y te hicieron sentir como si estuvieras en el episodio de "Soup Nazi" de "Seinfeld" cuando pides. Trabajan con postres deliciosos todo el día; ¡ponte una sonrisa!
text_en: During our last trip to Las Vegas, we discovered this bakery. But we were too full to try anything. For our next visit, I wanted to make sure I tried at least one of the delicious cakes offered by this bakery. It’s the bakery of Buddy Valastro (the face of the TV show “Cake Boss”), but that didn’t really matter to me. What really caught my attention were the desserts. They’re impressive and offer a wide variety. I also liked how they reinterpreted classic desserts, like the Boston cream pie, which they serve in a small circular mold instead of as a single piece of cake. I ordered the “Lobster Tail,” which is their specialty. It’s a croissant shaped like a lobster tail, covered with powdered sugar and filled with fluffy cream. I loved it, and it seemed like an extreme version of a “cream puff”. My husband ordered the “Oreo cake tower”. I’m not sure if it was mentioned in the description, but it turned out to be a cheese cake, which my husband doesn’t like. I didn’t get a chance to try it, but judging from the size of the dessert, a cheese cake would be quite large. We had to wait in line when we arrived, but I know this isn’t unusual at this place. What I didn’t like was the appearance of the employees; they seemed bored and indifferent. They completely ruined the fun atmosphere of this place, making you feel like you’re in an episode of “Soup Nazi” from “Seinfeld”. They work with delicious desserts all day long; just smile!
original: On our last trip to Vegas we had stumbled upon this bakery but were too full to try anything. For this next trip, I wanted to make sure I got to try one of the delicious looking pastries at this bakery. This is Buddy Valastro's (face of the Cake Boss TV show) bakery but I really didn't care about that much. It was the case after case of desserts that caught my interest. They are eye catching and there is a huge variety of what you can get. I also liked the unique take on old dessert favorites like the Boston creme pie, which they had in a little circular mold instead of as a pie slice. I got the Lobster Tail which is what they are known for. It's a croissant shaped like a lobster tail with powdered sugar on top and fluffy creme stuffed in the tail. I loved it and I felt like it was the extreme version of a creme puff. My husband got the Oreo cake tower. I'm not sure if it was written in the description but this turned out to be a cheesecake which my husband does NOT like. I didn't get to try it but based on the size of the dessert, a cheesecake would've been very rich. We had to wait in a line when we arrived but I know this isn't unusual for this place. The one thing I didn't like was how bored and disinterested the employees looked. They completely killed the fun vibe of this place and made you feel like you were in the Seinfield "Soup Nazi" episode when you place your order. You work with heavenly desserts all day; put on a smile!

text: Visitaba buscando el macaron francés perfecto en mi zona. Los macarons de Bouchon son aproximadamente 3 veces más grandes que un macaron normal, pero también tienen un precio de unos $3 por unidad. Sin embargo, si compras 5, obtienes uno gratis. Tienen la textura perfecta: una capa exterior delgada y crujiente que cubre un centro perfectamente masticable. El relleno era justo, pero fue el relleno lo que impide que obtengan 5 estrellas, en lugar de 4. Son buenos, pero tienen un relleno de mantequilla dulce, incluso en el sabor de frambuesa. Prefiero un relleno de fruta real con un toque ácido. En general, son deliciosos y los recomendaría. Si también prefieres un relleno de fruta con un toque ácido, les recomiendo que visiten la panadería La Belle Terre en W. Sahara.
text_en: I visited to find the perfect French macarons in my area. Bouchon’s macarons are about 3 times larger than a regular macaron, but they cost around $3 each. However, if you buy 5, you get one free. They have the perfect texture: a thin, crunchy outer layer covering a perfectly chewy center. The filling is just right, but it’s the filling that prevents them from getting 5 stars instead of 4. They’re good, but their sweet butter filling, even in the cranberry flavor, isn’t very appealing. I prefer a fruit-filled filling with a slight acidity. Overall, they’re delicious and I would recommend them. If you also prefer a fruit-filled filling with acidity, I suggest visiting La Belle Terre bakery in W. Sahara.
original: I visited as part of my search for my perfect French macaron locally. Bouchon macarons are about 3 times the size of a normal macaron but are also about 3x the price at $3+ a piece. But buy 5 and get 1 free. They do have the perfect texture, thin, crispy outer shell over the perfectly chewy center. The filling was just the right amount, but it was the filling that accounts for the 4 stars vs 5. It is good but it's a sweet buttercream type filing even in the raspberry. I prefer a real fruit filling with a little tart to it. Overall, they are delicious and I would recommend. If you prefer the fruit filling tart as well I'd recommend checking out La Belle Terre bakery on W. Sahara.

text: Overly sweet just like their prices. Amateur shtuff leaving raspberry seeds in the preserves and the glaze. It's called a chinois
text_en: Overly sweet just like their prices. Amateur shtuff leaving raspberry seeds in the preserves and the glaze. It's called a chinois

text: Eu prefer ir ao Dunkin' Donuts. Este lugar é horrível e muito caro.

original: I'd rather go to Dunkin Donuts. This place is horrible and way overpriced.

text: Delicious, but for the price I felt like I should have gotten more ice cream. They were cheap with the scoops and the sauce. The butter pecan with salted caramel was delicious. Just wish I had gotten more of it considering what I paid.
text_en: Delicious, but for the price I felt like I should have gotten more ice cream. They were cheap with the scoops and the sauce. The butter pecan with salted caramel was delicious. Just wish I had gotten more of it considering what I paid.

text: The hype about this place is spot on! The most delicious ice creams and sorbets you will taste. Brandon and staff are so friendly. Don't miss this place!
text_en: The hype about this place is spot on! The most delicious ice creams and sorbets you will taste. Brandon and staff are so friendly. Don't miss this place!

text: Siempre visitamos Ghirardelli en Las Vegas, y siempre es una experiencia maravillosa. El servicio es amable y rápido, y los helados son deliciosos. Además, el local siempre está limpio. ¡El sundae de brownie con salsa de chocolate y caramelo salado es increíble! Me encanta que siempre tengan muestras gratuitas de sus nuevos chocolates. También compartimos un sundae de galletas de chocolate mientras estábamos en Las Vegas, y fue simplemente aceptable en comparación con el sundae de brownie.
text_en: We always visit Ghirardelli in Las Vegas, and it’s always a wonderful experience. The service is friendly and fast, and the ice creams are delicious. Additionally, the store is always clean. The brownie sundae with chocolate sauce and salty caramel is incredible! I love that they always provide free samples of their new chocolates. We also shared a chocolate cookie sundae while we were in Las Vegas; it was just okay compared to the brownie sundae.
original: We always visit ghiradelli in vegas, and it's always wonderful. Friendly and fast service, and super sweet ice cream treats. They keep their store clean as well. The brownie hot fudge sundae with salted caramel is amazing! I love how they always have free samples of their newest chocolate squares, too. We also shared a chocolate chip cookie sundae while we were in vegas, and it was just okay compared to the brownie sundae.

text: Bouchon bakery is conveniently located in the Venetian near a public dining area. I was craving breakfast pastries and decided to try my luck here. I read a lot of good reviews and was prepared to wait in line if need be. To my pleasant surprise, there wasn't much of a wait! I got the chocolate almond crossaint, which I loved! The crossaint itself was made to perfection as it was extra flaky... so delicious. I also got the ham, egg, and cheese crossaint. Again, so very flaky... yummy. The only con for the ham, egg and cheese crossaint is that it is too salty. Takeaway: -A bit on the pricier side, but it's Vegas! -very good crossaint texture -convenient

text: O sorvete mais delicioso do mundo. Meus sabores preferidos são o creme de laranja com pedaços de chocolate, "Blue Moon" e uma mistura de morango com hortelã. E não há lugar melhor no mundo para comer sorvete do que no "Union", com música ao vivo, pessoas conversando, patos andando e barcos a vela flutuando no Lago Mendota.
text_en: The most delicious ice cream in the world. My favorite flavors are orange cream with chocolate chunks, “Blue Moon,” and a mix of strawberries and mint. And there’s no better place in the world to eat ice cream than at “Union” – with live music, people chatting, ducks walking around, and sailboats floating on Mendota Lake.
original: Best ice cream in the world. My favorites are the orange custard chocolate chip, blue moon, and a strawberry/mint mix. And there's no better place in the world to eat ice cream than in the back of the Union with the sound of live music, people chattering away, ducks waddling around and the sailboats floating in Lake Mendota.

text: Love this place! I came and had the red velvet cupcake and it was amazing! Really moist and full of flavor! I also ordered a latte and it was full flavor and none of that coffee after taste! Yummy!
text_en: Love this place! I came and had the red velvet cupcake and it was amazing! Really moist and full of flavor! I also ordered a latte and it was full flavor and none of that coffee after taste! Yummy!

text: ¡Un heladería fantástica en un barrio precioso! Me alegra mucho apoyar un negocio propiedad de una mujer, especialmente con helados en cono de gofres tan deliciosos. Una tienda muy encantadora y el personal me ofreció porciones generosas. Los trozos de gofre son fantásticos, con un sabor delicioso a mantequilla y caramelo. Definitivamente, si vives en Madison, ¡deberías visitar este lugar!
text_en: A fantastic ice cream shop in a beautiful neighborhood! I’m very happy to support a business owned by a woman, especially with such delicious cone-shaped ice creams. It’s a really lovely store, and the staff gave me generous portions. The gobby pieces are fantastic, with a delicious flavor of butter and caramel. Definitely, if you live in Madison, you should visit this place!
original: Really great neighborhood ice cream shop! So happy to support a female-owned business, especially with such delicious waffle cones. Very cute shop and the scooper gave me generous portions. The waffle cones pieces are fantastic, such a delicious caramel-y brown butter flavor. Definitely check this place out if you live in Madiso

text: Lovely French bakery in the Venetian Hotel. Pastries are fresh and deviously delightful. European style sandwiches are very good too. Good quality bakery in a day where most are below standard. Love Bouchon Bakery!
text_en: Lovely French bakery in the Venetian Hotel. Pastries are fresh and deviously delightful. European style sandwiches are very good too. Good quality bakery in a day where most are below standard. Love Bouchon Bakery!

text: The coffee is very good and an alternative to my usual Starbucks morning coffee run, but the pastries and cakes were disapointing to say the least. For first thing in the morning you would expect fresh and crisp, but they were soft and stale. The atmosphere of the new downtown location was very nice though, and it would be a great place for a meeting over coffee. Hope they get the bakery side running properly soon or they will find it difficult to stick around. Willing to give their breakfast and lunch food a try. So stay tuned.

text: Comida: Sanduíche de biscoito com sorvete – você escolhe o biscoito e o sorvete. – Sorvete de manteiga e nozes: delicioso e cremoso! 4/5 – Biscoito com chocolate salgado: o biscoito, por outro lado, estava excessivamente salgado! Sei que deveria ser salgado, mas parecia que os biscoitos estavam mergulhados em sal! No final, comi o sorvete e consegui comer apenas metade do biscoito. 2/5 Serviço: Apesar de a fila ser longa, os funcionários foram rápidos e simpáticos. 3/5 Pensamentos finais: Com certeza voltarei para experimentar outros doces! E definitivamente vou pedir o sorvete com sabor de café vietnamita! :)
text_en: Food: Cookie sandwich with ice cream – you choose the cookies and the ice cream. – Butter and nuts ice cream: delicious and creamy! 4/5 – Salty chocolate cookies: the cookies, on the other hand, were overly salty! I know they should be salty, but it seemed like the cookies were soaked in salt! In the end, I ate the ice cream and managed to eat only half of the cookie. 2/5 Service: Although the line was long, the staff were quick and friendly. 3/5 Final thoughts: I will definitely come back to try other desserts! And I’ll definitely order the coffee-flavored ice cream! :)
original: Food: Ice cream cookie sandwich - you choose your cookie and ice cream. -- Butter Pecan Ice Cream: delicious and creamy! 4/5 -- Salted Chocolate Chip Cookie: The cookie on the other hand was super salty! I know it's supposed to be salty but it was as if the cookies were dipped in salt! I ended up eating the ice cream and was only able to eat half a cookie. 2/5 Service: Even though the line was out the door, the employees were still quick and friendly. 3/5 Final thoughts: I'm definitely coming to try their other desserts! And I'm definitely getting the Vietnamese coffee flavored ice cream! :)

text: Mitchell's es uno de los lugares más populares de la zona de Greater Cleveland, y tienen sabores para todos los gustos. No solo es delicioso, sino que ofrece helado elaborado con los MEJORES ingredientes, todos de origen local y de alta calidad. Pagan a sus empleados un salario justo, y esos empleados siempre son amables y sonríen. Siempre son muy atentos cuando se les olvida preguntar por crema batida (¡la mejor crema batida, por cierto!). Además, ofrecen tarrinas y cuartos en la tienda para llevar a casa y disfrutar en el sofá. También ofrecen agua en el mostrador para que los clientes se sirvan, lo cual es fantástico... Mitchell's me hace volver una y otra vez, al menos una vez por semana.
text_en: Mitchell’s is one of the most popular places in the Greater Cleveland area, offering flavors for all tastes. It’s not only delicious, but also serves ice cream made with the BEST ingredients—all locally sourced and of high quality. They pay their employees fairly, and those employees are always friendly and smiling. They’re very attentive when customers forget to ask for whipped cream (the best whipped cream, indeed!). Additionally, they offer slices and quarts of ice cream to be taken home and enjoyed on the sofa. They also provide water at the counter for customers to use, which is great… Mitchell’s makes me return here over and over again, at least once a week.
original: Mitchell's is one of the Greater Cleveland area's greatest staples, and they have a flavor for everyone. Mitchell's is not only delicious, but offers ice cream made with the BEST ingredients, all locally sourced and high quality. They pay their workers a fair wage & those workers are always positive with smiling faces! They are always gracious when I forget to ask for whipped cream (the best whipped cream, btw). And they offer pints and quarts in the store to take home & enjoy on the couch! They also offer water out on the counter for people to self-serve which is SO great...Mitchell's keeps me coming back for more, at least once a week.

text: Ice Cream Social is incredible! I started buying pints from Katrina during the pandemic - I've probably bought at least 20 so far. The flavors are unique and delicious. And the ice cream stays reasonably soft in the freezer, which is a huge bonus. My favorite thing to get at the shop is a flight so that I can try 3 different flavors, because it is hard to choose just one! I highly recommend getting waffle cone pieces as your topping. It's too hard to choose a favorite flavor! I don't like the ones with jam as much (personal preference), but I've enjoyed every flavor I have tried.

text: Mmmmmm. Just mmmmmm. Samples for the asking and you still won't be able to make up your mind! And then you need to pick what container you want it in! Edible is best. Just saying.

text: Mi hermana descubrió este lugar en Yelp y parecía un lugar increíble para visitar. ¡Tenía razón! Nos recibieron al entrar, y también a cualquier persona que entrara. Y, créanme, este lugar se llenó rápidamente, ¡a pesar de que cuando entramos, solo había un par de personas antes de nosotros! Ahora entiendo por qué. Tienen muchísimas opciones de sabores y combinaciones, y me encantó. Además, tenían una gran variedad de cereales para mezclar, ¡lo cual era increíble! Al final, pedí una combinación con una base de helado de vainilla y mi elección fue Lucky Charms, ¡y los mezclaron en el helado! También pedí una cobertura adicional y elegí los "marshmallows", ¡y estaba delicioso! Mi hermana pidió una especie de té de leche con matcha y boba. Definitivamente, es el mejor lugar de helados que he probado hasta ahora. Sin duda, es un lugar para visitar si tienes ganas de helados o bebidas.
text_en: My sister found this place on Yelp, and it seemed like an amazing place to visit. She was right! They welcomed us upon entering, as well as anyone else who came in. And believe me, the place filled up quickly, even though when we arrived, there were just a couple of people before us! Now I understand why. They have countless flavor options and combinations, and I really liked it. Also, they had a wide variety of cereals to mix with, which was incredible! In the end, I ordered a combination with vanilla ice cream as the base, and my choice was Lucky Charms—they mixed those into the ice cream! I also asked for an extra topping and chose “marshmallows,” and it was delicious! My sister ordered some kind of milk tea with matcha and boba. Definitely, it’s the best ice cream place I’ve tried so far. Without a doubt, it’s a place worth visiting if you're in the mood for ice cream or drinks.
original: My sister found this place on yelp and it looked like an awesome place to check out.OMG was I right!!They greeted us as we entered including anyone who entered and lemme tell ya this place got rather busy quick even though when we walked in there was only a couple people before us!Now I can see why! So many options regarding topping wise and mix in I loved it and the fact that they had all kinds of cereal options for you the mix in was amazing.I ended up getting a mix in swirl which consisted of a vanilla base ice cream and my choice of mix was lucky charms which they grinder into the ice cream yes!And I got a choice topping as well and I went with the marshmallow charms omg SOOOO GOOD! My sis ended up getting a matcha milk tea of some sort with boba! Hands down best ice cream place I've been to so far! Most def a place to go and check out if you're in the mood for some ice cream or drinks!

text: Tasty cakes, big price tag. Not really any different from any other cupcake joint, but if you need a quick fix for your sweet tooth then it works!
text_en: Tasty cakes, big price tag. Not really any different from any other cupcake joint, but if you need a quick fix for your sweet tooth then it works!

text: Sou um grande fã do programa "Cake Boss" e de Buddy Velasco, então quando soube que existia uma filial do Carlos Bakery em Las Vegas, precisei ir! O Carlos Bakery está localizado no hotel Venetian. Ele fica no extremo norte da área de compras. A fila não era muito longa quando eu cheguei à noite. Tudo parecia tão delicioso! Muitas pessoas estavam pedindo bolos, mas eu queria experimentar os cannolis e as "lobster tails"... é o que eu sempre vejo no programa dele. Uau, os cannolis estavam muito bons... Um cannoli pode ser compartilhado por duas pessoas, pois é muito grande. As "lobster tails" eram ainda mais incríveis do que os cannolis. Bem crocantes por fora e saborosas por dentro. Hummm, delicioso! Um dia, adoraria experimentar os bolos dele. Os preços eram um pouco altos para tudo. Comprei 6 cannolis e 3 "lobster tails" por cerca de 45 dólares... mas ganhei uma caneca de presente! :)
text_en: I’m a big fan of “Cake Boss” and Buddy Velasco. So when I heard there was a branch of Carlos Bakery in Las Vegas, I had to go! Carlos Bakery is located at the Venetian hotel. It’s at the far northern end of the shopping area. The line wasn’t very long when I arrived that night. Everything looked delicious! Many people were ordering cakes, but I wanted to try the cannoli and “lobster tails”… those are the things I always see on his show. Wow, the cannoli were really good… A cannoli can be shared between two people, since it’s quite large. The “lobster tails” were even more amazing than the cannoli. They were crispy on the outside and tasty inside. Hmm, delicious! One day, I really hope to try his cakes. The prices were a bit high for everything. I bought 6 cannoli and 3 “lobster tails” for about $45… but I got a mug as a gift! :)
original: I'm a huge fan of the show Cake Boss and Buddy Velasco so when I heard there was a Carlos Bakery in Las Vegas, I had to go! Carlos Bakery is located in the Venetian Hotel. Its on the North end of the shopping area. The line wasn't too long when I went in the evening. Everything looked so delicious! Many people were ordering cakes but I wanted to try the cannoli and lobster tail... that's what I always see on his show. Wow, the cannoli was so good... One can be shared with two people, it's so big. The lobster tail was even more amazing than the cannoli. So crisp on the outside and flavorful on the inside. Oooh, yum! One day I would love to try his cakes. The prices were a bit pricey for everything. I got 6 cannolis and 3 lobster tail for a little over $45... but I got a free mug with it! :)

text: ¡Servicio increíble! Y helado y boba aún mejores. ¡Me encantó cada parte de la experiencia, definitivamente volveré!
text_en: Incredible service! The ice cream and bubble tea were even better. I loved every part of the experience; I’ll definitely come back!
original: Awesome service! Even better ice cream and boba tea!! Loved every part of the experience definitely will be returning!

text: I had seen Churn on multiple lists of places to try in and around Phoenix so I made sure to squeeze in a visit. I made my group drive all the way across the city for what promised to be the best ice cream. Even though it was a cold evening the place had a line. After having some difficulty deciding what to get I went with a straight forward ice cream cone. I don't know if my expectations were set too high but I thought it was good. It nothing spectacular. I think the chocolate chip cookie I got for the next day was way better than the ice cream.

text_en: A delicious ice cream! Definitely try the sundae with brownies and Oberweis chocolate sauce. I recommend the flavors “espresso, caramel, and nuts”. Follow me on Instagram at @tryatreat

On my most recently visit I got macaroons and I must say that the salted caramel is by far the best out of all of them. As far as the location in Las Vegas, it's VERYYYYY small.
