text: Sendo de fora da cidade, eu nunca tinha ouvido falar do Jack Frost Donuts, mas queria levar um doce para o meu cliente em Walton Hills. Quando entrei com esses, me senti um herói :). Eles eram criativos e bonitos, e o sabor era melhor do que qualquer outro que eu já tinha provado. Amei!
text_en: Since I was outside the city, I had never heard of Jack Frost Donuts. But I wanted to bring a donut to my client in Walton Hills. When I brought them over, I felt like a hero :). They were creative and beautiful, and their taste was better than any other I’ve ever tasted. I loved them!
original: Being from out of town I never heard of Jack Frost Donuts but wanted to take a treat to my customer in Walton Hills. When I walked in with these I became a hero :). These were creative and beautiful and the taste was better than any I have had anywhere. Loved it!

text: I got the chocolate confetti. Wasn't all that. I prefer the boxed one I get at Whole Foods.
text_en: I got the chocolate confetti. Wasn't all that. I prefer the boxed one I get at Whole Foods.

text: Uno de los helados más deliciosos que he probado. Llegamos alrededor de las 7:30 y la cola era bastante larga, pero valió la pena. Además, la cola se mueve bastante rápido. Pedí uno de menta con galletas y salsa de chocolate caliente, con trozos de Oreo. Estaba tan bueno porque lo preparan casero, por lo que no está muy frío ni duro. El personal también fue amable. Los precios son muy económicos en relación con las porciones que se obtienen.
text_en: One of the most delicious ice creams I’ve ever tried. We arrived around 7:30, and the queue was quite long, but it was worth it. Moreover, the ice cream melts quickly. I ordered a mint flavor with cookies and hot chocolate sauce, along with Oreo pieces. It was so good because it’s made homemade; it’s not too cold or hard. The staff were also very friendly. The prices are very affordable compared to the amount you get.
original: One of the best ice cream I've ever had. We got there around 7:30 and the line was pretty long but we'll worth it. Also the line moves pretty quick. I got the mint and cookies with hot fudge and Oreo pieces. It was so good because they make it homemade so it's not very cold and hard. The staff there was nice too. The prices are cheap for the portions you get.

text: Este lugar tiene todo lo delicioso y decadente que puedas imaginar. Desde dulces de chocolate, pasando por batidos, hasta cualquier tipo de golosina de chocolate. Simplemente entrar y ver todo lo que tienen es un placer en sí mismo. Mi golosina favorita son los "turtles" (golosinas de chocolate con forma de tortuga). Son absolutamente deliciosas. Otras cosas divertidas que ofrecen son "s'mores" de chocolate negro y con leche (galletas Graham cubiertas de malvavisco y chocolate), tocino cubierto de chocolate y todo tipo de trufas variadas. Están ubicados en la calle detrás de mi oficina, y es muy difícil no ir allí a comprar algo todos los días. El personal es muy amable. Y los precios son bastante razonables. Una porción generosa suele costar alrededor de 2,50 dólares. Calculan los precios por peso, así que cuanto más grande sea el producto, más caro será. Si vas a comer en Penn o en el centro de la ciudad, asegúrate de parar aquí para el postre. De hecho, creo que iré allí después del almuerzo hoy para comprar una "turtle" de almendras.
text_en: This place has everything delicious and decadent you can imagine. From chocolate candies to smoothies, and all kinds of chocolate treats. Just entering and seeing what they have is a pleasure in itself. My favorite treat is the “turtles” – chocolate candies shaped like turtles. They’re absolutely delicious. Other fun items they offer include black chocolate and milk “s’mores” (Graham cookies covered with marshmallow and chocolate), bacon covered in chocolate, and various other fancy treats. They’re located on the street behind my office, and it’s very hard not to go there every day to buy something. The staff are very friendly, and the prices are quite reasonable. A generous portion usually costs around $2.50. They calculate prices by weight, so the larger the item, the more expensive it will be. If you’re eating at Penn or in the city center, make sure to stop by here for dessert. In fact, I think I’ll go there after lunch today to buy a almond “turtle”.
original: This place has every delicious, decadent thing you can think of. From fudge, to milkshakes, to any kind of chocolate treat. Going in and taking a look at everything they have is a treat in itself. My favorite thing to get are the turtles. They're absolutely delicious. Some other fun stuff they have are dark and milk chocolate "s'mores" (a graham cracker and melted marshmallow covered in chocolate), chocolate covered bacon, and all kinds of assorted truffles. They are located on the block behind my office, and it is sooooo hard to not walk over there and get something every day. The staff is very friendly. And the prices are pretty decent. A nice sized treat is usually around $2.50. They do pricing by weight, so the bigger something is, the more expensive it will be. If you're eating anywhere on Penn or Downtown, make sure you stop here for dessert! In fact, I think I'll be stopping over there today after lunch for an almond turtle!

text: Sin duda, el mejor helado que probarás. Lo elaboran en pequeñas cantidades y ofrecen una amplia variedad de sabores. Prueba el "dough-melt", que es su versión de un helado en un donut con cobertura. Mi favorito es el helado de miel y lavanda con trozos de "fruity pebbles".
text_en: Without a doubt, it’s the best ice cream you’ll ever try. It’s made in small quantities, and they offer a wide variety of flavors. Try the “dough-melt” version—it’s like an ice cream in a donut with a topping. My favorite is the honey and lavender ice cream, topped with “fruity pebbles”.
original: Hands down the best ice cream you'll ever eat. It is made in small batches and a wide variety of flavors. Try a dough-melt. Their version of an ice cream sandwich is in a hot glazed donut. My favorite is honey lavender ice cream with fruity pebbles added.

text: ¡Me encanta esta heladería local! Sus helados, deliciosos y con mucho sabor, son los mejores, aunque los precios pueden ser un poco elevados.
text_en: I love this local ice cream shop! Their ice creams are delicious and full of flavor—the best kind. However, the prices might be a bit high.
original: Love this local ice cream shop! Their flavorful, rich ice cream is the best, can't be the prices.

text: Hey Buddy... F You! When you charge $11 for a tiny slice of cheesecake you better be giving people the best cheesecake they had in their lives. text: Parece que mi reputación de consumir mucha azúcar no me ha precedido hasta Amelie's. Cuando me dijeron: "¡Vaya, alguien va a tener que hacer más vueltas!". Gracias por el "azucarismo", pero ha pasado mucho tiempo desde la última vez que estuve aquí, y definitivamente admito que mis ojos eran más grandes que mi estómago... pero ¿no debería eso haber hecho que estuvieras contenta con la gran oferta, en lugar de hacerme sentir culpable por comprar tanto? Además, soy de "ahora y después", así que esto me duró días... Pero la lección más importante que aprendí fue que debería releer mis propias reseñas, porque me dejé llevar por dulces que parecían deliciosos, pero en realidad no sabían tan bien... Y luego vi que ya había probado esos dulces y me tomé nota para evitarlos. Bueno, ¡la lección está aprendida! El daño de esta visita fue: Brownie de caramelo salado - la capa de brownie sigue siendo muy delgada y granulada debido al azúcar - no se había disuelto por completo durante el horneado, y combinada con la capa de caramelo suave, el resultado final era granuloso y grasoso - definitivamente lo evitaré la próxima vez. Tarta de melocotón - estoy deseando que llegue la temporada de melocotones, pero no leí mi nota sobre que el sabor a melocotón era mínimo, y la primera evaluación seguía siendo correcta: había abundancia de limón y muy poco melocotón. Torta de chocolate con caramelo salado - esta fue una nueva tentación para mí, y ¡fue fenomenal! Toma un brownie de galleta con trozos de chocolate (o una galleta Toll House, si quieres) y pon una capa de crema batida en medio, luego agrega una pequeña capa de caramelo salado encima, y tienes una tarta realmente deliciosa. Muffin de queso crema - la parte de la masa era agradable, crujiente y desmenuzable. Habría estado aún mejor con más queso crema. Croissant doblemente horneado - solo quedaba uno cuando llegué, y el croissant no era ni crujiente ni desmenuzable en absoluto - había sido demasiado empapado con el líquido en el que se remoja antes del segundo "horneado", así que tenía sabor, pero no era realmente de almendras ni de croissant. Entonces, para los pasteles de un día menos afortunado (mis elecciones poco inteligentes) y los comentarios sarcásticos, esta experiencia fue simplemente perfecta.
text_en: It seems that my reputation for consuming a lot of sugar hasn’t preceded me to Amelie’s yet. When they said, “Wow, someone needs to go around more times!” I appreciate the “sugariness,” but it’s been a long time since I was here last, and I must admit that my eyes were bigger than my stomach… But shouldn’t that have made you happy with the great offer, rather than making me feel guilty for buying so much? Besides, I’m someone who prefers things that are fresh and new, so this lasted for days… But the most important lesson I learned is that I should read through my own reviews again—I let myself be tempted by sweets that seemed delicious, but actually weren’t that good… Then I realized I had already tried those sweets, so I’ll keep that in mind next time. Well, the lesson is learned! The downside of this visit was: Salted caramel brownies – the brownie layer remains very thin and gritty due to the sugar – it didn’t fully dissolve during baking, and combined with the soft caramel layer, the result was gritty and greasy – definitely something I’ll avoid next time. Peach tart – I’m looking forward to the peach season, but I didn’t read my note about the minimal peach flavor, and my initial assessment was still correct: there was plenty of lemon, but very little peach. Chocolate cake with salted caramel – this was a new temptation for me, and it was fantastic! Take a cookie brownie with chunks of chocolate (or a Toll House cookie, if you like), add a layer of whipped cream in the middle, then add a small layer of salted caramel on top, and you get a really delicious tart. Cream cheese muffin – the dough part was pleasant, crunchy, and easy to break apart. It would have been better with more cream cheese. Double-baked croissant – only one remained when I arrived, and the croissant wasn’t crunchy or easy to break apart at all – it was too soaked with the liquid used before the second baking, so it had flavor, but it wasn’t really almond or croissant-like. So, for those less fortunate day-old desserts (my stupid choices) and sarcastic comments, this experience was simply perfect.
original: My reputation for copious sugar consumption apparently has not preceded me all the way to Amelie's, when advised: "wow, someone's going to be doing extra laps" Thanks for the sugar-shaming but it's been forever since I'd last been here & I'll definitely admit my eyes were bigger than my stomach.....but shouldn't that have made you happy at the big sale, instead of making me feel guilty about purchasing so much? Plus, I'm a now & later kind of girl so this lasted me for days....... But my bigger lesson learned, was that I should reread my own reviews b/c I got sucked into delish-looking treats that actually weren't as delish-tasting as they appeared.....& then I saw I had tried them before & made note to skip. Oh well, lesson reinforced! Here was this visit's damage: Salted Caramel Brownie - the brownie layer continues to remain very thin & grainy from the sugar - it hadn't fully dissolved in the baking process & combined w/ the soft caramel layer, the overall effect was grainy & greasy - will def pass on this next time Peach Tart - looking forward to being peach season, I didn't read my note about there being little peach flavor & the 1st assessment still held true - there was an abundance of lemon & hardly any peach Brownie-Salted Caramel Chocolate Torte - this was a new indulgence for me & it was phenomenal! Take a blondie brownie w/ chocolate chips ( or a toll house bar cookie, if you will ) & put a layer of whipped cream in between, then add a small salted-caramel layer on top & you're talking 1 seriously delish torte Cream Cheese Muffin - the pastry part was nice & flaky & crumbly. More cream cheese would have made this even better Sticky Bun - the caramelized topping had hardened to the point it was like a toffee candy. Would have preferred much more goo! Twice-baked croissants - there was only 1 left by the time I got there & the croissant was not crispy or flaky at all - it had been over-saturated by whatever liquid they soak it in before the 2nd "bake" so it was flavorful but not really almondy or croissant-like So for the off-day pastries ( my unwise choices ) & the snarky comments, this experience was just an A-OK

text: I bought a cannoli and cupcake. The cannoli was mediocre, the shell was stale and too much filling. The cupcake was also stale. If you are going to pride yourself on being a top notch bakery don't serve stale products, waste of money.
text_en: I bought a cannoli and cupcake. The cannoli was mediocre, the shell was stale and too much filling. The cupcake was also stale. If you are going to pride yourself on being a top notch bakery don't serve stale products, waste of money.

text: This place is certainly a diamond in the rough. Chances are if you never saw it on yelp, you would have never noticed it. I kid you not when I say that their red velvet cake is the best I've ever had I'm my entire life. No red velvet cake comes close to villani's. Every other item I have tried there has been out of this world delicious but I frequently dream about their moist red velvet cake with its perfect cream cheese frosting.

text: ¡Increíble!! Si no hubieras venido a este pequeño local de 60 metros cuadrados, un verdadero paraíso de ensueño, cremoso y perfecto... ¡deja todo lo que estás haciendo, guarda lo que estás comiendo y ve a Novel lo antes posible! De verdad, te agradezco por compartir la mejor experiencia con helado que existe. Aquí está la información: al dueño le tomó 2 años encontrar la máquina de helado perfecta, y otro año perfeccionar sus donuts. Así que, en resumen: el donut perfecto está relleno con helado perfecto. Aquí está el dato: hay 12 sabores de helado, una gran variedad de toppings y cereales, para complementar tu helado. Probé todos los sabores antes de decidir cuál es, en mi opinión, la mejor combinación del mundo: helado de fresa con vinagre balsámico y una bola de helado de miel con lavanda. ¡Te lo juro, es lo mejor! Mi hijo se comió un donut relleno de "Cookie Monster", y mi marido un donut relleno de "bourbon toffee" con cereales de "cinnamon crunch". Puede sonar demasiado dulce, pero la verdad es que no lo es. Está perfectamente equilibrado, y te deja con ganas de más. Es magia, ¿verdad? El dueño y el personal fueron excepcionales, ofreciendo un servicio y productos increíbles. ¡Estoy agradecido mientras escribo esta reseña! ¡Nos vemos mañana!
text_en: Incredible!! If you hadn’t come to this small place of just 60 square meters—a real dreamland, creamy and perfect… stop what you’re doing, save what you’re eating, and go to Novel as soon as possible! I really appreciate you sharing the best ice cream experience there. Here’s the info: it took the owner two years to find the perfect ice cream machine, and another year to perfect their donuts. So, in short: the perfect donut is filled with perfect ice cream. There are 12 flavors of ice cream, along with a wide variety of toppings and cereals to complement your ice cream. I tried all the flavors before deciding which, in my opinion, is the best combination in the world: strawberry ice cream with balsamic vinegar, and a honey-lavender donut. I swear, it’s the best! My son ate a donut filled with “Cookie Monster,” and my husband ate one filled with “bourbon toffee” with “cinnamon crunch” cereals. It might sound too sweet, but actually, it isn’t. It’s perfectly balanced, and makes you want more. It’s magic, right? The owner and staff were exceptional, offering incredible service and products. I’m grateful while writing this review! See you tomorrow!
original: Phenomenal!! If you had not stopped into this little 600sq ft. of a wonderland of dreaminess, creamiest, indulgence perfection.......STOP what your doing, put down whatever you're eating and head to Novel ASAP! Seriously, you're welcome for passing on the most positive ice cream experience ever! Here's the down-low it took this owner 2 years, to find the perfect ice cream maker, and a year to perfect his doughnuts! So bottom line; the PERFECT doughnut is stuffed with perfect ice cream! Here's the scoop, there's 12 flavors of ice cream, handfuls of toppings, and cereal, if you choose, to top off your ice cream. I tried all flavors before deciding on what I think is the best combination in the world! Strawberry balsamic and a scoop of honey lavender! I kid you not, it's the best! My son got Cookie Monster stuffed in a warm doughnut, hubby got bourbon toffee with cinnamon crunch cereal stuffed in a warm delicious doughnut! This may sound over sweet, and stomach churning with sugar overload, on the contrary....it's not too sweet! It's perfected to be balanced, leaving you wanting more! It's magic, I don't understand it? The owner and staff were outstanding providing exceptional service, and products!! I'm bowing down, as I finish this review! See you tomorrow!

text: This place has been a staple for my family for decades. The best donuts ever. Most of my family has moved away, and this is their first stop when they get in town.
text_en: This place has been a staple for my family for decades. The best donuts ever. Most of my family has moved away, and this is their first stop when they get in town.

text: ¡La estética es fantástica! Es muy acogedora y moderna. Ofrecen una variedad de tés para elegir. Además, puedes elegir el nivel de dulzor que deseas, y creo que eso es genial si quieres un té menos dulce. El precio del té es excelente. Pago por un té tailandés con boba y cuesta menos de 5 dólares. He probado el tailandés, con azúcar moreno y chai. Personalmente, el chai no es mi favorito, pero a mi novio le encantó. Pero el té con azúcar moreno y el tailandés son realmente deliciosos. En general, es un lugar excelente para tomar boba, y los precios son muy asequibles.
text_en: The aesthetics are fantastic! It’s very cozy and modern. They offer a variety of teas for you to choose from. Additionally, you can select the level of sweetness you prefer—I think that’s great if you want a less sweet tea. The price of the tea is excellent. I pay for a Thai tea with boba, and it costs less than $5. I tried the Thai tea with dark sugar and chai. Personally, chai isn’t my favorite, but my boyfriend really liked it. But both the dark-sugar tea and the Thai tea are truly delicious. Overall, it’s an excellent place to enjoy boba, and the prices are very affordable.
original: The aesthetic there is great! So cozy and modern. They have a variety of Teas to choose from. Also you can choose how sweet you want it and I think that's great if you want your tea less sweet. The price for the Tea is great. I get Thai tea with boba and that's under 5 dollars. I've tried the Thai, brown sugar, and chai. Personally chai isn't my favorite but my bf really liked it. But the Brown sugar and Thai were really good and yummy! Overall a really great place to get Boba Tea from and you cannot go wrong with the prices there.

text: Amélie era un lugar interesante. En primer lugar, la decoración en sí ya merece la pena visitarlo. Es, sin duda, la panadería/restaurante más decorado que he visto. Pedí algo sencillo, una taza de té Earl Grey, y me encantó. Además, me gustó poder sentarme tanto en la barra, en una mesa como en un sofá, todo en el mismo lugar. Mi novia y yo llevamos unas magdalenas que eran espectaculares. Nos encantaron las de naranja y limón. Lo recomiendo mucho.
text_en: Amélie was an interesting place. First of all, the decor itself is worth visiting. It’s undoubtedly the most beautifully decorated bakery/restaurant I’ve ever seen. I ordered something simple—a cup of Earl Grey tea—and I loved it. Also, I liked being able to sit either at the counter or at a table or on a sofa, all in the same place. My girlfriend and I brought some muffins, which were amazing. We really enjoyed the orange-and-lime ones. I highly recommend it.
original: AmÃ©lie's was an interesting place. First off the decorations alone are worth the visit. This is easily the most widely decorated bakery/restaurant I've ever seen. I went basic and had a cup of earl gray. it was enjoyable and I liked being able to sit at a bar, table, and couch all in the same place. My girlfriend and I took home some macaroons that were outrageous. Fell in love with the orange and lemon ones. Highly recommend.

text: Sempre compro na Buchon Bakery quando estou em Las Vegas! Na minha última visita, ficamos no The Venetian, então foi perfeito para pegar algumas coisas para levar quando saímos! Essa unidade fica bem perto dos elevadores para os hóspedes, no primeiro andar. Como não tenho a oportunidade de visitar Las Vegas com frequência, sempre compro as mesmas coisas: Kouign Amann, macaron e croissant de amêndoa. Desta vez, também comprei um croissant de presunto e queijo para o meu marido, mas também me arrependo de não ter comprado mais macarons franceses. Acho que a gente aprende com a experiência! hahaha Meu marido ficou impressionado com o croissant de presunto e queijo, que eu pedi para ser aquecido. Ele disse que o ovo estava macio e o croissant estava crocante, simplesmente delicioso. O macaron estava macio e cremoso, e sinto falta de ter podido comê-lo sozinho. Sinceramente, acho que os macarons deles são até melhores do que os que eu comi na LaDuree, na França! Não há uma torta ruim aqui, e também tomei um café latte delicioso. Apesar disso, gostaria de mencionar que, na última visita, havia apenas uma fila para fazer o pedido. E quando fui pedir um sanduíche para o café da manhã, a funcionária me olhou com desaprovação e revirou os olhos, porque eu estava demorando um pouco. Por isso, tirei uma estrela.
text_en: I always buy from Buchon Bakery when I’m in Las Vegas! During my last visit, we stayed at The Venetian, so it was perfect to pick up some things to take with us when we left! This store is located close to the elevators for guests, on the first floor. Since I don’t have the chance to visit Las Vegas frequently, I always buy the same things: Kouign Amann, macarons, and almond croissants. This time, I also bought a ham and cheese croissant for my husband, but I regret not buying more French macarons too. I think we learn from our experiences! Hahaha My husband was impressed with the ham and cheese croissant, which I asked to warm up first. He said the egg was soft, and the croissant was crispy—simply delicious. The macaron was soft and creamy, and I wish I could have eaten it alone. Honestly, I think their macarons are even better than those I ate at LaDuree in France! There aren’t any bad cakes here, and I also had a delicious latte. However, I would like to mention that during my last visit, there was only one line to order. And when I went to order a sandwich for breakfast, the staff looked at me disapprovingly and rolled their eyes because I took some time. So, I gave it one star.
original: I've always stock up at Buchon Bakery when I'm in Vegas! The most recent Vegas visit we actually stayed at The Venetian, so it was perfect to grab some goodies to go as we check-out! This location is right by the guest elevators on ground floor. Since I don't get to visit Vegas often, I always get the same: Kouign Amann, macaron, and almond croissant. This time I also got a ham & cheese croissant for the hubby for the road, but I also instantly regret not getting more French macaron. I guess you live and learn! hahaha Husband was oohing and ahhing while eating the ham and cheese croissant which I requested to be heated up. He said the egg was soft and the crossiant nice and flaky it was simply delicious. The macaron was soft and creamy and I'm sad I had to share it with him. Honestly I think their macaron it's even better than when I had it in LaDuree in France! There's not a bad pastry here and I also had a really nice hot latte. Although I want to mentioned that this last visit there was only one line to order on the side. And when I had to come around to see what breakfast sandwich they had, the worker totally gave me a look and rolled her eyes because I was taking a bit too long. Hence the one star knocked off.

text: El batido de bizcocho de fresas era delicioso. Era como volver a la infancia. Escuchar el camión de helados me hizo sentir nostálgico. Este lugar suele estar muy concurrido, pero hay una razón muy buena. Los postres novedosos y visualmente atractivos son muy populares, y además, en este lugar realmente saben bien.
text_en: The strawberry cake smoothie was delicious. It felt like going back to childhood. Hearing the ice cream truck made me feel nostalgic. This place is usually very crowded, but there’s a very good reason for that. The new and visually appealing desserts are very popular, and besides, the food here really tastes good.
original: The strawberry shortcake milkshake was to die for. It's tasted like childhood. Made me nostalgic to hear the ice cream truck. This place gets insanely busy but there's definitely a reason. The esthetically pleasing novelty treats are all the rage and they actually taste good at this place.

text: This place is BOMB! My husband and I LOVE all their milkshakes. Definitely has turned into one of our go to sweets joint. Perfection!
text_en: This place is BOMB! My husband and I LOVE all their milkshakes. Definitely has turned into one of our go to sweets joint. Perfection!

text: Este es uno de mis heladerías favoritas en Charlotte. Ofrecen una gran variedad de sabores, incluyendo opciones sin gluten. Está ubicado en la South Boulevard, cerca del centro de la ciudad. A veces, la fila puede ser bastante larga, pero confíen en mí, el servicio es muy rápido.
text_en: This is one of my favorite ice cream shops in Charlotte. They offer a wide variety of flavors, including gluten-free options. It’s located on South Boulevard, near the city center. Sometimes the line can be quite long, but trust me—the service is very fast.
original: This is one of my favorite ice cream spot in Charlotte.. they have all type of flavors and including gluten free ice cream as well. It's located on south blvd near down town. Sometimes the line can be very long but trust me they will move pretty fast.

Upon walking in you are immediately greeted and welcomed. The person helping me was able to explain each and every donut and asked me what preferences I had and suggested items to try. text: Uma agradável tarde de primavera nos levou ao Little Italy no sábado passado. Após caminhar pelas ruas de Mayfield e Murray Hill, paramos na Presti's, uma charmosa padaria/café italiano, para almoçar. Oferecem pizza, stromboli, antipasti, sopa italiana de casamento, panetone, gelato, tiramisu, macarons, biscoitos, cannoli, bolo de cassata, espresso, cappuccino e muito mais. Este lugar tem de tudo. Eu pedi uma fatia de pizza de salsicha e pimentão. A salsicha não estava cortada em pequenos discos ou disposta de forma organizada. Imagine uma fatia de pizza coberta por salsicha e pimentões vermelhos e verdes. Comer envolvia dobrar a pizza como um pão de cachorro-quente e devorar tudo. A ideia era simplesmente genial. Eles também têm uma área de mesas ao ar livre, bem em frente ao café, com vista para a Mayfield Road. É um ótimo local para observar as pessoas.
text_en: A pleasant spring afternoon took us to Little Italy last Saturday. After walking through the streets of Mayfield and Murray Hill, we stopped at Presti’s, a charming Italian bakery/café, to have lunch. They serve pizza, stromboli, antipasti, Italian wedding soup, panetone, gelato, tiramisu, macarons, cookies, cannoli, cassata cake, espresso, cappuccino, and much more. This place has it all. I ordered a slice of pizza with sausage and bell peppers. The sausage wasn’t cut into small pieces or arranged neatly. It was just a slice of pizza covered with red and green bell peppers. Eating it meant bending the pizza like a hot dog bun and eating everything up quickly. The idea was simply great. They also have an outdoor dining area right in front of the café, with a view of Mayfield Road. It’s a great place to observe people.
original: A pleasant Spring afternoon brought us to Little Italy last Saturday. After walking up and down Mayfield and Murray Hill, we stopped at Presti's, a charming Italian bakery/cafe for lunch. Pizza, Stromboli, Antipasti, Italian Wedding Soup, Panetone, Gelato, Tiramisu, Macaroons, Biscotti, Cannoli, Cassata Cake, Espresso, Cappuccino & more. This place has it all. I ordered a slice of sausage & pepper pizza. The sausage wasn't cut into little medallions or arranged in a nice neat fashion either. Envision an entire sausage link smothered with red and green peppers on top of the pizza. Eating it involved folding up the pizza like a hotdog bun and digging in. The idea was pure genius. They also boast a charming outdoor seating area right outside the cafe and overlooking Mayfield Road. Serves as a great location for people watching.

text: Fue la primera vez que visité Fatty Daddy's y ¡fue increíble! Ofrecen una gran variedad de sabores deliciosos, como Cinnamon Toast Crunch, muffins esponjosos, "Netflix and Chill", pastel de cumpleaños de chocolate, y muchos más. Las chicas son muy amables y serviciales, y el dueño, Brian, fue muy amable e incluso nos ofreció una muestra de su nuevo sabor con Lucky Charms. ¡Comida excelente y gente maravillosa, me encantó este lugar!
text_en: It was the first time I visited Fatty Daddy’s, and it was incredible! They offer a wide variety of delicious flavors, such as Cinnamon Toast Crunch, fluffy muffins, “Netflix and Chill,” chocolate birthday cake, and many more. The girls are very friendly and helpful, and the owner, Brian, was extremely kind—he even offered us a sample of his new flavor with Lucky Charms. The food is excellent, and the people are wonderful; I really loved this place!
original: First time at Fatty Daddy's and it was amazing! They have all kinds of great flavors like Cinnamon Toast Crunch, blubbery muffin, Netflix and Chill, Chocolate birthday cake, and so many more! The girls are super friendly and helpful and the owner Brian was so friendly even gave us a sample of his new flavor with lucky charms! Great food and great people l, loved this place!

text: Great place to meet with friends. Everything I have tried has been great. Love the atmosphere.
text_en: Great place to meet with friends. Everything I have tried has been great. Love the atmosphere.

text: Oh, padaria Carlo, vocês perderam a identidade. Entrei no sábado, por volta do meio-dia, para satisfazer meu desejo de doces da costa leste, e não havia biscoitos pretos e brancos, rabanadas ou tiramisú! Inicialmente, vim procurando por biscoitos coloridos e acabei saindo muito insatisfeito. Os biscoitos eram pesados e sem sabor. Este lugar é uma má representação de uma padaria, oferecendo apenas doces simples que podem ser encontrados em qualquer outro lugar. Uma grande decepção, e apenas mais uma padaria na costa oeste que cobra preços elevados por cannolis e biscoitos de açúcar feitos na hora. Eu não vim aqui pelo nome, vim aqui pelos doces clássicos. Você entra com grandes expectativas de uma padaria italiana na costa leste e sai insatisfeito e decepcionado.
text_en: Oh, Padaria Carlo, you’ve lost your identity. I arrived on Saturday around noon to satisfy my desire for sweets from the East Coast, but there were no black and white cookies, no rabanadas, no tiramisu! At first, I was looking for colorful cookies, but I left very dissatisfied. The cookies were heavy and tasteless. This place is a poor representation of a bakery—it offers only simple sweets that can be found anywhere else. A great disappointment. Just another bakery on the West Coast that charges high prices for cannoli and instant sugar cookies. I didn’t come here because of the name; I came here for the classic sweets. You enter with high expectations of an Italian bakery on the East Coast, and leave feeling disappointed.
original: Oh Carlo's bakery, you have lost your identity. Came in on a Saturday around noon to satisfy my east coast cravings and there were NO BLACK AND WHITE COOKIES, LOBSTER TAILS or TIRAMISU! Originally came in looking for rainbow cookies and ended up leaving highly dissatisfied. Dense and stale, no flavor whatsoever. This place is a sad excuse for a bakery that has simple treats that you can find anywhere else. A major disappointment and just another west coast bakery charging premium prices for average cannolis and fresh baked sugar cookies. I didn't come here for the name, I came here for the classic baked goods. You go in with high hopes of an Italian east coast bakery and leave feeling unsatisfied and disappointed.

text: Es raro encontrar helados mejores que los de Mitchell's. El lugar es encantador: un antiguo teatro. La cartelera exterior anuncia los sabores de temporada. En Mitchell's siempre te permiten probar todos los helados que te interesen. Mis favoritos son el helado de "key lime pie", el de chocolate con coco y el de chocolate con "porter". Si compras una tarrina o un galón para llevar, también incluyen helados gratis. Puedes disfrutar de tu postre en la segunda planta, con vistas a la cocina, donde los cocineros trabajan constantemente para preparar helados. Además, sus horarios son excelentes. Están abiertos hasta tarde, para que puedas parar después de la cena, en un bar o en un concierto. Mitchell's es un lugar que todo el mundo debe visitar cuando está en Cleveland!
text_en: It’s rare to find ice creams better than those at Mitchell’s. The place is charming—an old theater. The sign outside announces the seasonal flavors. At Mitchell’s, you’re always allowed to try all the ice creams you’re interested in. My favorites are the “key lime pie” ice cream, the coconut chocolate ice cream, and the “porter” chocolate ice cream. If you buy a tin or a gallon for takeaway, they also include free ice creams. You can enjoy your dessert on the second floor, with a view of the kitchen, where chefs work constantly to prepare ice creams. Moreover, their hours are excellent. They’re open late, so you can stop after dinner, at a bar or at a concert. Mitchell’s is a place everyone should visit when they’re in Cleveland!
original: It's rare to find ice cream better than Mitchell's! The location is adorable-an old theater. The marquee on the outside announces the seasonal flavors. Mitchell's always allows you to sample any and all ice creams that you're interested in. My favorites are key lime pie, coconut chocolate chunk and porter chocolate chunk. If you take a pint or a quart to go, complimentary ice cream cones are included. You can enjoy your treat on the second floor overlooking the kitchen where cooks are constantly working to make ice cream. Their hours are also great. They're open late so you can stop in after dinner, the bar or a concert. Mitchell's is a stop everyone must make when they're in Cleveland!

text: Esta é a localização ideal da Bouchon Bakery para visitar no The Venetian. Sem se perder no labirinto do The Venetian, é fácil chegar aqui, já que está localizada no Strip. Há uma quantidade incrível de seus deliciosos produtos de panificação. O Kougin Aman é fantástico, assim como seus "Sticky Buns" (pães com cobertura pegajosa). Eu simplesmente não consigo ter o suficiente da Bouchon Bakery em Yountville, e estou muito feliz por ter planejado o percurso para chegar facilmente a este local durante minha estadia em Las Vegas. É simplesmente perfeito!
text_en: This is the perfect location for Bouchon Bakery to visit at The Venetian. Without getting lost in The Venetian’s maze, it’s easy to get here, as it’s located on the Strip. There are an incredible number of delicious bakery products from them. The Kougin Aman is fantastic, as is their “Sticky Buns” (sticky-covered buns). I simply can’t get enough of Bouchon Bakery in Yountville, and I’m very happy that I planned this route so I could easily reach this place during my stay in Las Vegas. It’s simply perfect!
original: This is the right Bouchon Bakery location to visit at The Venetian. Without getting lost in the belly of the Venetian beast, you can easily get here as it's right on the Strip. There's such an incredible amount of their delicious baked goods. Kougin Aman is fantastic as are their Sticky Buns. I can never get enough of Bouchon Bakery in Yountville and I'm so glad to have mapped out the route to easily get to this location while in Vegas. It's as good as it gets!

text: Que bom ter uma sorveteria com sorvetes produzidos localmente! Não comia sorvetes feitos aqui perto desde que morava na nossa pequena cidade universitária na Califórnia. Depois de fazer algumas compras nas lojas vintage ao redor do Roosevelt Row e suar bastante, meu amigo e eu paramos na Melt. Experimentamos vários sabores de sorvetes e sorbetes, incluindo chips e salsa (com Tapatio por cima). O sorvete de pepino estava realmente refrescante. Mas, no final, peguei uma pequena porção de sorvete de pasta de amendoim. Meu amigo também experimentou o chocolate quente mexicano e disse que estava muito picante. Mmmmm, mmmmm, mmmmm, cremoso! Foi simplesmente maravilhoso. O sorvete, cultivado pela Superstition Farms, é incrivelmente cremoso, suave e perfeitamente doce, sem ser exagerado. Todos os sabores que experimentei eram muito naturais, o que é um grande ponto positivo. Vocês têm que adorar seus potes de sorvete, que vêm em caixas de "take-out" chinesas, com uma biscoito da sorte por cima. Melhor ainda, se você não gostar do seu biscoito da sorte, eles têm um pote cheio deles para você trocar. Ha! Vimos seus biscoitos de guloseima na vitrine ao sairmos e ficamos muito curiosos. Mas perguntamos para a moça que estava trabalhando naquele dia (que era uma pessoa um pouco estranha e não nos ouvia muito bem) o que tinha, mas ela nem conseguiu nos dizer. Ummmmm, ok? O biscoito era ENORME e parecia ser alguma espécie de mistura de pasta de amendoim, aveia, batata chips e pretzels. Gostaria de ter pegado um para experimentar. Talvez na próxima! Meu amigo e eu nos divertimos muito sentados em seu amplo espaço ao ar livre. Foi um domingo agradável e tranquilo, e o Roosevelt Row é um ótimo lugar para relaxar e apreciar.
text_en: It’s great to have a ice cream shop with locally made ice creams! I haven’t eaten ice creams made here since I lived in our small university town in California. After doing some shopping at the vintage stores around Roosevelt Row and sweating a lot, my friend and I stopped by Melt. We tried several flavors of ice creams and sorbets, including chips and salsa (with Tapatio on top). The cucumber ice cream was really refreshing. But in the end, I got a small portion of peanut butter ice cream. My friend also tried Mexican hot chocolate and said it was very spicy. Mmmmm, mmmmm, mmmmm, creamy! It was simply wonderful. The ice cream, produced by Superstition Farms, is incredibly creamy, smooth, and perfectly sweet—without being overdone. All the flavors I tried were very natural, which is a big plus. You really should love your ice cream tubs, which come in Chinese “take-out” boxes with a lucky cookie on top. Even better, if you don’t like your lucky cookie, they have a full bottle for you to exchange. Ha! We saw your snack cookies in the window when we left, and we were very curious. But we asked the girl who worked there that day (she was a bit strange and didn’t listen very well) what they had, but she couldn’t tell us. Ummmmm, okay? The cookie was huge and seemed to be some kind of mixture of peanut butter, oats, potato chips, and pretzels. I wish I could have taken one to try. Maybe next time! My friend and I had a great time sitting in their spacious outdoor area. It was a pleasant and peaceful Sunday, and Roosevelt Row is a great place to relax and enjoy.
original: Woohoo for a locally grown ice cream shoppe! I haven't had some locally made ice cream since I lived in our small college town in Northern California. After doing some shopping in the vintage shops around Roosevelt Row and sweating like crazy, my friend and I stopped by Melt. We had quite a few samples of their sorbets and ice creams including chips and salsa (with Tapatio on top). The cucumber sorbet was seriously refreshing. But I ended up with a mini-scoop of Peanut Butter. My friend also tried their Mexican Hot Chocolate and did say it was too overly spicy. Mmmmm, mmmmm, mmmmm creamy! This was seriously dreamy. Their ice cream, cultivated by Superstition Farms is incredibly creamy, smooth, and perfectly sweet without being too over the top. All the flavors I tried were very natural and that's a definite plus. You've got to love their scoops come in Chinese take-out boxes topped with a fortune cookie. Better yet, if you don't like your fortune, they have a jar full of them you can switch yours out with. Ha! We spotted their junk food cookies in their case on the way out and were very curious. But we asked the girl working that day (who was a bit of an awkward person who didn't listen to us very well) what was in it, but she couldn't even tell us. Ummmmm, okay? The cookie was HUGE and looked like it may have been some sort of peanut butter oatmeal concoction with potato chips and pretzels piled on top of it. I wish I would have grabbed one up to check it out. Maybe next time! My friend and I thoroughly enjoyed sitting out on their large patio area. It was a nice quiet Sunday and Roosevelt Row makes for a nice relaxing spot to sit in and admire.

text: A Sloan's oferece uma variedade sólida de sabores de sorvete, então definitivamente vale a pena visitar se você estiver procurando algo diferente. Pedimos o sabor de biscoito com gotas de chocolate e café com rosquinha - atenção, você precisa pedir duas bolas (tentamos pedir apenas uma, mas eles são generosos). O principal ponto negativo é que o sorvete não parecia muito fresco ou natural, como anunciado. O meu tinha pedaços de gelo e o sabor granulado de sorvete que fica muito tempo no congelador. Talvez tenha sido porque fomos lá perto da meia-noite, na quinta-feira, logo antes do fechamento, mas ainda assim decepcionante. Não é um lugar ruim para comer sorvete tarde da noite, se você estiver sentindo uma vontade forte enquanto estiver nos cassinos Venetian/Palazzo!
text_en: Sloan’s offers a solid variety of ice cream flavors, so it’s definitely worth visiting if you’re looking for something different. We ordered the cookie with chocolate and coffee with biscuit flavor – note, you need to order two scoops (we tried asking for just one, but they’re generous). The main downside is that the ice cream didn’t seem very fresh or natural, as advertised. My ice cream had pieces of ice, and the texture was like frozen ice cream that stays in the freezer for a long time. Maybe it’s because we went there near midnight, on Thursday, right before closing time, but still, it’s disappointing. It’s not a bad place to eat ice cream late at night, if you’re feeling hungry while at the Venetian/Palazzo casinos!
original: Sloan's has a solid variety of ice cream flavors, so definitely stop by if you're looking for something out of the ordinary. We ordered the cookie dough cookie and coffee and doughnut flavors - beware you must order two scoops (we tried to order just one) but they are generous. The biggest downside is that the ice cream didn't seem very fresh or natural, as they advertised. Mine had ice flakes and the grainy taste of ice cream left too long in the freezer. May have been because we went at midnight on a Thursday, just before closing, but still disappointing. Not a bad place to catch late night ice cream if you are feeling a rumbling craving while at the Venetian/palazzo casinos!

text: ¡Increíble! Todo lo que hemos probado ha sido delicioso. Muchísimos sabores diferentes. Estuvimos en la fila solo 10 minutos. Había alrededor de 20 a 25 personas delante de nosotros. ¡La espera ha valido la pena! Además, las porciones son enormes. Una excelente relación calidad-precio.
text_en: Incredible! Everything we tried was delicious. So many different flavors. We only waited for 10 minutes in line. There were about 20 to 25 people ahead of us. The wait was worth it! Moreover, the portions are huge. An excellent quality-price ratio.
original: Wow. Everything we have tried has been amazing. So many flavors. We were in line for only 10 minutes. There were about 20 to 25 people in front of us. Well worth the wait. The portions are huge too. Great value for the money.

text: ¡Estupendo!!! Fui un fin de semana y estaba lleno, pero la cola se movía muy rápido. Pedimos el donut de panqueques franceses, crème brûlée, fresas con nata y el "blueberry lemon Meyer", ¡todo estaba delicioso! ¡Ya tengo ganas de volver y probar todo! Además, tienen un pequeño patio donde nos sentamos y pudimos llevar a nuestros perros para que nos acompañaran mientras disfrutábamos del desayuno.
text_en: Great!!! I visited for the weekend and it was full, but the line moved very quickly. We ordered French pancake donuts, crème brûlée, strawberries with cream, and “blueberry lemon Meyer” – everything was delicious! I’m already looking forward to coming back and trying more! Additionally, they have a small patio where we can sit down, and we were allowed to bring our dogs along so they could join us while enjoying breakfast.
original: Fantastic!!! Went in on a Weekend and it was busy but the line went really quick! We ordered the French toast donut, cremebrulee, strawberries and cream, and blueberry lemon meyer, all were delicious!!! I cant wait to go back and try them all!! They even have a little courtyard we sat in and were able to bring our dogs to sit with us while we enjoyed breakfast!!

text: Acabei de descobrir este delicioso lugar!! Tive a sorte de encontrá-lo, pois a Dairy Queen estava fechada e eu estava com vontade de comer sorvete. Eu não tinha ideia do que estava por vir, e que surpresa! Fiquei especialmente surpresa ao descobrir que eles oferecem o Taiyaki de feijão vermelho, que é uma espécie de waffle em formato de peixe, recheado com a opção de recheio desejado. Os recheios incluem creme, taro, feijão vermelho e muito mais! O Taiyaki de feijão vermelho era um dos meus pratos favoritos quando morava no Japão, e nunca consegui encontrar algo igual nos EUA até agora. Também experimentei o AH-BOONG, que é o waffle em formato de peixinho, com creme e sorvete, recheado com a opção de recheio desejada. Escolhi o creme e fiquei muito feliz com a escolha! Ambos os itens foram simplesmente deliciosos! Estou com água na boca só de escrever esta avaliação, então acho que preciso voltar para experimentar mais!!!
text_en: I just discovered this delicious place!! I was lucky to find it, as Dairy Queen was closed, and I really wanted to eat ice cream. I had no idea what would be available next, and it was a surprise! I was especially surprised to learn that they offer red bean taiyaki – a kind of fish-shaped waffle filled with your choice of filling. The fillings include cream, taro, red beans, and more! Red bean taiyaki was one of my favorite dishes when I lived in Japan, and I never found anything similar in the US until now. I also tried AH-BOONG, which is a fish-shaped waffle with cream and ice cream, filled with your preferred filling. I chose cream, and I was very happy with my choice! Both items were simply delicious! I can’t stop thinking about them just by writing this review, so I think I need to go back and try more!!!
original: I just recently found this delicious gem!! I luckily found it because Dairy Queen was closed and I was craving soft serve. I had no idea what I was in store for and was I ever in for a big surprise! I was especially surprised to find that they offer Red Bean TAIYAKI which is a warm fish-shaped waffle filled with choice of filling. Fillings include custard, taro, red beans and more! Red Bean Taiyaki was one of my favorite things when I lived in Japan and I've never been able to find it's equal in the USA until now. I also had the Milk Tea Swirl AH-BOONG which is their signature goldfish-shaped waffle cone stuffed with your choice of filling & soft serve. I chose the Custard filling and was so glad I did! Both of these items were super YUM! It's making my mouth water just writing this review so I think I better go back for more!!!

text: Onde começar a falar sobre o Sweet Republic? Este foi também um dos primeiros lugares que descobri quando me mudei para a região, graças a um folheto que recebi em um evento. É um pouco longe para mim, mas *sempre* vale a pena. Primeiro, o sorvete e os sorbets são incrivelmente deliciosos. Não há palavras que alguém possa escrever em uma dessas avaliações que consigam descrever a qualidade do Sweet Republic. No entanto, gostaria de citar um amigo que experimentou o sorvete pela primeira vez em um "Primeiro Sábado" recente. Depois de experimentar alguns sabores, ele olhou para mim e disse: "Agora entendo por que você viaja tanto para conseguir isso. Este é o melhor sorvete que já provei". O ambiente lá é muito divertido e agradável. Eles têm mesas ao ar livre e dentro, jogos para jogar (incluindo o jogo da conexão) e wi-fi gratuito. A decoração com menta e creme de laranja transmite uma sensação muito refrescante e reconfortante. No entanto, um dos aspectos que mais gosto do Sweet Republic é a oportunidade de experimentar coisas novas. Recomendo que todos que forem experimentem alguns sabores diferentes antes de decidirem o que comprar. Além disso, experimentem algo que vocês nunca pensariam em experimentar. Vocês ficarão surpresos, porque não apenas terá o sabor que vocês imaginaram, mas também será delicioso! Os donos investem muito tempo e esforço no preparo do sorvete e adoro experimentar os novos sabores e ouvir suas histórias sobre como, às vezes, eles mesmos acham que a ideia é louca, mas no final resulta em algo fantástico. O Sweet Republic vale totalmente a pena a viagem, não importa onde você more na região. Não conheço ninguém que tenha ido e ficado desapontado.
text_en: Where should I start talking about Sweet Republic? It was also one of the first places I discovered when I moved to this area, thanks to a brochure I received at an event. It’s a bit far from me, but it’s always worth it. First of all, the ice cream and sorbets are incredibly delicious. There’s no words that can describe the quality of Sweet Republic in a review. However, I’d like to mention a friend who tried the ice cream for the first time during a “First Saturday” event recently. After trying several flavors, he looked at me and said, “Now I understand why you travel so much just to get here. This is the best ice cream I’ve ever tasted.” The atmosphere there is very fun and pleasant. They have outdoor and indoor tables, games to play (including the connection game), and free Wi-Fi. The decor with mint and orange cream gives a very refreshing and comforting feeling. However, one of the things I like most about Sweet Republic is the opportunity to try new things. I recommend that everyone try some different flavors before deciding what to buy. Also, try something you never thought of trying. You’ll be surprised, because not only will it have the flavor you imagined, but it will also be delicious! The owners spend a lot of time and effort preparing the ice cream, and I love trying out new flavors and hearing their stories about how sometimes they think the idea is crazy, but in the end it turns out to be fantastic. Sweet Republic is definitely worth the trip, no matter where you live in the area. I don’t know anyone who has been there and been disappointed.
original: Where do you even start with Sweet Republic. This was also one of the first places I found upon moving to the valley with the help of a flyer I received at an event. It is quite a drive for me, but *always* worth it. First things first. The ice cream and sorbets are insanely delicious. No words anyone writes in one of these reviews could possibly accurately describe the goodness of Sweet Republic. However, I would like to quote one of my friends who had their ice cream for the first time at a recent First Friday. After having a couple bites, they looked at me and said, "Now I know why you drive so far to get this. This is the best ice cream I have ever tasted." The atmosphere there is so fun and uplifting. They have outdoor and indoor seating, games to play (including connect four) and free wifi. The mint and orange creamsicle decor has such a refreshing and comforting feel. However, one of my favorite aspects to Sweet Republic is being adventurous. I encourage everyone going to have a try of a few different ones there before deciding on what to get. Also, try something you never thought you would. You'll be pleasantly surprised, because not only will it taste exactly like you imagined, but it will be yummy! The owners put a lot of thought and time into their ice cream and I love tasting the new things they've made and hearing their stories about how sometimes it sounds just as crazy to them and ends up being fantastic. Sweet Republic is well worth the trip, no matter where you live in the valley. I don't know one person that has gone and been disappointed.

text: 10/10 recomendo! O pessoal foi muito simpático e as opções de sorvete são infinitas! Tantas variedades de sabores, e sabores exclusivos! Voltarei com certeza!
text_en: 10/10 – I highly recommend it! The staff were very friendly, and the ice cream options are endless! So many different flavors, plus exclusive flavors too! I will definitely come back!
original: 10/10 would recommend! The staff was very nice and the ice cream choices are endless! So many different flavors, and signature flavors! Will be coming back again!

text: Não consigo expressar o quanto fiquei decepcionado. O bombom que minha filha pediu era significativamente menor do que o que estava na vitrine. O éclair que eu pedi estava frio. Percebi que estava velho, pois o recheio havia se separado e havia água saindo dele. Da próxima vez, vou comer em casa.
text_en: I can’t express how disappointed I was. The candy my daughter asked for was significantly smaller than what was on display in the shop. The éclair I ordered was cold. I noticed it was old, as the filling had separated and water was coming out of it. Next time, I’ll eat at home.
original: I can't express how thoroughly disappointed I was. The cream puff my daughter ordered was significantly smaller than the one in the display. My eclair was cold. I could tell it was old because the filling separated and water was running from the filling. Next time I'll eat at home.

text: Really good pastries! I'm in love with their almond croissant ($4). I honestly wasn't expecting much but was very surprised. The almond croissant is very crunchy on outside but soft on the inside. It wasn't super sweet and had a million almond slices on it. Service - not the best. This place is a lot smaller than expected
text_en: Really good pastries! I'm in love with their almond croissant ($4). I honestly wasn't expecting much but was very surprised. The almond croissant is very crunchy on outside but soft on the inside. It wasn't super sweet and had a million almond slices on it. Service - not the best. This place is a lot smaller than expected

text: Homer Simpson ha fallecido y ha ido al cielo! ¡Tiene las mejores donas de Las Vegas, del mundo! Probé la barra de donas con maple y tocino, ¡simplemente no pude parar! Tuve que tomar tres y una taza de café caliente. Lo mejor es empezar el día visitando la barra de donas y poniendo una dona de chocolate y una taza de café caliente. Si quieres ser un héroe en tu trabajo, compra una docena en el camino al trabajo y ¡voilà!, tu personal te adorará... ¡Donas geniales! ¡El mejor secreto escondido de Las Vegas!
text_en: Homer Simpson has died and gone to heaven! He has the best donuts in Las Vegas, the best in the world! I tried the maple and bacon donut bar—I just couldn’t stop eating! I had to drink three cups of hot coffee along with it. The best thing to do is start your day by going to the donut bar and getting a chocolate donut and a cup of hot coffee. If you want to be a hero at work, buy a dozen of them on your way to work—and voilà! Your colleagues will adore you… Great donuts! The best secret of Las Vegas!
original: Homer Simpson has die and gone to Heaven! Man the best donuts in Las Vegas, in the world! I had the maple and Bacon bar, I just couldn't have one I had to have three and a cup of hot coffee. The best thing to do, first thing in the morning it to stop the Donut Bar and put up a cake donut and hot cup of coffee.. You want to be a hero at your job, pick up a dozen on the way to work and bam your staff will love you...... Great Donuts.... Las Vegas Best hidden secret.....

text: Después de pasar por este lugar varias veces y preguntándonos qué era un "consorcio de panadería", finalmente entramos y descubrimos una hermosa cafetería y panadería. El espacio está decorado como un salón de té tradicional de época, con vitrinas de pasteles de cristal, asientos y mesas de hierro forjado, y un papel pintado llamativo. Lo que mi esposo describió como una "interpretación hipster de la música jazz de los años 20" sonaba de fondo. Hay una impresionante variedad de postres expuestos, incluyendo opciones veganas (desafortunadamente, sin opciones sin gluten ese día). El barista fue excelente y se cuidó mucho al preparar mi americano y el pour-over de mi esposo, y el resultado fue delicioso. Si planean una visita rápida, no se pierdan este lugar acogedor para charlar y disfrutar de un postre. Les recomiendo que instalen mejor señalización, ya que al principio no estábamos seguros de si podíamos entrar. Pero sí, ¡váyanse y disfruten de una agradable tarde tomando café y comiendo algo!
text_en: After visiting this place several times and wondering what a “bakery consortium” meant, we finally went in and discovered a beautiful café and bakery. The space is decorated like a traditional tea room from the era, with glass display cases for cakes, iron-finished chairs and tables, and eye-catching wallpaper. What my husband described as a “hipster interpretation of 20th-century jazz music” could be heard in the background. There’s a impressive variety of desserts on display, including vegan options—Unfortunately, there were no gluten-free options that day. The barista was excellent and took great care in preparing my American coffee and my husband’s pour-over coffee; the results were delicious. If you plan to visit quickly, don’t miss out on this cozy place for chatting and enjoying a dessert. I recommend improving the signage, as at first we weren’t sure if we could enter. But yes, go ahead and enjoy a pleasant afternoon drinking coffee and eating something!
original: After running by this place numerous times and wondering what a "bake consortium" was, we finally walked in and discovered a beautiful coffee and bake shop. The space is decorated like a traditional old-fashioned tea parlor with crystal cake stands, wrought iron seating and tables, and dramatic wallpaper. What my husband referred to as a"hipster interpretation of 1920s jazz music" played in the background. An impressive array of treats are on display, including vegan options (no gluten-free on this day, sadly). The barista was excellent and took great care with my americano and my husband's pour over, and they tasted lovely because of it. A quick trip this is not- plan on stopping by in their cozy space for a chat and a dessert. I do suggest better signage, since we weren't sure if we could go in at first! But do go, and enjoy a lovely afternoon brew and treat.

text: Eu já fui aqui algumas vezes e, em nenhuma ocasião, tive um bom atendimento. Os funcionários sempre pareciam impacientes comigo, como se estivessem me fazendo um favor! Mesmo que a comida fosse boa, eu não conseguia me apegar muito a este lugar.
text_en: I’ve been here several times, but never once did I receive good service. The staff always seemed impatient with me, as if they were doing me a favor! Even though the food was good, I couldn’t really feel attached to this place.
original: I've come here a few times and never once had good service. The staff was always impatient with me, like they were doing me a favor! Even if the food was good, I couldn't bring myself to love this place too much.

text: Wow, just had a cinnamon cupcake and it's probably the best I've ever had! Tasted just like a snickerdoodle cookie. Don't miss this spit on the LINQ Promenade. It's full of little hidden gems.
text_en: Wow, just had a cinnamon cupcake and it's probably the best I've ever had! Tasted just like a snickerdoodle cookie. Don't miss this spit on the LINQ Promenade. It's full of little hidden gems.

text: I don't know why this gets so much praise. it's not that good. Maybe for people that don't have high standards, but I've yet to be impressed by this place. They are always packed though so someone must like it, but I really don't see it.
text_en: I don't know why this gets so much praise. it's not that good. Maybe for people that don't have high standards, but I've yet to be impressed by this place. They are always packed though so someone must like it, but I really don't see it.

text: La mejor crepes que he probado. Fue una excelente manera de dar la bienvenida a Cleveland, visitando este puesto dentro del West Side Market. Originalmente, pensé que era un restaurante, pero no fue un problema. El servicio fue rápido. Es divertido ver cómo preparan su crepes. ¡Recomiendo la de pollo, bacon y salsa ranch!
text_en: The best crepes I’ve ever tried. It was an excellent way to welcome Cleveland by visiting this place at the West Side Market. Initially, I thought it was a restaurant, but that wasn’t a problem. The service was quick. It’s fun to see how they prepare their crepes. I recommend the chicken, bacon, and ranch sauce crepe!
original: Best crepe I've had. This was a good way to be welcomed to Cleveland - visiting this stand inside the West Side Market. Originally, I thought it was a sit down restaurant, but it wasn't an issue. Service was quick. It's fun to watch them make your crepe. I recommend the chicken bacon ranch!

text: So far, this is one of my favorite Italian Bakeries in Las Vegas. We walked in about 10:30 am and it wasn't busy at all. We talked with Austin while placing our order and he gave us a few great suggestions. I liked the Nutella filled cookie, Pistachio Biscotti, butter cookies, Cannoli, and the Boston Cream. The Cannoli sweet, with chocolate chips, a great filling and a fresh crunch. I hate soggy ones, so this made my day. We waited to pay as he wrapped our purchases in boxes and even tied them shut with a string. It wasn't a speedy transaction and it can be a little pricey for some (I got a lot of stuff for $26.00), but it's Vegas. Live a little. For great Italian baked goods, service and attitude, this is the place!

text: Always my family's favorite! Absolutely love the Watermelon sorbet since our first visit. I love the style of their shops, friendly staff, and the awesome variety of flavors. I recommend getting a scoop of Peaberry espresso and chocolate sorbet together. Pretty delicious!
text_en: Always my family's favorite! Absolutely love the Watermelon sorbet since our first visit. I love the style of their shops, friendly staff, and the awesome variety of flavors. I recommend getting a scoop of Peaberry espresso and chocolate sorbet together. Pretty delicious!

text: Llegamos aquí el miércoles, mientras nos íbamos de Cleveland. No había cola y pudimos hacer nuestro pedido bastante rápido. Pedimos la crepes con salmón ahumado y ¡nos encantó! Es una pena que no vivamos en la zona. De lo contrario, volveríamos para probar otros platos del menú. El personal fue amable. ¡Nos encanta este lugar!
text_en: We arrived here on Wednesday, as we were leaving Cleveland. There was no long line, and we could place our order quite quickly. We ordered crepes with smoked salmon, and we really loved them! It’s a pity that we don’t live in the area. Otherwise, we would come back to try other dishes on the menu. The staff were friendly. We really enjoy this place!
original: We came here on a Wednesday as we were leaving Cleveland. There was no line and we got our order pretty quick. We ordered the Smoke Salmon crepe and loved it! Too bad we don't live in the area. Otherwise, we would be returning to try items on the menu! Guy was friendly. Love the place!

text: Exceptional savory and dessert selections. Absolutely the worst ordering sequence on the planet. Yes I still come once a month with my spouse but always get frustrated when it comes to ordering. Would be 5 stars if they could think a little and solve this. It's simple folks!
text_en: Exceptional savory and dessert selections. Absolutely the worst ordering sequence on the planet. Yes I still come once a month with my spouse but always get frustrated when it comes to ordering. Would be 5 stars if they could think a little and solve this. It's simple folks!

text: This place is great!!! The flavors they offer are unique and have strong flavors that leave your mouth watering. Beware this place is very popular and you may find yourself in a long line down the street! That only means one thing...this place is on fire!!
text_en: This place is great!!! The flavors they offer are unique and have strong flavors that leave your mouth watering. Beware this place is very popular and you may find yourself in a long line down the street! That only means one thing...this place is on fire!!

text: Ao chegar ao Donut Bar, a placa na vitrine anuncia que eles têm os melhores donuts do mundo. Bem, devo dizer que eles podem estar certos. Como esta foi minha primeira visita, eu queria experimentar uma variedade de opções. Eu pedi o donut de "French toast" (pão francês). Eu não costumo usar a palavra "divino", mas essa descrição se aplica ao donut de "French toast". Era delicioso e grande o suficiente para nós dois compartilharem. Também pedimos o donut de "strawberry shortcake" (bolo de morango). Também estava muito bom. Os donuts de "bacon maple" (bacon e maple) e "bacon cinnamon roll" (bacon e canela) foram ótimas opções, combinando o sabor salgado do bacon e o doce do donut. A equipe, incluindo o chef Jeff, foi muito simpática e atenciosa de forma genuína. Com certeza voltarei na minha próxima viagem a Las Vegas.
text_en: When I arrived at the Donut Bar, the sign in the window announced that they had the best donuts in the world. Well, I must say they might be right. Since this was my first visit, I wanted to try out various options. I ordered the “French toast” donut—it was delicious and big enough for us both to share. We also ordered the “strawberry shortcake” donut; it was very good too. The “bacon maple” and “bacon cinnamon roll” donuts were also great, combining the salty flavor of bacon with the sweetness of the donut. The staff, including chef Jeff, were very kind and attentive. I definitely will come back when I visit Las Vegas again.
original: When you walk up to Donut Bar, the window proclaims they are the best donuts in the world. Well, I have to say they just might be right. As this was my first visit, I wanted to get a variety of treats to sample. I ordered the French toast doughnut. I don't often use the word heavenly, however that description applies to the French toast doughnut. It was exquisite and large enough for both my wife and I to split. We also ordered the strawberry shortcake doughnut. That was tasty as well. The bacon maple longjohn and the bacon cinnamon roll were both awesome treats combining the salty of bacon and the sweet of the doughnut. The staff including Chef Jeff were all nice and very friendly in a genuine way. I will definitely be back on my next trip to Vegas.

text: Após uma experiência maravilhosa em Windsor, decidimos caminhar os 20 passos até a sorveteria ao lado, chamada Churn, para experimentar. Ficamos muito satisfeitos, foi fantástico! Duas bolas de sorvete de café em um coninho de waffle foram a conclusão perfeita para uma ótima refeição! Ótimo sabor de café e o sorvete tinha a consistência perfeita, delicioso! Também pedimos um biscoito de sorvete, um biscoito de "snickerdoodle" com sorvete de café, que também foi excelente. Windsor e Churn, a combinação perfeita para uma refeição deliciosa :)
text_en: After an amazing experience in Windsor, we decided to walk the 20 steps to the ice cream shop next to it, called Churn, to try it out. We were very satisfied; it was fantastic! Two cups of coffee ice cream served with waffle creme were the perfect finish to a great meal! The coffee flavor was excellent, and the ice cream had the perfect consistency—delicious! We also ordered a ice cream biscuit, a “snickerdoodle” biscuit with coffee ice cream, which was also excellent. Windsor and Churn – the perfect combination for a delicious meal :)
original: After a delightful experience at Windsor, we decided to walk the 20 steps next door and check out Churn. Glad we did, it was fantastic! Two scoops of Coffee ice cream in a waffle cone was the perfect conclusion to a great meal! Great coffee flavor and the ice cream was the perfect consistency, yum! We also ordered an ice cream cookie, snickerdoodle cookie with coffee ice cream, which was equally splendid. Its Windsor and Churn for the one-two-punch of dining :)

text: This place will blow your socks off. They're amazing and it's one of my favorites to go for a treat. It's an adorable store just perfect for ice cream. They have cool drinks to choose from.. but most importantly the ice cream is BOMB. Best ice cream in Phoenix and the customer service is hands down the best I've had at an ice cream shop period. And they're open super late. Definitely will be back again and again for a late treat. Ps they have doughnut & waffle ice cream sandwiches

text: We were in town and looking for a dessert place and I came across Sweet Republic so decided to give it a try. I tried a scoop of Banana Foster and Huckleberry Swirl. Not that I didn't like the Huckleberry but I should have just gotten Banana Foster. It is literally my FAVORITE ice creams ever! I talk about it all the time. It is that good! When I get back to Scottsdale or Phoenix, I'll definitely be going back to get some more! Totally recommend this place! Delicious ice cream! The toffee sundae was a hit with the group too.

text: I just recently found out about Butterwood Bake Consortium and had to check it! It's essential a cake shop. The interior is rich and inviting. I love the red velvet chairs and benches. It's a pretty small space but it feels very comfortable. I almost overwhelmed by the amount of sweets options in the display case. I was also surprised to see multiple vegan options. After looking at all my options I decided to try the lemon poppy seed cake with a black berry buttercream and a hot chocolate. My two friends and I sat down and waited for desserts. The staff person was friendly and quickly brought out our cakes and drinks. The hot chocolate was a tea cup filled half way with melted chocolate that you poured cream into. It was delicious and rich! Definitely would recommend it to anyone who goes. The cake on the other hand was just okay. It was just a little to dense for liking but still a quality cake. I can't wait to go back and try more of their wonderful selections!

text: Fresh cones and raspberry ice cream was excellent! I also like the macadamia nut cookie ice cream and the hot fudge sundae with nuts. Very good.

text: Graham Central Station - enough said. Homemade daily, quality ice cream with the BEST mix-ins. I can't even tell you what's in Graham Central except that it is by far the best one we've tried. I'm not a graham cracker lover either. It's seriously just the best - try it. Not that any of the others are not good- they're all INCREDIBLE. It's only that I dream of Graham Central and try to find ways to "reward" my children (myself) by bringing them here. There's also $2 Tuesday where you'll get a GIGANTIC scoop of ice cream (when they say single scoop, it's pretty much the size of a double or triple) for $2. Lastly, we once ran into Dan Reynolds (lead singer of Imagine Dragons) here and I really really wanted my kids to say hi (ID is their favorite band and they know every song off of both CDs) but were too shy. So, next time you're in the mood for ice cream - come here, get a Hot Fudge Sundae with Graham Central & nuts. You're welcome!

text: Francamente, no me convenció mucho este lugar. Es una heladería pequeña y los empleados eran muy amables. La heladería en sí no destacaba por nada en particular, y yo sé que los otros cuatro adultos que iban conmigo también pensaban lo mismo. Sin embargo, la presencia de Aaron Goldsmith con su familia fue lo que realmente hizo especial la visita.
text_en: Honestly, I wasn’t very impressed with this place. It’s a small ice cream shop, and the employees were very friendly. The ice cream shop itself didn’t stand out in any particular way, and I know that the other four adults who went with me thought the same. However, the presence of Aaron Goldsmith and his family made the visit truly special.
original: I wasn't feelin this place quite honestly. It's a little hole in the wall and the employees were more than nice. The ice cream just didn't really set itself apart in anyway if I'm being honest and I know the 4 other adults with me felt same way. Nonetheless, Aaron Goldsmith was in front of us with his family and that was definitely the highlight
