text_en: Just came here again. Love this place. The owner and his staff are awesome!! Love the creme brÃ»lÃ©e. I wish I could try all the different donuts. They are all amazing!

text: He estado deseando un donut de glaseado de maple con tocino todo el día. Tengo tanta necesidad que pediré a mi esposo que me traiga algunos esta semana.
text_en: I’ve been craving a maple glazed donut with bacon all day. I really need it, so I’ll ask my husband to bring some for me this week.
original: I have been craving a maple bacon doughnut all day!! So desperate that I'll be putting a request for My husband to bring me some this week!

text: O Churn era uma sorveteria incrível. Eu pedi um shake com o sabor de menta e biscoitos, e estava delicioso. Os sorvetes são um pouco caros, mas definitivamente valem cada centavo. Eles têm uma pequena área para comer ao ar livre. O Windsor está logo ao lado e é administrado pelo mesmo proprietário. Recomendo ir ao Windsor para jantar e aproveitar a sobremesa no Churn. Seria uma noite maravilhosa!
text_en: Churn was an amazing ice cream shop. I ordered a mint-flavored shake with cookies, and it was delicious. The ice creams are a bit expensive, but they definitely pay for themselves. They have a small outdoor dining area. Windsor is right next to it, and it’s managed by the same owner. I recommend going to Windsor for dinner and enjoying the dessert at Churn. It would be a wonderful night!
original: Churn was an awesome ice cream shop. I got their mint chip and cookies as a shake and it was delicious. The ice cream is a little on the pricey side but was definitely worth every cent. They have a small outdoor eating area. The Windsor is right next door and owned by the same owner. I would recommend going to the Windsor for dinner and treating yourself to dessert at Churn. Would definitely be a wonderful night!

text: Eu adorei minha primeira experiência no Sweet Republic e já estou procurando motivos para voltar. Acredito que começarei a levar meus amigos, um por um (o que significa muitas mais viagens para mim)! Amei o atendimento, os sabores e a paixão que eles demonstram ao criar combinações de sabores maravilhosas. Escolher foi a parte mais difícil! Consegui decidir o que pedir depois de me convencer de que voltaria em breve e poderia experimentar algo diferente...
text_en: I loved my first experience at Sweet Republic, and I’m already looking for reasons to go back. I think I will start bringing my friends along, one by one (which means many more trips for me)! I really enjoyed the service, the flavors, and the passion they show in creating amazing flavor combinations. Choosing what to order was the most difficult part! I managed to decide what to order after being convinced that I would return soon and be able to try something different…
original: I absolutely loved my first experience at Sweet Republic and am already looking for reasons to go back. I believe I will start taking all of my friends one at a time (this means many more trips for me)! I loved the customer service, the flavors and the passion that they clearly have for creating wonderful flavor combinations. Choosing was the hardest part! I was only able to decide on what to have after I consoled myself with the knowledge that I would be back soon and could have something different...

text: O Churn é definitivamente um lugar animado, e a equipe sempre está disposta a ajudar. Meu sorvete favorito é o "Delícia para maiores de 21 anos".
text_en: Churn is definitely a lively place, and the staff is always ready to help. My favorite ice cream is the “Delight for Adults Over 21”.
original: Churn is definetly a popping place and the staff is always upbeat. My favorite ice cream is their 21 and over delight.

text: O melhor lugar em Ohio City para parar e comprar sorvete! Uma das minhas coisas favoritas aqui é um milk shake com o sabor "double chunk", com chantilly e raspas de chocolate. Outra coisa ótima sobre o Mitchell's é a variedade de sabores. O Mitchell's está sempre lançando novos sabores. Então, você nunca fica entediado. Dica: Nos fins de semana e em algumas noites da semana, a loja pode ficar muito cheia, com uma fila que se estende pela porta. Se você só quer uma ou duas bolas de sorvete, pode pular a fila comprando uma pote inteiro. Já fiz isso em várias ocasiões quando a fila estava muito grande. O Mitchell's é uma ótima sorveteria com uma atmosfera incrível. Desde que me mudei para cá, tornou-se um dos meus lugares favoritos para parar e levar as pessoas.
text_en: The best place in Ohio City to stop and buy ice cream! One of my favorite things here is a milk shake with the “double chunk” flavor, with whipped cream and chocolate shards. Another great thing about Mitchell’s is the variety of flavors. Mitchell’s always introduces new flavors. So, you never get bored. Tip: On weekends and some weekdays, the store can get very crowded, with a line stretching all the way to the door. If you just want one or two scoops of ice cream, you can skip the line and buy a whole pot. I’ve done this several times when the line was too long. Mitchell’s is an excellent ice cream shop with a fantastic atmosphere. Since I moved here, it’s become one of my favorite places to stop and give people ice cream.
original: Best spot in Ohio City to stop and get some ice cream! One of my favorite things to get here is a milk shake using the double chunk flavor with whip cream and chocolate flakes. The other great thing about Mitchell's is the amount of different flavors. Mitchell's is always coming out with something new. So, you never get bored. Tip: During the weekends and some week nights the store can get a bit crazy with a line out the door. If you just want a scoop or so of ice cream you can skip the line by going and grabbing a pint. I have done this on several occasions when the line has been horrible. Mitchell's is a great ice cream shop that has an amazing atmosphere. Since moving here it has become one of my favorite places to stop and bring people to.

text: Eu vim de outra cidade e o atendimento aqui foi péssimo. A atendente foi um pouco rude, e depois de pagar, não houve nem um "tenha um bom dia" ou algo assim. Talvez ela estivesse tendo um dia ruim, mas sim, o atendimento ao cliente foi muito, muito ruim. Além disso, esta loja só tinha 12 sabores, e nenhum deles era interessante ou diferente. Tudo igual, nada de especial. Eles nem fazem seus próprios sorvetes. Em resumo, não recomendo ir a este lugar. É apenas um lugar comum, sem nada de especial.
text_en: I came from another city, and the service here was terrible. The clerk was a bit rude, and after paying, there wasn’t even a “have a good day” or anything like that. Maybe she had a bad day, but definitely, the customer service was very, very poor. Additionally, this store only offered 12 flavors, and none of them were interesting or different. Everything was the same; nothing special. They don’t even make their own ice cream. In short, I don’t recommend going to this place. It’s just an ordinary store with nothing special.
original: I came here from out of town and the service here sucked. The girl helping us out was kind of rude and after I paid there wasn't even a "have a good day" or anything. Maybe she was having a bad day but yeah, customer service was very VERY poor. In addition, this shop only had 12 flavors and none of them were appealing or unique. Same old same old nothing special. They dont even make their own cones. In short, going to keep exploring this was a skip for me. It's nothing special just average all around.

text: Así que, lo primero: me gustan los cafés con sabor a café. Por eso, es lo que bebo. Solo he probado el café de filtro y los pasteles, ¡pero su café de filtro es increíble! Estoy seguro de que el resto de sus bebidas de café son igual de buenas. Los pasteles son las estrellas del espectáculo. Recomiendo encarecidamente los "pop tarts". Son deliciosos y muy satisfactorios. Trabajo literalmente a 10 pasos de aquí, así que se convirtió rápidamente en un lugar que frecuento todos los días. No hay mucho más que decir. Si aún no has venido, te estás perdiendo esta joya.
text_en: So, first of all: I like coffee with a strong flavor. That’s what I drink. I’ve only tried filter coffee and the pastries, but their filter coffee is incredible! I’m sure all their other coffee drinks are just as good. The pastries are the star of the show. I highly recommend the “pop tarts”. They’re delicious and very satisfying. I work literally ten steps away from here, so it quickly became a place I visit every day. There’s not much more to say. If you haven’t been there yet, you’re missing out on this gem.
original: So, first things first... I like coffee-flavored coffee. So, that's what I drink. I've only had the drip coffee and pastries, but their drip is out of this world! I am certain the rest of their coffee drinks are just as good. The pastries are the rockstar of the show. I strongly recommend the pop tarts. They decadent AF and incredibly delicious! I work literally 10 steps from here, so it quickly became a daily stop. Not much else to say. If you've not been, you're totally missing out on this little gem.

text: Tenía grandes expectativas al llegar, debido a las reseñas, pero realmente me decepcionó la variedad y el sabor. El helado estaba regular y el precio era elevado. Preferiría comprar helado de Ben & Jerry's en el supermercado local.
text_en: I had high expectations when I arrived, thanks to the reviews, but the variety and flavor really disappointed me. The ice cream was average, and the price was too high. I would prefer to buy Ben & Jerry’s ice cream at the local supermarket.
original: My expectations were high coming in due to the reviews but really was unimpressed with selection and taste. Ice cream was eh and cost was high. Would rather get Ben and Jerry's from the local mart.

text: La tarta de frutas estaba bien, tenía muchas frutas, pero el relleno de la tarta era demasiado dulce para mi gusto. Tenía un relleno similar a la mermelada de frambuesa dentro de la masa de la tarta; era bastante peculiar. El zumo de naranja y la tarta costaron un total de 11 dólares. Era bastante caro.
text_en: The fruit tart was good; it had lots of fruits, but the filling was too sweet for my taste. There was a jam-like filling inside the tart dough; it was quite unusual. The orange juice and the tart together cost a total of 11 dollars. It was quite expensive.
original: Fruit tart was ok lots of fruit but the tart filling was too sweet for me. It had this raspberry jam-like filling inside the tart crust; kind of unique. Orange juice and the tart came out to be $11! Quite expensive.

text: Adorei o cheesecake, os brownies e os cupcakes. Uau! A única desvantagem é que não servem leite com chocolate.
text_en: I loved the cheesecake, brownies, and cupcakes. Wow! The only downside is that they don’t serve milk with chocolate.
original: Loved the cheesecake, brownie and cupcakes. Omg!!!!! Only downfall they do not have chocolate milk

text: Adoro este sorvete, o de chocolate com cereja. É o meu favorito.
text_en: I love this ice cream—chocolate with cherry. It’s my favorite.

text: Habría sido genial si 85 degree bakery se hubiera abierto en Las Vegas hace décadas, alrededor de 2009, pero como esperaron demasiado, durante todos mis viajes a California y de regreso a mi país, mi entusiasmo por esta panadería desapareció antes de que abrieran una en Las Vegas. Finalmente, hoy tuve la oportunidad de entrar por primera vez, ¿por qué? porque cuando abrieron, siempre veía una fila muy larga, y no quería perder el tiempo esperando, así que finalmente hoy, vi que no había fila y decidí entrar y ver qué tal era, en primer lugar, ni siquiera tenían el pan más popular y común, "Buttermilk Boroh Bun". No lo encontré, así que decidí preguntar a alguien que trabajaba en la tienda, creo que se llamaba Jasmine. Aquí está cómo fue nuestra conversación: "Disculpe, ¿pero tienen...?", antes de que siquiera pudiera terminar mi frase, dijo: "Lo siento, pero el pan estará disponible pronto". ¡Vaya!, ¿es que lee la mente o algo así? Aparte de eso, no era eso lo que quería preguntarle, solo quería saber si tenían el "Buttermilk Bun". Sin embargo, debo reconocer que se disculpó, pero, ¡vaya!, ¿les damos dos meses y esta es la calidad de atención al cliente que ofrecen? ¿Simplemente ignorar a los clientes con respuestas genéricas? De todos modos, para mi sorpresa, ni siquiera saben qué es el "Buttermilk Bun" (¡Deben saberlo, ya que es un pan asiático!), y, por cierto, no es un pan de piña (¡un nombre estúpido que usaron en la panadería JJ!), la traducción correcta es "Buttermilk Bun". Pues, para mí, eso es suficiente. El servicio al cliente me ha decepcionado por completo. Me alegro de haber perdido solo 5 minutos allí.
text_en: It would have been great if 85 Degree Bakery had opened in Las Vegas decades ago, around 2009. But since they waited too long, during all my trips to California and back to my country, my enthusiasm for this bakery disappeared before it even opened in Las Vegas. Finally, today I got the chance to enter it for the first time. Why? Because whenever it opened, there was always a very long line, and I didn’t want to waste time waiting. So today, seeing that there was no line, I decided to go in and see how it was. First of all, they didn’t even have the most popular and common bread, “Buttermilk Boroh Bun”. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to ask someone who worked there—I think her name was Jasmine. Here’s what our conversation was like: “Excuse me, but do you have…?” Before I could finish my sentence, she said, “I’m sorry, but the bread will be available soon.” Wow! Does she read my mind or something? Other than that, that wasn’t what I wanted to ask. I just wanted to know if they had “Buttermilk Bun”. However, I must admit that she apologized, but wow! We give them two months, and this is the level of customer service they offer? Just ignoring customers with generic responses? Anyway, to my surprise, they don’t even know what “Buttermilk Bun” is (they should know, since it’s a Asian bread!). And by the way, it’s not a pineapple bread (a stupid name they used at JJ Bakery!). The correct translation is “Buttermilk Bun”. For me, that’s enough. The customer service has completely disappointed me. I’m glad I spent only 5 minutes there.
original: It would've been nice if 85 degree bakery opened in Vegas a decades ago around 2009, but since they waited too long, between all my trips to california and back in my home country, my excitement about this bakery already vanished by the time they opened one in Vegas. I finally had a chance to walk in for the first time today, why? because when they first opened, I always see there's a super long line, I do not want to waste my time waiting, so finally today, I see there's no line and I decided to walk in and check it out what's the hype, first of all, they don't even carry the most popular and most common bread "Buttermilk Boroh Bun", I couldn't find it so I decided to ask someone who worked at the store, I believe her name was Jasmine, here's how our conversation goes "Excuse me, but do you.....", before I could even finish my sentence she said "Sorry, but the tray will be out soon", wow, is she a mind reader or something? except that wasn't even what I was going to ask her, I was just going to ask her if they have buttermilk bun, I did want to give her credit for apologizing though, but geez, we give you two month and this is the kind of customer service you provide? to just brush off customer with some "common answers"? anyway, to my shock, she doesn't even know what buttermilk bun is (I was in shock, all ASIAN baker should know what that bread is, and just fyi, no it's not pineapple bun(stupid name they used in jj bakery), the right translation should be buttermilk bun. So that does it for me, the customer service just completely turned me off, I'm glad I only wasted 5 minutes of my time in there.

text: I read about this place on The Pioneer Woman blog, and when Peter and I planned a visit to Ikea we decided to make a stop. We split a Croque Monsier. It was tasty, but next time we come here (the will be a next time for sure!) I'd probably try something else, or skip lunch altogether and just pick up some dessert. We got quite a selection of baked goods, and would order most again. We had some macarons and a salted caramel brownie at the actual restaurant. We both loved the pistachio, but the orange and lemon tasted a little bit like Fruit Loops and seemed stale compared to the pistachio. We took home a box full of goodies (another brownie, an eclair, a chocolate croissant, two more macarons, and a petit four) that we ate over the next couple of days. All were delicious. Peter said the eclair was exactly what an eclair should be. My favorite was the salted caramel brownie, it was heaven. I am a sucker for anything salty, especially sweet and salty, so this is no surprise. It was totally worth a stop, but I wouldn't make a special trip to Charlotte just to eat here.

text: Llegamos justo cuando abrieron el sábado, ya que esperábamos donuts recién hechos. Los empleados eran amables y nos ayudaron a decidir qué comprar. Optamos por un donut de crema de Bostón, un donut de "pop-tart" de arándanos, un rollo de canela con tocino de arce, un donut de pastel de Oreo, un donut de sándwich de queso, un "creme brûlée" (donuts con cobertura caramelizada), y un donut de Nutella. El donut de crema de Bostón era regular, nada especial, pero estaba bien y tenía una buena proporción de crema. El donut de "pop-tart" de arándanos era interesante, pero tampoco destacaba. El rollo de canela estaba un poco quemado, pero el centro era bueno. El donut de pastel de Oreo era bueno, siempre y cuando obtuvieras una porción completa de Oreo. El donut de sándwich de queso era enorme y, en general, estaba bastante bien. Venía con una salsa de Sriracha para mojar. Olvidé tomar una foto. El "creme brûlée" fue decepcionante, simplemente sabía como un donut normal con relleno. El donut de Nutella estaba bien, pero no noté mucho sabor a Nutella. Le di a este lugar 2 estrellas porque esperaba mucho más debido a su buena calificación, pero en general, me decepcionó. Tal vez simplemente no soy de los que comen donuts.
text_en: We arrived right when they opened on Saturday, as we were expecting freshly made donuts. The staff were friendly and helped us decide what to buy. We chose a Boston cream donut, a raspberry “pop-tart” donut, a cinnamon roll with maple bacon, an Oreo cake donut, a cheese sandwich donut, a “creme brûlée” donut (donuts with caramelized topping), and a Nutella donut. The Boston cream donut was average—nothing special, but it was still good and had a proper amount of cream. The raspberry “pop-tart” donut was interesting, but not particularly outstanding. The cinnamon roll was slightly burnt, but the center was good. The Oreo cake donut was fine, as long as you got a full piece of Oreo. The cheese sandwich donut was huge and overall quite good. It came with a Sriracha sauce to dip in. I forgot to take a photo. The “creme brûlée” donut was disappointing—it just tasted like a regular donut with filling. The Nutella donut was okay, but I didn’t notice much of a Nutella flavor. I gave this place 2 stars because I expected much more given its good rating, but overall, it was disappointing. Maybe I just aren’t one of those people who eat donuts.
original: We got there right as they opened on Saturday as we were expecting freshly made donuts. The employees were friendly and helped us decide on what to get. We went with a Boston cream, blueberry poptart donut, maple bacon cinnamon roll, oreo cake donut, donut grilled cheese, creme Bru Lee, and the Nutella donut. The Boston cream was average nothing special, it was nice and airy and the had a good cream ratio. The blueberry poptart donut was cool but again nothing special. The cinnamon roll was overbaked but the very center was good. The oreo cake donut was good as long as you got a bite full of oreo. The donut grilled cheese was massive and was pretty good I think. It came with a Sriracha dipping sauce. I forgot to snag a pic of it. The creme Bru Lee was very underwhelming it just tasted like a plain donut with filling. The Nutella donut was good but I didn't really taste the Nutella. I gave this place 2 stars because I was expecting so much more due to its rating but for the most part I was disappointed. Maybe I'm just not a donut person.

text: Ok, para começar, este lugar tem um cheiro incrível! (Pelo menos, esse é o cheiro que eu imagino que o paraíso tenha). A fila para os doces era bem longa. Esperei cerca de 20 minutos antes de chegar a minha vez, mas valeu a pena. Há tantas opções de doces, mas eu escolhi um cannoli tradicional, um cannoli de chocolate, um bolo de mousse de chocolate branco e um bombom de creme de avelã. Eu realmente queria um biscoito preto e branco, mas infelizmente eles estavam esgotados. Tudo o que eu escolhi estava delicioso! Meu preferido seria a mousse de chocolate branco. A $9,95, fiquei um pouco cético se valeria a pena, mas eu adoraria pagar de novo. Talvez eu tenha comido tudo sozinho... Não me arrependo. Os cannolis eram ótimos. Eles tinham um sabor caseiro, como deveriam. Eu preferi o cannoli tradicional ao de chocolate. Recomendo deixá-los em temperatura ambiente por cerca de 10 minutos antes de comer, pois, quando estão diretamente da geladeira, é um pouco difícil morder. Eles estavam muito melhores depois de descongelados :) Que bom que não moro perto do Carlo's, caso contrário, eu estaria super gordo(a) (mas eu estaria feliz!).
text_en: Okay, to start, this place has an amazing smell! (At least that’s what I imagine the paradise should smell like.) The line for the sweets was quite long. I waited about 20 minutes before my turn came, but it was worth it. There are so many options for sweets, but I chose a traditional cannoli, a chocolate cannoli, a white chocolate mousse cake, and a almond cream candy. I really wanted a black and white biscuit, but unfortunately they were out of stock. Everything I ordered was delicious! My favorite was the white chocolate mousse. At $9.95, I was a bit skeptical whether it was worth it, but I would love to pay again. Maybe I ate everything by myself… I don’t regret it. The cannoli were great. They had a homey flavor, just as they should be. I preferred the traditional cannoli over the chocolate one. I recommend letting them sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes before eating, because when they’re right out of the fridge, it’s a bit hard to bite into. They were much better after thawing :) It’s good that I don’t live near Carlo’s; otherwise, I would be super fat (but I would be happy!).
original: Ok first off, this place SMELLS like heaven! (What I imagine heaven smells like, anyway) The line was quite long for pastries. I waited about 20 minutes before it was my turn but it was well worth the wait. There's so many desserts to choose from, but I chose a regular cannoli, chocolate cannoli, white chocolate mousse cake and a hazelnut cream puff. I really wanted a black and white cookie but unfortunately they were sold out for the day. Everything I chose was delicious! My favorite would have to be the white chocolate mousse. At $9.95 I was a bit skeptical on whether it would be worth the money but I'd happily pay this again. I may have eaten the whole thing by myself.............. Not sorry. The cannolis were awesome. They tasted homemade, as they should. I preferred the regular cannoli over the chocolate covered one. I recommend letting them sit out like 10 mins before eating them because when they're straight from the fridge it's a bit hard to bite into. It tasted better when thawed out :) Good thing I don't live near Carlo's because I'd be super fat if I did (but I'd be happyyyy)!

text: Los donuts son el postre perfecto para la mañana, y ayer fue el día perfecto para una visita a Donut Bar. Esta tienda de donuts está ubicada justo al lado de Fremont Street y es fantástica desde el momento en que entras. Tan pronto como entras por la puerta principal, te reciben empleados muy amables y una gran variedad de donuts, probablemente los más bonitos que hayas visto. Tienen una gran selección y, cuando llegué alrededor de las 7:30 de la mañana, había unas 20 o 30 variedades diferentes. Al final, probé tres y fueron el donut grande con forma de pastel de cumpleaños, el pequeño donut con forma de pastel de cumpleaños y Oreo, con un trozo de Oreo en el centro, y el tercer donut era similar a un donut de "Rocky Road" (creo, perdóname). Desde el primer bocado del donut de "Rocky Road" grande, supe que había encontrado mi nueva tienda de donuts favorita, y no hubo comparación. Después, probé el donut relleno de pastel de cumpleaños, y estaba delicioso. La masa aquí es súper suave y la galleta de Oreo dentro lo convierten en un donut verdaderamente especial. El último donut que consumí (literalmente hace 10 minutos) fue el donut grande con forma de pastel de cumpleaños. No solo era grande y suave, sino que los ingredientes y la crema lo convirtieron en el mejor donut de pastel de cumpleaños que he probado. En general, Donut Bar es mi nueva tienda de donuts favorita, sin duda. El personal es increíblemente amable y servicial, el propio local es fantástico, con un acuario decorado con donuts, y los donuts en sí son de primera calidad y absolutamente deliciosos. Si te gustan los donuts, este es el lugar perfecto para ti.
text_en: Donuts are the perfect dessert for morning time. Yesterday was the perfect day to visit Donut Bar. This donut shop is located right next to Fremont Street, and it’s fantastic from the moment you enter. As soon as you walk in through the main door, friendly staff greet you, and there’s a wide variety of donuts—probably the most beautiful ones you’ve ever seen. They have a great selection; when I arrived around 7:30 in the morning, there were about 20 or 30 different varieties. In the end, I tried three types: the large birthday cake-shaped donut, the small birthday cake-shaped donut, and Oreo with an Oreo piece in the middle. The third donut was similar to a “Rocky Road” donut (I think so, please forgive me). From the first bite of the “Rocky Road” donut, I knew I had found my new favorite donut shop—there’s no comparison. Then I tried the birthday cake-filled donut—it was delicious. The dough here is super soft, and the Oreo cookie inside makes it a truly special donut. The last donut I ate (literally 10 minutes ago) was the large birthday cake-shaped donut. It wasn’t just big and soft, but the ingredients and cream made it the best birthday cake-shaped donut I’ve ever tasted. Overall, Donut Bar is definitely my new favorite donut shop. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful, the place itself is great—with an aquarium decorated with donuts, and the donuts themselves are of top quality and absolutely delicious. If you like donuts, this is the perfect place for you.
original: Donuts are the perfect treat in the morning and yesterday was the perfect day for a morning trip to the Donut Bar. This donut shop is located right off of Fremont Street and is awesome from the moment you walk in. As soon as you walk in the front door you are greeted by some extremely friendly employees and a ton of the best looking donuts you'll probably ever lay you're eyes on. They have a huge selection and it was probably about 20-30 different flavours when I showed up around 7:30AM. I ended up giving 3 a try and they were the big birthday cake donut, the little birthday cake/oreo donut with an oreo in the middle of it, and the third donut was the large equivalent to basically a rocky road donut (I think, give me a break here). From the first bite of the big rocky road donut I knew that I had a new favourite donut shop and it wasn't even a contest. Next I ate the stuffed birthday cake donut and it was oh so darn good. The dough here is super soft and the oreo cookie inside made this one a truly special donut. The final donut I consumed (literally 10 minutes ago) was the large birthday cake donut. Not only was this thing large and soft, but the toppings and cream made it the best birthday cake donut I've ever had. Overall, Donut Bar is my new favourite Donut shop, period. The staff was incredibly friendly and talkative, the establishment itself was awesome featuring a fish tank with donut decorations, and the donuts themselves were top of the line tasty and they were absolutely delicious. If you like donuts, this is the place for you!

I took an Uber there, so it wasn’t easy to get back. I opened my cup and used a spoon, but I couldn’t find any “boba”!! I’m very disappointed, since I paid for it! Moreover, both the receipt and the cup clearly stated “boba”. I also included a photo as proof.
original: They lose 2 stars for forgetting my boba that I paid for!!!! The cashier was nice but I specifically asked for boba in my green milk tea. I took an Uber to this place so it's not like I could return easily. I opened up my cup and dug with a spoon only to find no boba!! I'm very upset as I paid for it! original: Thunder buddies was delicious! Ice cream had a great consistency and was not overly sweet. Would love to come back and try others when I'm in the area.

I love ordering the tasting option, which includes 4 medium-sized cups at a great price, so I can try several flavors. The staff are friendly, and it’s the best ice cream in the city! I will definitely come back again!
original: Awesome ice cream best in town! Great flavors and so many to choose from. I love to get the sampler it's 4 med sized scoops for a great price and u get to try them this way. Friendly staff and the best ice cream in town! Definitely will come again and again!!!!

text: Li ótimas avaliações sobre este lugar e ainda vejo amigos recomendando, especialmente para quem vai a Las Vegas, mas, para ser sincero, não ficamos muito impressionados. text_en: I’ve heard great reviews of this place, and I still see friends recommending it, especially for those going to Las Vegas. But, to be honest, we weren’t very impressed. The cake was terribly dry, and, obviously, very expensive. I would avoid this place and simply enjoy the dessert at one of the high-quality restaurants available in Las Vegas instead.
original: I've read great reviews on this place and still see friends suggesting it to other friends heading to Vegas, but we were not impressed to say the least. The cake was terribly dry and obviously way over priced. Would skip this and just enjoy desert at one of the fine dining that is readily available in Vegas.

text: No wonder this place made one of the top 10 ice cream places in the country! It's a little taste of Heaven!!! I got the Campfire S'more sundae with the Madagascar vanilla and chocolate scoops. I'll admit that I got it just to see the marshmellow on top get slightly toasted with the dessert torch. It felt and tasted like eating a creme brulee marshmellow on top of a giant ice cream s'more. My husband got the Peanut Butter Brittle sundae, which was also nothing less than perfect! It was hilarious because there were two visitors from Atlanta in front of us in line, who has just come straight from the airport to Sweet Republic because they had to try this ice cream!! I guess that show "The Best Thing I Ever Ate" truly does help recognize this unique ice cream shop and the ice cream speaks for itself. I really wanted my husband to try the jalepeno avocado bacon brittle ice cream, but unfortunately this flavor was unavailable on Friday, so I'll try to check and see if it's there the next time we return. On the up side, we were able to purchase a bag of bacon brittle to take home with us. Of course, we didn't wait until we got home to try it. We broke off pieces of the bacon brittle and stuck them in our sundaes. Un-freaking-believable!!! Man! I love this place!

text: Durante un viaje reciente, un amigo me sugirió que pasara y probara los donuts y me pidiera su opinión... bueno, no me convencieron los dos que probé... primero, me sorprendió el tamaño de los donuts... eran enormes. casi demasiado grandes... no sé si se pueden llamar donuts... "Doughnut Planet" en Nueva York tiene donuts grandes, pero estos eran aún más grandes. La variedad era interesante, pero los dos que elegí no tenían sabor. "Vanilla bean" y "Boston creme"... los bizcochos de ambos no tenían sabor, pero el relleno del "Boston creme" era delicioso. La tienda es bastante agradable y la gente es amable, pero por favor, "Donut Bar", inviertan en bolsas de papel para los donuts. Salir de la tienda con dos donuts en una caja parece un gran desperdicio y no es lo que el mundo necesita...
text_en: During a recent trip, a friend suggested I go in and try the donuts, and ask for their opinion… well, neither of the donuts I tried impressed me at all… First, the size of the donuts surprised me—they were huge. Almost too big… I don’t know if they can really be called donuts… “Doughnut Planet” in New York has large donuts, but these were even bigger. The variety was interesting, but the two donuts I chose had no flavor. “Vanilla bean” and “Boston creme”… both cookies had no flavor, but the filling in “Boston creme” was delicious. The store is quite pleasant, and the people are friendly, but please, “Donut Bar,” invest in paper bags for the donuts. Leaving the store with two donuts in a box seems like a great waste, and it’s not what the world needs.
original: on a recent trip a friend said to stop by and try the donuts and give him my thoughts... well not a fan of the two donuts i had.... first i was surprised by the size of the donuts... huge. almost too big... i am not sure you can call them donuts.... doughnut planet in nyc has big doughnuts but these were far bigger..... the variety was varied and all interesting but the two i selected were flavor-less. vanilla bean and boston creme... the cakes of both had no flavor but the filling of the boston creme was delicious. the shop is cute enough and the people friendly but please donut bar invest in paper bags for the donuts..walking out of the shop with two donuts in a box seems like such a waste and not what the earth needs......

text: Estive muito ansioso para visitar, depois de ver tantas fotos de sorvetes da Jeni's nas redes sociais. A própria sorveteria é muito charmosa e moderna. Adoro o design elegante das mesas ao ar livre e o letreiro bem iluminado, que a fazem se destacar! Além disso, é convenientemente localizada perto da linha de trem e em torno de muitos restaurantes, tornando-a um ótimo lugar para sobremesas. Quando entrei pela primeira vez, fui imediatamente envolvido pelo aroma delicioso de sorvetes e confeitos recém-feitos. Gostaria de capturar esse aroma e transformá-lo em uma vela que eu pudesse acender todos os dias em minha casa. As atendentes foram muito atenciosas e conhecedoras de todos os sabores! Elas nos permitiram experimentar alguns antes de escolhermos um. No final, optei pelo Bumbleberry Crisp e pelo Salted Peanut Butter em um confeito de waffle. Estava realmente delicioso, e mesmo que os dois sabores não combinassem necessariamente, com qualquer sorvete da Jeni's, você não pode errar. Também é possível comprar uma embalagem para levar para casa e aproveitar durante toda a semana!
text_en: I was very excited to visit after seeing so many photos of Jeni’s ice cream on social media. The ice cream shop itself is very charming and modern. I love the elegant design of the outdoor tables and the well-lit signage that make it stand out! Additionally, it’s conveniently located near the train line and around many restaurants, making it a great place for desserts. When I entered for the first time, I was immediately overwhelmed by the delicious aroma of freshly made ice creams and desserts. I would like to capture that aroma and turn it into a candle that I can light every day at home. The staff were very helpful and knowledgeable about all the flavors! They allowed us to try a few options before we chose one. In the end, I chose Bumbleberry Crisp and Salted Peanut Butter in waffle flavor. It was really delicious, and even though those two flavors might not go together, with any Jeni’s ice cream, you can’t go wrong. You can also buy a package to take home and enjoy throughout the week!
original: I've been so excited about visiting since seeing Jeni's Ice Cream all over social media. The ice cream parlor itself is so cute and trendy. I love the sleek designs of the outdoor seating and brightly lit sign making it really stand out! It's also conveniently located off the of the light rail and around tons of restaurants making it a great place for dessert. When I first opened the door to enter, I was hit with the sweet smell of freshly made waffle cones and homemade ice cream. I want to take that smell and turn it into a candle that I can just burn every day in my house. The ladies working were so wonderful and knowledgeable about each and every flavor! They let us try a few before setting on one to commit to. I ended up with the Bumbleberry Crisp and the Salted Peanut Butter in a waffle cone. It was really good and even if the two flavors didn't necessarily compliment each other, with any Jeni's ice cream you can't go wrong. You can also pick up a pint to take home so you can have some for the rest of the week!

text: Me encanta Presti's. Solo he ido un par de veces, pero constantemente pienso en volver. El stromboli vegetariano es increíble, y puedo imaginar que las variedades con carne también son fantásticas. El parm de berenjena es bastante normal, y no volvería a pedirlo. Pero la pizza es excelente. Al igual que la tarta de manzana. Además de esta deliciosa variedad de opciones dulces y saladas, un ambiente cálido, acogedor y animado, Presti's es un lugar perfecto para comer. Estoy deseando volver a disfrutar de muchos desayunos y meriendas aquí.
text_en: I love Presti’s. I’ve only been there a couple of times, but I keep thinking about returning. The vegetarian stromboli is incredible, and I can imagine that the meat versions are also fantastic. The eggplant Parmesan is pretty ordinary, and I wouldn’t order it again. But the pizza is excellent. Same with the apple tart. With all these delicious sweet and savory options, along with a warm, cozy, and lively atmosphere, Presti’s is the perfect place to eat. I can’t wait to enjoy many breakfasts and lunches here again.
original: I love Presti's. I've only been a couple times but I'm constantly wanting to go/thinking about going. The veggie stromboli is out of this world, and I can only imagine that the meat varieties are fantastic too. The eggplant parm is pretty average and I wouldn't get it again. But the pizza is great. As is the apple tart. Add to this mouth-watering range of sweet and savory options a warm, cozy, and bustling atmosphere, and you've got yourself a winning eat-in bakery. I can't wait to make many more brunch/snack stops here.

text: El mejor lugar en Arizona para disfrutar de un postre refrescante. Vivo en Chandler y siempre me aseguraré de conducir a Scottsdale cuando tenga antojo de algo dulce. El personal y el equipo son increíbles, y siempre están al día con los nuevos sabores, los macarons y los toppings. Seguiré visitando.
text_en: The best place in Arizona to enjoy a refreshing dessert. I live in Chandler, and I always make sure to drive to Scottsdale when I have a craving for something sweet. The staff and team are amazing, and they’re always up-to-date with new flavors, macarons, and toppings. It’s an ideal place for families, but also perfect for a fun night out in town with a special touch. Thank you, Fatty Daddy’s, for satisfying my sweet cravings from time to time! I’ll continue to visit.
original: Best spot in AZ for a cold treat! I reside in Chandler and will make it a point to drive to scottsdale when dessert is desired. Staff and crew are amazing and they always stay current with updated flavors, macaroons, and toppings! Family friendly but a fun night out on the town with an edge inspired! Thanks for fixing my sweet tooth at times Fatty Daddy's! I will continue stopping by!!

text: Me encantó este lugar. De verdad, ¿cómo podrías equivocarte? Hay chocolate, helado y todos los tipos de caramelos y dulces intermedios. El chocolate es de primera calidad, como se esperaría de Ghirardelli. Además, la ubicación era muy conveniente para nosotros, ya que estaba justo al otro lado de la calle (a unos 10 minutos caminando) del Bellagio, donde nos alojábamos. La única queja que tendría, y la razón por la que le quito una estrella, es que creo que 11,95 dólares por un sundae de brownie con chocolate, sin importar la calidad, es un poco caro. Pero, volviendo al tema, si tienes un antojo de dulce, definitivamente vale la pena una visita para satisfacerlo.
text_en: I really loved this place. Really, how could you possibly be wrong? There’s chocolate, ice cream, and all kinds of caramels and sweets. The chocolate is of top quality, as expected from Ghirardelli. Additionally, the location was very convenient for us, as it’s just across the street (about 10 minutes walk away) from Bellagio, where we were staying. The only criticism I have—and why I deduct one star—is that I think $11.95 for a brownie with chocolate sundae, regardless of the quality, is a bit expensive. But still, if you have a craving for sweets, it’s definitely worth a visit to satisfy that craving.
original: I absolutely loved this place. I mean how can you go wrong, there is chocolate, ice cream, and every little caramel and fudge in-between. The chocolate is top notch as you would expect from Ghirardelli. The location for us was really convenient as well since it was just across the street (maybe a 10 min walk) away from the Bellagio where we were staying. The only one complaint I would have, and the reason I knocked off a point from this being a perfect 5 stars, is that I think $11.95 for a fudge brownie sundae no matter what the quality is a bit steep. But I digress, if you have a sweet tooth its most definitely worth a stop here to get your fix.

text: Ah, Sloan's. Seus adoráveis bichos de pelúcia e a decoração divertida foram o suficiente para me atrair, mas o sorvete, embora delicioso, é incrivelmente caro. Uma porção de dois sabores (como na foto) contém os menores sabores que existem, e custou-me quase 9 dólares. Isso me deixou não apenas desapontado, mas ainda com fome! Se eu voltar algum dia, será para abraçar um Squishable gigante. Mesmo que o Sloan's tivesse a seleção de sabores mais única e fascinante que eu já encontrei, eu simplesmente não conseguiria justificar pagar tanto por tamanhos de porção tão pequenos. Os outros doces expostos parecem ser mais interessantes, mas não tenho certeza sobre os preços; quem sabe, custe 20 dólares por um donut! No entanto, se você está procurando por decoração divertida para a cozinha ou brinquedos macios para as crianças, pode valer a pena dar uma olhada. A escolha é sua, mas tenha cuidado.
text_en: Ah, Sloan’s. Their cute plush animals and fun decorations were enough to attract me, but the ice cream, though delicious, is incredibly expensive. A portion of two flavors (as shown in the photo) contains the smallest flavors possible, and it cost me almost 9 dollars. This not only left me disappointed, but I also felt hungry! If I go back someday, it will be to hug a giant Squishable. Even if Sloan’s had the most unique and fascinating flavor selection I’ve ever seen, I simply couldn’t justify paying so much for such small portions. The other desserts on display seem more interesting, but I’m not sure about their prices—maybe they cost 20 dollars per donut! However, if you’re looking for fun decorations for the kitchen or soft toys for kids, it might be worth a look. The choice is up to you, but be careful.
original: Oh, Sloan's. Your adorable stuffed creatures and fun decor were enticing enough to reel me in, but your ice cream, though yummy, is incredibly overpriced. A regular 2-scoop cup (as pictured) contains the smallest scoops known to man, and cost me nearly $9. This left me feeling not only disappointed, but still hungry! If I ever stop by again, it'll be to hug a giant Squishable. Even if Sloan's had the most uniquely mesmerizing flavor selection I'd ever encountered, I just wouldn't be able to justify paying this much for such small serving sizes. The other sweets on display seem like they may be more worthwhile, but I'm unsure of the pricing on those; for all I know, it's $20/donut! However, if you're looking for humorous kitchen decor or soft toys for the tiny humans in your life, there might be some value in stopping by after all. The choice is yours, but be sure to proceed with caution.

text: We came here for a sweet bite after eating across the street at Federal Pizza. The line was out the door, but no one seemed to mind waiting. I was too busy looking at all the retro candy from my childhood, so when I got to the front of the line...I had no clue what I wanted and didn't want to hold the line up. So, one of the gals suggested the Peanut Butter ice cream (score!) and the pretzel cone I had already planned to try...because...it's a pretzel and a cone! Make sure you make your way back there instead of sitting out front where the line is a bit in the way.
