This is the kind of experience that one must repeat, and I would strongly urge you to make this a regular spot for you and yours!
text_en: So okay donut fans! I didn't think I would ever break away from my 40 year DD habit, but I found something better than those "wicked donuts from DD". I had forgotten how tasty a donut can be until I stumbled upon this place while hanging in Downtown LV. Seriously, these guys know how make a donut explode with tastiness on your tongue. Somehow they found a way to artistically create a culinary composition of a clever captivation that just wows your senses. This is the kind of experience that one must repeat, and I would strongly urge you to make this a regular spot for you and yours!

text: ¡Un helado casero delicioso! Había una fila cuando entramos en noviembre, pero la fila se mueve rápidamente. Probé su helado de fresa y normalmente no puedo terminar el mío, pero me comí todo el helado de fresa. También puedes añadir "fluff" (una especie de topping) a tu helado, y esto lo hará aún más delicioso.
text_en: Delicious homemade ice cream! There was a line when we went in November, but it moves quickly. I tried the strawberry ice cream—usually I can’t finish mine, but I ate all the strawberry ice cream. You can also add “fluff” (a kind of topping) to your ice cream, and it will make it even more delicious.
original: Delicious home made icecream! There was a line when we went in November but the line moves fast. I had their strawberry icecream and normally I can't finish my own but I devoured their strawberry icecream. You can also add fluff to your icecream toppings and it'll make it taste all the better!

text: I would always take friends here when they visit me in Charlotte and I would recommend the fruit tarts. They're pretty much the most delicious things in that bakery. I'd also recommend coming here late at night after clubbing downtown because it's open 24hrs. I definitely stopped by at around 1 or 2am and they still had a decent selection of sweets, food, and drinks available. Some of the other stuff are really sweet for me, though, and it's a bit overpriced, but I would say this is a good place to come to.
text_en: I would always take friends here when they visit me in Charlotte and I would recommend the fruit tarts. They're pretty much the most delicious things in that bakery. I'd also recommend coming here late at night after clubbing downtown because it's open 24hrs. I definitely stopped by at around 1 or 2am and they still had a decent selection of sweets, food, and drinks available. Some of the other stuff are really sweet for me, though, and it's a bit overpriced, but I would say this is a good place to come to.

text: O te gusta el ambiente parisino o no. Sé que lo están vendiendo... Pero no estoy seguro de que yo lo crea. Las rejas del cercado delantero son encantadoras, hasta que miras más allá y ves la realidad: es simplemente una reja en un cercado de alambre en un estacionamiento en Charlotte. Hay una gran variedad de pasteles y postres. Si no encuentras algo que te guste, simplemente no estás intentándolo. El mobiliario es un poco extraño, especialmente si estás tratando de sentar a un grupo de personas. Las colas suelen ser largas, pero el personal eficiente te ayuda rápidamente. Supongo que si cierras los ojos e imaginas... ¡el París puede estar en nuestro propio patio trasero!
text_en: Whether you like the Parisian atmosphere or not… I know they’re selling it… But I’m not sure if I really believe it. The front fence is pretty nice, until you look beyond it and see the reality: it’s just a fence in a wire fence at a parking lot in Charlotte. There’s a wide variety of cakes and desserts. If you can’t find something you like, it’s simply because you haven’t tried enough. The furniture is a bit strange, especially when trying to seat a group of people. The lines are usually long, but the staff is efficient and helps you quickly. I guess if you close your eyes and imagine… Paris could be right in our backyard!
original: You either get the Paris vibe or you don't. I know that they are selling it... But I'm not sure that I'm buying. The locks on the fence out front are sweet until you look past it and see the reality that it is just a lock on chain link fence in a parking lot in Charlotte. There is a huge assortment of pastries and desserts. If you can't find something to enjoy you just must not be trying. The seating is a bit bizarre especially if you are trying to sit a group. The lines are always long but the impatient staff moves you quickly through the process. I guess if you close your eyes and wish.... Paris can be in our backyard!

text: Locate right in front of the elevator to the suites tower of the Venetian so it is really convenient to grab a quick bite and something to drink. The prices are really reasonable consider being inside of the Venetian. I only grabbed myself a cheese danish which is 4 dollar and it was really good. The service was nice and quick. The cheese danish came in a nice box with a set of utensils.
text_en: Locate right in front of the elevator to the suites tower of the Venetian so it is really convenient to grab a quick bite and something to drink. The prices are really reasonable consider being inside of the Venetian. I only grabbed myself a cheese danish which is 4 dollar and it was really good. The service was nice and quick. The cheese danish came in a nice box with a set of utensils.

text: The best ice cream hands down! They need more locations here in vegas but im willing to drive.
text_en: The best ice cream hands down! They need more locations here in vegas but im willing to drive.

text: I've never been disappointed leaving here. The options are a plenty, something for every sweet tooth fix. Very eclectic frequented by almost everyone. Admittedly I'm not crazy about the chocolate croissants as everyone else is. I love to salted caramel brownie, German chocolate brownie, and honey buns
text_en: I've never been disappointed leaving here. The options are a plenty, something for every sweet tooth fix. Very eclectic frequented by almost everyone. Admittedly I'm not crazy about the chocolate croissants as everyone else is. I love to salted caramel brownie, German chocolate brownie, and honey buns

text: Sorvete incrível. A nova adição de um cardápio de bebidas quentes é fantástica! O affogato é imperdível. O novo proprietário do Fatty Daddys está realmente se destacando, oferecendo uma variedade maior de opções! Um ótimo lugar local!
text_en: Incredible ice cream. The addition of a new range of hot drinks is fantastic! The affogato is absolutely worth trying. The new owner of Fatty Daddys is really making a difference, offering more variety! A great local spot!
original: Amazing ice cream. The new addition of a hot drinks menu is fantastic! The affoggato is a must try. Fatty Daddys' new owner is really stepping up by providing more of a variety! Great little local spot!

text: My husband and I love cake boss so when we saw this place we just HAD to try it. We were not disappointed, the pastries we got were absolutely delicious and delectable. They were sweet and soft, not over baked. And the staff was great, they helped us decide since we didnt know what to choose they have soooo many things!
text_en: My husband and I love cake boss so when we saw this place we just HAD to try it. We were not disappointed, the pastries we got were absolutely delicious and delectable. They were sweet and soft, not over baked. And the staff was great, they helped us decide since we didnt know what to choose they have soooo many things!

text: El sándwich de helado y donut es lo más delicioso que he probado. Este lugar es imprescindible.
text_en: The ice cream and donut sandwich is the most delicious thing I’ve ever tried. This place is essential.
original: The ice cream/donut sandwich is the most delicious thing I've ever tasted. This place is a must visit.

text: O Churn é uma ótima adição aos estabelecimentos na rua East Carson. Eles oferecem doces, café, sorvete e gelato. Provavelmente têm mais produtos, mas eu estava procurando um bom sorvete. Optei por uma xícara pequena de café com granulado. Foi uma ótima escolha. O sorvete era delicioso e saboroso. Também experimentei o sorvete de menta da Girl Scout, que também estava excelente. A loja é bem iluminada e limpa. Parece que tudo está claramente identificado para ajudar os novos clientes. Experimentem!
text_en: Churn is a great addition to the establishments on East Carson Street. They offer desserts, coffee, ice cream, and gelato. There are probably more products, but I was looking for good ice cream. I chose a small cup of coffee with powdered sugar. It was a great choice. The ice cream was delicious and flavorful. I also tried the mint ice cream from Girl Scout, which was also excellent. The store is well-lit and clean. It seems that everything is clearly labeled to help new customers. Give it a try!
original: Churn is a really nice addition to the businesses on east carson street. They have pastries, coffee, ice cream and Gelato. They probably have more products but I was looking for some good ice cream. I settled on a small cup of coffee with sprinkles. It was a nice scoop. The ice cream was rich and tasty. I also sampled a friend's girl scout thin mint ice cream. It was a winner too. The store is bright and clean. Everything seems to be clearly marked to help the new clientele. Give the place a try.

text: Sorvete delicioso. Evite a longa fila e peça para uma atendente fora, para retirar na janela.
text_en: Delicious ice cream. Avoid the long line and ask a staff member to pick it up outside, right by the window.
original: Great ice cream. Skip the long line and order from a girl outside for the pick up window

text: Decir que el efecto del "melt" en la masa es transformador sería una subestimación y una falta de justicia hacia este producto increíble.
text_en: To say that the effect of “melt” on the dough is transformative would be an understatement and a lack of respect for this incredible product.
original: To say that the dough melt is life changing would be an understatement and disservice to this amazing product!

text: Sweet Republic es excelente. Es un lugar confiable. Han trabajado duro para construir su propia marca, y creo que eso es genial. He ido dos veces, y el helado es de muy buena calidad. En mi opinión personal, también disfruto de otros lugares, pero definitivamente vale la pena visitarlos: podrían convertirse en tu lugar favorito. Me encantaría verlos ofrecer sándwiches de helado.
text_en: Sweet Republic is excellent. It’s a reliable place. They have worked hard to build their own brand, and I think that’s great. I’ve been there twice, and the ice cream is of very good quality. In my personal opinion, I also enjoy other places as well, but they definitely worth visiting: they could become your favorite spot. I would love to see them offer ice cream sandwiches.
original: Sweet Republic is good. It's solid. They have worked hard to build a name for themselves, and I think that's awesome. I've been twice, the ice cream is legit. For me, personally, I also enjoy other places equally, but they are definitely worth checking out - they may end up being your favorite. I would love to see them do ice cream sandwiches!

text: Todo lo que sale de Mason's es una delicia, y es raro visitar sin probar algo que nunca se te habría ocurrido que pudiera ser delicioso como helado: piensen en el sabor del cereal Froot Loops o el nogotine de whisky. No es el lugar donde se va a pedir simplemente chocolate o vainilla, aunque siempre hay una opción similar a los productos estándar para aquellos que se niegan a desafiar sus gustos. ¿Y lo mejor de todo? Preparan todo desde cero, justo allí, e incluso bajo pedido: si realmente te encanta un sabor y no te importa comprarlo en grandes cantidades, puedes hacer un pedido en cualquier época del año y, en unos días, te prepararán una tanda solo para ti, para llevarla a casa y disfrutarla. Hasta ahora, no he aprovechado esta opción por temor a llevarlo a casa, cerrar la puerta y comerlo todo de una vez. He sido fan de Mason's desde que eran esos simpáticos dueños con su puesto en el mercado de pulgas de Cleveland; Jesse y Helen son lo que yo describiría como una pareja tranquila y eficiente. Después de haber disfrutado de su ambiente durante un año, puedo decir que tengo una fuerte preferencia, pero también puedo asegurar que, a pesar de mi entusiasmo, todavía no me han decepcionado.
text_en: Everything from Mason’s is delicious, and it’s unusual to visit without trying something you never thought could be as tasty as ice cream—think about the flavor of Froot Loops or whiskey nogotine. It’s not a place where you can just order chocolate or vanilla, though there’s always a similar option to the standard products for those who refuse to challenge their taste buds. And the best part? They prepare everything from scratch, right there, even upon request. If you really love a flavor and don’t mind buying in large quantities, you can order it at any time of year, and in a few days, they’ll prepare a batch just for you to take home and enjoy. So far, I haven’t taken advantage of this option because I was afraid of bringing it home, closing the door, and eating it all at once. I’ve been a fan of Mason’s since those kind-hearted owners started their shop at the Cleveland flea market. Jesse and Helen are what I would call a calm and efficient couple. After enjoying their atmosphere for a year, I can say I have a strong preference, but I can also assure you that, despite my enthusiasm, they haven’t disappointed me yet.
original: Everything that comes out of Mason's is a delight, and it's rare to visit without sampling something you never thought could be delicious as ice cream - think Froot Loops Cereal Milk or Whiskey Eggnog. This is not the place you go in and order simple chocolate or vanilla, though there's always a trade-standard-equivalent for those who refuse to challenge their tastes. Even better? They make everything from scratch, right there, and sometimes on-demand: if you really adore a flavor and don't mind buying it in bulk, put in an order any time of year and over a few days they'll mix up a batch just for you to take home and enjoy. I haven't yet availed myself of this only for fear that I'll take it home, lock the door and feedbag the whole thing in one sitting. I've been a devotee of Mason's since they were the friendly folks with the stand at the nascent Cleveland Flea; Jesse and Helen are what I would describe as a chill-power-couple. Having floated in their glow like some kind of dairy-treat-loving-moth for a year or so now, I can both claim a serious bias and attest that despite my fangirling, I haven't been burned yet.

text: Servicio rápido y amable, gran variedad, muy delicioso. Me encantó especialmente el caramelo con sal marina, pero las trozos de brownie en el otro helado que pedí también estaban muy, muy sabrosos.
text_en: Quick and friendly service, wide variety, very delicious. I especially loved the salted sea salt caramel, but the pieces of brownie in the other ice cream I ordered were also very, very tasty.
original: Quick and polite service, great selection, very delicious. I liked the sea salt caramel by far the most, but the real brownie pieces in the other ice cream I got were very very tasty also.

text: Eu fui no sábado passado e pedi a salada de frango. Sou bastante exigente com saladas de frango e daria nota 3 para a deles. Tinha um ótimo sabor, mas os pedaços de frango eram bem grandes. Também comprei o croissant com cream cheese e morango, que estava bom. Fiquei um pouco decepcionado, pois tinha grandes expectativas, e não me impressionou tanto quanto eu esperava. Com certeza voltarei para experimentar os outros doces e ver o que todo mundo está elogiando.
text_en: I went there last Saturday and ordered the chicken salad. I’m quite demanding when it comes to chicken salads, and I would give them a 3 out of 5. It had a great taste, but the pieces of chicken were quite large. I also bought the croissant with cream cheese and strawberries, which was good. I was a little disappointed because I had high expectations, and it didn’t impress me as much as I expected. I definitely will go back to try the other desserts and see what everyone is praising.
original: I went last Saturday and got the chicken salad. I am pretty picky about chicken salad and would give theirs a three. It had great flavoring but the chicken chunks were really big. I also got their cream cheese and strawberry croissant which was good. I was a little disappointed because I had such high hopes from all the reviews and it didn't blow me away. I will definitely go back to try some of the other desserts and see what everyone is raving about.

text: Fui allí por primera vez hoy. Le dije a una de las empleadas que era nueva. Parecía molesta al tener que explicar qué tipo de donut era cada uno. Quizás si tuvieran carteles o descripciones, ayudaría a eliminar la molestia de que todos preguntaran qué es cada uno. Los donuts estaban bien, pero la verdad es que no me impresionaron demasiado. Mi esposo y yo probamos los glaseados, los de Samoa, los de arce y los de mantequilla de cacahuete y los de Lucky Charms. Tal vez estaban recién hechos, pero no estoy segura. Especialmente el de Lucky Charms. Parecía que había estado allí un tiempo. La masa del donut es gruesa y más parecida a un pastel. Esperaba que el de glaseado fuera similar al de Krispie Kream, pero son sabores completamente diferentes. No son ligeros ni esponjosos. En general, son muy buenos donuts, la idea es interesante, pero siento que la publicidad hace que parezcan mejores de lo que realmente son.
text_en: I went there for the first time today. I told one of the employees that I was new. She seemed annoyed at having to explain what kind of donut each one was. Maybe if they had labels or descriptions, it would help reduce the hassle of people asking what each donut was. The donuts were okay, but honestly, they didn’t impress me much. My husband and I tried the glaze options: Samoa, maple, peanut butter, and Lucky Charms. Maybe they were freshly made, but I’m not sure. Especially the Lucky Charms one—it seemed like it had been there for a while. The dough of the donut is thick and more like a cake. I expected the glazed ones to be similar to Krispie Kreme, but the flavors are completely different. They’re not light or fluffy at all. Overall, they’re good donuts; the concept is interesting, but I feel that advertising makes them seem better than they really are.
original: I went there today for the first time. I told the one worker that I was new. She seemed annoyed that she had to explain which donut was what. Maybe if they had signs or descriptions, it would help eliminate the annoyance of everyone asking what's that? The donuts were good, but honestly I wasn't blown away. My husband and I tried the glazed, Samoan, maple, PB, lucky charms. They might have been fresh, but I don't think they were. The lucky charm one especially. Just seemed like it was sitting around awhile. The donut dough itself is thick and more like a cake. I was hoping the glazed one would top Krispie Kream but two totally different tastes. They are not light and airy. All in all very good donuts, the concept is cool, just feel like the hype makes it more than what it is

text: Não estou entendendo muito bem a polêmica. Experimentei o milkshake com cereal e, infelizmente, não gostei. Estava muito salgado e não tinha nenhum sabor doce. A parte de sorvete simplesmente tinha o gosto de sorvete feito com leite e milho. Depois, adicionei os flakes de milho e misturei tudo. Não foi nada especial, na verdade. O preço também é exagerado. Paguei 10 dólares por um copo de 12 onças. Considerando o quão desagradável foi o produto e o preço, acho que eles não merecem mais que uma estrela. Talvez eu volte para experimentar o sorvete e atualizar minha avaliação, se for bom.
text_en: I don’t really understand the controversy. I tried the cereal milkshake, but unfortunately, I didn’t like it. It was too salty and lacked any sweet taste. The ice cream part just had the flavor of ice cream made with milk and corn. Then I added the corn flakes and mixed everything together. It wasn’t anything special, actually. The price is also excessive. I paid $10 for a 12-ounce glass. Considering how unpleasant the product was and the price, I think they deserve no more than one star. Maybe I’ll go back and try the ice cream again to update my rating if it’s good.
original: I'm not quite understanding the hype. I got the cereal milk shake and it was very off. It was really salty and didn't had any sweetness to it at all. The ice cream part just tasted like as if I threw milk in the freezer and made it into ice cream. Then, I added corn flakes and blended it all up. It really wasn't anything special. The price is ridiculous as well. I got a regular size, which turned out to be $10 for a 12oz cup. Considering the how much I disliked the product and price, I don't think they deserve more than 1 star. I might come back once more to try their soft serve and update my review if that goes well.

text: É como um sorvete de morango, com calda de chocolate quente e chantilly. Eu decidi não me preocupar com as calorias. 😉 Totalmente delicioso!
text_en: It’s like a strawberry ice cream, with hot chocolate sauce and whipped cream. I decided not to worry about the calories. 😉 It’s absolutely delicious!
original: This is like a 4.5. Strawberry ice cream, hot fudge and whipped cream. I chose not to look at the calories. ;) Totally decadent!

text: Ok, eu sei que este local é mais caro do que os outros, mas estou disposto a pagar, pois é o único aqui na costa oeste. Sempre que estou em um Cosmopolitan, tento passar para comprar biscoitos. Adoro os sorvetes e milkshakes de leite de cereal (e o leite de cereal em si). Os biscoitos de blueberry são um favorito da família (assim como os biscoitos de aveia). Experimentei os mixes em caixas, mas, embora sejam ok, não são os mesmos. Invista um pouco mais e compre-os frescos!
text_en: Okay, I know this place is more expensive than the others, but I’m willing to pay it, because it’s the only one on the West Coast. Whenever I’m at a Cosmopolitan, I try to slip in to buy some cookies. I love cereal milk ice cream and milkshakes (and the cereal milk itself). Blueberry cookies are a family favorite (just like oat cookies too). I’ve tried the mix packs, but while they’re okay, they’re not the same. Spend a little more and get the fresh ones!
original: Okay, I know this location is pricier than others but I'll happily pay because it's the only location on the west coast. Anytime I'm at a Cosmopolitan, I try and stop by for cookies. I love the cereal milk soft serves and shakes (and just the cereal milk in general). The blueberry cookies are a family favorite (as are the compost cookies). I've tried the box mixes and while they're okay, they really aren't the same. Spend the extra and buy them fresh!

text: Seriously best ice cream, "dough melt," and experience. The Dream Team KILLED it on their costumer service and I can tell you that you won't be disappointed if you go here. If there is a line, I promise it is worth the wait. I had the "dough melt" with the Honey Lavender ice cream in it, and it was THE BEST EVER! Go and try it now... like right now.
text_en: Seriously best ice cream, "dough melt," and experience. The Dream Team KILLED it on their costumer service and I can tell you that you won't be disappointed if you go here. If there is a line, I promise it is worth the wait. I had the "dough melt" with the Honey Lavender ice cream in it, and it was THE BEST EVER! Go and try it now... like right now.

text: Sem dúvida, esta é a minha padaria favorita em Madison. Eles estão sempre cheios, e o pão e os doces são fantásticos em sabor, aparência e preço. Eu costumo comprar um croissant de presunto e queijo gruyère, ou uma baguette. Os croissants de presunto e queijo gruyère são incríveis. São os melhores quando saem do forno. As baguetes também são baguetes francesas autênticas, e eu gosto que não sejam muito duras por fora, pois isso pode machucar a parte de trás da boca. Uma vez, comprei uma caixa de "shorties" para levar ao trabalho, e eles adoraram.
text_en: Without a doubt, this is my favorite bakery in Madison. It’s always full, and the bread and desserts are fantastic in terms of taste, appearance, and price. I usually buy a ham and Gruyère croissant, or a baguette. The ham and Gruyère croissants are incredible. They’re the best when they come out of the oven. The baguettes are also authentic French baguettes, and I like that they aren’t too hard on the outside, as that can hurt the back of my mouth. Once, I bought a box of “shorties” to take to work, and they loved them.
original: This is hands-down my favorite bakery in Madison. They are always busy, and their bread and pastries are fantastic in taste, appearance, and value. I usually get a ham and gruyere croissant or a baguette. The ham and gruyere croissants are incredible. They are the best if you catch them when they first come out of the oven. The baguettes are also authentic French baguettes, and I like that they're not too hard on the outside because that can hurt the roof of my mouth. I also once got a box of shorties to bring to work, and they LOVED them.

text: Así que hoy fui a Mason's por primera vez, así que solo puedo comentar sobre su helado. Pero, en cuanto al helado, ¡fue fantástico! Llegamos justo cuando estaban abriendo, y gracias a Dios que lo hicimos, porque ya estaba lleno cuando llegamos (es simplemente muy popular). Solo tuvimos que esperar unos minutos, y luego pudimos hacer nuestro pedido en la ventana. Además, están cumpliendo bien con los protocolos de COVID: hay marcadas zonas en el suelo donde la gente debe esperar, y se exige el uso de mascarillas. Pedí el helado de matcha y Oreo en un waffle, con nata montada con sabor a almendras (no sé exactamente qué sabor era), y fue una delicia. Mi compañero de piso pidió el sabor limón y ricotta, y también lo disfrutó mucho. Un extra: las cucharas cambian de color. No es algo muy importante, pero es un detalle encantador que demuestra su atención al detalle y su gusto por lo divertido. En general, tanto yo como mi compañero de piso disfrutamos mucho del helado y la experiencia, y sin duda volveremos pronto.
text_en: So today was my first time going to Mason’s, so I can only talk about their ice cream. But as for the ice cream itself, it was fantastic! We arrived right when they were opening, and thank goodness we did, because it was already full when we got there (it’s really popular). We just had to wait a few minutes, and then we could place our order at the window. Additionally, they follow COVID protocols well: there are marked areas on the floor where people need to wait, and masks are required. I ordered matcha and Oreo ice cream in a waffle, with almond-flavored whipping cream (I’m not sure exactly what flavor it was), and it was delicious. My roommate ordered lemon and ricotta flavors, and he also enjoyed it very much. A bonus: the spoons change color. It’s not something very important, but it’s a lovely detail that shows their attention to detail and their love for fun things. Overall, both I and my roommate really enjoyed the ice cream and the experience, and we definitely will go back soon.
original: So I went to Mason's for the first time today, so I can only comment on their ice cream. But, as far as the ice cream goes, it was fantastic! We got there right as they were opening, and thank goodness we did because it was already busy by the time we got there (it's just that popular). We only had to wait a few minutes, and then we were able to place our order at the window. They're keeping up well with COVID procedures, by the way. Marked spots on the sidewalk where people should wait, masks required. I ordered the matcha Oreo ice cream in the eggwaffle with flavored whipped cream on top (it was some sort of almond flavored whip), and it was an absolute dream. My roommate ordered the lemon ricotta flavor and loved it as well. Bonus - the spoons are color changing! Not a huge thing, but a cute touch that just shows their attention to detail and penchant for whimsy. Overall, my roommate and I both loved our ice cream and experience, and we'll definitely be coming back soon!

text: ¡Qué buenos estaban los danés de queso y los croissants! Estoy aquí en la cama pensando en ello. Eran crujientes, crujientes, con mantequilla y aireados. No escatiman en crema de queso. Incluso saben mejor si se tostan ligeramente.
text_en: The Danish cheese and croissants were really good! I’m lying in bed thinking about it now. They were crispy, crisp, with butter and airy texture. They don’t skimp on cheese cream either. They even taste better if they’re lightly toasted.
original: Damn the cheese danish and croissants were both so good I'm laying here in bed thinking about it. It was crispy, flaky, buttery, and airy. They don't skimp on the cream cheese. Taste even better lightly toasted

text: I use to live down the street from Donut Bar. Their donuts were great! Full of flavor, fresh, fluffy, and versatile. As long as you like donuts, you can for sure find something here to your liking. Their iced chai was also very good. It was a little pricey for how watered down it seemed, but overall had a good sweet flavor.
text_en: I use to live down the street from Donut Bar. Their donuts were great! Full of flavor, fresh, fluffy, and versatile. As long as you like donuts, you can for sure find something here to your liking. Their iced chai was also very good. It was a little pricey for how watered down it seemed, but overall had a good sweet flavor.

text: Amelie's tiene los mejores postres de Charlotte. Siempre está en mi lista cuando tengo que estar en el centro de la ciudad. Mi esposo viene de Matthews para probar sus éclairs, y yo por el brownie de caramelo salado. Además, no importa cuándo necesite un capricho en Amelie's, porque están abiertos las 24 horas, todos los días del año, ¡incluso en Navidad! Y los dueños son personas encantadoras que realmente se preocupan por la comunidad.
text_en: Amelie’s has the best desserts in Charlotte. It’s always on my list when I need to be in the city center. My husband comes from Matthews to try their éclairs, and I go for the salty caramel brownies. Besides, it doesn’t matter when I need a treat at Amelie’s—they’re open 24 hours a day, every day of the year, even during Christmas! And the owners are wonderful people who really care about the community.
original: Amelie's has the best pastries in Charlotte. It is always on my itinerary when I have to be in the uptown area! My husband will drive from Matthews for their eclairs and I will for the Salted Caramel brownie!! What's more is that is doesn't matter when I need an Amelie's fix, because they are open 24x7 and every day of the year, including Christmas!!! And the owners are lovely people who actually care about the community!

text: Cupcakes fantásticos. Una pequeña máquina expendedora muy adorable. La ubicación es perfecta. Consiga su In-N-Out y también compre unos cupcakes. Tamaño adecuado para el precio.
text_en: Fantastic cupcakes. A very cute little vending machine. The location is perfect. Get an In-N-Out sandwich, and also buy some cupcakes. The size is just right for the price.
original: Fantastic cupcakes. Cute little vending machine. Location is perfectly centered. Grab your in n out and get a cupcakes. Reasonably sized for the price.

text: Service was friendly and quick, but these are absolutely not the best donuts ever. While they were beautifully presented, once we bit into them, we noticed how dry and unexceptional that they are. The hype really falls short at this establishment, which is really disappointing for how expensive these donuts are.
text_en: Service was friendly and quick, but these are absolutely not the best donuts ever. While they were beautifully presented, once we bit into them, we noticed how dry and unexceptional that they are. The hype really falls short at this establishment, which is really disappointing for how expensive these donuts are.

text: Este lugar es increíble. Tuve la suerte de no tener que esperar mucho para conseguir mis postres. Ofrecen muchas opciones y siempre están bien surtidos. Mi próximo destino es el restaurante.
text_en: This place is incredible. I was lucky not to have to wait long for my desserts. They offer many options, and they’re always well-stocked. My next destination is the restaurant.
original: This place is amazing. I was lucky enough not to wait for to long to get my deserts! Many options and it was kept stocked. My next stop is the restaurant !

text: This is the best ice cream. We used to get it mail ordered to us from Ohio. The flavors are so unique, and we just love the texture of their ice cream. When you walk in, one employee is hand making waffle cones. There isn't much to say about this place, except about how amazing it is!
text_en: This is the best ice cream. We used to get it mail ordered to us from Ohio. The flavors are so unique, and we just love the texture of their ice cream. When you walk in, one employee is hand making waffle cones. There isn't much to say about this place, except about how amazing it is!

text: Apaixonado por este lugar! Visitei pela primeira vez neste fim de semana e adorei! Um lugar muito charmoso e pequeno, com sorvete delicioso!!
text_en: I’m in love with this place! I visited it for the first time this weekend and loved it! It’s a very charming and small place, with delicious ice cream!!
original: In love with this place! Went for the first time this weekend and i loved it! Super adorable little place and delicious ice cream!!

text: Experimentei em todos os lugares que vendem macarons na Las Vegas, e este é o melhor. No entanto, já comi macarons melhores em outras cidades. Os macarons são maiores do que a maioria, mas têm um preço relativamente alto.
text_en: I tried them at all the macarons shops in Las Vegas, and this is the best one. However, I’ve eaten better macarons in other cities as well. The macarons are larger than most, but they are also relatively expensive.
original: I tried every single french macaroon place in Vegas and this is the best. However, I've had better in other cities. The macaroons are bigger than most, but they are pretty pricey.

text: Es el mejor lugar para ir por la noche en Charlotte. Mis amigos y yo hemos estado aquí, probablemente, miles de veces. El café es increíble. Los pasteles, tartas y macarons son deliciosos. Prueba la soda francesa y también la cerveza de jengibre.
text_en: It’s the best place to go at night in Charlotte. My friends and I have been here countless times. The coffee is incredible. The cakes, tarts, and macarons are delicious. Try the French soda as well as the ginger beer.
original: It's the best place to go late night in Charlotte. My friends and I have been here probably a billion times. The coffees are amazing. The tarts, cakes, and macaroons are delicious. Try the french soda and also the ginger beer.

text: O sorvete Rocky Road é o melhor que existe. E está localizado em um lugar perfeito, perto de muitos restaurantes excelentes. Sempre que comemos na 7th Street, paramos na Mary Coyle's para saborear um delicioso sorvete! Altamente recomendado! O favorito do meu marido é o Cashew Salted Caramel!
text_en: Rocky Road ice cream is the best there is. It’s located in a perfect spot, near many excellent restaurants. Whenever we eat at 7th Street, we stop by Mary Coyle’s to enjoy delicious ice cream! Highly recommended! My husband’s favorite is Cashew Salted Caramel!
original: Best Rocky Road ice cream alive. And in the perfection location of a ton of great restaurants. Anytime we eat off 7th street, we stop by Mary Coyle's for some good ol' fashion ice cream! Highly recommended! My hubbys favorite is the Cashew Salted Caramel!

text: Tenía grandes expectativas, quizás demasiado altas. Estaba muy emocionado cuando supe que Sprinkles iba a abrir en Las Vegas. Intenté ir a la de Los Ángeles, pero había una cola y no teníamos mucho tiempo. También había una cola afuera de este lugar, pero nosotros (junto con otras personas que también estaban esperando) no nos dimos cuenta de que era solo para los helados. Solo queríamos cupcakes. El "portero" no ayudó a evitar este problema. Una vez dentro, las personas que trabajaban detrás del mostrador estaban hablando muy fuerte (había alrededor de 4 o 5), por lo que la persona que tomó mi pedido no me oyó. Después de todo eso, el cupcake en sí no fue muy bueno. Por 3,75 dólares cada uno, esperaba algo mejor. 4 estrellas por la presentación, 3 estrellas por el sabor y 1 estrella por el servicio.
text_en: I had high expectations—perhaps too high. I was very excited when I heard that Sprinkles would open in Las Vegas. I tried to go to the one in Los Angeles, but there was a long line, and we didn’t have much time. There was also a line outside this place, but we (along with other people waiting) didn’t realize it was only for ice cream. We just wanted cupcakes. The “doorman” didn’t help solve this problem either. Once inside, the people working behind the counter were talking very loudly (there were about 4 or 5 of them), so the person who took my order didn’t hear me. After all that, the cupcakes themselves weren’t very good. For $3.75 each, I expected something better. 4 stars for presentation, 3 stars for taste, and 1 star for service.
original: I had high expectations, possibly too high. I was so excited when I heard Sprinkles was coming to Vegas. Tried going to the one in LA, but there was a line and we didn't have much time. There was also a line outside this location, but we (along with others who were also waiting) didn't realize it was for the ice cream side only. We only wanted cupcakes. The "doorman" didn't help avoid this. Once inside, the people working behind the counter were chatting so loudly (there were about 4 or 5 of them) that the one taking my order couldn't hear me. After all that, the actual cupcake was just ok. For $3.75 a pop, I expected a little more. 4 stars for presentation 3 stars for flavor 1 star for service

text: Um lugar muito charmoso, com muitas opções! Eu pedi o cone de donuts com sorvete cremoso e granulado colorido. O cone estava completamente cheio de sorvete, delicioso! Eu nunca tinha comido um cone de donuts antes, então esperava que fosse macio como um donut, mas era crocante. Ainda assim, tinha um sabor incrível, porque estava coberto com açúcar e canela! Com certeza, gostaria de voltar para experimentar os donuts, que pareciam deliciosos!
text_en: A very charming place with lots of options! I ordered a donut cone with creamy and colorful granulated ice cream. The cone was completely filled with ice cream—delicious! I had never eaten a donut cone before, so I expected it to be soft like a regular donut, but it was crunchy. Still, it had an amazing taste, as it was covered with sugar and cinnamon! Definitely, I would like to go back and try the donuts again—they seemed delicious!
original: Very cute place with tons of options! I got the donut cone with the soft serve ice cream with rainbow sprinkles. The cone was completely filled with ice cream yum! I have never had a donut cone so I was expecting it to be soft like a donut but it was crunchy. It still tasted amazing because it was covered in cinnamon sugar! I definitely would like to return so that I can try the donuts which looked amazing!

text: This place is a big surprise in the city! Shop is clean, nice view on the factory behind the windows. Ice cream is tasty (at least all flavors we tried). Quick service, do not be scared by the size of the line...
text_en: This place is a big surprise in the city! Shop is clean, nice view on the factory behind the windows. Ice cream is tasty (at least all flavors we tried). Quick service, do not be scared by the size of the line...

text: Un helado fantástico que ofrece todo lo que podrías desear en una heladería. Tienen helados excelentes, conos, postres de helado y batidos deliciosos. Puedes elegir algo simple como vainilla, o algo más interesante como Matcha o helado de caramelo salado. Además, hacen unos helados maravillosos. El helado de sandía estaba increíble, ¡que me lo pedí aparte del postre que compré! El personal también es muy amable y te permite probar muchas muestras con sus cucharas de metal y bien frías. Al final, pedí un postre de banoffee, que era una mezcla de plátano y caramelo con el helado de caramelo salado como base. Les recomendaría pedir un segundo postre, ya que mover todos los ingredientes puede ser un poco desordenado. ¡Pero, vaya, estaba delicioso! Todo era muy satisfactorio y perfecto como postre. Los cuencos con cono de waffle lo hacen aún mejor. Aunque no soy muy fan del papel tapiz naranja, el diseño interior es secundario. Lo importante es el helado, ¡así que no te pierdas esta heladería!
text_en: A fantastic ice cream that offers everything you could wish for in a ice cream shop. They have excellent ice creams, waffle cones, ice cream desserts, and delicious smoothies. You can choose something simple like vanilla, or more interesting options like matcha or salted caramel ice cream. In addition, they make wonderful ice creams too. The watermelon ice cream was incredible—I ordered it alongside the dessert I bought! The staff are also very friendly, and they allow you to try many samples using their cold metal spoons. In the end, I ordered a banana pancake dessert, which is a mix of bananas and caramel with salted caramel ice cream as the base. I would recommend ordering a second dessert, as mixing all the ingredients can be a bit messy. But hey, it was delicious! Everything was very satisfying and perfect as a dessert. The waffle cone bowls make it even better. Although I’m not really a fan of orange wallpaper, the interior design isn’t important. What matters is the ice cream—so don’t miss out on this ice cream shop!
original: Fantastic ice cream that offers everything you would want from an ice cream shop. They have great ice cream, ice cream cones, ice cream sundaes, and great milkshakes. You can get something as simple as vanilla or you can get something more exciting like Matcha or Salted Butter Caramel Swirl. They make WONDERFUL sorbets. The watermelon sorbet was so damn good, I ordered a single on the side of the sundae I got! The staff is also really nice about letting you try a buttload of samples with their chilled, metal spoons. I ultimately got a banoffee sundae, which was banana and toffee with the Salted Butter Caramel Swirl as the base. I would advise you get a second bowl as shifting all the ingredients around can get messy. But damn was it good! Everything was so satisfying and hits the spot as a dessert. The waffle cone bowls only make it better. Im not the biggest fan of the orange wallpaper as the interior design, but the ice cream was more important! Either way, make sure to stop here.

text: Este lugar es súper creativo y encantador. ¡Me encantaron todos los pequeños adornos en cada habitación! Llegamos temprano y casi evitamos la hora punta de la mañana, ¡genial! Por lo tanto, pedí el sándwich de desayuno con salchicha, espinacas y queso en una croissant. Era muy abundante, pero también tuve que probar su brownie de caramelo salado (ya que la cajera dijo que han vendido millones de sus famosos brownies, ¡jaja!). Definitivamente era dulce y diferente. Finalmente, también pedí su mocha (creo que viene con dos espressos, así que simplemente pedí uno). ¡Ya estaba llena de azúcar!
text_en: This place is super creative and charming. I loved all the small decorations in each room! We arrived early and almost avoided the morning rush hour—great! So, I ordered a breakfast sandwich with sausage, spinach, and cheese on a croissant. It was very generous, but I also had to try their salty caramel brownies (the cashier said they’ve sold millions of their famous brownies, haha!). It was definitely sweet and different. Finally, I also ordered a mocha (I think it comes with two espressos, so I just ordered one). It was already full of sugar!
original: This place is super creative and cute-I loved all the little decorations in each room! We came here pretty early and barely beat the morning rush-yay. So, I had the breakfast sandwich with sausage, spinach and cheese on a croissant. It was super filling, but I also had to grab their salted caramel brownie (since the cashier said they've sold millions of their famous brownies, haha). It was definitely sweet and unique! Lastly, I had to drink up their mocha as well (I believe it comes with two espresso shots, so I just asked for one). I was already all amped up from sugar!

text: En el segundo piso del Cosmopolitan, se encuentra Milk Bar, propiedad de Christina Tosi. Es la panadería hermana del restaurante Momofuku, de David Chang, con quien Tosi trabajó anteriormente como pasteler. Su especialidad era transformar las galletas de maíz tostadas remojadas en leche en la base para sus helados, panna cotta y tartas de helado. En 2008, abrió su primera Milk Bar en Nueva York. ¡Y ahora hay una sucursal aquí en Las Vegas! Nos quedamos mirando el menú y realmente no sabíamos qué pedir, así que el amable joven detrás del mostrador nos ofreció degustaciones. Primero probamos el Crack Pie y luego el helado de leche con cereales. ¡Impresionante! Decidimos pedir una porción de Crack Pie para llevar, un vaso de helado de leche con cereales de tamaño "pint" cubierto con Crack Pie para compartir, y un vaso de helado individual con textura de galleta de maíz. El helado de leche con sabor a cereales sabía exactamente como la leche del fondo de tu tazón de cereales con un toque de sabor a galleta de maíz, pero en forma congelada. ¡Muy interesante! Era ligero y aireado, no demasiado dulce. De mi agrado. Pero, la adición de las porciones de Crack Pie de tamaño individual hizo que el postre fuera un poco demasiado abundante. El vaso de tamaño "pint" para dos personas resultó ser una porción generosa y no pudimos terminarlo. Un vaso individual a la mitad de precio habría sido perfecto. Por otro lado, las porciones de galletas de maíz en el vaso individual resultaron ser un postre más ligero con una agradable textura crujiente. Probablemente pediré eso la próxima vez. El Crack Pie en sí es muy rico. Es una porción fría de crema pastelera, hecha con mantequilla y azúcar moreno, sobre una base de avena tostada. Es como una mezcla entre baklava y una barra de granola. Muy sustancioso, pero también satisfactorio en solo unos pocos bocado. Probablemente mejor acompañado de una taza de café. ¡Hay mucho más por probar y estoy seguro de que volveré con amigos y familiares para compartir! Galletas, pasteles, panes, batidos, batidos sofisticados: ¡una gran cantidad de dulzura allí!
text_en: On the second floor of Cosmopolitan, there’s the Milk Bar, owned by Christina Tosi. It’s a sister bakery to the Momofuku restaurant owned by David Chang. Tosi used to work as a baker for David Chang. Her specialty was turning baked cornflakes soaked in milk into the base for ice creams, panna cotta, and ice cream desserts. In 2008, she opened her first Milk Bar in New York. Now, there’s a branch here in Las Vegas! We looked at the menu and really didn’t know what to order. So, the kind young man behind the counter offered us samples. First, we tried Crack Pie, and then the milk ice cream with cereal. It was amazing! We decided to order a portion of Crack Pie to take home, a glass of milk ice cream with cereal, covered with Crack Pie, for sharing, and a glass of individual ice cream with a cornflake texture. The milk ice cream with cereal flavor tasted exactly like the milk in your cereal bowl, but frozen. Very interesting! It was light and airy, not too sweet. I liked it. But adding the individual portions of Crack Pie made the dessert a little too abundant. The “pint” size glass for two people turned out to be a generous portion, and we couldn’t finish it. A half-price individual glass would have been perfect. On the other hand, the portions of cornflakes in the individual glass were a lighter dessert with a pleasant crumbly texture. I might order that next time. Crack Pie itself is very rich. It’s a cold portion of whipped cream, made with butter and dark sugar, on top of toasted oats. It’s like a mix between baklava and granola bars. Very substantial, but also satisfying in just a few bites. Probably better served with a cup of coffee. There’s so much more to try, and I’m sure I’ll come back with friends and family to share! Cookies, cakes, breads, smoothies, sophisticated smoothies: plenty of sweetness there!
original: On the 2nd Floor of The Cosmopolitan is Milk Bar by Christina Tosi. It's the sister bakery to Momofuku Restaurant by David Chang, who Tosi used to work for as pastry chef! Her specialty was turning toasted cornflakes steeped in milk into the base for her ice cream, panna cotta, and ice cream pies. In 2008, she opened up her first Milk Bar in NYC. And now there's a storefront here in Las Vegas! We stared at the menu and truly had no idea what to order, so the nice young man behind the counter offered samples to try. First we tried the Crack Pie and then the Cereal Milk soft serve. Sold! We decided to order a slice of the Crack Pie to-go, a pint size Soft Serve of Cereal Milk topped with crack pie to share, and a single size Soft Serve with corn flake crunch. The Cereal Milk flavored soft serve tasted just like the bottom of your bowl cereal milk with a tinge of corn flake flavor, except in frozen form. Pretty cool! It was light and frothy-like, not too sweet. My kind of dessert. But, the addition of the bite-sized crack pie toppings made the dessert a little overbearing. The pint size for two of us was actually a generous serving and we couldn't finish it. The single size for half the price would've been perfect. On the other hand, the corn flake toppings on the single size serving was a lighter dessert with a nice crunchy texture. Probably will order that next time! The Crack Pie itself is very rich. It is a chilled slice of buttery, brown sugar custard on a toasted oat crunch. It's like a cross between baklava and a granola bar. Very filling yet satisfying in just a few bites. Probably better with a cup of coffee. So much more to try and I'm sure I'll be back with friends and family so we can share! Cookies, cakes, breads, milkshakes, fancy shakes - a whole lot of sweetness right there!

text: Ótima variedade de crepes e um cardápio excelente. A equipe parece um pouco sobrecarregada, já que está muito movimentada. Os crepes são frescos e vale a pena experimentar. Vale a pena esperar e voltarei em breve.
text_en: Great variety of crepes, and an excellent menu. The staff seems a bit overwhelmed, as there’s a lot of activity. The crepes are fresh, and it’s worth trying them. It’s worth waiting—I’ll be back soon.
original: great crepe selection and a great menu..staff looks a bit overwhelmed because it's busy.. fresh crepes and a must try..worth the wait and will be back soon..

text: Hay muchísimos postres deliciosos. Es muy difícil dejar de pedir cuando vienes aquí. Desde los macarons hasta las tartaletas y los muffins, todo está delicioso. ¡Y el café también es excelente!
text_en: There are so many delicious desserts. It’s very hard not to order when you come here. From macarons to cakes and muffins, everything is delicious. And the coffee is also excellent!
original: There are sooooo many delicious treats. It's so hard to stop ordering when you go here. From macaroons to tarts and muffins they are all so good. The coffee is yummy too!

text: Aunque la caja para llevar de comida china y la galleta de la fortuna sean solo una tontería, ¡todavía las disfruto! Es una pequeña tienda que ofrece algunos sabores interesantes. No diría que los sabores son extravagantes, pero tampoco son convencionales. El "Captain Crunch" me conquistó. Tenía el mismo sabor que el cereal. No todos los sabores son tan sorprendentes, pero hay una buena cantidad que son realmente deliciosos. También me encantó el chocolate blanco con frambuesa. ¡Pruébenlo!
text_en: Although the Chinese food bag and the “fortune cookie” are just a bit silly, I still enjoy them! It’s a small store that offers some interesting flavors. I wouldn’t say the flavors are extravagant, but they aren’t either conventional. “Captain Crunch” really caught my attention. It had the same taste as cereal. Not all flavors are so surprising, but there are plenty that are truly delicious. I also loved the white chocolate with raspberry flavor. Try it out!
original: Even if the chinese takeout box and fortune cookie are gimmicky, I still eat it up! A small, cooky shop that offers some interesting flavors. I wouldnt say the flavors are wacky, but they are not conventional. The captain crunch won my heart! It tasted EXACTLY like the cereal. Not every flavor they have is as mindblowing, but there's a good amount that are damn good. The white chocolate raspberry chocolate stood out to me as well. Check it out!

text: Que delícia e diversão comprar um cupcake diretamente de um caixa eletrônico! Os cupcakes eram deliciosos e macios. Recomendo fortemente uma parada no caixa eletrônico.
text_en: What a delight and fun it is to buy a cupcake directly from an ATM! The cupcakes were delicious and soft. I highly recommend making a stop at the ATM.
original: What a cupcake and fun of buying it out of an ATM. The cupcakes where Delicious and moist. I highly recommend a stop at the ATM.

text: Paramos aquí en el camino a casa para satisfacer el antojo de dulces de mi esposa, después de haber cumplido mis propias necesidades de cerveza. Me sorprendió la cantidad de gente justo antes de las nueve de la noche, un jueves. De hecho, no había leído nada sobre este lugar y había pasado por delante muchas veces sin saber que existía. La multitud de personas decidiendo qué pedir no era lo ideal, pero un empleado tomó nuestro pedido y nos indicó dónde sentarnos. Simplemente le dije que quería algo de chocolate, con chocolate y más chocolate. Lo que eligió fue perfecto. El mousse de chocolate combinó muy bien con mi Abita Jockamo IPA y el último episodio de "Gran Hermano". En general, nuestro pedido costó alrededor de 13 dólares por dos porciones pequeñas y dos porciones más grandes. Gracias al libro de entretenimiento, que nos dio un descuento de 5 dólares, el total fue de 8 dólares.
text_en: We stopped here on the way home to satisfy my wife’s craving for sweets, after fulfilling my own beer needs. It was surprising how many people were there just before 9 p.m., on a Thursday. In fact, I hadn’t read anything about this place before, and I had passed by it many times without knowing it existed. The crowd deciding what to order wasn’t ideal, but a staff member took our order and showed us where to sit. I simply said I wanted something with chocolate—more chocolate, really. What they chose was perfect. The chocolate mousse paired well with my Abita Jockamo IPA and the latest episode of “Big Brother”. Overall, our order cost around $13 for two small portions and two larger portions. Thanks to the entertainment book, which gave us a $5 discount, the total came to $8.
original: We stopped by here on the way home to satisfy my special lady wife's need for sweets after two stops indulging my own beer needs. i was surprised at the crowd just before 9 o'clock on a Thursday night. i really had not read anything about this place and had driven by countless times having no clue it even existed. The cluster of ooglers and droolers deciding what to order wasn't ideal, but some dude took our order and moved us along. i just told him i wanted something chocolate and chocolate with some chocolate. Whatever he picked out was perfect. The chocolate mousse-stuff went nicely with my Abita Jockamo IPA and the latest episode of Big Brother. All in all, our order was like $13 for 2 little bites and two bigger treats. Thanks be to the Entertainment Book for $5 off, bringing the total to $8.

text: Insane. I wish I had a quarter for size comparison. This sandwich was almost as big as my head! And SO delicious. I was a little put off by the fact that it was $8.00, but let me tell you, it was worth every penny. I got Captain Crunch ice cream (yes, you read that right). It tasted like the milk at the end of the bowl, and had some chewy Captain Crunch pieces throughout. The girl behind the counter let me sample it first, so if you're skeptical, give it a try! THEN, I sandwiched it between two salted caramel oatmeal cornflake cookies. You can't see the second cookie, but it's under there somewhere. I can't even begin to explain how amazing this was. You could definitely split it with another person, but why would you want to!

I was a little put off by the fact that it was $8.00, but let me tell you, it was worth every penny. I got Captain Crunch ice cream (yes, you read that right). It tasted like the milk at the end of the bowl, and had some chewy Captain Crunch pieces throughout. The girl behind the counter let me sample it first, so if you're skeptical, give it a try! THEN, I sandwiched it between two salted caramel oatmeal cornflake cookies. You can't see the second cookie, but it's under there somewhere. I can't even begin to explain how amazing this was. You could definitely split it with another person, but why would you want to!

text: Walking the strip we wanted something sweet to snack on and something to wash it down with. We sampled the Better Nutter Cookie and Almond Chocolate Croissant (warmed up). If you love peanut butter you can't go wrong with the cookie. It was all sorts of peanut goodness. I'd recommend asking them to warm up your croissant - it melts in your mouth when you do! We had a Vanilla Latte and Iced London Fog (like an Earl Gray Tea Latte with Vanilla - but you have to ask for since it's not on the menu). Both were good.
text_en: Walking the strip we wanted something sweet to snack on and something to wash it down with. We sampled the Better Nutter Cookie and Almond Chocolate Croissant (warmed up). If you love peanut butter you can't go wrong with the cookie. It was all sorts of peanut goodness. I'd recommend asking them to warm up your croissant - it melts in your mouth when you do! We had a Vanilla Latte and Iced London Fog (like an Earl Gray Tea Latte with Vanilla - but you have to ask for since it's not on the menu). Both were good.

text: Fuimos aquí después de disfrutar de la cena en Windsor, que está justo al lado. Todo el personal fue muy amable y nos animó a probar varios sabores antes de decidirnos por uno. Yo pedí el de caramelo y nueces, y estaba delicioso. Mi esposa optó por el de galletas y menta. Se nota claramente la calidad y el sabor artesanal del helado. Una excelente opción para complementar la excelente cena en Windsor.
text_en: We came here after enjoying dinner in Windsor, which is right next door. All the staff were very friendly and encouraged us to try several flavors before deciding on one. I ordered the caramel and nuts flavor, and it was delicious. My wife chose the cookies and mint flavor. The quality and artisanal taste of the ice cream are clearly evident. It’s an excellent choice to complement the great dinner in Windsor.
original: We went here after enjoying dinner at Windsor next door. Everyone behind the counter was super friendly and encouraged us to sample a few flavors before deciding on one to order. I had the Caramel Cashew and it was delicious. My wife went for the Cookies and Mint. You can definitely tell the quality and homemade taste of the ice cream. A great follow up to the excellent dinner at Windsor.

text: ¡Qué encantadora heladería! El personal fue informativo y servicial. El menú es fácil de leer. Entramos por la parte trasera, desde Windsor, y el personal nos indicó amablemente que la cola estaba afuera. Había una pareja delante de nosotros y permanecimos dentro, disfrutando del ambiente fresco. El personal fue atento y parecía disfrutar de su trabajo. Gran ambiente y actitud. Mientras esperábamos para ordenar, la heladería tenía varios tipos de dulces expuestos para ver y comprar, por si queríamos disfrutarlos con nuestro helado. ¡Hay tantas opciones, pero pedí un clásico helado de chocolate, fresa y plátano! ¡Delicioso!
text_en: What a lovely ice cream shop! The staff were informative and helpful. The menu is easy to read. We entered from the back side, from Windsor, and the staff kindly told us that the line was outside. There was a couple in front of us, so we stayed inside, enjoying the cool atmosphere. The staff were attentive and seemed to enjoy their work. Great atmosphere and attitude. While we were waiting to order, the shop had several types of desserts displayed for us to see and buy, in case we wanted to enjoy them with our ice cream. There are so many options, but I ordered a classic chocolate, strawberry, and banana ice cream! Delicious!
original: What a cute little ice cream shop!! The staff was informative and helpful. The menu is easy to read. We entered through the backside from Windsor and the staff kindly let us know that the line went outside. There was 1 couple in front of us and we stayed inside in the cool air. The staff was attentive and was happy to be at work. Great attitude/atmosphere. While waiting to order, the store has several types of candy placed for viewing/purchasing in case you want to enjoy with your treat. There are so many choices but I got a classic hot fudge, strawberry, & banana sundae. Yummy!!

text: He encontrado mi lugar favorito para postres, especialmente el halo halo. ¡Increíble! La presentación y el sabor de mi bebida han sido perfectos para mi paladar. Tenía tantos ingredientes deliciosos que se encuentran en una bebida de halo halo, e incluso más. El ube, el buko y el flan, ¡son los que lo hacen tan delicioso! Costó alrededor de 6 dólares y valió cada centavo. Está ubicado en un centro comercial y cerca de las vías, por lo que es difícil perderlo. Es un lugar excelente para reunirse con amigos y disfrutar de una variedad de bebidas y postres. ¡Definitivamente volveré!
text_en: I found my favorite place for desserts, especially Halo Halo. It’s amazing! The presentation and taste of my drink are perfect for my palate. There are so many delicious ingredients in a Halo Halo drink—and even more. Ube, buko, and flan are what make it so delicious! It costs around $6, and it was worth every penny. It’s located in a shopping center near highways, so it’s hard to miss it. It’s an excellent place to meet friends and enjoy a variety of drinks and desserts. I’ll definitely go back!
original: I have found my go-to place for sweets, specifically halo halo. My goodness, the presentation and substance in my drink has done justice to my palate. It had so much of the flavorful ingredients that you have in a halo halo drink and more. The ube, buko panda, and flan what makes it so delicious. It was around $6 and well worth it. It's located in a strip mall and by the rails so it would be hard to miss. It's a great place to meet up with people for a variety of drinks and sweets. Will definitely will be back!

text: Ok I know everyone will hate me, only 3 stars. The pastries all look better then that actually taste. I feel the place is ok but a real good competitor would give them a real run for the money. The pricing is over the top. The people that work there are very pleasant. A place to go but not as wonderful as I would expect.
text_en: Ok I know everyone will hate me, only 3 stars. The pastries all look better then that actually taste. I feel the place is ok but a real good competitor would give them a real run for the money. The pricing is over the top. The people that work there are very pleasant. A place to go but not as wonderful as I would expect.

text: Comida: 5 Decoración: 4 Ambiente: 5 Servicio: 4 Valor: 4.5 Los mejores bizcochos que he probado. Probablemente también los mejores capuchinos y rollos de canela. Este lugar cumple con todas las expectativas.
text_en:
Food: 5  
Decoration: 4  
Atmosphere: 5  
Service: 4  
Value: 4.5  
The best biscuits I’ve tried. Probably also the best capuchinos and cinnamon rolls. This place meets all expectations.
original: Food: 5 Decor: 4 Ambiance: 5 Service: 4 Value: 4.5 The best biscotti I've ever tasted. Probably the best cappuccino and cinnamon roll as well. This place lives up to its hype for sure.

text: Increíblemente económico, considerando la calidad de los productos horneados y el café es excelente.
text_en: Incredibly cost-effective, considering the quality of the baked products; the coffee is also excellent.
original: Unbelievably inexpensive for the quality of the baked goods and the coffee is amazing.

text: Amostras de chocolates na entrada, ótimo. Localizado em frente à Sprinkles, legal. Os baristas discutindo sobre como preparar o café com chocolate branco gelado que eu pedi... não muito legal. Espero que saibam preparar um café simples. O sabor estava ok, mas precisava de algo doce e com cafeína. Gosto sempre de saber os preços ao ler essas avaliações, então paguei 8,70 dólares por um latte médio e uma garrafa de água. Era uma tarde tranquila de terça-feira, apenas duas outras pessoas na loja, e demorou um pouco para preparar meu café. Mas a senhora na entrada foi muito simpática. A loja oferece uma boa variedade, com uma promoção de 80 unidades. Mas eu não comprei nada.
text_en: Sample chocolates at the entrance – great. Located right in front of Sprinkles, nice place. The baristas were discussing how to make the cold white chocolate coffee I ordered… not very pleasant. I hope they can prepare a simple coffee. The taste was okay, but I needed something sweet with caffeine. I like to know the prices when reading these reviews, so I paid $8.70 for a medium latte and a bottle of water. It was a quiet Tuesday afternoon; there were just two other people in the store, and it took a while to prepare my coffee. But the person at the entrance was very friendly. The store offers a good variety of products, with a promotion of 80 units. But I didn’t buy anything.
original: Sample chocolates at the door, awesome. Located across from Sprinkles, cool. The baristas going back and forth about how to make the Iced White Chocolate Latte that I ordered... not so cool. I would hope you should know how to make a simple coffee drink. Tasted okay, but needed a sweet caffeinated treat. I always like to know price points when reading these reviews.. so I paid $8.70 for a medium latte and a bottle of water. It was a quiet Tuesday afternoon, only 2 other people in the store, and it took a little while to make my coffee. But the lady at the door was very nice. The store offers a good variety with an 80-piece special. But I didn't buy any.

text: En dos ocasiones, alimentos de este establecimiento han provocado intoxicación alimentaria en mi familia. Tienen un cartel que indica que se deben mantener todos los productos refrigerados, así que supongo que este es un problema recurrente. Primero, mi esposo se enfermó después de comer una galleta hace seis meses. Esta mañana, mi hija está enferma después de comer un cupcake como postre anoche. Nunca más. Obviamente, tienen un problema si esperan que todos coman pasteles fríos. Quizás deberían cocinar los alimentos correctamente en primer lugar. He escuchado de un amigo que él y su familia se enfermaron después de comer aquí. Es una pena, esperaba que solo fuera mi familia. Siento pena por las personas que están de vacaciones y se enferman aquí.
text_en: On two occasions, the food from this establishment has caused food poisoning in my family. They have a sign indicating that all products must be kept cold, so I assume this is a recurring problem. First, my husband fell ill after eating a cookie six months ago. This morning, my daughter is sick after eating a cupcake as dessert last night. No more like that. Obviously, there’s a problem if they expect everyone to eat cold desserts. Perhaps they should cook the food properly first. I heard from a friend that he and his family got sick after eating here. It’s unfortunate; I thought it would just be my family. I feel sorry for people who are on vacation and get sick here.
original: Twice now, treats from this joint have given my family food poisoning. They have a sign saying to keep everything you purchase refrigerated, so I imagine this is an ongoing problem. First, my husband got sick off a cookie six months ago. This morning my daughter is sick after have a cupcake for dessert last night. Never again. Obviously they have an issue if they expect everyone to eat cold pastries. Maybe they need to cook things properly in the first place. Have heard from a friend she and her family have become ill after eating here. Too bad, had hoped it was just my family. Feel for people on vacation who get sick here.

text: So glad that Charlotte finally have a place for matcha ice cream!!! Love it so much that I have been here twice already since they opened. Great place and the staffs are friendly. Soft serve tasted good with huge tea flavor, vanilla is also great, not much vanilla flavor but more like milk flavor. A little on the pricey side but pretty sure I will be a regular here.
text_en: So glad that Charlotte finally have a place for matcha ice cream!!! Love it so much that I have been here twice already since they opened. Great place and the staffs are friendly. Soft serve tasted good with huge tea flavor, vanilla is also great, not much vanilla flavor but more like milk flavor. A little on the pricey side but pretty sure I will be a regular here.

text: 5 stars for friendly staff. 1 star for pastries. Disappointed. Cannoli was old, waxy and had funny flavor after. Bananas on the pie were old & dried. We ended up throwing everything away. because it was so bad.
text_en: 5 stars for friendly staff. 1 star for pastries. Disappointed. Cannoli was old, waxy and had funny flavor after. Bananas on the pie were old & dried. We ended up throwing everything away. because it was so bad.

text: I woke up this morning... 7 AM... because I was going to go try The Donut Bar. There was so much hype about this place from USA today to the food network to Ellen. I was energized and ready to go! I got there at 7:50 in the morning and it was easy to find parking. There was already a line of at least 40 people ahead of me who were also waiting for a shop that was about to open at 8 AM. The wait time to get in once the shop opens at 8 AM was 30 minutes in line outside. Luckily, it was a pleasant day. As I approached the inside of the store, I was surprised to see that I wasn't all that excited. I saw many very large looking donuts with hard tacky frosting that weren't at all appealing. The oversized amount made them less appealing rather than to appear yummy. The smaller donuts looked good and, by smaller, I mean normal size like Dunkin' Donuts regular donuts. The service was just OK. Whoever chose to run this place really doesn't seem to understand what the best environment for customer service is. It was glaring super loud music over the speakers where I could barely hear the person helping me and I'm not sure if they could hear me. I had to order several donuts for a party and thought this is a good place to try because it gets so much publicity so it has to be good. I decided to put my instincts aside because so many people were waiting in front of me and behind me to get into this place and it has gotten all these reviews. As I ordered, after two dozen donuts, the server just went off to help somebody else without even asking me if I was finished with my order. I couldn't believe it! I was very friendly during the whole interaction which is why this shocked me. I did not bother calling her back because I am not confrontational and simply will let something like this go, but won't let it go during a review. The donuts range from two dollars that are very small to some pastries that are upwards of four dollars. I ordered several donuts including the Twix, Samoa, blueberry with lemon, chai, Nutella, Red velvet, and the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. Here is what I have to say: firstly, you have to eat these donuts the day of because they are not as good the next day. With that being said, most of the donuts were not that impressive to begin with. They were just ok or disappointing. In fact, the crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e donut, which gets all of this amazing hype, was one of the worst ones of the bunch. The hard sugar/Caramel crust on top of the donut was so burnt that it carried a foul aftertaste. The donut itself had a yummy crÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e center within the dough. The topping of the crunchy burnt sugar/Caramel ruined it. I also did not like that many of the donuts were grossly over sized with a great deal of tacky frosting on it which was glazed and dried off. I did order a couple of those and they were not very good. This place is OK. I did not try the coffee and I wonder if that would've changed my mind and increased their ratings. The donuts are so so. They aren't that much better than other places or don't cost a lot less so I do not know what people are talking about. Also, the wait time and price just isn't worth it. It is a very popular place and a lot of people come here. Not sure if there are people that love donuts so much that this is considered great quality??? I love food and have been very fortunate to taste some phenomenal food internationally at some of the best places. I know donuts and sadly, the donut bar does not have anywhere close to the best donuts around. The two stars are because it is expensive, the service was disappointing, the wait time to get the donuts was way too long for this,and the donuts did not impress. I am glad I tried it just take the hype away and I should have gone with my instincts.
