text: Não consigo descrever o quão incrível era o sorvete, e o atendimento foi ainda melhor!! Agora é o meu lugar favorito.
text_en: I can’t describe how amazing the ice cream was, and the service was even better!! Now it’s my favorite place.
original: Can't even put into words how amazing the ice cream was and the ownership was even better!! New favorite spot.

text: Love, love, love this place! They have a spunky interior. Some cool ideas and awesome cupcakes and ice creams. I tried their dark chocolate banana cupcake n was left speechless!
text_en: Love, love, love this place! They have a spunky interior. Some cool ideas and awesome cupcakes and ice creams. I tried their dark chocolate banana cupcake n was left speechless!

text: Um café muito espaçoso em Urbana. Gostaria que este existisse durante a maior parte dos meus estudos de graduação – infelizmente, só descobri quando estava quase terminando a pós-graduação. A decoração é divertida, e muitos dos doces também são deliciosos. Há bolos gigantes recheados com frutas e enormes BingSu! O café tem raízes coreanas, então também serve sushi e onigiri de atum picante, pelo que entendo. O café é bom. Minha última visita foi antes que os estudantes retornassem ao campus, então o ambiente era convidativo e relaxante. Acho que durante o ano, provavelmente não há lugar para sentar aqui, o que provavelmente me incomodaria se eu quisesse apenas tomar um café. Há placas nas portas que dizem "proibido entrada de alimentos ou bebidas externas". Sinto que isso deveria ser óbvio, mas claramente houve vários clientes que não seguiram essa regra!
text_en: A very spacious coffee shop in Urbana. I wish such a place existed during most of my undergraduate studies – unfortunately, I only discovered it when I was nearing the end of my graduate studies. The decor is fun, and many of the desserts are also delicious. There are huge cakes filled with fruits and big BingSu! The coffee shop has Korean origins, so it serves sushi and spicy tuna onigiri, as I understand. The coffee is good. My last visit was before the students returned to the campus, so the atmosphere was pleasant and relaxed. I think throughout the year, there probably isn’t much space to sit here, which would be inconvenient if I just wanted to have a coffee. There are signs on the doors saying “no food or drink allowed.” I feel this should be obvious, but clearly several customers didn’t follow this rule!
original: Very spacious coffee shop in Urbana. I wish this was around for most of my undergrad - alas it didn't really pop up until I was almost done with grad school. The interior furniture is fun and a lot of the dessert items are very fun too. Giant sweetbreads loaded with fruit and giant BingSu! The shop has Korean roots so they serve Korean sushi as well as spicy tuna onigiri I think. The coffee is alright. My most recent visit was before students moved back to campus so the ambience was inviting and relaxing. I think during the year there is probably nowhere to sit in here which would probably annoy me if I wanted to stop in and just get a chill cup of coffee. There are signs on the doors that say no outside food or drink. I feel like this should be obvious but clearly there have been mult. Patrons guilty of this faux paux!

text: Siempre hemos sido fans del programa "Cake Boss", así que cuando nos enteramos de que había una pastelería en el Venetian, decidimos visitarla. Mi hermana pidió un cannoli de hojaldre con miel y, para ser honestos, no fue necesario envolverlo en una caja para llevarlo. Después de probarlo, no pudo dejarlo. ¡Estos pasteleros son talentosos y sus creaciones son realmente deliciosas!
text_en: We’ve always been fans of the “Cake Boss” show. So when we heard there was a bakery at the Venetian, we decided to visit it. My sister ordered a pastry made of puff pastry with honey. To be honest, there wasn’t even a need to wrap it in a box to take home. After trying it, she couldn’t stop eating it. These bakers are talented, and their creations are really delicious!
original: We've always been a fan of the show Cake Boss, so when we heard there was a bakery shop in the Venetian we made it a point to check it out! My sister ordered a maple donut cannoli and let's just say, there was no need to wrap it in a box to take to go. After 1 bite, she couldn't put it down. These bakers are TALENTED and the treats are quite the treat!

text: Não tenho certeza do que aconteceu na minha visita à Sinful Sweets. Estava realmente animado para experimentar este lugar depois de ler as avaliações, mas não correspondeu totalmente às minhas expectativas. Comprei um milkshake de chocolate vermelho (4,99 dólares). Outros avaliadores mencionam um atendimento incrível, e eu precisei lutar para conseguir um milkshake simples numa noite de quinta-feira, em horário de pico. Peça recomendações, mas não consegui nem isso do funcionário do balcão. Talvez tenha sido apenas um dia ruim. O milkshake em si estava ótimo, com um sabor maravilhoso, mas eu realmente queria um canudo com chocolate, como outros avaliadores mencionaram. Isso definitivamente não aconteceu. Talvez eu volte um dia, para tentar novamente, mas fiquei bastante desapontado. Eles aceitam cartões de crédito!
text_en: I’m not sure what happened during my visit to Sinful Sweets. I was really excited to try this place after reading the reviews, but it didn’t quite meet my expectations. I ordered a red chocolate milkshake for $4.99. Other reviewers mention excellent service, and I had to fight for a basic milkshake on a Thursday night during peak hours. I asked for recommendations, but I couldn’t even get that from the cashier. Maybe it was just a bad day. The milkshake itself was great—with a wonderful taste—but I really wanted a chocolate straw, as other reviewers mentioned. That definitely didn’t happen. Maybe I’ll come back someday to try again, but I’m quite disappointed. They accept credit cards too!
original: I'm not sure what went wrong on my trip to Sinful Sweets. I was really excited to try here after reading the reviews, but it did not quite meet my expectations. I got a red velvet milkshake ($4.99). Other reviewers talk about this amazing service, and I was pulling teeth to get a basic milkshake on a Thursday night at rush hour. I asked for recommendations and could not even get that from the person working the counter. Maybe it was just an off day. The actual milkshake was great with amazing flavor, but I really wanted a chocolate dipped straw like other reviewers had. That definitely did not happen. Maybe I'll make it back here eventually for a second try, but I was bummed out. They do take credit cards!

text: This was my first time going to this business. I am a huge fan of cheesecake ice cream and theirs is spot on. It has chunks in the ice cream not just flavoring. The location is easy to find and it's very well priced for the quality. Great place for ice cream
text_en: This was my first time going to this business. I am a huge fan of cheesecake ice cream and theirs is spot on. It has chunks in the ice cream not just flavoring. The location is easy to find and it's very well priced for the quality. Great place for ice cream

text: Sugar bomb a Rama. I actually think they have gone to larger donuts and more frosting than their San Diego original, but hey, Vegas baby. My favorite remains the Oreo birthday cake, but most anything is good -- except the fritters. Those are the only thing on the menu that goes the other way, under glazed relative to their dough mass. Definitely worth the walk when you're near downtown.
text_en: Sugar bomb a Rama. I actually think they have gone to larger donuts and more frosting than their San Diego original, but hey, Vegas baby. My favorite remains the Oreo birthday cake, but most anything is good -- except the fritters. Those are the only thing on the menu that goes the other way, under glazed relative to their dough mass. Definitely worth the walk when you're near downtown.

text: Their donut/ ice cream sandwich WAS DELICIOUS!! They had the most welcoming and kind staff. Although it was a pretty penny, their ice cream was worth it!!!
text_en: Their donut/ ice cream sandwich WAS DELICIOUS!! They had the most welcoming and kind staff. Although it was a pretty penny, their ice cream was worth it!!!

text: Não tenho palavras para descrever o quão maravilhosa é a comida e o sorvete! O atendimento também é excelente e mal posso esperar para voltar! Os sabores do sorvete são incrivelmente criativos, hum, como o de manga com habanero! Este lugar é imperdível!
text_en: I have no words to describe how wonderful the food and ice cream are! The service is also excellent, and I can’t wait to come back! The flavors of the ice cream are incredibly creative—like mango with habanero! This place is absolutely worth visiting!
original: I cannot say enough about how amazing the food and the ice cream is! The staff is equally incredible and I can't wait to go back! The ice cream flavors are so creative, umm hello mango habanero This place is a must visit!

text: Que lugar incrível para tomar sobremesa! Este lugar me lembrou algo que encontraria em Chicago (minha cidade natal). Eu pedi o sundae de s'mores e tudo que posso dizer é: DELÍCIA! Sorvete de chocolate, biscoitos Graham com mel, marshmallow caramelizado... O que mais eu poderia pedir? Meu namorado pediu um brownie com calda quente e o brownie estava simplesmente perfeito... Recomendo muito este estabelecimento se você está procurando uma sobremesa divertida e inovadora! E tem mais: eles ficam abertos até tarde!
text_en: What an amazing place for dessert! This place reminded me of something I would find in Chicago (my hometown). I ordered the s’mores sundae, and all I can say is: DELICIOUS! Chocolate ice cream, Graham crackers with honey, caramelized marshmallows… What more could I ask for? My boyfriend ordered a brownie with hot syrup, and the brownie was simply perfect… I highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a fun and innovative dessert! And they’re open until late!
original: What a great place to grab dessert!! This place reminded me of something you'd find in Chicago (my hometown). I had the s'mores sundae and all I can say is YUM! Chocolate ice cream, honey graham crackers, seared marshmallow fluff, etc... what more could I have asked for? My boyfriend had a brownie ala mode with hot fudge and the brownie was phenomenal... I highly recommend this establishment if you're looking for a fun, innovative dessert! Added bonus, they are open late!

text:
Estábamos preparándonos para ir al aeropuerto y queríamos comer algo en el hotel antes de marcharnos. Estaba cerca, en el camino hacia el aeropuerto, y asumimos que probablemente sería mejor que cualquier comida que se pudiera encontrar en un aeropuerto. Aquí están los platos que probamos:

Sándwich de pavo y brie: Brie, lechuga, pavo asado y mostaza. Calentado y prensado, el pan tenía la textura de un ciabatta, lo cual era bueno. La cremosidad del brie se volvió un poco pegajosa y líquida en el sándwich después de calentarlo, y me gustó el aroma y la textura del brie derretido en cualquier forma. Sin embargo, debo admitir que no fue excepcional, era bueno, pero el sabor no era diferente a un sándwich que podría haber hecho yo mismo.

Sándwich de jardiniere de verduras: Con champiñón portobello, berenjena, hinojo, cebollas caramelizadas, chile picillo, queso fontina y pesto. Mi pareja pidió este. ¡Oh, Dios mío! Este es el sándwich que DEBERÍA haber pedido desde el principio. Es un sándwich vegetariano, pero la jugosidad de los champiñones, la textura de la berenjena, con los aromas y el crujido del hinojo. Cada bocado era casi una experiencia única y satisfactoria, con una mezcla de cebollas caramelizadas, el suave calor y la textura del chile y el queso fontina derretido que se sentaba delicadamente en el borde del cuchillo, con un sabor y una textura abundantes, pero también manteniendo la delicadeza para no dominar el sándwich. En serio, a mi pareja le encantó tanto este sándwich que casi no pude probar más. Incluso le ofrecí un intercambio en nuestros sándwiches, y ella simplemente sonrió y siguió comiendo. Este fue un sándwich fantástico, incluso para mí, un ferviente amante de la carne, que siento que sería un sándwich que me gustaría comer regularmente.

"Bouchons" de chocolate: Su nombre se debe al hecho de que están formados como las tapas de las botellas de vino. Sin duda, saben mucho mejor que las tapas reales, estos pequeños bocados eran ricos y muy jugosos, con pequeños trozos de chocolate en su interior. Me recuerda a un brownie, ¡un brownie excelente!

"Eclair" de chocolate: Este fue mi postre, y, siendo un gran amante del chocolate, cuando lo vi en el escaparate, no tuve ninguna oportunidad. La masa del choux era ligera y aireada, con una dulzura suave y sutil, además, la crema de chocolate era decadente y suave, y había una generosa capa de más chocolate encima, creando un equilibrio perfecto con cada bocado delicioso.

Tarta de limón: La elección de mi pareja, y, honestamente, ¡otra vez me ha superado! El relleno de limón me recordó casi a un curd de limón; con toda la ralladura que pusieron, realmente se podía saborear el limón fresco, con un nivel de acidez maravilloso equilibrado con una textura cremosa. Lo más notable es la corteza, en lugar de hacer simplemente una corteza de tarta o una corteza de galletas Graham, usaron una corteza de nueces de pino fresca, las nueces de pino crearon un aroma maravilloso, una textura crujiente y con nueces. Cada bocado de los dos elementos, con sus sabores y texturas contrastantes, se unieron creando un plato absolutamente increíble. Es una experiencia que se debe probar, y es algo que me gustaría volver a probar la próxima vez.

"Macarons" parisinos: Estéticamente, eran impresionantes. Compré algunos paquetes para llevar a casa como regalo, y aunque al principio estaban agotados, el personal fue lo suficientemente amable como para ir a la parte de atrás y preparar el resto para completar nuestro pedido. Una presentación y colores maravillosos. Me dijeron que cada uno tenía un sabor diferente (que incluían limón, naranja, fresa, vainilla, mocha y chocolate). Básicamente, tuvimos una demora y, finalmente, un vuelo cancelado, así que mi pareja y yo tal vez probamos uno de los paquetes, ya sabes, queríamos probar el regalo que íbamos a dar y queríamos asegurarnos de que el regalo que íbamos a dar fuera fresco, ya que nuestro próximo vuelo sería al día siguiente. Así que probamos un paquete. Rico, masticable y muy denso, con un maravilloso sabor encerrado en una capa muy delgada de crema. Si tuviera que calificarlo, estaría: vainilla, café, limón, chocolate, fresa y naranja. ¡Se combina muy bien con una taza de café simple!

El día siguiente,
text_en:
We were getting ready to go to the airport, and we wanted to eat something at the hotel before leaving. It was close by, on the way to the airport, and we thought it would probably be better than any food you can find at an airport. Here are the dishes we tried:

Pork and Brie Sandwich: Brie, lettuce, grilled pork, and mustard. The bread had a ciabatta texture when heated and pressed, which was nice. The creamy texture of the brie became a bit sticky and liquid in the sandwich after heating, but I liked the aroma and texture of the melted brie in any form. However, I must admit it wasn’t exceptional—it was good, but the flavor wasn’t different from a sandwich I could have made myself.

Vegetable Gardener Sandwich: With portobello mushrooms, eggplant, fennel, caramelized onions, poblanos, fontina cheese, and pesto. My partner ordered this. Oh my! This is the sandwich I should have ordered from the start. It’s a vegetarian sandwich, but the juiciness of the mushrooms, the texture of the eggplant, along with the aromas and crunch of the fennel. Every bite was almost a unique and satisfying experience, with a mix of caramelized onions, gentle warmth, and the texture of the poblanos and melted fontina cheese, which sat nicely on the edge of the knife. The flavor and texture were rich, but they also kept the delicate nature of the sandwich intact. Really, my partner loved this sandwich so much that I couldn’t eat more. I even offered her a swap in our sandwiches, and she just smiled and continued eating. It was a fantastic sandwich, even for me, a huge fan of meat, who feel like it would be a sandwich I’d like to eat regularly.

Chocolate “Bouchons”: Their name comes from the fact that they’re shaped like wine bottle caps. They definitely taste much better than real caps. These small bites were rich and juicy, with tiny pieces of chocolate inside. It reminded me of a brownie—an excellent brownie!

Chocolate Eclair: This was my dessert. As someone who loves chocolate very much, when I saw it in the shop window, I didn’t have any chance. The choux dough was light and airy, with a soft and subtle sweetness. The chocolate cream was decadent and smooth, and there was a generous layer of more chocolate on top, creating a perfect balance with each delicious bite.

Lemon Tart: My partner’s choice. Honestly, once again, she exceeded my expectations! The lemon filling reminded me of a lemon curd; with all the shredded lemon, you could really taste the fresh lemon, with a wonderful balance of acidity and creamy texture. What’s most remarkable is the crust—instead of just a tart or Graham cracker crust, they used fresh pine nuts. The pine nuts created a wonderful aroma, a crunchy texture with nuts. Each bite of both elements, with their contrasting flavors and textures, combined to create an absolutely incredible dish. It’s an experience that should be tried, and I’d like to try it again next time.

Parisian Macarons: Esthetically, they were impressive. I bought some packages to take home as gifts. Although they were sold out at first, the staff was kind enough to go back and prepare the rest to complete our order. The presentation and colors were wonderful. They said each one had a different flavor (lemon, orange, strawberry, vanilla, mocha, and chocolate). Basically, we had a delay, and eventually, a canceled flight. So my partner and I might have tried one of the packages. You know, we wanted to try the gift we were going to give, and we wanted to make sure it was fresh, since our next flight was the next day. So we tried one package. Rich, chewy, and very dense, with a wonderful flavor enclosed in a thin layer of cream. If I had to describe it, it would be: vanilla, coffee, lemon, chocolate, strawberry, and orange. It goes well with a simple cup of coffee!

The next day,
original: We were getting ready to leave for the airport and wanted to get a bite to eat in the hotel before we left. It was close, on the way out to the airport and we assumed it would probably kick the crap out of any airport food you could get. Here's what we sampled: Turkey Brie Sandwich: Brie, lettuce, roast turkey, and mustard. Warmed and pressed, the bread had a texture of a ciabatta which was good, the creaminess of the brie got a little sticky and runny in the sandwich after heating it, and I liked the aroma and texture of melted brie in any way shape or form. Still, I have to admit, this didn't outstanding, it was good, but the taste wasn't any different from a sandwich that I could have made myself. Vegetable jardiniere Sandwich: With Portabello mushroom, eggplant, fennel, caramelized onions, picquillo pepper, fontina cheese and pesto. My g/f ordered this. Oh my goodness. This is the sandwich I SHOULD have ordered from the start. It is a vegetarian sandwich, but the meatiness of the mushrooms, the texture of the eggplant, with the aromatics and crisp bite from the fennel. Each bite was almost a unique cathartic experience, you had a mixture of caramelized onions, the mellow heat and body from the pepper and the melted fontina cheese was able the sit carefully on the knife edge on being flavorful and robust but also remained delicate enough it didn't overpower the sandwich. Seriously, my g/f loved this sandwich so much, it was almost impossible for me to get additional bites, I even offered her a trade on our sandwiches, where she simply smiled at me and continued eating. This was a fantastic sandwich that even me; a devote carnivore, feel as though this was a sandwich that I would be happy to eat on a regular basis. Chocolate bouchons: Their name was given due to the fact that they are shaped like the corks from bottle of wine. Without a doubt they certainly taste better then the real corks, these little morsels were rich and super moist, with little chocolate bits inside. It reminds me of a brownie, a damn good one at that. Chocolate Eclair: This was my dessert, me being the chocoholic after first glance when I saw it in the glass enclosure, I didn't stand a chance. The choux pastry dough, was light and airy, carried a light and subtle sweetness, additionally the chocolate creme patissiere was decadent and smooth, and there was a rich slathering of more chocolate right on top, creating a lovely balance with each intoxicating mouthful. Lemon Tart: My g/f's choice, and quite honestly she has bested me once again, in terms of picking the item I would get again, the lemon filling almost reminded me of a lemon curd; with all the zest that they put in you could really taste the fresh lemons, the wonderful level of acidity balanced with a creamy richness. Most notably, is the crust, here rather then to just do a pie crust or a simple graham cracker crust, they went with a fresh pine nut crust, the pine nuts created a great aroma, nutty texture with a crisp crunch. With each bite of the two elements, with their contrasting flavors, and textures melded together creating a absolutely amazing dish. It's a must try for those that have yet to experience this, and one I'll be getting next time. Parisian Macaroons Appearance wise these were stunning, I bought a couple of boxes to take back home as gifts, and even though up front they ran out, the staff were kind enough to go into the back room and make the rest to complete our order. Wonderful presentation and colors, I was told that they each had different flavors, (which included lemon, orange, strawberry, vanilla, mocha and chocolate.) Basically, we had a delay and ultimately a cancelled flight so me and my g/f may have dug into one of the boxes, you know we had to sample the gift we were giving and we did want to make sure the gift we were about to give was fresh since our next flight would be the next day. So we sampled a box. Rich, chewy and super dense, with a wonderful flavor sandwiched with a very thin layer of creme. If I had to rate it in the order of preference, it went vanilla, coffee, lemon, chocolate, strawberry and orange. Goes really well with a nice cup of plain coffee as well! The next day on our way back for attempt #2 to the airport, we stopped by one more time here and replenished the macaroons gift box that we consumed while taste testing it. So make sure next time your here go ahead and give into whatever pastries and sweets you desire just make sure don't leave without trying the lemon tart and the Vegetable jardiniere!

text: ¡Oh, Dios mío! Este lugar es increíble. El personal es encantador y, cuando fuimos, no había nadie, así que pudimos probar CADA sabor. ¡Estaba delicioso! Pudimos compartir dos sabores en sus deliciosos y recién hechos donuts, que además eran muy suaves y calientes. Yo pedí "Bourbon Toffee" con miel y lavanda, mi hermana pidió "Cookie Monster" y su "vainilla de Madagascar" (dijo que nunca prueba vainilla porque suele ser aburrida, pero esta sí, había una razón por la que había ganado tantos premios), y mi amiga pidió "butter pecan". No estoy mintiendo cuando digo que estaba tan bueno que nos encantó muchísimo. ¡De verdad, deben ir a este lugar!
text_en: Oh, my God! This place is incredible. The staff are wonderful, and when we went there, there was no one around, so we could try every flavor. It was delicious! We were able to share two flavors in their deliciously fresh donuts—they were also very soft and warm. I ordered “Bourbon Toffee” with honey and lavender; my sister ordered “Cookie Monster” and its “Madagascar Vanilla” (she says she never tries vanilla because it’s usually boring, but this was different—there must be a reason why it won so many awards). My friend ordered “Butter Pecan”. I’m not lying—it was so good that we really loved it. Really, you should go to this place!
original: Oh. My. Gosh. This place you guys is next level! The staff there was incredibly nice and when we went there was no one there so we had a chance to literally try ALL the flavors. SO GOOD. We were able to split two flavors on their amazingly soft and warm home made doughnuts. I got Bourbon Toffee with the Honey Lavender, my sis got Cookie Monster and their Madagascar Vanilla Bean (she said that she never gets vanilla because it tends to be boring but NOT this one, there was a reason why it had won so many awards), and my friend got Butter Pecan. I am not kidding when I say we were literally dying is was sooooooo awesome!! Go out of your way and try this place!

text: Esta foi a terceira vez que experimentei o café da Milk, e, honestamente, estou desistindo. Tudo está ruim, desde os biscoitos, os milkshakes, o bolo e o sorvete. Os biscoitos e bolos estão sempre secos. Os milkshakes são medíocres. Experimentamos o de chocolate e não houve nada de especial, e o preço é extremamente alto para o que a Starbucks considera um "grande". E oferecer o tamanho "pequeno"... que piada! E o sorvete? Sempre tem um gosto estranho, como se fosse meio sal e meio ar. O sorvete é tão leve que quase parece chantilly, em vez de sorvete. O problema não é o atendimento, mas sim a comida.
text_en: This is the third time I’ve tried Milk’s coffee, and honestly, I’m giving up. Everything is bad—the cookies, the milkshakes, the cakes, and the ice cream. The cookies and cakes are always dry. The milkshakes are mediocre. We tried the chocolate version, but there’s nothing special about it, and the price is extremely high for what Starbucks considers a “great” product. And offering a “small” size… what a joke! And the ice cream? It always has a strange taste, like half salt and half air. The ice cream is so light that it almost looks like whipped cream, not ice cream. The problem isn’t the service, but the food.
original: this was the 3rd chance i gave milk and honestly, i give up. everything sucks, from cookies, shakes, cake, soft serve. cookies and cakes are always dry. shakes are meh. we tried the chocolate one and nothing home to write home about, and extremely expensive for what starbucks considers a "tall". and what a joke to even offer the "short" size... and soft serves? always taste like they're half salt, half air. the soft serves are so airy borderline whipped cream tasting more than they are ice cream. it's not the service i have issues with, it's the food.

There is a ton of unique dun flavors of ice cream but I decided on just getting a single scoop cake cone ($4) & my guest got a hot fudge sundae w whipped cream n a cherry on top (bday cake & coolie dough ice cream). text: Incrível!!! Adoro o programa "Cake Boss" e fiquei muito animada ao descobrir sobre a confeitaria em Las Vegas. Após ler as avaliações aqui, no início fiquei um pouco hesitante, pois parecia que teria uma experiência ruim, mas estou muito feliz por ter ido. Inicialmente, fomos no sábado à noite e esperamos apenas cerca de 15 minutos, que foi o tempo total de espera. Não havia uma grande variedade, mas é uma confeitaria pequena e eu não esperava encontrar tudo lá. Pedimos o bolo de chocolate meio amargo em miniatura e um brownie, e oh meu Deus, estavam incríveis! Valeu cada centavo. Então, diria que, se você se baseia em avaliações, espero que isso ajude, pois minha experiência foi exatamente como eu queria!
text_en: Incredible!!! I love the “Cake Boss” program, and I was very excited to learn about the bakery in Las Vegas. After reading the reviews here, at first I was a little hesitant, as it seemed like I might have a bad experience. But I’m very happy that I went. Initially, we went on Saturday night, and we waited just about 15 minutes—that’s the total waiting time. There wasn’t much variety, but it’s a small bakery, and I didn’t expect to find everything there. We ordered a mini half-sweet chocolate cake and a brownie. Oh my God, they were amazing! It was worth every penny. So, if you rely on reviews, I hope this helps—my experience was exactly what I wanted!
original: Amazing!!! I love the show Cake Boss and I was super excited to find out about the bakery in Vegas. After reading the reviews here I was hesitant at first because it seemed like I would have a bad experience but I'm so glad I went. First we went on Saturday evening and we only waited approximately 15 minutes and that was total wait. There was not a huge selection but it's a small bakery and I wasn't expecting everything to be there. We ordered the dark chocolate mini cake and a brownie and ooooohhhhh myyyyy wooordddd they were incredible! Worth every penny. So I would have to say if you are influenced by reviews hopefully this helps because my experience was completely how I wanted it to be!

text_en: The team was very friendly and answered all our questions/provided us with samples of the ice cream. But I was a little disappointed with the cookies I bought… PUMPKIN COOKIE – I was really excited to try it, since I love pumpkin. But I was quite disappointed; it didn’t have the texture or taste I expected. It simply had the flavor of a pumpkin cookie. However, my friend’s mother loved it, so I think it depends on your personal taste. COMPOSED COOKIE – I’m not very fond of crunchy cookies, and this one was also too sweet. The ice cream really worked well with the cereal, but the price was a bit high for what it is.

text: Es un lugar imprescindible en Madison. Es una gran tienda con pocos asientos, pero con una gran variedad de pasteles salados y dulces. Sus croissants rellenos de gruyere son, literalmente, los mejores croissants de Wisconsin. Sus palitos de pan con ajo y queso son grandes, grasientos y me encantan. Mi cosa favorita para comer rápido es comprar uno de sus grandes bollos de pan rellenos de carne o frijoles. Varían diariamente: salchicha, champiñones y queso; frijoles, pesto y queso; tocino, frijoles blancos y parmesano. Todos son increíbles, aunque necesitarás dos para sentirte satisfecho. Aún no he probado los postres, pero puedo asegurarles que también son fantásticos.
text_en: It’s an essential place in Madison. It’s a large store with few seats, but offers a wide variety of salty and sweet pastries. Their Gruyère-filled croissants are literally the best croissants in Wisconsin. Their garlic-and-cheese bread sticks are big, greasy, and I absolutely love them. My favorite quick-meal option is buying one of their large meat or bean-filled bread buns. The options change daily: sausage, mushrooms, and cheese; beans, pesto, and cheese; bacon, white beans, and Parmesan. All of them are incredible, though you’ll need two to be satisfied. I haven’t tried the desserts yet, but I can assure you they are also fantastic.
original: A must-visit in Madison. It's a large storefront with few seats and many savory and sweet pastries. Their croissants filled with gruyere are literally the best croissants in Wisconsin. Their cheese crusted garlic bread sticks are large, greasy, and I have dreams about them. My favorite thing to do on the run is to buy one of their large bread balls with meat or bean filling. It changes daily - sausage, mushroom, and cheese; chick peas, pesto, and cheese; bacon, white bean, and parmesan. All amazing, though you'll need two to be full. I haven't even gotten to the sweets yet but rest assured that they're also all fantastic.

text: Fui a una inauguración limitada y, ¡vaya!, sus crepes eran deliciosos. También probé los crepes de mango y frambuesa, así como el bollo de arroz con aguacate y salmón. El bollo de arroz no vale la pena el precio (2,50 dólares), pero los crepes son increíbles. Salen bien crujientes, con un ligero dulzor proveniente de la crema de yogur. También hay bollos de arroz crujientes en la parte inferior del crepe para compensar la falta de crujido, ¡y eso es genial! Definitivamente recomiendo este lugar por sus crepes. Todavía no he probado otras cosas, como las bebidas y el helado, así que actualizaré cuando las pruebe.
text_en: I went to a limited-time opening, and wow—their crepes were delicious. I also tried mango and cranberry crepes, as well as rice cake with avocado and salmon. The rice cake isn’t worth the price (2.50 dollars), but the crepes are amazing. They’re crispy on the outside, with a slight sweetness from the yogurt cream. There are also crispy rice cakes at the bottom of each crepe to compensate for the lack of crunch—and that’s great! I definitely recommend this place because of its crepes. I haven’t tried anything else yet, like the drinks and ice cream, so I’ll update when I do.
original: I went for a soft opening and omg their crepes were so good. I've had the mango-raspberry and mixed berry crepes as well as the avocado kani rice ball. The rice ball isn't worth the price ($2.50) but the crepes are amazing. They come out nice and crispy with a slight sweetness from the yogurt cream. There are also crunchy chocolate rice balls at the bottom of the crepe to make up for the lack of crispiness there which is so nice!! I definitely recommend this place for their crepes. I've yet to eat the other things like the lightbulb drinks and ice cream, so I'll update once I try those.

text: Se a experiência vegana é assim, por que não somos todos veganos! Estou sempre ouvindo falar sobre o TVDC, e hoje eu passei por ali e decidi parar para comprar alguns. Descobri um novo lugar favorito. O interior do TVDC é absolutamente deslumbrante. É um espaço pequeno e rápido, mas entrar é uma experiência mágica! A equipe foi muito simpática e prestativa ao me ajudar a escolher. Frequentemente, com versões veganas de alimentos, as coisas nem sempre "funcionam" tão bem, mas não é o caso com esses donuts. De verdade, você não teria ideia de que eram veganos, o que os torna incríveis. Os dois que experimentei foram o tiramisu e o shortcake de morango. Sério, este lugar é incrível. Visite o TVDC o mais rápido possível, pois é uma pequena empresa local de propriedade de mulheres e afro-americanas.
text_en: If the vegan experience is like this, why aren’t we all vegans! I keep hearing about TVDC, and today I passed by them and decided to stop by to buy some products. I found a new favorite place. The interior of TVDC is absolutely stunning. It’s a small and quick place, but entering there is a magical experience! The staff were very friendly and helpful in helping me choose. Often, with vegan versions of foods, things don’t always work as well, but not this time. Really, you wouldn’t even know they were vegan, which makes them amazing. The two dishes I tried were tiramisu and strawberry shortcake. Seriously, this place is incredible. Visit TVDC as soon as possible, because it’s a small local business owned by women and African Americans.
original: If going vegan tastes like this, why aren't we all vegan! I keep hearing about TVDC, today I passed it and made a quick decision to pull over and grab some. I've found a new favorite spot. TVDC is absolutely stunning inside. It's a small in and out space, but walking in feels so magical! Staff was so nice and helpful when picking out which to get. Often times with vegan remakes of food, things often times just feel "off" but not with these donuts. You seriously would have NO idea that these were vegan, which is what makes them to die for. My two favorites I tried were the tiramisu and the strawberry shortcake. Seriously, this place rocks. Go show love to this Female Owned, Black Owned, Cleveland Local, small business ASAP.

text: Experimente o sorvete feito com leite de cereal. É bem interessante. A textura é cremosa e o sabor é exatamente como o do cereal. Um ótimo lugar no Cosmo se você estiver procurando por sobremesas rápidas, como biscoitos, milkshakes e sorvete. Lembre-se que não há mesas e é apenas para levar.
text_en: Try the ice cream made with cereal milk. It’s really interesting. The texture is creamy, and the flavor is exactly like that of the cereal. A great place at Cosmo if you’re looking for quick desserts, such as cookies, milkshakes, and ice cream. Remember, there are no tables, and it’s just for taking away.
original: Give their cereal milk soft serve a try. It's pretty interesting. Texture is creamy and taste exactly like cereal. A great spot in cosmo if you are looking for some quick desserts like cookies, milk shakes and ice cream. Bare in mind they do not have any seating and it's to go only.

text: Mi novia y yo fuimos allí hace unas semanas porque el nombre era atractivo, estaba cerca, y las fotos eran interesantes. Sin embargo, me preocupé rápidamente cuando pedí un pedido muy sencillo (una bola de helado de vainilla y otra de fresa en un vaso) y el empleado parecía que no sabía por dónde empezar. Hizo que el pedido fuera mucho más complicado de lo necesario, y el resultado fue tan pequeño que creo que un niño se habría sentido decepcionado. No dije nada porque no me importaba, y le pedí que le preparara a mi novia lo que ella quisiera. Ella pidió uno de los helados de hielo que estaban en la señal. Tenía tres ingredientes, aparte del hielo. El empleado tuvo que volver a mirar la señal varias veces, claramente no tenía idea de qué ingredientes se usaban, y para colmo, ella dijo que apenas podía distinguir los sabores y básicamente tenía un cuenco de hielo rallado por cinco dólares. Los precios son un poco altos para lo que se obtiene, y no tenían casi ningún sabor que nos interesara o que quisieramos probar. Me sentí mal por mi amiga, porque ella había aceptado ir allí porque en línea decía que ofrecían yogur helado. Bueno, en realidad, no ofrecen helado. Ella no puede comer helado. Diré que el interior es estéticamente agradable y podría ser un lugar pequeño y único, si fueran precisos con su menú, supieran qué ofrecen y tuvieran la capacidad de preparar los platos que ofrecen. Espero tener más suerte la próxima vez.
text_en: My girlfriend and I went there a few weeks ago because the name was attractive, it was close by, and the photos were interesting. However, I quickly became worried when I ordered something very simple—a vanilla ice cream ball and a strawberry ice cream in a glass. The employee seemed unsure of how to proceed. They made the order much more complicated than necessary, and the result was so small that I think even a child would be disappointed. I didn’t say anything because it didn’t matter to me, and I asked them to prepare whatever my girlfriend wanted. She ordered one of the frozen ice creams from the menu. It had three ingredients, plus ice. The employee had to look at the menu several times; clearly, they had no idea what ingredients were used. Moreover, she said she could barely distinguish the flavors, and it cost five dollars for just a bowl of crushed ice. The prices are a bit high for what you get, and there wasn’t much flavor that interested or appealed to us. I felt bad for my friend, because she agreed to go there because online it said they offered frozen yogurt. Well, actually, they don’t offer frozen yogurt. She can’t eat frozen yogurt. I’ll say that the interior is visually pleasing, and it might be a small and unique place if they were more precise with their menu, knew what they offered, and had the ability to prepare the dishes they serve. I hope I have better luck next time.
original: My girlfriend and I went there a few weeks ago because it was a catchy name, it was close, and the pictures were interesting. However, I was quickly apprehensive when I ordered a very simple ( one scoop vanilla one scoop strawberry in a cup) order and the employee seemed like he didn't know where to start. He made it vastly more complicated than it had to be and it was so tiny I think a child would have been distraught. I didn't say anything because I didn't mind and told him to get my girlfriend whatever she wanted. She ordered one of the snow cones that they have featured on the sign. It had three ingredients excluding ice. He had to look back at the sign numerous times, he clearly had no idea what went into the dish, and to top it off she said she could barely taste the flavors and basically had a five dollar bowl of shaved ice. They're a little pricy for what you get and they were out of nearly all the flavors we either wanted or wanted to try. I felt bad for my friend because she agreed to go because online it says they offer frozen yogurt. Well, Inside, they don't. She can't have ice cream. I will say the inside is esthetically pleasing and could be a cool little unique place If they were accurate with their menu, knew the menu, and had the ability to make the dishes that they offer. Better luck next time I suppose.

text: Sorvetes deliciosos! (O "Key Lime Pie", os "S'mores", o sorvete de menta com chocolate e a "Chocolate peanut butter cup" foram todos provados durante nossa estadia em Cleveland). Muitas opções, inclusive uma opção sem lactose. Este local tinha bastante espaço, com algumas mesas na parte de trás do prédio e outras no andar de cima. Foi também interessante ver o processo de produção dos sorvetes. Eles também oferecem uma variedade de refrigerantes e água, mas também é possível obter um copo de água gratuitamente. Depois de experimentar esses sorvetes, procuramos por eles em toda a área de Cleveland e conseguimos sempre que podíamos. Delicioso!
text_en: Delicious ice creams! (The “Key Lime Pie”, “S’mores”, mint ice cream with chocolate, and “Chocolate peanut butter cup” were all tried during our stay in Cleveland). There were many options, including one without lactose. The place had plenty of space—some tables were in the back part of the building, and others on the upper floor. It was also interesting to see the process of making the ice creams. They also offer a variety of drinks and water, but it’s possible to get a glass of water for free. After trying those ice creams, we searched around Cleveland to find them, and we managed to get them whenever we could. Delicious!
original: Great ice-cream! (Key Lime Pie, S'mores, Mint-Chocolate Chip and Chocolate peanut butter cup were all eaten during our stay in Cleveland) lots of options - even a dairy free option. This location had a lot of seating, there is some in the back of the building, and some upstairs. Also it was cool to see them making the ice cream. They also have a selection of soda and water, but you can also get a free water cup. Once we tried this ice cream we kept looking for it throughout the Cleveland area and got it whenever we could. Yum!

text: Finalmente, The Milk Bar ha llegado a Las Vegas, con toda la expectación generada por Christina Tosi, el "Crack Pie", el pastel de cumpleaños y el sabor a leche de cereal. Estaba muy emocionado, de hecho, incluso vi vídeos de postres para ponerme de buen humor. Cuando llegó el momento, me encontré con incredulidad y confusión. La experiencia fue decepcionante, similar a la caída de Wile E. Coyote al precipicio mientras persigue a Road Runner. Sentí que las porciones eran pequeñas para los precios exorbitantes que cobraban por los productos. 7 dólares por un helado de tamaño infantil y 6,50 dólares por una porción pequeña de "Crack Pie" es ridículo. Pienso que ambos sabían muy bien, pero no a ese precio. Lo peor es que se servían en vasos de papel y sobres de cartón, durante un momento pensé que estaba en McDonald's. Me hubiera gustado probar el pastel de cumpleaños, pero solo ofrecían el pastel completo. Además, no había suficiente espacio para sentarse. Noté algunas sofás en la zona. Estaba muy concurrido, la gente estaba sentada tomando cócteles, y me sentí incómodo comiendo helado en medio de ellos. No puedo imaginar que esto sea la visión de Christina, ya que esta experiencia no se parece en nada a lo nostálgico que era el helado. Afortunadamente, hay otras opciones en Cosmopolitan que sí disfruto.
text_en: Finally, The Milk Bar has arrived in Las Vegas, bringing all the excitement that comes with Christina Tosi, “Crack Pie,” birthday cakes, and cereal milk flavors. I was really excited; in fact, I even watched videos of desserts to lift my mood. But when it came time to go ahead, I felt both surprised and confused. The experience was disappointing—like Wile E. Coyote falling off a cliff while chasing Road Runner. The portions seemed small for the exorbitant prices charged for the products. $7 for a child-sized ice cream, and $6.50 for a small piece of “Crack Pie” – that’s ridiculous. I think both desserts were delicious, but not at that price. The worst part is that they were served in paper cups and cardboard boxes. For a moment, I thought I was at McDonald’s. I would have liked to try the birthday cake, but they only offered the whole cake. Also, there wasn’t enough space to sit. I saw some sofas in the area. It was very crowded; people were sitting down drinking cocktails, and I felt uncomfortable eating ice cream among them. I can’t imagine this being what Christina had in mind, as this experience doesn’t resemble the nostalgic feeling that ice cream usually gives. Thankfully, there are other options at Cosmopolitan that I actually enjoy.
original: The Milk Bar has finally arrived in Las Vegas, with all the hype surrounding Christina Tosi, the Crack Pie, Birthday Cake and the cereal milk. I was thrilled with anticipation, in fact I even watched dessert clips to get pumped up. When the moment arrived, I was met with disbelief and confusion. The experience factor took a dive similar to how Wile E. Coyote falls off the cliff as he's chasing road runner. I felt the portions were small for the exorbitant prices they were asking for the products. $7 for a kiddie size soft serve and $6.50 for a mini slice crack pie is ridiculous. I thought they both tasted great but not at that price point. What's worse was it was presented in paper cups and cardboard envelopes, for a minute I thought I was at Mcdonalds. I wish I could've tried the birthday cake but they did not offer slices only in a whole. Also, no adequate seating I noticed a few lounge sofas across from me. It was crowded, people were sitting having cocktails, I felt awkward eating ice cream around them. I can't imagine this being Christina's vision as having that nostalgic ice cream experience, this is far from it fortunately, there are other options in Cosmopolitan that I do enjoy.

text: The interior styling and decor of this cafe is incredible with usage of antiques and vintage items to create a cozy, artsy aesthetic. The Butterwood offers a variety of succulent gourmet pastries and cakes with surprising flavors to delight every taste bud. In addition, many coffees and teas are available to accompany your sweet treat. Service is always excellent and the baristas are extremely helpful answering any and all questions. If you want to stop somewhere for a great (and unique) baked good and hot beverage in an interesting setting, you must stop here!

Probé dos "mini tartas" veganas y estaban deliciosas. Definitivamente recomiendo cualquier tipo de bebida con café, probé un capuchino con leche de almendras y fue, sin duda, el mejor que he probado. ¡Sin duda, volveré!
text_en: Your visit was exceptional in every way. Not only was the food delicious, but the staff were also very friendly and willing to chat. I tried two vegan “mini tarts” and they were absolutely delicious. I definitely recommend any drink with coffee—I tried an almond milk cappuccino, and it was undoubtedly the best one I’ve ever had. Without a doubt, I will come back!
original: I had an all-around exceptional visit. Not only was the food delicious, but the staff were very friendly and eager to talk. I had 2 vegan "mini cakes" and they were so delicious! I definitely recommend any type of espresso drink - I had a cappuccino with almond milk and it was by far the best I have ever had. I will definitely be going back!

text: Mmmm, very good ice cream! Since there's no way to get Graeter's in WI (unless I ship it, but I'd end up spending a fortune with how often I'd love to eat it...and it's so much better at the scoop shop), this is a pretty good substitute. I particularly love the great selection of flavors - it seems like there is just about anything and everything you could be in the mood for. Espresso Oreo? Yup. Strawberry Cheesecake? Sure thing. Zanzimint? You got it. Banana or Malted Milk or Peppermint Stick or Cappuccino or Fat Elvis..... I could go on for a while.... As was previously mentioned there's also quite a selection of non-ice cream: gelato, sherbert, non-fat yogurt, soy, etc.

text: Se você procura sorvete, este é o lugar certo! Tenho apenas três coisas a comentar, mas confio em uma avaliação de 5 estrelas para o sorvete e 0 estrelas para a comida. Meu favorito é o sorvete tradicional em um cone de bolo, com cobertura de "Scooter Crunch". O sorvete é cremoso e saboroso, e a cobertura "Scooter Crunch" eleva a experiência a outro nível. Clássico! Meu marido pediu o sundae com biscoito de chocolate e estava delicioso, mas um pouco exagerado para mim. Era feito com sorvete de baunilha, um biscoito de chocolate "Nancy B" quente e calda de chocolate. Se você tem um doce e um apetite grande, recomendo. Na minha última visita, experimentei o "arctic swirl" de cheesecake de blueberry. Se a parte do cheesecake não te interessar, simplesmente peça o sorvete de blueberry. Vale a pena. Ignore a comida – meu amigo pediu batatas fritas e estavam cruas. Não deixe que a fila te desanime, ela se move rapidamente.
text_en: If you're looking for ice cream, this is the right place! I have only three things to comment on: I give the ice cream a 5 stars rating, but 0 stars for the food. My favorite is the traditional ice cream in a cake cone, with “Scooter Crunch” topping. The ice cream is creamy and delicious, and the “Scooter Crunch” topping really enhances the experience. Classic! My husband ordered the sundae with chocolate cookies, which was delicious, but a bit too much for me. It consisted of vanilla ice cream, hot “Nancy B” chocolate cookies, and chocolate syrup. If you have dessert and a big appetite, I recommend it. During my last visit, I tried the “arctic swirl” blueberry cheesecake. If you’re not interested in the cheesecake part, just order the blueberry ice cream instead. It’s worth it. Ignore the food – my friend ordered fried potatoes, and they were raw. Don’t let the line get you down; it moves quickly.
original: If you're looking for soft serve - this is the place to go! I only have 3 things to review, but I feel confident in a 5 star rating for the ice cream and 0 stars for the food.. My go to is the standard twist in a cake cone with scooter crunch topping. The ice cream is smooth and rich and the scooter crunch topping takes it to the next level. Classic! My husband ordered the chocolate chip cookie sundae and it was delicious but a little over the top for me. It came with vanilla ice cream, a warm Nancy B chocolate chip cookie, and hot fudge. If you have a sweet tooth and a big appetite I say go for it. On my last trip I tried the blueberry cheesecake arctic swirl. If the cheesecake part doesn't spark your interest, just get the blueberry soft serve. Worth it. Skip the food - my friend ordered french fries and they were raw. Don't be deterred by the line, it moves quickly

text: Eu fui aqui outro dia para comprar sorvete com meu irmão, não foi nada espetacular... Já experimentei o de banana antes, e também comprei o de chocolate belga e um biscoito, enquanto ele escolheu o de queijo azul com mel. Os sorvetes estavam bons, mas não eram nada de especial. Mas não compre o biscoito com chocolate, ele era tão fino que ficava crocante, e tinha apenas duas gotas de chocolate. Considerando o preço, por apenas uma (pequena) porção + um biscoito, o custo estava próximo de US$ 6. Talvez eu estivesse esperando demais com base nas avaliações? Mas, apesar disso, dei uma estrela extra pela variedade de sabores.
text_en: I went here the other day to buy ice cream with my brother. It wasn’t anything special… I’ve already tried the banana ice cream before, and I also bought Belgian chocolate ice cream and a cookie. He chose the blue cheese with honey one. The ice creams were good, but not particularly special. But don’t buy the chocolate cookie—it was so thin that it was crunchy, and there were just two drops of chocolate in it. Considering the price, for just one small portion plus a cookie, it cost almost $6. Maybe I was expecting too much based on the reviews? But still, I gave an extra star for the variety of flavors.
original: I came here the other day to get ice cream with my brother, it wasn't anything amazing..I've tried the banana before, and got the Belgian chocolate and a cookie, while he tried the honey blue cheese. The ice creams were good, but nothing special really. Don't get the chocolate chip cookie though, it was soo thin that it was crunchy, and had two chocolate chips in it. Especially for what you pay, for just one (tiny) scoop+a cookie it was close to $6. Maybe I was just expecting too much from all of the reviews? 1 extra star for the unique flavors though.

text: Eu já visitei este lugar algumas vezes. Eles oferecem sorvetes com sabor de cereal ou chá de leite. A ideia de sorvete com sabor de cereal é bem interessante. Não sei se já visitei outro lugar que faça isso. Eles definitivamente oferecem muitas opções de acompanhamentos. É um ótimo lugar para encontrar amigos depois de uma refeição e queremos algo leve para petiscar e colocar o papo em dia. Na minha opinião, as bebidas não eram tão boas quanto em outros lugares. Eu pedi o chá de leite de jasmim, que estava um pouco mais fraco do que em outras lojas de boba. No entanto, adoro matcha e pretendo experimentar os seus drinks de matcha na próxima vez.
text_en: I’ve been to this place several times. They offer ice cream with cereal flavors or milk tea. The idea of cereal-flavored ice cream is really interesting. I don’t know if I’ve been to another place that does this. They definitely have many options for side dishes. It’s a great place to meet friends after a meal, and we want something light to snack on and keep the conversation going. In my opinion, the drinks weren’t as good as those in other places. I ordered jasmine milk tea, which was a bit weaker than in other tea shops. However, I love matcha, and I plan to try their matcha drinks next time.
original: I have been to this place a few times. They have ice cream infused with cereal or milk tea drinks. The cereal-infused ice cream is a pretty neat concept. I don't think I have been to another dessert shop that does this. They definitely give you a lot of toppings. This is a great place for meeting up with friends after a meal and we just want something light to snack on and catch up. The drinks in my opinion weren't as great as other places. I ordered the jasmine milk tea which was a little light compared to other boba shops. However I really love matcha and will have to try their matcha drinks next time.

text: El sorbete de pera con especias es increíble. ¡Nunca se podría adivinar que no lleva productos lácteos: es rico y cremoso! Nos alegra haber encontrado este tesoro en la primera noche de nuestro viaje a Phoenix, ¡volveremos!
text_en: The pear sorbet with spices is incredible. It’s hard to believe that it doesn’t contain any dairy products—it’s rich and creamy! We’re glad we found this treasure on the first night of our trip to Phoenix; we’ll come back!
original: Spiced pear sorbet is amazing! You'd never guess it's dairy free: rich and creamy! We're happy to find this gem on the first night of our Phoenix trip, we'll be back!

text: O sorvete de caramelo com manteiga salgada é o motivo pelo qual eu sempre volto... Não preciso experimentar nada mais, porque é perfeito. Rico, cremoso, doce e salgado... mmmmmm. A loja é adorável, embora esteja localizada em um lugar um pouco incomum... mas é um pouco mais cara que a Baskin Robbins, mas vale muito a pena! Os donos são muito simpáticos. Acidentalmente, fomos no dia em que estavam fechados para a sessão de fotos do "Bon Appétit", então estavam fechados, mas quando o dono viu nossa expressão triste, ele gentilmente nos deixou entrar para que pudéssemos pegar um sorvete!
text_en: The caramel ice cream with salty butter is why I always come back… I don’t need to try anything else; it’s perfect. Rich, creamy, sweet, and salty… mmmmmm. The store is lovely, although it’s located in a somewhat unusual place… but it’s a bit more expensive than Baskin Robbins. However, it’s well worth it! The owners are very friendly. By chance, we went there on the day they were closed for “Bon Appétit” photo sessions, so they were closed. But when the owner saw our sad expressions, he kindly let us in so we could get some ice cream!
original: The Salted Butter Caramel ice cream is the reason I go....I don't need to try anything else....because it is perfect. Rich, creamy, sweet and salty.....mmmmm. The shop is adorable, although located in a somewhat odd location....it is a tad pricier than Baskin Robbins....but it is so worth it! The owners are so nice, we happened to go by the day they were closing for their Bon Appetite photo shoot so they were closed, but when the owner saw our sad faces outside, they kindly let us in so we could get a scoop!

text: Esta foi a primeira vez que visitei o Sprinklers, e fiquei impressionado com os cupcakes e sorvetes. Eles também têm uma máquina de vendas para cupcakes. Todos os sabores de sorvete podem ser combinados com os cupcakes. Fizemos um sanduíche de sorvete com cobertura de cupcake. Os preços não são muito altos para Las Vegas, e o atendimento foi rápido. Também há mesas para sentar ao ar livre. Eles também têm uma variedade de biscoitos. Um lugar bom para experimentar.
text_en: This was the first time I visited Sprinklers, and I was impressed by the cupcakes and ice cream. They also have a machine for selling cupcakes. All flavors of ice cream can be combined with cupcakes. We made an ice cream sandwich with a cupcake topping. The prices aren’t very high for Las Vegas, and the service was quick. text: Visitei o Churn depois de ler as avaliações e não fiquei decepcionado. Experimentei a versão com duas bolas, uma com café vietnamita e a outra com sabor de nozes e manteiga – ambas estavam deliciosas! Adicionei chantilly para complementar o sabor… Também experimentei o chocolate com leite maltado, que estava gostoso, mas o sabor de nozes e manteiga me encantou mais. O café vietnamita foi o meu sabor favorito, tanto para mim quanto para o meu marido. A única razão pela qual não dei cinco estrelas é porque, ao verificar o menu online, vi que tinham muitas opções incríveis e diferentes, que eu estava muito ansioso para experimentar, mas na loja só tinham cerca de 6 a 8 sabores de sorvete para escolher – e, independentemente do sabor que experimentei, todas estavam, sem dúvida, excelentes! Além disso, pensei que meu marido e eu não conseguiríamos comer a porção de duas bolas de uma vez (o que, no final, conseguimos), então pedi uma tampa para a tigela, mas eles só tinham uma tigela com borda plana, não uma com formato de cúpula, o que não foi ideal.
text_en: I visited Churn after reading the reviews, and I wasn’t disappointed. I tried the version with two scoops: one with Vietnamese coffee, and the other with nut and butter flavor – both were delicious! I added whipped cream to enhance the taste… I also tried the chocolate with malted milk, which was tasty, but the nut and butter flavor impressed me more. The Vietnamese coffee was my favorite flavor, both for me and my husband. The only reason I didn’t give five stars is because when I checked the menu online, I saw that there were many amazing and diverse options, and I was very eager to try them. But in the store, there were only about 6 to 8 flavors to choose from – and no matter which flavor I tried, they were all excellent! Additionally, I thought that my husband and I wouldn’t be able to finish the two-scoop portion at once (which we did eventually), so I asked for a lid on the bowl. But they only had a bowl with a flat edge, not a dome-shaped one, which wasn’t ideal.
original: Visited churn after looking at the reviews and wasn't disappointed. Tried the double scoop with one scoop of Vietnamese coffee and the other being butter pecan- both were amazing! Got whipped cream as a topping to add to the taste... Also tried the malted milk chocolate which was yummy but butter pecan won over for me. The Vietnamese coffee was the top favorite flavor for me and my husband. The only reason I'm giving less stars here is because when I checked their online menu they had so many amazing and out of the box flavors showing up which I was really looking forward to try but they barely had 6-8 ice cream flavors to choose from at the store - whatever flavor I tried were without a doubt amazing for sure! Also, I thought my husband and I wouldn't be able to finish the double scoop portion at once (which we ended up finishing) so I asked for a lid for the cup and they had only a flat top cup not a dome shaped one which wasn't cool.

text: ¡Una excelente recomendación de helado que me dieron! Había oído hablar de Jeni's antes, pero nunca había tenido la oportunidad de probarlo. ¡Estoy muy contento de haberlo hecho finalmente! Tienen una selección bastante amplia de sabores, al menos un tercio de los cuales son únicos y que nunca había visto ni oído. Ofrecen opciones donde básicamente puedes probar diferentes sabores, lo cual es genial para compartir con amigos y/o familiares. Una opción es la de "trio", donde puedes elegir hasta 3 sabores a tu gusto; la otra opción es literalmente un "menú" con 10 de sus sabores más populares (con posibilidad de sustituciones). Si eres un gran fan del helado y quieres probar prácticamente todos sus sabores, no te equivocarás con el menú de 10. Cuando fui, tenían disponibles 13 sabores... Dicho esto, con el menú, básicamente probarías todos sus sabores. Mis sabores favoritos fueron probablemente la de lavanda y mantequilla de nuez con whisky. El sabor a lavanda no era demasiado intenso, lo cual realmente aprecié. El sabor a lavanda era probablemente más sutil, y se complementaba muy bien con otro sabor, casi cítrico, que en general hizo que la experiencia de degustación fuera única y fenomenal. La de mantequilla de nuez con whisky tenía exactamente el sabor que indica su nombre. El toque alcohólico no era abrumador en absoluto; para mí, realzó mucho el sabor a mantequilla de nuez. La calidad del helado me recordó al de las heladerías artesanales. Definitivamente se puede notar la diferencia entre su helado y, por ejemplo, el helado comprado en la tienda (aunque es una comparación un poco impía, lo sé). Incluso describen sus estándares de producción en sus servilletas, lo cual creo que es muy creativo. Si aún no los has probado y estás de paso, definitivamente deberías hacer una parada para probar el helado aquí.
text_en: A great recommendation for ice cream I received! I had heard of Jeni’s before, but never had the chance to try it. I’m very happy I finally got to try it! They have a quite wide range of flavors, with at least one-third being unique and something I’ve never seen or heard of before. They offer options where you can basically try different flavors, which is great for sharing with friends and/or family. One option is the “trio” set, where you can choose up to 3 flavors according to your preference; another option is a “menu” with 10 of their most popular flavors (with possible substitutions). If you’re a big fan of ice cream and want to try almost all of their flavors, the 10-flavor menu is definitely worth it. When I went there, they had 13 flavors available… But with the menu, you can basically try all of them. My favorite flavors were probably lavender and walnut butter with whiskey. The lavender flavor wasn’t too strong, which I really appreciated. It was more subtle, and it complemented well with another flavor, almost citrusy, which made the tasting experience truly unique and wonderful. The walnut butter with whiskey flavor was exactly what it says on the label. The alcohol taste wasn’t overwhelming at all; it really enhanced the walnut butter flavor. The quality of the ice cream reminded me of handmade ice cream shops. You can definitely tell the difference between their ice cream and, say, ice cream bought from a store (though it’s a bit impious of me to compare them like that). They even describe their production standards on their napkins, which I think is very creative. If you haven’t tried them yet and are passing by, you definitely should make a stop to try their ice cream here.
original: A great ice cream recommendation I was given! I had seen/heard of Jeni's before but never got around to trying it. I am very happy I finally did so! They have a decently wide selection of flavors, at least 1/3 of which are unique and I have never seen/heard of. They provide options where you basically get flights of ice cream, which is super great to share amongst friends and/or family! One option is the trio where you can choose up to 3 flavors of your choosing whereas the other option is literally a flight of 10 of their most popular flavors (substitution allowed). If you're a huge ice cream fan and want to try basically all their flavors, you won't go wrong with the flight of 10. When I went they had 13 flavors available... That being said, with the flight, you'd basically be tasting all their flavors! My personal favorite were probably the Lavender and Whiskey Butter Pecan. The Lavender flavor wasn't overwhelmingly aromatic, which I really appreciated. The lavender flavor was probably more on the subtle side, which was very well complemented by another, almost citric-like flavor that overall made the tasting experience unique and phenomenal. The Whiskey Butter Pecan tasted exactly as it sounds. The alcoholic kick wasn't overbearing at all; to me, it really brought forward the butter pecan flavor. The quality of the ice cream resounded Artisan in my head with eat mouthful. You can definitely taste the difference between their ice cream and for example, store bought ice cream (a blasphemous comparison, I know). They even describe their ice cream production standards on their napkins, which I think is very creative. If you haven't tried them already and are in town, definitely do try to make a stop to try the ice cream here!

Experimentamos pão de banana com Nutella, muffins de cereal, OCP e brownies com marshmallows. O melhor de tudo foi o pão de banana, embora fosse um pouco doce demais. O latte que eu tomei ajudou a equilibrar o sabor. Espero que eles adquiram um micro-ondas ou uma torradeira. Achei que algumas coisas teriam ficado melhores quentes. Por exemplo, os brownies com marshmallows teriam ficado ótimos se estivessem aquecidos. A textura dos marshmallows frios não me agradou tanto. O OCP foi a minha opção menos favorita. O biscoito em si não era o melhor. O recheio estava muito doce e tinha uma textura um pouco arenosa. No geral, um lugar muito charmoso e com funcionários simpáticos.
text_en: I went on a trip from New York to Charlotte to visit friends. I’ve been coming here for some time now, and I was really excited to try it out. I was also very happy to see that the inventory was full! The atmosphere is very charming and welcoming. The dishes they serve are excellent. My friends and I bought some items to try. We tried banana bread with Nutella, cereal muffins, OCP, and brownies with marshmallows. The best part was the banana bread, though it was a bit too sweet. The latte I drank helped balance the taste. I hope they get a microwave or toaster. I thought some items would be better if they were warm. For example, the brownies with marshmallows would have been great if they were heated up. The texture of the cold marshmallows didn’t satisfy me much. OCP was my least favorite option. The biscuit itself wasn’t the best. The filling was too sweet and had a slightly sandy texture. Overall, it’s a very charming place with friendly staff.
original: Took a trip from NYC to Charlotte to visit friends. I've been following the batch maker, for a while now. I was super excited to go and try it out. Also, very happy that the case was stocked !! The setting is very cute and super cozy. The china that they use is to die for. Me and friends all grab some treats, to enjoy. The Banana Nutella bread, the cereal muffins, OCP, and s'mores brownies. The best out of all was the banana bread, although it was a bit too sweet. The latte that I had did help cut back the sweetness. I hope they get a microwave or a toaster. I felt like some of the thing would have been better warmer up. Like the S'more brownie, would have been amazing if it was warmed up. The texture of the cold set marshmallow was a bit off for me. The OCP, was my least favorite. The cookie itself was not the best. The filling was too sweet, and felt a bit chalky. Overall, a super cute spot and friendly staff.
