text: Eu estava com muita vontade de tomar um milkshake e, por acaso, encontrei este lugar em uma busca no Yelp, e foi a melhor descoberta que eu poderia ter feito. Experimentei o milkshake feito com "Bottom of the Cereal bowl" (ou seja, o fundo do pote de cereal), com Cinnamon Toast Crunch, com um toque de pasta de biscoito, e foi ABSOLUTAMENTE delicioso!!!!
text_en: I really wanted to have a milkshake, and by chance, I found this place during a search on Yelp. It was the best discovery I could have made. I tried the milkshake made with “Bottom of the Cereal Bowl,” along with Cinnamon Toast Crunch and a touch of cookie paste—it was absolutely delicious!!!!
original: I was really craving a milkshake and randomly found this place in a Yelp search and it was the greatest thing I could have ever stumbled upon. I got the Bottom of the Cereal bowl milk with Cinnamon Toast Crunch with a drizzle of cookie butter and it was ABSOLUTELY delicious!!!!

text: ¡Qué helado tan delicioso! La textura es increíblemente cremosa y los sabores son ricos y abarcan tanto los clásicos como muchos sabores creativos, como el de flor de naranja (¡impresionante!) y el de miel y galletas Graham — todo a precios excelentes. El personal es paciente y amable. Hay mucho espacio para sentarse al aire libre; no hay asientos en el interior, ya que es una heladería grande, pero gran parte de los asientos están bajo un toldo. Mi única queja es que, de alguna manera, aunque como en otros lugares que he visto en Cleveland, parece que solo se pueden usar algunos sabores para hacer batidos (y a menudo se me olvida preguntar por qué), lo cual es una lástima, ya que muchos de los otros sabores harían batidos increíbles.
text_en: What a delicious ice cream! The texture is incredibly creamy, and the flavors are rich—covering both classic options and many creative flavors, such as orange blossom flavor (impressive!) and honey and Graham cracker flavor—all at excellent prices. The staff is patient and friendly. There’s plenty of space to sit outside; there are no seats inside, since it’s a large ice cream shop, but most seats are under a canopy. My only complaint is that, like in other places I’ve seen in Cleveland, it seems that only some flavors can be used to make smoothies (and I often forget to ask why). It’s a pity, as many of the other flavors would make great smoothies.
original: Such wonderful ice cream!! The texture is joyously creamy and the flavors are rich and encompass the standards and many creative ones -- like orange blossom (outstanding!) and honey graham -- all at excellent prices. The staff is patient and friendly. There's plenty of outdoor seating; there's no indoor seating as this is a large ice cream stand, but much of the seating is under an awning. My only complaint is that oddly -- although like other places I've seen around Cleveland -- it looks like only a few flavors can be used for milkshakes (and I keep forgetting to ask why that is), which is too bad as many of the other flavors would make incredible milkshakes.

text: My niece had been begging me to take her there as she had been raving about how great this place is. So, finally I took her and my daughter. Well, they loved it, but I have to say I wasn't impressed at all. The place is cute and the service was super friendly, but the cupcake I had was not too good. I just had their mini "black and white" and it was about 2 steps below a hostess cupcake. Very dry and very little taste. That's the story! I always tell the good, the bad and the ugly...
text_en: My niece had been begging me to take her there as she had been raving about how great this place is. So, finally I took her and my daughter. Well, they loved it, but I have to say I wasn't impressed at all. The place is cute and the service was super friendly, but the cupcake I had was not too good. I just had their mini "black and white" and it was about 2 steps below a hostess cupcake. Very dry and very little taste. That's the story! I always tell the good, the bad and the ugly...

text: Después de una larga noche de fiesta, estoy agradecido con mis amigos por haber decidido irse temprano y NO salir. Uno de mis amigos hizo exactamente eso. Así que se despertó temprano y alquiló un coche para explorar. Regresó con 5 cajas de donuts para que todos en nuestro grupo las probáramos. Mis favoritas fueron las de crema pastel. ¡Pero todos los donuts eran deliciosos!
text_en: After a long night of partying, I’m grateful to my friends for deciding to leave early and not go out. One of my friends did just that. So he woke up early and rented a car to explore. He came back with 5 boxes of donuts so that everyone in our group could try them. My favorite were the cream pie donuts. But all the donuts were delicious!
original: After a long night of drinking, you are grateful for your friends who decided to call it an early night and NOT go out. One of my friends, did just that. So he woke up early and took the rental car exploring. He came back with 5 boxes of donuts for our group to sample. My favorites were the creme brulee. But every single donut was heaven!

text: We always go here! All of their ice creams are amazing! Definitely worth it! My favorite is their strawberry cheesecake!
text_en: We always go here! All of their ice creams are amazing! Definitely worth it! My favorite is their strawberry cheesecake!

text: Esta avaliação se refere ao café gelado e aos seus macarons. O café gelado estava incrível. Sem notas amargas, muito suave! Os macarons. Meu Deus, nunca vi macarons tão grandes! Eles têm o tamanho de uma palma e oferecem uma variedade de sabores. Comprei uma caixa com sabores de morango, chocolate, café, pistache e blueberry. Achei que estavam perfeitamente feitos, enquanto minha namorada achou que estavam um pouco doces demais. Na defesa dela, eu estava comendo os macarons com meu café gelado preto, então talvez isso tenha sido uma boa combinação. A fila aqui pode ficar um pouco longa, dependendo do horário, mas a fila se move relativamente rápido.
text_en: This review refers to the iced coffee and its macarons. The iced coffee was incredible—no bitter notes at all, very smooth! As for the macarons… Good heavens, I’ve never seen macarons this big! They’re the size of a palm and come in various flavors. I bought a box with flavors like strawberry, chocolate, coffee, pistachio, and blueberry. I thought they were perfectly made, while my girlfriend thought they were a little too sweet. To defend her, I was eating the macarons with my black iced coffee, so maybe it was a good combination. The line here can be a bit long, depending on the time of day, but it moves relatively quickly.
original: This review is for the cold brew and their macaroons. The cold brew was amazing. No bitter notes, very smooth! Their macaroons. Oh my god, I've never seen macaroons so large! They're about palm sized and they offer a variety of flavors. Got an box of Strawberry, chocolate, coffee, pistachio, and blueberry. I thought they were perfectly crafted while my girlfriend thought they were a bit too sweet. In her defense, I was having the macaroons with my cold brew black so maybe that was a nice complement. The line here can get a little long depending on when you arrive but the line moves fairly fast.

text: Llamé el jueves 14 de abril de 2016, pero la empresa estaba cerrada ese día. Sin embargo, el gerente, Joe, contestó el teléfono. Estaba muy contento de poder hablar con alguien. Realicé un pedido para una fiesta de cumpleaños el 23 de abril. Me dijeron que me llamarían para confirmar. Sin embargo, he estado llamando durante cuatro días seguidos para confirmar si el pedido se había realizado y si estaría listo para recoger el 23. He enviado correos electrónicos a la empresa, pero lo único que puedo decir es: ¡no se confíen! No es fiable. Es mejor buscar otro lugar.
text_en: I called on Thursday, April 14, 2016, but the company was closed that day. However, the manager, Joe, answered the phone. He was very happy to be able to talk to someone. I placed an order for a birthday party on April 23. They said they would call me to confirm. But I’ve been calling for four days in a row to check if the order was processed and whether it would be ready to be picked up on April 23. I’ve also sent emails to the company, but all I can say is: don’t trust them! It’s not reliable. It’s better to find another place.
original: I called on Thursday 4/14/2016 business was closed for day. But, manager Joe answer phone called. I was excited was able to speak to someone.. I placed a order for a birthday party of 23rd of April. I was told I would get a call back to confirm. .Well I've been calling them myself for 4 days straight. Seeing if order was place and will be ready for pick up on 23rd.. sent business emails.. all i have to say is Don't bother with this place!! Not reliable. . Rather take business else where..

text: Su helado es delicioso. Ofrecen una gran variedad de sabores interesantes y están constantemente actualizando su oferta.
text_en: Their ice cream is delicious. They offer a wide variety of interesting flavors, and they constantly update their menu.
original: Their ice-cream is so good. Coming with all kind of interesting flavors and keep updating!

text: FYI, this is review is of their truck that was at First Friday... I would like to state that I am observing no-meat Fridays during this Lenten season. I managed to avoid meat at the other food trucks, but decided to break it for dessert. It was sinfully delicious........ Some of the flavors they had on hand were Belgian Chocolate, Mint Chip, Salted Butter Caramel, White Rose and I Heart Bacon. They also had a pomegranate sorbet. I think it was blueberry pomegranate. After reading reviews of Sweet Republic, I knew they were known for their gourmet flavors so my choices on Friday were between White Rose and I Heart Bacon. I'm not a big fan of rose flavor.. so I ordered a single scoop ($3) of bacon flavored ice cream. The initial bite was confusing. My mind knew I was eating ice cream, but didn't understand why there was a hint of smoked bacon with my dessert. It was an unusual flavor, but after about 3 bites it grew on you. In the ice cream were pieces of bacon and I think some maple flavored toffee. Those sugary, maple-y pieces were a really good accompaniment to the bacon. All in all, trying this bacon ice cream was worth the three dollars, plus a few Hail Marys.

text: This place IS all that its cracked up to be. The line is always long but worth the wait. The ice cream cookie sandwiches look great, but they are so BIG that I have never had the gusto to try them.... yet. You cannot go wrong here and I love the ever-changing flavors.
text_en: This place IS all that its cracked up to be. The line is always long but worth the wait. The ice cream cookie sandwiches look great, but they are so BIG that I have never had the gusto to try them.... yet. You cannot go wrong here and I love the ever-changing flavors.

text: Procurando por sorvete na região, descobri o Melt. Pedimos o "monster cookie", que continha diferentes tipos de pedaços de biscoito. Era servido em uma caixa charmosa de estilo chinês, com um biscoito da sorte por cima. Era bastante simples, sem opções adicionais de cobertura, e custava US$ 7. Não recomendo se você está apenas procurando por sorvete.
text_en: While looking for ice cream in the area, I discovered Melt. We ordered the “monster cookie,” which contained various types of biscuit pieces. It was served in a charming Chinese-style box, with a lucky biscuit on top. It was quite simple—no extra toppings available—and cost $7. I don’t recommend it if you’re just looking for ice cream.
original: Looking for ice cream in the area, came across Melt. We got the monster cookie which had multiple types of cookie chunks in it. Came in a cute Chinese take out box topped with a fortune cookie. Pretty basic with no additional options for topping for $7. Don't recommend if you are just looking for ice cream.

text: Mi lugar favorito para comprar helado en Pittsburgh. Ofrece muchísimas opciones de sabores y productos especiales.
text_en: My favorite place to buy ice cream in Pittsburgh. It offers a huge variety of flavors and special products.
original: My favorite place to go for ice cream in Pittsburgh! So many different options of flavors and speciality items.

text: The place is a little hard to find, but the ice cream here is amazing! I definitely recommend the Fruity Pebble and Nutella flavor. It was super creamy and delicious. I wasn't hungry enough for the "Cookie Cup", but I am going to try it next time. The Cookie Cup is essentially 2 flavors of ice cream, choice of a macaroon and a toasted marshmallow on top. All for $6.50!
text_en: The place is a little hard to find, but the ice cream here is amazing! I definitely recommend the Fruity Pebble and Nutella flavor. It was super creamy and delicious. I wasn't hungry enough for the "Cookie Cup", but I am going to try it next time. The Cookie Cup is essentially 2 flavors of ice cream, choice of a macaroon and a toasted marshmallow on top. All for $6.50!

text: ¡Me encanta Handel's! Siempre vengo con mis amigos. Ya he estado aquí tres veces y la calidad es constante. Me encanta la muestra de cuatro sabores porque es económica y me permite probar diferentes opciones. El sabor del pastel de cumpleaños es delicioso y sabe exactamente como debería. Los galletas y crema tienen Oreos dentro y se pueden apreciar claramente los sabores. Mi favorito es el algodón de azúcar porque lo han recreado perfectamente en un helado. El pastel de queso con fresas también es delicioso porque contiene pequeñas porciones de pastel de queso dentro!
text_en: I love Handel’s! I always go there with my friends. I’ve been here three times already, and the quality remains consistent. I really like the four-flavor sample because it’s affordable and allows me to try different options. The birthday cake flavor is delicious—it tastes exactly as it should. The cookies and cream have Oreos inside, and the flavors are clearly visible. My favorite is the sugar cotton candy, as it’s been recreated perfectly in a ice cream. The cheese cake with strawberries is also delicious, because there are small pieces of cheese cake inside!
original: I absolutely love Handel's! I always come with my friends! I have been here 3 times already and the quality is consistent. I love the four scoop sampler because it is cheap and gives me a variety. The birthday cake flavor is rich and tastes exactly like it's supposed to. The cookies and cream has Oreos inside and you can definitely taste the flavors. My favorite is the cotton candy because they perfectly capture it in an ice cream. The strawberry cheesecake is also delectable because there are little cheesecake bites within it!

text: I LOVE THIS PLACE. It's pretty close to happiness on earth. Their snowstorms are the best. Be warned, it melts really fast. But the texture is super light and doesn't give you that heavy feeling after you eat ice cream. My go to is their blueberry cobbler. It has blueberries and oatmeal crumbles in their vanilla custard which is absolutely AMAZING It's a great place which outdoor seating to chill with friends and to enjoy the summer weather. Whether you're a local or just here for the weekend, this place is worth prioritizing on your list of places to enjoy a delicious treat.
text_en: I LOVE THIS PLACE. It's pretty close to happiness on earth. Their snowstorms are the best. Be warned, it melts really fast. But the texture is super light and doesn't give you that heavy feeling after you eat ice cream. My go to is their blueberry cobbler. It has blueberries and oatmeal crumbles in their vanilla custard which is absolutely AMAZING It's a great place which outdoor seating to chill with friends and to enjoy the summer weather. Whether you're a local or just here for the weekend, this place is worth prioritizing on your list of places to enjoy a delicious treat.

text: Have a dirty chai with almond milk, it's the best coffee I've ever had. Ever. Get a baguette with pimento and jam. And then get a chocolate torte and a salted caramel brownie. Perfect meal with an exemplary staff. I love this place!
text_en: Have a dirty chai with almond milk, it's the best coffee I've ever had. Ever. Get a baguette with pimento and jam. And then get a chocolate torte and a salted caramel brownie. Perfect meal with an exemplary staff. I love this place!

text: Este lugar estava no nosso caminho, e, para minha surpresa, eu queria um fritter! Então, paramos. Felizmente, a fila não era muito grande. Além dos sabores tradicionais (com cobertura e de bolo, etc.), havia uma grande variedade de sabores diferentes, como creme brûlée, panquecas e donuts de queijo grelhado. Eu peguei meu fritter, um donut de chocolate, um donut de bolo e alguns outros sabores. Todos eram doces e pareciam bons, mas acabaram sendo um pouco secos. O fritter parecia ter sido frito demais, especialmente nas bordas.
text_en: This place was in our way, and to my surprise, I wanted a fritter! So we stopped. Fortunately, the line wasn’t very long. Besides the traditional flavors (with toppings and cake flavors, etc.), there was a wide variety of different flavors, such as cream brûlée, pancakes, and grilled cheese donuts. I got my fritter, a chocolate donut, a cake donut, and some other flavors. All of them were sweet and seemed good, but they turned out to be a bit dry. The fritter seemed to have been fried too much, especially at the edges.
original: This place was on our way and dang it, I wanted a fritter! So we stopped. Luckily the line was short. Among the usual flavors (glazed and cake etc)!here was a great selection of different flavors like the Creme brÃ»lÃ©e , French toast and grilled cheese donuts. I got my fritter, a chocolate bar, cake donut and a couple other flavors. All were sweet and looked good but ended up being pretty dry. The fritter seemed over fried especially the edges.

text: Excelente servicio y un ambiente encantador. ¡Muy bonito y con un diseño cuidado! Un lugar ideal para encontrar en una ubicación agradable.
text_en: Excellent service and a lovely atmosphere. Very nice, with a well-designed layout! An ideal place to visit in a pleasant location.
original: So good and great service. So cute and aesthetic inside! Great place to find in a cute location!

text: O pudim não é nada como os que já experimentei. É rico e cremoso. Na primeira vez que fui, pedi o de chocolate, e quase todos me disseram que tinha feito a escolha errada. Venha aqui para experimentar o pudim de limão. Não experimentei os outros sabores mais elaborados, principalmente porque o pudim de limão em um cone de açúcar é simplesmente delicioso! E os preços são extremamente acessíveis. Minha única reclamação, e é pequena, é que eles não aceitam cartões de crédito. Bom, acho que terei que guardar dinheiro para quando a vontade surgir!
text_en: The pudding is nothing like those I’ve tried before. It’s rich and creamy. The first time I went there, I ordered the chocolate version, and almost everyone said I made the wrong choice. Come here and try the lemon pudding instead. I haven’t tried the other more elaborate flavors, mainly because the lemon pudding in a sugar cone is simply delicious! And the prices are extremely affordable. My only complaint, and it’s minor, is that they don’t accept credit cards. Well, I guess I’ll have to save up some money when I feel like eating it again!
original: Custard isn't really like anything I've tried before. It's rich and creamy. I got chocolate the first time I went there, and I was told by pretty much everyone that I made the wrong choice. Come here for the lemon custard. I haven't gotten into all of the other complicated choices, mainly because the lemon custard on a sugar cone is so darn good! And the prices are extremely reasonable. My one complaint, and it's a small one, is that they don't take credit cards. Oh well, guess I'll have to keep cash around for when the mood strikes!

text: What more can I add to the already sufficient reviews left for this fine establishment? Relatively new to the Ohio City scene, the fact that it's already synomous with the neighborhood is a testament as to how truly beloved Mitchell's is. Clevelanders are all about anything local, so by nature Clevelanders are fiercely loyal. But real talk, it's clean, spacious, friendly - Willy Wonka himself would be proud! Ice cream flavors for days! Go treat yo self to a salted caramel milk shake. I know I'm gonna!
text_en: What more can I add to the already sufficient reviews left for this fine establishment? Relatively new to the Ohio City scene, the fact that it's already synomous with the neighborhood is a testament as to how truly beloved Mitchell's is. Ice cream flavors for days! Go treat yo self to a salted caramel milk shake. I know I'm gonna!

text: Adoro este lugar. Os bolos e outras delícias sempre foram excelentes. O atendimento também é ótimo. A única reclamação que tenho é que, por não ser um café onde se pode comer e beber, as pessoas tendem a ficar por longos períodos, e o espaço disponível para sentar é limitado. Por isso, muitas vezes preciso levar as coisas para viagem.
text_en: I love this place. The cakes and other treats are always excellent. The service is also great. The only complaint I have is that, since it’s not a café where you can eat and drink, people tend to stay for long periods of time, and there isn’t enough seating space. So, often I have to bring my things with me when I leave.
original: Love this place. Cakes and other delights have always been great. Service is nice too. My only complaint is that since this not a coffee shop where you drink/eat and go, people tend to stay for long periods of time and seating space is limited. Hence, forcing me to get things to go.

text: Excelente padaria francesa autêntica. Ideal para encontros sociais ou de negócios. Ótima seleção de cafés e opções de café da manhã.
text_en: Excellent authentic French bakery. Ideal for social or business meetings. Great selection of coffees and breakfast options.
original: Great authentic French bakery. Good for social or business meetings. Great coffee selection and breakfast options

text: Intentaré ser breve. He probado muchos de los postres, sopas y sándwiches. ¡Son excelentes! No suelo ir a Amelie's con tanta frecuencia como debería. Ya sea para un postre después de la cena, algo para darte un capricho o una sopa reconfortante para un día frío, siempre hay algo que te espera.
text_en: I’ll try to be brief. I’ve tried many of the desserts, soups, and sandwiches. They’re excellent! I don’t usually go to Amelie’s as often as I should. Whether it’s a dessert after dinner, something to satisfy your cravings, or a comforting soup on a cold day, there’s always something waiting for you.
original: I'll keep it simple. I've tried many of the desserts, soups and sandwiches. They are superb! I don't frequent Amelie's as often as I should. Whether it's desert for a dinner, something to spoil yourself or an unctuous soup to curl up with on a cold day - there is something waiting for you.

text: Estaba muy emocionado por poder probar finalmente Milk Bar cuando estuve en Las Vegas. Pedí el helado de leche con cereales y galletas de maíz, así como el helado de leche con cereales y frutas. Cuando probé el helado, mi primera impresión fue que estaba demasiado dulce. De hecho, me costó mucho terminarlo, y yo soy una persona con un gran gusto por lo dulce. El sabor a leche con cereales era exactamente como la leche, y el helado de leche con frutas me recordó a los Fruity Pebbles. Aunque cuesta un poco más, recomiendo pedir el helado con galletas de maíz. El sabor salado de las galletas de maíz contrasta muy bien con el helado dulce. Aunque las fotos hacen que el helado parezca pequeño, es fácil compartirlo con otra persona y será suficiente. Este es un lugar caro para comprar helado, y mis expectativas no se cumplieron.
text_en: I was very excited to finally try Milk Bar when I was in Las Vegas. I ordered the milk ice cream with cereal and cornflakes, as well as the milk ice cream with cereal and fruit. When I tasted it, my first impression was that it was too sweet. In fact, it took me a long time to finish it, and I’m someone who really likes sweet flavors. The cereal flavor was just like regular milk, and the fruit ice cream reminded me of Fruity Pebbles. Although it’s a bit more expensive, I recommend ordering the cornflake ice cream. The salty taste of the cornflakes contrasts nicely with the sweet ice cream. Even though the photos make it seem like a small ice cream, it’s easy to share with someone else, and it’s enough. This is a expensive place to buy ice cream, and my expectations weren’t met.
original: I was super excited to finally be able to try Milk Bar when I was in Vegas. I got the cereal milk soft serve with cornflake crunch and the fruity cereal milk soft serve. My first thought when I got a taste was that it was way too sweet. I actually struggled to finish it and I have a major sweet tooth. The cereal milk tasted just like milk and the fruit cereal milk reminded me of Fruity Pebbles. Even though it costs extra, I recommend getting the cornflake crunch. The saltiness of the cornflake crunch is a good contrast against the sweet soft serve. Even though the soft serve looks small in pictures, you can easily share one with another person and it'll be enough. This is a pricey place for soft serve and my expectations fell short.

text: El helado siempre es increíble y el personal que suelen tener es excelente, excepto por la persona que atendió el teléfono hoy. Quería recoger un helado, pero antes de conducir 35 minutos, pensé en llamar para ver si podía recogerlo o, al menos, para saber si el sabor que quería estaba disponible. La última vez que fui, no tenían ese sabor, así que no quiero hacer un viaje de una hora para nada. "No estamos aceptando pedidos para recoger. No tenemos personal para ello", CLIC. Entiendo que estén ocupados, pero colgó el teléfono antes de que pudiera hacer otra pregunta. ¿Por qué siquiera atienden el teléfono si van a colgar?
text_en: The ice cream is always amazing, and the staff is excellent, except for the person who answered the phone today. I wanted to pick up some ice cream, but before driving 35 minutes away, I thought about calling to see if I could pick it up or at least to check if the flavor I wanted was available. The last time I went there, they didn’t have that flavor, so I don’t want to spend an hour traveling for nothing. “We don’t accept orders for pickup. We don’t have staff for that,” CLICK. I understand they’re busy, but they hung up the phone before I could ask any more questions. Why even answer the phone if they’re going to hang up?
original: The ice cream is always amazing and the staff they usually have on is great except for whoever picked up the phone today. I wanted to pick up some ice cream but before driving 35 minutes to get there I thought I'd give them a call to see if I could do a pick up or at least to see if the flavor I wanted was in stock. they were out on my last trip so I don't want to make an hour long round trip for nothing. "We're not taking pickup orders I don't have the staff" CLICK I get your busy and all but you hung up before I could even ask another question. Why do you pick up the phone in the first place if you're gonna hang up on customers?

text: Bolo delicioso. Eles já têm tudo pronto e ele viaja bem. Minha família ficou muito satisfeita quando cheguei com fatias para eles!
text_en: Delicious bolo. They have everything ready, and it travels well. My family was very happy when I brought slices for them!
original: Solid cake. They have it all ready to go and it travels well. My family was not disappointed when I walked in with slices for them!

text: Este es un NUEVO lugar de moda para visitar. El ambiente es INCREÍBLE y la dueña es muy amable, al igual que sus productos de pastelería. Mi primera experiencia aquí hoy fue muy agradable. Entré por la puerta principal y fui recibido inmediatamente por la dueña, junto con una de las baristas. El ambiente es muy ecléctico. Hay papel tapiz moderno en las paredes y vajilla decorativa expuesta. El baño tiene un tema inspirado en "Las chicas del cable", ¡qué original! Pedí un latte de vainilla helado, pero actualmente solo tienen de caramelo. El caramelo estaba delicioso. Afortunadamente, también tienen leche de avena. La dueña me permitió tomar algunas fotos del local para que todos los usuarios de Yelp las disfruten. El estacionamiento es pequeño, pero hay estacionamiento en la calle cerca. Hoy fue su inauguración. Este sábado será su gran inauguración, y estoy deseando ver qué tienen preparado.
text_en: This is a new and fashionable place to visit. The atmosphere is incredible, and the owner is very kind, as are her pastries. My first experience here today was very pleasant. I entered through the main door and was immediately greeted by the owner, along with one of the baristas. The environment is very eclectic—there are modern wallpaper designs on the walls, and decorative tableware is displayed there too. The bathroom has a theme inspired by “The Girls of the Cable” – what an original idea! I ordered a vanilla ice cream latte, but currently they only have caramel. The caramel was delicious. Fortunately, they also have oat milk. The owner allowed me to take some photos of the store so that all Yelp users can enjoy them. The parking space is small, but there’s parking on the street nearby. Today was its opening day. This Saturday will be its grand opening, and I can’t wait to see what they have prepared.
original: This is a NEW HOT SPOT to visit. The vibe is AMAZING and the owner is super sweet, just like her baked goods. My first experience here today, was very pleasant. I walked in the front door and was immediately greeted by the owner in one of the baristas. The vibe is very eclectic. Cool wallpaper on the walls and decorative plates are on display. The bathroom has a golden girls theme, how unique. I ordered a vanilla latte iced but they currently only have caramel. The caramel was amazing. Luckily, they also have oat milk. The owner let me snap a few photos around the shop for all yelpers to enjoy. The actual parking lot is small, but there is street parking nearby.Today was their soft opening. This Saturday will be their grand opening, and I can't wait to see what they have in store.

text: Sorvete delicioso. Eu pedi o sorvete de chá matcha, mas houve dois problemas: #1 veio com palitos de chocolate Pocky em vez de matcha. #2, o preço é muito alto, comprei dois por 16 dólares. Definitivamente não é uma boa oferta. No entanto, no final das contas, eles merecem pelo menos 4 estrelas, pois fiquei impressionado com o sabor.
text_en: Delicious ice cream. I ordered the matcha tea ice cream, but there were two problems: #1 it came with Pocky chocolate sticks instead of matcha. #2 the price is very high; I bought two for 16 dollars. Definitely not a good deal. However, in the end, they deserve at least 4 stars, as I was impressed by the taste.
original: Great ice cream I got the matcha tea I cream but two issues: #1 came a with chocolate pocky sticks instead of matcha. #2 greatly expensive, I bought 2 for $16. Definitely not a great deal. But at the end of the day they at least deserve 4 stars because I was impressed with the taste.

text: Quando frequentava a Case Western, ia frequentemente ao Presti para almoçar. No entanto, o sabor é realmente normal. O pior é a lentidão dos garçons! Leva cerca de 10 minutos para eles trazerem uma fatia de pizza. Apesar de terem funcionários suficientes, eles são muito lentos.
text_en: When I attended Case Western, I often went to Presti for lunch. However, the service is really normal. The worst part is the slowness of the waiters! It takes about 10 minutes for them to bring over a slice of pizza. Even though they have enough staff, they are very slow.
original: When I went to school in Case Western, I went to Presti to get lunch very often. However, the taste is really just normal. The most terrible thing is the servers' speed is extremely slow!!!! It takes them 10 minutes to just get you a piece of pizza. They have enough people work there though, Those people just slow!

text: Nossa, este é um dos melhores sorvetes que já experimentei. Comprei uma porção do sorvete de "Key Lime Pie" e foi exatamente o que eu esperava, e até mais... um sorvete cremoso e suave, com uma textura agradável proveniente dos pedaços da casca, e o sabor cítrico perfeito. Ah, e o cone de waffle também estava ótimo! Um bônus por estar em um prédio antigo e interessante, com janelas que dão para a área de produção, e por ter um pequeno trem de brinquedo no teto, por algum motivo. Delicioso de verdade. Se você estiver na área e procurando um doce, pare aqui.
text_en: Wow, this is one of the best ice creams I’ve ever tried. I bought a portion of the “Key Lime Pie” ice cream, and it was exactly what I expected—and even better! It’s a creamy and smooth ice cream with a pleasant texture from the ice cream shells, along with a perfect citrus flavor. Oh, and the waffle cone was also great! Plus, it’s located in an old and interesting building, with windows overlooking the production area, and there’s even a small toy train on the ceiling for some reason. Really delicious. If you’re in the area and looking for a sweet treat, stop by here.
original: Woah, this is some of the best ice cream I've ever had. I got a scoop of the Key Lime Pie and it was everything I wanted and more... creamy smooth ice cream, a bit of texture from the crust pieces, and just the right bite of citrus. Oh, plus the waffle cone I got it in was pretty much perfect too! Bonus points for it being in such a cool old building, having windows to the production area, and for having a little toy train in the ceiling for some reason. Seriously delicious. If you're in the area and looking for a treat, stop here.

text: Delicioso, cremoso, con nueces y suave, eran las palabras que mi madre usaba para describir el helado de arce y nueces. "Cremoso, salado, dulce y suave" era cómo mi esposo describía el helado de caramelo con mantequilla salada. "¡Increíble!" sería cómo yo describiría el sorbete de albahaca y lima. Fresco, ligero, dulce y con la cantidad justa de dulzor. Pregunté a la mujer detrás del mostrador cuáles eran los ingredientes y me dijo: albahaca, lima, hielo y azúcar. Lo comí con una de las pequeñas cucharas y disfruté cada bocado. Sé que volveré durante mi próxima visita a Arizona para visitar a mi madre, porque todavía no puedo dejar de pensar en ese sorbete. ¡Enhorabuena, Sweet Republic! ¡Enhorabuena por crear un enfoque sólido, sin aditivos ni conservantes, basado en "alimentos integrales" para los postres dulces! ¡DELICIOSO!
text_en: Delicious, creamy, with nuts and soft—that’s what my mother used to describe the maple and nut ice cream. “Creamy, salty, sweet, and soft” was how my husband described the caramel ice cream with salted butter. “Incredible!” would be how I describe the basil and lime sorbet. Fresh, light, sweet, with just the right amount of sweetness. I asked the woman behind the counter what the ingredients were, and she said: basil, lime, ice, and sugar. I ate it with a small spoon and enjoyed every bite. I know I’ll come back to Arizona during my next visit to see my mother, because I still can’t stop thinking about that sorbet. Congratulations, Sweet Republic! Congratulations on creating a solid approach, without additives or preservatives, based on “whole foods” for sweet desserts! Delicious!
original: Tasty, creamy, nutty, and smooth were the words my mom used to describe the Maple Pecan ice cream Creamy, salty, sweet and smooth was how my husband described the Salted Butter Caramel ice cream. Aaaaaaahhhhhh-mazing is how I would describe the basil lime sorbet. Fresh, light, sweet, and just the right amount of sugary goodness. I asked the woman behind the counter for the igredients and she said basil, lime, ice and sugar. I ate it on one of the tiny little spoons and savored every little bite. I know that I will be back during my next visit to AZ to visit mom b/c I still can't stop thinking about that darn sorbet. Kudos to you Sweet Republic. Kudos on creating a solid, additive and preservative free - "whole foods" approach to sweet desserts! YUM!

text: Most amazing ice cream on the planet! Soo happy our hometown ice cream finally came to vegas!!! Yum!
text_en: Most amazing ice cream on the planet! Soo happy our hometown ice cream finally came to vegas!!! Yum!

text: O Churn é um lugar bastante popular, e quase todos os meus amigos já foram lá. A funcionária que trabalhou lá foi muito simpática. Como não havia mais ninguém na fila depois de mim, ela insistiu que eu experimentasse todos os sabores, e eu não reclamei! :) Há muitos sabores para escolher, mas geralmente peço o sabor de café vietnamita, porque é o meu favorito. Normalmente, pego uma ou duas bolas em um cone de waffle. É muito gostoso :) O ambiente é realmente único e charmoso. Na verdade, está conectado a um corredor que leva a um restaurante chamado Windsor. O corredor inclui a famosa parede de fitas cassete, que é uma das minhas partes favoritas do lugar. Pessoalmente, acho que o Sweet Republic é melhor, mas o Churn também é muito bom :)
text_en: Churn is a very popular place, and almost all my friends have been there. The employee who worked there was very friendly. Since there was no one else in line after me, she insisted that I try all the flavors, and I didn’t complain! :) There are many flavors to choose from, but usually I ask for the Vietnamese coffee flavor, because it’s my favorite. Usually, I get one or two balls in a waffle cone. It’s really delicious :) The atmosphere is truly unique and charming. In fact, it’s connected to a hallway that leads to a restaurant called Windsor. The hallway includes the famous cassette wall, which is one of my favorite parts of the place. Personally, I think Sweet Republic is better, but Churn is also very good :)
original: Churn is a pretty popular place that almost all my friends have been to. The girl that worked there was really nice. No one else was in line after me so she insisted that I try every flavor and I didn't complain! :) There are lots of flavors to choose from but I usually get the Vietnamese Coffee flavor because it's my favorite. I usually get one or two scoops in a waffle cone. It's pretty good :) The environment is really unique and cute. It is actually connected with a hallway that leads to a restaurant called the Windsor. The hallway consists of the famous cassette tape wall which is one of my favorite parts of the entire place. Personally, I think that Sweet Republic is better but Churn is also really good :)

text: ¡IMPRESIONANTE! Estoy muy impresionado con lo deliciosos, esponjosos y masticables que son sus donuts. Compré la masa para el pastel, el cheesecake de arándanos, la Nutella, los donuts de "samoa", los donuts de "Homer" y los donuts de "red velvet". Llegué alrededor de las 11 de la mañana durante su apertura, y había varias opciones interesantes disponibles. Desafortunadamente, el de fresas y Oreo estaban agotados, pero no importa, ¡lo que compré estaba delicioso! En comparación con otras tiendas de donuts en la ciudad, "Donut Bar" destaca por sus donuts enormes (4 dólares cada uno), y por opciones únicas como el Oreo dentro del donut, el "pop tart" dentro del donut, y, con suerte, los donuts con helado pronto (eso es lo que anunciaban en su Instagram). La masa es excepcionalmente masticable y húmeda, los ingredientes están equilibrados y proporcionales, y, lo más importante, el glaseado no es demasiado dulce. Definitivamente recomiendo este lugar, ¡solo vengan temprano para tener más opciones!
text_en: Impressive! I’m very impressed by how delicious, fluffy, and easy to chew are their donuts. I bought the cake batter, raspberry cheesecake, Nutella, “Samoa” donuts, “Homer” donuts, and “red velvet” donuts. I arrived around 11 a.m. during opening hours, and there were several interesting options available. Unfortunately, the strawberry and Oreo donuts were sold out, but it doesn’t matter—what I bought was delicious! Compared to other donut shops in town, “Donut Bar” stands out for its huge donuts (4 dollars each), as well as unique options like Oreo inside the donut, “pop tart” inside the donut, and hopefully, donuts with ice cream soon (that’s what they announced on their Instagram). The batter is extremely easy to chew and moist; the ingredients are well-balanced and proportionate. And most importantly, the glaze isn’t too sweet. I definitely recommend this place—just come early to get more options!
original: MIND BLOWN! I am so impressed with how delicious, fluffy, and chewy their donut are. I bought the cake batter, blueberry cheesecake, Nutella, samoa, Homer's donut, and the red velvet donuts. I came in around 11 AM during their soft opening and there were quite a few good choices left. Unfortunately the strawberry split & Oreo one was sold out but that's okay because what I got was tasty! Donut Bar compared to other donut shops around town is their HUGE donuts ($4 each), and unique ones like the Oreo inside the donut, the pop tart inside the donut, and hopefully the donut cones soon (well that's what they advertised on their Instagram). The dough is exceptionally chewy, moist, the toppings are even & proportionate, and most importantly the frosting isn't overly sweet. I definitely recommend this place, just come early so you have more options!

text: Não eram muito boas... recebemos três biscoitos (de milho, de corn flakes e de chocolate). O biscoito de milho tinha um gosto ruim... evite esse. O biscoito de corn flakes estava melhor, mas era um pouco duro. Depois de experimentar esses dois, nem quero experimentar o de chocolate.
text_en: They weren’t very good… we got three types of cookies (cornflake, cornflakes, and chocolate). The cornflake cookie had a bad taste… avoid that one. The cornflake cookie was better, but it was a bit hard. After trying those two, I don’t even want to try the chocolate one.
original: Not very good...we got three cookies (corn, cornflakes, and chocolate/chocolate). The corn cookie is nasty...do not get that one. Cornflake cookie was better but kind of hard. I don't even want to try the chocolate one after those two.

text: Após assistir a "Chef's Table" e ouvir falar sobre a Milk Bar, decidimos visitá-la durante nossa estadia em Las Vegas. Localizada no Cosmopolitan, a Milk Bar é, na verdade, um quiosque ao ar livre, sem mesas. Optamos pelo pacote "favoritos", que incluía uma biscoito de composto, sorvete de leite com cereal, uma fatia de torta "crack" e um pacote de três trufas de aniversário. Fiquei decepcionado ao perceber que, além do sorvete, todos os itens eram pré-embalados. A fatia da torta "crack" era muito pequena para o preço, mas estava gostosa. Não me impressionou o biscoito de composto e o sorvete de leite com cereal estava apenas razoável. No entanto, adorei as trufas de aniversário. No geral, foi um menu divertido e indulgente, mas fiquei desapontado por os itens não serem mais frescos, considerando o preço.
text_en: After watching “Chef’s Table” and hearing about the Milk Bar, we decided to visit it during our stay in Las Vegas. Located at the Cosmopolitan, the Milk Bar is actually an outdoor kiosk with no tables. We chose the “favorites” package, which included a compound biscuit, milk cereal ice cream, a slice of “crack” cake, and a pack of three birthday truffles. I was disappointed to find that, aside from the ice cream, all the items were pre-packaged. The slice of “crack” cake was too small for the price, but it was delicious. The compound biscuit and milk cereal ice cream were just okay. However, I really liked the birthday truffles. Overall, it was a fun and indulgent menu, but I was disappointed that the items weren’t more fresh, considering the price.
original: After watching Chef's Table and hearing the hype surrounding Milk Bar, we had to make it there during our visit to Vegas. Located in the Cosmopolitan, the Milk Bar is literally a walk up stand with no seating. We went with the favorites package which including a compost cookie, cereal milk soft serve, crack pie and pack of three birthday truffles. I was disappointed to see that aside from the soft serve, all the items were prepackaged. The crack pie slice was super small for the price but pretty tasty. I was unimpressed by the compost cookie and the cereal milk soft serve was only ok. I really loved the birthday truffles though. Overall it was a fun and indulgent menu but I was disappointed that the items weren't more fresh for the price.

text: BEST ICE CREAM OF ALL TIME!! the salted peanut butter is the best flavor and the waffle cones are fantastic!
text_en: BEST ICE CREAM OF ALL TIME!! the salted peanut butter is the best flavor and the waffle cones are fantastic!

text: Antes de irme o salir del juzgado, me apetece parar en la barra de donuts y elegir algunos de sus deliciosos donuts y un café helado con nitro. Una excelente versión de los clásicos "old fashions", los "fritters" y los "bismarks", con creaciones de pastelería creativas y deliciosas. También ofrecen lattes y otras bebidas a base de expreso. Normalmente hay aparcamiento disponible y un servicio amable. No es barato, pero vale cada centavo. Es ideal después de una noche en vela.
text_en: Before leaving and going out of the court, I feel like stopping at the donut counter to pick up some delicious donuts and a frozen coffee with nitro. It’s an excellent version of the classic “old fashions”, “fritters”, and “Bismarks” – with creative and tasty pastries. They also serve lattes and other espresso-based drinks. There’s usually parking available, and the service is friendly. It’s not cheap, but it’s worth every penny. It’s perfect after a night of sleepless nights.
original: Before I go or I get out of court I am tempted to stop at the donut bar and choose some of their delicious donuts and a nitro iced coffee. Great spin on traditional old fashions, fritters and bismarks with creative pastry creations which are mouth watering and delicious. Lattes and other expresso drinks as well. Usually parking is available and friendly service. Not cheap but worth every penny. Good after an all nighter.

text: O muffin de três frutas que eu já comi é o melhor. Bem úmido e fresco. O atendimento ao cliente foi excelente, e eu voltarei. A variedade de bebidas quentes não é muito grande, como bebidas geladas. Mas eu recomendo muito os produtos de panificação.
text_en: The three-fruit muffin I’ve eaten before is the best. It’s very moist and fresh. The customer service was excellent, and I will come back. The variety of hot drinks isn’t very extensive, compared to cold drinks. But I highly recommend the bakery products.
original: Best triple berry muffin I have ever had. Moist and fresh. The customer service was excellent I will go back. Not much to off in the coffee dept such as iced drinks. But I would highly recommend the baked goods.

text: Pasadas unas semanas desde que regresé de mis vacaciones, todavía sueño con esos deliciosos pasteles. ¡Cada vez que esté en Las Vegas, los compraré! Son realmente exquisitos, así que no pierda la oportunidad de comprarlos y llevar algunos para disfrutar más tarde.
text_en: A few weeks have passed since I returned from my vacation, and I still dream about those delicious pastries. Every time I’m in Las Vegas, I’ll buy them! They’re really exquisite, so don’t miss the chance to get some and take a few with you to enjoy later.
original: Days after coming home from my vacation im still dreaming of these amazing pastries, i will go and get them every single time im in las vegas! They are so delicious,do yourself a favor and buy extras to have later!

text: I have stopped here two time already this winter while visiting Vegas. I have fallen in love with their corn cookie. I think it is just a unique flavor than your typical chocolate chip cookies and I usually pick up three with a crack pie and soft serve with cereal topping. All very unique and delicious. Last time my friend and I bought 1 container of 10 cookies each. Waiting for this summer to pick me some corn cookies on my way through Vegas!
text_en: I have stopped here two time already this winter while visiting Vegas. I have fallen in love with their corn cookie. I think it is just a unique flavor than your typical chocolate chip cookies and I usually pick up three with a crack pie and soft serve with cereal topping. All very unique and delicious. Last time my friend and I bought 1 container of 10 cookies each. Waiting for this summer to pick me some corn cookies on my way through Vegas!

text: ¡Su bizcocho es lo mejor! Los macarons de pistacho son mis favoritos, y los suyos son, sin duda, los mejores. ¡Definitivamente volveré!
text_en: Your cakes are the best! Pistachio macarons are my favorites, and yours are undoubtedly the best. I will definitely come back!
original: Their pound cake is the best! Pistachio macarons are my go-to and theirs is by far the best! I will def be back.

text: Produtos deliciosos, frescos e de alta qualidade, que vão te encantar. Experimentei o croissant de amêndoa e o "kruigel" (um tipo de pão). Eram macios, saborosos e perfeitos.
text_en: Delicious, fresh, and high-quality products that will delight you. I tried the almond croissant and the “kruigel” (a type of bread). They were soft, tasty, and perfect.
original: Large, beautiful, fresh baked goods to make you swoon. Enjoyed the Almond Croissant and the Kruigel. Buttery, flaky and delicious.

text: Después de cenar en su restaurante, caminamos por el pasillo hasta este lugar. Mi esposo y yo estábamos deseando probar los postres de Buddy's. Hubo una espera, pero todos estaban muy organizados y serviciales, lo que hizo que la experiencia fuera agradable. Le di a esta panadería tres estrellas porque los postres no fueron tan buenos como esperábamos. Además, los precios eran demasiado altos. ¡El pastel de crema fue increíble! Sin embargo, las galletas y el cupcake de caramelo salado que compramos fueron bastante insípidos. No nos gustan los postres demasiado dulces, pero estos tenían casi nada de sabor, y un poco de dulzor habría sido útil. Realmente no me gusta dar una valoración de tres estrellas, pero siendo honestos, no volveremos.
text_en: After dinner at their restaurant, we walked down the hallway to this place. My husband and I were very eager to try the desserts at Buddy’s. There was some waiting time, but everyone was very organized and helpful, which made the experience pleasant. I gave this bakery three stars because the desserts weren’t as good as we expected. Additionally, the prices were too high. The cream pie was amazing! However, the cookies and the salted caramel cupcake we bought were quite bland. We don’t really like overly sweet desserts, but these had almost no flavor at all—a little sweetness would have been helpful. I really don’t like giving three stars, but to be honest, we won’t go back.
original: After all sting dinner at their restaurant we walked across the hall to this place. My husband and I have been looking forward to trying Buddy's desserts. There was a bit of a wait but everyone was very organized and helpful which made the experience smooth. I gave this bakery three stars because the desserts weren't as good as we thought they'd be. Prices were also way too high! The cream puff was awesome! However, the cookies and salted caramel cupcake we purchased were very bland. We don't like super sweet treats but these had almost no flavor and having some sweetness would have been helpful. I totally hate to give a three star review but in all honesty we won't be returning.

text: We gave this a try on our Vegas trip. Had the bday cake and strawberry shortcake soft serve. It was good but not anything exceptional. Staff was friendly and helpful.
text_en: We gave this a try on our Vegas trip. Had the bday cake and strawberry shortcake soft serve. It was good but not anything exceptional. Staff was friendly and helpful.

text: Si hubiera una gran batalla entre Voodoo Doughnuts y The Doughnut Bar, toda la costa oeste sería destruida de forma deliciosa. Afortunadamente, estos dos lugares están lo suficientemente separados, así que estamos a salvo (por ahora). Estas donas son una verdadera obra de arte. Se ven tan deliciosas como saben. El clásico crème brûlée es realmente una maravilla, y el bacon con sirope de arce es poesía. Cuando uno piensa en donas, piensa en The Doughnut Bar. ¿Es esta una crítica demasiado exagerada? No puedo saberlo cuando estoy bajo la influencia del sirope de arce y el bacon.
text_en: If there were a fierce battle between Voodoo Doughnuts and The Doughnut Bar, the entire West Coast would be destroyed in a delicious way. Fortunately, these two places are far apart from each other, so we’re safe for now. These donuts are truly a work of art. They look as delicious as they taste. The classic crème brûlée is really amazing, and bacon with maple syrup is poetry in its own right. When one thinks of donuts, it’s The Doughnut Bar that comes to mind. Is this a bit of an overstatement? I can’t tell when I’m under the influence of maple syrup and bacon.
original: If there was a great kaiju battle between Voodoo Doughnuts and The Doughnut Bar, the entire west coast would be deliciously destroyed. Thankfully these two places are far enough apart that we are safe (for now). These doughnuts ARE art. They look as delicious as they taste. The signature creme brÃ»lÃ©e is truly a marvel and the maple bacon is poetry. When one dreams of doughnuts one dreams of The Doughnut Bar. Is this too over the top a review? I can't tell when I am under the influence of maple an and bacon.

text: Ah, como eu gostaria que houvesse uma filial da Amelie's perto de mim! A comida mais simples (como pão e manteiga) é sempre como um banquete, porque é fresca, deliciosa e você pode sentir a qualidade dos ingredientes e o cuidado que é colocado em cada item. Os doces são dignos do Rei Luís XIV, e as tortas são criativas e simplesmente deliciosas. Poderia continuar por horas. Em resumo, há uma razão para a longa fila e para as inúmeras avaliações de 5 estrelas. Viva a Amelie's!
text_en: Ah, how I wish there was a branch of Amelie’s near me! The simplest foods—like bread and butter—are always like a feast, because they are fresh, delicious, and you can feel the quality of the ingredients and the care put into each item. The desserts are worthy of King Louis XIV, and the cakes are creative and simply delicious. It could go on for hours. In short, there’s a reason for the long lines and the countless 5-star reviews. Long live Amelie’s!
original: Oh, how I wish there was an Amelie's close to me! The simplest of food there (i.e. bread and butter) is always like a feast because it is fresh and delicious and you can taste the quality ingredients and care that goes into every single item. The pastries are fit for King Louis XIV and the quiches are inventive and utterly melt in your mouth. I could go on and on. Simply said, there is a reason why the line is long and the 5-star reviews are plentiful. Vive l'Amelie's!

text: Although nothing bizarre, the conservative type flavors are still solid choices. My favorites were Italian Cherry and Cookies and Mint. Everything was good, but those two really stood out. The creaminess of the ice cream is key to the ice cream's success. The flavorings are also quite potent, which I like. Nothing breaks my heart more than mildly flavored ice cream. I wanted to try their shakes or sundaes, but I also needed to save room for elsewhere at the time. I did pick a pretzel cone for my scoop. The pretzel isn't bad, but it wasn't what I was expecting. Its not as crumbly as a traditional waffle cone. Its not necessarily as sweet either, but it does add an undeniably delicious saltiness to each bite.
text_en: Although nothing bizarre, the conservative type flavors are still solid choices. My favorites were Italian Cherry and Cookies and Mint. Everything was good, but those two really stood out. The creaminess of the ice cream is key to the ice cream's success. The flavorings are also quite potent, which I like. Nothing breaks my heart more than mildly flavored ice cream. I wanted to try their shakes or sundaes, but I also needed to save room for elsewhere at the time. I did pick a pretzel cone for my scoop. The pretzel isn't bad, but it wasn't what I was expecting. Its not as crumbly as a traditional waffle cone. Its not necessarily as sweet either, but it does add an undeniably delicious saltiness to each bite.

text: Growing up Presti's was the spot for donuts. It's so much more now. Prepared pastas, pizza slices, gelato, pastries. I'm not sure what they do best now. That's probably the only problem I have with them. That being said they do a lot of things very well.
text_en: Growing up Presti's was the spot for donuts. It's so much more now. Prepared pastas, pizza slices, gelato, pastries. I'm not sure what they do best now. That's probably the only problem I have with them. That being said they do a lot of things very well.

text: A Latrice foi incrível com seu excelente atendimento ao cliente. Era evidente que ela estava sorrindo por baixo da máscara, e mesmo com pelo menos 30 clientes em fila, ela se esforçou ao máximo para garantir que todos estivessem bem. Cinco estrelas, pois houve uma longa espera, mas ela fez o possível.
text_en: Latrice was incredible with her excellent customer service. It was obvious that she was smiling beneath her mask, and even with at least 30 customers in line, she did her best to ensure everyone was well taken care of. Five stars, as there was a long wait, but she did everything she could.
original: Latrice was so amazing with her excellent customer service. I could tell she was smiling under her mask and even though there was at least 30 customers back to back she kept doing her best to make sure everyone was in good spirits. stars cause it was a long wait but she did the best she could

text: Me encantan los pasteles que venden aquí, nunca he tenido que quejarme, pero el servicio al cliente es terrible. Entré con mi perro y lo estaba sosteniendo, y me dijeron que tenía que salir inmediatamente porque no permiten mascotas dentro. Entiendo eso, pero podrían haber dejado que yo pidiera primero y luego salir con mi perro. Pero no, me dijeron que tenía que irme, e incluso no pude pedir lo que quería. Debería haber un cartel que diga "no se admiten mascotas", en lugar de echarme de la tienda. Honestamente, quería comentar algo, pero no soy de los que crean escenas frente a muchos clientes. Estoy muy decepcionado. Nunca volveré a ese lugar.
text_en: I really love the cakes they sell here; I’ve never had to complain about them. But the customer service is terrible. I entered with my dog and was holding it with me, and they told me I had to leave immediately because they don’t allow pets inside. I understand that, but they could have let me order first and then leave with my dog. But no—they said I had to go, and I couldn’t even order what I wanted. There should be a sign saying “No pets allowed,” instead of kicking me out of the store. Honestly, I wanted to comment something, but I’m not one who creates scenes in front of many customers. I’m very disappointed. I will never go back to that place again.
original: I love the pastries here, I've never had to complain about them but the customer service is horrible. I bought my dog inside and I was holding him and they told me I had to leave immediately because they do not allow pets inside. I understand that, but they could have let me order first and then go outside with my dog. But no they said I had to leave, I couldn't even order what I wanted. There should be a sign saying "no pets allowed" instead of them kicking me out the place. I honestly wanted to say something about it, but I'm not the type of person to create a scene in front of a lot of customers. I'm very disappointed. Never coming to that location again.

text: Fue la primera vez que probaba Donut Bar. Recibí un excelente servicio por parte de Alexia y Jasmine. Había muchísimas opciones para elegir. Alexia fue muy amable y paciente conmigo mientras tomaba mi tiempo para mirar todos los donuts. Se tomó el tiempo de explicarme todos los sabores y rellenos. Me recomendó los más populares. Jasmine fue muy amable y alegre al atenderme. Mis favoritos fueron los donuts de bizcocho. Eran jugosos y no demasiado dulces. Los donuts de levadura eran demasiado densos y secos. Definitivamente volveré por los donuts de bizcocho y por el excelente servicio!
text_en: It was the first time I tried Donut Bar. I received excellent service from Alexia and Jasmine. There were many options to choose from. Alexia was very kind and patient with me as I took my time to look at all the donuts. She took the time to explain all the flavors and fillings. She recommended the most popular ones. Jasmine was also very friendly and cheerful during my visit. My favorite were the cake donuts—they were juicy and not too sweet. The yeast donuts were too dense and dry. I will definitely come back for the cake donuts and for the excellent service!
original: It was my first time trying Donut Bar. I received A1 service from Alexia and Jasmine. There were so many options to choose from. Alexia was very sweet and patient with me as I took my time to look at all the donuts. She took her time to explain all the flavors and fillings. She recommended all the popular ones. Jasmine was very friendly and joyful to talk to as she rang me up. My favorites were the cake donuts. They were moist and not too sweet. The yeast donuts were too dense and dry. I will definitely return for the cake donuts and friendly service!

text: Una panadería tan adorable y a la vez peculiar. Me gusta que ahora también sirvan cerveza y vino. Ya no vivo en Charlotte, pero me encanta visitarla cada vez que regreso a la ciudad. Tienen algunos de mis macarrones favoritos. Además, por cierto: ¡recibes un éclair gratis en tu cumpleaños!
text_en: A bakery that’s so cute and yet also quite unique. I like that they now serve beer and wine too. I don’t live in Charlotte anymore, but I love visiting it every time I return to the city. They have some of my favorite macarons. By the way, you get an éclair for free on your birthday!
original: Such a cute yet eccentric bakery. I like that it serves beer and wine now. I don't live in Charlotte anymore, but love visiting whenever I'm back in town. They have some of my favorite macaroons ever. Also FYI: you get a free eclair when it's your birthday!

text: Esta pequeña tienda me robó el corazón. Me encantan los recipientes para llevar comida china y las galletas de la suerte. Nunca en mi vida había visto algo así. Y es increíble la cantidad de helado que cabe en un recipiente tan pequeño. Si suena raro, simplemente pruébalo y entenderás de lo que hablo.
text_en: This small shop has captured my heart. I love those containers for carrying Chinese food and those lucky cookies. I’ve never seen anything like this in my life. And it’s amazing how much ice cream can fit in such a small container. If it sounds strange, just try it—you’ll understand what I’m talking about.
original: This little shop stole my heart. I love the chinese take out containers and the fortune cookie. Never in my life have I seen anything like it. And so much ice cream fits into such a little container. If it sounds weird just give it a try and you'll know what I mean.

text: I loved this place when it was scary looking and I love it even more now that it's fancy looking. Such freaking good donuts and the staff is so nice. Thank goodness they accept cards now, so I can eat even more donuts lol the fancy/fun looking ones are cute but I'm more of a simple girl. Their classic donuts are my fav. Blueberry is delicious and soft, LOVE the maple bacon. The twist donuts are great in all the flavors. Gotta get there in the morning to get exactly what you want. A place worth the drive to get to!
text_en: I loved this place when it was scary looking and I love it even more now that it's fancy looking. Such freaking good donuts and the staff is so nice. Thank goodness they accept cards now, so I can eat even more donuts lol the fancy/fun looking ones are cute but I'm more of a simple girl. Their classic donuts are my fav. Blueberry is delicious and soft, LOVE the maple bacon. The twist donuts are great in all the flavors. Gotta get there in the morning to get exactly what you want. A place worth the drive to get to!

text: i don't know where they make all the pastries, but i know they don't have a oven anywhere near the store. that explains the tko being slightly dry. even though the bakery at yountville bakes everything in store, you can't beat listening to slot machines and smelling cigarettes while munching on some pretty tasty pastries.

text: Sorvete delicioso, funcionários simpáticos e um charme local. Nós adoramos o Churn e acabamos comendo sorvete com mais frequência do que o necessário ultimamente! Os funcionários são muito prestativos e agradáveis, e a degustação de sorvete é realmente incentivada – excelente! O sorvete de manteiga de amendoim é divino e os sabores disponíveis mudam regularmente. Existem dois pontos a serem considerados: 1. Estacionamento. Há poucos espaços de estacionamento e eles são reservados para serviço de valet, o que é um pouco inconveniente, considerando a localização e o nível das empresas (não são de luxo). 90% das minhas visitas foram de bicicleta, então não percebi a dificuldade até recentemente. Estacione na rua ou no estacionamento restrito ao norte. 2. Não há mesas dentro. Eu costumo ter vontade de comer sorvete quando o tempo está bom, então isso não tem sido um problema para mim... apenas um aviso:).
text_en: Delicious ice cream, friendly staff, and a charming local atmosphere. We really love Churn, and we’ve been eating ice cream more often than necessary lately! The staff are very helpful and pleasant, and trying out different flavors is actually encouraged—excellent! Peanut butter ice cream is amazing, and the available flavors change regularly. There are two things to keep in mind: 1. Parking. There are few parking spaces, and they’re reserved for valet service, which is a bit inconvenient considering the location and the level of the businesses (they’re not luxury establishments). 90% of my visits were by bike, so I didn’t notice the difficulty until recently. Park on the street or in the restricted parking area north. 2. No tables inside. I usually feel like eating ice cream when the weather’s nice, so it hasn’t been a problem for me… just a note:).
original: Delicious ice cream, delightful staff and local charm. We LOVE Churn and find ourselves enjoying an ice cream more often than is likely necessary these days! The staff is very helpful and pleasant and ice cream "sampling" is actually encouraged---- score! The peanut butter ice cream is divine and the available flavors rotate regularly. There are two potential negatives to be aware of: 1. Parking. There are very few parking spaces and these are reserved for valet, which is pretty lame given their location and the caliber of the businesses (not upscale). 90% of my visits have been on a bike so I didn't realize the inconvenience until recently. Park across the street or in the restricted business lot to the North. 2. There is no indoor seating. I usually crave ice cream when it's nice out so this has not been an issue for me... just a warning:).

text: Ok... na verdade, existe um caixa eletrônico de cupcakes 24 horas, bem em frente ao prédio deles! Impressionante! Quem nunca sentiu vontade de comer um cupcake em horários estranhos? Eu acabara de terminar meu café da manhã depois do nosso primeiro dia em Las Vegas e o vi. Meu noivo sugeriu que provavelmente não tínhamos espaço para um cupcake naquele momento. Então, seguimos em frente. Mas, 5 horas depois, durante nosso caminho de volta, não conseguia parar de pensar no caixa eletrônico de cupcakes. Então, voltamos para que eu pudesse fazer meu primeiro saque. A experiência foi incrível! Saquei um cupcake de baunilha! Um cupcake de baunilha perfeito! Foi maravilhoso! Quando estiver em Las Vegas, você precisa experimentar isso!
text_en: Okay… actually, there’s a 24-hour cupcake vending machine right in front of their building! Amazing! Who hasn’t had the urge to eat a cupcake at odd times? I just finished my breakfast after our first day in Las Vegas, and I saw the vending machine. My fiancé said we probably didn’t have room for a cupcake at that moment. So we continued on our way. But 5 hours later, on our way back, I couldn’t stop thinking about the cupcake vending machine. So we went back so I could make my first purchase. It was an amazing experience! I got a vanilla cupcake! A perfect vanilla cupcake! It was wonderful! When you’re in Las Vegas, you really need to try it out!
original: Ok...there is legitimately a 24hr cupcake atm right outside of their building! Mind blown! Who hasn't craved a cupcake at weird hours? I had just finished breakfast after our first day in Vegas and spied it. My fiancÃ© suggested we probably didn't have room for a cupcake just then. So we walked on. But 5hrs later on our walk back by I couldn't get the cupcake atm out of my mind. So we went back so I could make my first cupcake withdrawal. The experience was fabulous! I withdrew a vanilla cupcake! Perfect little vanilla cupcake! It was amazing! When in Vegas, you have to experience this!

text: An institution worth the title. Exceptionally delicious homemade ice cream. Glad to see Mary Coyle's live on! Pb chocolate is da bomb!
text_en: An institution worth the title. Exceptionally delicious homemade ice cream. Glad to see Mary Coyle's live on! Pb chocolate is da bomb!

text: ¡Qué rico, qué rico, qué rico! Esperamos afuera durante unos 15 minutos en la fila. No hay asientos dentro, a menos que estemos en el Windsor. Incluso puedes probar muestras, ¡lo cual es genial! Pedimos a los niños helado de mantequilla y nueces, ¡y está increíble!
text_en: So delicious, so delicious, so great! We waited outside in line for about 15 minutes. There are no seats inside, unless we’re at the Windsor. You can even try samples – which is great! We ordered children’s butter and nut ice cream, and it’s incredible!
original: Yummy yummy yummy! We waited outside for about 15 minutes in line. There is no seating inside unless you're probably eating at the Windsor. You can even try samples which is awesome. Got the kids scoop butter pecan and it is BOMB!!!

text: Adoro voltar a comprar nestas bolachas! São as mais frescas e macias que já provei! Adoro as bolachas de canela e baunilha. Gosto da embalagem e apresentação. Perfeitas para transportar.
text_en: I love buying these cookies again! They’re the freshest and smoothest ones I’ve ever tasted! I really like the cinnamon and vanilla cookies. I enjoy the packaging and presentation too. Perfect for carrying around.
original: Love coming back to this sprinkles! Freshest and most moist cupcakes ever! Love their cinnamon and vanilla cupcakes! Love their boxing and packaging. Perfect for portability.

text: Ordered a small Coffee Oreo Snowstorm. I think it's a local favorite and definitely worth a try! The place is super cute and very homey, they have a lot of really interesting flavors and the service sizes are huge.
text_en: Ordered a small Coffee Oreo Snowstorm. I think it's a local favorite and definitely worth a try! The place is super cute and very homey, they have a lot of really interesting flavors and the service sizes are huge.

text: Cheguei aqui depois do bar/club às 3 da manhã. Gosto que esteja aberto 24 horas, mas é uma pena que não haja tantas opções à noite. Fiquei triste por não termos conseguido pedir o crème brûlée. Os macarons estavam bons, os brownies de caramelo salgado também estavam bons, mas estavam um pouco doces demais para mim. A barra de brownies de caramelo salgado era excelente. Não gostei do petit gateau de morango, mas estava ok. O café de coco e macadâmia estava bom, no entanto. Havia apenas dois funcionários e a fila estava longa. Voltarei mais cedo e experimentarei outras coisas do cardápio. 19/08/2019: Voltei aqui com minha filha. Pedimos os macarons de frutas vermelhas, os macarons de baunilha, o bolo de caramelo, dois crème brûlée e o café de coco e macadâmia. Os macarons de frutas vermelhas podem manchar a língua e os dentes/lábios por um tempo, mas são gostosos, o crème brûlée está ok, mas tem um sabor um pouco de ovo.
text_en: I arrived here after the bar/club at 3 a.m. I like it when it’s open 24 hours a day, but it’s a pity that there aren’t many options at night. I felt sad because we couldn’t order the crème brûlée. The macarons were good, and the salty caramel brownies were also good, but they were a little too sweet for me. The block of salty caramel brownies was excellent. I didn’t like the strawberry petit gateau, but it was okay. The coconut and macadamia coffee was fine, though. There were only two staff members, and the line was long. I will come back earlier and try other items on the menu. 19/08/2019: I came back here with my daughter. We ordered red fruit macarons, vanilla macarons, caramel cake, two crème brûlées, and coconut and macadamia coffee. The red fruit macarons can stain the tongue and teeth/lips for a while, but they’re delicious. The crème brûlée is okay, but it has a slightly eggy taste.

The macaroons were good, the salted caramel brownies was good too a bit too sweet for me. The deluxe salted brownie bar was bomb. I didn't like the strawberries petit gateau was decent.
