The panthers macaroon will stain your tongue and teeth/lip for a bit but it's good, the cream brÃ»lÃ©e is ok but it's a bit eggy.

text: Um lugar incrível. Os milkshakes são ótimos e tudo está coberto de chocolate, inclusive o canudo.
text_en: An amazing place. The milkshakes are great, and everything is covered in chocolate, including the straw.
original: Amazing place. The milkshakes are awesome and everything is dipped in chocolate. Including your straw.

text: Llegamos alrededor de la 1:30 pm un domingo y estaban cerrando. Queríamos conseguir los últimos donuts que les quedaban. Teníamos dos opciones: "compre uno y llévese otro" o una caja por $10. La opción de la caja era mucho más conveniente, así que terminamos comprando 16 donuts por $10!!! ¡UNA OFERTA INCREÍBLE! Además, si revisas en Yelp, puedes obtener un café americano o un café de filtro gratis. #ganar Blueberry Lemon - Bastante bien, pero me gustó que no fuera tan dulce como pensaba. Strawberry Split - Regular. No volvería a pedirlo. El donut era solo de canela y estaba seco (probablemente porque había estado afuera todo el día) y la crema batida dentro estaba seca y sabía a que venía de una lata. Las fresas también estaban muy simples y habría estado mejor si estuvieran glaseadas. Crème brûlée - Mi favorito de todo lo que probé. El glaseado crujiente en la parte superior era genial, y me encantan los donuts rellenos. Después de comer la mitad, la crema dentro empezó a tener un sabor artificial, como el glaseado barato de pastel, así que tuve que volver a probarlo. Buttermilk Bar - ¡Realmente me gustó la textura de este! Suave y similar al pastel por dentro y crujiente por fuera. Los otros donuts parecen increíbles, así que definitivamente volveré a probar otros sabores. Estoy de acuerdo en que he probado donuts mejores en otros lugares, pero este lugar se inauguró hace solo 3 meses, así que tal vez su calidad mejore. El aparcamiento en la calle fue fácil de encontrar.
text_en: We arrived around 1:30 p.m. on a Sunday, and they were closing up. We wanted to get the last donuts left. We had two options: “buy one and take another” or a box for $10. The option of a box was much more convenient, so we ended up buying 16 donuts for $10!!! An incredible deal! Also, if you check Yelp, you can get a free American coffee or filter coffee. #win Blueberry Lemon – Pretty good, but I liked that it wasn’t as sweet as I thought. Strawberry Split – Regular. I wouldn’t order it again. The donut was just cinnamon flavor and was dry (probably because it had been outside all day), and the whipped cream inside was dry too, tasting like something from a can. The strawberries were also very basic; they would have been better if they were coated with frosting. Crème brûlée – My favorite among everything I tried. The crunchy frosting on top was great, and I love stuffed donuts. After eating half of it, the cream inside started to taste artificial, like cheap cake frosting, so I had to try it again. Buttermilk Bar – I really liked the texture of this one! Soft and similar to cake inside, and crunchy on the outside. The other donuts seem amazing, so I definitely will try other flavors again. I agree that I’ve tried better donuts elsewhere, but this place opened just 3 months ago, so maybe their quality will improve. The parking lot on the street was easy to find.
original: We came here around 1:30pm on a Sunday and they were closing up and wanted to get rid of the last couple of donuts they had. We had 2 options: BOGO or one box for $10. The box deal was so much more worth it so we ended up getting 16 donuts for $10!!! WHAT A STEAL. Plus if you check in on Yelp you can get either a free Americano or drip coffee. #win Blueberry Lemon - Just okay, but I liked how it wasn't as sweet as I thought it would be. Strawberry Split - Meh. I wouldn't get this again. The donut was just cinnamon and dry (probably because it had been sitting out all day) and the whipped cream inside was dry and tasted like it came from a can. The strawberries were also very plain and it would've been better if they were glazed. CrÃ¨me Brulee - My favorite out of everything I tried. The crunchy glaze on top was cool, and I love filled donuts. After eating half though, the cream inside started tasting artificial like cheap cake frosting so I had to come back to it. Buttermilk Bar - I really liked the consistency of this! Moist and cake-like on the inside and nice and crunchy on the outside. The other donuts look bomb so I'm definitely going to come try some other flavors. I agree that I've had better donuts elsewhere, but this location just opened 3 months ago so maybe their quality will go up. Street parking was easy to find.

text: Found this little gem today after doing a quick yelp search. So glad we decided to stop in. Brandon was such an amazing help with helping us decide what to get. You can tell he has a passion for what he does. The ice cream flavors are amazing and very unique with a few of the classics!
text_en: Found this little gem today after doing a quick yelp search. So glad we decided to stop in. Brandon was such an amazing help with helping us decide what to get. You can tell he has a passion for what he does. The ice cream flavors are amazing and very unique with a few of the classics!

text: Great peanut butter cookie and I am not even a peanut butter fan! Also loved the strawberry and butter pecan ice creams.
text_en: Great peanut butter cookie and I am not even a peanut butter fan! Also loved the strawberry and butter pecan ice creams.

text: Eu adoro o Sprinkles, costumava ir à unidade em Scottsdale e fiquei muito animada quando soube que uma estava vindo para Las Vegas. Ela está no Linq, então é um pouco inconveniente ter que ir até lá, a menos que você já esteja por perto. Já conhecemos o produto, estes são meus cupcakes favoritos, mas eles também têm sorvete Sprinkles. Ainda não experimentei, então não posso comentar sobre isso. Recentemente, passamos por perto perto do horário de fechamento e decidimos experimentar o Sprinkles ATM depois que um grupo de jovens quase esvaziou o lugar. É um terminal de autoatendimento onde você escolhe os sabores. Optamos por "red velvet" e "chocolate branco com leite", inserimos a cartela e esperamos pelos cupcakes. A porta abriu e não havia nada lá dentro. Fiquei triste... fiquei triste e confusa, então chamamos o rapaz que estava movendo as cadeiras e ele explicou que há uma balança dentro da máquina, então se nenhum cupcake sair, o valor não será cobrado. Tentamos novamente e, dessa vez, informou que o "chocolate branco com leite" que eu mais gostava estava esgotado, então escolhi morango. Fizemos uma segunda tentativa, ouvimos ruídos estranhos e, em seguida, vimos uma mensagem de erro na tela. Como trabalhamos em TI, achamos isso muito divertido. O rapaz confirmou que era um problema mecânico e entrou para pegar nossos cupcakes. Ele encontrou o "chocolate branco com leite"! Fiquei muito feliz, e minha cartela não foi cobrada, e senti muito. Continuamos tentando dar dinheiro ao rapaz, mas ele disse que era por nossa conta e continuou pedindo desculpas, pois não podíamos usar o ATM de cupcakes. Um rapaz muito simpático, excelente atendimento ao cliente, e espero que o ATM seja consertado, pois eu gostaria de pegar cupcakes em um ATM.
text_en: I love Sprinkles. I used to go to the store in Scottsdale, and I was very excited when I heard that one location was coming to Las Vegas. It’s at Linq, so it’s a bit inconvenient to have to go there unless you’re already nearby. We’ve already tried the product; these are my favorite cupcakes, but they also have Sprinkles ice cream. I haven’t tried them yet, so I can’t comment on that. Recently, we passed by during closing time and decided to try the Sprinkles ATM after a group of young people almost emptied the place. It’s an self-service machine where you choose your flavors. We chose “red velvet” and “white chocolate with milk.” We entered our order and waited for the cupcakes. The door opened, but there was nothing inside. I was sad… confused, so we called the guy who was moving the chairs, and he explained that there’s a scale inside the machine, so if no cupcakes come out, no charge will be made. We tried again, and this time he said that the “white chocolate with milk” I liked the most was gone, so I chose strawberry. We tried a second time, heard some strange noises, and then saw an error message on the screen. Since we work in IT, we found it really fun. The guy confirmed it was a mechanical issue and went to get our cupcakes. He found the “white chocolate with milk”! I was very happy, and my order wasn’t charged, which made me feel good. We kept trying to pay the guy, but he said it was our responsibility and kept apologizing because we couldn’t use the cupcake ATM. A very kind guy, great customer service, and I hope the ATM will be fixed, because I would like to get cupcakes using an ATM.
original: I love Sprinkles, I used to go to the one in Scottsdale and was super excited when I found out one was coming to Vegas. It's at the Linq so it's kind of a pain to go out of your way to get to, unless you're already there anyway. We already know the product, theses are my favorite cupcakes, but they also have Sprinkles ice cream. I haven't had it yet so I can't comment on it. Recently we walked by around closing time and decided to try the Sprinkles ATM after this group of chicks almost cleared it out. It's a touchscreen where you pick flavors, we went for red velvet and vanilla milk chocolate, swiped the card, and waited for cupcakes. The door opened and there was nothing inside. I was sad... I was sad and confused, so we pulled the guy who was moving chairs around and he explained there is a scale inside the machine so if no cupcakes came out the card wasn't charged. We tried it a second time and this time it said my favorite vanilla milk chocolate was out so I picked strawberry. We tried a second transaction, heard weird mechanical noises, and then saw an error come up on the screen. Since we're in IT, we found this highly amusing. The guy confirmed it was a mechanical issue and went in to get our cupcakes. He found a vanilla milk chocolate! I was so happy, and my card wasn't charged and I felt bad and we kept trying to give the guy cash but he said it was on them and kept apologizing cause we couldn't use the cupcake atm. Really really nice guy, great customer service, and I hope the atm gets fixed because I wanna pull cupcakes out of an atm.

text: Foi a primeira vez que fui à noite, depois do jantar, e o lugar é muito charmoso!! É simples e limpo, com uma equipe muito simpática e um ótimo atendimento! Eu pedi um sorvete em um copo e, para minha surpresa, ficou muito melhor do que eu esperava. A forma como os sabores se misturaram, com a opção que eu escolhi, ficou perfeita! Volto com certeza, eles têm o meu negócio! Na próxima, vou experimentar as bebidas, é interessante como eles usam telas com fotos das bebidas como propaganda.
text_en: It was the first time I went at night, after dinner, and the place is really charming!! It’s simple and clean, with a very friendly staff and excellent service! I ordered ice cream in a cup, and to my surprise, it was much better than I expected. The way the flavors blended together, along with the choice I made, was perfect! I will definitely come back; they have my favorite place! Next time, I’ll try the drinks. It’s interesting how they use screens with pictures of the drinks as advertising.
original: First time was tonight after dinner and the place was super cute!! Very simple and clean, such friendly staffs and great service! I ordered an ice cream swirl in a cup and it came out way better than I thought, the way it got mixed together with one choice of your mix, PERFECT Would come back again, they have my business! Next time I'll try out the beautiful drinks, it's nice how they used canvases with photos of their drinks as advertisement.

text: Oh. My. Gosh. This was the most delicious thing I've ever tasted. I got the doughmelt with the chocolate cherry pistachio ice cream and it was heaven. The three other people I was with tried different ice cream flavors with their melts and everyone was in love! We will definitely be back. The only downside is that they're not located closer to me!
text_en: Oh. My. Gosh. This was the most delicious thing I've ever tasted. I got the doughmelt with the chocolate cherry pistachio ice cream and it was heaven. The three other people I was with tried different ice cream flavors with their melts and everyone was in love! We will definitely be back. The only downside is that they're not located closer to me!

text: Gelo realmente delicioso, uma loja super fofa/vintage/nostálgica/divertida/charmosa. Olá, sou um apreciador de gelo de alta qualidade. E, como tal, preciso saber onde encontrar o melhor gelo. O Churn está entre as minhas melhores opções na área de Phoenix, devido aos seus sabores únicos, que não soam absurdos/terribles, E eles têm uma consistência cremoso e amanteigado (embora eu gostaria que fosse ainda mais cremoso e aveludado!). A própria loja me faz sentir como uma criança em uma loja de doces, em parte devido ao ambiente retrô, e também porque eles vendem doces... e outros produtos/brinquedos divertidos. Para uma loja pequena, é possível gastar muito dinheiro aqui. Meus filhos menores adoram este lugar. Os funcionários (na maior parte) são simpáticos e prestativos, e parecem genuinamente felizes em oferecer amostras. Os sabores mais memoráveis que experimentei são: - pecan com manteiga - chocolate - café vietnamita - biscoitos e hortelã - bolo de cenoura. TUDO tem sido excelente, e parece que usam ingredientes de alta qualidade. Além das opções clássicas, eles também têm um cone de pretzel divertido, que é bastante único e delicioso. Há algumas mesas e cadeiras na frente (e uma área de refeições compartilhada no fundo, com o restaurante vizinho). Mas atenção: durante os horários de pico (ou seja, após o jantar/à noite de sexta e sábado), a fila pode ficar bastante longa, e o espaço limitado pode se tornar um problema, já que a loja é pequena.
text_en: The ice is really delicious. It’s a super cute/vintage/nostalgic/entertaining/charming store. Hello, I’m a lover of high-quality ice. As such, I need to know where to find the best ice. Churn is one of my top choices in Phoenix, due to its unique flavors that aren’t absurd or terrible. They also have a creamy and smooth texture (although I would like it to be even more creamy and velvety!). The store itself makes me feel like a child in a candy shop, partly because of the retro atmosphere, and also because they sell candies… and other fun products and toys. For a small store, it’s possible to spend a lot of money here. My younger children love this place. The staff (most of them) are friendly and helpful, and seem genuinely happy to give samples. The most memorable flavors I’ve tried are: pecan with butter, chocolate, Vietnamese coffee, cookies and mint, carrot cake. Everything has been excellent, and it seems like they use high-quality ingredients. In addition to the classic options, they also have a fun pretzel cone that’s quite unique and delicious. There are some tables and chairs in front, and a shared dining area at the back, next to the nearby restaurant. But note: during peak hours (i.e., after dinner/at night on Fridays and Saturdays), the line can get very long, and the limited space can be a problem, since the store is small.
original: Really good ice cream, super adorable/old school/nostalgic/fun/cute shop. Hi, I'm an ice cream snob. And as such, I'm required to know where to find the best ice cream. Churn is toward the top of my list in the Phoenix area so far, bc of their unique flavors that don't sound ridiculous/terrible AND they've got a decently creamy, buttery consistency (though I wish it were creamier and velvetier!). The shop itself literally makes me feel like a fat kid in a candy store, partly bc of all the retro vibes, and bc they also sell candy...and other goodies/novelty toys. For a tiny shop, you sure can spend a crap load of money here. My toddlers go nuts over this place. Employees (for the most part), are peppy and sweet and they genuinely seem happy to give out samples. The most memorable flavors I've had are: - butter pecan - chocolate - Vietnamese coffee - cookies and mint - carrot cake It's ALL been good and it tastes like they use high quality ingredients. On top of the classic cone options, they even have a fun pretzel cone that's pretty unique and yummy. There's a couple tables and chairs out front (and a shared dining area in the back with the neighboring restaurant). But beware: during their peak times (i.e. after dinner/Fri-Sat nights) the line can get pretty freaking long and limited seating can get ugly since the shop is small.

text: Noel was great! Really great attitude! Spoke with her on the phone before arriving and she was just as nice in person. Came specifically to this location for the flavor of bread pudding that day. Noel took my order and proceed to work on my computer. Bread pudding arrives and it's the wrong flavor. Took it back to the counter and she apologized and put another in the over for me. No biggie. But 40 mins go by and the correct bread pudding came. Go back and Noel says the kitchen forgot and it's burnt. Again she was very polite, put yet another in the oven and offered to bag one for the rode. 30 more mins pass, and the warm bread pudding never comes. Finally I gave up and took my cold bread pudding and made it at home. If it weren't for the staff's great attitude, this entire trip would've been a bust
