text: Los pasteles de Presti para ocasiones especiales son excelentes. El pastel es tierno y sabroso, y el betún es denso y delicioso. Además, están muy bien decorados. Un pastel tal como debe ser, un manjar delicioso (¡a diferencia de otros pastelerías... ya sabe, las que tienen un betún desagradable y decoraciones de plástico). El café también es muy agradable y ofrecen una gran variedad de galletas y pasteles finos. En ocasiones, he experimentado un servicio un poco lento debido a personal en formación, pero no suele ser así. Sin embargo, admitámoslo: Corbo tiene mejores cannoli. Corbo también probablemente tiene pasteles fabulosos, pero no ofrecen pastel amarillo.
text_en: Presti’s cakes for special occasions are excellent. The cake is tender and delicious, and the betún is thick and tasty. Moreover, they are beautifully decorated. A real masterpiece—unlike other bakeries, where the betún is unpleasant and the decorations are plastic. The coffee is also very pleasant, and they offer a wide variety of cookies and delicate cakes. Sometimes, the service can be a bit slow due to staff still in training, but it’s not always the case. However, let’s admit it: Corbo has better cannoli. Corbo probably also has fantastic cakes, but they don’t offer yellow cakes.
original: Presti's cakes for special occasions are excellent. The cake is tender and flavorful, and the buttercream is dense and heavenly. They are also decorated beautifully. Cake as it is supposed to be, a delicious treat (not like those OTHER bakeries.... you know the ones... with the gross frosting and plastic decorations.) The cafe is also very pleasant and they have such a variety of fine cookies and pastry. Occasionally I have had slow service from trainees, but not usually. However, let's admit it. Corbo's definitely has better cannoli. Corbo's also probably has fabulous cakes, but they don't have yellow cake.

text: What an amazing Thai iced tea!! The owner was so nice and sweet! I recommend the Thai tea ice cream. Everything thing was so great!
text_en: What an amazing Thai iced tea!! The owner was so nice and sweet! I recommend the Thai tea ice cream. Everything thing was so great!

text:
Había oído hablar de Sprinkles durante años, pero nunca había tenido la oportunidad de probar sus productos... ¡hasta ayer! Después de visitar el restaurante de Gordon Ramsay, fuimos aquí para comprar cupcakes. A mi esposa le encantan los cupcakes, y estaba deseando mucho este parada en nuestra aventura gastronómica en Las Vegas. Entramos y nos recibió una joven alegre, y dimos nuestro pedido. Elegimos un cupcake de chocolate y mantequilla de cacahuete, un pastel de piña al revés y un cupcake con tres capas de canela. Cada uno costaba $4.00. Aquí están los que pedimos:

*   **Cupcake de chocolate y mantequilla de cacahuete:** ¡Este fue el favorito de mi esposa! Le encanta la combinación de chocolate y mantequilla de cacahuete. Era muy rico, dulce y tenía una excelente textura y sabor a mantequilla de cacahuete. ¡5 estrellas!
*   **Pastel de piña al revés:** También estaba muy bien. Tenía una base de pastel de piña húmeda, rellena con una mermelada/compota de piña, y cubierta con un glaseado de mantequilla. Este fue mi favorito de los tres. Creo que era uno de sus especiales mensuales/semanales/diarios. Estaba delicioso, y si te gusta la piña, ¡no dudes en probar este! 5 estrellas!
*   **Cupcake con tres capas de canela:** Este fue nuestro menos favorito de los tres, pero incluso así, ¡estaba bastante delicioso! Era un pastel especiado con leche, con glaseado de queso crema y canela. Tenía una textura más densa que los otros, y parecía un poco "anticuado". Sin embargo, incluso así, estaba bastante delicioso. 4 estrellas.

El servicio de la joven que nos preparó los cupcakes en la caja, y del amable empleado en la caja, fue excelente. $4.00 puede parecer mucho por un cupcake, pero son grandes, y ¡la calidad lo vale! Definitivamente volvería.
text_en:
I had heard of Sprinkles for years, but never had the chance to try their products… until yesterday! After visiting Gordon Ramsay’s restaurant, we went here to buy cupcakes. My wife loves cupcakes, and she was really looking forward to this stop in our culinary adventure in Las Vegas. We entered, and a cheerful young woman greeted us, and we made our orders. We chose a chocolate and peanut butter cupcake, a upside-down pineapple cake, and a cupcake with three layers of cinnamon. Each one cost $4.00. Here are the ones we ordered:

*   **Chocolate and peanut butter cupcake:** This was my wife’s favorite! She loves the combination of chocolate and peanut butter. It was very rich, sweet, and had an excellent texture and flavor with the peanut butter. 5 stars!
*   **Upside-down pineapple cake:** It was also great. It had a moist pineapple cake base, filled with pineapple jam/custard, and covered with butter frosting. This was my favorite out of the three. I think it was one of her monthly/weekly/daily specials. It was delicious, and if you like pineapple, don’t hesitate to try this! 5 stars!
*   **Cupcake with three layers of cinnamon:** This was our least favorite among the three, but still, it was quite delicious! It was a spiced cake with milk, cream cheese frosting, and cinnamon. It had a denser texture than the others, and seemed a bit “old-fashioned”. However, even so, it was still quite delicious. 4 stars.

The service from the young woman who prepared the cupcakes in the box, and the kind staff member at the counter, was excellent. $4.00 might seem expensive for a cupcake, but they are large, and the quality makes it worth it! Definitely would go back.
original: I had heard about Sprinkles for years now, but had never had the chance to try out their goods......until yesterday! After Gordon Ramsay's, we walked down here to get some cupcakes. My wife is all about cupcakes and she was looking forward to this stop the most on our Vegas eating adventure. We walked in and were greeted by a cheery young lady, and we placed our order. We went with a chocolate peanut butter, a pineapple upside down cake, and a triple cinnamon cupcake. They were $4.00 each. Here is how they were.............. Chocolate Peanut Butter- This was my wife's favorite! She is all about the chocolate peanut butter. Very rich and sweet and had a great texture and peanut butter flavor. 5 stars! Pineapple Upside Down Cake- This was fantastic as well. It had a moist pineapple cake base, filled with some pineapple jam/compote and then topped with some buttercream icing. This was my favorite of the 3. I think it was one of their rotating monthly/weekly/daily specials. It was delicious and if you like pineapple, get this one. 5 stars! Triple Cinnamon Cupcake- This was our least favorite of the 3, but even then, it was still pretty fucking tasty! It was a buttermilk spiced cake, with cream cheese icing topped with cinnamon sugar. It had a more dense texture to it than the other ones, and seemed a little bit "old". Like I said though, even then, it was still pretty damn tasty. 4 stars! Service from the lady who got our cupcakes together in the box, and the friendly dude at the cash register were great! $4.00 seems like a lot for a cupcake, but they are large, and well worth it! I would definitely return!

text: Esta reseña es breve y carece de fotos porque comí mi postre demasiado rápido para tomar una foto. El helado de leche de cereal con copos de maíz realmente sabe a leche de cereal, pero obviamente más dulce y, obviamente, mucho mejor, ya que la dulzura siempre implica una mejor calidad, según mi opinión. El pastel de la "milk bar". ¡Chicos! Si les gusta el pastel de nueces, les encantará este, porque sabe de manera similar al relleno de un pastel de nueces. Sin nueces. Es delicioso y me sentí avergonzada de lo rápido que lo comí. Además, ¡NO DESPERDICIEN LAS GALLETAS! A mi esposo le encanta la versión del pastel de cumpleaños, y a mí también. Simplemente, soy más de galletas tipo "compost" (base de galletas graham, pretzels, patatas fritas, café, avena y mantequilla de caramelo). Soy originaria de Nueva York y solía ir mucho a la "milk bar" cuando vivía allí. No hay ninguna diferencia en el sabor/calidad/servicio en este lugar. Así que, si están de postre en Las Vegas (lo cual, para mí, es constante), haganse un favor y vengan aquí.
text_en: This review is short and lacks photos, as I ate my dessert too quickly to take a picture. The cereal milk ice cream with corn flakes really tastes like cereal milk, but obviously it’s sweeter—and, of course, much better, since sweetness always implies better quality, in my opinion. The “milk bar” cake… Hey guys! If you like nut cake, you’ll love this one, because it tastes similar to the filling in nut cake. No nuts involved. It’s delicious, and I felt embarrassed that I ate it so quickly. Also, don’t waste the cookies! My husband loves the birthday cake version, and I do too. I prefer “compost” type cookies—made with graham crackers, pretzels, fried potatoes, coffee, oats, and caramel butter. I’m from New York, and I used to go to the “milk bar” a lot when I lived there. There’s no difference in flavor, quality, or service here. So, if you’re looking for dessert in Las Vegas (which is pretty common for me), please come here.
original: This review is short and lacking photos because I ate my dessert too fast to take a photo. The cereal milk ice cream with cornflake really does taste like you're having cereal milk except obviously sweeter and obviously way better because sweeter always equals better in my humble opinion. The milk bar pie. Y'all. If you like pecan pie, you'll love this because it tastes similar to the filling of a pecan pie. Sans pecans. It's so good and I was embarrassed at how quickly I finished it. Also-DONT SLEEP ON THE COOKIES. My husband loves the birthday cake one as do I, I'm just more of a compost cookie kind of gal (graham cracker base, pretzels, potato chips, coffee, oats and butterscotch). I'm originally from NY and used to frequent milk bar when I lived there. There's no difference in taste/quality/service at this one. So if you're in the mood for dessert while you're in Vegas (which for me that's constantly) do yourself a favor and go here!

text: Depois de ver isso na Food Network há alguns anos, tive que experimentar este lugar. Se Alton Brown recomenda algo, você sabe que é algo especial. A loja estava limpa e havia uma fila. Depois de passar pela fila, não havia lugar para sentar imediatamente, mas isso não nos impediu de saborear um Toffee Banoffee e Smores ao redor da fogueira. O Toffee Banoffee realmente oferece uma combinação de sabores muito boa. As texturas combinam muito bem. Você tem a crocância do sorvete e do caramelo, a suavidade da banana e um toque doce delicioso. Tenho que dizer que, na verdade, gostei um pouco mais dos Smores ao redor da fogueira. Se você fechar os olhos, você pode até sentir o cheiro da fogueira. Não sei como eles adicionam esse sabor defumado, mas Alton Brown também deveria experimentar este. Eventualmente, conseguimos uma mesa e pudemos relaxar e aproveitar essas criações mágicas. Também há água potável disponível – seria ótimo se tivessem leite grátis! Vale a pena a viagem até Scottsdale para experimentar esta sorveteria.
text_en: After seeing this on Food Network a few years ago, I had to try this place myself. If Alton Brown recommends something, it’s definitely something special. The store was clean, and there was a line. After going through the line, there wasn’t immediate seating available, but that didn’t stop us from enjoying a Toffee Banoffee and Smores around the fire. The Toffee Banoffee really offers a great combination of flavors. The textures blend well together—there’s the crunch of ice cream and caramel, the softness of bananas, and a delicious sweet touch. I must say that I actually preferred the Smores around the fire a little more. If you close your eyes, you can even smell the fire. I don’t know how they add that smoked flavor, but Alton Brown should definitely try this too. Eventually, we managed to get a table and could relax and enjoy these magical creations. There’s also drinking water available—it would be great if they offered free milk too! It’s worth making the trip to Scottsdale just to try this ice cream shop.
original: After seeing this on the Food Network a few years ago, I had to try this place. If Alton Brown puts his stamp of approval on something, you know there is something special there. The store was clean and there was a bit of a line. Once through the line, there was no where to sit right away but that didn't stop us from enjoying a Toffee Banofi and Camp Fire Smores. You really get a good mix of flavor in the Toffee Banofi. The textures play with each other nicely. You have the crunch of the cone and toffee, the smoothness of the banana, and a nice sweet kick from the caramel. I must say that I actually enjoyed the Camp Fire Smores a little better. If you close your eyes, you can actually smell the campfire. I don't know how they add that smokiness, but Alton Brown really needs to try this one as well. Eventually we snagged a table and were able to relax and enjoy these magical creations. There is also tap water available - wish they had free milk! Worth the trip out to Scottsdale to try this ice cream shop.

text: Meu Deus, eu amo este sorvete. Os sabores não são extravagantes, mas são de alta qualidade. Eles têm profundidade, têm dimensão. A Mitchell's tem sido uma parte importante da minha vida em Cleveland há cerca de 6 anos, e qualquer pessoa que visita Cleveland PRECISA visitar a Mitchell's. Até mesmo os sabores mais simples, como o de massa de biscoito, são incríveis. Na verdade, esse é o meu favorito. MAS, se você gosta de sabores de chocolate e frutas, o sorvete de cereja Bing com pedaços de chocolate é excelente.
text_en: Oh my God, I love this ice cream. The flavors aren’t extravagant, but they’re of high quality. They have depth and flavor. Mitchell’s has been an important part of my life in Cleveland for about 6 years, and anyone who visits Cleveland MUST visit Mitchell’s. Even the simplest flavors, like cookie dough, are amazing. In fact, that’s my favorite. BUT, if you like chocolate and fruit flavors, Bing cherry ice cream with chocolate chunks is excellent.
original: God, I love this ice cream. The flavors aren't like,, wild, but they're quality. They have depth, they've got dimension. Mitchell's has been a staple in my life in Cleveland for like 6 years and anyone who visits Cleveland HAS to stop by Mitchell's. Even their super simple flavors like cookie dough are amazing. In fact, that's my favorite. BUT if you like chocolate and fruit flavors, the bing cherry chocolate chunk is stellar

text: Sí, este lugar merece todas las estrellas que le he dado… y todas las que le han dado los demás. He probado los donuts antes (cuando mis compañeros de trabajo los compraban) y siempre había querido ir a comprar algunos para mí, pero nunca llegué hasta esta mañana. Sé que algunas personas tienen problemas con la ubicación/el edificio antiguo, pero… ¡a la gente le importa solo la calidad de los donuts! Y eso se nota: ¡son realmente deliciosos! Compré seis donuts esta mañana… y un pastel de manzana… (no se preocupen, los compartiré). Los donuts incluyen: arándanos, calabaza, mantequilla de cacahuete y chocolate, manzana con caramelo, Reese's, y caramelo salado. La manzana = increíble. Los arándanos = increíbles. El pastel de manzana es del tamaño de mi cabeza… ¡o incluso más grande! Los seis donuts estaban en una caja más pequeña… el pastel de manzana, en una caja diseñada para doce (aunque no llenaba toda la caja, aún así… enorme). En total, gasté 9,25 dólares, y principalmente por el pastel de manzana. ¡Seis donuts cuestan menos de 6 dólares! Donuts increíblemente frescos… precios increíblemente bajos… gente amable detrás del mostrador… ¿qué no hay que amar? (PD: Traigan efectivo o cheque – no aceptan tarjetas de crédito/débito).
text_en: Yes, this place deserves all the stars I’ve given it… and all the stars others have given it too. I’ve tried the donuts before (when my coworkers bought them), and I always wanted to buy some for myself, but I never got the chance until this morning. I know some people have trouble with the location or the old building, but… people care only about the quality of the donuts! And that’s obvious—they’re really delicious! I bought six donuts this morning… and a apple pie… (don’t worry, I’ll share them with you). The donuts include: raisins, pumpkin, peanut butter and chocolate, apple with caramel, Reese’s, and salted caramel. The apple is amazing. The raisins are incredible. The apple pie is the size of my head… or even bigger! The six donuts were in a smaller box… the apple pie was in a box designed for twelve pieces (even though it didn’t fill the whole box, still… huge!). In total, I spent $9.25, mostly on the apple pie. Six donuts cost less than $6! Incredibly fresh donuts… incredibly low prices… friendly staff behind the counter… what could be better? (PS: Bring cash or check– they don’t accept credit/debit cards.)
original: Yep - this place deserves every star I gave it... and every star everyone else gave it. I've had the donuts before (when people at work had them) and always meant to go in and grab some of my own, but never made it there till this morning. I know some people have an issue with the location / old building - but people... Jack Frost only cares about the quality of the donuts! and it's apparent - they're SO good! Got a half dozen this morning..... and an apple fritter..... (don't worry, I'm going to share!) Donuts included: blueberry, pumpkin, peanut butter chocolate, caramel apple, reeses peanut butter cup, and salted caramel. Pumpkin= amazing. Blueberry = amazing. The apple fritter is the size of my head... if not bigger! The 6 donuts were in a smaller box... apple fritter, in a box made for a dozen (granted, it didn't take up the entire box, but still... huge) All in all, spent $9.25 and it was mainly because of the fritter. 1/2 dozen is less than 6 dollars! Amazingly fresh donuts... amazingly cheap prices... sweet people behind the counter - what's there not to love?!? (PS bring cash or a check- no credit/debit here)

text: Es un lugar "aceptable", simplemente para variar un poco de la oferta de Starbucks. Pedí tostadas con queso frito, y tardaron unos 10 minutos en prepararlas. El café mocha no era de gran calidad.
text_en: It’s a “acceptable” place, just to break up the usual Starbucks offerings. I ordered toast with fried cheese, and it took about 10 minutes to prepare them. The mocha coffee wasn’t very good quality.
original: It's an "OK" place, just for the sake of changing the Starbucks flavor. i got the fried cheese toast, took them like 10 minutes to heat it. the cafe mocha was not that great.

text: Adoro a Milk Bar. Se você ainda não assistiu ao documentário sobre Christina Tosi na Netflix, está perdendo uma ótima experiência. Meu marido e eu sempre pedimos o sorvete de leite com cereais, é simplesmente incrível. Isso te fará reviver a nostalgia da sua infância, quando você sempre bebia todo o leite depois de comer os cereais. A torta de biscoito é exatamente isso: é viciante, uma mordida e você quer mais e mais. Já experimentei os brigadeiros de aniversário, mas não me agradaram tanto, e o bolo de aniversário que comi estava um pouco seco para mim. Por isso, dou uma nota 4/5.
text_en: I love the Milk Bar. If you haven’t watched the documentary about Christina Tosi on Netflix yet, you’re missing out on a great experience. My husband and I always order the milk ice cream with cereal – it’s simply amazing. It will bring back memories of your childhood, when you always drank all the milk after eating the cereal. The cookie cake is just that – addictive; one bite and you want more. I’ve tried the birthday chocolates, but they didn’t really impress me, and the birthday cake I ate was a bit too dry for me. So, I give it a 4/5.
original: Love me some Milk Bar. If you haven't watched the documentary about Christina Tosi on Netflix, your missing out. My husband and I always get the cereal milk ice cream with cornflakes, it will blow your mind. This will nostalgically take you back to your childhood days of drinking all the milk after eating your cereal. The crack pie, is just that, it's like crack, one bite and you want more and more. I have had the birthday cake truffles, not a fan and the birthday cake, cake I had was a tad dry for me. Which is why I'm giving it 4/5.

text: Sem dúvida, o melhor sorvete em Phoenix! Não deixe que a localização e o tamanho pequeno o dissuadam, este lugar vale a visita. Eles estão sempre inovando nos sabores, e sempre têm algo realmente único! Tudo é feito no local, e você pode experimentar tudo. Eles oferecem sanduíches de sorvete com donuts, sim, sanduíches de sorvete com donuts. Parece demais, mas na verdade são perfeitos! Não são muito doces, e nem são exageradamente grandes. Eles até são prensados em uma máquina de panini quente, que os aquece perfeitamente antes de serem saboreados. Na última vez que fui, experimentei o sorvete de baunilha, que parece super simples, mas foi, sem dúvida, o sorvete de baunilha mais saboroso e fresco que já provei! Ele ganhou prêmios por seu sabor (e é verdade!). Eles não fazem publicidade e dependem apenas do boca a boca, são muito simpáticos e atenciosos com todos os clientes. ADORO este lugar.
text_en: Without a doubt, the best ice cream in Phoenix! Don’t let its small location and size deter you—this place is worth a visit. They constantly innovate with flavors, and there’s always something truly unique! Everything is made in-house, so you can try everything. They offer ice cream sandwiches with donuts—yes, ice cream sandwiches with donuts. It sounds amazing, but it’s actually perfect! They aren’t too sweet, and not overly large either. They’re even pressed using a hot panini machine, which warms them perfectly before you taste them. The last time I went there, I tried vanilla ice cream—it seems simple, but it was undoubtedly the most flavorful and fresh vanilla ice cream I’ve ever tasted! It won awards for its taste (and that’s true!). They don’t advertise; they rely solely on word of mouth. They’re very friendly and attentive to all customers. I absolutely love this place.
original: Hands down the best ice cream in a Phoenix! Don't be put off by its location and small size, this place is worth the visit. They are always changing up their flavor options, and always have something super unique! It's all made in house, and you are welcome to sample it all. They offer doughnut ice cream sandwiches, yes doughnut ice cream sandwiches. It sounds like too much but they are actually perfect! Not too sweet, and not overly huge. They even get pressed inside a warm panini machine that warms them to perfection before enjoying. Last time I stopped in I hade their vanilla bean ice cream which sounds super plain but it was by far the best tasting and most fresh vanilla bean I have ever tasted! It has won awards for its flavor (no joke). They don't advertise and rely solely on word of mouth, super sweet and personable to all customers. LOVE this place.

text: Estos fueron los macarons peores que he probado en mucho tiempo. ¡Qué decepción! Eran extremadamente duros, y costaban $2 cada uno.
text_en: These were the worst macarons I’ve tried in a long time. What a disappointment! They were extremely hard, and each cost $2.
original: These were the worse macarons I've had in a long time! Smh. Extremely HARD, and for $2 a pop

text: Los famosos "sprinkles"... en cuanto a decoración, los cupcakes son definitivamente minimalistas. Esto te hace replantearte los cupcakes de tu infancia. Mi esposo pidió los de azúcar y canela (sin glaseado) y yo pedí los de doble azúcar y canela con glaseado. Realmente me encantó el glaseado, pero la parte del pastel en sí no me convenció (normalmente, al contrario, yo). Mi esposo, que no es muy aficionado a los dulces, disfrutó del cupcake. Esto me hace preguntarme: ¿realmente es un cupcake si se comercializa a personas que no son muy aficionadas a los dulces? Quizás pruebe los "sprinkles" de nuevo, pero probablemente pediré los cupcakes como una novedad, o tal vez incorpore la función de helado de la tienda en mi pedido.
text_en: The famous “sprinkles”… when it comes to decoration, cupcakes are definitely minimalist. This makes you rethink your childhood cupcakes. My husband ordered those with sugar and cinnamon (without icing), while I asked for those with double sugar and cinnamon with icing. I really loved the icing, but the cake itself didn’t impress me (usually, on the contrary, I do). My husband, who isn’t very fond of sweets, enjoyed the cupcake. This makes me wonder: is a cupcake really a cupcake if it’s sold to people who aren’t very fond of sweets? Maybe I’ll try the “sprinkles” again, but probably I’ll order cupcakes as a novelty, or maybe I’ll add the ice cream function of the store to my order.
original: The famous sprinkles...in regards to decor the cupcakes are definitely minimalist. It makes you rethink the cupcakes of your youth. My husband got the cinnamon sugar (without icing) and I got the double cinnamon sugar with icing. I really loved the icing but the actual cake part fell flat (it's usually the opposite with me). My husband who isn't really into sweets loved the cupcake. This makes me wonder is it really a cupcake if you market to those who aren't that into sweets? I might try sprinkles again but will probably do the cupcake ATM for novelty or maybe incorporate the ice cream function of the store into my order.

text: Era caro e não valeu a espera. A embalagem de biscoitos custava US$ 22 –.-, um preço considerável para apenas 450 gramas. Os mini bolos custavam US$ 10.
text_en: It was expensive and not worth the wait. The biscuit package cost $22 –.-; a considerable price for just 450 grams. The mini cakes cost $10.
original: Pricey and wasn't worth the wait. The cookie bag was $22 -.-" quite pricey for 1lb. The mini cakes was $10.

text: Este lugar é um verdadeiro achado, escondido sob uma ponte. Eu passo diariamente em frente à Page Dairy Mart depois do trabalho, e sempre há uma fila longa às 15h, mesmo em dias de chuva. Finalmente, parei um dia e foi delicioso... agora se tornará um vício. Optei por algo simples: sorvete cremoso com um pouco de refrigerante de cola. Muito gostoso e nostálgico. Eles têm uma grande variedade de sabores e acompanhamentos, então espero experimentar mais no futuro. Talvez até experimente um dos muitos sundes que anunciam! Não há atendimento no interior, você faz o pedido pela janela. Eles não aceitam dinheiro, mas há um caixa eletrônico próximo ao prédio. O cardápio é bastante extenso, então certifique-se de analisar todas as opções enquanto espera na fila! A situação de estacionamento é boa, com várias vagas ao redor da Page's.
text_en: This place is a real gem, hidden behind a bridge. I pass by Page Dairy Mart every day after work, and there’s always a long line at 3 p.m., even on rainy days. Finally, I stopped in one day, and it was delicious… now it’s become a habit for me. I chose something simple: creamy ice cream with some candy soda. It was very tasty and nostalgic. They have a wide variety of flavors and toppings, so I hope to try more in the future. Maybe I’ll even try one of the many sundes they offer! There’s no service inside; you order through the window. They don’t accept cash, but there’s an ATM nearby. The menu is quite extensive, so make sure to check all the options while waiting in line! The parking situation is good, with several spots around Page’s.
original: This place is such a gem under an overpass. I drive past Page Dairy Mart every day after work and there is always a long line at 3:30 in the afternoon, even in a downpour of rain. I finally stopped one day and it was so good... it's now going to become a bad habit. I went simple - swirl soft serve ice cream on a cake coke. So yummy and nostalgic. They have tons of flavors and dips though, so I hope to try out more in the future. Maybe I'll even try one of the many sundaes they advertise! There is no inside- you order from a window. They don't accept cash but there is an ATM around the corner of the building. The menu is pretty extensive so make sure you're studying all the options while you're waiting in line! The parking situation is decent- there are a lot of spots that surround Page's.

text: Located near ASU downtown campus, Melt. is a perfect addition to the Arts' District. I mean, why didn't we have a local ice cream parlor in PHOENIX yet? The small shop is ran by a nice youthful and friendly couple and the ice cream is made with local ingredients. You can grab ice cream and take it next door to Lost Leaf and make a beer float, take it across the street to the bookstore and watch the open mic, or just sit on Melt.s incredible front patio. At first I was a little scared of their 7 dollar milkshake until I was reminded that it was made using local dairy products (and it was the most delicious shake I have ever put in my face). Melt. It's a First Friday must stop venue too!
text_en: Located near ASU downtown campus, Melt. is a perfect addition to the Arts' District. I mean, why didn't we have a local ice cream parlor in PHOENIX yet? The small shop is ran by a nice youthful and friendly couple and the ice cream is made with local ingredients. You can grab ice cream and take it next door to Lost Leaf and make a beer float, take it across the street to the bookstore and watch the open mic, or just sit on Melt.s incredible front patio. At first I was a little scared of their 7 dollar milkshake until I was reminded that it was made using local dairy products (and it was the most delicious shake I have ever put in my face). Melt. It's a First Friday must stop venue too!

text: El brownie de caramelo salado podría ser el postre más delicioso que he probado. No me impresionaron demasiado sus croissants, lo que me impidió darles 5 estrellas.
text_en: The salty caramel brownie could be the most delicious dessert I’ve ever tasted. I wasn’t very impressed by their croissants, which is why I couldn’t give them 5 stars.
original: The salted caramel brownie might be the best sweet I've ever had! Wasn't terribly impressed with their croissants, which is what kept me from giving 5 stars.

text: No soy muy fan de los donuts, pero me encanta este lugar. Tienen los mejores donuts. Todo lo que he probado ha sido delicioso. Mis favoritos son el donut de cheesecake de arándanos y el donut tipo tostada francesa. Vengo cada vez que puedo.
text_en: I’m not a big fan of donuts, but I really love this place. They have the best donuts. Everything I’ve tried is delicious. My favorites are the cheesecake and raisin donut, and the French toast-style donut. I go there whenever I can.
original: I'm not a donut fan at all but this place I absolutely love! They have the best donuts. Everything I've tried has been delicious. My favorites are blueberry cheesecake and the French toast donut! I go every chance I get.

text: ¡Un lugar genial para disfrutar de dulces! Lo recomiendo mucho, el personal es muy amable y la comida es deliciosa.
text_en: A great place to enjoy sweets! I highly recommend it. The staff are very friendly, and the food is delicious.
original: Really cool spot for sweets! Highly recommend checking this place out, super nice staff and good snacks.

text: ¡MADRE MÍA! Estaba visitando Madison y busqué "La mejor panadería en Madison" y esta apareció. Como pueden imaginar, ¡es evidente por qué! Este lugar es absolutamente encantador y la variedad es deliciosa. Me dejé llevar un poco y compré alrededor de 30 dólares en productos de panadería, y luego me di cuenta de que debería comprar algunos para las personas a las que voy a visitar. ¡Deben venir aquí! Las empleadas fueron muy amables y serviciales. Si alguna vez vuelvo a Madison, ¡definitivamente volveré! Acabo de registrarme en Yelp para poder dejarlos una reseña.
text_en: Mom! I was visiting Madison and searched for “The best bakery in Madison,” and this one came up. As you can imagine, it’s no wonder! This place is absolutely charming, and the variety of products is delicious. I went ahead and bought around $30 worth of bakery items. Then I realized I should buy some for the people I’m visiting next time. They really should come here! The staff were very kind and helpful. If I ever go back to Madison, I’ll definitely come back! I just registered on Yelp so I can leave a review for them.
original: HOLY HEAVEN! Visiting Madison and I searched "Best bakery in Madison" and this came up. Needless to say I can see why! This place is adorable beyond words and the selection is delightful! I got a little carried away and bought about $30 worth of baked goods, then realized I should probably buy some for the people I am visiting. You have got to go here! The women were super sweet and helpful too! If I ever come back to Madison I am 100% coming back here! Just signed up for Yelp so I could review them!!

text: Descubrí Milk Bar inicialmente al probar sus trufas en una caja de regalo y me encantó el concepto y el empaque en general. Sin embargo, las trufas eran un poco demasiado dulces para mi gusto, así que esperaba que el helado de cereal fuera mejor – ¡y lo fue! El helado sabe exactamente como uno imagina que sería el sabor del helado con leche de cereal. No era demasiado dulce, y me gustó que la cobertura de cereal (con un costo adicional de $1) proporcionara una agradable textura crujiente que complementaba el helado suave y cremoso. Sin embargo, desearía que la cobertura de cereal fuera menos salada. No sé qué hacen con ella, pero si la dejaran tal como está, sería mucho mejor: crujiente, copos de maíz. ¡Por favor, no salen los copos de maíz! No puedo dar a este lugar 4 estrellas completas simplemente por el precio. Pagar $7 por un helado muy pequeño es simplemente una locura y no vale la pena.
text_en: I first discovered Milk Bar when I tried its truffles in a gift box. I really liked the concept and the overall packaging. However, the truffles were a bit too sweet for my taste. So, I expected the cereal ice cream to be better—and it was! The ice cream tasted exactly like what one would expect from cereal milk ice cream. It wasn’t too sweet, and I liked that the cereal topping (at an extra $1 cost) provided a pleasant crunchy texture that complemented the soft, creamy ice cream. But I wish the cereal topping could be less salty. I don’t know what they do with it, but if they kept it as it is, it would be much better—crunchy, cornflake-like. Please don’t remove the cornflakes! I can’t give this place full 4 stars just because of the price. Paying $7 for a very small ice cream is simply crazy and not worth it.
original: I was first introduced to Milk Bar after trying out their truffles in a gift box and loved the whole concept and packaging. The truffles were a little too sweet for me, so I was hoping the cereal soft serve would be better - and it was! The soft serve tastes EXACTLY like what you would imagine cereal milk in ice cream form would taste like. It wasn't overly sweet, and I liked that the cereal topping (extra $1) provided a nice crunch which complemented the soft, creamy ice cream. I do wish that the cereal topping was less salty. I don't know what they do to it, but it would taste so much better if they left it plain and simple - crunchy, corn flakes. Don't salt the cereal guys! I cannot give this place a full 4 stars simply because of the price. Paying $7 for a very small soft serve is simply CRAZY and not worth it.

text: La comida y el café siempre son deliciosos. Algunos de mis favoritos son: "Cafe Marcotter", el sándwich de ensalada de pollo, cualquier sopa y todas las pastelerías. El aspecto negativo es el servicio en la barra y el momento de pagar. Es un lugar muy popular, y cuando la cola se extiende por otras habitaciones, es lógico contar con más de una o dos personas atendiendo a los clientes. Hemos estado allí varias veces, y es muy frustrante. Pero seguimos volviendo, lo que demuestra la calidad de la comida. :)
text_en: The food and coffee are always delicious. Some of my favorite items include “Cafe Marcotter”, chicken salad sandwiches, any soup, and all the pastries. The negative aspects are the service at the bar and the payment process. It’s a very popular place, and when the line extends to other rooms, it’s natural for more than one or two people to be serving customers. We’ve been there several times, and it’s really frustrating. But we still come back, which shows the quality of the food. :)
original: The food and coffee are always delish. Some favorites .... Cafe Marcotter, Chicken Salad Sandwich, Any of the Soups, and all of the Pastries. The negative aspect is the counter service and checkout. This is a wildly popular place, and when the line snakes around into other rooms, it makes sense to have more than one or two people working the line. We've been there multiple times where this is the case, and it is very frustrating. But we keep going back, so that should speak to the quality of the food. :)

text: EL MEJOR HELADO DE MI VIDA. Sí, lo leíste bien. Este helado es el mejor de todos. Lo preparan a mano y se nota que el creador es un apasionado de hacer helado, porque se puede saborear todo el cariño que le pone. Probé varios sabores, pero el de miel y lavanda me conquistó. Estaba perfectamente equilibrado y no era demasiado dulce. ¡Si pudiera, volvería todos los días a probar todos los sabores! Absolutamente vale la pena la espera.
text_en: The best ice cream of my life. Yes, you read that right. This ice cream is the best of all. It’s made handcrafted, and it’s clear that its creator is a passionate ice cream lover, because you can taste all the care and love they put into it. I tried several flavors, but the honey and lavender flavor won me over. It was perfectly balanced, and not too sweet. If I could, I would go back every day to try all the flavors! It’s absolutely worth the wait.
original: THE BEST ICE CREAM OF MY LIFE Yes, you read that right. This ice cream is the creme de la creme of ice creams. They make every flavor by hand and you can tell the creator is passionate about making ice cream because you can taste all the love they put into it. I tried multiple flavors but the Honey Lavender stole my heart. It was perfectly balanced and not overly sweet. I would go back everyday to try all the flavors if I could! Absolutely worth the wait.

text: ¡Delicioso! Soy adicto al dulce. Este lugar cumplió mis expectativas. Pedí un helado con waffle. ¡Pralinas y crema! El estacionamiento es fácil y el servicio fue rápido. ¡Delicioso!
text_en: Delicious! I’m addicted to sweets. This place met my expectations. I ordered a waffle ice cream. Pralines and cream! The parking is easy, and service was quick. Delicious!
original: Delicious! I have a sweet tooth! This place definitely delivered. I got the waffle cone sundae! Pralines & Cream! Parking is easy and service was quick! Yummy

text: Minha filha e eu fomos durante o período de inauguração, em um domingo. Foi a nossa primeira vez. Apesar de estar movimentado, tudo funcionou bem e as filas foram relativamente rápidas. A única coisa que comprometeu a experiência foram os clientes desatentos. Eles constantemente bloqueavam o caminho dos funcionários que tentavam levar pães e doces frescos, ou saíam da fila (em vez de esperar até chegarem à área) para pegar pães e doces, dificultando a situação para todos. Também havia aqueles que começavam a pegar diretamente das bandejas dos funcionários enquanto passavam. Que falta de educação! Apesar de tudo isso, os funcionários permaneceram profissionais, amigáveis e prestativos. Tudo o que pedimos estava delicioso! Os pães e os doces eram gostosos e macios. O chá com leite estava bom e suave, com a quantidade certa de açúcar. Com certeza, um lugar que frequentaremos com frequência :) No geral, uma ótima padaria asiática que cumpre o que promete.
text_en: My daughter and I went during the opening period, on a Sunday. It was our first time there. Although it was busy, everything worked well, and the lines moved relatively quickly. The only thing that ruined the experience were the careless customers. They constantly blocked the way for staff who tried to bring fresh bread and sweets, or left their lines (instead of waiting until they reached the area) to pick up bread and sweets themselves, making things difficult for everyone. There were also those who started taking items directly from the staff’s trays as they passed by. What a lack of courtesy! Despite all this, the staff remained professional, friendly, and helpful. Everything we ordered was delicious! The bread and sweets were tasty and soft. The tea with milk was good and smooth, with just the right amount of sugar. Definitely a place we will visit often :) Overall, a great Asian bakery that lives up to its promises.
original: My daughter & I stopped by on a Sunday during their soft opening. It was our first time. Even though it was busy things went smoothly and lines went fairly quick. The only thing that ruined it were inconsiderate customers. They would constantly block the way of staff trying to bring out fresh bread & pastries or would get out of line (instead of waiting until they reached that area) to get bread & pastries making it difficult and squishy for everyone. There were also those who would start grabbing from staff trays as they walked by. So rude! Despite all of that, staff remained professional, friendly and helpful. Everything that we ordered was delicious! Breads & pastries were nice & soft. Milk tea was nice and mild with just the right amount of sweetness. Definitely a place we will visit often :) Overall a great asian bakery that lives up to the hype.

text: Gostaria de começar dizendo que a qualidade do sorvete deles é boa, no entanto, liguei para perguntar se tinham um produto que não estavam disponivel há meses, e o dono/gerente respondeu que não colocaria algo à venda se não tivesse em estoque. No entanto, já visitei este lugar antes, e estava anunciado como se tivessem disponível, apenas para descobrir que não tinham, devido a problemas de fornecimento. Em resumo: ele foi rude, não profissional e, francamente, um indivíduo desagradável! Nunca mais frequentarei este estabelecimento!
text_en: I would like to start by saying that the quality of their ice cream is good. However, I called to ask if they had a product that hadn’t been available for months. The owner/management replied that they wouldn’t sell anything if it wasn’t in stock. But I’ve been to this place before, and it was advertised as being available. Only to find out that it wasn’t, due to supply issues. In short: he was rude, unprofessional, and frankly, an unpleasant person! I will never visit this store again!
original: Let me start by saying that the quality of their ice cream is good, however, I called to ask if they had a product that they've been out of for months and the owner/manager responds that he wouldn't put something up if he didn't have it. However, I've come here before, and it was posted as if I they had it in stock, only to find out that they didn't have it due to supply issues. Bottom line: he was rude, unprofessional and quite frankly a jerk! I will never patronize this business again!

text: ¿Puedo dar 3.5 estrellas? Los productos horneados eran decentes. Compramos una gran cantidad de galletas y algunos pasteles para el desayuno. Diría que los pasteles para el desayuno que adquirimos, una tartaleta de manzana y algún tipo de pastel de mantequilla y limón, eran realmente muy buenos. Si tuviera que calificar este lugar solo por la calidad de esas dos cosas, diría que son 5 estrellas sin dudarlo. También probamos otro tipo de galleta con avellanas, y para mí simplemente estuvo bien. Lo peor de este lugar son el precio, el servicio poco amable y, en menor medida, la confusión general. Al llegar, había dos colas muy largas, así que ¿cuál debemos elegir? Nadie parecía saberlo. Resulta que una era para hacer la orden y la otra para pagar. No es un proceso muy intuitivo, ya que la cola para pagar parecía estar claramente señalizada como el punto de inicio. ¡Necesitan poner algunas señales! El servicio fue relativamente rápido, pero los empleados no fueron muy amables. Estábamos comprando cosas para nosotros mismos y para otra persona, así que pedimos cajas separadas. Sí, eso no pareció funcionar muy bien con la persona que atendía. Tenía una expresión de molestia en la cara. De hecho, esa misma expresión de molestia la tenían todos los trabajadores. Y, por último, el precio. ¡Increíble! Al final, probablemente fue nuestra culpa haber comprado demasiadas galletas, pero en general, gastamos 50 dólares en unos pocos pasteles, una galleta y quizás una bolsa de galletas, lo que en un entorno donde los precios son normalmente altos, todavía serían solo 20 dólares. Si pudiera comprar los pasteles para el desayuno (5 dólares cada uno) sin tener que esperar en la cola, lo haría. Por otro lado, definitivamente estoy interesado en probar el restaurante Buddy V's, también de Carlo.
text_en: Can I give it 3.5 stars? The baked products were decent. We bought a large amount of cookies and some breakfast pastries. I would say that the breakfast pastries we got—an apple tart and some butter-lime pastries—were really good. If I had to rate this place only based on the quality of those two items, I would definitely give it 5 stars. We also tried another type of cookie with walnuts; for me, it was just okay. The worst aspects of this place are the prices, the unhelpful service, and, to a lesser extent, the overall confusion. When we arrived, there were two very long lines, so which one should we choose? No one seemed to know. It turned out that one line was for placing orders, and the other was for paying. It’s not very intuitive, as the payment line seemed clearly marked as the starting point. They need to put some signs! The service was relatively quick, but the staff weren’t very friendly. We were buying things for ourselves and for someone else, so we asked for separate boxes. Yes, that didn’t seem to work well with the person who served us. They had a annoyed expression on their face. In fact, everyone at the restaurant had that same annoyed look. And finally, the prices… unbelievable! In the end, maybe it was our fault for buying too many cookies, but overall, we spent $50 on just a few pastries, one cookie, and maybe a bag of cookies. In a place where prices are usually high, that would be only about $20. If I could buy the breakfast pastries (5 dollars each) without having to wait in line, I would do it. On the other hand, I’m definitely interested in trying Buddy V’s restaurant, also owned by Carlo.
original: Can I put 3.5 stars? The baked goods were decent. We got a whole bunch of biscotti and some miscellaneous breakfast pastries. I would say that the breakfast pastries we got, an apple turnover and some sort of lemon butter crumb pastry were both extremely good. If I was rating this place just on the quality of those two things, i would say 5 stars all the way. We tried another kind of cookie thing with hazelnut on it, and it was just okay for me. The really bad part about this place, the price, gruff service, and to a lesser extent, the confusion of the madness. Walking up, there were two huge lines, so which one do we get in? Nobody had a clue. Turns out, one was the line to order, and one line was to pay. Not a very intuitive process, since the line to pay looked like it was properly roped off as if it were the starting point. Get some signs! Service was relatively quick, but they sure weren't very nice. We were buying stuff for ourselves and stuff for someone else, so we asked for separate boxes. Yea, that didn't seem to go very well with the person taking the order. Annoyed look on her face. Actually, that annoyed look was on all the workers faces. And finally, the price. Wow! At the end of the day, it was probably our fault that we bought too much biscotti, but all in all we spent $50 for a couple pastries, a cookie, and maybe a bag of biscotti that in a normally overpriced environment (if that makes sense) would still only be $20. If I could get the breakfast pastries ($5 each) without waiting in line, I would do it. Unrelated, I am definitely interested in trying the Buddy V's restaurant, also by Carlo.

text: La experiencia en este lugar fue un poco contradictoria. Pedimos un plato de langosta y estaba increíble. Ligeros, crujientes y con un relleno delicioso. En cambio, los cannolis eran prácticamente incomibles. La crema que contenían era muy arenosa y la masa del cannoli estaba lejos de ser crujiente. Cada uno probó una pequeña porción y el resto lo tiramos. He probado cannolis mucho mejores y también más económicos.
text_en: The experience at this place was a bit contradictory. We ordered a plate of lobster, and it was incredible—light, crispy, and with a delicious filling. On the other hand, the cannoli were practically inedible. The cream they contained was very gritty, and the dough of the cannoli was far from crispy. Each of us tried a small portion, and we threw the rest away. I’ve tried much better and more affordable cannoli elsewhere.
original: A bit of a mixed bag from this place. We had one of the lobster tails and it was amazing. Light and crispy with a delicious filling. The cannoli on the other hand was virtually inedible. The cream inside was very grainy and the cannoli shell was far from crisp. We each tried one small bite and threw the rest away. Have had far better cannolis and cheaper ones too.

text: Don't come here unless you want to make it a regular stop. The staff is friendly and attentive. They also explained the menu as well as how the ice cream is made. I tasted a few flavors and ended up getting Horchata as well as the "Fat Elvis" flavor , which was peanut butter, banana, and bacon which I loved. They are dog friendly and even have ice cream for them!
text_en: Don't come here unless you want to make it a regular stop. The staff is friendly and attentive. They also explained the menu as well as how the ice cream is made. I tasted a few flavors and ended up getting Horchata as well as the "Fat Elvis" flavor , which was peanut butter, banana, and bacon which I loved. They are dog friendly and even have ice cream for them!

text: A fila tinha cerca de 25 pessoas. O atendimento foi rápido! Eles oferecem uma variedade de doces e sobremesas. Pedimos um tiramisu, e o creme de mascarpone estava delicioso. Cremoso e com a doçura perfeita. Também pedimos outra sobremesa com uma bolinha de chocolate sobre um biscoito – aprovado pelas crianças. O café também estava bom. Eles servem café Lavazza, o que agrada aos apreciadores de café.
text_en: There were about 25 people in line. The service was quick! They offer a variety of desserts and sweets. We ordered a tiramisu, and the mascarpone cream was delicious—creamy and with the perfect sweetness. We also ordered another dessert with a chocolate ball on a biscuit; the children loved it. The coffee was also good. They serve Lavazza coffee, which is appreciated by coffee lovers.
original: Line was about 25 people long. It went fast! They have a variety of pastries and desserts to choose from. We got a tiramisu where the mascarpone tasted great. Creamy and just the right amount of sweetness. Got another dessert with chocolate ball over a cookie - toddler approved. The coffee was good. They serve lavazza coffee, fyi for coffee connoisseurs.

text: A macaron ice cream sandwich with a Fluff It marshmallow on top? Yes please! There are so many options too, including some very unique ones such as Fruity Pebbles macarons and Netflix and Chill ice cream. The cookie cup consists of two large macarons of your choice (They had strawberry, vanilla, Fruity Pebbles, and red velvet when I was here), four scoops of ice cream, with a marshmallow that is bruleed with a torch in front of you. We got ours with Fruity Pebbles and red velvet macarons, blueberry muffin and white chocolate raspberry ice cream. The entire cup was a beautiful sugary sight to behold. We dug in with gusto. I loved the chewy texture of the macaron with the creamy smooth ice cream and fluffy pillowy marshmallow with caramelized crust. We were definitely satisfied and full after sharing it. The cost was $6.25 pre-tax. Service was very friendly and warm and everyone seemed very happy to be working here. I would be too if I were surrounded with all this delicious bounty! The location is definitely a bit odd as it's hidden in the back of a shopping plaza right next to a residential area. Thanks to Yelp though we were able to indulge in a unique and tasty collaborative dessert we probably wouldn't have been able to see from the street. I'll definitely be back again for more delicious dessert.
text_en: A macaron ice cream sandwich with a Fluff It marshmallow on top? Yes please! There are so many options too, including some very unique ones such as Fruity Pebbles macarons and Netflix and Chill ice cream. The cookie cup consists of two large macarons of your choice (They had strawberry, vanilla, Fruity Pebbles, and red velvet when I was here), four scoops of ice cream, with a marshmallow that is bruleed with a torch in front of you. We got ours with Fruity Pebbles and red velvet macarons, blueberry muffin and white chocolate raspberry ice cream. The entire cup was a beautiful sugary sight to behold. We dug in with gusto. I loved the chewy texture of the macaron with the creamy smooth ice cream and fluffy pillowy marshmallow with caramelized crust. We were definitely satisfied and full after sharing it. The cost was $6.25 pre-tax. Service was very friendly and warm and everyone seemed very happy to be working here. I would be too if I were surrounded with all this delicious bounty! The location is definitely a bit odd as it's hidden in the back of a shopping plaza right next to a residential area. Thanks to Yelp though we were able to indulge in a unique and tasty collaborative dessert we probably wouldn't have been able to see from the street. I'll definitely be back again for more delicious dessert.

text: Everything LOOKED delicious...I got the strawberry shortcake. The only good thing on there was the strawberries and the whip cream. Cake was dry. My friend got the cheesecake and he needed water to wash it down because it was dry. How can cheesecake be dry?? My other friend got a cupcake and she also said it was dry. All the cakes are the same batter. Not worth the money. We ended up finding a fountain to sit by since there were only 4 stools in the place.
text_en: Everything LOOKED delicious...I got the strawberry shortcake. The only good thing on there was the strawberries and the whip cream. Cake was dry. My friend got the cheesecake and he needed water to wash it down because it was dry. How can cheesecake be dry?? My other friend got a cupcake and she also said it was dry. All the cakes are the same batter. Not worth the money. We ended up finding a fountain to sit by since there were only 4 stools in the place.

text: Eu sou apaixonado por pão, e este é o melhor pão que encontrei no lado leste. Talvez em toda Madison. Ou até mesmo no estado inteiro. Os croissants são divinos. E se você procura algo um pouco menos calórico, mas ainda assim delicioso, o bolo de maçã é uma ótima opção.
text_en: I’m obsessed with bread, and this is the best bread I’ve found in the east side. Maybe even throughout all of Madison. Or maybe across the entire state. The croissants are amazing. And if you’re looking for something slightly less calorie-dense but still delicious, apple pie is a great option.
original: I am a bread freak, and this is the best bread on the east side. Maybe all of Madison. Perhaps the entire state. The croissants are divine. And if you want something not-quite-so-fattening-er-decadent, the apple cake is a splendid little thing to try.

text: Ver las opciones en la vitrina de la panadería parece delicioso. Lo que me decepcionó fue que el menú de café es limitado (solo café de filtro). Y aunque el croissant con queso gruyere me pareció excelente, los demás pasteles y productos horneados que compramos (una selección de 6 artículos diferentes) no estuvieron a la altura. Tanto los salados como los dulces (excepto por ese delicioso croissant con queso gruyere) fueron simplemente aceptables. Volveré por ese croissant, pero probablemente evitaré los otros muffins, panes y galletas, etc.
text_en: It seems delicious to see the options in the bakery display. What disappointed me was that the coffee menu is limited—just filter coffee. Although the Gruyère croissant seemed excellent, the other pastries and baked goods we bought (a selection of 6 different items) were not up to par. Both savory and sweet items (except for that delicious Gruyère croissant) were just acceptable. I will go back for that croissant, but I probably won’t try the other muffins, breads, and cookies, etc.
original: Walking in the bakery display looks delicious. Disappointing for me was that the coffee menu is lacking (drip coffee only). And while I thought the gruyere croissant was awesome, the rest of the pastries and baked goods we bought (an assortment of 6 other items) left a little to be desired. Both savory and sweet (outside of the aforementioned delicious gruyere croissant) were just ok. I'll be back for that croissant, but will probably skip the other muffins, breads, cookies, etc.

text: Prós: Sobremesas deliciosas (bolos/doces), café, chá, etc. Os biscoitos, dependendo do que você escolher, são bons, mas não são os melhores que já experimentei. Contras: Geralmente muito cheio (e difícil se locomover por dentro devido ao espaço), e o sistema de números com muitas pessoas ao redor me deixa um pouco ansioso. No entanto, depois de algumas visitas, você se acostuma com isso. Eu sempre verifico todas as opções de sobremesas para estar preparado quando for minha vez.
text_en: Pros: Delicious desserts (cakes/desserts), coffee, tea, etc. The cookies are good, depending on what you choose, but they’re not the best I’ve ever tried. Cons: It’s usually very crowded (and hard to move around inside due to the space), and the number system with many people around makes me a little anxious. However, after a few visits, you get used to it. I always check all the dessert options so I’m ready when it’s my turn.
original: Pros: Delicious desserts (cakes/pastries), coffee, tea, etc. Cookies, depending on what you get, are good but not the best I've had. Cons: Always pretty packed (and hard to get around inside due to space), and the number system with lots of people all around makes me a bit anxious. However, once you've been here a few times, you get used to it. I just make sure to look at all of the desserts and so that I am ready to choose when called.

text: Desculpe, amigo! Nós te amamos! Vimos todos os seus programas e sentimos que o conhecemos e sua família. Mas o atendimento ao cliente na sua padaria em Las Vegas é o pior! Esperamos pacientemente para receber nossos doces. Meus filhos comeram seus cupcakes e biscoitos! Eu pedi os éclairs, que são deliciosos! Meu marido pediu seus famosos cannolis e, quando abrimos a encomenda, os cannolis estavam faltando. Quando voltamos, a atendente não acreditou em nós. Mostramos a ordem, sem os biscoitos e cupcakes que meus filhos já haviam comido. Fomos tratados como criminosos. Depois de tanta discussão e mostrando nosso comprovante, e com muitos olhares de desaprovação, finalmente recebemos os cannolis. Os cannolis mais ruins que já comemos em nossas vidas. Não voltaremos à unidade em Las Vegas.
text_en: Sorry, friend! We love you! We’ve watched all your programs and feel like we know you and your family. But the customer service at your bakery in Las Vegas is terrible! We waited patiently for our desserts. My children ate your cupcakes and biscuits! I ordered the éclairs, which were delicious! My husband ordered your famous cannoli, but when we opened the order, the cannoli were missing. When we returned, the staff didn’t believe us. We showed them the receipt, without the biscuits and cupcakes that my children had already eaten. We were treated like criminals. After much arguing and showing our proof, and with many disapproving looks, we finally got the cannoli. The worst cannoli we’ve ever eaten in our lives. We won’t go back to that unit in Las Vegas.
original: Sorry Buddy! We love you! We have watched all your shows and feel like we know you and your family. But customer service at you Bakery in Las Vegas is the worst! We waited patiently to get our treats. My kids had your cupcakes and cookies! I asked for the eclairs which all are delicious! My husband order your famous cannoli and when we open our order the cannoli were missing. When we went back, the girl who ring me didn't believe me. We showed them the order minus the cookies and cupcakes my kids had already eaten. We were treated like criminals. After so much back and forth and showing our receipt and many dirty looks we got the cannolis. The most bitter cannolis we have eaten in our lives. Not going back to the Vegas location.

text: Pedí el helado doble y, ¡vaya, había muchísimo helado! Era increíblemente delicioso. Paradójicamente, no había opción de helado de chocolate negro, así que opté por un doble de helado de café con trozos de chocolate. ¡Estaba genial, pero demasiado helado para una persona! Debería haber pedido el helado individual. ¡Una excelente adición al distrito de entretenimiento The LINQ!
text_en: I ordered a double ice cream cone, and wow, there was so much ice cream! It was incredibly delicious. Ironically, there were no black chocolate ice creams available, so I chose a double coffee ice cream with chocolate chunks. It was great, but too much ice cream for one person! I should have ordered individual ice creams instead. An excellent addition to The LINQ entertainment district!
original: Got the double Ice Cream and man it was a lot of ice cream, so incredibly good. Ironically no dark chocolate ice cream choice so I went with a double of Espresso Chip and Chocolate. Dang, super good but too much ice cream for one person. Should have gone with the single. GREAT Addition to The LINQ entertainment district.

text: Una panadería italiana auténtica con un menú de almuerzo muy sabroso (aunque limitado). Todo lo que hay en las vitrinas de la panadería es delicioso, así que ¡aprovecha! Cada vez que vengo, compro una caja entera de productos horneados porque son tan buenos. El personal es amable, aunque no precisamente rápido, como se ha mencionado antes (la persona que prepara los pedidos parece encargarse de todo, por lo que los pedidos urgentes o complejos ralentizan el servicio). Y el aparcamiento es complicado en Little Italy, así que prepárate mentalmente para ello. A pesar de esto, cualquier vez que tengo una tarde libre, encuentro una excusa para venir a este lugar. ¡Gracias, Presti's!
text_en: A genuine Italian bakery with a very delicious (though limited) lunch menu. Everything in the bakery’s displays is delicious, so don’t miss out! Every time I visit, I buy a whole box of baked goods because they are so good. The staff are friendly, though not exactly fast, as mentioned earlier (the person who handles orders seems to take care of everything, which slows down service for urgent or complex orders). And parking is tricky in Little Italy, so be prepared for that. Still, whenever I have a free afternoon, I find an excuse to come here. Thank you, Presti’s!
original: A quintessential Italian bakery with a very tasty (albeit limited) lunch menu. Everything in the bakery cases is delicious, so just go hog-wild. Everytime I come here, I buy an entire box of baked items because they're just that good. The staff are friendly, although not admittedly speedy as has been mentioned before (the person preparing your stuff kind of does everything themselves, so heated orders or complex orders slow down the line). And parking is Little Italy, so mentally prepare for that. That said, any time I have a free afternoon, I find any reason that I can to come by this place. Thanks, Presti's!

text: Estaba muy decepcionado de que no nos informaran con antelación de que no tenían cannoli.
text_en: I was very disappointed that they didn’t inform us in advance that they wouldn’t have cannoli.
original: Very upset that they didn't let's us know ahead of Time that they where out of cannoli !

text: Presti's is one of my favorite places in Cleveland! I went here all the time when I lived in little Italy. They have a huge variety of pastries ranging from m&ms cookies to fancy miniature cheesecakes. They also serve a variety of lunch type foods, like sandwiches, stromboli and pizza by the slice. OH, and of course there's the gelato! So yummy! There really is something for everyone here. Word of warning though, they are usually quite busy! Make sure to take a number before looking at all those pastries. :)
text_en: Presti's is one of my favorite places in Cleveland! I went here all the time when I lived in little Italy. They have a huge variety of pastries ranging from m&ms cookies to fancy miniature cheesecakes. They also serve a variety of lunch type foods, like sandwiches, stromboli and pizza by the slice. OH, and of course there's the gelato! So yummy! There really is something for everyone here. Word of warning though, they are usually quite busy! Make sure to take a number before looking at all those pastries. :)

text: Después de escuchar tantas cosas sobre este lugar, y siendo una persona que adora los dulces, realmente quería que me gustara. Está abierto las 24 horas y el brownie con caramelo y sal es bastante bueno. Sin embargo, después de tres visitas, he probado varios pasteles y postres, y la verdad es que son, como mucho, "aceptables", y en el peor de los casos, son insípidos y pesados. Los postres están fríos, y algunos de ellos, debido a esto, no son tan buenos como deberían ser, como por ejemplo, cualquier cosa que se supone que sea crujiente. La decoración encantadora no compensa los postres mediocres. Todavía no he probado sus opciones para el almuerzo o el desayuno, así que quizás esto es lo que mantiene a otros críticos tan entusiasmados.
text_en: After hearing so much about this place, and being someone who loves desserts, I really hoped it would be good to me. It’s open 24 hours, and the brownie with caramel and salt is quite good. However, after three visits, I’ve tried several pastries and desserts, and in reality, they’re at best “acceptable” – at worst, they’re bland and heavy. The desserts are cold, and some of them, due to this, aren’t as good as they could be, like anything that’s supposed to be crunchy. The lovely décor doesn’t make up for the mediocre desserts. I haven’t yet tried their lunch or breakfast options, so maybe that’s what keeps other critics so enthusiastic.
original: Having heard so much about it, and being a complete sugar-head, I REALLY wanted to like this place. It's open 24 hours and the caramel salted brownie is quite good. But, after 3 visits, I have tried several pastries and cakes and they are just ok at best and at worst kind of tasteless and spongy/heavy. The desserts are chilled and for some of them it makes them worse for the wear-- such as anything that is supposed to be flaky. Cute decor does not make up for mediocre sweets. I have yet to try their lunch/breakfast offerings, so maybe this is what keeps other reviewers so enthused.

text: Tal vez los pasteles sean buenos, pero el servicio es pésimo, el café es malo y el servicio sigue siendo pésimo. Además, está en medio de la nada.
text_en: Maybe the pastries are good, but the service is terrible, the coffee is bad, and the service remains terrible. Moreover, it’s in the middle of nothingness.
original: maybe the pastries are good but the service is shit, the coffee sucks and the service is shit. and its in the middle of nowhere.

text: I had never heard of Milk Bar until it was suggested to me on social media. I'm apparently easily influenced when it comes to food ads, because I started thinking about their cake often! I considered ordering it to be shipped from New York, but I'm actually glad I didn't spend the money because what I tried at the Vegas location wasn't the greatest. I got a slice of birthday cake, which was straight out of the fridge. Do people like cold cake? I really dislike it. I debated letting it sit out for a while, but decided to just go for it. It tasted like week old refrigerated cake, heavy and overly moist. I did appreciate the icing though, it melted in my mouth! I wasn't able to eat more than 1/4 of the cake slice, but I did eat a bunch of icing because it was pretty good. I'd love to try a fresh slice of their birthday cake! For $14, I just expected so much more. I left feeling pretty disappointed.

I considered ordering it to be shipped from New York, but I'm actually glad I didn't spend the money because what I tried at the Vegas location wasn't the greatest.
