I wasn't able to eat more than 1/4 of the cake slice, but I did eat a bunch of icing because it was pretty good. I'd love to try a fresh slice of their birthday cake! For $14, I just expected so much more. I left feeling pretty disappointed.

text: Finalmente tuve la oportunidad de probar este "excelente" helado durante el recorrido de la heladería Jeni's. Cuatro de nosotros estuvimos en la fila durante 30 minutos, y valió la pena probar una porción gratuita del helado de mantequilla de avellanas, frambuesas, pastel de mantequilla pegajosa y chocolate oscuro. Todos eran ricos y deliciosos. Definitivamente, iré al South End para probar los otros sabores.
text_en: Finally, I got the chance to try this “excellent” ice cream while visiting Jeni’s Ice Cream Store. Four of us waited in line for 30 minutes, and it was worth trying a free sample of hazelnut buttercream, raspberry, sticky butter cream, and dark chocolate ice cream. All of them were rich and delicious. Definitely, I’ll go to South End to try the other flavors.
original: I was finally able to try this 'splendid' ice cream during Jeni's ice cream truck tour. Four of us stood in line for 30 minutes and it was worth it to try a free scoop of the Brown Butter Almond Brittle, Brambleberry Cobbler, Gooey Butter Cake and Darkest Chocolate. All were rich and delicious. I will definitely make my way to South End to try the other flavors.

text: Dulces y golosinas muy buenas. Un lugar muy relajado.
text_en: Sweet and delicious treats. A very relaxing place.
original: Very good sweets and treat. Very laid back place

text: DELICIOSO, mas muito caro para o que oferece. Adorei as opções e estou muito feliz por ter pedido o sorvete com marshmallow e macaron. No entanto, acho que os macarons não são tão bons quanto outros que já experimentei, e, considerando o preço, acredito que cada componente deveria ser delicioso por si só. De novo, estou muito feliz por ter experimentado isso, e o marshmallow é essencial!
text_en: Delicious, but very expensive for what it offers. I loved all the options, and I’m very happy that I ordered the ice cream with marshmallows and macarons. However, I think the macarons aren’t as good as those I’ve tried before. Considering the price, I believe each component should be delicious on its own. Again, I’m very happy that I tried this, and the marshmallows are essential!
original: DELICIOUS but too expensive for what it was to get full stars. I loved the options and I'm definitely happy I ordered the ice cream with the marshmallow and macaroon. However, I feel like the macaroons aren't as great as other macaroons I've had and for the price, I think each component should be delicious on its own. Again, I'm still super happy I tried this out and the marshmallow is a MUST!

text: Enquanto continuava minha busca pelo macaron perfeito, cheguei a Las Vegas para experimentar aqueles doces do tamanho de uma palma que tenho visto no Yelp. Como sou bastante exigente, sempre compro dois macarons primeiro para testá-los. A Bouchon Bakery foi um sucesso... experimentei o caramelo salgado com framboesa, e acabei comprando mais 5 (recebi o sexto de graça). Os macarons (3,50 dólares cada) são leves, mas com uma textura agradável, exatamente como eu gosto. O recheio de caramelo salgado também tem uma textura interessante, o que eu gosto, enquanto a framboesa e os demais tinham um recheio com a textura normal. Também experimentamos os sabores de chocolate e pistache, mas acho que não os pediria novamente, pois não tinham muito sabor. Fui até o Aria para ver os macarons da Jean Philippe, mas eles só vendiam em caixas pré-embaladas de 6 unidades. Além disso, eram muito pequenos. Acabei não me interessando, se não posso experimentar um ou dois primeiro, não compro... sim, sou um pouco exigente. Acho que você vai gostar muito na Bouchon, o atendimento foi atencioso e prestativo... mas, o mais importante, os macarons foram divinos!
text_en: While continuing my search for the perfect macaron, I ended up in Las Vegas to try those tiny macarons the size of a palm leaf that I’ve seen on Yelp. Being quite demanding, I always buy two macarons first to try them out. Bouchon Bakery was a success… I tried the salty caramel with strawberry filling, and ended up buying five more (the sixth one was given away for free). The macarons (costing $3.50 each) are light but have a pleasant texture, just as I like them. The salty caramel filling also has an interesting texture, which I enjoy, while the strawberry and other fillings had a normal texture. We also tried the chocolate and pistachio flavors, but I don’t think I would order them again, because they didn’t have much flavor. I went to Aria to see the macarons from Jean Philippe, but they were only available in pre-packaged boxes of 6 pieces. Plus, they were very small. I wasn’t interested at all; if I can’t try one or two first, I don’t buy anything… yes, I’m quite demanding. I think you’ll really like them at Bouchon—the service was attentive and helpful… but most importantly, the macarons were amazing!
original: While continuing my search for the ultimate macaron, I've come to Vegas to taste those palm sized treats I've been seeing on yelp. Since I am such a snob, I always buy 2 macarons first to test them. Bouchon Bakery passed with flying colors...tried the salted caramel and raspberry, eventually bought 5 more (got the 6th FREE). The macarons ($3.50 ea) are light yet chewy, just the way I like them. The salted caramel filling is a bit chewy too which I like, the raspberry and the rest had the normal frosting type filling. We also tried the chocolate and pistachio flavors but don't think I'd order them again because there was not enough flavor in them. Went to the Aria to check out the macs at Jean Philippe but they only sold them in pre-packaged boxes of 6. They were also very tiny in size. Didn't even bother, if I can't taste one or two first, I don't partake...yes I am a snob. Think you'll be happy at Bouchon, the service was kind and helpful...but more importantly, the macs were divine!

text: You're forewarned to get to the bakery it is a mission from the Venetian guest parking lot. But the walk is worth it. We ordered a cake with Cristina for my mother in law and it came out fantastic! We got some goodies while there and all in all FRESH, DELICIOUS & perfectly sized for us! Major thank yous to Cristina she went above and beyond for us it is greatly appreciated! Thank you Cristina for making the cake even better than we thought! Definitely worth taking a trip into the Venetian for Carlos Bakery Team!
text_en: You're forewarned to get to the bakery it is a mission from the Venetian guest parking lot. But the walk is worth it. We ordered a cake with Cristina for my mother in law and it came out fantastic! We got some goodies while there and all in all FRESH, DELICIOUS & perfectly sized for us! Major thank yous to Cristina she went above and beyond for us it is greatly appreciated! Thank you Cristina for making the cake even better than we thought! Definitely worth taking a trip into the Venetian for Carlos Bakery Team!

text: Tenía un helado de vainilla con nueces y cubierto con la crema de caramelo casera. ¡Estaba increíble! He comido en Windsor muchas veces, y este sería un final perfecto para una excelente comida. Pedí dos porciones como postre por la tarde, y la próxima vez podría pedir tres.
text_en: I had a vanilla ice cream with nuts, covered with homemade caramel cream. It was incredible! I’ve eaten in Windsor many times, and this would be the perfect end to an excellent meal. I ordered two servings as dessert in the afternoon, and next time I might order three.
original: Had the Vanilla sprinkled w/ walnuts and drizzled w/ the home made Carmel.. It was incredible! Have eaten at Windsor many times, this would be a very nice finish to a great meal! Had two scoops as an afternoon dessert may consider getting three next time!

text: Ótima atmosfera, pratos deliciosos. Eu pedi o frango e estava excelente! Os outros à minha mesa pediram bife e presunto com queijo. Foi uma experiência muito agradável. Minha única reclamação é que as mesas estão muito próximas, e a pessoa atrás de mim batia constantemente na minha cadeira ou braço.
text_en: Great atmosphere, delicious dishes. I ordered chicken, and it was excellent! The people at my table ordered steak and prosciutto with cheese. It was a very pleasant experience. My only complaint is that the tables are too close together, and the person behind me kept knocking on my chair or arm constantly.
original: Great atmosphere, amazing dishes. I had the chicken & it was fabulous! Others at my table had steak & the ham & cheese. It was quite the treat. My only complaint is that the tables are so packed in that the man behind me kept hitting me with his chair or arm or back.

text: Este lugar ficava a uma curta distância a pé do meu hotel, então precisei parar para dar uma olhada. Com certeza recomendaria para qualquer pessoa que visite a região! Comprei 6 tipos diferentes de donuts, mas o de creme brulee foi o meu preferido! O de "butterbeer" também era muito charmoso! Adoraria voltar na próxima vez que estiver em Las Vegas!
text_en: This place was just a short walk from my hotel, so I had to stop by and take a look. I definitely would recommend it to anyone who visits the area! I bought 6 different types of donuts, but the cream cheese one was my favorite! The “butterbeer” donut also was very charming! I would love to come back next time I’m in Las Vegas!
original: This place was walking distance from my hotel so had to stop and check it out. Definitely would recommend to anyone visiting the area! Picked up 6 different kinds of donuts but the creme brulee one was my favorite! The butterbeer one was adorable! Would love to stop by again next time I'm in Vegas!

text: Great customer service! The workers here were very nice. The donuts are soft and have unique flavors. This will be added to the lists of musts while in vegas.
text_en: Great customer service! The workers here were very nice. The donuts are soft and have unique flavors. This will be added to the lists of musts while in vegas.

text: Obtuvimos un número de un dispensador, similar al que se encuentra en la oficina de licencias, y nos sentamos discretamente detrás de la multitud hambrienta que acudió a esta panadería el sábado por la noche. El proceso tomó aproximadamente 10-15 minutos, lo cual no está mal para ese tipo de ambiente. Nos fuimos con nuestro delicioso tiramisú y otros productos horneados. En cuanto al tiramisú, este fue uno de los más ligeros, esponjosos y delicados que he probado. Diría que está entre los mejores que he probado. Es muy fácil de comer. Este es un lugar excelente para disfrutar de un postre, e incluso, un paraíso si te gusta el dulce.
text_en: We got a number from the dispenser, similar to the one in the licensing office. We sat quietly behind the hungry crowd who came to this bakery on Saturday night. The process took about 10–15 minutes, which is not bad for such a situation. We left with our delicious tiramisu and other baked goods. As for the tiramisu, it was one of the lightest, fluffiest, and most delicate ones I’ve ever tasted. I would say it’s among the best I’ve ever had. It’s very easy to eat. This is an excellent place to enjoy a dessert—and even a paradise if you like sweet things.
original: We took a number from a number dispenser not unlike one that you'd find in your local license bureau and neatly shuffled behind the hungry Saturday night crowd that flocked to this bakery. It took maybe 10-15 minutes total, which is not bad for THAT kind of crowd. We went home with our precious Tiramisu and other baked goods. As far as Tiramisus go, this one was among the airiest, fluffiest and most delicate ones I've tried. I'd say it's up there with the best I had. Easy to inhale. This is a great place for dessert and perhaps, paradise if you have a sweet tooth.

text: Demasiado inflado. Estaba muy decepcionado. El servicio fue regular, una de las empleadas fue amable, pero la otra no sonrió en absoluto. Los cupcakes no eran muy buenos. Probé el de tocino y arce, que estaba horrible, y ya había probado uno similar antes y me encantó. También probé el de red velvet, que estaba mejor.
text_en: It was overinflated. I was very disappointed. The service was average; one of the staff members was friendly, but the other didn’t smile at all. The cupcakes weren’t very good. I tried the bacon and maple one—it was awful. I had already tried a similar cupcake before, and I loved it. I also tried the red velvet one—it was better.
original: Over rated. I was very unimpressed. Service was ok, one lady was nice the other didn't smile at all. the cupcakes weren't that great. I Tried the maple bacon which was gross and I have had maple and bacon before and loved it. Also tried the red velvet which was better.

text: Sí, los postres son increíbles. Pero el café es terrible. Siempre vuelvo por los postres, pero nunca por el café. Esta noche, decidí probar el café de nuevo en su nueva ubicación. Y resultó ser un desastre. Eviten los cafés si no les gusta el café quemado.
text_en: Yes, the desserts are amazing. But the coffee is terrible. I always go back for the desserts, but never for the coffee. Tonight, I decided to try the coffee again at its new location. And it turned out to be a disaster. Avoid the cafes if you don’t like burnt coffee.
original: Yes the desserts are awesome! But THE COFFEE SUCKS. I always come back for desserts but never coffee. Tonight I gave the coffee a chance again at their new location. & they BURNED ALL OF MY INSIDES. Stay away from the lattes unless you enjoy burning coffee.

text: Un baño muy agradable y unisex, con un inodoro y un urinario. Tiene paredes de un rosa brillante y una iluminación tenue, lo que contribuye mucho a su ambiente. También hay un cuadro muy inspirador de Frida Kahlo sobre la importancia de ser uno mismo, que encaja con el ambiente del lugar. Otra elección de diseño interesante es la presencia de varias docenas de adornos reflectantes sobre el inodoro, lo que realmente me hizo reflexionar sobre mi lugar en el universo mientras iba al baño. Mi única queja es que había heces en el inodoro. Con un mantenimiento adecuado, sería un 5 sobre 5 estrellas.
text_en: A very pleasant and unisex bathroom, with a toilet and a urinal. The walls are bright pink, and the lighting is soft, which greatly enhances the atmosphere. There’s also a very inspiring painting by Frida Kahlo about the importance of being oneself, which fits well with the environment. Another interesting design feature is the dozens of reflective decorations on the toilet, which really made me think about my place in the universe while using the bathroom. My only complaint is that there were excrement particles in the toilet. With proper maintenance, it would be a 5 out of 5 stars.
original: Very nice unisex bathroom with a urinal as well as a toilet. It has bright pink walls and low lighting which adds a lot to it's atmosphere. They also have a very inspiring Frida Painting about being yourself which fits the atmosphere of the place. Also a very interesting design choice is that there are several dozen reflective ornaments above the toilet which really caused me to ponder my place in the universe while defecating. My only complaint is that there was specks of poop coating the bowl of the toilet. With proper maintenance this would be 5 out of 5 stars.

text: This review is solely for the cannolis. We did not try anything else at the bakery yet. But the cannolis were quite disappointing for how expensive they were and for such a well reviewed place. We will not be returning for those.
text_en: This review is solely for the cannolis. We did not try anything else at the bakery yet. But the cannolis were quite disappointing for how expensive they were and for such a well reviewed place. We will not be returning for those.

text: O Novel Ice Cream é, de fato, uma experiência única. Localizado em um estabelecimento charmoso, com um estilo de casa de campo, eles oferecem um pequeno espaço ao ar livre para desfrutar da sua criação. Possuem diversos acompanhamentos (incluindo o cereal favorito da infância), sabores de sorvete caseiros e a opção de colocar o sorvete em um sanduíche de sorvete com um donut (sim, você ouviu direito) ou com um biscoito vegano preso no copo. A equipe foi incrivelmente atenciosa e prestativa. Eles nos permitiram experimentar vários sabores antes de escolhermos nossas combinações. Eu pedi um sorvete de lavanda com mel e um biscoito crocante por cima, e o biscoito em si. Gostaria que tivessem outras opções de biscoitos, mas o biscoito estava bom (mais parecido com a textura de um biscoito doce). O sabor do sorvete que eu pedi era forte (não para todos), mas eu adoro lavanda em qualquer coisa! Se eu voltar a Phoenix, certamente procurarei o sorvete deste lugar. Um lugar divertido com opções originais!
text_en: Novel Ice Cream is truly a unique experience. Located in a charming establishment with a country-style atmosphere, they offer a small outdoor space where you can enjoy their ice cream. They have various toppings—including your favorite childhood cereal, homemade ice cream flavors, and the option to put ice cream on a sandwich with a donut (yes, you heard that right) or with a vegan cookie stuck in the cup. The staff was incredibly attentive and helpful. They allowed us to try several flavors before we chose our combinations. I ordered lavender ice cream with honey and a crispy cookie on top, plus the cookie itself. I would like to see more types of cookies, but the cookie was good—more like the texture of a sweet cookie. The flavor of the ice cream I ordered was strong (not for everyone), but I love lavender in anything! If I visit Phoenix again, I will definitely go back to this place’s ice cream. A fun place with original options!
original: Novel Ice Cream is indeed novel. Located in a cute cottage-like establishment, they have a small outdoor patio for enjoying your creation. They have multiple toppings (including your favorite childhood cereal), homemade fun ice cream flavors, and the option to put the ice cream into a donut ice cream sandwich (you heard me) or with a vegan sprinkle cookie stuck in your cup. The staff were incredibly nice and helpful. They let us sample multiple flavors before settling on our combinations. I got a lavender honey ice cream with cookie crisp on top and the cookie. I wish they had options of other cookies but the cookie was good (more like a sweet biscuit texture). The ice cream flavor I got was potent (not for everyone) but I love lavender in anything! If I find myself back in Phoenix I would definitely seek out ice cream from here. Such a fun place with original options!

text: Tudo o que experimentei nesta padaria é incrível!! Só gostaria que também tivessem um espaço com mesas para sentar dentro.
text_en: Everything I experienced in this bakery is incredible!! I just wish they had a space with tables where people could sit.
original: Everything I've tried at this Bakery is amazing!! I only wish they also had some seating area indoors.

text: Ahora entiendo cómo los franceses elaboran los croissants... más allá de las palabras sobre su sabor a mantequilla y su crujiente corteza, es imposible que una mano estadounidense, con un enfoque más práctico, logre crear algo tan delicado e intrincado. Con una técnica precisa, estos croissants se derretirán en la boca y llenarán el paladar con una ligera dulzura, que proviene naturalmente del gluten de la harina.
text_en: Now I understand how the French make croissants… Beyond the descriptions of their buttery taste and crisp crust, it’s impossible for an American hand, with a more practical approach, to create something so delicate and intricate. With precise techniques, these croissants melt in the mouth, filling the palate with a subtle sweetness that comes naturally from the gluten in the flour.
original: I now understand how the French do croissants...beyond buttery words and flakey crusts, there's no way a lugubrious American hand could mend such a delicate, intricate pastry. With a shale-like dissembling, these croissants will melt in the heat of your mouth and fill it with a slight sweetness that derives naturally from wheat gluten.

text: Antes, estaba en el Palazzo. Mi familia y yo comimos pasteles de Bouchon durante tres días seguidos. La canela era increíble y el croissant de fresas era irresistible. ¡La comida era fantástica!

text: Essas donuts são melhores do que as tradicionais. Você sabe, quando finalmente vê algo de bom no mundo, isso te inspira a viver a vida de uma forma mais otimista. Foi o que senti quando comi o donut de bolo de morango. O donut de bolo de blueberry também estava incrível. Eu recomendo muito, muito, muito, muito, muito, muito. Os donos também são muito simpáticos e acessíveis.
text_en: These donuts are better than the traditional ones. You know, when you finally see something good in the world, it inspires you to live life in a more optimistic way. That’s exactly what I felt when I ate the blueberry cake donut. The blueberry cake donut was also amazing. I highly recommend them—very, very highly. The owners are also very friendly and approachable.
original: These donuts are better than non-vegan donuts. You know when you finally see some goodness in the world and it inspires you to live your life a little more optimistically. That's what I felt when I bit into the strawberry shortcake donut. Their blueberry cake donut was also amazing. Would highly highly highly highly highly highly recommend. The owners are also very down to earth and lovely

text: Experimentei os macarons aqui quando me dei o prazer de comprar o pacote de seis unidades. Por US$ 17,50, tinha grandes expectativas, considerando a reputação do Bouchon e tudo mais. Os macarons são duas vezes maiores do que os que já experimentei antes, o que achei ótimo. Apesar do tamanho maior, o sabor e a textura não foram comprometidos. A parte cremosa não era muito doce e o biscoito era macio e não seco. Seria ótimo se o chef-chefe ou a equipe estivessem presentes na barraca no Venetian onde comprei, pois eu daria um "high-five" a todos eles por fazerem macarons tão deliciosos! É uma guloseima agradável e luxuosa, mas cara. Para mim, uma recompensa agradável para esperar no final de uma viagem típica e agitada em Las Vegas! Em seguida, vou realmente experimentar o restaurante Bouchon!
text_en: I tried the macarons here when I had the pleasure of buying the six-unit package. For $17.50, I had high expectations, considering Bouchon’s reputation and everything else. The macarons are twice the size of those I’ve tried before, which I found great. Despite their larger size, the taste and texture weren’t compromised. The creamy part wasn’t too sweet, and the cookie was soft and not dry. It would be great if the head chef or the team were present at the tent in Venice where I bought them, because I would give them a “high-five” for making such delicious macarons! It’s a pleasant and luxurious treat, but it’s expensive. For me, it’s a delightful reward to wait for at the end of a typical and busy trip in Las Vegas! Next, I’m really going to try out the Bouchon restaurant!
original: I tried the macarons here when I indulged myself and got the six pack. For $17.50, I had high expectations considering Bouchon's reputation and all. Their macarons are twice the size of macarons that I've tried before so I was kind of digging that. Despite their bigger size, the taste and flavor were not compromised. The cream wasn't too sweet and the cookie part was soft and not dry. It's too bad that the pastry chef leader or team weren't there at the kiosk at the Venetian where I got these because I'd give each person a high-five for making such damn good macarons! It's a nice luxurious but expensive treat. For me, a nice reward to look forward to eat at the end of a typical crazy Vegas trip! Next up, actually eating at Bouchon the restaurant itself!

text: I've been eyeing this place for a while. I finally made my way inside and the atmosphere was quaint and relaxed. The staff was also very friendly. I got the famous lemon lavender and a strawberry shortcake. I am not a fan of lemon desserts but both of these donuts were possibly the best donuts i've ever had. I am questioning if they are vegan because they are that good! Will definitely be coming back.

text: Um tesouro de Pittsburgh! A maionese de Carmel é a estrela, mas também os hambúrgueres e o sanduíche de contrafilé são excelentes! ... E a sorvete é outra coisa completamente! É o "The Godfather"! Tem um sabor que remete aos anos 50!
text_en: A treasure from Pittsburgh! Carmel mayonnaise is the star, but the hamburgers and the steak sandwich are also excellent! … And ice cream is something else entirely! It’s like “The Godfather”! It has a flavor that reminds me of the 1950s!
original: 100% Pittsburgh treasure! The Carmel sauce is the secret winner but also the burgers and rib eye sandwich! .......The soft serve is a totally different object! That's The Godfather! It tastes like 1955 all over!!

text: ¡Qué bueno que nos detuvimos anoche! Novel es un heladería con una ubicación encantadora, rodeada de restaurantes. El dueño es muy amable y se esforzó por presentarse, contar su historia al abrir la heladería y expresar su agradecimiento a sus clientes. Todos quedamos muy impresionados con él y con el helado en forma de donut. ¡Definitivamente volveremos!
text_en: It’s great that we stopped last night! Novel is a ice cream shop with a lovely location, surrounded by restaurants. The owner is very kind and tried his best to introduce himself, tell his story when opening the shop, and express his gratitude to his customers. We were all very impressed by him and the donut-shaped ice cream. We definitely will come back!
original: So happy we stopped by last night. Novel ice cream is in the cutest location with surrounding restaurants. The owner was so personable and really made it point to introduce himself, talk about his journey opening his ice cream shop and showing his appreciation for his customers. We were all super impressed with him and the ice cream donut! We will definitely be back

text: Com certeza, um ótimo local, ideal para observar as pessoas. Desfrute da vista do calçadão. Eles vendem muitas barras de chocolate e sorvete. Eu nem sabia que vendiam sorvete! Meu sundae de sorvete de menta estava delicioso.

text: We stopped for dessert with friends and thought Butterwood was such a quaint little bakery with really unique flavor combinations. The atmosphere was super cozy and more like being a guest at someone's home than being in a bakery. The employee was friendly. The desserts were like nothing I had ever had before. Typical bakeries have chocolate and vanilla, but Butterwood uses unique flavors that were delicious. We tried the mini chocolate cake with Strawberry whipped cream, the olive oil orange cake with strawberry icing, the fig cake and apricot cake with pistachio icing. The cakes are definitely denser than what I was used to, more like pound cake. Everything was very flavorful. The cakes were moist and the icing wasn't too sweet. Such a nice little place to stop and loved that they are open late!

It had the perfect consistency, with a pleasant sweet flavor in the mouth. The banana cream pie had small pieces of dough, along with a slight banana flavor. This place offers many other flavors to choose from. We will definitely come back!
original: Same great taste. I remember going to a Handel's ice cream shop in Montclair, California. This is the same franchise I believe. I ordered the banana cream pie sundae and it was so fresh and creamy. It was the right consistency of melty, creamy and a good amount of sweetness on my tongue. The banana cream pie had little chunks of crust and a hint of banana flavor. This place has so many other flavors to choose from. We are coming back for sure...

text: Eu adoro descobrir lugares incríveis como este, e fiquei triste ao ler as avaliações anteriores. Ouvi dizer que o atendimento ao cliente não era bom e que os doces não eram de alta qualidade. Fiquei muito feliz em descobrir que essas avaliações não correspondiam à minha experiência com a Amélie's NoDa. A mulher que me ajudou foi muito simpática e prestativa, o que me surpreendeu, considerando o grande número de pedidos que ela havia atendido nos dez minutos em que estive lá. Sim, estava cheio, mas a fila andava muito rápido e demorei apenas alguns minutos para chegar ao balcão. Fiquei tentada pelos doces deliciosos, mas comprei apenas os macarons franceses, que eram o meu objetivo. Os preços me deixaram um pouco triste (estudante universitário), mas entendo que vocês estão cobrando por ingredientes frescos e de qualidade. Tirei um milhão de fotos dos lindos "biscoitos" antes de experimentar. Comprei uma variedade de sabores, e custaram cerca de 15 dólares (aproximadamente 1,45 dólares por unidade). Meus sabores favoritos foram o de mel e o de framboesa. O de frutas vermelhas foi incrível e, combinado com o sabor de pasta de amendoim, me lembrou um sanduíche de pasta de amendoim e geleia. Gostei da pasta de amendoim, e o único sabor que não gostei foi o de laranja. Para alguém que normalmente não gosta de laranja, simplesmente não foi tão bom para mim. Mas não fiquei triste por ter comprado, porque ficou muito bonito nas minhas fotos...
text_en: I really love discovering such amazing places, and I was disappointed to read the previous reviews. I heard that customer service wasn’t good, and the desserts weren’t of high quality. I was very happy to find out that these reviews didn’t reflect my experience at Amélie’s NoDa. The woman who helped me was very kind and helpful, which surprised me, considering the large number of orders she handled in just ten minutes when I was there. Yes, it was busy, but the line moved very quickly, and it took me just a few minutes to reach the counter. I was tempted by the delicious desserts, but I only bought the French macarons, which were my goal. The prices made me a little sad (as a university student), but I understand that you charge for fresh and high-quality ingredients. I took millions of photos of the beautiful “biscuits” before trying them. I bought various flavors, and they cost about $15 (approximately $1.45 per unit). My favorite flavors were honey and raspberry. The red fruit flavor was amazing, and combined with the peanut paste taste, it reminded me of a peanut paste sandwich with jam. I liked the peanut paste, but the only flavor I didn’t like was orange. For someone who usually doesn’t like orange, it wasn’t very good for me. But I wasn’t sad about buying them, because they looked great in my photos…
original: I love finding amazing places like this, and I was sad reading previous reviews. Ive heard that the customer service wasnt good and the pastries were sub-par. I was elated to learn that these reviews did not match my experience with AmÃ©lie's NoDa. The woman who helped me was lovely and helpful, which was suprising to me considering the large volume of orders she had filled in the ten minutes I'd been there. For someone who dosent like oranges normally, it just wasnt that good for me. But I wasnt sad I got it, because it was quite nice in my pictures...

text: Fechado mais de 45 minutos antes das 21h. A mulher, enquanto guardava os doces e macarons não vendidos, disse: "Simplesmente decidimos fechar mais cedo". Foi frustrante, pois tínhamos planejado nossa última noite na orla em torno de uma parada para doces.

text: Para ser honesto, la única razón por la que pedí un cupcake ese día fue porque pensé que era divertido pedir algo de la máquina expendedora de cupcakes. text_en: To be honest, the only reason I ordered a cupcake that day was because I thought it would be fun to order something from the cupcake machine. Usually, cupcakes aren’t my favorite dessert, but the chocolate cupcake I ordered was an exception. It wasn’t too sweet, and the ratio of icing to cake was perfect. Maybe it was the best cupcake we’ve ever tried. I wish I had also tried the ice cream!
original: To be honest, the only reason I got a cupcake that day was because I thought it was fun to order something off the cupcake ATM. Cupcakes are usually not my favorite but the milk chocolate cupcake that I got was an exception. It was not overly sweet and the proportion of the frosting to cake was perfect. It may have been the best cupcake we have had. Wish I tried the ice cream too!

text: Buscamos incansablemente un lugar que merezca alegrarnos el día. Pasamos por el Bosque de las Pimientas, escalamos las Montañas de las Gomitas, nos detuvimos en el Bosque de las Lollipos y, finalmente, tomamos un barco para cruzar el Mar de los Helados y llegar a nuestro destino final, el Castillo de los Caramelos. Esta fue nuestra reacción al encontrar la heladería de Sloan. De hecho, caminamos cerca del canal que nos llevó a la Plaza de San Marcos en las Tiendas del Gran Canal para encontrar la heladería de Sloan. Al entrar en esta heladería, llena de luz, color y encanto, nos evocan recuerdos felices de nuestra infancia. Si eres un niño del corazón, este lugar seguramente te traerá mucha alegría. El personal era muy amable y servicial. A pesar de estar ocupados, trabajaban de manera eficiente para asegurarse de que todos estuvieran bien. Los helados que ofrecían venían en una variedad de sabores, desde los de Circo hasta los de Café, y todos los sabores comunes que esperarías en una heladería. También había una variedad de helados tipo "sundae", incluyendo el extravagante "Tracy's Kitchen Sink", que consiste en 18 bolas de helado y una gran cantidad de toppings en un fregadero. Terminamos comprando un "sundae" de helado de Circo: una bola de helado de Circo, chocolate caliente, gomitas, crema batida y cereza, en un divertido y reutilizable cofre de plástico. El helado de Circo era dulce, pero los toppings lo hicieron aún más divertido de comer. Los brownies y las galletas de caramelo que también compramos estaban igualmente deliciosos, ya que se podían calentar. Eran suaves, masticables y bastante grandes para una porción individual. De hecho, muchos de los productos ofrecidos se podían compartir entre dos o tres personas. Otra cosa genial que ofrece Sloan son sus conos de gofres. Se elaboran frescas en el local todos los días. En general, es un lugar divertido para disfrutar del paisaje y volver a ser niños. Una excelente adición a la heladería en el Gran Canal de Venecia. Volveré a probar otros productos si alguna vez estoy en la zona. Reseña de Yelp #11 de 2018
text_en: We searched tirelessly for a place that could bring joy to our days. We passed by the Pepper Forest, climbed the Gum Trees Mountains, stopped in the Lollipop Forest, and finally took a boat across the Frozen Sea to reach our final destination: the Candy Castle. This was our reaction when we found Sloan’s ice cream shop. In fact, we walked near the canal that led us to St. Mark’s Square in the Grand Canal Stores, where we found Sloan’s ice cream shop. Entering this bright, colorful, and charming ice cream shop brings back happy memories from our childhood. If you’re a heartfelt child, this place will surely bring you a lot of joy. The staff were very kind and helpful. Even though they were busy, they worked efficiently to make sure everyone was well taken care of. The ice creams they offered came in various flavors—from circus flavors to café flavors—all the usual flavors you would expect from an ice cream shop. There was also a variety of “sundae” types, including the extravagant “Tracy’s Kitchen Sink,” which consists of 18 ice cream balls and plenty of toppings in a sink. We ended up buying a “sundae” made of circus ice cream: an ice cream ball, hot chocolate, gummies, whipped cream, and cherry, all packed in a fun and reusable plastic container. The circus ice cream was sweet, but the toppings made it even more enjoyable to eat. The brownies and candy bars we also bought were equally delicious, as they could be heated up. They were soft, chewy, and quite large for a single serving. In fact, many of the products offered could be shared among two or three people. Another great thing about Sloan’s is her waffle cones. They are made fresh every day in the store. Overall, it’s a fun place to enjoy the scenery and become children again. An excellent addition to the ice cream shop in Venice’s Grand Canal. I will try other products if I’m in the area again. Yelp review #11 from 2018

text: Estive em Las Vegas celebrando meu 27º aniversário com um grupo de amigos e alguns de nós descobrimos este ótimo lugar no Yelp. Chegamos para o brunch e o restaurante estava cheio, com uma espera de 25 minutos. O que não foi ruim, já que eles ofereceram enviar uma mensagem quando nossa mesa estivesse disponível. Sentamos em uma mesa grande com assentos de veludo e nosso garçom chegou rapidamente, nos servindo água gelada e fazendo algumas recomendações. Dois de nós pediram o "petit déjeuner américain" e outro pediu o prato especial, do qual não me lembro o nome. Mas ele continha cogumelos. Fomos servidos rapidamente, e as bebidas foram reabastecidas sem a necessidade de chamar um garçom. A comida era incrível, e os doces eram simplesmente deliciosos. Descobri que Beverly Hills tem uma padaria e mal posso esperar para visitar a unidade local. Recomendo este lugar se você procura opções e comida que derrete na boca.
text_en: I was in Las Vegas celebrating my 27th birthday with a group of friends, and some of us found this great place on Yelp. We arrived for brunch, and the restaurant was full, with a wait of 25 minutes. That wasn’t a problem, as they offered to send us a message when our table would become available. We sat at a large table with velvet seats, and our waiter came quickly, serving us cold water and giving us some recommendations. Two of us ordered the “Petit Déjeuner American,” while another ordered a special dish whose name I don’t remember. But it contained mushrooms. We were served quickly, and the drinks were refilled without having to call for a waiter. The food was amazing, and the desserts were simply delicious. I learned that Beverly Hills has a bakery, and I can’t wait to visit the local branch. I recommend this place if you’re looking for delicious food that melts in your mouth.

text: Jack Frost Donuts is your old neighborhood donut shop in Cleveland. I literally came in early one day and a police officer was having a mentoring conversation with one of the young employees. If you just sit in the parking for a while in the morning, you'll see all types of people coming in and out: the lazy grungy dude in his PJs, the businessman in a hurry, the mom with 4 kids, and multiple cops. Anyway, you'll never be disappointed eating fried cake and coffee and I wouldn't miss out on Jack's if you're looking for a Cleveland staple. My recommendations are the German Chocolate, Salted Caramel, and Maple Bacon. The coffee is self-serve and is pretty good.

text: Devido ao serviço de júri no início deste mês, tive a oportunidade de visitar o Donut Bar durante dois dias seguidos. Primeira visita: 11:30 da manhã... escolhendo entre o que restava, experimentei um cheesecake de morango e um Boston Creme. Ambos tinham um sabor aceitável, mas o glacê de chocolate no Boston Creme não era apenas excessivamente doce, mas também parecia opaco, sem o brilho que se encontra em outras lojas de donuts. Além disso, a massa era um pouco mais densa do que eu preferia. Dei ao Donut Bar a chance de melhorar e decidi voltar no dia seguinte, mais cedo. Segunda visita: 7:30 da manhã... chegando com uma variedade completa, examinei a lista e pedi três tipos de donuts de massa: Matcha, Blueberry Meyer Lemon e The Samoa. Também pedi um donut de Creme Brulee e o donut especial do dia, Strawberries and Cream. O melhor dos três foi o donut de Creme Brulee e o Strawberries and Cream, que ficaram logo atrás. Os donuts de massa aqui não são tão leves e fofos, mas mais densos e mais escuros do que outros estabelecimentos na cidade. Os donuts de massa parecem melhores do que realmente eram, e eu apenas provei um pedaço de cada um, mas fiquei impressionado com o quão SECOS eles estavam. Não consegui identificar o sabor de matcha ou meyer lemon, mas eram excessivamente doces (e eu cheguei meia hora depois da abertura). O atendimento foi ok, e o preço é um pouco incerto, já que existem outras lojas na cidade que cobram menos por um produto com melhor sabor, e que não deixarão você com arrependimento. Como a música diz: "Eu gosto de donuts clássicos"... Eu prefiro donuts com um estilo clássico, que sejam leves e fofos, e que não sejam cobertos por glacês grossos, e que não precisem de adição de Oreo ou Pop Tart. Para mim, menos é mais, e talvez na terceira vez a sorte esteja do meu lado, mas por enquanto, não estou com pressa para voltar. ALOHA!!! Medida Shaka: \uuu/ \uuu/ \uu. 2,5
text_en: Due to the jury service at the beginning of this month, I had the opportunity to visit the Donut Bar for two consecutive days. First visit: 11:30 a.m… among the remaining options, I tried a strawberry cheesecake and a Boston Creme. Both had an acceptable taste, but the chocolate glaze on the Boston Creme wasn’t just overly sweet—it also seemed dull, lacking the shine found in other donut shops. Additionally, the dough was a bit denser than I preferred. I gave the Donut Bar a chance to improve, so I decided to return the next day, earlier. Second visit: 7:30 a.m… arriving with a full selection, I checked the menu and ordered three types of donuts: Matcha, Blueberry Meyer Lemon, and The Samoa. I also ordered a Creme Brulee donut and the special donut of the day, Strawberries and Cream. The best of the three were the Creme Brulee donut and Strawberries and Cream; they came right after each other. The dough-based donuts here aren’t as light and fluffy, but they’re denser and darker than those in other shops in town. The dough-based donuts seem better than they really are—I only tasted a piece of each, but I was impressed by how dry they were. I couldn’t identify the flavors of matcha or Meyer lemon, but they were overly sweet (and I arrived half an hour after opening). Service was okay, and the prices are a bit uncertain, as there are other shops in town that charge less for products with better flavors, and won’t leave you feeling disappointed. As the song says: “I like classic donuts…” I prefer donuts with a classic style—light and fluffy, not covered with thick glazes, and not requiring Oreo or Pop Tart additions. For me, less is more. Maybe on my third visit, I’ll be lucky, but for now, I’m not in a hurry to go back. HELLO!!! Shaka’s measurement: \uuu/ \uuu/ \uu. 2.5

text: Dripps es una pequeña y moderna heladería y tienda de té, que forma parte de Pokitrition. Ambiente: Una pared de fondo con plantas artificiales muestra letras brillantes con el letrero "Dripp it like it's hot". Definitivamente un lugar perfecto para Instagram, que atrae a los millennials, incluyendo a mí. Los clientes esperaban detrás para disfrutar de sus helados y tomar la foto perfecta con este atractivo fondo. En cuestión de horas después de la apertura, muchas personas ya habían publicado fotos en las redes sociales. Creo que hicieron un buen trabajo promocionando el nuevo lugar, y así muchas personas activas en las redes sociales se enteraron. Inauguración: La inauguración de Dripps tuvo lugar el pasado sábado, 29 de septiembre. El local estuvo abierto desde las 16:00 hasta las 22:30. Mi amigo y yo no queríamos esperar tanto en la fila, así que llegamos después de cenar, alrededor de las 20:30. ¡La cola seguía siendo muy larga! Por lo tanto, felicidades a Dripps Co. por esta exitosa nueva iniciativa. Sus helados y tés coloridos son un éxito. Todos los productos tienen la promoción "compra uno y llévate otro" y permanecerá vigente durante la primera semana después de la apertura. Helados: 1. En vaso o con palo (solo un tamaño) 2. Ingredientes: Todos los helados son de vainilla y puedes elegir tu cereal favorito de la infancia, como Lucky Charms, Cap'n Crunch, Frosted Flakes, Honey Bunches of Oats, Honey Nut Cheerios, Cookie Crisp, Froot Loops, y muchos más, que se combinarán con la vainilla. 3. Aderezos: Puedes elegir entre una lista de aderezos que ofrecen. La mayoría son cereales secos, pero también hay algunos aderezos comunes como masa de galletas y Oreos trituradas. Puedes pagar 50 centavos adicionales por otros aderezos, que incluyen frutas y otros deliciosos. Vaso de helado con un aderezo: Pedí el helado en un vaso, mezclado con uno de mis cereales favoritos, Cap'n Crunch. Lo acompañé con trozos de cheesecake, que es mi aderezo preferido en los lugares de froyo. La combinación fue increíble. El helado es muy rico y cremoso, y la cantidad que sirven es justo. El cereal mezclado era un poco crujiente y granulado, pero aún así muy delicioso. Recomiendo encarecidamente los helados. Creo que incluso solo el helado normal sería delicioso. Tés y café: También ofrecen tés de matcha, tés de leche de rosa, cafés de matcha y té tailandés. Puedes añadir boba si lo deseas. Todavía tengo que probarlos, pero he oído de otros clientes que no decepcionan. En mi próxima visita, me gustaría probar el té de leche de rosa o el café de matcha. Todo es estéticamente agradable, estoy seguro de que el sabor también coincide con la belleza de estas bebidas.
text_en:
Dripps is a small and modern ice cream and tea shop that belongs to Pokitrition. The atmosphere: A wall with artificial plants displays bright letters with the sign “Dripp it like it’s hot”. It’s definitely a perfect place for Instagram—it attracts millennials, including me. Customers waited behind to enjoy their ice creams and take great photos with this attractive background. Within a few hours of opening, many people already posted photos on social media. I think they did a good job promoting the new place, and many social media users became aware of it.  

Opening: Dripps opened last Saturday, September 29th. The store was open from 4:00 PM to 10:30 PM. My friend and I didn’t want to wait in line so long, so we arrived after dinner, around 8:30 PM. The line was still very long! So, congratulations to Dripps Co. on this successful new venture. Their colorful ice creams and teas are a success. All products have the promotion “buy one, get one free” and will remain valid during the first week after opening.  

Ice Creams:  
1. In a glass or with a stick (only one size available).  
2. Ingredients: All ice creams are vanilla-based, and you can choose your favorite childhood cereal, such as Lucky Charms, Cap’n Crunch, Frosted Flakes, Honey Bunches of Oats, Honey Nut Cheerios, Cookie Crisp, Froot Loops, and many others. These will combine with the vanilla flavor.  
3. Toppings: You can choose from a list of toppings offered. Most are dry cereals, but there are also some common toppings like cookie dough and crushed Oreo cookies. You can pay an extra 50 cents for other toppings, including fruits and other delicious options.  

Ice cream in a glass with a topping: I ordered an ice cream in a glass, mixed with my favorite cereal, Cap’n Crunch. I added pieces of cheesecake as my preferred topping at ice cream shops. The combination was amazing. The ice cream is rich and creamy, and the amount served is just right. The mixed cereal was slightly crumbly and granular, but still very delicious. I highly recommend the ice creams. I think even the regular ice cream would be delicious.  

Teas and Coffee: They also offer matcha teas, rose milk teas, matcha coffees, and Thai tea. You can add boba if you want. I still need to try them, but I’ve heard from other customers that they don’t disappoint. Next time I visit, I’d like to try the rose milk tea or matcha coffee. Everything looks beautiful, and I’m sure the taste matches the beauty of these drinks.

Absolutely Instagram-worthy surely attracting millennials including myself. Customers stayed behind waiting to lick their ice cream cones so they can take the perfect picture with the cute backdrop. Within hours of opening, many, many people have already posted pictures on social media. I think they did a good job of promoting the new place so many people who are active on social media were aware of it. Grand Opening: The grand opening of Dripps was this past Saturday, September 29th. The place was open from 4 p.m. until 10:30 p.m. My friend and I didn't want to wait so long in line, so we came after dinner around 8:30. The line was still super long! So congrats, Dripps Co., on the successful new venture. Your soft serves and colorful teas are a hit! All items were BOGO and will be BOGO for the first week since opening. Soft Serve Ice Cream: 1. Cup or Cone (one size only) 2. Mix-In: All soft serves are vanilla only and you can choose your favorite childhood cereal including Lucky Charms, Cap'n Crunch, Frosted Flakes, Honey Bunches of Oats, Honey Nut Cheerios, Cookie Crisp, Froot Loops, and many more, that they will blend in with the vanilla soft serve. 3. Toppings: You can choose from a list of toppings they have. Most of them are more dry cereal but a few toppings I spotted are the usual froyo toppings like cookie dough and crushed oreos. You can pay 50 cents extra for other toppings from a list that includes fruit and other yummies. Cup of Soft Serve w/ One Topping: I ordered the soft serve in a cup mixed with one of my favorite super sugary childhood cereals, Cap'N Crunch. I topped it with cheesecake bites, my go-to topping at froyo places. The combination was amazing. The ice cream is so rich and creamy, the amount that they serve is just enough. The cereal mixed in was a little crunchy and grainy, but still so delicious. I highly recommend the soft serves. I think even just the plain soft serve would have been tasty! Teas + Coffee: They also serve matcha teas, rose milk teas, matcha coffees, and thai tea. You can add boba to it if you like. I still need to try these, but I have heard from the other customers, that they do not disappoint. My next visit, I would love to try either the rose milk or matcha coffee. Everything is aesthetically pleasing, I'm sure the taste matches the beauty of these drinks as well!

text: No merece la pena el precio por la pequeña porción. El helado estaba simplemente regular. Probé el de cereza, café y mantequilla de cacahuete, y todos estaban simplemente regulares.
text_en: The price isn’t worth it for such a small portion. The ice cream was just average. I tried the cherry, coffee, and peanut butter flavors—all were just ordinary.

text: I was there at the grand opening at 9. got there around 8:00am and was one of the first 25 people . They had UNLV cheerleaders to cheer and had a great opening. The bread was nice and fresh. Respect for the managers to have crowd control and not let it look like a Hong Kong protest inside with people grabbing bread off the trays before they hit the shelf. They handled that pretty well. I got everything I could on my tray. two mugs and the yardstick for the first 100 customers. The above review is 5 stars worthy for the morning. the reason why I put a one star is for people who are curious and for the managers to look at how they did cause they care about the business and need customer feedback. I went back there at night because I gave most of the bread pastries away to my coworkers since we had a birthday celebration. I did not have a chance to try the matcha custard bread, milk pudding bun, the croquette bun. etc. I went back hoping there was still more at night. instead it was mostly subpar items like muffins and the egg tarts. None of the premium items I saw in the morning or mentioned above or the ones you see in the morning review posts. It was just pumping out the same bread and put it in three different places. I saw the berry tart like in three different shelves and muffins that anyone can go get at Starbucks. It was just selling bread at that point for profit since there was a demand there, but also because they probably ran out of ingredients for the other items. Here is the reason where they screwed up. Since the morning. it was pretty chaotic with all the excitement. I forgot to ask if the free yardstick was refillable or not. I heard the regional divisional manager say this is the first of its kind for Las Vegas since it has Vegas themes on the free items. I could not hear if he said "free" refills or " no refills for the yardstick. I went back at night to ask and clarify. I asked three employees and they did not know. Till I asked the lady at the drink section kindly if it was free refill or not. The cashier next to her heard me and said in an angry tone. NO REFILL. then mumbled to her coworker " they brought it up in the meeting." the one I asked kindly went to her manager and asked and she came back and told me no without yelling No REFILL like the other cashier did. I accepted it since i wasnt sure due to all the noise in the morning. The one star is for the rude cashier at the front. All it takes is one thing to ruin the whole experience. the customers are the driving force for the business, but if they have cashiers not able to handle the customers, then people reading should be aware to expect it. Bread was perfect, grand opening was perfect. Ask a question and get an angry response from another employee and I am willing to spend the time to write this one star review. Do yourself a favor. Dont go there at night and grab the leftover inventory. Wait till the hype goes down and they train their employees to be nice and courteous to the customers.

text: He comprado raciones de langosta en mis viajes anuales a Las Vegas, y siempre eran crujientes y deliciosas. Por eso, el pasado jueves 22 de febrero de 2018, decidí comprar 4 y compartirlas con mis seres queridos. Sin embargo, esta vez no fueron como antes. Creo que quizás no estaban frescas. No eran crujientes, sino duras y quebradizas. Intentaré comprarlas de nuevo, pero antes de comprarlas, preguntaré cuándo fueron preparadas.
text_en: I bought lobster meals during my annual trips to Las Vegas, and they were always crispy and delicious. So, on Thursday, February 22, 2018, I decided to buy 4 and share them with my loved ones. However, this time they weren’t like before. I think they might not have been fresh. They weren’t crispy at all; instead, they were hard and brittle. I will try to buy them again, but before buying, I’ll ask when they were prepared.
original: I have gotten lobster tails on my yearly trips to Las Vegas and they were always crispy and delicious so last Thursday 2/22/18 I decided to get 4 and share the goodness with those I love. To my disappointment these were not as before. I think that they may not have been fresh. They were not crispy but tough and crunchy. I will try them again but will ask when they were made before purchasing.

text_en: Before and after the pandemic, Handel’s is unmatched. The service, product, and prices are excellent. I don’t understand why I was wasting time at Cold Stones. If you find a Handel’s nearby, don’t hesitate to visit it—you won’t regret it.
original: Pre and post COVID, Handel's is the bomb. Service, Product, Price can't be beat. Don't know why I had been wasting my time at Cold Stones. If you find a Handel's near you stop by you won't regret it.

text: Comida e bebidas deliciosas! Grande variedade. Aberto 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana (o que é ótimo para aqueles desejos noturnos). Pode ficar bastante cheio, dependendo do dia da semana e do horário. Definitivamente, um lugar imperdível na região de Charlotte.
text_en: Delicious food and drinks! A wide variety available. Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week – which is great for those evening cravings. It can get quite crowded, depending on the day of the week and time of day. Definitely a must-visit place in the Charlotte area.
original: Great food & drinks! Wide selection. Open 24/7 (which is great for those late-night cravings) Can get crowded easily depending on the day of the week/time of day. Definitely a must-try in the Charlotte area.

text: Updating this review, as the old Ninety's is LONG GONE, and the new Ninety's is my new ice cream go-to! The owners are incredibly friendly and super helpful when picking from the variety of ice cream (and cookie dough!) treats they have available. Their milkshakes are spot-on (for extra, you can add icing and toppings on the outside for that perfect instagram photo!), and their macaron ice cream sandwiches are messy, but delicious! I would highly recommend any of their cookie dough pops. While the location itself is off the beaten path (in University), it's worth the trip to try these unique treats!

text: Aparentemente, muitos de vocês não sabem a diferença entre macarons e macaroons. São dois tipos diferentes de biscoitos. A "Ninety's" é especializada em sanduíches de sorvete com macarons e são deliciosos, mas também muito difíceis de comer! Minha primeira visita foi há cerca de um ano, antes das reformas na loja e da atualização do cardápio. Naquela época, os sanduíches de sorvete com macarons pareciam ter sido preparados com antecedência e armazenados no congelador. Havia algumas opções de cada, em cerca de 15-20 sabores diferentes. Eu escolhi o sabor de pistache, principalmente porque gosto da cor verde, e minha amiga escolheu o sabor de bolo de aniversário. Os macarons estavam um pouco secos, pois estavam armazenados no congelador, mas, além disso, nós duas adoramos! Eram enormes e uma ótima opção por apenas $5,95 cada. Voltei durante o verão, depois que as reformas foram concluídas. Gostaria de dizer que fiquei um pouco decepcionado ao ver que só tinham cerca de 4-5 sabores de sanduíches de macaron disponíveis (talvez, preparados diariamente?), MAS agora eles estavam os preparando sob encomenda, em vez de preparar vários e armazená-los no congelador. Dessa forma, os macarons não ficariam secos, e desta vez pareciam muito frescos. Minha última visita foi há alguns dias. Estava na área e queria experimentar todos os meus lugares favoritos antes de dirigir 30+ minutos de volta para casa. Mais macarons com tema de unicórnio no cardápio, mas tinham sanduíches de sorvete com macarons de chá tailandês naquele dia... Sério? Sorvete de baunilha com calda de chá tailandês, entre macarons com sabor de chá tailandês. Era tudo o que eu, com minha gula, poderia desejar... Chá tailandês incorporado em uma sobremesa incrível! Eles também têm outras opções que não me interessam muito... Pães "Yum-ee" (não gosto de donuts), misturas de milkshake de cereal, e até um cardápio com pratos salgados? Hmm, talvez um dia... Mas vamos ser realistas... Os sanduíches de macaron são demais! De qualquer forma, falando sério, se alguém tiver dicas de como comer os sanduíches de sorvete com macarons sem parecer que estou aprendendo a me alimentar, por favor, me avisem. Vou tentar na minha próxima visita à "Ninety's"!
text_en: Apparently, many of you don’t know the difference between macarons and macaroons. They’re two different types of cookies. “Ninety’s” specializes in ice cream sandwiches with macarons, and they’re delicious—but also very difficult to eat! My first visit was about a year ago, before the renovations and menu updates at the store. At that time, the ice cream sandwiches with macarons seemed to have been prepared in advance and stored in the freezer. There were several options for each sandwich, around 15–20 flavors. I chose the pistachio flavor, mainly because I like the green color, and my friend chose the birthday cake flavor. The macarons were a little dry, as they had been stored in the freezer, but still, we both loved them! They were huge, and a great choice at just $5.95 each. I returned during summer, after the renovations were completed. I would say I was a little disappointed to see that there were only 4–5 flavors of macaron sandwiches available (maybe prepared daily?). But now they’re making them on order, instead of preparing multiple items and storing them in the freezer. This way, the macarons won’t be dry, and this time they looked very fresh. My last visit was a few days ago. I was in the area and wanted to try all my favorite places before driving 30+ minutes home. There were more macarons with unicorn themes on the menu, but that day they had ice cream sandwiches with Thai tea macarons… Seriously? Vanilla ice cream with Thai tea syrup, along with macarons with Thai tea flavors. It was everything I, as a food lover, could desire… Thai tea integrated into an amazing dessert! They also have other options that aren’t very appealing to me… “Yum-ee” breads (I don’t like donuts), cereal milkshakes, and even a menu with salty dishes? Hmm, maybe one day… But let’s be realistic… The macaron sandwiches are amazing! Anyway, seriously, if anyone has tips on how to eat those ice cream sandwiches with macarons without feeling like I’m learning to eat, please let me know. I’ll try it during my next visit to “Ninety’s”!

Ninety's specializes in MACARON ice cream sandwiches & they are incredibly messy to eat but delicious! My first visit was around this time a year ago, before their renovations to the store & the menu revamp. The macaron ice cream sandwiches at that time looked like they were prepared ahead of time & kept in a freezer. There were a few of each in about 15-20 different flavors. I opted for the pistachio flavor, mostly because I like the color green, & my friend chose the birthday cake flavor. The macarons were a little dried out since they were kept in a freezer but other than that my friend & I were hooked! They were huge & a good deal for this novelty at $5.95 each. I came back again during the summer, after their renovations were completed. I will say I was a little disappointed to see that they only had about 4-5 flavors of macaron sandwiches available (rotating daily, maybe?) BUT now they were making them to order, instead of preparing a bunch of them & keeping them in the freezer. This way the macarons won't get dried out & they did seem a lot fresher this time around. My most recent visit was a couple of days ago. I was in the area & wanted to hit up all of my spots before driving 30+ min back home. No more unicorn macarons on the menu but they had THAI TEA MACARON ICE CREAM SANDWICHES that day.. Are you kidding me?! Vanilla ice cream with Thai tea drizzle, sandwiched between Thai tea flavored macarons. It was everything that my fatass self could have hoped for.. Thai tea incorporated into one bomb AF dessert! They have other offerings that I really DGAF about.. Yum-ee buns (can't stand donuts), cereal milkshake concoctions, & an actual SAVORY menu? Ehh maybe one day.. But let's be real.. Macaron sandwiches are where it's at! Anyway seriously though, if anyone has tips on how to eat the macaron ice cream sandwiches without looking like I just started learning how to feed myself, let me know.. I'll try it out on my next visit to Ninety's!

text: El helado de chocolate vegano estaba tan delicioso que compré una tarrina para llevar. ¡Probablemente es el mejor helado sin lácteos que he probado! A los niños también les encantaron los sabores de helado con leche, y creen que es el mejor helado de Charlotte – al menos, según ellos, solo superado por el Creamery de Penn State, en State College, Pennsylvania.
text_en: The vegan chocolate ice cream was so delicious that I bought a whole container to take with me. It’s probably the best dairy-free ice cream I’ve tried! The kids also loved the flavors of ice cream with milk; they think it’s the best ice cream in Charlotte—at least, according to them, only surpassed by the Creamery at Penn State in State College, Pennsylvania.
original: The vegan chocolate ice cream was so good, I bought a pint to go. ...probably the best non-dairy I've cream I've ever had! The kids loved their dairy ice cream flavors as well, and think it's the best ice cream in Charlotte - in their opinion, probably only bested by the Creamery at Penn State, State College, PA.

text: Presti's es un lugar ideal para tomar un refrigerio y un café: tienen muchos asientos, tanto en el interior como en el exterior, y funcionan de manera eficiente con un sistema de pedidos tipo "ticket de la tienda". Me encanta venir aquí y sentarme en uno de los asientos junto a la ventana para estudiar y observar a la gente mientras la gente charla a mi alrededor. Tienen una selección asombrosa, realmente todo lo que podrías imaginar que encontrarías en una panadería italiana. Sin embargo, gran parte de la comida se prepara temprano en el día, por lo que, sobre todo a última hora de la tarde, después de que los pasteles hayan estado expuestos por un tiempo, podría ser mejor buscar en otro lugar. Nunca te equivocas con el helado o cualquier pastel: este es definitivamente el lugar ideal para pedir un pastel personalizado para una ocasión especial (mis favoritos son, por supuesto, el tiramisú y el de pistacho). Además, es quizás el único lugar en Little Italy que vende porciones de pizza, y también tienen una excelente selección de comida caliente y salada.
text_en: Presti is an ideal place to enjoy a snack and coffee: they have plenty of seats, both inside and outside, and operate efficiently using a “store ticket” ordering system. I love coming here and sitting in one of the windows-side seats to study and watch people chat around me. They offer an amazing selection—everything you could imagine you’d find in an Italian bakery. However, most food is prepared early in the day, so especially in the late afternoon, after the pastries have been displayed for a while, it might be better to look elsewhere. You can never go wrong with ice cream or any pastry there: it’s definitely the perfect place to order a custom cake for a special occasion (my favorites are, of course, tiramisu and pistachio ones). Also, it’s perhaps the only place in Little Italy that sells pizza slices, and they also have a great selection of hot and cold foods.
original: Presti's is a solid spot for a snack and a coffee - they have plenty of seating, both inside and outside, and run efficiently with deli ticket style ordering. I love coming here and camping out in one of the window seats to do study and people watch while people are chattering around me. They have an astounding selection, really everything you could think of an Italian bakery might have. However, a lot of the food is made earlier in the day, so in the late afternoon after pastries have been sitting out for a while it might be better to look elsewhere. You can never go wrong with the gelato or any of the cakes - this is definitely the spot to order a custom cake for a special occasion (my favs being the tiramisu ofc and the pistachio). What's also fun is that they are maybe the only place in Little Italy that sells pizza slices, and they have a great hot/savory food selection as well!

text: Na minha primeira visita, há alguns anos, adorei este lugar. Mas a minha última visita não foi tão boa. É um lugar divertido, com uma atmosfera muito interessante e uma linda vitrine de doces. Experimentamos vários doces e meu marido também pediu um latte. Eu queria muito experimentar um dos lattes deles, mas infelizmente eles não têm café descafeinado, então não consegui. Meu marido adorou o seu. Eu experimentei um pouco de quase tudo, e tudo estava muito doce. Como como muitos doces, eu esperava que fossem doces, mas estes eram tão açucarados que não consegui comer muito. Todos estavam bons, mas longe de serem os melhores que já experimentei. As mesas estavam cheias de migalhas e não tinham sido limpas, o que não é muito agradável. O atendimento no balcão foi atencioso e rápido. Diria que vale a pena conhecer, caso você esteja visitando e quiser fazer algo diferente.
text_en: During my first visit a few years ago, I really loved this place. But my last visit wasn’t as good. It’s a fun place with a very interesting atmosphere and a beautiful display of sweets. We tried several candies, and my husband also ordered a latte. I really wanted to try one of their lattes, but unfortunately they don’t have decaffeinated coffee, so I couldn’t have it. My husband enjoyed his latte very much. I tried almost everything, and everything was very sweet. Like many candies, I expected them to be sweet, but these were so sugary that I couldn’t eat much. They were all good, but far from the best I’ve ever tried. The tables were full of crumbs, and they weren’t cleaned properly, which isn’t very pleasant. The service at the counter was attentive and quick. I would say it’s worth visiting if you’re there and want to do something different.
original: The first time I came here years ago I absolutely loved this place, but my most recent visit was lacking. It's a fun spot with a really interesting atmosphere and a beautiful display case of pastries. We got a myriad of treats to try and my husband also got a latte. I really wanted to try one of their lattes but can't have caffeinated coffee, unfortunately for me they don't have decaf espresso so I didn't get to try one. My husband really enjoyed his though. I tried a bite of nearly everything and it was all so sweet. I eat baked goods a lot so I expect them to be sweet, but these were so sugary I just couldn't stomach much of it. They were all good but far from the best I've had. The tables were littered with crumbs and hadn't been cleaned, which is a little off putting. The service behind the counter was helpful and prompt. I would say it's worth checking out if you're visiting and wanting to do something unique.

text: Home grown Ice !! Have to swing here... Trending and always new trys! Swing by this place after a slice of pizza across the street from Grads Pizza

text: Me encantó este lugar de helados en California y cuando lo vi aquí, ¡grité! Estoy bastante segura de que era una noche de invierno muy fría, pero eso no me impidió pedir. La variedad aquí es increíble y cada sabor es cremoso y delicioso. Hay algo para todos. Siempre pido la degustación de 4 sabores porque es una oferta excelente. 4 porciones grandes por 4,25 $. Si intentas pedir 4 porciones en Cold*****, prepárate para pagar una fortuna, #solo digo. Vas a querer 4 porciones porque no podrás elegir solo una. Si crees que no podrás terminarlo, llévalo a casa y congélalo. Tu yo del futuro te lo agradecerá, te lo prometo. Algunos de mis favoritos son Graham Central Station, Blue Monster y Blueberry Cobbler. La fila puede parecer larga, pero se mueve rápido. Los empleados y la forma en que está organizado el local son muy eficientes. Además, te permiten probar muestras, así que no seas tímido.
text_en: I loved this ice cream place in California, and when I saw it here, I cried! I’m pretty sure it was a very cold winter night, but that didn’t stop me from ordering. The variety here is incredible, and each flavor is creamy and delicious. There’s something for everyone. I always order the 4-flavor tasting because it’s an excellent offer. 4 large servings for $4.25. If you try to order 4 servings at Cold*****, be prepared to pay a lot of money – #just saying. You’ll definitely want 4 servings, because you won’t be able to choose just one. If you think you can’t finish it, bring it home and freeze it. Your future self will thank you, I promise. Some of my favorite flavors are Graham Central Station, Blue Monster, and Blueberry Cobbler. The line might seem long, but it moves quickly. The staff and how the place is organized are very efficient. Plus, they allow you to try samples, so don’t be shy.

The variety here is amazing and every flavor is creamy and delicious. There is something here for everyone! Always get the 4 scoop sampler because it is such a good deal! 4 large scoops for $4.25 If you tried to order 4 scoops at Cold*****, prepare to pay an arm and a leg, #justsayin. They will also let you try samples, so don't be shy.

text_en: Unique and delicious. I don’t know why it took me so long to try their donuts. It’s a clean and pleasant store. They had over 50 types of donuts, and I asked the staff how to identify each one. She explained each type as I chose a half-dozen different flavors. It’s really necessary to buy a half-dozen to try various tastes.
original: Unique and tasty I'm not sure why I waited so long to try their donuts. Nice clean store. They had over 50 donuts in the case and I asked the lady how you know what they are. She went donut by donut and gave me a description as I picked an assorted dozen out. You definitely need a dozen to get a variety of flavors.

text: O melhor lugar em Las Vegas para comer sorvete e cupcakes. Adoro! Meu favorito é o cupcake com sobremesa, feito com cupcake de red velvet e sorvete de baunilha.

text: It's really hit-or-miss at Milk Bar, but for the most part their desserts are way too sweet. I saw the chef's episode - Christina Tosi - on Chefs Table on Netflix and have been to Milk Bars across the country and I don't recommend anything really, which is a shame because I have lots of respect for the chef herself. Here's what I've had: It was our friends bday so they brought over these Milk Balls to Momofuku to end the meal. The only cute thing about it was the candle. It was just a crumbled up former-cake dusted with too much powdered sugar. I'd be embarrassed to serve this to people if I was the owner, even if it was free (it wasn't, we paid for this abomination) 1/10 Crack Pie - (now it's known as the milk bar pie) - again, too sweet, but edible. 5/10 Compost cookie kit - this is the only reason I'm bumping up my review. I brought home a tin with the ingredients from my trip to DC years ago and it was really fun to make and not bad at all! 8/10 Assorted cookies- got these for my bday this year and couldn't finish them. Way too sweet and hard/crumbly! 4/10 Overall everything is way too sweet at Milk Bar. I heard their cereal milk soft serve is good, so maybe... the 5th time I visit one of their locations... I can try it one day.

text: Parei para comprar alguns doces depois do almoço e, no final, comprei mais do que o necessário. Acabei comprando 1,5 dúzia de donuts, e optei pelos sabores especiais, como os de bacon com maple, por exemplo. Embora eu tenha gostado dos donuts, eu recomendaria que você os consuma apenas uma vez por ano, pois são bem doces! Enquanto esperava, um dos funcionários continuava me oferecendo pedaços de donut para experimentar, e até mesmo quando saí, me deu uma caixa cheia para a minha viagem, com esse tipo de atendimento personalizado, não é surpresa que este lugar seja tão popular! Se você estiver na cidade, eu recomendo uma visita e experimentar os donuts especiais deles.
text_en: I stopped to buy some candies after lunch, and in the end, I bought more than I needed. I ended up buying 1.5 dozen donuts, and I chose the special flavors, like bacon with maple flavor. Although I liked the donuts, I would recommend eating them only once a year, as they are really sweet! While I was waiting, one of the staff members kept offering me pieces of donut to try. Even when I left, they gave me a whole box for my trip. With such personalized service, it’s no surprise that this place is so popular! If you’re in the city, I recommend visiting and trying their special donuts.
original: Stopped by after lunch to grab some sweets, walked out with more then I should have. Ended up buying 1.5 dozen orders, went with their specialty donuts - like maple bacon donuts, etc. While I liked their donuts, I would recommend you only consumed these once a year, as they are very sweet! While I was waiting, one of the gentleman kept on giving me donut holes to sample and even when I left, he gave me a box full for my road trip, with this kind of personal touch and service no wonder this this place is popular! If you are in town, I would recommend a visit and give their specialty donuts a try.

text: ¡Este lugar fue genial! El servicio fue excelente y mi helado de vainilla de Madagascar con fresas también fue delicioso. ¡Lo disfruté mucho!
text_en: This place was great! The service was excellent, and my vanilla ice cream with strawberries from Madagascar was also delicious. I really enjoyed it!
original: This place was great ! Service was excellent and so was my Madagascar vanilla topped with strawberries . Loved it!

text: Jarlings ocupa um lugar especial em nossos corações. É o melhor lugar para comer sorvete na cidade. A equipe, às vezes, é um pouco lenta, e usa as próprias mãos para colocar os acompanhamentos (o que me irrita, pois fazem isso logo após manusear o dinheiro), mas não há nada que se compare. Eles não têm Reese's e ficam um pouco inconvenientes se você perguntar, então, simplesmente, aceite. Além disso, eles não têm calda de chocolate quente e ficam um pouco irritados se você perguntar. Felizmente, o creme é tão bom que compensa qualquer inconveniente. Quando um dia nos mudarmos, sei que sentirei muito a falta desse creme.
text_en: Jarlings holds a special place in our hearts. It’s the best place to eat ice cream in the city. The staff, sometimes, is a bit slow, and they use their hands to put the toppings on (which annoys me, because they do this right after handling the money). But there’s nothing else that can compare. They don’t have Reese’s, and they can be a bit annoying if you ask, so just accept it. Also, they don’t have hot chocolate sauce, and they get upset if you ask. Thankfully, the cream is so good that it makes up for any inconvenience. When we move somewhere one day, I know I’ll really miss that cream.
original: Jarlings holds a special place in our hearts. It's the best ice cream place in town. The staff are somewhat slow at times, and use their bare hands to put toppings on (which irritates me because they do this immediately after handling money), but there's just no substitute. They don't have Reese's and are fussy if you ask, so just let it go. They also don't have hot fudge and get fussy if you ask. Luckily the custard is good enough that it eclipses any grievances. When we move away someday, I know I will miss this custard sorely.
