text: Atualização – o serviço está um pouco melhor do que antes (em comparação com há um ano), no entanto, o tempo de espera ainda é considerável. Quanto ao sabor, continua sendo de qualidade inferior. Seus chás de leite e chás com bolinhas ainda são feitos com base em pó, o que não me surpreende, já que fazem parte de uma cadeia. No entanto, me choca que algo tão simples como um chá de leite precise de embalagens de pó para facilitar o preparo. Em relação aos seus cafés, adoraria ver que os grãos sejam tratados com o respeito que merecem. Há muito mais do que apenas colocar uma etiqueta dizendo "da Etiópia" ou "Comércio Justo". No geral, não é um lugar que eu escolheria para ir.
text_en: Update – the service is a bit better than before (compared to a year ago), but the waiting time is still quite long. As for the taste, it’s still of poor quality. Their milk tea and bubble tea are still made using powder, which isn’t surprising since they’re part of a chain. However, it surprises me that something as simple as milk tea needs to be packaged in powder to make preparation easier. Regarding their coffee, I would like to see that the beans are treated with the respect they deserve. There’s more to it than just putting a label saying “from Ethiopia” or “Fair Trade”. Overall, it’s not a place I would choose to go.
original: Update--service is a bit better than before (compared to a year ago) however, the wait time is still on the longer side. As for taste, it is still on the lower quality. Their milk teas and bubble teas are still powder based which doesn't surprise me as it is part of a chain. However it blows my mind that something as simple as milk tea requires powder packets for the sake of convenience. As for their coffees, I'd love to see the beans treated with the respect they deserve. There's much more than just sticking a label on it "from Ethiopia" or "Fair Trade". Overall, it's not somewhere I would choose to go to.

text: 9/21/21 - CLARIFIED DIRECTIONS TO GRAB AND GO BAKERY: 1. Park in the Venetian Self Park Garage 2. Take Elevators to Food court /shops level 3. Take the escalators down and make a sharp right or left to join line for the shop counter (line window started right across JUICE FARM) Idk if they recently changed the location, but previous reviews mentioned near the palazzo theater, guest elevators etc, but If you don't know where those places are then you might get frustrated like i did. I done lost my mind looking for this counter right behind the escalators that take you up to coffee bean(food court) /parking garage. Pastries were just as good as I remember from the restaurant and the boxes flew home well on my flight home. Standouts- kouighamann : the closest texture I've tried in the states to the ones in France. Dense and buttery- should not be flaky or falling apart into crumbs. Almond croissant: so toasty (even when cold) with good buttery almond filling. Bouchon: a hybrid between a brownie bite and toasted cannele lol. Got a few chocolate chips on the bottom too.

text: Antes iba a O Face Doughnuts por sus "maple bars", así que decidí probar este lugar. Me sorprendió la variedad que ofrecían. Era casi abrumadora, pero no me impidió probar diferentes cosas. Hay tal vez demasiadas para enumerarlas, pero lo que realmente destacó fue el "French Toast Donut". Solo lo ofrecen los fines de semana, pero ¿realmente se necesita un donut todos los días de la semana? Yo lo pedía semanalmente durante un tiempo con mi pareja. Venía con jarabe de arce de Vermont, mantequilla batida y mermelada casera de arándanos. Normalmente era suficiente para mí, pero él es más grande y también pedía el donut de cheesecake de arándanos, que decía que era el mejor pastel dulce que había probado. Además, también tienen leche de chocolate casera y café frío disponible, lo que ya vale la pena el viaje. Un personal excelente y una experiencia rápida y sencilla. Les recomiendo que vengan antes de que se acaben los donuts.
text_en: Before, I used to go to O Face Doughnuts for their “maple bars”. So I decided to try this place out. I was surprised by the variety they offered. It was almost overwhelming, but it didn’t stop me from trying different things. There might be too many items to list all of them, but what really stood out was the “French Toast Donut”. They only serve it on weekends, but do you really need a donut every day of the week? For a while, I ordered it weekly with my partner. It came with Vermont maple syrup, whipped butter, and homemade raspberry jam. Usually, it was enough for me, but he is bigger, so he also ordered the raspberry cheesecake donut, which he said was the best sweet treat he’d ever tasted. Additionally, they have homemade chocolate milk and cold coffee available, which makes the trip worth it. The staff are excellent, and the experience is quick and simple. I recommend coming before the donuts run out.
original: Used to go to O Face Doughnuts for maple bars so I thought id give this place a try. Was surprised to see the variety they had. Almost too overwhelming but I didn't let that stop me from trying a variety of things. There's maybe too many to list, but what definitely stood out was the French Toast Donut. It's only a weekend run but who really needs doughnuts 7 days a week ;) I did the FTD on a weekly routine for awhile with my bf. It came with hot Vermont maple syrup, whipped butter, and house made blueberry jam. It was usually big enough for me but he's a bigger guy and would also get the blueberry cheesecake donut which he said was the best sweet pastry hes ever had. In addition they also have homemade chocolate milk and cold brew on tap which alone is worth the trip. Awesome friendly staff and a quick in and out experience. I suggest you get here before the donuts run out

text: I was so excited for Milk Bar's arrival. And, I was So disappointed. I got 3 cookies, a shake, and a soft serve ice cream. Everything was OK, but for $26 I expected to be blown away and I wasn't. There are off Strip places for way less money turning out a much better product. I wished that this location was more bakery and less walk up counter. I think when you SEE items in a bakery case... It's part of the experience. Everything here is already packaged to go or, with the frozen treats, you don't see them until you get them. Also, there is no seating anywhere. The Birthday Cake shake was tasty, but fairly small for $10. The soft serve cup is one size, but they do fill it up. I got the cereal milk flavor with the cornflake topping. It definitely tasted like it was supposed to which I enjoyed, bit the ice cream had a weird texture that was off-putting...like the cream was curdled or something. I threw it away about halfway through. Cookies was an OK size and a chewy texture, but 3 for $8?!?!? Completely overpriced. I can cross this place off my bucket list, but I won't likely be back.

text: Já visitei este lugar duas vezes e adorei em ambas as ocasiões. O sorvete é realmente incrível. Não encontrei outra sorveteria no Arizona que se compare à qualidade deste lugar. Além disso, nas duas vezes em que estive aqui, o proprietário estava trabalhando e ele permite que você tire o tempo necessário para fazer perguntas e experimentar o máximo de sabores possível. É evidente que ele quer que você tenha a melhor experiência possível. Não tenho palavras para descrever o quanto eu gosto deste lugar, definitivamente vale a pena experimentar.
text_en: I’ve been to this place twice already, and I loved it both times. The ice cream is truly amazing. I couldn’t find another ice cream shop in Arizona that compares to the quality of this place. Moreover, during both visits, the owner was working, but they allow you enough time to ask questions and try as many flavors as possible. It’s clear that they want you to have the best experience possible. I have no words to describe how much I enjoy this place; it’s definitely worth trying.
original: Been here twice and loved it each time. The ice cream is truly incredible. I haven't found another ice cream shop in AZ that matches its quality. To top it off, both times I've been in the owner has been working and he will let you take your time to ask questions and try as many flavors as you want. You can tell he just wants you to have the best experience possible. I can't say enough good things about this place, it's definitely worth trying out.

text: Eu fiquei impressionado com isso! O sorvete de leite de cereal com flocos de milho é incrível. A quantidade de doçura no sorvete combinada com os flocos de milho é perfeita. Era leve e cremoso, mas não muito pesado. Compramos duas tortas de "crack", que também estavam muito boas. A torta com açúcar mascavo é divina. São pequenas, mas a quantidade é perfeita, pois são bem saborosas. A única ressalva que eu teria seria o preço. Eu sei que é um lugar conhecido, mas pagar US$ 30 por dois sorvetes e duas tortas é um pouco alto, além do estacionamento. Agradeceria muito o apoio da comunidade local.
text_en: I was impressed by this! The cereal milk ice cream with corn flakes is incredible. The amount of sweetness in the ice cream combined with the corn flakes is perfect. It was light and creamy, but not too heavy. We bought two “crack” cakes too; they were also very good. The cake with dark sugar is divine. They’re small, but the quantity is just right, as they’re really tasty. The only criticism I have is the price. I know it’s a well-known place, but paying $30 for two ice creams and two cakes is a bit high, especially considering the parking costs. I would greatly appreciate the support from the local community.
original: This placed wowed me! The cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes is crazy good. It's just the right amount of sweetness in the soft serve mixed with the corn flakes. It was light and creamy, but not heavy. We took home 2 crack pies which was also really good. Butter the brown sugar is heaven. They're small but it's the perfect amount because they're rich. My only only con would be the prices. I know it's the cosmo, but I'm local and paying $30 for 2 soft serves and 2 pies is kind of crazy + parking. Local love would be appreciated.

text: Decidi experimentar o "toffee banofi" depois de ver o prato que considero o melhor que já provei. Gostei, mas não se comparava com o que foi exibido na televisão. O "toffee banofi" que o Alton serviu tinha 3 bolas de sorvete e não vinha em um copo de waffle. A quantidade de caramelo e a crocância eram menores do que o mostrado e apresentado na loja. O sabor era ótimo, mas fiquei com a impressão de que mostraram um prato diferente no canal de culinária e, considerando o preço de US$ 7,75, eu esperaria algo mais generoso em termos de caramelo e acompanhamentos. Infelizmente, minhas expectativas eram altas e fiquei decepcionado.
text_en: I decided to try the “Toffee Banofi” after seeing the dish that I consider to be the best I’ve ever tasted. I liked it, but it wasn’t comparable to what was shown on TV. The “Toffee Banofi” served by Alton had 3 ice cream balls and wasn’t served in a waffle cup. The amount of caramel and the crunch were less than what was shown and presented in the store. The taste was great, but I had the impression that a different dish was shown on the cooking channel. Considering the price of $7.75, I would have expected something more generous in terms of caramel and side dishes. Unfortunately, my expectations were high, and I was disappointed.
original: Went for the toffee banofi after watching the best thing I've ever ate. It was good but did not match up to the one shown on tv. The one Alton had was 3 scoops of ice cream & no waffle cup. The amount of Carmel & hard crunch was less than a 1/3 of what was shown & pictured in the shop. It was great tasting but I feel like they showed one thing on food channel & at $7.75 you would think it more than covers a few more squirts of Carmel & toppings. Unfortunately I had high expectations & was disappointed.

text: Una amplia variedad de panes y productos de panadería italianos, incluyendo los canolli más deliciosos al oeste de Nueva York. Estaba muy concurrido cuando fui el domingo, durante la hora del almuerzo.

original: A huge range of Italian breads and baked goods, including the best canolli west of NYC. Incredibly busy when I was there Sunday lunch time.

text: Día de inauguración... primeras impresiones... los precios son bastante elevados en comparación con lo que se ofrece... Para el día de inauguración, realmente no hubo mucha espera, llegué rápidamente a las cajas después de bajar del ascensor del Cosmo. Para probar diferentes sabores, opté por el combo "Los más populares" y el "milkshake" de fresa y maíz. El servicio fue rápido, aunque hubo un error en nuestro pedido que resultó en un "milkshake" de batata gratis. Se supone que estos "milkshakes" son similares a un "blizzard" de Dairy Queen o un "mcflurry". Para mi sorpresa, ninguno era excesivamente dulce, y el sabor era bastante agradable. Lo que no me convenció fueron todos los trozos que quedaban en el fondo del "milkshake". Se proporciona un "palito de boba", pero los trozos son demasiado grandes para el palito, y, lamentablemente, no hay cucharas convencionales disponibles; solo se pueden obtener palitos tipo espátula de madera. Además, la consistencia entre los dos "milkshakes" era muy diferente: uno era demasiado espeso para beber con el palito y el otro era demasiado líquido. En cuanto al "soft serve" de leche con cereales, no me pareció nada espectacular. Todavía no he probado el pastel de nueces, los "truffles" de cumpleaños y las galletas de composta de mi combo. Sin embargo, no creo que regrese a Milk; ¡hay otras opciones, más económicas, en VEGAS! Desafortunadamente... demasiado publicidad.
text_en: Opening day… initial impressions… the prices are quite high compared to what’s offered. On opening day, there wasn’t much waiting time; I quickly reached the counters after coming down from the Cosmo elevator. To try out different flavors, I chose the “Most Popular” combo and the strawberry-millet milkshake. The service was quick, though there was a mistake with our order, resulting in a free sweet potato milkshake. These milkshakes are supposed to be similar to Dairy Queen’s Blizzard or McFlurry. To my surprise, none of them were overly sweet, and the flavor was quite pleasant. What didn’t satisfy me were all the pieces left at the bottom of the milkshake. A straw is provided, but the pieces are too big for it, and unfortunately, there are no regular spoons available; only wooden spatula-like sticks can be used. Additionally, the consistency between the two milkshakes was very different: one was too thick to drink with a stick, while the other was too liquid. As for the milk soft serve with cereal, it didn’t seem very impressive. I haven’t tried the nut cake, birthday truffles, or composta cookies in my combo yet. However, I don’t think I’ll go back to Milk; there are cheaper options elsewhere at VEGAS! Unfortunately… too much advertising.
original: Opening day... first impressions... prices are rather steep for what you get... For opening day there really wasn't much wait at all, went quickly to the registers after coming off of the Cosmo escalator. To get a nice sampling I opted for the "Greatest Hits" combo and the strawberry-corn milkquake. Service was speedy despite a mistake in our order which resulted in a free sweet potato milkquake. The milkquakes are supposed to be similar to a Dairy Queen blizzard or a mcflurry. To my surprise neither was overly sweet, and taste was rather enjoyable. What missed the mark were all the leftover bits at the bottom of the milkquake. A large "boba tea straw" is provided however the chunks are too overwhelming for the straw and unfortunately no regular spoons are available, all that can be obtained is a wooden spatula type. Also the consistency between the 2 milkquakes differed greatly, one was too thick to drink with the straw and the other was super runny. As for the cereal milk soft serve, nothing too spectacular to me. I have yet to try the crack pie, bday truffles, and compost cookies from my combo. However, I don't foresee myself returning to Milk; there are other, better priced, options in VEGAS! Unfortunately.... overhyped

text: Love it!!! My boyfriend and I always walk down to get ice cream in the summer. The staff is always friendly and wonderful. The patio area is perfect on sunny days, and the ice cream is great!! I always get something involving chocolate, but you really cant go wrong! Even the wackiest combinations taste good when made by this capable staff, and nothing gets an odd look. The quality is the best on Cleveland's west side, and the service is speedy. It is a must try for anyone new, and a regular summer spot for many. Bottom line: yumm!

text: Kind of more expensive than the chain ice cream places BUT the ice cream was delicious. Tried roasted almond and the cookie monster flavors. Not too heavy and definitely the cool treat that we needed during the still hot Arizona days. Met the owner. Such a friendly guy. Moreover, the location is such a great place. We were planning to just grab ice cream and go but we felt the vibe and chilled for a bit. Even went back to grab a nice sugar cane Coca Cola from Mexico to complete the afternoon 'snack'. Sad that we were just passing through but definitely glad to help out a local owner and hope to return again.

text: Delicious chocolates. I'm sad I was too full from dinner to consider getting a cupcake. They looked decadent.
text_en: Delicious chocolates. I'm sad I was too full from dinner to consider getting a cupcake. They looked decadent.

text: Un pequeño y acogedor lugar de helados. Definitivamente tiene un ambiente especial, el interior con temática de cereales de los años 80 te transporta a otra época. A mi amiga le pedimos un tazón, "Cosmo & Wanda", con cereales de frutas y "Captain Crunch" mezclados con leche de almendras e helado, ¡y estaba deliciosa! De hecho, la leche de almendras le dio un toque dulce adicional, lo cual fue sorprendente. Una combinación perfecta. Yo pedí un batido y pedí "Mucha Lucha". Era un batido de horchata muy dulce, con un equilibrio perfecto de canela y azúcar. A ambos nos encantó. Fueron muy considerados al ayudar a organizar la fila lo más rápido posible, prestando atención a los detalles. Creo que tuvimos que cambiar algo a último momento, pero fueron excelentes comunicándose con nosotros y actuando rápidamente para solucionar cualquier problema. Definitivamente usaban guantes y todo, lo que hizo que el lugar se sintiera muy limpio y bien organizado. El personal sonreía mucho y nos encantó, nos sentimos muy cómodos y felices allí.
text_en: A small and cozy ice cream place. It definitely has a special atmosphere—the interior with its 80s cereal theme takes you back to another era. We asked our friend for a bowl of “Cosmo & Wanda,” which contains fruit cereals and “Captain Crunch” mixed with almond milk and ice cream—and it was delicious! In fact, the almond milk added an extra sweet touch, which was surprising. It was a perfect combination. I ordered a smoothie and “Mucha Lucha.” It was a very sweet horchata smoothie, with a perfect balance of cinnamon and sugar. Both of us loved it. They were very thoughtful in helping to arrange the line as quickly as possible, paying attention to every detail. I think we had to make some changes at the last minute, but they communicated well with us and acted quickly to solve any problems. They definitely wore gloves, which made the place feel very clean and well-organized. The staff smiled a lot, and we really enjoyed being there—we felt comfortable and happy.
original: Hype little ice cream spot. Definitely a vibe, throwback cereal interior gives you that nostalgia. My friend got the bowl, Cosmo & Wanda--fruit loops and captain crunch all berries with almond milk and ice cream haha, she loaded up, that was actually legit though because the almond milk almost made it sweeter if you can imagine that. Perfect Combo I went with a shake and got Mucha Lucha it was the perfect little mix basically a hella sweet horchata milkshake, perfect cinnamon sugar balance. We both enjoyed it so much. They were very considerate when helping move the line as quick as they could, paying attention to detail. I think we had to switch something last minute but they were great with communicating to us and quick to make fixes and pivot. They were definitely using gloves and all that so it felt very clean and just well run. Lots of great smiles from the staff and we loved that, we felt very comfortable and happy to be there.

text: Place was amazing Cheyanne and Alanna(Great young ladies)kept me in there longer than I shouldve been(ie. Buying more milkshakes and cupcakes) but it was well worth it. Only problem is theres NOOOOOO place to sit and it seemed like theres a spot for it. Definitely recommending it.
text_en: Place was amazing Cheyanne and Alanna(Great young ladies)kept me in there longer than I shouldve been(ie. Buying more milkshakes and cupcakes) but it was well worth it. Only problem is theres NOOOOOO place to sit and it seemed like theres a spot for it. Definitely recommending it.

text: Amelie's es un lugar maravilloso. Abre las 24 horas, ofrece buen café y mucho espacio para sentarse, por lo que es un lugar ideal para relajarse y leer. Como cualquiera te dirá, no puedes perderte el brownie de caramelo salado. ¡Lo hicieron para la Casa Blanca! Le resté una estrella, solo porque es muy común que la cola sea excesivamente larga. Obviamente, esto también es prueba del valor del lugar. Pero es casi como estar esperando en la fila para un parque de atracciones.
text_en: Amelie’s is a wonderful place. It is open 24 hours a day, offers great coffee, and has plenty of space to sit, making it an ideal spot for relaxing and reading. As anyone would say, you can’t miss out on the salty caramel brownies—they were made especially for the White House! I deduct one star just because the queue is usually too long. Obviously, this also shows the value of the place. But it’s almost like waiting in line for a theme park attraction.
original: Amelie's is a wonderful place. Open 24 hours, and offering good coffee and lots of seating, this is a staple go-hang-out-and-read spot. As anyone will tell you, you have to have the salted caramel brownie. They made them for the White House for goodness sakes. Minus 1 star, only because it is so frequently true that the line is unbearably long. Obviously that is also a testament to the value of the place. But it's almost like standing in line for a roller coaster.

text: Ubicado justo al lado de la escalera en el segundo (¿?) piso, y al lado del restaurante Momofuku, ¡allí está Milk Bar! Nunca he tenido la oportunidad de ir a Nueva York para probar estos deliciosos postres, así que quería probarlos mientras estaba en Las Vegas. Pedí el combo "Greatest Hits" (19 dólares) y tres galletas (8 dólares). El combo "Greatest Hits" incluía un helado de leche de cereal con copos de maíz, una porción de "crack pie", una galleta de compost y un paquete de 3 "truffles" de pastel de cumpleaños. También pedí otra galleta de compost, una galleta de chocolate con copos de maíz y una galleta de arándanos y crema. El helado era pequeño, pero ¡estaba delicioso! De hecho, se podía notar el sabor del cereal en el helado, como la leche cuando terminas de comer tus "Frosted Flakes". Los copos de maíz que venían con el helado estaban ligeramente salados y servían como un crujido y contraste agradable. El "crack pie" era este pastel untuoso y cremoso, dulce y delicioso. Las galletas de compost y de chocolate con copos de maíz, para mí, estaban bien, pero la galleta de arándanos y crema fue increíble: ¡tenía exactamente el mismo sabor que la parte superior de un muffin de arándanos! Sin embargo, lo mejor que compré fueron las "truffles" de pastel de cumpleaños. Tenían exactamente el mismo sabor que los "funfetti" y no estaban secas, a pesar de su apariencia.
text_en: It’s located right next to the stairs on the second floor, alongside the Momofuku restaurant. That’s where the Milk Bar is! I never had the chance to visit New York to try these delicious desserts, so I wanted to try them while I was in Las Vegas. I ordered the “Greatest Hits” combo for $19, along with three cookies for $8. The “Greatest Hits” combo included a cereal milk ice cream with corn flakes, a portion of “crack pie,” a compost cookie, and a package of 3 birthday cake truffles. I also ordered another compost cookie, a chocolate cookie with corn flakes, and a raspberry and cream cookie. The ice cream was small, but it was delicious! In fact, you could taste the cereal flavor in the ice cream, just like when you finish eating your Frosted Flakes. The corn flakes that came with the ice cream were slightly salty, which provided a nice crunch and contrast. “Crack pie” was a creamy and sweet dessert. The compost and chocolate cookies were okay, but the raspberry and cream cookie was amazing—it had exactly the same flavor as the top part of a raspberry muffin! However, the best thing I bought were the birthday cake truffles. They had the same flavor as “funfetti” and weren’t dry, despite their appearance.
original: Located right by the escalator on the second (?) floor and next to the Momofuku restaurant is Milk Bar! I haven't been able to make my way to NY to try these treats so I wanted to try them while I was in Vegas. I got the Greatest Hits Combo ($19) and three cookies ($8). The Greatest Hits came with a cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes, a slice of crack pie, a compost cookie and a 3-pack of birthday cake truffles. I also got another compost cookie, cornflake chocolate chip cookie, and a blueberry & cream cookie. The soft serve was tiny but soooo good! You can actually taste the cereal flavor in the soft serve, like the milk when you finish all your Frosted Flakes. The cornflakes on the side of the soft serve were lightly salted and served as a good crunch and contrast to the soft serve. The crack pie was this ooey-gooey buttery pie that was sweet and delicious. The compost cookie and cornflake chocolate chip cookie to me were just okay, but the blueberry & cream cookie was amazing - it tasted just like the top of a blueberry muffin! The best thing I got however were the birthday cake truffles! They tasted just like funfetti and weren't dry at all despite their appearance.

text: The food is excellent, as far as Italian bakeries go they know what they're doing. I love that they serve lunch and provide a variety of options through the week, pizza, stromboli, pasta, pasta salads, all very solid. Three stars due to service. We went on a Wednesday for lunch and I waited as the next in line for 10 minutes for my number to be called. 10 minutes in line easily feels like 30, especially when you're on your lunch break. They have it set up that one employee serves one ticket from order all the way through checkout, it's a very inefficient process during peak hours. I consider myself very patient as I used to be a waiter, but I was really close to walking out, especially when the employees started bickering about tips. Finally, when I was ready to check out my server had to wait for the sole cash register as it was being used by another employee. As Marcus Lemonis would say, the process is broken. I recommend the food, but I doubt I will return, I can't give up that much of my lunch hour just waiting....
