text: Eu os vi recentemente na Food Network e estava querendo experimentar o sundae Toffee Bonafi. É um pouco longe da minha casa, mas devo dizer que valeu a pena o trajeto. Há poucas coisas que correspondem às expectativas, e este é um deles. É praticamente o sundae perfeito e vale cada grama de culpa. Normalmente, não sou muito fã de doces e sorvete, mas o caramelo com amêndoas neste sundae é realmente delicioso. O sorvete de caramelo salgado e baunilha de Madagascar também é ainda melhor do que eu imaginava. A funcionária da loja foi muito simpática e fez um ótimo trabalho preparando meu sundae. Senti um pouco de culpa antes de devorar tudo. (Mas rapidamente esqueci.) Se você mora longe, vale a pena o trajeto. Se você mora perto, recomendo que reserve um tempo para ir. Experimente: - Toffee Bonafi
text_en: I saw them recently on Food Network, and I wanted to try the Toffee Bonafi sundae. It’s a bit far from my house, but I have to say it was worth the trip. There are few things that meet expectations, and this is one of them. It’s basically the perfect sundae, and it’s worth every gram of guilt. Usually, I’m not a big fan of sweets and ice cream, but the caramel with almonds in this sundae is really delicious. The salty caramel and vanilla ice cream from Madagascar is even better than I expected. The store employee was very kind and did an excellent job preparing my sundae. I felt a little guilty before eating it all up. (But I quickly forgot about it.) If you live far away, it’s worth the trip. If you live nearby, I recommend taking some time to go. Try it: – Toffee Bonafi
original: Saw them awhile back on The Food Network and had been meaning to try the Toffee Bonafi Sundae. It's a haul from my house, but I will have to say it was worth the drive. There are few things that live up to what you think they will be in life and this is one of them. It's pretty much the perfect sundae and well worth the guilt. I'm not a fan of candy and ice cream usually, but the toffee with almonds on this thing is pretty amazing. The salted caramel and madagascar vanilla ice cream are also even better than I imagined them to be. The girl behind the counter was really nice and did a great job constructing my sundae. I felt guilty for half a second before I destroying it. ( I quickly got over it. ) If you live far from Shea it's worth the drive. If you live close by I feel for the gym time you need to put in. Try: - Toffee Bonafi

text: O sabor do creme puff é o melhor! Geralmente há uma fila, então tente ir durante a tarde, em dias úteis. Também é possível fazer o pedido online e solicitar a entrega, caso você compre potes. Gosto que eles permitem que você experimente alguns sabores antes de decidir qual pedir. Custa cerca de 5 dólares por porção, então certifique-se de aproveitar cada pedaço!
text_en: The flavor of the puff cream is the best! Usually, there’s a line, so try to go during the afternoon on weekdays. You can also order online and have it delivered, if you buy the pouches. I like that they allow you to try out several flavors before deciding which one to order. It costs about $5 per serving, so make sure to enjoy every piece!
original: The cream puff flavor is the best! There tends to be a line so try to go middle of the day on weekdays. You can also order online and request delivery if you order pints. I love that they let you sample a few if you're unsure of which to order. ~$5 a scoop so make sure you eat every bit!

text: Chegamos bem tarde e não estávamos seguros se ainda teriam muitas opções disponíveis. A equipe estava muito simpática e atenciosa. Conseguimos experimentar o bolo de veludo vermelho, bolo de pão, brownie e biscoito com gotas de chocolate. Tudo estava delicioso!!! Com certeza voltaremos para experimentar mais itens e tomar café.
text_en: We arrived quite late, and we weren’t sure if there would still be many options available. The staff was very friendly and attentive. We were able to try the red velvet cake, bread cake, brownies, and chocolate-dusted cookies. Everything was delicious!!! We definitely will come back to try more items and have coffee.
original: We stopped in pretty late and wasnt sure if they would have many options left. The staff working was really friendly and patient..We were able to try the red velvet cake, pound cake, brownie and chocolate chip cookie.. Everything was amazing!!! We definitely will be back to try some more items and coffee..

text: Paramos depois de um jantar ruim. Serviço: rápido, amigável e eficiente. No geral, excelente. Sabores: grande variedade, criativos e não muito doces. Textura (quantidade de ar no sorvete e cremosidade): excelente. Preço: justo.
text_en: We stopped after a poor dinner. Service: fast, friendly, and efficient. Overall, excellent. Flavors: a wide variety, creative, and not too sweet. Texture (amount of air in the ice cream and creaminess): excellent. Price: fair.
original: Stopped in after a bad dinner. Service: quick, friendly, efficient. Excellent over all Flavors: great selection, creative and not too sweet Texture ( amount of air in ice cream and creaminess): excellent Price: Fair

text: Los pasteles son increíbles, pero el sándwich para el desayuno tenía un poco de sal.
text_en: The pastries are incredible, but the breakfast sandwich had a little bit of salt.
original: Pastry is amazing but the breakfast sandwich was a little salty.

text: Too sweet and sugary for my liking, but this is definitely a cute place for families and kids to go to. There are lots of options. I would definitely recommend going here though if you have a sweet tooth.
text_en: Too sweet and sugary for my liking, but this is definitely a cute place for families and kids to go to. There are lots of options. I would definitely recommend going here though if you have a sweet tooth.

text: ¡Me encanta este lugar popular en el centro! A mis hijos les encanta comprarlos como un capricho, y los hemos usado en fiestas y reuniones de trabajo. El personal siempre es muy amable y atento. Es fácil llegar caminando desde Fremont st y Container Park. Está cerca de Life is Beautiful y del arte callejero que se mantiene durante todo el año.
text_en: I love this popular place in the center! My children love buying them as a treat, and we’ve used them at parties and work meetings. The staff is always very friendly and attentive. It’s easy to get there on foot from Fremont St. and Container Park. It’s also close to Life is Beautiful and the street art that remains available all year round.
original: Love this downtown hot spot! My kids like getting these as a treat and we've had them at parties and work gathering. Staff is always super nice and friendly. Easy location to walk to from Fremont st and container park. Close to life is beautiful and year round street art.

text: Probablemente los mejores donuts de Cleveland, ¡y es increíble que también sean veganos! Siempre tienen los clásicos y sabores nuevos y divertidos. Probé los de glaseado, cítricos y cardamomo, limón y lavanda, y tiramisú. Todos estaban deliciosos, y siempre están cambiando el menú. Asegúrate de llegar temprano, porque a menudo se agotan los sabores más tarde en la tarde. Definitivamente volveré la próxima vez que tenga antojo de un donut.
text_en: Probably the best donuts in Cleveland—and it’s amazing that they’re also vegan! They always have the classic options, as well as fun and unique flavors. I tried those with glaze, citrus and cardamom, lemon and lavender, and tiramisu. All of them were delicious, and their menu keeps changing. Make sure to arrive early, because the favorite flavors often run out later in the afternoon. I’ll definitely come back next time I feel like eating a donut.
original: Probably the best donuts in Cleveland, and incredible that they're vegan too! They always have the classics and fun new flavors - I got the glazed, citrus and cardamom, lavender lemon, tiramisu. All were great and they're always changing up the menu! Be sure to get in on the earlier side, because they do sell out of flavor later in the afternoon. Definitely going back next time I'm craving a donut.

text: Sou um grande fã de donuts e, acredite, já visitei lugares onde eles têm donuts incríveis. Este é, sem dúvida, um dos melhores lugares para comer donuts que já experimentei. É como um tesouro escondido no centro da cidade. O local abre (aos domingos) às 8h (horário do Pacífico). Você encontrará uma fila se formando a partir das 7h30. Às 8h, a loja abre e alguém sai para contar quantas crianças estão na fila com suas famílias naquele momento... O chef e seus assistentes saem com uma bandeja de donuts recém-feitos para as crianças e entregam cada um. Os assistentes entregam um balão para as crianças. Então, eles começam a atendê-lo. Ao entrar na loja, você é recebido com um sorriso e um aroma maravilhoso de donuts, creme e café. Eles se dedicam a atendê-lo, respondem às suas perguntas e preparam seu pedido. Quando você chega ao caixa, seu pedido já está pronto! O local é limpo, com um ambiente alegre e agradável, um ótimo atendimento e donuts incríveis. É IMPRESCINDÍVEL visitar este lugar e experimentar os donuts!
text_en: I’m a huge fan of donuts, and believe me, I’ve been to places where they have amazing donuts. This is undoubtedly one of the best places I’ve ever tried for donuts. It’s like a hidden treasure right in the center of the city. The store opens (on Sundays) at 8 a.m. (Pacific Time). You’ll see a line forming by 7:30 a.m. At 8 a.m., the store opens, and someone goes out to count how many children with their families are in line at that time… The chef and his assistants come out with a tray of freshly made donuts for the children and hand them out one by one. The assistants also give each child a balloon. Then they start serving customers. When you enter the store, you’re greeted with a smile and the wonderful smell of donuts, cream, and coffee. They take great care to serve you, answer your questions, and prepare your order. By the time you reach the checkout, your order is already ready! The place is clean, with a cheerful and pleasant atmosphere, excellent service, and amazing donuts. It’s absolutely essential to visit this place and try the donuts!
original: I am big fan of Donuts and believe me I have been to palaces where they have amazing donuts. This is by far one of the best donuts place I have been too. It is like hidden gem in downtown. Place opens (on Sundays) at 8am (pst). You will find line forming from 7:30am. 8am store opens and some one comes out from store and counts how many kids they have in line with their family at that time...Chef and his assistance comes out with plate of freshly made donuts for kids and gives them each. Assistance hand over balloon to kids. Then they start serving you. You get in the shop and welcomed with smile and amazing smell of fresh donuts, cream and coffee. They take time to serve you, answer your questions and get your order ready. By the time you get to cashier, your order is ready! Place is clean, great happy environment, awesome service and amazing donuts. MUST VISIT THIS PLACE AND HAVE DONUTS....

text: Fui después de la cena en Ohio City, un viernes. Había una fila, aunque no demasiado larga, y el servicio era rápido. Los sabores que ofrecían en la vitrina eran interesantes, pero ninguno realmente me convenció. Sin embargo, había varios sabores en el "tablero de ideas" que parecían geniales, así que quizás simplemente tuve una mala noche. Pedí un sándwich de helado con churros, con helado de vainilla, pero pedí solo una porción de helado en lugar de dos, ya que ya estaba bastante lleno después de la cena. Los churros estaban muy buenos, calientes y recién sacados de la freidora. El helado, en cambio, no estaba mal, pero tampoco era excepcional (para mí). También he probado su helado en otras ocasiones en festivales, etc. Quizás simplemente no es de mi gusto. Pero esto no significa que algunos de sus sabores sean muy interesantes y divertidos, y que ir simplemente a ver qué ofrecen y si algo suena bien no sea una mala idea.
text_en: I went to Ohio City on a Friday after dinner. There was a line, though not very long, and service was quick. The flavors displayed in the window were interesting, but none really caught my attention. However, there were several flavors on the “idea board” that seemed great, so maybe it was just a bad night for me. I ordered a ice cream sandwich with churros, with vanilla ice cream. But I asked for just one portion of ice cream instead of two, since it was already quite full after dinner. The churros were very good—hot and freshly made from the freezer. The ice cream wasn’t bad, but it wasn’t exceptional either (for me). I’ve also tried their ice cream at other festivals and such. Maybe it just isn’t my favorite. But that doesn’t mean all their flavors are very interesting or fun. It’s just a good idea to check out what they have and see if something suits your taste.
original: Came after dinner in Ohio City on a Friday. Line was kind of long but it moved quickly. The flavors in the case were interesting but none of them really struck my fancy. There were a bunch of flavors on the "idea board" that sounded awesome though, so maybe I just hit on an off night for me. I ordered a churro ice cream sandwich with vanilla ice cream- except I asked for only 1 scoop of ice cream rather than 2 as I was kind of full from dinner. The churro was very good. Warm and straight outta the fryer. The ice cream was, meh. It wasn't bad, but it was nothing special either (for me). I've also sampled their ice cream a few other times at festivals etc. maybe its just not for me. But that's not to say that some of their flavors are very interesting and fun and coming here just to see what they have and if anything sounds good isn't a bad idea.

text: Provavelmente, este é um dos lugares mais únicos que já visitei. Estava caminhando pela cidade de Charlotte e um amigo me recomendou este lugar. Definitivamente, é o meu lugar favorito para tomar café até agora. A arte é muito criativa e bonita. Tirei muitas fotos. O café estava incrível. É imperativo que você experimente este lugar.
text_en: Probably, this is one of the most unique places I’ve ever been to. I was walking through Charlotte and a friend recommended this place to me. It’s definitely my favorite place to have coffee so far. The art is very creative and beautiful. I took many photos. The café was amazing. You really should try this place out.
original: This is probably one of the most unique places I've ever been to. I was walking through the city of Charlotte and I friend recommended me this place. Has to be my favorite spot to have coffee thus far. The art work is so creative and beautiful. I took pictures nonstop. The coffee was amazing. You have to definitely try this spot.

text: Eu adoro o Sprinkles. Seus cupcakes são deliciosos de forma consistente, então você nunca precisa se preocupar com um dia ruim. Também gostei que este local tenha sua nova loja de sorvetes. Ainda não experimentei, mas pretendo fazê-lo em breve. Eles preparam sundes com pedaços de qualquer sabor de cupcake que você desejar, sanduíches de biscoito, milkshakes/malts, chocolate quente congelado, até mesmo cones de "red velvet"! Incrível. A variedade à noite é um pouco limitada, então tente chegar mais cedo durante o dia, se possível. Paramos depois de andar no High Roller (que fica ao lado) e compramos dois mini cupcakes (limão e baunilha). Meu sabor favorito é o de baunilha, assim como o de canela, banana, e o "red velvet" vegano. Como alguém que não é vegano, isso diz muito. Também há sabores sazonais sempre disponíveis (atualmente, caramelo e abóbora), e eles também fazem cupcakes para cães, que nossas meninas adoram. Agora, eles também têm um programa de recompensas gratuito, com muitos benefícios interessantes, como um cupcake de presente no seu aniversário, qualquer item do menu gratuito sempre que você acumular 15 pontos, acesso a eventos exclusivos, promoções "compre um, leve outro", e passes para pular a fila. A fila do sorvete costuma ser mais longa aqui do que a do cupcake (já que é sobremesa), então você deve conseguir entrar e sair de forma relativamente rápida, se o seu objetivo são os cupcakes.
text_en: I really love Sprinkles. Their cupcakes are always delicious, so you never have to worry about a bad day. I also liked that they have their new ice cream shop. I haven’t tried it yet, but I plan to do so soon. They make sandwiches with pieces of any cupcake flavor you like—biscuit sandwiches, milkshakes/malt drinks, frozen hot chocolate, even “red velvet” cones! It’s amazing. The evening menu is a bit limited, so try to arrive earlier during the day if possible. We stopped at the High Roller (next to them) and bought two mini cupcakes (lemon and vanilla). My favorite flavors are vanilla and cinnamon, as well as banana and the vegan “red velvet” flavor. As someone who isn’t vegan, this says a lot. There are also seasonal flavors available all the time (currently caramel and pumpkin), and they also make dog cupcakes, which our girls love. They also have a free rewards program with many interesting benefits: a cupcake as a gift on your birthday, free items from the menu whenever you accumulate 15 points, access to exclusive events, “buy one, get one free” promotions, and queue-buster passes. The ice cream queue is usually longer than the cupcake queue (since it’s a dessert), so you should be able to enter and exit quickly if your goal is just getting cupcakes.
original: I love Sprinkles. Their cupcakes are consistently delicious, so you never have to worry about them having an off day. I also liked that this location has their new ice cream shop. I haven't tried it yet, but want to soon. They do sundaes with bits of any flavor of cupcake you want folded in, cookie sandwiches, shakes/malts, frozen hot chocolate, even red velvet cones! Um, sold. The selection at night is pretty scarce so try to come earlier in the day if you can. We stopped by after ridding the High Roller (which is next-door) and got two mini cupcakes (lemon and vanilla). Their vanilla is my absolute favorite as is their triple cinnamon, banana, sprinkle, and vegan red velvet. As someone who is not a vegan, that says a lot. There is always fun seasonal flavors too (right now it's caramel apple and pumpkin) and they also make doggy cupcakes which our girls go nuts for. They now have a free rewards program as well with a ton of cool perks such as a complimentary cupcake on your birthday, any free menu item of your choice each time you hit 15 points, access to exclusive events, bogo deals, and skip the line passes. The ice cream line is always longer here than the cupcake one (being a desert and all), so you should be able to get in and out fairly quickly if cupcakes are all you're after.

text: Los donuts son bastante buenos, tienen sabores interesantes y, en general, parecen tener una buena cantidad de glaseado, si eso es lo que busca. Me alegró que no estuviera muy concurrido cuando fui, ya que tuve que preguntar sobre los sabores, ya que ninguno estaba etiquetado. Al final, compré algunos donuts de chocolate con glaseado festivo y dos con glaseado de frambuesa. Volvería si estuviera en la zona.
text_en: The donuts are quite good; they have interesting flavors, and generally seem to have plenty of frosting, if that’s what you’re looking for. I was glad that it wasn’t very crowded when I went there, as I had to ask about the flavors, since none of them were labeled. In the end, I bought some chocolate donuts with festive frosting, and two with cranberry frosting. I would go back if I were in the area again.
original: Pretty good donuts, fun flavors, and most seem to be heavy on the frosting if that's what you're looking for. I was glad that it wasn't super busy when I went since I had to ask questions about what each flavor was since non of them were labeled. I ended up with a couple festive chocolate frosted donuts and two raspberry glazed. I would come again if in the area.

text: The Chocolate Shoppe provides quintessential Wisconsin ice cream. As they fully claim, it's not health food and not meant to be taken as such. It's simply good ice cream of a wide variety of flavors. They also have malts and ice cream sodas, as well as coffee. Basically, a great place, and an absolutely necessary place during the hot summer months.
text_en: The Chocolate Shoppe provides quintessential Wisconsin ice cream. As they fully claim, it's not health food and not meant to be taken as such. It's simply good ice cream of a wide variety of flavors. They also have malts and ice cream sodas, as well as coffee. Basically, a great place, and an absolutely necessary place during the hot summer months.

text: ¡Es nuestro postre favorito en familia! Nos encanta el pastel de zanahoria y el de red velvet. A los niños les encantan las barras de limón y las galletas. Paul y Amanda son maravillosos, amables y atentos. ¡Estamos muy contentos de que hayan abierto una panadería en Concord!
text_en: It’s our favorite dessert for family gatherings! We love the carrot cake and the red velvet cake. The kids love lemon bars and cookies. Paul and Amanda are wonderful, kind, and attentive. We’re very happy that they opened a bakery in Concord!
original: Our family favorite! Love the red velvet and carrot cakes. Kids love the lemon bars and cookies. Paul and Amanda are wonderful, warm and friendly. So glad they have come to Concord!

text: Solía frecuentar este lugar con regularidad. El guardia de seguridad era un completo idiota y me insultó delante de todo el mundo porque estaba apoyando los pies en la mesa frente al sofá en el que estaba sentado, después de que ya me hubiera disculpado. Nunca más volveré.
text_en: I used to visit this place regularly. The security guard was a complete idiot; he insulted me in front of everyone because I was resting my feet on the table next to the sofa where I was sitting, even after I had already apologized. I will never go there again.
original: I used to be a regular here. The security guard was a complete a-hole and insulted me in front of the entire place because I had my feet on the table in front of the couch I was sitting on, after I had already apologized. Never going there again.

text: Desculpe, mas entreguei meu dinheiro... Funcionários muito mal-educados. Os quatro estavam ocupados (ou fingindo estar) com as costas viradas para os clientes, e quando finalmente se viraram, não fizeram contato visual. Se isso continuasse, eu teria ido embora! Depois de receber a ajuda, tivemos que repetir a seleção de sabores várias vezes. Embora o sorvete fosse delicioso, as porções eram pequenas e caras. 7,57 dólares por duas pequenas porções não valia a pena. Por fim, o caixa parecia suspeito, acho que estava tentando me enganar para não devolver a diferença. Depois de dar a ele 20 dólares para as 7,57 que eu devia, ele me deu o comprovante e então parou. Acho que ele estava esperando que eu fosse embora naquele momento. Ele só me devolveu a diferença quando eu pedi. Cuidado, pessoal... tenham cuidado...
text_en: Sorry, but I’ve already given my money… The staff were very rude. All four of them were busy (or pretending to be busy), with their backs turned to the customers. When they finally turned around, they didn’t make eye contact at all. If this continued, I would have left! After receiving some help, we had to repeat the flavor selection several times. Although the ice cream was delicious, the portions were small and expensive. $7.57 for two small portions wasn’t worth it. Finally, the cashier seemed suspicious; I think he was trying to trick me so he wouldn’t have to give me back the difference. After giving him $20 for the $7.57 I owed, he gave me the receipt and then stopped. I think he was waiting for me to leave right then. He only gave me back the difference when I asked. Be careful, folks… be careful…
original: Sorry I gave them my money... Super rude employee's. All four were occupied (or pretending to be) with their backs to the customers and when they did face the customers, they did not make eye contact. One more second of this crap and I was out of there! Once helped, we had to repeat our flavor selection several times. Although the Ice Cream was delicious the scoops were small and expensive. $7.57 for two small scoops was not worth it. Lastly, the cashier was a little shady, I think he was attempting to scam me out of my change. After giving him a $20 for the $7.57 that I owed him, he gave me my receipt and then paused. I think he was expecting me to walk away at this point. He only gave me my change when I asked for it. Beware people... beware...

text: Padaria/café com muita publicidade exagerada. A decoração é horrível, embora muitas pessoas a chamem de "abstrata". Parece que comprou cadeiras e mesas em 10 diferentes vendas de garagem e as colocou em um único local. Os doces não eram ruins, mas também não eram excepcionais. Pedi dois doces e duas bebidas geladas quando visitei. Os doces foram servidos rapidamente, mas a atendente com cabelo laranja, que preparou as bebidas geladas, não pareceu se importar, pois estava no celular.
text_en: A bakery/café with excessive advertising. The decor is awful, although many people call it “abstract”. It seems like they bought chairs and tables from 10 different garage sales and put them all together in one place. The desserts weren’t bad, but they weren’t exceptional either. I ordered two desserts and two cold drinks when I visited. The desserts were served quickly, but the waitress with orange hair who prepared the cold drinks didn’t seem to care, as she was on her phone.
original: Very over hyped bakery/cafe. The decor is hideous, although many people will call it "abstract." It looks as if you bought chairs and tables from 10 different garage sales and put them all in one location. The desserts were not bad, but not great either. Ordered two desserts and two iced coffees when I visited. The desserts were served promptly, but the girl with orange hair that served the iced coffee couldn't be bothered as she was on her phone.

text: ¿Adivinen qué descubrí hoy? Esta heladería, o mejor dicho, esta boutique de helados artesanales, tiene un chef. Por lo tanto, en el momento de escribir esta reseña, ya hay 259 reseñas que informan a todos sobre la existencia de helados deliciosos. Por lo tanto, yo me limitaré a una reseña, ¡pero sus helados son buenos! Pedí el helado de chocolate con sal y caramelo. Generalmente, cuando se pide un helado con chocolate caliente, uno espera una porción generosa de chocolate caliente que derrite un poco el helado. Aquí, en cambio, se obtiene una ración más ligera, ya que el chocolate caliente viene en un frasco cuadrado que parece una botella, y se guarda en algo que parece una olla llena de agua. Vale, entiendo, no quieren arruinar sus helados artesanales, pero yo no clasificaría lo que pedí como un helado con chocolate caliente, sino más bien como "una porción de helado con un chorrito de salsa de chocolate". De todas formas, disfruté del helado con una de las tres opciones gratuitas que ofrecen, las escamas de sal marina (que eran negras para que vieran cuánto están usando), lo que hizo que el helado fuera un poco más especial, seguido de su nata casera. Por cierto, las otras dos opciones gratuitas son los chispas de colores y el aceite de oliva virgen extra. Elegí disfrutar del "helado con un chorrito de salsa de chocolate" en un cuenco de gofres recién hechos, que eran muy cremosos y deliciosos, pero, siendo honestos, la mantequilla hace que todo sea mejor. La primera mitad del helado se disfrutó en una silla súper incómoda, pero con un diseño moderno. Cuando mi zona coccígea comenzó a doler, pasé a su mesa, que parecía tener un relieve en la parte posterior, pensando que podría conseguir un masaje, pero, lamentablemente, no pude leerlo :( En cualquier caso, helados buenos que vale la pena probar al menos una vez, así que ahorren dinero, ya que son caros.
text_en: Can you guess what I discovered today? This ice cream shop, or rather, this boutique selling handmade ice creams, has a chef working there. So, at the time I wrote this review, there are already 259 reviews that tell everyone about the delicious ice creams available. Therefore, I’ll just write one review myself, but their ice creams are really good! I ordered the chocolate with salt and caramel ice cream. Usually, when ordering hot chocolate ice cream, you expect a generous portion of hot chocolate that will melt some of the ice cream. But here, the portion is lighter, as the hot chocolate comes in a square bottle-like container, and it’s stored in something that looks like a pot filled with water. I get it—they don’t want to ruin their handmade ice creams, but I wouldn’t classify what I ordered as hot chocolate ice cream; instead, it’s more like “a portion of ice cream with a little bit of chocolate sauce”. Anyway, I enjoyed the ice cream along with one of the three free options they offer: sea salt flakes (which were black so you could see how much was used), which made the ice cream a little more special, followed by their homemade cream. By the way, the other two free options are colored sprinkles and extra virgin olive oil. I chose to enjoy the “ice cream with a little bit of chocolate sauce” in a bowl of freshly made gofret, which was very creamy and delicious. But honestly, butter makes everything better. The first half of the ice cream was enjoyed on a super uncomfortable chair, but with a modern design. When my stomach started to hurt, I went to their table, which had a relief pattern on the back, thinking I might get a massage, but unfortunately, I couldn’t read it :( In any case, it’s good ice cream that’s worth trying at least once. So save your money, since they’re expensive.
original: Guess what I learned today? This ice cream shop, nay, ahem, this artisan cream of ice boutique, has a chef! So, as of writing this review, there have been 259 others written that let everyone know that they have delicious ice cream. So I will keep mine to a minimum, their ice cream is good! I ordered the Salted Caramel Hot Fudge Sundae. Generally, when one gets a hot fudge sundae you expect a scoop full of hot fudge that melts a bit of your ice cream. Well, here you get more of a lukewarm drizzle, as the hot fudge is in a condiment looking squreze bottle that is kept in what looks like a crock pot full of water. Okay, I get it, they don't want to ruin their artisan ice cream, but I would not classify what I ordered as a hot fudge sundae, but rather a "scoop of ice cream with a drizzle of fudge sauce". Anyhoo, I had the sundae topped with one of their three complimentary toppings, the sea salt flakes, (which were black so as they can see how much they are putting on) that made the sundae a little more special, followed by their house-made whipped cream. FYI, the other two complimentary toppings are rainbow sprinkles and EVOO. I chose to enjoy the "scoop of ice cream with a drizzle of fudge sauce" in their freshly made waffle bowl that was super buttery, but delicious, but lets be honest, butter makes everything better. The first half of my sundae was enjoyed in a super uncomfortable, yet modern looking chair. As my coccyx began to bruise, I moved onto their booth that looked like it had brail background along the back thinking I might be able to get a massage, but negative ghost rider, I couldn't tell it was brail :( Anyway, good ice cream that you should experience at least once, so save up your money because it is expensive for frozen cream of ice.

text: ¡Guau! De verdad. Bendito sea el ganado cuyo leche dio origen a este helado. Es una pequeña tienda ubicada en uno de los cabios restaurados de un antiguo campo de prisioneros, así que prepárense para ser pacientes si es un momento de mucha afluencia. El helado es sorprendentemente delicioso, cremoso y creativo. Como soy una persona sencilla, probé el helado de caramelo con bourbon. ¡Es fantástico! Lleven su postre y siéntense en el patio. Observen cómo se pone el sol sobre las encantadoras cabañas restauradas. Si son personas de la noche, observen cómo surge la luna. Si tienen hambre, compren pizza en la calle de al lado primero. El dueño también es muy amable. Es genial conocer gente que disfruta de lo que hacen.
text_en: Wow! Really. Bless the cattle whose milk gave rise to this ice cream. It’s a small shop located in one of the restored cabins from an old prison camp. So, be prepared to be patient if there’s a lot of traffic at times. The ice cream is surprisingly delicious, creamy, and creative. As someone who is simple-minded, I tried the caramel with bourbon ice cream. It’s fantastic! Bring your dessert and sit in the courtyard. Watch how the sun shines on the charming restored cabins. If you’re people who enjoy the night, watch how the moon appears. If you’re hungry, buy pizza from the street next to the shop first. The owner is also very kind. It’s great to meet people who enjoy what they do.
original: Holy cow. Literally. Bless the cow whose milk made this ice cream. It's a tiny shop in one of a cluster of restored POW-camp cabins, so be prepared to be patient if it's a popular time. The ice cream is startlingly delicious, creamy, and creative. Being basic, I tried the bourbon caramel. It is fantastic. Take your dish and sit on the patio. Watch the sun set over the picturesque restored cottages. Watch the moon rise, if you're a night person. Get pizza across the street first, if you're hungry. The owner is super-nice, too. It's so cool meeting people who love what they do.

text: Not really crazy about the ice cream. Some flavors are cloyingly sweet and hard to finish. Then there's the ingredients. This ice cream always tastes like it's got stabilizers and gums (and who knows what else) in it which I really don't like in my ice cream.
text_en: Not really crazy about the ice cream. Some flavors are cloyingly sweet and hard to finish. Then there's the ingredients. This ice cream always tastes like it's got stabilizers and gums (and who knows what else) in it which I really don't like in my ice cream.

text: Esta joya está cerca de la universidad y cerca del aeropuerto. Está en una parcela de esquina y en el lado interior del estacionamiento, así que casi la perdimos. ¡Qué bueno que la encontramos! Definitivamente, esta está en nuestra lista de lugares que visitar cuando estemos en Phoenix. El helado de chocolate fue, sin duda, el mejor helado que he probado. No, no tenía mucha hambre: era cremoso y delicioso. El hecho de que estuviera dentro de un donut y cubierto de Oreos lo hizo aún más increíble. Y estamos de vacaciones, así que cero calorías, ¿verdad?
text_en: This gem is located near the university and close to the airport. It’s in a corner plot, on the inner side of the parking area, so we almost missed it. Thank goodness we found it! Definitely on our list of places to visit when we’re in Phoenix. The chocolate ice cream was, without a doubt, the best ice cream I’ve ever tasted. No, I wasn’t very hungry—it was creamy and delicious. The fact that it was inside a donut and covered with Oreo cookies made it even more amazing. And we’re on vacation, so zero calories, right?
original: This gem is near the university and close to the airport. It's on a corner lot and on the interior side of the parking lot, so we almost missed it. So glad we found it - This is officially on our list of stops when visiting Phoenix! The chocolate ice cream was hands down the very best ice cream I've ever had! No, I wasn't starving:) It was creamy and rich - so good! The fact that it was wedged inside a donut and sprinkled with Oreos just made it that much more amazing. And we're on vacation, so zero calories, right?

text: Adoro este lugar, o sorvete é incrível. Minha única reclamação é que eles acabam com os biscoitos, então perco a oportunidade de experimentar meus favoritos. O sorvete de caramelo salgado com um biscoito de chocolate é simplesmente delicioso.
text_en: I love this place; the ice cream is amazing. My only complaint is that they run out of cookies, so I miss the chance to try my favorite ones. The salty caramel ice cream with a chocolate cookie is simply delicious.
original: Love this place the icecream is amazing my only complaint is they run out of cookies so I miss out on my favorites a lot . The salted caramel with a chocolate chip cookie is crazy good.

text: I hate ice cream. I hate it because it is so good. Churn is on top of my hate list. Salted caramel is hated too.. especially with cocolate ice cream... talk about hate.
text_en: I hate ice cream. I hate it because it is so good. Churn is on top of my hate list. Salted caramel is hated too.. especially with cocolate ice cream... talk about hate.

text: The BEST ice cream in AZ!! It is tasty, fresh and soo DELICIOUS! Their donuts pair perfectly with the ice cream (donut sandwich), and they have a lot of flavors of ice cream. Floats are made with your choice of ice cream and your choice of soda. A must have when you are craving and need your sweet tooth fix!
text_en: The BEST ice cream in AZ!! It is tasty, fresh and soo DELICIOUS! Their donuts pair perfectly with the ice cream (donut sandwich), and they have a lot of flavors of ice cream. Floats are made with your choice of ice cream and your choice of soda. A must have when you are craving and need your sweet tooth fix!

text: ¡Están en una posición totalmente merecida en la clasificación! Estos donuts son simplemente increíbles y deliciosos. El chef Jeff es una persona fantástica; tuvimos un pedido de última hora para el día siguiente, y nos entregó una colección de donuts personalizados y fantásticos para nuestro evento. Habíamos probado en otros lugares, pero al entrar en su tienda, ya sabíamos que íbamos a terminar aquí. El ambiente es muy relajado, el personal es amable y el ambiente es excelente. ¡Este es el lugar al que hay que ir!
text_en: They are in a truly deserved position in the rankings! These donuts are simply incredible and delicious. Chef Jeff is an amazing person; we had a last-minute order for the next day, and he delivered a collection of custom, fantastic donuts for our event. We’ve tried elsewhere, but when we entered his store, we knew we would end up here. The atmosphere is very relaxed, the staff is friendly, and the overall experience is excellent. This is a place you really should visit!
original: Rightfully high in the ranking! These Donuts are just dreamy and so delicious! Chef Jeff is an awesome guy, we had a last minute order for the next day and he delivered a fantastic customized donut collection for our event. We had tasted at several other locations, but actually when stepping into their shop, we already knew we would end up here. The atmosphere is very relaxed, nice crew and great ambiance! This is the place to go!

text: Made a quick stop on a Saturday, mid-afternoon. There were a few spaces for street parking during the summer in front of the bakery, and although the line was long, if was pretty fast. We tried cannolis, an apple tart-like pastry, and something akin to a cinnamon roll. All delicious! We will be back! Note: There is a Catholic church across the street. This seems like a great place to stop by after church!
text_en: Made a quick stop on a Saturday, mid-afternoon. There were a few spaces for street parking during the summer in front of the bakery, and although the line was long, if was pretty fast. We tried cannolis, an apple tart-like pastry, and something akin to a cinnamon roll. All delicious! We will be back! Note: There is a Catholic church across the street. This seems like a great place to stop by after church!

text: Atendimento excelente e amigável. Sabores de sorvete criativos, especialmente o Cinnamon Toast Crunch, que foi muito apreciado. O marshmallow foi flambado perfeitamente. Infelizmente, o macaron não foi tão bom. Era muito mastigoso, e não deveria ser assim.
text_en: Excellent and friendly service. The ice cream flavors are creative, especially the Cinnamon Toast Crunch, which was very appreciated. The marshmallow was served perfectly. Unfortunately, the macarons weren’t as good. They were too chewy, and they shouldn’t be like that.
original: Phenomenal, friendly service. Inventive ice cream flavors, especially enjoyed Cinnamon Toast Crunch. The marshmallow was flambeed to perfection. Unfortunately, the macaron was meh. Very chewy, and that's not how macarons should be.

text: Eu costumava gostar dos seus biscoitos, mas a qualidade e o sabor diminuíram muito. Esta é a terceira vez que compro os biscoitos e, desta vez, o sabor está rançoso e, de forma geral, simplesmente não têm um bom gosto. Depois de toda a fama que esta padaria ganhou, parece que os esforços não estão mais lá. Existe uma razão pela qual as pessoas elogiavam este lugar quando ele foi inaugurado, mas vamos lá! Se a sua paixão pela confeitaria não refletir nos resultados, você vai perder seus clientes.
text_en: I used to like your cookies, but their quality and taste have greatly declined. This is the third time I’m buying them, and this time, the taste is bad, and overall, they simply don’t have a good flavor. After all the fame this bakery has gained, it seems that the efforts aren’t evident anymore. There must be a reason why people praised this place when it opened, but come on! If your passion for baking doesn’t show in the results, you’ll lose your customers.
original: I used to like their cookies, but the quality and taste has declined tremendously. This is the third time in a row I've bought the cookies and it tastes stale and just doesn't taste good in general. After all the hype this bakery has gotten, the efforts aren't there anymore. There's a reason why people raved about this place when it first opened, but come on! You're going to lose your customers if your passion for baking doesn't reflect the results.

text: Been to this place many times. Pastries and drinks are good and employees are nice but they need to improve the drink orders. Often times they run out of what I go there for which is the mango coconut pearl. Today, a guy before me warned me to check on my drink order because they forget some orders and he's been waiting for his order for a while. Sure enough, they forgot about my order. People who placed their orders after me got their orders before me until I asked them where my drinks were. I'm just disappointed.
text_en: Been to this place many times. Pastries and drinks are good and employees are nice but they need to improve the drink orders. Often times they run out of what I go there for which is the mango coconut pearl. Today, a guy before me warned me to check on my drink order because they forget some orders and he's been waiting for his order for a while. Sure enough, they forgot about my order. People who placed their orders after me got their orders before me until I asked them where my drinks were. I'm just disappointed.

text: He probado sus productos antes, pero esta fue mi primera visita. Lo mejor fue recibir respuestas completas y precisas por parte del personal. El personal merece un aplauso. El pastel que elegí tenía una textura perfecta. A. Lo único que le impidió alcanzar la máxima calificación fue la cobertura de frambuesa; buen sabor, pero con una textura gomosa y elástica. No es fácil presentar este tipo de pastel en un ambiente de cafetería. Elegí un muffin de arándanos y queso crema. La masa no era demasiado dulce y la cobertura tenía un buen equilibrio. Los arándanos tenían un sabor delicioso, pero había demasiados dentro del muffin, lo que hacía que algunas secciones estuvieran demasiado húmedas. A. Pedí el pastel de frutas y mi camarero me recomendó el pastel de fresas frescas, y lo acepté de inmediato. El pastel estaba perfecto, muy impresionante. Las fresas cortadas tenían una frescura agradable, que se complementaba y no se veía abrumada por el glaseado. La textura del pastel era ligera y crujiente, y los bordes tenían ese crujido satisfactorio. A+. Mi momento más feliz fue cuando le pregunté a mi camarero, esperando una respuesta como "Obvio", si tenían "café en prensa francesa". Casi nadie lo sabe, y esperaba esa respuesta. La respuesta que recibí fue mostrarme dos tamaños diferentes y preguntarme si prefería el café oscuro o medio. Café en prensa francesa de un personal que sabe lo que hace. A+. Si no te preocupan los carbohidratos, debes visitar Amélie's. Si tienes que controlar los carbohidratos, puedes hacerlo como yo, probando los productos horneados y dándoles a los demás porciones más grandes.
text_en: I have tried their products before, but this was my first visit. What was best was getting complete and accurate responses from the staff. The staff really deserve praise. The cake I chose had an excellent texture. The only thing that prevented it from achieving the highest rating was the raspberry topping—good taste, but with a gummy and elastic texture. It’s not easy to serve this kind of cake in a coffee shop setting. I chose a blueberry and cream cheese muffin. The dough wasn’t too sweet, and the topping had a good balance. The blueberries tasted delicious, but there were too many inside the muffin, so some sections were too wet. I ordered a fruit cake, and my server recommended a fresh strawberries cake, which I accepted right away. The cake was perfect, very impressive. The cut strawberries had a pleasant freshness, which complemented each other without being overwhelmed by frosting. The cake had a light and crunchy texture, and the edges had that satisfying crunch. A+. My happiest moment was when I asked my server, expecting a response like “Of course,” if they had “French press coffee”. Almost no one knows this, and I was looking for that answer. The response was that they showed me two different sizes and asked if I preferred dark or medium coffee. French press coffee from staff who know what they’re doing. A+. If you don’t mind carbohydrates, you should visit Amélie’s. If you need to control your carbs, you can do it like me—try out the baked goods and give others more portions.
original: I have had their products before, but this was my first visit. The best part was being answered by the staff in complete sentences with factual and responsive answers. The staff gets a *****. The Financier I chose had a perfect texture. A. The only thing that kept it from A+ was the raspberry drizzle; good flavor but rubbery, stretchy feel. This is not an easy patissiere to present to the public in a coffee house aesthetic. I chose a blueberry and cream cheese muffin. The batter was not too sweet and the topping was a good balance. The blueberries tasted great but there were too many in the muffin itself, ruining large sections by over-moist sections. A. I asked for the fruit Danish and my server recommended the fresh strawberry instead which I instantly accepted. The pastry was spot-on, very impressive. The sliced strawberries had a lovely freshness which was accented and not over-powered by the glaze. The texture of the pastry was light and flaky and the edges had that satisfying crunch. A+ My happiest moment was when I asked my server, fully expecting a "Duh" response, if "They had French Press." Almost nobody knows this, and I expected this reply. The reply I got was to show me two different sizes and to ask if I preferred dark or medium. Dark French Press Coffee from a staff who knows what they're doing. A+ If you don't mind carbohydrates, you must visit AmÃ©lie's. If you must watch carbs, then go as I did with others and taste the baked goods, giving the larger portions to the others.

text: Very nice staff!!! Variety of cereals! Only con was there was no bowls being served that day, other than that it was a great experience.
text_en: Very nice staff!!! Variety of cereals! Only con was there was no bowls being served that day, other than that it was a great experience.

text: Bienvenidos a The Republic. ¡La República del helado rico y delicioso! Ofrecen sabores únicos, incluyendo algunos sabores especiales para festividades como menta, jengibre y ponche de huevo. Después de revisar la selección de sabores, decidí probar un sándwich de helado (4,50 dólares) con helado de jengibre. Los galletas que vienen con el sándwich son de chocolate o de miel, pero también se pueden añadir galletas premium (una mezcla de galletas de avena y chocolate) por 10 dólares. Quería probar algo diferente, así que pedí una galleta de chocolate y otra de miel. El helado en sí estaba excelente y me encantaron los trozos de jengibre mezclados con el helado. Sin embargo, las galletas tenían demasiado dulzor para mi gusto, por lo que cuando probé el sándwich, solo percibí un dulzor genérico, en lugar de los ingredientes reales. Además, aunque la galleta de miel tenía una textura agradable que facilitaba su consumo con el helado suave, la de chocolate era más dura. El servicio fue amable y atento. Si estoy en la zona y tengo antojo de helado, volvería a este lugar.
text_en: Welcome to The Republic. The Republic of rich and delicious ice cream! They offer unique flavors, including special flavors for celebrations like mint, ginger, and egg punch. After reviewing the flavor options, I decided to try an ice cream sandwich (4.50 dollars) with ginger ice cream. The cookies that come with the sandwich are chocolate or honey-based, but you can also choose premium cookies (a mix of oat and chocolate cookies) for 10 dollars. I wanted something different, so I ordered a chocolate cookie and a honey cookie. The ice cream itself was excellent, and I really liked the pieces of ginger mixed with the ice cream. However, the cookies were too sweet for my taste. When I tasted the sandwich, I only felt a generic sweetness, not the actual ingredients. Also, although the honey cookie had a pleasant texture that made it easier to eat with the soft ice cream, the chocolate cookie was more hard. The service was friendly and attentive. If I’m in the area and have an urge for ice cream, I would definitely go back here.
original: Welcome to the Republic. The Republic of rich, luscious ice cream! They have some unique flavors, including some holiday flavors like peppermint, gingerbread, and eggnog. After browsing through the flavor selection, I decided on an ice cream sandwich ($4.50) with the gingerbread ice cream. The cookies included with the sandwich are either chocolate chip or molasses but you can also upgrade to a premium cookie (A chocolate chip oatmeal concoction) for $10. I felt like mixing it up so I had a chocolate chip on one side and a molasses on the other. The ice cream itself was great and I loved the bits of gingerbread mixed in with the ice cream. The cookies though tasted too sweet for my tastes so when I bit into the sandwich all I could taste was a generic sweetness rather than the actual ingredients. Also, while the molasses cookie had a nice chewiness that made it easy to eat with the soft ice cream, the chocolate chip was harder. Service was warm and friendly. If I'm in the area and craving ice cream I'd go here again.

text: Todas as guloseimas que você possa desejar, além de que eles têm potes de foie gras que você pode levar de volta para a Califórnia na sua viagem de saída de Las Vegas. Entre os destaques, estão os macarons perfeitamente feitos (o de limonada com morango é o meu preferido), a deliciosa mousse de foie gras e, por último, mas não menos importante, o melhor doce que já foi feito: o Kouign-Amann, um doce salgado e amanteigado que vai encantar o seu paladar e deixar você com vontade de fumar um cigarro após o sexo. A MELHOR COISA DO MUNDO!
text_en: All the treats you can imagine, and they even have containers of foie gras that you can take back to California on your way out of Las Vegas. Among the highlights are the perfectly made macarons (the lemonade with strawberries is my favorite), the delicious foie gras mousse, and, last but not least, the best dessert ever made: Kouign-Amann – a salty, caramelized dessert that will enchant your taste buds and make you want to smoke a cigarette after sex. THE BEST THING IN THE WORLD!
original: All the sweet treats you could ever want plus they've got jars of foie that you can smuggle back to CA on your way outta Sin City. Notable items include their perfectly made macarons (strawberry lemonade is my fave), their delicious foie gras mousse, and last but not least the single greatest pastry ever made, the Kouign-Amann, which is a sweet and salty buttery treat that will make love to you taste buds and leave you wanting to smoke a post-coital cigarette. BEST THING EVER!

text: I've come to the conclusion that I'm not a huge macaroon person but I had to check out Bouchon because of the rave reviews on Yelp and since I had time to kill... text: O pipoca sempre foi um lanche um pouco comum para mim, mas, de qualquer forma, adicionar manteiga, sal ou chocolate a qualquer coisa geralmente torna-o comestível. NO ENTANTO, graças a uma tarde sem compromisso no mercado do lado oeste, provavelmente nunca mais ficarei sem uma ou três sacos escondidos em algum lugar. Você nunca mais comprará pipoca no micro-ondas! Eu sei que não vou. Todos aqueles anos desperdiçados... Recomendo muito a pipoca com sabor de refrigerante de cereja! Sim, pessoal do Yelp, pipoca com sabor de refrigerante de cereja. Isso já vale a pena uma visita. Se você está procurando doces tradicionais, a pipoca de caramelo sempre está fresca, feita na hora! Um ótimo custo-benefício é uma das suas caixas grandes de presente, com 2 ou 3 dos seus sabores frescos e únicos, e você estará pronto para 3 noites de cinema! DICA: Embora eles tenham uma barraca no mercado do lado oeste, eles têm uma loja logo em frente. Assim, você pode evitar as filas ridículas.
text_en: Popcorn has always been a somewhat common snack for me. But generally, adding butter, salt, or chocolate makes it edible. However, thanks to an unplanned afternoon at the western market, I probably won’t ever go without one or three bags hidden somewhere. You won’t have to buy popcorn in the microwave anymore! I know I won’t. All those years wasted… I highly recommend popcorn with cherry soda flavor! Yes, Yelp folks, popcorn with cherry soda flavor. It’s worth a visit. If you’re looking for traditional desserts, caramel popcorn is always fresh, made right away! A great value option is their large gift boxes, containing 2 or 3 of your favorite, unique flavors, and you’ll have enough for 3 nights of movies! TIP: Although they have a tent at the western market, they also have a store right across from it. So you can avoid those ridiculous lines.
original: Popcorn has always kind of been an unremarkable snack to me, but then again, put some butter, salt, and or chocolate on anything and chances are it's edible. BUT, thanks to an aimless afternoon at the west side market, I probably will never be without a bag or 3 stashed away somewhere. You will never buy microwaved popcorn again! I know I won't. All those wasted years... I highly recommend their cherry cola popcorn! Yes people of yelp, cherry cola flavored popcorn. That alone is worth a visit. If you are looking for some traditional sweet treats, their caramel corn is always fresh, made right in front of you! A really great value is one of their large gift tins, 2 or three of their fresh and unique flavors and you are set for 3 movie nights to come! PRO TIP: While they have a stall in west side market, they have a store right across the street. That way, you can skip some of the ridiculous lines.

text: Best ice cream in Vegas hands down! We've never tried a flavor we didn't love. The portions are huge as well.
text_en: Best ice cream in Vegas hands down! We've never tried a flavor we didn't love. The portions are huge as well.

text: Eu adoro este lugar. O que eu mais gosto são os "cupcakes" de sorvete. Você recebe duas porções de sorvete com um macaron por cima e um marshmallow tostado. Você pode escolher duas porções do mesmo sabor ou duas diferentes. O tamanho da porção é perfeito. Suficiente para alimentar uma ou duas pessoas. O sorvete é delicioso e tem uma textura muito rica. Eu comprei um sorvete de Nutella com morango e goiaba, com um macaron de "fruity pebble". Paguei cerca de US$ 7,50 pelo "cupcake". O local fica em um pequeno centro comercial, mas ainda é um bom lugar para ir. E você pode experimentar qualquer sabor de sorvete com funcionários muito simpáticos. Este lugar é um dos poucos lugares únicos que o Arizona oferece.
text_en: I love this place. What I like best are the “cupcakes” with ice cream. You get two servings of ice cream, plus a macaron on top and a toasted marshmallow. You can choose two servings of the same flavor or two different ones. The size of each serving is perfect—enough to serve one or two people. The ice cream is delicious and has a very rich texture. I bought a Nutella ice cream with strawberries and guava, along with a “fruity pebble” macaron. I paid about $7.50 for the “cupcake”. The place is located in a small shopping center, but it’s still a great place to visit. You can try any flavor of ice cream, and the staff are very friendly. This place is one of the few unique places that Arizona has to offer.
original: I love this place. My favorite thing is their cookie cup. You get two scoops of ice cream with a macron on top and a toasted marshmallow. You can get two scoops of the same flavor or two different ones. The portion size is perfect. Enough to feed one or two people. Their ice cream is tasty and very rich texture. I got Nutella and strawberry guava ice cream with fruity pebble macron. I paid about $7.50 for the cookie cup. The location is kinda in a hidden plaza but still a good place to go to. And you can sample any ice cream flavor with nice staff. This place is one of the few unique places that AZ offers.

text: The best ice cream in Vegas. There is no indoor seating but they have a few benches outside. The ice cream is fresh and delicious. The serve real fruit in their ice cream which is a plus. Will be going back again.
text_en: The best ice cream in Vegas. There is no indoor seating but they have a few benches outside. The ice cream is fresh and delicious. The serve real fruit in their ice cream which is a plus. Will be going back again.

text: Disappointed. I have been eating sprinkles cupcakes since the beginning. This red velvet had to be the most dry cupcake I've ever had. I can guarantee it wasn't made today. I don't know what's going on but sprinkles has gone down hill as it has spread the country. Cupcakes have gotten dry, smaller & the quality just isn't what it used to be. text: La tienda era preciosa y limpia, con una exhibición muy colorida de una gran variedad de productos. Mi única queja fue que tuvimos que esperar 45 minutos solo para poder entrar y hacer nuestro pedido. Pero el pastel de fresas, las galletas con chispas de chocolate y los cannoli eran increíbles.
text_en: The store was beautiful and clean, with a very colorful display of a wide variety of products. My only complaint was that we had to wait 45 minutes just to get in and make our order. But the strawberry cake, chocolate chip cookies, and cannoli were incredible.
original: The shop was beautiful and clean with a very colorful display of many different varieties of goodies. My only qualm was the fact that we had to wait 45 minutes just to get in and order! But the strawberry shortcake, chocolate chip cookies, and cannoli's were amazing!!

text: Sou fã da marca 85 degrees e já visitei unidades em outros estados. Ontem, tive um problema com o meu pedido nesta unidade em Las Vegas. Mas, quando liguei e falei com Edna, a gerente, ela foi muito rápida em resolver o problema. Ela se desculpou pelo erro e tentou oferecer uma solução, que eu gentilmente recusei. O fato de ela ter reconhecido o meu transtorno e corrigido o problema já foi suficiente para mim. A atitude amigável e a disposição em garantir a satisfação do cliente são muito importantes. Por isso, recomendo e dou 5 estrelas.
text_en: I’m a fan of the 85 degrees brand, and I’ve visited stores in other states before. Yesterday, I had an issue with my order at this store in Las Vegas. But when I called and spoke with Edna, the manager, she handled the problem very quickly. She apologized for the mistake and tried to offer a solution, which I politely declined. The fact that she recognized my concern and corrected the issue was enough for me. A friendly attitude and a commitment to ensuring customer satisfaction are very important. Therefore, I recommend it and give it 5 stars.
original: I'm a fan of 85 degrees in general and have visited locations in other states. I had a problem with my order yesterday from this Vegas location. But when I called and spoke with Edna, their manager, she was very quick to help me resolve the issue. She was apologetic for what was a mistake and tried to offer resolution, which I kindly dismissed. The fact that she acknowledged my inconvenience and corrected the problem was more than enough for me. Her pleasant attitude and willingness to ensure customer satisfaction speak volumes. And it is for this reason that they receive my 5 stars.

text: Our favorite dessert spot is finally on this side of the town, we don't have to drive all the way to Chinatown anymore. Taiyaki cones are crispy on the outside, and airy on the inside. Great texture overall. You can customize the toppings as well. Great service and fast too!

text_en: The pistachio macarons were, undoubtedly, the best thing I ate in Las Vegas. And yes, I ate quite a lot. The flavor was incredibly intense. You won’t forget this taste. I also tried the éclairs and croissants; both were good, but they didn’t stand out. The macarons were much better.
original: The pistachio macaron was THE BEST thing I ate in Vegas. And I was eating quite a bit. Unbelievably intense in flavor. You will not forget the taste. I also had the eclaire and croissant, both good but average. The macaroon was far better.

text: Esta é a melhor padaria em Carolina do Norte. Sem dúvida. O ambiente, a decoração e a atmosfera são únicos! Minha namorada e eu descobrimos este pequeno tesouro e ficamos maravilhados! Os preços são incríveis, considerando a qualidade dos doces que se obtém. O bolo de brownie com caramelo foi incrível!! Além disso, os pequenos doces cremosos também foram fantásticos!! Com certeza voltarei muitas vezes!
text_en: This is the best bakery in North Carolina. Without a doubt. The atmosphere, decorations, and overall vibe are unique! My girlfriend and I discovered this little treasure and were absolutely amazed! The prices are incredible, considering the quality of the desserts they offer. The brownie cake with caramel was amazing!! Moreover, the small creamy desserts were also fantastic!! I will definitely go back many times!
original: This is the best bakery in NC. Hands down. The atmosphere, decor, and ambience is like none other!! Me and my boyfriend discovered this little gem and were blown away! The prices are phenomenal for the quality of dessert you are getting. The caramel brownie torte was amazing!! Also, the bite sized cream desserts were incredible too!! I will absolutely be coming back tons!!

text: No sé por qué siempre vuelvo a Donut Bar. No entiendo por qué a tanta gente le gusta tanto Donut Bar. ¡No entiendo el revuelo! Pero me encanta el revuelo. Lo que más me gusta de Donut Bar es su donut de crema brûlée con el recubrimiento de azúcar crujiente y el relleno de crema. ¿Por qué están usando menos recubrimiento y menos relleno? Donut Bar tiene los donuts más parecidos a pan. Son básicamente pan ligeramente dulce, pero de un tamaño grande o con una decoración excesiva. Probablemente he probado todos sus donuts y, en mi opinión, no son buenos. Su helado en cone de donut es bueno, y su donut de crema brûlée solía ser bueno. Probablemente he estado aquí seis veces porque su cuenta de Instagram es muy popular, pero tengo que decir que sus donuts simplemente no son buenos.
text_en: I don’t know why I always go back to Donut Bar. I can’t understand why so many people like Donut Bar so much. I don’t understand the hype around it! But I really enjoy the hype. What I like most about Donut Bar is its cream brûlée donuts with a crunchy sugar coating and cream filling. Why are they using less coating and less filling? Donut Bar’s donuts are more like bread. They’re basically slightly sweet bread, but in large sizes or with excessive decorations. I’ve probably tried all their donuts, and in my opinion, they’re not good. Their donut cone ice cream is good, and their cream brûlée donuts used to be good too. I’ve probably been here six times because their Instagram account is very popular, but I have to say that their donuts simply aren’t good.

text: Me alegró mucho que vinieran a la ciudad. Una excelente panadería, considerando el precio. La mayoría de los productos tienen un precio de entre 11,50 y 3,00 dólares. El personal de la caja siempre está muy ocupado, ya que todas sus ubicaciones son populares. Sin embargo, estoy muy decepcionado con su café helado con sal marina. Me encanta, y cada vez que estoy en California, suelo comprar tres cafés al día. Voy allí todos los días. En la ubicación de Las Vegas, añaden un poco de café y luego agua al café. ¿Café diluido? ¿De verdad? Es como pedir un "venti" en Starbucks y que usen una sola dosis de espresso y agua para las otras dos dosis. Cuando pregunté sobre esto, el empleado me dijo que es así como lo preparan. Luego, le pidió al gerente que explicara lo mismo. He visto cómo lo preparan en California, y no diluyen el café. Por eso me gusta, es fuerte, pero ya no. Café diluido, gracias. Para obtener café con sal marina sin diluir, vaya a BREW TEA BAR.
text_en: I was very happy that they came to the city. It’s an excellent bakery, considering the price. Most products cost between $11.50 and $3.00. The staff at the counter is always busy, as all their locations are popular. However, I’m very disappointed with their salted sea salt coffee. I really like it, and every time I’m in California, I usually buy three cups a day. I go there every day. In the Las Vegas location, they add some coffee and then water to the coffee. Diluted coffee? Really? It’s like ordering a “venti” at Starbucks, but they use just one dose of espresso and water for the other two doses. When I asked about this, the employee said that’s how they prepare it. Then she asked the manager to explain it too. I’ve seen how it’s prepared in California, and they don’t dilute the coffee. That’s why I like it—it’s strong, but not anymore. Thanks for the diluted coffee. To get salted sea salt coffee without dilution, go to BREW TEA BAR.
original: Was so happy they came to town. Great bakery for the price. Most items are about $11.50-$3.00.+- The cashier to purchase bakery items is always long, as most of their locations.. Very disappointed though is their SEA SALT ice coffee. Which I love and every time in California, I would stop by 3 times a day for the coffee. Everyday I'm there. AT the Vegas location they add a little bit oF coffee & then WATER to the coffee. Water down coffee ?? RealLy ?? That's like ordering a venti at Starbucks and they do 1 shot of espresso & water for the other 2 shots. When I asked them about it the guy said that's how they do it. He then asked the manager to come to explain the same thing. I've watch them make it in California and they do not water down the coffee. That's why I like it, it's strong, but not anymore. Water down coffee, no thanks. Go to BREW TEA BAR for sea salt for non watered down coffee.

text: Omg this place is so amazing! I had the donut with ice cream...will be back for every cheat day
text_en: Omg this place is so amazing! I had the donut with ice cream...will be back for every cheat day

text: Came here expecting some delicious ice cream and was not disappointed. I decided on mint choc chip with a sugar cone and it was exactly what I expected. The wait was longer than I expected, but I did see employees wearing gloves and the counters were clean. The store was well organized and easy to see prices. Sharda was my cashier and she was very friendly!
text_en: Came here expecting some delicious ice cream and was not disappointed. I decided on mint choc chip with a sugar cone and it was exactly what I expected. The wait was longer than I expected, but I did see employees wearing gloves and the counters were clean. The store was well organized and easy to see prices. Sharda was my cashier and she was very friendly!

text: Milk Bar es uno de mis lugares favoritos cuando estoy de vuelta en Nueva York, así que me alegró mucho descubrir que también tenían una sucursal en Las Vegas. En mi primera visita, pedí mi postre habitual: helado de cereal con copos de maíz espolvoreados por los lados. La segunda vez, probé el "cereal milk latte", que básicamente era la combinación de mis dos postres favoritos. El servicio aquí fue rápido y sencillo, y la joven que tomó mi pedido se encargó de servirme el helado antes de que pudiera siquiera firmar el recibo. Fue una experiencia fantástica con un delicioso postre, y estoy deseando volver.
text_en: Milk Bar is one of my favorite places when I’m back in New York. So I was very happy to learn that they also have a branch in Las Vegas. During my first visit, I ordered my usual dessert: cereal ice cream with cornflake sprinkles on both sides. The second time, I tried the “cereal milk latte” – which was basically a combination of my two favorite desserts. The service here was quick and simple; the young girl who took my order got to serve me the ice cream before I even had time to sign the receipt. It was an amazing experience, with delicious dessert, and I can’t wait to go back.
original: Milk Bar is one of my favorite go to spots when I'm back home in NYC so I was very happy when I found that there was a full location in Las Vegas. I had my usual the first visit, cereal ice cream with corn flakes dusted on the sides, the second time around I had the cereal milk latte which was basically my two favorite food items combined. The service here was quick and easy and the young lady who took my order was quick to have my ice cream served to me before I could finish even signing my receipt, just an awesome experience with good dessert, can't wait to go back.

text: Loved this place! While standing in line trying to decide what to order, the woman behind the counter asked me if she could help me choose. I told her I was deciding between a cookie and soft serve, and once I decided on the soft serve she handed me a cookie on the house! The cereal milk soft serve with the cornflake topping was delicious and not too sweet. The cornflake marshmallow cookie had a very different taste from what I was expecting, but it was moist and delicious. The only downfall of this place is the price ($6 for that tiny soft serve), but the free cookie made up for that I guess! I would definitely recommend trying this place

text: Estaba en el paraíso, disfrutando del pastel de cumpleaños aquí. ¡Estaba delicioso! Tenemos una bolsa con seis galletas que voy a comer durante el viaje de regreso en avión hoy, y estoy segura de que serán absolutamente deliciosas. No puedo expresar lo bien que estuvo. Además, fue rápido, lo cual fue una ventaja.
text_en: I was in paradise, enjoying the birthday cake here. It was delicious! We have a bag with six cookies that I’ll eat on my flight back today, and I’m sure they will be absolutely delicious. I can’t express how good it was. Besides, it was quick, which was an advantage.
original: I was in literal heaven eating the birthday cake here. It was so good. We have a bag of six cookies that I will eat on the plane ride home today that I'm sure will be absolutely delicious. Can't say enough good things. And it was quick which didn't hurt.

text: El helado más delicioso que he probado. He estado viniendo aquí durante unas semanas gracias a algunos amigos, y lamento no haberlo hecho antes. De hecho, normalmente no puedo comer helado debido a algunos problemas con los lácteos, pero sorprendentemente, este lugar no me causa ningún problema. Probablemente porque es REAL y delicioso. Normalmente pido la "Graham Central Station" (x4) y mi novio pide la degustación de 4 sabores con todas las opciones de cheesecake. ¡ME ENCANTA ESTE LUGAR! Ahora, aunque las colas pueden ser un poco largas a veces, todo eso desaparece cuando pruebas ese primer cucharón y se derrite en tu boca. Ahora será mi lugar favorito para postres y ya he contado a toda mi familia y amigos. Si has visto este lugar y aún no lo has visitado, ¡VE AHORA MISMO! Especialmente los martes de 2 dólares.
text_en: The most delicious ice cream I’ve ever tried. I’ve been coming here for a few weeks thanks to some friends, and I regret not having visited earlier. Actually, usually I can’t eat ice cream due to some issues with dairy products, but surprisingly, this place doesn’t cause any problems for me. Probably because it’s real and delicious. Usually, I order “Graham Central Station” (x4), and my boyfriend orders a tasting of 4 flavors with all the cheesecake options. I’m obsessed with this place! Now, although the lines can be a bit long sometimes, all that disappears when you take your first spoonful and it melts in your mouth. Now it’s my favorite place for desserts, and I’ve already told all my family and friends about it. If you’ve seen this place but haven’t visited yet, go now! Especially on Tuesdays, for just $2.
original: The best ice cream I have ever eaten. I've been coming here now for a few weeks thanks to some friends and I regret not coming sooner. I'm actually not really suppose to eat ice cream because of some dairy problems but surprisingly enough, this place doesn't cause any issues. Probably because it's REAL and delicious. I normally get the graham central station (x4) and my boyfriend gets the 4 scoop sampler with all the cheesecake options. WE LOVE THIS PLACE SO MUCH. Now I will say the lines are a bit ridiculous at times but all the aggravation goes away when you take that first scoop and it melts in your mouth. This will now be my go to dessert spot and I've told all my family and friends. If you've seen this place and haven't stopped by yet, DO IT NOW. Especially for the 2 buck Tuesday's.

text: Estaba alojado en el Palazzo y vi en Yelp que había una panadería muy bien valorada justo al lado, en el Venetian. Esta panadería está justo enfrente del café Grand Luxe en el Venetian. Pedí un macaron de vainilla, un croissant de almendra y un muffin de arándanos. El macaron era realmente grande y de muy mala calidad. Estaba frío, duro y tenía la sensación de que estaba comiendo algo que había estado en el refrigerador durante una semana. Probé un bocado y lo tiré a la basura. Como suelo comer macarons en todo Estados Unidos, un macaron normal está a temperatura ambiente, no es duro y suele tener una textura suave. Evite este macaron a toda costa. Por otro lado, el croissant de almendra y el muffin de arándanos estaban bien, pero no destacaban.
text_en: I stayed at the Palazzo, and I saw on Yelp that there was a highly rated bakery right next to it, at the Venetian. This bakery is just across from the Grand Luxe Café at the Venetian. I ordered a vanilla macaron, an almond croissant, and a raspberry muffin. The macaron was really large but of very poor quality. It was cold and hard, and it felt like I was eating something that had been in the refrigerator for a week. I took a bite and threw it away. Since I usually eat macarons across the United States, a regular macaron is at room temperature, not hard, and usually has a soft texture. Avoid this macaron at all costs. On the other hand, the almond croissant and raspberry muffin were good, but not particularly outstanding.
original: I was staying at the Palazzo and i saw on yelp there was a highly rated bakery next door at the Venetian. This location is right outside of the Grand Luxe cafe in the Venetian. I ordered the Vanilla Macaron, Almond Croissant, and Blueberry Muffin. The macaron was really big and really bad. It was cold, chewy, and i felt like i was eating something that sat in the refrigerator for a week. I took one bite and threw it in the trash. I eat Macarons all over the United States, and a normal macaron is room temp, not chewy, and usually has a nice soft texture to it. Avoid this Macaron at all costs. On a better note, the Almond Croissant was and Blueberry Muffin were both OK, but nothing to write home about.

text: Modifiqué la reseña porque no abren hasta las 7 de la mañana. Es un problema para los residentes que necesitan donuts para trabajar. Para los turistas, el horario funciona bien. ¡Desde que estuve en Portland, no he estado tan emocionado por los donuts! Son preciosos y deliciosos. Un donut grande puede alimentar a cuatro personas. ¡Increíble y una parada obligatoria en Las Vegas!
text_en: I changed the review because they don’t open until 7 a.m. This is a problem for residents who need donuts to get through their work. For tourists, the hours work well. Since I’ve been in Portland, I’ve never been so excited about donuts! They’re beautiful and delicious. A big donut can feed four people. Amazing—and a must-visit stop in Las Vegas!
original: Changed review because they don't open until 7am. Lethal for locals who need donuts for work. For tourist hours will work. Not since Portland have I been so excited about donuts! These are so beautiful AND delicious! One large donut could feed four people.Amazing and a must stop for Vegas.

text: We came to Presti's and were overwhelmed by the sheer amount of people in here! It almost looked like a madhouse - but Presti's has a method to their madness. People can grab a number by the entrance and wait inside/look around until they hear their number being called. Once the Presti's employee shouts out their number, customers can go to the front to place their orders. Presti's employees will loudly shout the number twice before moving on to the next number. We ordered some strombolis but they were adequate! Definitely did the job for some Italian food, but I wished there was something that wowed me more.
