text: Esta es la primera sucursal de Sprinkles que he visitado que ofrece cupcakes, galletas y helado. Ya he probado sus cupcakes antes... en general, son buenos, pero tienen demasiado glaseado, según mi gusto. En cuanto a las galletas, ¡son deliciosas! Mi única queja es que no compré más de una galleta. La galleta de chispas de chocolate no era demasiado dulce y tenía una buena cantidad de chispas de chocolate. La galleta era un poco crujiente, pero muy suave y con sabor a mantequilla en el centro. ¡Estaban deliciosas! También probé un poco de la galleta de mantequilla de cacahuete con chispas de pretzel, y para mi sorpresa, me gustó mucho. En general, no soy muy fan de las galletas de mantequilla de cacahuete, pero mezcladas con chispas de chocolate y trozos de pretzel, ¡me encantan! El servicio fue amable y la persona que nos atendió fue bastante paciente mientras C decidía qué helado y cupcake y galleta quería. Si la fila dentro se hace demasiado larga, esta sucursal tiene un "dispensador de cupcakes" que se puede usar afuera (abierto las 24 horas).
text_en: This is the first Sprinkles branch I’ve visited that offers cupcakes, cookies, and ice cream. I’ve already tried their cupcakes before… generally, they’re good, but there’s too much frosting, according to my taste. As for the cookies, they’re delicious! My only complaint is that I didn’t buy more than one cookie. The chocolate sparkle cookie wasn’t very sweet, and there was a lot of chocolate sparks. The cookie was a bit crumbly, but very soft, with a buttery flavor in the middle. They were really tasty! I also tried a little of the peanut butter cookie with pretzel sparks, and to my surprise, I really liked it. Generally, I’m not a big fan of peanut butter cookies, but mixed with chocolate sparks and pretzel pieces, I love them! The service was friendly, and the person who served us was quite patient as C decided what ice cream, cupcake, and cookie she wanted. If the line inside gets too long, this branch has a “cupcake dispenser” that can be used outside (open 24 hours a day).
original: This is the first Sprinkles location I've been to that service cupcakes, cookies, and ice cream. I've had their cupcakes before...for the most part they are good, but have way too much frosting for my liking. Now their cookies on the other hand are delicious. My only complaint is I didn't get more than one cookie!!! The chocolate chip cookie wasn't overly sweet and had a good amount of chocolate chips in it. The cookie was a tad crunchy but super soft and buttery in the middle. So good! I also tried a bite of the peanut butter pretzel chip, which I surprisingly enjoyed. Generally not a huge fan of peanut butter cookies, but mix it with chocolate chips and pretzel bits and I'm a fan. Service was friendly and the lady helping us was rather patient while C was trying to decide what ice cream topping and cupcake and cookie he wanted. If the line inside gets too long, this location has a cupcake ATM you could use outside (open 24 hours).

text: Excelente servicio al cliente y el helado es el mejor. ¡Volveremos la próxima vez, sin duda!
text_en: Excellent customer service, and the ice cream is the best. We will definitely come back next time!
original: Great customer service and the ice cream is the best ! We will come back next visit fir sure

text: Sin duda, el helado más delicioso que he probado en mi vida. Siempre hay cola, pero la espera merece la pena. Una increíble variedad de sabores, todos elaborados aquí mismo.
text_en: Without a doubt, it’s the most delicious ice cream I’ve ever tasted in my life. There’s always frosting, but the wait is worth it. An incredible variety of flavors—all made right here.
original: Absolutely the best ice cream I've ever had in my life. Always a line here, but well worth the wait. Amazing variety of flavors that are all made on site.

text: Propietarios maravillosos y una panadería increíble. Probé el pastel de crema italiana y fue el mejor pastel que he probado en mucho tiempo. No es demasiado dulce, así que puedes comer todo el trozo. Además, el servicio es excelente.
text_en: Amazing owners and an incredible bakery. I tried the Italian cream pie, and it was the best pie I’ve had in a long time. It isn’t too sweet, so you can eat the whole piece. Additionally, the service is excellent.
original: Amazing owners and amazing bakery! I had the Italian cream cake and it was the best cake I've had in a loooooong time. Not too sweet - so you can eat the whole piece! Great service, too.

text: Estaba visitando Scottsdale y quería algo delicioso para el postre... busqué en Yelp y encontré este lugar INCREÍBLE. Pedí el helado de cheesecake de chocolate blanco, frambuesa y fresa en mi vaso de galletas. Elegí los macarrones de coco y venían con una bola de malvavisco caliente... ¡estaba delicioso y lo recomiendo mucho! Abrieron hace 3 meses y es un descubrimiento genial.
text_en: I was visiting Scottsdale and wanted something delicious for dessert… I searched on Yelp and found this place to die for. I ordered the white chocolate cheesecake ice cream with raspberries and strawberries in a cookie cup. I chose coconut macaroni, which came with a warm ball of hot wafers… it was delicious and I highly recommend it! They opened 3 months ago, and it’s a great discovery.
original: Visiting Scottsdale and wanted something yummy for dessert...looked on YELP and found this AMAZING place. I had the white chocolate raspberry and strawberry cheesecake ice cream in my cookie cup. I chose the coconut macaroons and it was topped off with a warm Marshmallow.....it was delicious and highly recommend! They opened 3 months ago and it's a great find!

text: As a coffee addict, I can be pretty critical of bakeries/coffee shops etc. Amelie's impressed me. They offer an array of hot and cold beverages that are artfully crafted but available in limited and small sizes. The ambiance is great for socializing, studying, or just sitting and people-watching. I love that it is open 24/7, 365 days a year - you can't beat that convenience! The pastries are too numerous to review individually here, but are all delicious. I have dreams about their twice-baked croissants and their Neopolitan pastries are perfect to share. They are adding more gluten-free options (like the salted caramel brownies) but right now there are only a few. Overall, Amelie's is an awesome venue for pretty much anything (you can also rent out the back rooms for bridal/baby showers etc.) and is only on an upward trajectory. I would definitely recommend it for people of all ages and walks of life :)

text: Siempre había querido venir aquí y estoy muy contento de haber podido hacerlo finalmente. Necesitaba un café por la mañana y algo para picar antes de empezar un día en Las Vegas, y este "Bouchon" estaba justo en la base de los ascensores del Venetian, así que pude pasar por allí. El café estaba bueno, fuerte. Pedí un croissant de chocolate y un "danish" de queso para compartir con mi novio. El croissant de chocolate estaba fresco y crujiente, pero ¡ay, ese "danish" de queso era algo especial! Tan untuoso y crujiente, con un relleno de queso perfectamente cremoso y dulce. ¡Estoy babeando solo escribiendo esto! De verdad, merece la pena probarlo, y en realidad, los productos horneados tienen un precio EXTREMADAMENTE razonable para una panadería tan famosa de Las Vegas.
text_en: I always wanted to come here, and I’m very happy that I finally got the chance. I needed coffee in the morning and something to eat before starting a day in Las Vegas. This “Bouchon” restaurant was right by the elevator base at the Venetian, so I could just walk by. The coffee was good—strong and delicious. I ordered a chocolate croissant and a cheese Danish to share with my boyfriend. The chocolate croissant was fresh and crispy, but oh, that cheese Danish was special! So creamy and crunchy, with perfectly smooth and sweet cheese filling. I’m drooling just writing this! Really, it’s worth trying. And actually, baked goods here are extremely affordable for such a famous bakery in Las Vegas.
original: I had always wanted to stop by here and I'm so glad I was finally able to! Needed a morning coffee and little nosh before embarking on a day of Vegas, and this Bouchon was located right at the base of the Venetian elevators so I could pass it up. Coffee was good- strong! Ordered the chocolate croissant and cheese danish to share with my boyfriend. The chocolate croissant was fresh and flaky, but OH MAN that cheese danish was just somethin else! So buttery and flaky with a perfectly creamy and sweet cheese filling- I'm drooling just typing this!! Really worth trying and honestly the baked goods are EXTREMELY reasonably priced for such a famous Vegas bakery!

text: This place is a waste of time. You wait in line for over an hour. Granted I understand their method of a conventional style bakery. But to that fact maybe you should include on your website, the fact not all of your desserts are "served daily". Very disappointed and feel that they should fix situations like this instead of the usual "sorry" and smile.

text: I have somehow managed to miss their pop up ramen nights but am so happy I caught their full time ramen menu!!!! I went with a couple of my girlfriends, two of us got the pork ramen, and another got the chicken. I got the iced tea for $7 WHICH IS ENOUGH FOR TWO TO SHARE FYI. (We didn't know it was so big but it's amazing). HOWEVER: the noodles were super fluffy but it didn't take away from the overall experience and we will still come back!

text: Aquí probé un helado delicioso. Como se puede ver en las fotos, todavía se sirve en una caja típica de comida china, con una galleta de la suerte incluida. Además, los precios son bastante asequibles.
text_en: Here I tried a delicious ice cream. As can be seen in the photos, it’s still served in a traditional Chinese food box, with a lucky cookie included. Moreover, the prices are quite affordable.
original: I had some great ice cream here. As the photos depict, it still comes in a Chinese food box with a fortune cookie tossed in. Fairly low prices, too.

text: La heladería de Sloan's es literalmente la más adorable que he visto. El ambiente y la decoración que han elegido son realmente atractivos, muy alegres y con un toque de fantasía. No solo venden helado, sino que también ofrecen otras golosinas y opciones de dulces. Pedí dos porciones de su sabor "masa de galletas" y, sinceramente, fue uno de los mejores helados caseros que he probado. Era muy suave y cremoso, con trozos de masa de galletas bien distribuidos. El precio era un poco elevado, $7.49 por las dos porciones, pero, ¿qué no tiene un precio elevado en Las Vegas? ¡Definitivamente volveré la próxima vez que esté en Las Vegas!
text_en: Sloan’s ice cream shop is literally the most adorable I’ve ever seen. The atmosphere and decorations they have chosen are really attractive, very cheerful, and with a touch of fantasy. They not only sell ice cream, but also offer other sweets and desserts. I ordered two servings of their “biscuit dough” flavor—honestly, it was one of the best homemade ice creams I’ve tasted. It was very smooth and creamy, with well-distributed biscuit dough pieces. The price was a bit high—$7.49 for two servings—but what isn’t expensive in Las Vegas? Definitely going back next time I’m in Las Vegas!
original: Sloans Ice Cream shop is literally the cutest ever! The vibe and decor they chose really is eye catching, very happy and whimsical. They not only sell ice cream but also have other sweet treats and candy options. I got two scoops of their Cookie dough flavor and it was honestly some of the best home made ice cream I've ever had! So nice and creamy with nice chunks of cookie dough spread throughout. It was a bit pricey at $7.49 for the two scoops but honestly what isn't over priced in Vegas? I'll be back for sure next time I'm in Vegas!

text: Los pasteles estaban muy buenos y la fila se movía rápido, hasta que llegaba el momento de pedir el té de burbujas. Tardamos más de 10 minutos solo para conseguir una bebida. No vale la pena la espera.
text_en: The pastries were very good, and the line moved quickly, until it was time to order the bubble tea. It took us over 10 minutes just to get a drink. The wait isn’t worth it.
original: The pastry were very good and the line went by quick until you order a boba tea. The wait took over 10 minutes just for a drink. Not worth the wait

text: No había estado aquí en unos años, pero hoy volví y me decepcioné. No encontré el dispensador de entradas, una señora mayor me atendió de forma un poco grosera. Las barras de mantequilla de cacahuete tenían un sabor extraño, como si llevaran glaseado enlatado. No es como era antes. La semana que viene iré a otro lugar.
text_en: I hadn’t been here for a few years, but today I returned and was disappointed. I couldn’t find the ticket dispenser; an older woman served me in a rather rude manner. The peanut butter bars tasted strange, as if they had canned glaze on them. It’s not like it used to be. Next week, I’ll go somewhere else.
original: Hadn't been here for a couple if yrs but stopped today & was disappointed. Never found ticket disperser, older lady waited on me was a bit rude. Peanut butter bars tasted like they had canned frosting on them..kinda gross. Not what it used to be. I'll go elsewhere next week.

text: If you are looking for a quaint coffee shop with excellent baked goods this is the spot. With different options everyday this is a place that won't get dull. Staff is very helpful and knowledgeable of the items sold.
text_en: If you are looking for a quaint coffee shop with excellent baked goods this is the spot. With different options everyday this is a place that won't get dull. Staff is very helpful and knowledgeable of the items sold.

text: This place is amazing! Their matcha is super high quality and their soft serve js amazing! They even have a different flavor every month which keeps the menu fresh for customers to try something new on a frequent basis, which i love! So far their ube, sesame and earl grey flavors that i tried are amazing as well! I see some people complaining about prices here but you pay for what you get and its not like u cant see the prices on the menu before paying. No ones forcing you to buy things that you cant afford *SMH. Go to McDonalds and get urself a dollar cone if ur complaining abt the prices. Ppl just dnt understand that somethings are expensive to make, especially matcha products. If u can pay $6 for a starbucks coffee that costs them probably 20 cents to make then you can pay $6 for high quality matcha that has ingredients way more expensive than coffee. =] Anyways i love this place and def recommend everyone to try.

text: I have seen Milk Bar all over my Instagram feed. They're cups are trendy, the presentation is perfect for your feed (and for feeding). I was delighted when I visited Las Vegas and saw they had a location in the Cosmopolitan. The wannabe Instagram influencer came out in me and was ecstatic to try this cereal + milk ice cream combo. I've never been one to drink the milk at the bottom of my cereal bowl so I was didn't think I was going to enjoy this treat as much as I did. The corn cereal flavor really shined. It was creamy, sweet, and crunchy. A perfect treat for a warm Las Vegas afternoon. I would love to visit Milk Bar's other locations and try more of their creations.

text: Okay their food is top notch. Fresh baked pastries, sandwiches, and creamy gelato. You can't go wrong here. The staff is friendly and the service is quick. Love it! What I didn't love was seeing flies in the case with all the desserts. I guess I expected controlling the flies to be better when in a bake shop in Little Italy. That was so much of a turn off I had to give Presti's 3 stars. However, the case that didn't have flies were the cakes. I had the tiramisu which was so creamy and light! I took some hazelnut biscottis home and paired them with a chai tea. text: The best thing about Mitchells? Their vegan chocolate ice cream is literally better than any dairy-based ice cream I've ever had. Hands down. Their seasonal flavors are always on point (e.g. the coffee porter, the mint chocolate truffle, etc), and their classic flavors can't be beat (black raspberry chocolate chunk, pistachio, peanut butter, cookies and cream, bing cherry chocolate chunk, etc). Their staff are also super nice and knowledgeable about the flavors, which is fantastic when I can't decide what new flavor to try. text: Las magdalenas de frambuesa son la verdadera razón por la que viajo a Las Vegas cada año. (Vale, mi jefe paga el viaje, haciéndose pasar por una invitación al Salón del Consumo Electrónico, pero en realidad solo está intentando mantenerme en la empresa pagándome para poder disfrutar de mis magdalenas de Bouchon). Es una pequeña tienda de pastelería en The Venetian. Encontrarás varias ubicaciones dispersas. Hay dos (una arriba, otra abajo) en el extremo norte, donde hay un pasillo elevado que conecta con el TI y el Mirage. Normalmente voy a la de arriba, ya que está en mi camino hacia el centro de expos y los autobuses del CES hacia el LVCC. He visto algunas habitaciones más grandes que la tienda que frecuento, pero mientras que sea lo suficientemente grande para guardar las magdalenas (y un dependiente para venderlas, junto con una taza de café), eso es todo lo que importa. Las magdalenas parecen un poco caras (pero, ¿qué en Las Vegas no?), pero una vez que pruebas una, sabrás al instante que estarías dispuesto a pagar más. Son delicadas y masticables a la vez. No son demasiado dulces, pero lo suficientemente dulces para satisfacer un antojo de pastelería. La capa exterior se desmorona de forma agradable, y el interior es cremoso y firme. Sueño con estas magdalenas. Necesitas una. Ve a conseguir una, o una docena.
text_en: Strawberry muffins are the real reason I travel to Las Vegas every year. (Well, my boss pays for the trip, pretending it’s an invitation to the Electronic Consumer Hall of Fame, but really, he’s just trying to keep me employed by paying me to enjoy my Bouchon muffins.) It’s a small bakery in The Venetian. You can find several locations scattered around. There are two (one upstairs, one downstairs) at the northern end, where there’s a raised hallway that connects to the IT and Mirage areas. Usually, I go to the one upstairs, as it’s on my way to the exhibition center and the CES buses heading to LVCC. I’ve seen some rooms that are larger than the one I frequent, but as long as it’s big enough to store the muffins (and a clerk to sell them, along with a cup of coffee), that’s all that matters. The muffins seem a bit expensive (but what isn’t in Las Vegas?), but once you try one, you’ll immediately realize you’d be willing to pay more. They’re delicate yet chewy at the same time. They’re not too sweet, but just sweet enough to satisfy a craving for pastries. The outer layer breaks apart pleasantly, and the inside is creamy and firm. I dream of these muffins. You need one. Go get one, or a dozen.
original: The raspberry macaroons are the REAL reason I go to Las Vegas every year. (OK, my boss pays for the trip under the pretense of sending me to the Consumer Electronics Show- but he's really just making an effort to keep me on staff by paying for me to get my Bouchon macaroon fix.) It's a little bakery stand in The Venetian. You'll find a couple of locations scattered around. There are two (one upstairs, one downstairs) up on the north end where there's a raised walkway across the strip to TI & Mirage. I tend to go to the upstairs one, as it's on my walk over to the Expo center, and the CES shuttle busses to the LVCC. I've seen a few walk-in closets bigger than the stand I frequent- but as long as it's big enough to hold the macaroons (and an attendant to sell them to me, along with a cup of coffee), that's all that matters. The macaroons seem a little high-priced (but what in Vegas isn't?), but once you take a bit, you'll know instantly that you would pay more. They're delicate and chewy all at the same time. Not overly sweet, but sweet enough to satisfy a bakery craving. The outer shell crumbles nicely, and the core is creamy and firm. I dream about these macaroons. You need one. Go get one- or a dozen.

text: Excelente lugar para tomar un refrigerio y un café. A veces las colas parecen largas, pero en realidad solo tardan unos 5 minutos en pasar. El día que fui, ofrecían una promoción: una botella de agua Carlos gratis con una compra de 24.00. Es un buen recuerdo si vienes de fuera.
text_en: An excellent place to have a snack and coffee. Sometimes the lines seem long, but actually it only takes about 5 minutes to pass. On the day I visited, they had a promotion: a bottle of Carlos water for free with a purchase of 24.00. It’s a great memory if you come from outside.
original: Great place to grab a snack and some coffee. The lines appear long at times but really only take about 5 minutes to get through. The day I went they had a special that provided you a free Carlos water bottle with 24.00 purchase. Nice souvenir if you're from out of town.

text: A Carlo's Bakery em Las Vegas foi uma experiência deliciosa! Não, não é Nova Jersey, e o lugar é pequeno, então não espere uma grande variedade. Para uma pequena loja localizada dentro dos shoppings do Venetian Hotel, foi muito divertido visitá-la! Meus doces favoritos foram as éclairs com chocolate por cima e os "pecan white puffs"! Eles também vendem lembranças, o que foi o toque final perfeito para mim! Os doces não são baratos, mas também não são caros. Espere pagar cerca de $4,00 por um doce. Mas você está em Las Vegas, então quase nada é barato! Você pode observar os funcionários preparando os doces enquanto espera pela embalagem e pelo sacolão. Visitei o local duas vezes durante a minha estadia em Las Vegas e até levei alguns para casa na minha mala!
text_en: Carlo’s Bakery in Las Vegas was a delightful experience! No, it’s not in New Jersey, and the place is small, so don’t expect a huge variety of products. For a small local shop located inside the Venetian Hotel shopping area, it was really fun to visit! My favorite desserts were the eclairs with chocolate on top and the “pecan white puffs”! They also sell souvenirs, which added a perfect touch for me! The desserts aren’t cheap, but they aren’t expensive either. You’ll probably have to pay around $4.00 for a dessert. But you’re in Las Vegas, so almost nothing is cheap! You can watch the staff prepare the desserts while waiting for your packaging and bag. I visited the place twice during my stay in Las Vegas, and even brought some back with me in my suitcase!

For a small shop set up inside the Venitian Hotel shoppes, it was very fun to visit! My favorite baked goods were the eclaires with chocolate on top, and the pecan white puffs! They even sell souvenirs which was the icing on the cake for me! The sweets are not cheap, yet not expensive. Expect to pay about $4.00 for one sweet. You are in Vegas though, almost nothing is cheap! You can watch employees bake pastries while you wait for your sweets to be boxed and bagged! I went there twice during my stay in Vegas and even brought some home with me on my carry on!

text: Los postres son increíbles, y el hecho de que estén disponibles las 24 horas es una gran ventaja. Amelies siempre está en mi lista cuando visito el barrio de NoDa. Café de prensa francesa: 10-10, Brownies de caramelo salado: 10-10, 100 $ por una baguette con queso: 10-10 (ese cero extra no es un error... la mejor comida económica de la ciudad). La única razón por la que le doy 4 estrellas en lugar de 5 es porque a veces no hay mesas disponibles y está tan lleno que se tarda 30 minutos en llegar al mostrador y conseguir la comida... pero supongo que los lugares increíbles como Amelies no pueden evitar las multitudes porque el lugar es simplemente tan bueno. Si visitas Charlotte, no te pierdas este lugar, ya que es imprescindible. Amelies también diseñó y horneó todos los pasteles que se ven en la película "Los Juegos del Hambre", lo cual me pareció un dato curioso. También vale la pena mencionar: este lugar es ideal para una primera cita, ya que es bastante informal. ¡Visítalo!

French press coffee: 10-10; salty caramel brownies: 10-10; 100 dollars for a baguette with cheese: 10-10 (that extra zero isn’t an error… it’s the best budget-friendly food in the city). The only reason I give it 4 stars instead of 5 is because sometimes there aren’t any tables available, and it’s so crowded that it takes 30 minutes to get to the counter and get food… but I guess places like Amelies can’t avoid crowds because the place is just so good. If you visit Charlotte, don’t miss this place—it’s essential. Amelies also designed and baked all the cakes shown in the movie “The Hunger Games”, which I found to be a curious detail. It’s also worth mentioning that this place is perfect for a first date, as it’s quite casual. Go check it out!

French press coffee: 10-10, Salted Caramel Brownies: 10-10, $1 Baguettes with cheese spread: 100-10 (that extra zero is not a typo...best cheap meal in town). The only reason I give 4 stars instead of 5 is because sometimes there is no seating available and it is so packed it takes 30 minutes to get to the front of the line and get your food.....but I guess awesome places like Amelies can't avoid the crowds because the place is just so dang good! If you're visiting Charlotte, don't skip over this place as it is a must-see. Amelies also designed and baked all the pastries in the Hunger Games movie, which I thought was a fun fact. Also worth noting: This place is great for a first date since it's pretty casual. Check it out!

original: Pastries were okay, atmosphere was great!

text: ¡ME ENCANTA CHURN! Después de comer en Windsor, fuimos a Churn para el postre. Mi hermano y mi cuñada nunca habían ido, así que siempre disfruto llevándolos a este lugar. El personal es joven, pero siempre son muy amables y serviciales, y te ofrecen tantas muestras y sugerencias como necesitas. Siempre pido el helado de mantequilla de cacahuete, así que decidí probar "Everything but the Kitchen Sink", que incluye el helado de mantequilla de cacahuete. Cualquier cosa que tengan con ese helado es excelente. ¡Incluso su helado de chocolate es INCREÍBLE! Si buscas un postre excelente, ¡visita Churn! ¡Vale la pena! Y es mi opción preferida para un día de "caprichos"!
text_en: I’m obsessed with Churn! After eating in Windsor, we went to Churn for dessert. My brother and sister-in-law had never been there before, so I always enjoy taking them there. The staff are young, but they’re always very friendly and helpful, and they offer plenty of samples and suggestions just as you need. I always order peanut butter ice cream, so I decided to try “Everything but the Kitchen Sink,” which includes peanut butter ice cream. Anything they serve with that ice cream is excellent. Even their chocolate ice cream is amazing! If you’re looking for great dessert, visit Churn! It’s worth it! And it’s my favorite choice for a day of “whimsy”!
original: I LOVE CHURN!!! After stuffing ourselves at Windsor we walked over to Churn for dessert! My brother and sis in law have never been so I always enjoy treating people to this place! The staff is a younger staff but they are always very friendly and helpful and give you as many samples and suggestions you need! I always get the peanut butter ice cream so I decided to get Everything but the Kitchen Sink! Which has the peanut butter ice cream in it! Anything with their peanut butter ice cream is worth it! Even their chocolate ice cream is AMAZING!! If you want a excellent dessert, stop at Churn! Its worth it! And IT IS MY GO TO for a cheat day dessert!!

text: Uma baguete com ovo, queijo cheddar, espinafre e tomate é sempre uma ótima opção!
text_en: A baguette with egg, cheddar cheese, spinach, and tomatoes is always a great choice!
original: You can't go wrong with a egg, cheddar cheese, spinach and tomato baguette!

text: El kouign-amann es delicioso. Su té helado también estaba muy bueno, no era amargo ni ácido. Si pudiera, empezaría cada día con esos dos productos de aquí.
text_en: Kouign-amann is delicious. Their ice tea was also very good; it wasn’t bitter or acidic. If I could, I would start each day with those two products from here.
original: The kouign-amann is to die for. Their iced tea was pretty good too, not bitter or sour. I would start my day with those two things from here every single day if I could.

text: Só parei para comprar um sanduíche de sorvete. Biscoitos de chocolate com sorvete de chocolate belga. Incrível! Além disso, o pessoal aqui é muito simpático. É a melhor sorveteria que já visitei!
text_en: I just stopped to buy a ice cream sandwich. Chocolate cookies with Belgian chocolate ice cream. Amazing! Besides, the people here are very friendly. It’s the best ice cream shop I’ve ever been to!
original: Just stopped by for an ice cream sandwich. Chocolate chip cookies with belgian chocolate ice cream. Amazing! The staff here are so friendly as well. Best ice cream shop I've ever been to!

text: Antes do período de quarentena devido ao coronavírus, tive a oportunidade de aproveitar esta maravilhosa e pequena padaria. Eles realmente têm tudo o que você poderia desejar. A equipe também foi muito simpática e prestativa. É uma padaria para levar, com um fluxo constante de clientes. Oferecem uma variedade de doces, bolos e guloseimas doces e salgadas. Eu escolhi o cheesecake de Oreo (hummm) e minha namorada pegou o cheesecake de pistache e macarons (todos os sabores, 12 unidades). Nós nos deliciamos com nossos doces e realmente estamos ansiosos para voltar! O único ponto negativo é que há uma grande variedade de biscoitos, doces e bagels expostos no balcão, sem proteção para os clientes que passam e tocam ou falam sobre eles. Eu não comprei nenhum desses itens.
text_en: Before the coronavirus quarantine period, I had the opportunity to enjoy this wonderful and small bakery. They really have everything you could wish for. The staff was also very kind and helpful. It’s a bakery that can be taken away, with a constant stream of customers. They offer a variety of sweets, cakes, and sweet and salty treats. I chose the Oreo cheesecake (mmmm), and my girlfriend picked the pistachio cheesecake and macarons (all flavors, 12 units). We enjoyed our desserts and are really looking forward to going back! The only negative point is that there’s a huge variety of cookies, sweets, and bagels displayed on the counter, without any protection for customers who pass by and touch or talk about them. I didn’t buy any of those items.
original: Prior to the coronavirus quarantine, I had a chance to enjoy this amazing little bakery. They literally have anything you could possibly want. The staff was super sweet and helpful as well. It's a takeout bakery with a steady flow of traffic. An assortment of pastries, cakes and sweet and savory treats. I went for the oreo cheesecake (nommm) and my girlfriend got the pistachio cheesecake and macaroons (every flavor, 12). We enjoyed our sweet treats and truly can't wait to go back! My biggest drawback is that there's a large assortment of cookies, pastries and bagels that sit on top of the counter not protected from customers walking up and touching or talking over them. I did not order any of those items.

text: O Butterwood Bake Consortium é um lugar maravilhoso e exatamente o tipo de lugar que Upper Lawrenceville precisava. Há apenas um ano, não havia bons lugares para tomar café ou chá e doces além da 52ª rua. Com esta opção de sobremesas, café e chá, e o café B52 nas proximidades, a área agora não carece de nada. Eu vim aqui com uma amiga que queria experimentar com a mim. Cheguei um pouco antes dela e fui recebida pela simpática atendente. Pedi um bolo vegano de framboesa com baunilha e perguntei sobre as opções de chá. Ela me deixou experimentar os diferentes tipos de chá e escolhi o de hortelã, que achei que combinaria bem com o bolo. O chá de castanha tinha um aroma excelente, e pretendo voltar para experimentar com um bolo de chocolate amargo. Sentei-me em uma das mesas com estilo de jardim vitoriano, e meu pedido foi entregue em menos de cinco minutos. O bolo estava aquecido e o chá veio com um pequeno temporizador para preparo. Tudo tinha um sabor delicioso! Nesse momento, minha amiga chegou e escolheu um mousse de chocolate e um expresso. Ela também ficou muito satisfeita com a qualidade do seu doce. Fui oferecido mais água para uma segunda xícara de chá, e nós ficamos sentados e conversamos por mais de uma hora, enquanto o lugar ficava cada vez mais cheio e animado. (Até havia um clube de leitura!) Adorei ver como as pessoas estavam se divertindo. Comer doces aqui se tornará um hábito!
text_en: The Butterwood Bake Consortium is a wonderful place—exactly the kind of spot that Upper Lawrenceville needed. Just one year ago, there were no good places to have coffee, tea, or desserts other than on 52nd Street. With this option for desserts, coffee, and tea, plus the B52 Coffee nearby, the area now has everything it needs. I came here with a friend who wanted to try it out with me. I arrived a little early and was greeted by a friendly staff member. I ordered a strawberry vanilla vegan cake and asked about the tea options. She let me try different types of tea, and I chose mint tea—I thought it would go well with the cake. The walnut tea had an excellent aroma, and I plan to come back to try it with a dark chocolate cake. I sat at a Victorian-style garden-themed table, and my order was delivered in less than five minutes. The cake was warm, and the tea came with a small timer for preparation. Everything tasted delicious! At that moment, my friend arrived and chose a chocolate mousse and an espresso. She was also very satisfied with the quality of the dessert. I was offered more water for a second cup of tea, and we sat there and talked for over an hour, as the place became increasingly crowded and lively. (There was even a reading club!) I loved seeing how people were having fun. Eating sweets here will become a habit!
original: The Butterwood Bake Consortium is a gem of a place and exactly the sort of spot Upper Lawrenceville was lacking. Only a year ago there weren't any good places to grab coffee or tea and pastries past 52nd street. With this covering desserts, coffee, and tea and the nearby B52 cafe, the area is lacking no longer. I came here with a friend who had been wanting to try it with me. I arrived a bit earlier than she did and was greeted by the lovely woman behind the counter. I ordered a vegan blackberry vanilla cake and inquired about the tea options. She let me smell the different types of tea, and I chose the peppermint which I thought would be light enough to pair with the cake. The chestnut tea smelled excellent, and I will be back to try some with a dark chocolate dessert. I sat at one of the Victorian garden style tables, and my order was brought out to me in under five minutes. The cake had been warmed up and the tea came with a little timer for steeping. Everything tasted delicious! By this time my friend had arrived and selected chocolate mouse and an espresso. She felt much the same about the quality of her dessert. I was offered more water for a second cup of tea, and we sat and chatted for over an hour as the place became progressively more full and lively. (There was even a book club!) I loved seeing how much people were enjoying themselves. Dessert here is going to be a regular occurrence!

text: DELICIOUS ice cream. Available in pints in grocery stores and also at the Mitchell's flagship in Ohio City. Both are well worth it. The store is lively and has tons of great flavors. And the ice cream still tastes great in pints from the grocery store. Chocolate peanut butter cup is particularly delicious, but all their flavors with chocolate are great.
text_en: DELICIOUS ice cream. Available in pints in grocery stores and also at the Mitchell's flagship in Ohio City. Both are well worth it. The store is lively and has tons of great flavors. And the ice cream still tastes great in pints from the grocery store. Chocolate peanut butter cup is particularly delicious, but all their flavors with chocolate are great.

text: The bakery is open again! They were even giving out free boxes with a few masks. A+ bonus for the free gifts!!!
text_en: The bakery is open again! They were even giving out free boxes with a few masks. A+ bonus for the free gifts!!!

text: Had to visit the Carlos bakery and went on a sat. Night. The line was as long as a show line in Vegas. Didn't wait but went back at 745am before they opened at 8. Already 10 people in front of me. Wow but worth the wait. Very organized pleasant staff, prices reasonable, best lobster tails I ever had. The cannolis are to die for. Yum I will be back waiting in line before I leave Vegas. Kudos to the manager and to buddy.

text: Teníamos grandes expectativas para este lugar. A las 10 de la mañana, solo les quedaba una selección muy limitada, y ninguna de las especialidades que son famosas en ese lugar estaban disponibles. Mi café habitual no sabía muy bien. Un servicio excelente y un bonito patio trasero, pero nada particularmente destacable.
text_en: We had high expectations for this place. At 10 a.m., there was only a very limited selection available, and none of the specialties that are famous at this location were available. My usual coffee didn’t taste very good. The service was excellent, and there’s a nice backyard, but nothing particularly outstanding.
original: We had high expectations for this place. By 10am, they only had a very small selection left - none of the ones that the place is known for were available. My regular coffee did not taste good at all. Very nice service and a pretty back patio but nothing to write home about.

text: Eu adoro este lugar. Meu namorado também adora este lugar. Minha colega de quarto diz que este é o seu lugar favorito em Las Vegas. Para ser sincero, eu não gosto de cobertura de glacê. Não é culpa da Sprinkles, mas é o que é. Dito isto, eu ainda adoro os seus cupcakes. (Normalmente, eu escolho aqueles com sabores como canela e açúcar, que não têm cobertura.) Nunca tive um cupcake ruim deles. O sorvete deles também é excelente. Eu só experimentei o sabor "Cap'n Crunch", mas é tão delicioso que não tenho vontade de experimentar nenhum outro. As sobremesas com brownies também são boas, as sobremesas com biscoitos também são boas (experimente o "snickerdoodle!") e os cones de waffle vermelhos também são ótimos. De verdade, você não pode errar aqui.
text_en: I love this place. My boyfriend also loves it. My roommate says this is her favorite spot in Las Vegas. To be honest, I don’t like the glaze on the cupcakes. It’s not Sprinkles’ fault, but it just is. Still, I really enjoy their cupcakes. (Usually, I choose those with flavors like cinnamon and sugar, which don’t have a glaze.) I’ve never had a bad one from them before. Their ice cream is also great. I only tried the “Cap’n Crunch” flavor, but it’s so delicious that I don’t want to try any other flavors. The desserts with brownies are good too, as are those with cookies (try the “snickerdoodle!”), and the red waffle cones are also excellent. Really, you can’t go wrong here.
original: I love this place. My boyfriend loves this place. My roommate says this is her favourite place in all of Las Vegas. In the interest of being upfront - I don't like icing. It's not Sprinkles fault, but it is what it is. That being said, I still love their cupcakes. (I usually choose ones like the cinnamon sugar flavour that doesn't have icing.) I've never had a bad cupcake from them. Their ice cream is also phenomenal. I've only had the cap'n crunch flavour, but it's so freaking good that I have no desire to try any other one. Their brownie sundaes are good, their cookie sundaes are good (get the snickerdoodle!), and their red waffle cones are good. You seriously cannot go wrong here.

text: Went for the toffee banofi but ended up making my own mix......Triple play coconut sorbet, peaberry espresso sorbet, coconut cashew curry ice cream with homemade brittle and caramel sauce. WOW WEEEEEEEE WOW!!!!! is all I can say. For once I can say there is something that rivals gelato. I will definitely be back!
text_en: Went for the toffee banofi but ended up making my own mix......Triple play coconut sorbet, peaberry espresso sorbet, coconut cashew curry ice cream with homemade brittle and caramel sauce. WOW WEEEEEEEE WOW!!!!! is all I can say. For once I can say there is something that rivals gelato. I will definitely be back!

text: If you are willing to wait in the line, you will be rewarded. I love Milk Bar. I've been to a couple of the store locations in NYC and always like to get a slice of crack pie, if I can. This recent visit to Las Vegas was no different. We had just gone for cocktails at the Chandelier Bar and Milk Bar was still open so we bee lined over for a slice of crack pie, a Thanksgiving croissant (this was new for me - turkey, stuffing, cranberry and gravy goodness, tucked in a warm croissant for $8! Perfect post-bar food) and a couple of cookies to bring back for the kids (confetti cookie and cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie). Nothing is cheap, but everything was delicious and tasted just as good as it does in NYC.

text: O atendimento foi excelente e fiquei interessado no sabor do "Crack Pie", já que a nossa sorveteria local não oferece esse sabor. O atendente também foi prestativo, oferecendo um recipiente maior para evitar derramamentos.
text_en: The service was excellent, and I became interested in the flavor of “Crack Pie”, as our local ice cream shop doesn’t offer this flavor. The staff was also helpful, offering a larger container to prevent spills.
original: Service was excellent and I was intrigued by the Crack Pie flavor, seeing that our local Milk Bar does not serve that. Server was also helpful by offering a larger container to prevent spillage.

text: É bom que eu não more mais perto deste lugar, caso contrário, estaria em sérias dificuldades. Parece que este é um dos melhores machás disponíveis. Há uma grande variedade de sabores deliciosos e diferentes itens no cardápio para experimentar. É um lugar muito divertido. O ambiente também é muito agradável.
text_en: It’s good that I don’t live near this place anymore; otherwise, I would be in serious trouble. It seems to be one of the best restaurants available. There’s a wide variety of delicious flavors and different dishes to try. It’s a very fun place. The atmosphere is also very pleasant.
original: It's a good thing I don't live closer to this place or I would be in serious trouble. This has to be some of the freshest matcha available. There are so many delicious flavors and various menu items to try. This is a very fun place. The ambience is also very cute.

text: Excelente panadería de "vida cotidiana" en el corazón de Little Italy. Paré a media tarde después de visitar el museo de arte. El lugar seguía estando animado, pero todo el personal de la barra era muy amable. Tenía una oferta irresistible, pero opté por el "Napoleon" y un café au lait. A pesar de un pequeño debate conmigo mismo en favor de la moderación, terminé comiendo casi todo el pastel. Era maravilloso y un poco diferente a otros "Napoleon" que he probado, y, sí, sé lo que dicen: comí un pastel francés en una panadería italiana. Mi estómago no conoce fronteras. Pero de todas formas, las capas del pastel eran ligeras y sabrosas. Lo interesante es que la capa de crema era bastante consistente y cremosa, no especialmente elegante, pero muy deliciosa. Me dio la energía para caminar desde Murray Hill de vuelta a mi barrio en Coventry. Una visita obligada en Little Italy.
text_en: An excellent “daily life” bakery right in the heart of Little Italy. I stopped by in the middle of the afternoon after visiting the art museum. The place was still lively, but all the staff at the counter were very friendly. There was an irresistible offer, but I chose the “Napoleon” and a coffee au lait. Despite a little internal debate about moderation, I ended up eating almost the whole cake. It was wonderful—a bit different from the other “Napoleon” cakes I’ve tried before. Yes, I know what people say: I ate a French cake in an Italian bakery. My stomach knows no boundaries. But still, the layers of the cake were light and delicious. What’s interesting is that the cream layer was quite solid and creamy—not particularly elegant, but very tasty. It gave me the energy to walk from Murray Hill back to my neighborhood in Coventry. A must-visit in Little Italy.
original: Great "slice of life" bakery in the heart of Little Italy. Stopped in mid-afternoon after visiting the art museum. The place was still bustling, but the counter staff were all very pleasant. It was an impossibly tempting set of choices but I went with the Napoleon and a cafe au lait, Despite a little bargaining with myself in the direction of restraint, I pretty much devoured the pastry. It was wonderful and a little unusual compared to other Napoleon's I've sampled, and, yes, I know: I had a French pastry in an Italian bakery. My tummy knows no borders. But at any rate the pastry layers were light and flavorful. The interesting thing is that the creme pÃ¢tissiÃ¨re was a rather substantial custardy layer, not especially elegant but very delicious. It gave me the strength to walk up from Murray Hill back into my home turf in Coventry! A must-visit in Little Italy.

text: MACARONS MACARONS MACARONS! When you're in Vegas, do yourself a favor and go to the Venetian and get yourself a box of these macarons (maybe even two boxes). They're $17.50 for a total of 6 macarons. It might be a little pricier than most but they are delicious! They got the texture pretty perfect. Delicate flaky outside and chewy inside. YUM! My favorite was the coffee flavor (which I usually don't like in macarons but this one was excellent)!! But I still think Euro Pane's salted caramel macaron is #1! I have yet to find one that beats that! although Chantilly comes close. But this is a very close tie for 2nd! Get it get it get it!

text: Após uma caminhada intensa e longa nas montanhas vermelhas, um sorvete é o complemento perfeito. Experimentei o "Fruity Pebble", que veio em um pequeno recipiente de take-away chinês, com um "biscoito da sorte". Sem motivo, apenas porque é possível. ADORO os sabores únicos que a Melt oferece. Com certeza voltarei para ver o que eles inventarão em seguida!
text_en: After an intense and long walk through the red mountains, ice cream is the perfect complement. I tried the “Fruity Pebble” – it came in a small Chinese takeaway container, along with a “lucky biscuit”. Without a reason, just because it’s possible. I love the unique flavors that Melt offers. I will definitely come back to see what they will create next!
original: After a hot, long hike in the red mountains, ice cream is the perfect pick-me-up. I tried the Fruity Pebble, and it came in a cute little Chinese take-out container with a fortune cookie. No reason, just because it can. I LOVE the unique flavors Melt has to offer. Will certainly return to see what they will come up with next!

text: We stopped in at Presti's for the first time. Great selection and we looked forward to a great dessert. After taking a number we began the wait. There were approximately 8 customers in front of us so I expected a bit of a wait. After 35 minutes I was on the verge of walking out, as others had done. Although there were 4 employees there only 1 was helping customers. After ten minutes he left, went to the deli area, waited on 2 customers, chatted with them awhile and left the bakery customers waiting. One employee at the bakery counter was wrapping loaves of bread into bags for future sale, never thought to ask the group of customers if they needed help, just kept wrapping and ignored the group. Finally, made my selection, and walked out. The products were great but I would not go again. Amateurs all.

text: Esta é a primeira semana de funcionamento, espero que o processo de pedido e atendimento seja revisado. Cheguei hoje para pegar meu cannoli gratuito e uma xícara de café. Fiz meu pedido e eles anotaram. Basicamente, é só servir café e cannoli. Esperei 15 minutos para que meu cannoli fosse colocado em um saco e registrado. Cheguei ao balcão, mas o café ainda não estava pronto. Uau. O cannoli não era o tipo de cannoli de ricota que se encontra em Filadélfia ou Nova York, era mais do tipo recheado com glacê. Não fiquei muito impressionado. Os outros doces pareciam bons.
text_en: This is the first week of operation. I hope the process of ordering and service can be improved. I arrived today to get a free cannoli and a cup of coffee. I placed my order, and they took notes on it. Basically, it’s just about serving coffee and cannoli. I waited for 15 minutes until my cannoli was put into a bag and recorded. I went to the counter, but the coffee wasn’t ready yet. Wow. The cannoli wasn’t the type of cannoli made with ricotta that you find in Philadelphia or New York—it was more like one filled with glaze. I wasn’t very impressed. The other desserts seemed good.
original: This is opening week, hopefully the ordering and serving process gets revised. I stop in for my free cannoli and a cup of coffee this morning. Placed my order and they wrote it down. Wth it's coffee and cannoli just serve it. I wait 15 minutes for my cannoli to be put in a bag and rung up at the register. I get to the register and the coffee isn't ready yet. Wow. The cannoli wasn't the ricotta cannoli you would get in Philly or New York, it was more the icing filling kind. Wasn't impressed. The other pastries looked good.

text: Compramos um quadrado de creme de morango (3,20 dólares), um pastel de coco (2,05 dólares) e um pacote com 3 biscoitos de chocolate (3,30 dólares). O quadrado de creme de morango estava apenas aceitável, mas é caro considerando o tamanho. O pastel de coco também não foi tão bom quanto eu esperava; posso encontrar opções melhores na Sunville Bakery. A minha maior reclamação foi com os biscoitos de chocolate, que tinham um sabor de canela muito forte! Os biscoitos não tinham sabor de manteiga e estavam duros e crocantes, o que não é o meu preferido.
text_en: We bought a square of strawberry cream (3.20 dollars), a coconut cake (2.05 dollars), and a package of 3 chocolate cookies (3.30 dollars). The square of strawberry cream was just acceptable, but it’s expensive considering its size. The coconut cake wasn’t as good as I expected either; I can find better options at Sunville Bakery. My biggest complaint was the chocolate cookies—they had a very strong cinnamon flavor! The cookies didn’t have any buttery taste and were hard and crunchy, which isn’t my favorite.
original: We got the strawberry cream square ($3.20), coconut twist pastry ($2.05) and the bag of 3 chocolate chip cookies ($3.30). The strawberry cream square was just ok, but it's expensive for such a small square of cake. The coconut twist pastry was just ok too, better can be found at Sunville Bakery. I had the biggest complaint with the chocolate chip cookies, which was horrible with the large cinnamon flavor in the cookies! The cookies didn't have any buttery flavor with the chocolate chips and the cookies were hard and crispy, where I prefer crispy outside and chewy inside.

text: Creo que tienen los mejores macarons. He probado varios, ya que a mi esposa le encantan. Esta es la segunda vez que los compramos y, como la primera, ¡están deliciosos! Además, no son del tamaño normal.
text_en: I think they have the best macarons. I’ve tried several of them, as my wife really loves them. This is the second time we’ve bought them, and, just like the first time, they are delicious! Moreover, they aren’t of regular size.
original: I believe they have the best macarons! I've had plenty since my wife loves them. This is the second time we've gotten them and they've been just as tasty! They aren't your normal size either.

text: ¡BIENVENIDOS A FLAVORLAND! Ubicado en un centro comercial, a pocos pasos de McDowell Fatty Daddy's, Flavorland fue perfecto para un "aperitivo dulce después del cine". Fui recibido por un vendedor de helados muy profesional. Tenía un amplio conocimiento de sus helados y sorbetes, y me explicó el menú. Elegí la taza especial que contiene: una porción de su helado (con chispas de chocolate), una macarona (elegí la de almendra) y un cuadrado de malvavisco perfectamente tostado. Volveré para probar el helado sin lácteos.
text_en: Welcome to Flavorland! Located in a shopping center, just a few steps from McDowell Fatty Daddy’s, Flavorland was perfect for a “sweet pre-dinner snack after movies”. I was greeted by a very professional ice cream vendor. He had extensive knowledge of his ice creams and sorbets, and explained the menu to me. I chose the special cup that contains: a portion of his ice cream (with chocolate shards), a macaron (I chose the almond one), and a perfectly toasted marshmallow square. I will return to try the dairy-free ice cream.
original: WELCOME TO FLAVORLAND! Tucked away in a strip mall just an alleyway from McDowell Fatty Daddy's was beyond satisfying for my "after a movie sweet snack". I was greeted with a very professional ice cream sales man. He was knowledgeable about their gelato & sorbets and gave me a run down of the menu. I choose the specialty cookie cup that layers: a scoop of their gelato (chocolate chip), a macaroon ( I picked almond), and a perfectly toasted marshmallow square on top. I will be going back to try the dairy free gelato.

The staff was friendly and helpfu. The atmosphere is cute and quirky. They have lots of fun things for sale there. The only con? The cookies are terrible! They are hard and dry and flavorless. text: ¡El helado más delicioso que he probado! Pedí el de frambuesa con virutas de chocolate, que en realidad son trozos de chocolate. Muy sabroso y con mucho sabor. Tiene un precio muy razonable y un horario excelente, con un personal muy amable. La pareja que estaba delante de nosotros probablemente probó 5 o más sabores antes de decidir, y el empleado no mostró ninguna frustración. Definitivamente deberían abrir una sucursal en Nueva Jersey (o enviar helado). ¡Es una visita obligada si estás en Cleveland y te gustan los dulces!
text_en: The most delicious ice cream I’ve ever tried! I ordered the raspberry with chocolate chips—actually, they’re just chunks of chocolate. Very tasty and full of flavor. The price is very reasonable, and the hours of operation are excellent, with a very friendly staff. The couple sitting in front of us probably tried 5 or more flavors before deciding, and the employee didn’t show any frustration at all. Definitely should open a branch in New Jersey (or send out ice cream). It’s a must-visit if you’re in Cleveland and love sweets!
original: Best ice cream Ive had! I had the raspberry with chocolate sprinkles which are actually chocolate shavings! Very flavorful and rich. Well priced and great hours, with a very friendly staff. The couple in front of us probably tried 5 or more flavored before deciding and no issue or frustration by the worker. They need to build one in NJ (or ship!). A must do if you are in Cleveland and love sweets!

text: Este lugar é simplesmente incrível!!! Não é muito caro, mas o sabor dos doces e bolos vale cada centavo! Eu daria 5 estrelas, mas precisei esperar em uma fila por 1 hora só para entrar na confeitaria. Eu estava com meus filhos e eles não estavam bem esperando, então os coloquei contra uma parede (de forma discreta, longe de todo mundo), mas a segurança naquele local, no The Venetian, foi muito mal-educada e disse que estavam atrapalhando o tráfego (o que não era verdade) e os obrigou a voltar para a fila conosco! Eu voltaria, mas não levaria meus filhos da próxima vez... e estaria preparado para a espera e com meus sapatos confortáveis!
text_en: This place is simply amazing!!! It’s not very expensive, but the taste of the desserts and cakes is worth every penny! I would give it 5 stars, but I had to wait in line for an hour just to get into the bakery. I was with my children, and they weren’t happy waiting, so I put them against a wall (discreetly, away from everyone), but the security at The Venetian was very rude—they said they were blocking traffic (which wasn’t true), and forced them to return to the line with us! I would go back, but I wouldn’t bring my children next time… and I’d be prepared for the wait, with my comfortable shoes on!
original: This place is soooo good!!! Not too overpriced, but the taste of their desserts and pastries is worth every penny! I would have given them 5 stars, but I had to wait in line for 1 hour just to get into the bakery. I had my kids with me and they were not doing well with the wait so I had them stand against a wall (totally out of the way of everybody), but security there at The Venetian was very rude and said they were in the way of traffic (they were not) and made them come back in line with us! Would come back again, but I wouldn't bring my kids next time...and I would be prepared for the wait and have my comfy shoes on!!

Mas, uma vez que chegamos ao balcão, a equipe é extremamente atenciosa e nunca nos faz sentir apressados. Adoro o mousse de chocolate e o café gelado deles. But once we reached the counter, the staff is extremely attentive and never makes us feel rushed. I love their chocolate mousse and cold coffee. Unfortunately, they often run out of my boyfriend’s favorite flavor (Napolitano), so I imagine that means they’re really good! The place itself has a charming and eclectic atmosphere. Definitely a nice place to sit down, have coffee, and eat a treat. I would like to see more outdoor space. On pleasant days, there’s never a table available!

text_en: 5 stars purely for the macarons – an excellent quality-price ratio, considering the price, flavor, and size. The pistachio flavor is delicious! The cranberry and salt caramel macarons were good, but they couldn’t compare to those with pistachio flavor. However, I have reduced the rating to 4 stars because the chocolate and almond croissant didn’t meet my expectations or my previous experiences. I’ve definitely tried better croissants; it was a bit hard and crumbly, and it lacked that light, crumbly texture that one expects from a croissant. Without a doubt, I would go back for the macarons.
original: 5 stars for the macaron alone - great value considering price, taste, and size. Pistachio flavor soo yummy!!! The raspberry and salted caramel were OK, but pale in comparison to the pistachio. Knocked it down to 4 stars though because the chocolate almond croissant didn't live up to my expectation or past experiences. Have definitely had better, was a bit too hard and crunchy and lacked some of that light flakey texture you expect from a croissant. Would definitely come back for the macaron.

text: O letreiro de neon e a janela de retirada do Milk Bar são fáceis de encontrar no segundo andar do Cosmopolitan, bem em frente às escadas e ao lado do Momofuku. Tinha ouvido tantas opiniões ("demasiado doce", "exagerado", "nostalgia perfeita", etc.), e minha experiência foi que gostamos do que experimentamos. Nada foi transformador – mas, no entanto, não necessariamente quero que minha vida seja transformada por um doce. O sorvete de leite com cereais tinha o sabor de leite com cereais, e os pedacinhos de flocos de milho caramelizados que estavam por cima eram divertidos. O sorvete de bolo de chocolate era realmente intenso, como um bolo de chocolate congelado e espesso. Experimentamos o biscoito com confete, o biscoito com milho, o biscoito com composto, o biscoito com flocos de milho/marshmallow/chocolate e o biscoito com chocolate/chocolate. O biscoito favorito foi o de flocos de milho/marshmallow/chocolate, porque a combinação de doce, salgado, macio e crocante estava em perfeito equilíbrio. Em seguida, o biscoito com confete, que tinha o sabor de uma versão de bolo de baunilha saboroso. Os biscoitos de chocolate/chocolate e de milho eram gostosos no momento, mas, no final, eram esquecíveis. E o biscoito com composto foi controverso – alguns não gostaram dos grãos de café, outros tiveram problemas com as lascas de batata chips/pretzel que eram inesperadamente crocantes. Uma pessoa amou o prazer de comer um biscoito feito com composto de lixo. Sim, os preços são altos (os biscoitos custam US$ 4).
text_en: The neon sign and the window for the Milk Bar are easy to find on the second floor of the Cosmopolitan, right in front of the stairs and next to Momofuku. I’ve heard many opinions—“too sweet,” “overdone,” “perfect nostalgia,” etc.—and from my experience, we liked what we tried. Nothing was truly transformative—but still, I don’t necessarily want my life to be changed by a candy. The milk ice cream with cereal had the taste of milk with cereal, and the caramelized cornflakes on top were fun. The chocolate cake ice cream was really intense, like a thick, frozen chocolate cake. We tried the confetti cookie, the corn cookie, the compound cookie, the corn/marshmallow/chocolate cookie, and the chocolate/chocolate cookie. My favorite was the corn/marshmallow/chocolate cookie, because the combination of sweet, salty, soft, and crunchy flavors was perfectly balanced. Then there was the confetti cookie, which tasted like a delicious vanilla cake. The chocolate/chocolate and corn cookies were tasty at first, but eventually became forgettable. And the compound cookie was controversial—some didn’t like the coffee grains, while others had trouble with the unexpected crispy potato chip/pretzel pieces. Someone really enjoyed the pleasure of eating a cookie made from waste compost. Yes, the prices are high—the cookies cost $4 each.
original: Milk Bar's neon sign and takeout window is easy to find on the second floor of the Cosmopolitan, right in front of the escalators and beside Momofuku. I'd heard so much ('too sweet", "overhyped", "nostalgia perfected", etc.), and my experience was that we enjoyed what we tried. Nothing was life-changing - but then again, I don't necessarily want my life changed by a sugary treat. The cereal milk soft serve tasted like cereal milk, and the caramelized corn flake crumbs sprinkled on it were fun. The chocolate cake batter soft serve was really intense, like frozen thick cake batter. We tried the confetti cookie, corn cookie, compost cookie, corn flake/marshmallow/chocolate cookie, and chocolate/chocolate cookie. Favorite cookie was the corn flake/marshmalow/chocolate because the sweet, salty, soft, crunchy was in perfect balance, followed by the confetti cookie because it tasted like the cookie version of a tasty vanilla birthday cake. The chocolate/chocolate and corn cookies were yummy at the time but ultimately forgettable, and the compost cookie was polarizing - some of us were turned off by the coffee grounds, others had an issue with the potato chip/pretzel bits that were unpredictably crunchy, one person loved the guilty pleasure of a cookie made from junk food compost. Yes, prices are on the high end (cookies are $4).
