text: I had the pleasure of visiting the LV Sprinkles Cupcakes & Ice Cream in April 2014, soon after they opened. It's always neat to see how each Sprinkles location differs, and this particular store just screamed "VEGAS," from its light-up signage to the attention-grabbing cupcake ATM. This was the first Sprinkles store that I had seen actually joined--cupcakes and ice cream were not separated--which was neat but also confusing. I think that, because the store had only recently opened, they were still trying to figure things out. I entered from the ice cream side, but I was directed to stand in the line for cupcakes (when I wanted ice cream, not cupcakes). Hopefully by now, the Vegas store has everything a little more under control, because with two entrances, it can be easy for customers to get confused/not know where to go when it comes time to order. I was surprised to see that I didn't have to wait in an enormously long line to order my ice cream (there was a line, but it moved along). I appreciated the fact that there was a good seating area outside the store for customers to enjoy their cupcakes and ice cream -- more seats and tables than I have ever seen at a Sprinkles store. I ordered the seasonal "Cookie Dough" ice cream flavor--one of my favorites; I wish it were a regular menu item--in the "Sprinkles Sundae," complete with my all-time favorite "Peanut Butter Chip" cupcake. I think because the workers were still getting into the groove of things at Sprinkles, the ice cream scoops were a bit larger than what I usually receive ... and hey, no complaints about that! The ice cream and cupcake quality were the same as I had experienced at other Sprinkles stores, which was great. However, I was a bit disappointed with the "Salted Oatmeal Cornflake" and "Peanut Butter Pretzel Chip" cookies that I ordered. Instead of the normal slightly crispy exterior and moist, soft interior, these cookies were on the harder, crunchier side, and the "Salted Oatmeal Cornflake" was definitely saltier than I would have liked. But, then again, gotta have some grace and patience because the store had just opened -- hopefully the cookies are a bit more consistent with the usual Sprinkles taste by now. The BF ordered the "Sprinkles Shake" with his usual combo of "Captain Crunch" ice cream and "Peanut Butter Chip" cupcake. The shake was as sweet as usual--I got a few sips in there--but we both noticed that the texture was also chunkier than usual. At one point, he had to use a spoon to get some of the larger cupcake chunks (definitely different from being able to inhale everything quickly with a straw). But he had no complaints--he said it was actually nice to munch on those cupcake bits every now and then. The friends we were with decided to share a "Sprinkles Shake" with "Red Velvet" ice cream and cupcakes (she really likes the "Red Velvet"). They were extremely pleased with their foray into Sprinkles and said they would definitely get the "Red Velvet"-heavy shake again (though, they were happy that they shared it, saying that it would have been too much red velvet for one person to handle). Overall, I had a positive experience at this LV Sprinkles. I really, really liked its dÃ©cor--the dazzling lights and huge marquee made it stand out from any other store I've been to so far--and the dÃ©cor really made the store easily spottable. I have no doubts that this location stays busy far into the night and keeps up with the Vegas nightlife. I do hope, though, for customers' sakes, that the ordering system is a bit more streamlined and organized to avoid confusion when entering/exiting the store.
text_en: I had the pleasure of visiting the LV Sprinkles Cupcakes & Ice Cream in April 2014, soon after they opened. It's always neat to see how each Sprinkles location differs, and this particular store just screamed "VEGAS," from its light-up signage to the attention-grabbing cupcake ATM. This was the first Sprinkles store that I had seen actually joined--cupcakes and ice cream were not separated--which was neat but also confusing. I think that, because the store had only recently opened, they were still trying to figure things out. I entered from the ice cream side, but I was directed to stand in the line for cupcakes (when I wanted ice cream, not cupcakes). Hopefully by now, the Vegas store has everything a little more under control, because with two entrances, it can be easy for customers to get confused/not know where to go when it comes time to order. I was surprised to see that I didn't have to wait in an enormously long line to order my ice cream (there was a line, but it moved along). I appreciated the fact that there was a good seating area outside the store for customers to enjoy their cupcakes and ice cream -- more seats and tables than I have ever seen at a Sprinkles store. I ordered the seasonal "Cookie Dough" ice cream flavor--one of my favorites; I wish it were a regular menu item--in the "Sprinkles Sundae," complete with my all-time favorite "Peanut Butter Chip" cupcake. I think because the workers were still getting into the groove of things at Sprinkles, the ice cream scoops were a bit larger than what I usually receive ... and hey, no complaints about that! The ice cream and cupcake quality were the same as I had experienced at other Sprinkles stores, which was great. However, I was a bit disappointed with the "Salted Oatmeal Cornflake" and "Peanut Butter Pretzel Chip" cookies that I ordered. Instead of the normal slightly crispy exterior and moist, soft interior, these cookies were on the harder, crunchier side, and the "Salted Oatmeal Cornflake" was definitely saltier than I would have liked. But, then again, gotta have some grace and patience because the store had just opened -- hopefully the cookies are a bit more consistent with the usual Sprinkles taste by now. The BF ordered the "Sprinkles Shake" with his usual combo of "Captain Crunch" ice cream and "Peanut Butter Chip" cupcake. The shake was as sweet as usual--I got a few sips in there--but we both noticed that the texture was also chunkier than usual. At one point, he had to use a spoon to get some of the larger cupcake chunks (definitely different from being able to inhale everything quickly with a straw). But he had no complaints--he said it was actually nice to munch on those cupcake bits every now and then. The friends we were with decided to share a "Sprinkles Shake" with "Red Velvet" ice cream and cupcakes (she really likes the "Red Velvet"). They were extremely pleased with their foray into Sprinkles and said they would definitely get the "Red Velvet"-heavy shake again (though, they were happy that they shared it, saying that it would have been too much red velvet for one person to handle). Overall, I had a positive experience at this LV Sprinkles. I really, really liked its dÃ©cor--the dazzling lights and huge marquee made it stand out from any other store I've been to so far--and the dÃ©cor really made the store easily spottable. I have no doubts that this location stays busy far into the night and keeps up with the Vegas nightlife. I do hope, though, for customers' sakes, that the ordering system is a bit more streamlined and organized to avoid confusion when entering/exiting the store.

text: Ok... ¿qué me estoy perdiendo? Todas las reseñas positivas y el premio de la crítica de los periódicos locales por tener un helado bueno, me habían convencido de ir. Tenían varios sabores extraños y algunos clásicos. Quizás debería haber elegido uno de los clásicos. En cambio, opté por el sabor de trufa, pensando que iba a ser un delicioso postre. Al probarlo, ¡¡¡EWWWW!!! Pregunté qué era y me dijeron que estaba hecho con trufa... ¡pero con hongo! No tenía idea de que alguien hiciera helado con eso. Necesitaba algo para limpiar mi paladar inmediatamente. No podía deshacerme de ese sabor desagradable. La chica detrás del mostrador lo encontró muy divertido. Simplemente no entiendo el revuelo que hay alrededor de ese lugar. Me gusta usar ingredientes frescos y locales, así que prefiero el helado de Crave o Udder Delights.
text_en: Okay… what am I missing? All the positive reviews and the critic awards given by local newspapers for having a good ice cream made me decide to go there. There were several unusual flavors, as well as some classic ones. Maybe I should have chosen one of the classic flavors. Instead, I chose the truffle flavor, thinking it would be a delicious dessert. But when I tasted it, EWWWW!!! I asked what it was, and they told me it was made with truffle… but with mushrooms! I had no idea that someone could make ice cream with that. I needed something to clean my palate right away. I couldn’t get rid of that unpleasant taste. The girl behind the counter found it very amusing. I simply don’t understand the fuss around that place. I like to use fresh, local ingredients, so I prefer Crave or Udder Delights ice cream.
original: Ok...what am I missing? All the 'rave' reviews and the local news papers' critic award for good ice cream, I was eager to go there. There were several weird-o flavors and a few of the basic. Perhaps I should have stayed with the basic. Instead, I chose the truffle...thinking I was getting the sweet treat truffle. One taste and YUCK! I asked what it was and was told that it was made with truffle...but the fungus truffle!!!! I was not aware ANYONE would make ice cream out that! I needed a palate cleanser right away..I could not get that nasty taste out of my mouth. The girl behind the counter thought it was very humorous. My cup went straight into to garbage. I just don't understand the buzz about that place. I like using fresh and local ingredients so give me Crave or Udder Delights ice cream any day.

text: Experimentei o latte com leite de rosas, que estava delicioso. Fiquei satisfeito em saber que este lugar começou a servir boba! Pedimos um tamanho pequeno, acredito que custou cerca de $5. As mesas estavam um pouco sujas, então tivemos que limpá-las antes de sentar, mas parece que havia apenas uma pessoa trabalhando no balcão na época, e, naturalmente, ele estava muito ocupado atendendo aos pedidos. Os sabores são bem únicos, então eu voltaria!
text_en: I tried the latte with rose milk, and it was delicious. I’m happy to know that this place has started serving bubble tea! We ordered a small size; I believe it cost about $5. The tables were a little dirty, so we had to clean them before sitting down. It seems that there was only one person working at the counter at that time, and of course, he was very busy serving customers. The flavors are really unique, so I would definitely go back!
original: Got the rose milk latte, which was delicious. I'm glad this place started serving boba! We got a small, I believe, for ~$5. Tables were sort of filthy, so we had to wipe them down ourselves before sitting, but I believe there was only one person working behind the counter at the time, and he was understandably very busy with orders by himself. The flavors are pretty unique, so I'd go again!

text: So so so good! The food is great and the desserts are pretty good too! The best part is the atmosphere. Hands down. Had so much just hanging around and people watching. A must stop and see!
text_en: So so so good! The food is great and the desserts are pretty good too! The best part is the atmosphere. Hands down. Had so much just hanging around and people watching. A must stop and see!

text: Todos os seus produtos de panificação são deliciosos, você não pode errar com nada. Se você for comprar algo, também deve experimentar o chá tailandês deles, pois é muito bom.
text_en: All of their bakery products are delicious; you can’t go wrong with anything they offer. If you plan to buy something, you should also try their Thai tea, as it’s really good.
original: All of their baked goods are delicious, you can't go wrong with anything. If you are going to buy some things, you should also pick up their Thai tea because it's very good.

text: Lugar encantador! O tiramisu deles é delicioso, nós o compramos para o aniversário de um amigo e a consistência é tão cremosa e densa, que lembra sorvete. Os acompanhamentos são feitos com biscoitos finos e macios, e a sobremesa foi uma delícia! Uma sobremesa compartilhada por cerca de 6 pessoas custou US$ 30, o que a torna mais cara do que outras sobremesas menores, mas definitivamente valeu a pena. Eu também sempre peço o café com leite deles e, às vezes, adicionam muito leite e pouco café, mas por US$ 2, ainda é uma bebida agradável! O espaço ao ar livre é muito agradável, com vista para Mayfield e Murray Hill. A disposição da padaria permite que haja bastante luz natural, e eu consigo imaginar vindo aqui em um dia menos movimentado para ler ou simplesmente relaxar e aproveitar o sol! Experimente também os produtos da padaria com desconto! Você pode conseguir muffins ou croissants por apenas US$ 1, se forem do dia anterior, e eles também têm outros produtos com desconto, como crostata e sanduíches de frango.
text_en: A wonderful place! Their tiramisu is delicious – we bought it for a friend’s birthday. The consistency is so creamy and dense that it feels like ice cream. The side dishes are made with fine, soft biscuits, and the dessert was absolutely delightful! A dessert served for about 6 people cost $30, which makes it more expensive than other smaller desserts, but definitely worth it. I also always order their coffee with milk; sometimes they add too much milk and little coffee, but at $2, it’s still a pleasant drink. The outdoor space is very nice, with a view of Mayfield and Murray Hill. The layout of the bakery allows plenty of natural light, and I can imagine coming here on a less busy day to read or just relax and enjoy the sunshine. Try also the bakery products at a discount! You can get muffins or croissants for just $1, if they’re from the previous day. They also have other discounted products, like crostata and chicken sandwiches.
original: Cute place! Their tiramisu is delectable, we had it for a friend's birthday and its consistency is so creamy and thick, it's ice cream like. The sides are aligned with light and fluffy lady fingers and it was a joy of a cake! A cake shared between about 6 people came to $30 so more expensive than other small cakes for not a huge party but it was surely a treat. I also always get their cafe au lait and sometimes there is too much milk added and not enough coffee but for $2, it is still a good drink! The outdoor seating is super nice overlooking mayfield and Murray hill. The way the bakery is placed allows plenty of sunlight and I can see myself on a less busy day coming here to read or just sit and enjoy the sun! Try their discounted bakery goods as well! You can get muffins or croissants for just $1 if they are a day old and they have other discounted goods like crostata and Turkey sandwiches.

text: Como ousa cobrar US$ 14 por uma única fatia de bolo e, além disso, não se esforçar para que ele tenha um bom sabor ou seja fresco? Estou profundamente indignado e considero isso uma das piores atitudes em um ano de injustiças terríveis que ocorrem diariamente. Sinceramente, se eu quisesse algo pequeno, de gosto ruim e que desperdiçasse meu dinheiro, eu simplesmente ligaria para o meu ex.
text_en: How dare they charge $14 for just one piece of cake, and not even try to make it taste good or fresh? I’m deeply outraged, and I consider this one of the worst attitudes in the past year of terrible injustices that happen every day. Honestly, if I wanted something small, bad-tasting, and that wastes my money, I would just call my ex.
original: How dare you charge $14 for a single slice of cake and not even try to make it taste good or fresh. I am personally outraged and count this among the worst transgressions in a year of terrible injustices occurring daily. Honestly if I wanted something tiny that tasted like shit and wasted my money and left me disappointed I would call my ex.

text: Sus macarons son realmente deliciosos. Me encanta el tamaño grande de los macarons, la corteza delicada y crujiente, y la textura masticable en el interior. ¡Definitivamente valió la pena el precio. Creo que cada uno cuesta alrededor de 3,50 dólares. Mis favoritos son los de pistacho, frambuesa y limón. El de pistacho es, sin duda, mi favorito.
text_en: Their macarons are really delicious. I love the large size of the macarons, the delicate and crispy shell, and the chewy texture inside. Definitely worth the price. I think each one costs around $3.50. My favorites are pistachio, cranberry, and lemon macarons. The pistachio macaron is, without a doubt, my favorite.
original: Their macarons are sooooo good. Love the big size of the macarons, the delicate and flaky crust, and chewy inside. It was totally worth the money. Around $3.50 each I believe. My favorites are pistachio, raspberry, and lemon. Pistachio being number one by far.

text: Com base nas inúmeras avaliações de 5 estrelas, eu realmente esperava uma experiência incrível. O que obtive foi uma experiência sólida e caseira de sorvete. Melhor que a Dairy Queen, mas não o melhor sorvete que já experimentei. Talvez eu tenha pedido algo errado? (Sundae de amendoim e nozes). De qualquer forma, é excelente.
text_en: Based on the numerous 5-star reviews, I really expected an amazing experience. What I got was a solid and cozy ice cream experience. It’s better than Dairy Queen, but not the best ice cream I’ve ever tried. Maybe I ordered something wrong? (Peanut and nut sundae). Anyway, it’s excellent.
original: Based on the plethora of 5 star reviews, I really wanted to be blown away. What I got was a solid homemade ice cream experience. Better than Dairy Queen, but not the finest ice cream I have ever had. Maybe I ordered the wrong thing? (Butter Pecan sundae). Regardless, it's solid.

text: A Jeni's recusou vender sorvete para meu filho de 6 anos. Não aceitam dinheiro, o que é inconveniente, especialmente depois de esperar na fila por 30 minutos. Além disso, ofereceram que guardassem a diferença de uma nota de 20 dólares. É realmente lamentável que a Jeni's não consiga atender aqueles que a apoiam. Nós compramos lá duas vezes por semana desde que abriram, e não voltaremos mais!
text_en: Jeni’s refused to sell ice cream for my 6-year-old son. They don’t accept cash, which is inconvenient, especially after waiting in line for 30 minutes. Moreover, they offered to keep the difference in exchange for a $20 bill. It’s really unfortunate that Jeni’s can’t serve those who support them. We buy there twice a week since they opened, and we won’t be back anymore!
original: Jeni's denied my 6 year old ice cream. No cash excepted, nice to know once you wait in line for 30 min. Even offered to let them keep the change out of a $20. It's real nice that Jeni's can't take care of those that take care of them. We have supported them 2 times a week since they opened, never again!

text: I ordered the pear dessert crepe listed on the menu. YUK! The rock hard pear was put put in the crepe unpeeled. Two bites and thew the mess out. YUK!
text_en: I ordered the pear dessert crepe listed on the menu. YUK! The rock hard pear was put put in the crepe unpeeled. Two bites and thew the mess out. YUK!

text: Overrated soft serves, shakes, and cookies. Their marketing team definitely deserves some recognition though. Everything from installing those ig worthy neon lights/ signage to choosing the prime location inside Cosmo. Great work to those guys. At the end of the day, save yourself the $ and head over to McDonalds instead!
text_en: Overrated soft serves, shakes, and cookies. Their marketing team definitely deserves some recognition though. Everything from installing those ig worthy neon lights/ signage to choosing the prime location inside Cosmo. Great work to those guys. At the end of the day, save yourself the $ and head over to McDonalds instead!

text: Muito caro, para ser sincero, já tive milkshakes melhores no Burger King. Não há nada de especial neste lugar. Eu comprei uma fatia de torta de leite e achei que viria com sorvete, mas não veio. Era como pagar US$ 6,50 por um biscoito. Um milkshake custa US$ 10, o que não vale a pena.
text_en: It’s very expensive. To be honest, I’ve had much better milkshakes at Burger King. There’s nothing special about this place. I bought a slice of milk cake and expected it to come with ice cream, but it didn’t. It was like paying $6.50 for a cookie. A milkshake costs $10, which isn’t worth it at all.
original: Very overpriced, honestly have had better shakes at Burger King. Nothing special about this place at all. I got a slice milk bar pie I thought it would come with ice cream and it didn't, it was like paying $6.50 for a cookie. A milkshake there runs ya $10 totally not worth it

text: Sorvete sempre excelente, mas o atendimento deixa a desejar. Já fui a este local várias vezes, pois moro muito perto, e parece que sempre há falta de funcionários e que não há uma forma clara de organizar filas ou atender às pessoas. Isso pode ser frustrante. Tenho certeza de que, no inverno ou em dias mais lentos, esse problema é muito menor. O sorvete de chocolate Zanzibar é excelente e isso me faz voltar sempre! Há aparentemente milhões de sabores, muitos para escolher e diversos tipos de sobremesas, como milkshakes, sorvetes em cones e até opções de "sorvete em variedade".
text_en: The ice cream is always excellent, but the service is lacking. I’ve been to this place several times because I live very close by. It seems there are always shortages of staff, and there’s no clear way to organize lines or serve customers properly. This can be frustrating. I’m sure that during winter or during slower times, the problem is much less severe. The Zanzibar chocolate ice cream is great, which is why I keep coming back! There seem to be millions of flavors to choose from, many options for desserts like milkshakes, cone-shaped ice creams, and even “variety ice cream” options.
original: Great ice cream always, poor service in my experiences. I have been to this location many times as I live very near, and they always seem to be understaffed and have no clear way of forming lines or serving people. It can get frustrating. I'm sure in the winter or slow days this is far less of a problem. The Zanzibar chocolate is on point as can be and that keeps me going back! There are seemingly millions of flavors, so many to pick from and all kinds of float, shake, cone, and even ice cream flight options.

text: My first experience with Donut Bar was at at Yelp event where I tried their pumpkin filled yeast donut and it was pretty disappointing. The dough wasn't as perfectly light as I like. And I really prefer for the entire donut to have a thick layer of glaze - this did not. Also, the filling was barely sweetened and basically tasted like butter. However, after brunch at eat. I figured I might as well stop by and give it another chance. This time I knew not to get a yeast donut and to try the cake instead. I went with one Strawberry Cream Cheese and one Apple Crumble. The latter was nice, but the Strawberry was even better because it was super sweet and flavorful. (In case you couldn't tell, I expect as much sugar as possible.) But both were moist on the inside (the Strawberry even had little juicy specks of red) and the outside had a nice thick glaze. I went on a Saturday and there was a line to the door that moved at a pretty decent speed. There was a big family behind me and I believe I heard someone behind the counter say that kids get a free donut on Saturdays. Pretty cool! Does my three month old count? Haha!

text: Finalmente, tuve la oportunidad de visitar este famoso establecimiento de Cleveland en el camino de regreso de un festival religioso griego en North Royalton. También visité la estación del parque metropolitano de Rocky River recientemente. Probé los sabores de miel y nueces pecanas, así como de chocolate con menta, y ambos estaban deliciosos. Me encantaría probar el sabor de flor de naranja la próxima vez. Sé que la gente es muy localista y disfruta defendiendo lo suyo, e incluso puede que sobreestimen sus comidas favoritas. Honey Hut encaja en esta categoría. Sí, el helado es realmente bueno, pero ¿es realmente el mejor de todo Cleveland y el noreste de Ohio? Para mí, está al mismo nivel que Mitchell's (que también me gusta), pero no está ni cerca de la calidad de algunas de las heladerías gourmet más "de alta gama" en Tremont. Y definitivamente no está al mismo nivel que algunas de las heladerías especializadas increíbles que he visitado a lo largo de la costa de Jersey o en Miami. Es realmente difícil ser el número uno en cualquier categoría, pero Honey Hut produce helado de excelente calidad que todos pueden disfrutar. Si ha estado en el negocio durante 43 años, ¡tiene que probarlo!
text_en: Finally, I had the opportunity to visit this famous establishment in Cleveland on my way back from a Greek religious festival in North Royalton. I also visited the Rocky River Metropolitan Park station recently. I tried the flavors of honey and pecan nuts, as well as mint chocolate—both were delicious. I would love to try the orange blossom flavor next time. I know people are very local and enjoy defending their own things, and they might even overestimate their favorite foods. Honey Hut falls into this category. Yes, the ice cream is really good, but is it truly the best in all of Cleveland and the Northeast of Ohio? For me, it’s on par with Mitchell’s (which I also like), but it’s far from the quality of some of the more “high-end” gourmet ice cream shops in Tremont. And definitely not on par with some of the amazing specialty ice cream shops I’ve visited along the coast of Jersey or in Miami. It’s really hard to be number one in any category, but Honey Hut produces ice cream of excellent quality that everyone can enjoy. If it’s been in business for 43 years, you absolutely should try it!
original: I finally got around to stopping by this Cleveland institution on the way back from a Greek church festival in North Royalton. I also stopped at the Rocky River metroparks dock location recently. I had the honey pecan and mint chocolate chip flavors, which both tasted excellent. I'd love to try the orange blossom flavor next. I realize people are very regional-centric and love to defend their turf, and even overrate their favorite foods. Honey Hut falls into this category. Yes, their ice cream is real good, but is it really the best in all of Cleveland and Northeast Ohio? To me, it's on the same level as Mitchell's (which I like too), but not nearly as good as some of the more 'high-end' gourmet ice cream shops in Tremont. And certainly not as good as some of the incredible specialty ice cream stores i've been to along the Jersey Shore or in Miami. It's really hard to truly be #1 in any category, but Honey Hut makes damn good quality ice cream that everyone can enjoy. You have to, if you've been around for 43 years!

text: Mi primo nos recomendó este lugar. Llegamos y pensamos: "¡Uy, hemos llegado al lugar correcto?". La respuesta es sí. Pedí el "cup" de galletas con una doble ración de "fruity pebbles". Tanto el helado como la "macaroon". Pero el "marshmallow" fue una sorpresa total. No se desanimen por estar en un centro comercial extraño en medio de un barrio. Entren y disfruten. Todo está hecho a mano y a medida.
text_en: My cousin recommended this place to us. When we arrived, we thought, “Oh, we’ve found the right place?” And indeed, it was. I ordered a “cup” of cookies with a double serving of “Fruity Pebbles”. Both the ice cream and the “macarons” were great. But the “marshmallow” was a complete surprise. Don’t worry if you’re in a strange shopping center in a different neighborhood. Just enter and enjoy yourself. Everything is made handmade and custom-made.
original: We got word of this place from my cousin. We drove up and thought 'uh oh. Did we come to the right place.' Short answer. Yes. I had the cookie cup with a double dose of fruity pebbles. Both the gelato and the macaroon. But the marshmallow was a total surprise. Don't turn away because it's in a crazy strip mall in the middle of a neighborhood. Go in and indulge. Everything is home made and made to order.

text: Nossa! Adoro o 85C!! Esse lugar está sempre cheio e tem um motivo para isso! Cada item que comprei aqui foi excelente! Esteja preparado para esperar em uma fila a qualquer hora do dia. Vale a pena a espera!
text_en: Wow! I love the 85C!! This place is always full, and there’s a reason for it! Every item I bought here was excellent! Be prepared to wait in line at any time of day. The wait is worth it!
original: OMG! I love 85C!! This place is always busy and there is a reason for that! Every single item I have gotten here was outstanding! Be ready to stand in a line at any time of day here. It's worth the wait!

text: Minha amiga queria um bolo de arco-íris e encontrou a Carlos Bakery, que tinha muitas fotos mostrando diversos modelos. Então ela pediu um aqui. Estávamos celebrando o aniversário dos nossos filhos, que eram em dias diferentes, e pensamos que seria bom ter bolos parecidos, mas diferentes, então também pedimos aqui. Embora 50 dólares por um pequeno bolo simples de 15 cm tenha sido o máximo que paguei, considerando a qualidade e a fama do chef, que deveria ser impecável, me enganei! O bolo parece bonito e adequado para as crianças, mas é basicamente isso. O bolo não é diferente do que se encontra em supermercados ou lojas como a Costco, mas custa o triplo! Parece que eu poderia ter colocado granulados e um nome de celebridade e cobrado o triplo! Em resumo: o bolo era denso, excessivamente doce e seco. O último coisa que precisamos é que nossos filhos fiquem ainda mais agitados, com muitas visitas ao dentista, o que aumentaria o custo deste bolo. Estou bastante decepcionado, considerando que o chef responsável é famoso. Talvez ele precise encontrar outro ajudante ou outra padaria para representar, pois isso não parece ser uma boa escolha. Por outro lado, talvez os outros bolos e guloseimas sejam melhores, mas com essa experiência cara e que não foi sequer comestível, nos faz hesitar em experimentar outras opções. Para duas pequenas tortas de 15 cm, sobraram metade de cada torta e as fatias que comemos foram quase inteiras, o que mostra o quão ruim era para toda a nossa festa. Ninguém gostou. Na verdade, até uma criança de 4 anos não gostou, dizendo que não era macio e úmido o suficiente, o que é um problema. Estou surpreso com a longa fila que outros avaliadores mencionaram, pois o preço é excessivo e a qualidade não corresponde ao valor. Desculpe, mas não. Obrigado, mas não.
text_en: My friend wanted a rainbow cake and found Carlos Bakery, which had many photos showing various models. So she ordered one here. We were celebrating our children’s birthdays, which were on different days, and we thought it would be good to have cakes that were similar but different. So we also ordered one here. Although $50 for a small 15-cm cake was the maximum I paid, considering the quality and the chef’s reputation—which should be excellent—I was wrong! The cake looks nice and suitable for kids, but basically that’s all it is. It’s not much different from the cakes you can find in supermarkets or stores like Costco, but it costs three times more! It seems like I could have added sprinkles and a celebrity name and charged three times more! In short: the cake was dense, overly sweet, and dry. The last thing we need is for our kids to get even more upset, with lots of visits to the dentist, which would increase the cost of this cake. I’m very disappointed, considering the famous chef who made it. Maybe he needs to find another assistant or another bakery to represent him, because this doesn’t seem like a good choice. On the other hand, maybe the other cakes and treats are better, but with this expensive experience and the fact that it wasn’t even edible, we’re hesitant to try other options. For two small 15-cm cakes, half of each cake was left over, and the slices we ate were almost whole, which shows how bad it was for our party. No one liked it. In fact, even a 4-year-old didn’t like it, saying it wasn’t soft and moist enough, which is a problem. I’m surprised by the long line mentioned by other reviewers, because the price is too high and the quality doesn’t match the value. Sorry, but no. Thank you, but no.
original: My friends daughter wanted a rainbow cake and came across Carlos Bakery with so many pics that showcased alot of that. So she ordered one from here. We were celebrating both our kids bday thats a day apart and figured for both to have similar cakes yet different and ordered from here as well. Although $50 for a small simple 6 inch bday cake was the most I ever paid for, for what you get, i figured coming from Venetian and a celebrity chef which i was told couldn't go wrong but boy was I wrong! Looks cute and pretty for the kids but thats all there is to it. The cake was no different than what I would get at a supermarket or costco, so to speak but for 3x the cost!! Its as if i could have slapped a bunch of sprinkles on it myself and add a celebrity name to it and charge others triple! Bottom line: it was dense, WAY overly sweet and dry. Last thing we need is our kids any more hyper than they already are and many trips to the dentist which will add to that cost of this cake. Quite disappointed coming from a celebrity chef named behind it. Perhaps he needs to find another sous chef or another bakery to represent as this does not look good. On the defense, perhaps its just the cake and other treats they have are better but with this costly experience that was not even close to edible, it makes us hesitate to try other things. Let say for 2 small 6in cakes....we have half the cake of each leftover and the slice we each had on our plates were half eaten was how bad it was for our whole party. No one, not one person enjoyed it. Actually, even a 4 year old didn't even care for it saying it was not soft and moist enough which is bad. So I am surprised at the crazy long line other reviewers have stated as it is over rated and overly priced for what you get. Sorry but not sorry. Thank you but no thank you.

text: Tantas opções deliciosas que você não pode errar! Ótimo atendimento, ótimo lugar!
text_en: So many delicious options you can’t go wrong with! Great service, great place!
original: So many Yummy options you cant go wrong! Great service great place!!!!

text: Probé este lugar porque un compañero de trabajo me lo recomendó. Pedí el "Mini Daddy": helado de caramelo salado, galleta de vainilla y malvavisco tostado. La persona que trabajaba allí me sugirió probar el "Fatty Daddy", ya que es lo que más se promociona. Si buscas algo diferente a las heladerías tradicionales, ¡prueba el Fatty Daddy!
text_en: I tried this place because a coworker recommended it to me. I ordered the “Mini Daddy”: salty caramel ice cream, vanilla cookie, and toasted malted milk. The person working there suggested I try the “Fatty Daddy” as it’s what gets the most promotion. If you’re looking for something different from traditional ice cream shops, try the Fatty Daddy!
original: Tried this place because my coworker suggested it. I had the mini daddy - salted caramel ice cream, vanilla macaroon and toasted marshmallow. The lady who worked there suggested that or the fatty daddy since that's what they are known for. If you want something a little different than your normal ice cream shoppe, try Fatty Daddy's!

text: This was the first time my boyfriend and I tried this. We have lived in Pittsburgh our whole lives and have heard good reviews. The menu had plenty of options and looked awesome. I was torn between the chocolate chip sundae and the chocolate dip cone. I decided to get the dip cone but they said they had no chocolate left. This was at 7pm. I then asked for the sundae and they also had no chocolate chip cookies left. Whaaat!? Ugh. So I got a regular vanilla brownie sundae. The sundae was mostly vanilla and had one small brownie and very little chocolate syrup. I asked to add cherries which tasted different to me as well. I can sadly say I was disappointed in my Visit here and am truly not a picky eater. I wish they had possibly put a sign on the window that they were out of these ingredients before people ordered. My boyfriend did say he enjoyed his dirt sundae though. I don't think I will be returning unfortunately.

text_en: Recently, I visited this store to see if they had unique gifts for my customers. I loved it! There are so many different types of popcorn and special items for each holiday! I ordered the “Green Beer” popcorn for the delivery on St. Patrick’s Day! They have a website and ship products too!
original: I recently popped into this shop to see what they had in the way of unique gifts for my customers. Fell in love! So many different flavors of popcorn to choose from and special items during each holiday! I ordered the Green Beer Popcorn for my St. Patty's Day deliveries this week! They have a website and will ship!

text: Esperé en una larga fila para conseguir un latte en un día frío en Las Vegas. ¿Valió la pena la espera? ¡SÍ! Probé un pastel llamado Kouign Amann. Es un croissant con una corteza crujiente y dulce, como caramelizada. ¡Estaba delicioso! El latte también estaba excelente, y además pedí un croissant simple con mantequilla. Pero el Kouign Amann es lo que realmente destaca. ¡Pídalo! Mi única queja sería que, para intentar acortar la fila y que el servicio fuera más rápido, el personal pide el pedido mucho antes de que se pueda ver la selección de sándwiches refrigerados y el menú en la pizarra. Solo se puede ver la exposición de pasteles que no están refrigerados. Las personas como yo, que eran clientes por primera vez, no vimos las opciones del otro lado hasta que llegó el momento de pagar. Si hubiera visto esas opciones, habría pedido otras cosas para probar.
text_en: I waited in a long line to get a latte on a cold day in Las Vegas. Was the wait worth it? YES! I tried a cake called Kouign Amann. It’s a croissant with a crispy, sweet crust, like caramelized. It was delicious! The latte was also excellent, and I ordered a simple croissant with butter. But Kouign Amann is what really stands out. Order it! My only complaint is that, in order to shorten the line and make service faster, the staff asks for orders far before the selection of frozen sandwiches and menu options are displayed on the board. Only the uncooled cakes are visible. People like me, who were customers for the first time, didn’t see the other options until it was time to pay. If I had seen those options, I would have ordered something else to try.
original: Waited in a long line for latte on a cold Las Vegas day. Was it worth the wait? YES! Had this pastry called Kouign Amann. A croissant with a candied crunchy sugary crust. Beyond delicious!!! Latte was great and I also got a butter plain croissant. But the star is the Kouign Amann. Order that! Now my only complaint would be that in order to try to reduce the line and make it go faster. Staff asks for your order way far in ahead before you are actually able to see the glass refrigerated selection of sandwiches and the chalkboard menu. You are only able to see the display of non refrigerated pastries. People like myself who were going for the first time did not see offerings on the opposite side until it was time to pay. I would of order other things to try had I seen that.

text: Finalmente tive a oportunidade de experimentar a Carlo's Bakery em Las Vegas. No passado, sempre que passava por lá, havia uma fila enorme. Eu não tinha paciência para esperar. Há algumas semanas, não havia fila e as vitrines da confeitaria estavam cheias de doces deliciosos. Perguntei à jovem o que eram os dois itens mais populares, e comprei aqueles. Ela recomendou o "Lobster Tail" (rabo de lagosta) e os "Cannolis" (cannoli). No entanto, fiquei um pouco decepcionado com ambos. Já experimentei esses itens várias vezes na Costa Leste. As versões da Carlo's eram boas, mas não tão ótimas quanto eu esperava. Fiquei especialmente decepcionado com os cannolis. Eles não tinham sabor fresco. A massa tinha um gosto antigo e estragado. Eu voltaria para experimentar mais doces se não houvesse fila. Para mim, não vale a pena ficar em uma fila longa com base nesta experiência. Espero ter bons resultados na próxima vez.
text_en: Finally, I got the chance to try Carlo’s Bakery in Las Vegas. In the past, there was always a long line whenever I passed by. I didn’t have the patience to wait. A few weeks ago, there was no line at all, and the bakery’s windows were filled with delicious desserts. I asked the young woman what were the two most popular items, and I bought them. She recommended “Lobster Tail” and “Cannoli”. However, I was a bit disappointed with both. I’ve tried these items several times on the East Coast. The versions from Carlo’s were good, but not as great as I expected. I was especially disappointed with the cannoli—they didn’t have a fresh taste. The dough had an old, stale flavor. I would go back to try more desserts if there wasn’t a long line. For me, it’s not worth waiting in such a long line based on this experience. I hope I get good results next time.
original: Finally got the chance to try Carlo's Bakery in Las Vegas. In the past, everytime I came by there was such a long line. I would not have the patience to wait. A couple of weeks ago, there was no line and bakery cases filled with lovely looking sweets. I asked the young lady what the two most popular items were, and I bought those. She recommended the Lobster Tail and the Cannolis. Well, I was underwhelmed with both of them. I've tried these items quite a bit on the East Coast. Carlo's versions were decent, but not nearly as great as I thought they would be. Was especially disappointed with the Cannoli. It did not taste fresh at all. The shell tasted old and stale. I'd return again to try more of their goodies if there was no line. Not worth it to me to stand in a long line based on this one experience. Hoping for good results next time.

text: No sé, la calidad de los pasteles no es muy buena... Y los precios me parecen demasiado altos. Sin embargo, sí merecen una buena calificación por el ambiente.
text_en: I don’t know, the quality of the pastries isn’t very good… And the prices seem too high. However, they do deserve a good rating for the atmosphere.
original: Idk, it's not that great quality pastries..... And the prices make me less excited. They get a gold star for the atmosphere though.

text: Un lugar encantador en un barrio peculiar, que ofrece helados y donuts únicos. Podría seguir hablando de Novel. Definitivamente, el mejor donut con glaseado que he probado en mucho tiempo. Me encanta lo ligero y poco dulce que son, y son perfectos para rellenar con una bola de helado cremoso. El dueño es muy amable y sincero, y te hace sentir muy bienvenido. Mi familia y yo estamos deseando volver.
text_en: A lovely place in a unique neighborhood, offering unique ice cream and donuts. I could talk more about Novel. Definitely, the best donut with frosting I’ve tasted in a long time. I love how light and not too sweet they are, and they’re perfect for filling with a creamy ice cream ball. The owner is very kind and honest, and makes you feel very welcome. My family and I are looking forward to returning.
original: Amazing little place in a quirky neighborhood serving unique ice cream and out of this world donuts. I could go on and on about Novel. Definitely the best glazed donut I've had in a long time. I love how light and not to sweet these are and they make the perfect "bun" to sandwich a scoop of creamy ice cream between. The owner is super hospitable and sincere, and makes you feel welcomed. My family and I can't wait to go back!

text: Cada vez que voy a Las Vegas, me cuesta resistir la tentación de venir aquí y comprar uno de sus vitrinas. ¡Todo se ve tan bien! Sin embargo, aunque esto es difícil, he decidido controlarme. Tengo previsto probar su variedad con moderación. Eso solo significa que tendré que volver a Las Vegas, ¡genial! Hasta ahora, he probado su pastel de red velvet, un macaron de vainilla y, por supuesto, algunos TKOs. El pastel de red velvet estaba bien, pero no era el mejor que he probado. Sin embargo, el macaron de vainilla es uno de los mejores que he probado. Tienen las texturas perfectas y un equilibrio de sabores bien pensado. No demasiado sutil ni abrumador. ¡Perfecto!, lo cual aprecio mucho. En cuanto a los TKOs, puedo decirles exactamente dónde estaba cuando probé uno por última vez. Ese recuerdo me acompañará para siempre. Tuve que parar de caminar para disfrutar del momento. *Hace una pausa para pensar...* En cualquier caso, la crema que hay dentro es una nube suave de dulzura que se combina perfectamente con la deliciosa galleta de chocolate. Es imprescindible probarlo. En cuanto al café, es bueno. Demasiado dulce para mi gusto, pero no es malo. Tampoco es algo excepcional. Sin embargo, no dañará como acompañamiento de los deliciosos pasteles que hay aquí.
text_en: Every time I go to Las Vegas, it’s hard for me to resist the temptation to come here and buy one of their products. Everything looks so good! However, even though it’s difficult, I’ve decided to hold myself back. I plan to try their variety in moderation. That just means I’ll have to go back to Las Vegas again—great! So far, I’ve tried their Red Velvet cake, a vanilla macaron, and, of course, some TKOs. The Red Velvet cake was okay, but not the best I’ve tried. But the vanilla macaron is one of the best I’ve ever had. They have perfect textures and a well-balanced flavor profile. Not too subtle or overwhelming. Perfect! I really appreciate that. As for the TKOs, I can tell you exactly where I was when I tried one last time. That memory will stay with me forever. I had to stop walking to enjoy the moment. *Pauses to think…* In any case, the cream inside is a soft cloud of sweetness that blends perfectly with the delicious chocolate cookie. It’s essential to try it. As for the coffee, it’s good. Too sweet for my taste, but not bad. It’s not exceptional either. However, it doesn’t ruin the experience along with the delicious cakes here.
original: Everytime I go to Vegas, I have to resist the urge to stop by here and buy their display case. Everything looks so good!!! As DIFFICULT as this is, however, I have decided to restrain myself. I plan on trying their assortment in moderation. That can only mean more Vegas trips for me, woohoo! Thus far, I've tried their red velvet cupcake, a vanilla macaron, and of course, a few TKOs. Red velvet cupcake was good, but not the best I've had. The vanilla macaron, however, is one of the best I've had. They have the textures down nicely and a well-thought out balance of flavor. Not too subtle or overpowering. JUST right, which I can appreciate. As for the TKO, I can tell you the exact setting of where I was when I last bit into one. The memory will stay with me forever. I had to stop walking in order to savor the moment. *pauses to think back...* Anyways, the filling cream inside is a soft pillow of sweetness that melds perfectly with the decadent, chocolate cookie. It's a definite must-try. As for the coffee, it's good. Too sweet for my taste, but it's not bad. Nothing out of this world either. It won't hurt as an accompaniment to the delectable pastries in store for you here though!

text: Experimentei o sorvete do circo de animais, e descobri o sorvete derretido dentro do donut. Então, pedi o sorvete dentro do donut, e foi perfeito. O donut estava perfeitamente aquecido e o sorvete era incrível. Também pedimos o sorvete do "Cookie Monster" e, sem dúvida, foi o MELHOR sorvete que já comi (no final da viagem, compramos mais sorvete do "Cookie Monster").
text_en: I tried the animal circus ice cream, and I found that the melted ice cream was inside the donut. So, I ordered the ice cream inside the donut, and it was perfect. The donut was perfectly warm, and the ice cream was amazing. We also ordered the “Cookie Monster” ice cream, and undoubtedly, it was the BEST ice cream I’ve ever tasted (at the end of our trip, we bought more “Cookie Monster” ice cream).
original: Went in for the animal circus ice cream, found out about the stuffed donut melt, so I got that ice cream in the donut and it was perfection. The donut was perfectly warmed and the ice cream was amazing. We also ended up getting the monster cookie ice cream and that was hands down the BEST ice cream I have ever had (we ended up getting more of the Cookie Monster ice cream on the same trip)

text: Ah, un heladería independiente y recién inaugurada, como en los buenos tiempos. Este heladería clásica tiene un ambiente nostálgico. Aunque no ofrecen 31 sabores, sí tienen una gran variedad de opciones tradicionales y menos conocidas, pero igualmente deliciosas. Me encanta el sabor a coco y chocolate negro, y aquí lo tienen. Si os gusta el helado artesanal, cremoso y recién hecho, no os perdáis este pequeño local, que está justo al otro lado de la calle de Joyride Tacos, un buen lugar para comer antes de terminar aquí con un postre.
text_en: Ah, an independent ice cream shop that just opened up, just like in the good old days. This classic ice cream shop has a nostalgic atmosphere. Although it doesn’t offer 31 flavors, it does have a wide range of traditional and less-known flavors that are still delicious. I really love the coconut and dark chocolate flavors—and they have them here. If you enjoy handmade, creamy ice cream that’s freshly made, don’t miss out on this little shop, located right across from Joyride Tacos. It’s a great place to eat before finishing with a dessert here.
original: Ah - a non franchise fresh ice cream palour just like the days of old. There's a bit of a nostalgic air to this classic ice creamery. They may not have 31 flavors but they have plenty of traditional and less popular but equally delectable choices. I love coconut and dark chocolate and they have it. If you love fresh, creamy hand scooped ice cream don't miss this little spot across the street from Joyride Tacos which is a good place for a meal before you finish here with dessert.

text: I came into sprinkles today at the Las Vegas location and got some ice cream. The man Markell who helped me was so kind and helpful because it was my first time trying the ice cream. He offered me many samples to help me make a decision and pointed out to me what the best selling item was. I ended up getting a sprinkles sundae with the cookie cupcake and cookie dough ice cream and it was delicious. Thank you so much for the great suggestions sir.
text_en: I came into sprinkles today at the Las Vegas location and got some ice cream. The man Markell who helped me was so kind and helpful because it was my first time trying the ice cream. He offered me many samples to help me make a decision and pointed out to me what the best selling item was. I ended up getting a sprinkles sundae with the cookie cupcake and cookie dough ice cream and it was delicious. Thank you so much for the great suggestions sir.

text: An apparent local institution and Tom Hanks recommended. The good: Classic frozen treat stand. Fresh, smooth custard (we saw a couple of the extruders working while waiting). Tons of flavor combinations with their snowstorms (mix in shakes or blizzards). Reasonable prices. The bad: While all three lines and drive through were open, the lines do take longer than I would think, even with what looked to be a full staff. While I appreciate that this is a tough job, with what propably seems like endless lines of hungry customers, I would have liked a bit more friendliness from our stereotypical surly teenager. The unknown: Perhaps I ordered wrong, but while delicious, my turtle sundae seemed a little light on the custard. I was left with quite a bit of hard chocolate/nutty shell and had to steal some spoons of custard from Cheddartarian's double custard root beer float. The other treats ordered by earlier guests looked quite a bit more generous. Ultimately, I would go back though, and that is as good a measure as anything.
