text: El personal es rápido y eficiente. La tienda es encantadora. Las habilidades con el fondant para el pastel son increíbles. SIN EMBARGO, todo puede parecer delicioso, pero el sabor es decepcionante. Esperamos en la fila durante unos 25 minutos y estuvimos realmente decepcionados. Compramos: Un cupcake amarillo con glaseado de mantequilla - el pastel estaba seco y el glaseado no tenía sabor. Un "pouf" de crema - la crema interior, de nuevo, carecía de sabor y sabía a huevos cocidos en exceso. La parte de masa no era crujiente en absoluto. Un "shortcake" de fresa - Además de la fresa, tiré el plato. El pastel estaba de nuevo seco y la nata estaba aguada. Una galleta con chispas - Estaba bien. Nada que valga la pena la espera de media hora. Tiramos la mayoría de los productos, ya que estaban muy insípidos. Si van a comer algo que no sea saludable, cada bocado debe ser realmente bueno. Esto no lo era. Además, los precios son elevados y el lugar está abarrotado, aunque, lamentablemente, los pasteles no están a la altura.
text_en: The staff is quick and efficient. The store is lovely. Their skills in making fondant for cakes are incredible. HOWEVER, everything may seem delicious, but the taste is disappointing. We waited in line for about 25 minutes and were really disappointed. We bought: a yellow cupcake with butter frosting – the cake was dry, and the frosting had no flavor. A “pouf” of cream – the cream inside also lacked flavor and tasted like overcooked eggs. The dough part wasn’t even crunchy at all. A strawberry shortcake – besides the strawberries, I threw the plate away. The cake was again dry, and the custard was watery. A cookie with sparkles – it was okay. Nothing worth waiting half an hour for. We threw away most of the products because they were very tasteless. If you’re going to eat something that isn’t healthy, every bite must be really good. This wasn’t the case. Moreover, the prices are high, and the place is crowded, although unfortunately, the cakes don’t live up to expectations.
original: The staff are quick and efficient. The shop is cute. The fondant skills for the cake are amazing. HOWEVER, everything may look delicious, but it won't taste it. We waited in line for about 25 minutes and was truly disappointed. We got: One yellow cupcake with buttercream - cake was dry and frosting was flavorless. One cream puff - The cream inside was once again flavorless and tasted like overcooked eggs. The pastry part was not flakey at all. One cup of strawberry shortcake - Besides the strawberry, I toss the cup away. The cake was once again dry and the whipped cream was flat. A sprinkle cookie - It was okay. Nothing worth the half hour wait. We tossed most of the items away, since it so bland. If you're going to eat something bad for your health, every bite better be worth it! This was not worth it. It's also overpriced and overcrowded, yet sadly the pastries are underachieved.

text: Me encanta este lugar. Hoy, probé las galletas con chispas. ¡Qué ambiente tan divertido y sus postres son deliciosos! Soy fan de la serie, y he visitado la panadería original en Jersey. Por eso, la visita es aún más interesante. ¡Gran fan de Buddy! Un lugar imprescindible para los turistas.
text_en: I love this place. Today, I tried the sparkle cookies. What an enjoyable atmosphere—and their desserts are delicious! I’m a fan of the series, and I’ve also visited the original bakery in Jersey. That makes the visit even more interesting. Great fan of Buddy! An essential place for tourists.
original: Love this place so much. Today, I got the sprinkle cookie. What a fun atmosphere and their desserts are so yummy. I'm a fan of the show, and been to the original bakery in Jersey. So, it makes it much more interesting going. Big fan of buddy! A must stop for tourists!

text: Like In N Out, they have seriously long lines. Their icecream is slooooooooo good. Love their chocolate chip cookies. It just melts in your mouth. Their Sprinkles Cupcake ATM machine is ingenious. We need these machines everywhere.
text_en: Like In N Out, they have seriously long lines. Their icecream is slooooooooo good. Love their chocolate chip cookies. It just melts in your mouth. Their Sprinkles Cupcake ATM machine is ingenious. We need these machines everywhere.

text: ¿Quién no ama Amelies? Bueno, mi madre, por ejemplo, porque no le gusta el ambiente industrial, pero a mí me encanta el lugar y es un sitio perfecto para recibir a visitantes de fuera de la ciudad.
text_en: Who doesn’t love Amelies? Well, my mother, for example, because she doesn’t like the industrial atmosphere. But I really enjoy this place, and it’s a perfect spot to welcome visitors from outside the city.
original: Who doesn't like Amelies? Well my mom for one, because she doesn't like the industrial feel, but I love the place and it's a great place to bring out-of-towners

text: ¡EL MEJOR HELADO! Tienen sabores únicos (por ejemplo, sésamo negro), e incluso opciones veganas. También ofrecen diferentes tipos de nata montada. En mi última visita, probé esta creación mágica llamada "eggwaffle". Consiste en dos bolas de helado envueltas en una galleta recién hecha, y coronadas con nata montada. Yo pedí una con dos sabores diferentes: helado de chocolate y mantequilla de maní. Elegí la nata montada de mantequilla de maní. Probablemente fue una de las mejores cosas que he probado. Las personas que trabajan aquí son muy amables. A veces la cola es larga, pero les prometo que vale la pena la espera.
text_en: The best ice cream! They have unique flavors (such as black sesame), and even vegan options available. They also offer different types of whipping cream. During my last visit, I tried this magical treat called “eggwaffle”. It consists of two ice cream balls wrapped in a freshly made cookie, topped with whipping cream. I ordered one with two different flavors: chocolate ice cream and peanut butter. I chose the peanut butter version. It was probably one of the best things I’ve ever tasted. The people who work here are very friendly. Sometimes the line is long, but I promise it’s worth waiting for.
original: THE BEST ICE CREAM!!!! They have unique flavors (e.g. black sesame), and even vegan options. They also have different types of whipped cream. On my most recent visit, I got this magical creation called the "eggwaffle." It's two scoops of ice cream wrapped up in a freshly made waffle, and it's topped with whipped cream. I had mine filled with two different scoops - chocolate malt and nutter butter. I chose the peanut butter whipped cream. It was probably one of the best things I have ever had. The people who work here are all very nice. Sometimes the line is long, but I promise it is well worth the wait.

text: Desde que assisti a "Chef's Table", tenho sonhado em experimentar a Milk Bar em Nova York, mas ainda não poderei ir nas próximas semanas. Fiquei surpresa e animada ao encontrar esta unidade em Las Vegas. Embora eu não seja muito fã de doces, fiquei fascinada pela inovação e paixão da Chef Christina Tosi, como retratado em "Chef's Table". Decidi experimentar o "ICED CEREAL MILK LATTE" e foi delicioso! A atendente confirmou que não era muito doce, e ela estava certa. Não era excessivamente doce, mas tinha um sabor incrivelmente delicioso, com um leve toque de leite de cereal. Foi tão bom que queria voltar no dia seguinte para experimentar outra, desta vez em um tamanho maior.
text_en: Since watching “Chef’s Table”, I’ve been dreaming of trying the Milk Bar in New York, but I won’t be able to go there in the next few weeks. I was surprised and excited to find this location in Las Vegas. Although I’m not a big fan of sweets, I was fascinated by the innovation and passion of Chef Christina Tosi, as shown in “Chef’s Table”. I decided to try the “ICED CEREAL MILK LATTE” and it was delicious! The staff member confirmed that it wasn’t too sweet, and she was right. It wasn’t overly sweet, but it had an incredibly delicious taste with a slight hint of cereal milk. It was so good that I wanted to go back the next day to try another one, this time in a larger size.
original: Since watching Chef's Table I have been clamoring to try Milk Bar in NY, but won't be going for a few months. I was surprised and excited to wander by this one in LV. I do not have a big sweet tooth but was intrigued by Chef Christina Tosi's innovation and passion as portrayed on Chef's Table. I decided to try the ICED CEREAL MILK LATTE and it was sooo good. The cashier confirmed it was not too sweet and she was right. It was not overly sweet but it was amazingly delicious with a slight hint of cereal milk flavor. It was so good I wanted to come back the next day for another one in a larger size.

text: Se o Napoleão fosse deste sabor, seria excelente, um pouco doce demais para o meu gosto, mas ainda assim melhor do que muitos Napoleões que já experimentei. Combinaria muito bem com um Chai Latte.
text_en: If Napoleon were of this kind, it would be excellent—a little too sweet for my taste, but still better than many Napoleons I’ve tried before. It goes well with Chai Latte.
original: Had Napoleon, it is pretty good, a bit to sweet for my taste, but still better than many sad Napoleons that I had. It will go great with a Chai Latte.

text: Macarons franceses! Eu só experimentei os macarons aqui, mas estavam bem gostosos. Provavelmente os maiores que já comi, custando cerca de US$ 3,30 cada, eram macarons leves e crocantes, com um recheio cremoso e suave. O sabor de limão era um pouco azedo, mas também um pouco doce, o que o tornou perfeito. O de framboesa estava um pouco doce demais, mas ainda assim não era ruim, especialmente se você tiver leite ou água para acompanhar. Com certeza voltarei para experimentar outros sabores!
text_en: French macarons! I only tried the macarons here, but they were really delicious. Probably the biggest ones I’ve ever eaten—each costing about $3.30—were light and crispy, with a creamy and smooth filling. The lemon flavor was a bit sour, but also a bit sweet, which made it perfect. The raspberry one was a little too sweet, but still not bad, especially if you have milk or water to go with it. I definitely will go back to try other flavors!
original: french macaroons! i only had the macaroons here but they were pretty tasty. possibly the biggest ones i had, for about $3.30 a piece it was a light, flaky macaroon with a light cream filling. the lemon was a bit tart but also a bit sweet making it the perfect balance. the raspberry was a little too sweet but it was still not bad if you have milk or water to wash it down. definitely coming back to try other flavors!

text: Diversas opções para escolher, o sorvete estava gostoso, embora eu não diria que é o melhor que já provei. Talvez eu volte, mas não faria um esforço especial para ir.
text_en: There are many options to choose from; the ice cream was delicious, though I wouldn’t say it’s the best one I’ve ever tasted. Maybe I will go back, but I wouldn’t make a special effort to go there.
original: Variety of options to choose from, the ice cream was tasty, although I wouldn't say the best I've ever had. May visit again, but wouldn't go out of my way to go.

text: Lugar encantador, golosinas deliciosas. Incluso tienen dulces clásicos. "¡Oh, Razzles!", nos acabábamos de hablar de ellos y de que no los encontramos en ningún lugar. Me encantan sus caramelos salados, ¡qué rico! También probé una porción de un helado de coco realmente bueno. Me encanta esta adorable tienda. Por cierto, la chica que trabaja allí es encantadora. La única desventaja es que una señora entró con un perro de servicio. Eso no me parece nada apropiado.
text_en: A wonderful place, with delicious treats. They even have classic sweets. “Oh, Razzles!” We had just talked about them and how we couldn’t find them anywhere. I love their salty caramels—so tasty! I also tried a portion of a really good coconut ice cream. I really enjoy this adorable store. By the way, the girl who works there is very nice. The only downside is that a woman came in with a service dog. That doesn’t seem very appropriate.
original: Cute place, delish treats. They even have old school candy. "Oh My, Razzles." We were just talking about them and how we could not find them anywhere. I love their Salted Caramels, yum. I also had a scoop of pretty darn good coconut ice cream. I love this darling little shop. By the way, the girl who works there is delightful. The only negative is that a lady came in with a Non- Service dog. That is a big no no for me.

text: Se você estiver na área, precisa visitar esta sorveteria. Mesmo que precise desviar um pouco do caminho, vale a pena. O sorvete é realmente delicioso! Experimentei o caramelo salgado. Tem um sabor salgado, mas depois o doce do caramelo toma conta – a combinação é divina. Os sabores são muito marcantes e você consegue realmente sentir o caramelo. Também experimentei o caramelo com amêndoas e manteiga. O sabor é exatamente como o nome sugere. Teria dificuldade em escolher entre os dois, mas, felizmente, é possível escolher dois sabores. A equipe disse que parou de oferecer amostras, mas se você não gostar do sabor, pode pedir para trocá-lo.
text_en: If you’re in the area, you need to visit this ice cream shop. Even if you have to take a detour a little, it’s worth it. The ice cream is really delicious! I tried the salty caramel flavor. It has a salty taste, but then the sweet caramel flavor takes over—the combination is divine. The flavors are very distinct, and you can really taste the caramel. I also tried the caramel with almonds and butter. The flavor is exactly as it sounds. It would be hard for me to choose between the two flavors, but fortunately, you can choose two flavors at a time. The staff said they stopped offering samples, but if you don’t like the flavor, you can ask to exchange it.
original: If you're in the area, you have to stop by this ice cream shop. Even if you have to go a little out of the way, it's worth stopping by. It's seriously good! I've tried the salty caramel. It tastes salty but then you are hit with the sweet caramel - the 2 melded together is heavenly. The flavors are very prominent and you can actually taste the caramel. I've also tried the brown butter almond. It tastes just as it sounds. I'd have difficulty choosing between the two but luckily, you can choose 2 flavors. The staff said they stopped giving samples to try but if you don't like the flavor, you can let them know and they can exchange it for you.

text: Llevaba tiempo queriendo probar este lugar, unos 6 meses. Finalmente, fui anoche con la familia y pedí el "Toffee Bonafi", y estaba delicioso. Mis hijas pidieron el helado con brownie y les encantó. Nos sentamos y disfrutamos jugando a un juego de mesa, ya que tienen varios disponibles. Un lugar genial para pasar un rato y disfrutar del helado. Tienen varios sabores, y además, las galletas caseras parecen increíbles. Definitivamente, probaré las galletas la próxima vez.
text_en: I had been wanting to try this place for a while now—about 6 months. Finally, I went there with my family last night and ordered the “Toffee Bonafi,” and it was delicious. My daughters asked for the ice cream with brownies, and they really liked it. We sat down and enjoyed playing some board games, as they have several available. It’s a great place to spend some time and enjoy the ice cream. There are several flavors, and the homemade cookies also look amazing. Definitely, I’ll try the cookies next time.
original: Been wanting to try this place for about 6 months. I finally went last night with the family and I got the Toffee Bonafi and it was delicious. My girls got the brownie sundae and they loved it as well. We sat and enjoyed playing a board game as they have several to choose from. Great place to hangout and enjoy ice cream . They have several flavors and also they're homemade cookies look amazing. I'm definitely have to try the cookies next time.

text: ¡Este lugar es genial! Es muy limpio, las paredes son blancas y se puede ver la zona donde preparan el helado, lo que hace que la estancia parezca más grande. También hay un tren pequeño que circula sobre el área de asientos, lo cual es divertido de observar. Lo mejor es que hay muchos asientos, ya que hay dos plantas abiertas al público. ¡El helado es delicioso! No es demasiado cremoso y tiene un sabor muy similar al que elegí. Elegí helado de galletas, "cookies and cream" y de plátano, ¡y estaba perfecto y asequible!
text_en: This place is great! It’s very clean; the walls are white, and you can see where the ice cream is prepared, which makes the space feel larger. There’s also a small train that runs along the seating area—it’s fun to watch. The best part is that there are plenty of seats, with two floors open to the public. The ice cream is delicious! It’s not too creamy, and its flavor is very similar to what I chose. I ordered cookie and cream ice cream and banana ice cream—both were perfect and affordable!
original: This place is so cool! It's very clean looking, the walls are all white and you can see the area where they make the ice cream which makes the room look bigger. There is also a cute train the runs around above the seating area that's fun to watch. The great part is that there is plenty of seating as there are two floors open to customers. The actual ice cream is delicious!! It's not too creamy and tastes very much like the flavor you chose. I chose cookie dough ice cream, cookies and cream, and banana- it was perfect and affordable!

text: Worst French macarons I have ever had. They were so stale that we went back to get a new one. They told us they were between 2-4 days old and had no idea which ones were recently made. The second one we got was harder than the first. We just threw them out. They brought shame to such an exquisite treat. However, the guys at the bakery were very nice.
text_en: Worst French macarons I have ever had. They were so stale that we went back to get a new one. They told us they were between 2-4 days old and had no idea which ones were recently made. The second one we got was harder than the first. We just threw them out. They brought shame to such an exquisite treat. However, the guys at the bakery were very nice.

text: helado delicioso, techo impresionante, los sabores más originales valen la pena probar (como el de fresa y jalapeño) - las porciones de "trio de sabores" son muy generosas.
text_en: Delicious ice cream, impressive décor, and the most unique flavors are worth trying (like strawberry and jalapeño). The “trio of flavors” portions are very generous.
original: yummy ice cream, beautiful ceiling, funkier flavors are worth a try (like the strawberry jalapeÃ±o) -Taster trio scoops are very generous

text: BROWNIE. Eso es todo lo que puedo decir. Es el brownie más delicioso que he probado. No lo comí hasta el día siguiente, y seguía siendo suave y muy sabroso. También probé un cannoli, el cubierto de chocolate, y estaba delicioso. No hay nada de lo que te puedas arrepentir si vas allí.
text_en: Brownie. That’s all I can say. It’s the most delicious brownie I’ve ever tasted. I didn’t eat it until the next day, and it was still soft and very tasty. I also tried a cannoli, the chocolate-covered one, and it was delicious too. There’s nothing you can regret if you go there.
original: BROWNIE. That's all I have to say. Best brownie I've ever had. Didn't get to eat it until the next day and it was still soft and so good. Also got a cannoli, the chocolate covered, and it was delicious! Can't go wrong with anything you get there!

text: Este lugar deve ser um dos meus preferidos para comer sorvete! A verdade é que, em Chicago (minha cidade natal), experimentei um donut recheado com sorvete de baunilha e frutas em pedaços. Fiquei encantado! Procurei por muito tempo e finalmente encontrei este lugar incrível! Quero começar dizendo que, além de ser DELICIOSO, os funcionários são as pessoas mais maravilhosas que já conheci! Eles têm uma personalidade adorável e muito simpática. Para mim, é uma grande vantagem quando se oferece comida excelente e se tem pessoas incríveis para tornar o negócio ainda melhor! O estacionamento é bem pequeno, como a maioria dos lugares no centro da cidade. Sempre consigo um lugar, mesmo quando está muito cheio (e eles ficam bem cheios!!!). Eles têm uma área externa com um espaço agradável para desfrutar da comida! O interior é MUITO pequeno, mas vale totalmente a pena! Tenho que visitar o Novel Ice Cream!
text_en: This place must be one of my favorite spots to eat ice cream! In fact, in Chicago (my hometown), I tried a donut filled with vanilla ice cream and chopped fruits. I was absolutely thrilled! I searched for a long time, and finally found this amazing place! I have to say that, besides being delicious, the staff are the most wonderful people I’ve ever met! They have a lovely personality and are very friendly. For me, it’s a great advantage when there’s excellent food and amazing people who make the experience even better! The parking space is quite small, like most places in the city center. I always manage to find a spot, even when it’s very crowded (and they are really crowded!!!). They have an outdoor area with a pleasant space where you can enjoy your food! The interior is very small, but it’s definitely worth it! I must visit Novel Ice Cream!
original: This has to be one of my most favorite ice cream places ever! Truth is, I had a donut filled with vanilla bean ice cream and fruity pebbles in Chicago ( my hometown.) I feel so much in love with it. I searched high and low. And came across this GEM! I have to first say that aside from it being DELICIOUS! The staff members are my favorite people on this planet! They have the cutest and bubbliest personality. It's a win for me when you serve amazing food and have great people to make your business amazing! The parking is a really small area like most places in the downtown area. I have always found a spot even when it's pretty busy ( and they certainly get busy!!!) they have an outside patio area where you can enjoy the deliciousness! The inside is SUPER tiny. But it's so so worth it! You must visit novel ice cream!

text: ¡Está riquísimo! El taiyaki es caliente, suave, crujiente, masticable y con un sabor dulce muy suave, todo a la vez.
text_en: It’s absolutely delicious! The taiyaki is hot, soft, crispy, chewable, and has a very mild sweet taste—all at the same time.
original: Sooooo good! Taiyaki is hot, soft, crispy, chewy, and mildly sweet all at the same time.

text: Esta foi a minha primeira visita à Sinful Sweets, e definitivamente não será a última. Eu estava procurando algo doce, depois de jantar na região. Adoro que a loja fica aberta até às 20h, o que é perfeito para um lanche após o jantar! Havia tantas opções: docinhos, guloseimas, tudo coberto de chocolate, e sorvete. Escolhi o "s'more" coberto de chocolate ao leite. Estava delicioso... um marshmallow macio e fofo, entre duas biscoitos de aveia crocantes, e coberto com chocolate ao leite delicioso. Essa guloseima estava INCRÍVEL! Mal posso esperar para voltar e experimentar outras opções.
text_en: This was my first visit to Sinful Sweets, and definitely not my last. I was looking for something sweet after dinner in the area. I love that the store is open until 8 p.m., which is perfect for a snack after dinner! There were so many options: candies, treats, everything covered in chocolate, and ice cream. I chose the “s’more” covered in milk chocolate. It was delicious… a soft, fluffy marshmallow between two crispy oat cookies, covered with delicious milk chocolate. This treat was absolutely amazing! I can’t wait to come back and try other options.
original: This was my first visit to Sinful Sweets and definitely not my last. I was looking for a little something sweet, after having dinner nearby. I love that the shop stays open until 8:00, which is perfect for after dinner snacking! There was so much to choose from, cake pops, bulk treats, chocolate dipped everything, and ice cream. I opted for the milk chocolate covered s'more. It was delicious....soft billowy marshmallow, sandwiched between 2 crunchy graham crackers and dipped in delicious milk chocolate. This treat was SO good! I can't wait to return to try some other treats.

text: Off the beaten path, but such a unique spot. Good, solid flavors and loved the special touch of a toasted marshmallow and macaroon on top in the Fatty Daddy Cookie Cup. There's a handful of spots to sit in the shade out front and enjoy your sweet treat. We would definitely go back.
text_en: Off the beaten path, but such a unique spot. Good, solid flavors and loved the special touch of a toasted marshmallow and macaroon on top in the Fatty Daddy Cookie Cup. There's a handful of spots to sit in the shade out front and enjoy your sweet treat. We would definitely go back.

text: Visitei o Handel's pela primeira vez com um grupo de amigos há muito, muito tempo atrás, quando o Kauai Cafe ainda estava nessa praça. Eu nem sabia que era um lugar de sorvete, por causa da janela de atendimento. É assim que eles mantêm o lugar limpo, sem ter uma loja com muito movimento. É uma estratégia inteligente, imagino. Eles têm um cardápio bem variado – cones, sobremesas de sorvete, smoothies, "hurricanes", etc. Muitas opções de sabores de sorvete, mas decidi ser mais simples e experimentar o de Oreo. Na verdade, não foi nada de especial. Estou satisfeito com o meu sorvete "Dreyer's Cookies 'N Cream" que tenho em casa. De qualquer forma, não voltava aqui há algum tempo, já que sou fã do sorvete da Thrifty's no Sweet Addiction. Quando voltei aqui pela segunda vez, decidi pedir o "Raspberry Sherbet Parfait", porque parecia bom na foto. Nossa, estava delicioso! Mal consigo lembrar da última vez que comi um "Sherbet" tão bom, mas essa é a única razão pela qual continuo voltando! Apesar disso, a quantidade que você recebe pode variar, dependendo do funcionário que o prepara. Às vezes, as porções são grandes e bem recheadas, e outras vezes, as porções são apenas pequenas. As filas podem ser longas no verão. Talvez eu experimente outros sabores do sorvete deles no futuro, mas por enquanto, sou definitivamente fã do seu "Sherbet"!
text_en: I visited Handel’s for the first time with a group of friends a very long time ago, when Kauai Cafe was still in this square. I didn’t even know it was a ice cream place, just from the service window. That’s how they keep the place clean—without having a busy storefront. It’s a smart strategy, I guess. They have a wide variety of options: cones, ice cream desserts, smoothies, “hurricanes,” etc. There are many flavors to choose from, but I decided to try the Oreo flavor instead. Actually, it wasn’t anything special. I’m satisfied with my “Dreyer’s Cookies ‘N Cream” ice cream at home. Anyway, I haven’t been here for a while, since I’m a fan of Thrifty’s ice cream at Sweet Addiction. When I came back here for the second time, I ordered the “Raspberry Sherbet Parfait” because it looked good in the photos. Wow, it was delicious! I can hardly remember the last time I ate such great sherbet. But that’s why I keep coming back. However, the amount you get may vary depending on the employee who prepares it. Sometimes, the portions are large and filling, and other times, they’re just small. The lines can be long during summer. Maybe I’ll try other flavors in the future, but for now, I’m definitely a fan of their “Sherbet”!
original: Came to Handel's for the first time with a group of friends a long long time ago, back when Kauai Cafe was still in this plaza. I didn't even know that this was an ice cream place because of the walk-up window. That's how they keep this place really clean, by not having a store with constant foot traffic. Smart, I suppose. They have a pretty big menu - cones, sundaes, smoothies, hurricanes, etc. So many flavors of ice cream, but I decided to be boring and try the Oreo. It really was nothing special. I am fine with my Dreyer's Cookies 'N Cream ice cream that I have at home. Anyway, didn't come back here for a while since I am actually a fan of Thrifty's ice cream at Sweet Addiction. When I ended up here again for the second time, I decided to order the Raspberry Sherbet Parfait since it looked good in the picture. Daaang, it was delicious! Can't even remember the last time I actually had good Sherbet, but this is the only reason why I keep coming back! Although, the amount that you get is a hit or miss depending on the employee who makes it. Sometimes the scoops are huge and stacked high, and sometimes the scoops are just sad. The lines can be long during the summer. Maybe I'll try other flavors of their ice cream in the future, but for now I am definitely a fan of their Sherbet!

text: Everyone who knows me knows my love for ice cream! Today was my first time trying ice cream in Arizona...I am usually very picky so it took me a long time and searching on yelp to find something that would catch my eye and attract my taste buds. I found Churn on Yelp and decided to try it out. This place was amazing!! I was happily greeted by two wonderful employees. Sebastian has such a great amount of energy and was so kind, I was so happy to be there just for his energy itself! The store was set up as a beautiful candy shop that will catch the eye of any child, adult or senior citizen. The music is very bubbly and exciting! I was very indecisive of what to get, after reviewing pictures on Yelp I decided to get either a sundae or a cookie ice cream. I asked Sebastian between the two which was the best and his eyes lit up of excitement and passion as he said the icecream cookie! I told him which ice cream I wanted and told him to pick out everything himself on which he feels would be best. He did not steer me wrong at all! He gave me a tasteful girl scout cookie ice cream with peanut butter cookies and chocolate sprinkles. This was by far thee most amazing I have ever had thus far! I am astonished about the service, food, and everything! It is def a must go for anyone who enjoys the sweeter things in life!

text: I dragged my ass over to the Venetian to get my coveted TK macarons, and it was SO worth it. I also got a cookie and coffee and a strawberry croissant, and YES, I did eat all of it. I consider myself a bit of a connoisseur of macarons, having had what I previously considered THE BEST, Laduree, in Geneva and Paris. But these were bigger. Perfectly smooth, filled with the most wonderful buttercreams. I only wish there were more flavors to choose from! I also brought a box back for my petsitter, and she was quite pleased. I don't know if I'll return to Vegas in the near future, but if I do I think I will spend most of my time at Bouchon Bakery :)

text: Este lugar me impresionó mucho. Al principio, estaba escéptico porque parecía demasiado similar a una pequeña empresa, pero me sorprendí gratamente. Los dueños de la tienda nos atendieron y fueron extremadamente amables y serviciales. Nos contaron toda la historia y cómo elaboran el helado en pequeñas cantidades, utilizando uno de los mejores fabricantes de helado de Estados Unidos, y también nos informaron que sus donuts habían sido elegidos como uno de los 50 mejores de Estados Unidos. Ambos merecen todas las alabanzas. Todo el helado era más cremoso y sabroso que cualquier otro que haya probado. ¡Y el donut! El mejor que he probado, y probablemente el mejor que probaré. No me gustan los donuts demasiado dulces o con mucha cobertura. Este fue una combinación perfecta de dulce y salado, y de textura. ¡Volveremos!
text_en: This place really impressed me. At first, I was skeptical because it looked too much like a small business, but I was pleasantly surprised. The owners of the store treated us very kindly and helpfully. They told us the whole story and how they make ice cream in small quantities, using one of the best ice cream manufacturers in the United States. They also mentioned that their donuts were ranked among the top 50 in the U.S. Both deserve all the praise. All the ice cream was more creamy and tasty than anything I’ve ever tasted before. And the donuts! The best I’ve ever had, and probably the best I’ll ever have. I don’t like donuts that are too sweet or have too much frosting. This was a perfect combination of sweet and salty flavors, as well as texture. We’ll be back!
original: This place blew me away. I was skeptical at first because it looks too much like a start-up, but I was pleasantly surprised. The brothers who own the shop served us and they were extremely friendly and helpful. They told us the whole story and how the ice cream is made in small batches by one of the best ice cream makers in America and their donut was just voted one of the 50 best doughnut in America. Both deserve the rave reviews. All of the ice creams were more creamy and flavorful than any I have ever had. AND THE DOUGHNUT! Best I have ever had or will ever have. I hate overly sweet and iced doughnuts. This was a perfect mixture of sweet and savory and texture. We will be back!

text: Quem diz que os macarons do Bouchon são ótimos, claramente não sabe nada sobre macarons. Considero-me um apreciador de macarons, tendo descoberto esses doces durante minha estadia em Paris há alguns anos. Os macarons do Bouchon são horríveis. São muito grandes, muito densos e "mastigáveis", e estão excessivamente gelados. Não eram frescos nem delicados. Mesmo não atingindo os padrões de Pierre Hermé ou Ladurée, ainda ficam muito atrás de outros lugares em Nova York, São Francisco e Vancouver. Normalmente, nós apreciamos cada pedacinho, mas no Bouchon, nem queríamos terminá-los. Era um trabalho árduo. E, além disso, muito caro. A única razão para dar duas estrelas é porque o "TKO" (um tipo de biscoito Oreo para adultos) estava bom.
text_en: Those who say that Bouchon’s macarons are great clearly know nothing about macarons at all. I consider myself a macaron enthusiast; I discovered these desserts while I was in Paris a few years ago. The Bouchon macarons are awful. They’re too big, too dense, and “chewy,” and they’re also excessively cold. They weren’t fresh or delicate at all. Even though they don’t meet the standards of Pierre Hermé or Ladurée, they still fall far behind other places in New York, San Francisco, and Vancouver. Usually, we enjoy every bite, but at Bouchon, we didn’t even want to finish them. It was a tough job. And, besides, it’s very expensive. The only reason I give them two stars is because the “TKO” (a type of adult Oreo cookie) was good.
original: Anyone who says Bouchon has great macarons clearly does not know anything about macarons. I consider myself somewhat of a macaron connoisseur, having discovered them while living in Paris a few years ago. The macarons at Bouchon are horrible. They are overly big, too dense and chewy, and over-refrigerated. They were not fresh or delicate at all. Not even holding them to the lofty standard of Pierre HermÃ© or LadurÃ©e, they still pale in comparison to other places in NYC, San Fran, and Vancouver. We usually sit and savor every last crumb, but at Bouchon, we didn't even want to finish them. It was a chore. And way overpriced. The only reason it gets two stars is because the TKO (like an adult Oreo cookie) was good.

text: Mi esposa y yo estuvimos en Las Vegas hace un mes y nos detuvimos en Milk Bar en el Cosmo. Como era de esperar, estaba bastante concurrido, pero la fila se movía rápido. Pedimos una porción individual del helado de leche con sabor a frutas (inspirado en los "fruity pebbles"), que básicamente es helado cremoso con sabor a frutas. Personalmente, me encantó el sabor y la cobertura de cereal (de copos de maíz, que era un extra) en los bordes. Al día siguiente, también fuimos a probar el batido de pastel de cumpleaños, que estaba delicioso, pero era muy dulce (¡no pude terminarlo!). El pastel de cumpleaños está relleno de chispas, trozos de pastel y leche de cereal. Todavía tengo ganas de volver a Milk Bar y estoy muy agradecido de que mi esposa me convenciera de ir.
text_en: My wife and I were in Las Vegas a month ago, and we stopped at Milk Bar at the Cosmo hotel. As expected, it was quite busy, but the line moved quickly. We ordered a single serving of fruit-flavored ice cream (inspired by “fruity pebbles”) – essentially creamy ice cream with a fruit flavor. Personally, I loved the taste and the cereal coating on the edges (corn flakes, which was an extra). The next day, we also tried the birthday pudding drink; it was delicious, but very sweet – I couldn’t finish it! The birthday cake is filled with chips, cake pieces, and cereal milk. I still really want to go back to Milk Bar, and I’m very grateful that my wife convinced me to go.
original: My wife and I were in LV over a month ago and stopped at Milk Bar in the Cosmo. As expected, it was quite busy but the line moved quickly. We ordered the single serving of the fruity cereal milk (basically fruity pebbles inspired) soft serve. I personally loved the flavor and the cereal topping (cornflake crunch which was an extra charge) on the edges as well. The next day, I stopped by for the birthday cake milkshake which was delicious - but super rich (I couldn't finish it! So sweet!). The birthday cake is filled with sprinkles, cake pieces, and cereal milk. I still have cravings for Milk Bar and am so happy my wife convinced me to stop by.

text: Man oh man. if I wasn't won over by their huge following and excellent cupcakes made with natural ingredients, I was definitely won over by the limited edition Batman cupcakes that they had last Saturday. The staff was so friendly when I called in to see if they had anymore, they even went ahead and made me a couple extra with the left over decorations they had in stock. I loved them for that reason. Well and because their cupcakes are awesome. Their location in Las Vegas is touristy, mostly because it is at the Linq hotel and casino right in their promenade. Mostly.Mostly tourists are going here but sometimes they have locals around or local specials so you need to check. Also they have different flavors on different days, so if you are seeking a special flavor make sure to call first for availability. For example on Monday they have strawberry, but on Tuesday they have banana, but not strawberry, on Wednesday they have a limited edition pumpkin spice BUT no banana, and so on. You get the idea. Parking is easy here, plus it is free and close by to the promenade. They are open long hours and the inside smells delicious and is super clean! I love this place I'll be back for sure!!!

text: I am so glad they brought Carlos Bakery out to Las Vegas! Being a local it's fun to have family friendly places to visit here. Although it is a busy place that is to be expected! Ignore the negative reviews, budget in a treat or two and have fun! My husband and I loved it and will be sharing this with our family and friends.

text: Mmmmm. Estaba muy emocionado al ver Bouchon Bakery en el camino a mi habitación en el Venetian. No creía que los precios fueran tan malos, considerando que estaba en una zona turística de una ciudad turística y ofrecía pasteles y comida francesa de alta calidad y auténticos. Vi comida mucho peor a precios similares en Las Vegas. Durante mi estancia, probé el pudín de chocolate (tres capas de diferentes sabores, cremoso y delicioso, y del tamaño perfecto para un snack), un macaron de frambuesa (un poco demasiado dulce, pero muy suave), un pain au chocolat (crujiente y delicioso, con la cantidad perfecta de trozos de chocolate suave), y una galleta de pastel de zanahoria (dos galletas enormes, muy suaves y similares a un pastel, con un delicioso glaseado de queso crema). El servicio fue bueno, bastante rápido y nada pretencioso; de hecho, fue lo contrario (una mujer que me ayudó pronunció todo mal - es macaRON, no macaROON). Además, puntos extra por los cubiertos desechables falsos que parecen exactamente los reales. Muy elegante, Thomas Keller.
text_en: Mmmmm. I was very excited to see Bouchon Bakery on my way to my room at the Venetian. I didn’t expect the prices to be so bad, considering it’s in a touristy area of a touristy city, and they offer high-quality, authentic French desserts and food. I’ve seen much worse food at similar prices in Las Vegas. During my stay, I tried the chocolate pudding (three layers of different flavors, creamy and delicious, and just the right size for a snack), a raspberry macaron (a little too sweet, but very soft), a chocolate bread (crispy and delicious, with just the right amount of soft chocolate pieces), and a carrot cake cookie (two huge, very soft cookies that look like a cake, with a delicious cream cheese frosting). The service was good, quite fast, and not pretentious; in fact, it was the opposite—a woman who helped me said everything wrong—“macaRON,” not “macaROON”. Plus, extra points for the fake disposable utensils that look exactly like the real ones. Very elegant, Thomas Keller.
original: Mmmmm. I was so excited to see Bouchon Bakery on the way up to my room at the Venetian. I didn't think the prices were all that bad, considering it was in a toursity area in a toursity city and had high quality, authentic French pastries and food. I saw much crappier food for similar prices in Vegas. During my stay, I tried the chocolate pudding (3 layers of different flavors, creamy and heavenly and just the right size for a snack), a (huge) raspberry macaron (a bit too sweet but lovely smooth consistency), pain au chocolat (flaky and delicious, with the perfect amount of smooth chocolate chunks inside), and a carrot cake cookie (2 huge cookies, very soft and cake-like, with amazing cream cheese frosting inside). Service was fine, pretty fast and not at all snotty - if anything, it was the opposite (one woman who helped me pronounced everything incorrectly - it's macaRON NOT macaROON). Also, bonus points for the fake disposable silverware that looks exactly like the real thing. Very classy, Thomas Keller.

text: O que posso dizer sobre a Amelies? É a melhor padaria que já experimentei! Visitamos duas vezes durante uma viagem curta. Foi muito difícil escolher o que comprar. A equipe foi muito simpática e também paciente enquanto decidíamos. Se voltarmos para a Carolina do Norte, esta padaria certamente estará na nossa lista de lugares para visitar. Além disso, o café também é muito bom.
text_en: What can I say about Amelies? It’s the best bakery I’ve ever experienced! We visited twice during a short trip. It was very difficult to decide what to buy. The staff were very kind and patient while we made our choice. If we go back to North Carolina, this bakery will definitely be on our list of places to visit. Moreover, the coffee is also really good.

text: Experimentei um pedaço da focaccia do dia, que parecia ter queijo de cabra, pesto e tomate. Eles aqueceram para mim e estava realmente delicioso. No entanto, o macaron de chocolate que eu comprei foi um dos melhores biscoitos que já experimentei. É *tão* bom. É óbvio que este é o melhor biscoito que já provei. A textura interna era realmente macia e levemente fofa, enquanto a parte externa tinha uma leve crocância devido ao glacê. Era doce, mas não excessivamente, e o chocolate tinha um sabor delicioso, mas não era amargo demais. Vou passar o resto da minha vida pensando se este é o melhor biscoito que já terei.
text_en: I tried a piece of the focaccia from that day; it seemed to have goat cheese, pesto, and tomatoes. They warmed it up for me, and it was really delicious. However, the chocolate macaron I bought was one of the best cookies I’ve ever tasted. It’s *so* good. Obviously, this is the best cookie I’ve ever had. The interior texture was really soft and slightly fluffy, while the exterior had a slight crunch due to the glaze. It was sweet, but not too much, and the chocolate had a delicious flavor, but not too bitter. I’ll spend the rest of my life wondering if this is the best cookie I’ve ever had.
original: I got a piece of the foccacia of the day, which seemed to have goat cheese, pesto, and tomato on it. They heated it for me and it was quite delicious. The chocolate macaroon I got, though, was the kind of cookie I'm going to tell my grand children about. It was *that* good. It goes without saying that this is the best cookie I've ever had. The inside texture was really soft and slightly fluffy, while the outside had an ever-so-slight frosting "crunch" to it. It was sweet, but without being too rich, and the chocolate was flavorful, but without being too bitter. I'm going to spend the rest of my life wondering if this is the best cookie I will ever have.

text: Enquanto navegava nas histórias do Instagram, encontrei este café e soube imediatamente que precisava ir a Charlotte e experimentar este lugar. Como grande fã de matcha e de tudo relacionado a este ingrediente, este lugar definitivamente me agradou muito. O matcha utilizado tinha um sabor levemente amargo, o que significa que é "matcha de alta qualidade" ou "matcha de grau ceremonial", o que é diferente da maioria dos lugares em Carolina do Norte. O café está decorado de acordo com a época festiva, então é definitivamente um lugar para tirar fotos deliciosas para o Instagram, além de experimentar sobremesas com matcha de alta qualidade! Eu definitivamente recomendaria este lugar a qualquer pessoa!
text_en: While browsing Instagram stories, I came across this café and immediately knew I needed to go to Charlotte and try it out. As a big fan of matcha and everything related to it, this place really impressed me. The matcha used had a slightly bitter taste, which means it’s “high-quality matcha” or “ceremonial-grade matcha” – different from most places in North Carolina. The café is decorated according to the seasonal events, so it’s definitely a great place for beautiful Instagram photos, as well as for trying desserts made with high-quality matcha! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!
original: When I was browsing Instagram stories I came across this Cafe and I knew immediately that I needed to come to Charlotte and try out this place for myself. As a lover of Matcha and everything Matcha, this place definitely hit the spot for me. The Matcha used was barely noticeably bitter, which means that it is "ceremoniously grade Matcha" or "High-Quality Matcha", which is unlike most places in North Carolina. The Cafe is decorated to match the Holiday season so it is definitely a spot to get your instagrammable foodie pictures as well as try out high-quality Matcha desserts! I'd definitely recommend this place to anyone!

text: If you like cupcakes, this is the place for you. If you don't, this place will change your mind! It's located on the street on the way to the High Roller. It's small inside with a line on the left for cupcakes and the right for ice cream. There probably will be a small line especially for the cupcakes. The cupcakes are displayed on very upscale looking wooden shelves. They have a decent selection of flavors. Having tried a few I can say you cannot go to wrong with any of them. The peanut butter is one of my favorites. These are American-style, so expect a very thick layer of buttercream icing that is sweet along with a fairly dense though moist cake. For a bit of extra fun try their cupcake ATM outside available 24/7 for your cupcake cravings. Choose from the touchscreen, and the machine delivers a boxed cupcake. Cool! We tried the ice cream too (Rocky Road for me). It was ok but nothing too amazing. The cupcakes are the highlight here.

text: Eu detesto não dar uma avaliação perfeita a este lugar, mas a equipe/os proprietários precisam saber que alguns dos seus funcionários são desonestos! Tenho um filho de 2 anos que adora sorvete, mas ainda não está pronto para os cones normais, então o sorvete "para bebês" é perfeito para ele. Ele adora o sabor de baunilha e a quantidade é ideal. Toda vez que minha família vai lá, pedimos esse sorvete para ele e não temos problemas, mas hoje fomos atendidos por um adolescente/talvez um jovem na faixa dos 20 anos que se recusou a dar para ele. Ele explicou: "O sorvete para bebês é apenas para bebês! Ele quer sorvete, então precisa de um tamanho normal!" Sinto muito, mas será que a regra agora é que apenas bebês podem ter um sorvete pequeno? Não se tratava apenas do preço, pois sei que eles oferecem o sorvete pequeno gratuitamente, mas se fosse algo importante, teríamos pago por ele, pois é o tamanho ideal para ele. Mas esse rapaz simplesmente se recusou! Não sei se estava tentando ganhar dinheiro ou se achava que estávamos nos aproveitando, mas isso deixou um gosto amargo na minha boca! Minha família adora este lugar. O sorvete é sempre bom e perfeito para qualquer dia quente de verão em Las Vegas! Então, a loja em si merece 5 estrelas, e a maioria dos funcionários que conhecemos no passado são genuinamente agradáveis e parecem gostar do que fazem, ao contrário do rapaz com quem fomos infelizmente precisou ser atendido hoje!
text_en: I really don’t want to give this place a perfect rating, but the staff/owners need to know that some of their employees are dishonest! I have a 2-year-old son who loves ice cream, but he’s not ready for regular cones yet, so “baby” ice cream is perfect for him. He loves the vanilla flavor, and the amount is just right. Every time my family goes there, we order this ice cream for him, and there are no problems. But today, we were served by a teenager—maybe in his early 20s—who refused to give it to him. He said, “Baby ice cream is only for babies! He wants ice cream, so he needs a normal size!” I’m sorry, but is it really true that only babies can get small ice cream? It wasn’t just about the price; I know they offer small ice cream for free, but if it were important, we would pay for it, because it’s the right size for him. But that guy just refused! I don’t know if he was trying to make money or thinking we were taking advantage of him, but it left me with a bad taste in my mouth! My family really likes this place. The ice cream is always good and perfect for any hot summer day in Las Vegas! So, the store itself deserves 5 stars. Most of the employees we’ve met in the past are genuinely nice and seem to enjoy what they do, unlike that guy who unfortunately had to be dealt with today!
original: I hate not giving this place a perfect review but the management team/owners need to know that some of their workers are cheats! I have a 2 year old that loves ice cream but he's not ready for the regular cones yet so the baby come they offer is perfect. He loves vanilla and it's the right amount. Every time my family goes there we order it for him and no problem, but today we were helped by a teenager/maybe early 20s kid who refused to give him any. He explained "the baby cones are for babies! He wants ice cream he needs a regular size!" I'm sorry but is the rule now only a infant can have a baby size cone? It wasn't even the matter of price because I know they offer the baby cones for free but if it was a big deal we would have paid for it because it's just the right size for him. But this guys literally refused! I don't know if he was trying to make money or thought we were taking advantage but it put a bad taste in my mouth! My family loves this place. The ice cream is always good and perfect on any hot Las Vegas Sumer day! So the store itself deserves 5stars and most of the workers we met in the past are genuinely pleasant and seem like they love their jobs unlike the guy we had to unfortunately be helped by today!
