text: Nada que eu não tenha gostado ((exceto talvez as longas filas nos fins de semana)). Até mesmo os seus chicletes são INCRÍVEIS ((nunca tinha opiniões sobre chicletes antes)). Alguns funcionários são mais simpáticos do que outros // alguns conversam sobre a vida e me recordam // mas todos os funcionários são ótimos e atenciosos! Vá em uma noite de semana se não quiser esperar muito. Em termos de qualidade, não é tão caro quanto se imagina. Eles também oferecem tamanhos de porções justos! É imperdível – recentemente, houve menos mudanças nos sabores de sorvete, mas espero que essa diminuição seja devido ao preparo para o verão?
text_en: Nothing I didn’t like ((except maybe the long lines on weekends)). Even their gummies are amazing ((I never had any opinions about gummies before)). Some staff members are more friendly than others // some talk about life and remind me // but all the staff are great and attentive! Go on a weekend night if you don’t want to wait too long. In terms of quality, it’s not as expensive as it seems. They also offer reasonable portion sizes! It’s worth it – recently, there have been fewer changes to the ice cream flavors, but I hope this is because of preparations for summer?
original: Nothing there that I haven't liked ((except maybe the long lines on weekends)). Even their gummy bears are AMAZING ((I've never had gummy bear opinions before)). Some staff are more friendly than others //some talk about life and remember me // but all staff are great and nice! Go on a weeknight if you don't want to wait awhile. For the quality, it's not as expensive as one would think it would be. They also have fair scooping sizes! Must try-- recently less changes in ice cream flavors but hoping the lull is due to revving up for the summer?

text: Visité Dripps con mi esposo. La decoración era muy encantadora y me gustó que tuvieran una pared para las fotos de Instagram. Uno de los empleados nos ayudó explicando el menú y ayudándonos a elegir nuestras opciones. Mi esposo terminó pidiendo uno de sus postres más populares, galletas y crema. Yo terminé preparando mi propio batido con "fruity pebbles". Me encantó la variedad y la posibilidad de preparar mi helado exactamente como me gustaba.
text_en: I visited Dripps with my husband. The decor was very charming, and I liked that they had a wall for Instagram photos. One of the staff helped us by explaining the menu and assisting us in choosing our options. My husband ended up ordering one of his most popular desserts: cookies and cream. I decided to make my own smoothie using “Fruity Pebbles”. I loved the variety and the ability to make my ice cream exactly how I like it.
original: I visited Dripps with my husband. The decor was super cute and I liked that they had a wall for the Instagram pictures. One of the employees helped us out by explaining the menu and helping us pick our options. My husband ended up getting one of their signature ones, cookies and cream. I ended up making my own shake with fruity pebbles. I loved the variety and how I could make my ice cream the way I wanted.

text: ¡No se pierdan este lugar para un desayuno rápido! Es muy rápido y las colas no son largas. Y sus croissants son tan deliciosos y crujientes que me recordaron a cuando estaba en Italia. No puedo opinar sobre el café, ya que soy un gran fan de Starbucks, pero todos los demás lo estaban pidiendo para acompañar su desayuno. ¡Definitivamente 5 estrellas de mi parte!
text_en: Don’t miss this place for a quick breakfast! It’s very fast, and the lines aren’t long. Their croissants are so delicious and crispy—they remind me of when I was in Italy. I can’t comment on the coffee, as I’m a big fan of Starbucks, but everyone else ordered it to go with their breakfast. Definitely 5 stars from me!
original: Don't skip out on this place for a quick breakfast bite to eat! Super quick and moving lines. And their croissants were so buttery and delicious it reminded me of when I was actually in Italy. Can't say anything about the coffee as I'm kind of a Starbucks junkie but everyone else was ordering it to go along with they're morning pastry. A for sure 5 stars from me.

text: NoDa tiene otra joya. El ambiente relajado y la decoración única son perfectos, y la comida no decepcionó. Un delicioso puré de higos con tocino crujiente ahumado, acompañado de un brie cremoso y rico, todo sobre rebanadas de baguette tostadas. El personal fue muy amable y atento, lo que parecía atraer a los clientes. La próxima vez que tenga antojo de algo dulce o necesite un buen almuerzo, sé exactamente dónde ir. ¡Ah! Y este lugar está abierto prácticamente las 24 horas del día.
text_en: NoDa has another gem. The relaxed atmosphere and unique decor are perfect, and the food didn’t disappoint either. It’s a delicious pomegranate purée with crispy, smoked bacon, paired with creamy and rich brie cheese, all served on toasted baguette slices. The staff were very friendly and attentive, which seems to attract customers. Next time I have a craving for something sweet or need a good meal, I know exactly where to go. Ah! And this place is open almost 24 hours a day.
original: NoDa has another gem. The relaxed atmosphere and unique decor is spot on and the meal did not disappoint. Sweet fig spread with smoky crisp bacon, paired with rich smooth brie all on top of toasted baguette slices. The staff was very informative and all smiles which seemed to gravitate to the clientele. The next time I have a midnight craving for sweets or a great lunch I know exactly where to go. Oh!!! and this location is pretty much open 24/7.

text: Sinto muito, mas nada vale a pena esperar tanto tempo! Esperar na fila sob o sol escaldante por mais de 20 minutos para conseguir algo que leva apenas 5 minutos para comer parece absurdo. Acredito que isso é mais uma perda de tempo do que qualquer outra coisa. Se aplicarmos isso a qualquer outra situação na vida, não faríamos. Então, por que aqui? Além disso, este sorvete é o mais salgado que já experimentei. Sinto muito que o Pike's fechou e perdeu negócios para este lugar. Era um lugar histórico em QC.
text_en: I’m sorry, but there’s nothing worth waiting for for so long! Waiting in line under the scorching sun for more than 20 minutes just to get something that takes only 5 minutes to eat seems absurd. I believe it’s more a waste of time than anything else. If we apply this to any other situation in life, we wouldn’t do it either. So why here? Besides, this ice cream is the saltiest I’ve ever tasted. I’m sorry that Pike’s closed and lost business to this place. It was a historic location in QC.
original: I'm sorry but nothing is worth waiting that long for! Wait in line in the hot sun for 20+ minutes to get something that only takes 5 minutes to eat seems insane. I truly think is more of a Fab than anything else. Apply that to anything else in life and you wouldn't do it, so why here!? Plus this is the saltiest Ice-cream I've ever had. I truly hate that Pike's closed and lost business to this place. That was a historical place in the QC.

text: ¡Qué tesoro escondido! Antes, este lugar era una panadería de donuts que cerró. He probado los churros y los beignets originales. ¡Son increíbles! Son ligeros y esponjosos, con la cantidad perfecta de masa y dulzor en el exterior. Tuve la oportunidad de conocer a uno de los dueños, ¡muy amable! El personal también era muy atento. Estoy segura de que, con los postres y el excelente café que ofrecen, estarán aquí por mucho tiempo.
text_en: What a hidden treasure! Before, this place was a donut bakery that has closed down. I tried the original churros and beignets – they’re incredible! They’re light and fluffy, with just the right amount of dough and sweetness on the outside. I had the opportunity to meet one of the owners; he was very kind. The staff were also very attentive too. I’m sure, with the desserts and excellent coffee they offer, they’ll stay here for a long time.
original: What a hidden treasure! This spot used to be another doughnut shop and closed down. I've tried the churro and original beignets. Omg they are like heaven! So good! Light and airy, it's the perfect amount of dough to sweetness on the outside. I had a chance to meet one of the owners, very very nice! The own staff was nice as well. I'm certain with the desserts they offer and fabulous coffee, they will be here to stay!

text: Ótima sorveteria. Eles permitem que você experimente quantos sabores quiser. O sorvete é rico, cremoso e delicioso. Possui mesas ao ar livre em uma área charmosa da cidade. A equipe foi fantástica. Um ótimo lugar, voltaremos com certeza.
text_en: Great ice cream shop. They allow you to try as many flavors as you want. The ice cream is rich, creamy, and delicious. There are tables outdoors in a charming area of the city. The staff were fantastic. A great place—we will definitely come back.
original: Great ice cream shop. They let you try as many flavors as you want. The ice cream is rich, creamy and delicious. Outdoor seating na cool little part of town. The staff was fantastic. Great place, we will definitely be back.

text: Na minha primeira visita a esta padaria Carlos em Las Vegas, localizada dentro do The Grand Canal Shopes no The Palazzo/The Venetian, a espera para entrar não foi grande, pois eu cheguei em um horário mais tranquilo. Experimentei um cannoli, que sempre quis provar. Foi extremamente delicioso e com um preço justo. Também comprei uma caneca de metal como souvenir. Adoro a comida daqui, e na próxima vez que estiver na área, com certeza voltarei para experimentar mais. Se você procura sobremesas deliciosas e acessíveis, venha para a Carlos Bakery, a melhor padaria do mundo.
text_en: During my first visit to Carlos Bakery in Las Vegas, located within The Grand Canal Shops at The Palazzo/The Venetian, the wait to enter wasn’t long, as I arrived at a more relaxed time. I tried a cannoli, which I’ve always wanted to try. It was extremely delicious and at a reasonable price. I also bought a metal cup as a souvenir. I love the food here, and next time I’m in the area, I will definitely return to try more dishes. If you’re looking for delicious and affordable desserts, come to Carlos Bakery—the best bakery in the world.
original: On my very first visit to this Carlos Bakery in Las Vegas inside The Grand Canal Shopes at The Palazzo/The Venetian. The wait to get in was really no wait at all because I came around the slow part of the day. I got a cannoli which I had always wanted to try. It was extremely delicious and fairly priced too. I also purchased A souvenir metal coffee mug. I love the food their and next time im in the area im going to come back for more for sure. If you want awesome desserts that's delicious in your stomach and good on the wallet come to Carlos Bakery the worlds greatest bakery.

text: Wow. I can't believe how complacent people are. I loved everything that I bought. Don't believe the reviews until you go and try it for yourself. These "one star" and "two star" people are just unhappy and miserable people.
text_en: Wow. I can't believe how complacent people are. I loved everything that I bought. Don't believe the reviews until you go and try it for yourself. These "one star" and "two star" people are just unhappy and miserable people.

text: Jeni's es mi heladería favorita. Aunque la espera en la fila, especialmente por la noche, suele ser de unos 15 minutos, la espera merece la pena, y los empleados gestionan bien la multitud. Los sabores del helado son creativos y tus papilas gustativas se deleitan con cada bocado. Mis sabores favoritos son el Brambleberry Crisp (similar a un muffin de arándanos) y el de Limón y Arándanos (que es agrio pero delicioso, con un sabor rico y profundo)!!!
text_en: Jeni’s is my favorite ice cream shop. Although the wait in line, especially at night, is usually about 15 minutes, it’s worth the wait. The staff manage the crowd well. The flavors of the ice creams are creative, and your taste buds will enjoy every bite. My favorite flavors are the Brambleberry Crisp (similar to a raspberry muffin) and the Lemon and Raspberries flavor (it’s sour but delicious, with a rich and deep taste)!!!
original: Jeni's is my favorite ice cream shop. Although the wait in line, specifically at night, is about 15 minutes - the wait is worth it and the employees handle the crowd fairly well. The flavors of ice cream are creative and your tastebuds do a little dance after each lick. My favorite flavors are the Brambleberry Crisp (similar to a blueberry muffin) and the Lemons & Blueberry (which is tart but delicious with a rich flavor) !!!

text: Espero que um café sirva café em xícaras de cerâmica, em vez de copos de papel descartáveis. Nós dirigimos 30 minutos apenas para experimentar este lugar, e não havia café no meu mocha. Sim, não estou brincando! O que não entendo é por que um lugar que está aberto 24 horas por dia, serviria café aos seus clientes em copos descartáveis, a menos que eles solicitem? Eu recomendaria que você vá a outro lugar, especialmente se você mora longe.
text_en: I hope that coffee is served in ceramic cups, rather than disposable paper cups. We drove for 30 minutes just to try out this place, and there was no coffee in my mocha. Yes, I’m not joking! What I don’t understand is why a place that is open 24 hours a day would serve coffee to customers in disposable cups, unless they ask for it. I would recommend going to another place, especially if you live far away.
original: I expect a coffee place to serve coffee in ceramic coffee cup instead of a use and throw paper cup. We drove 30 mins just to try out this place and there was no coffee in my mocha. Yeah, no kidding!! What I fail to understand is why will a place that is open 24/7 will serve coffee to it's customers in a to-go cup unless asked for it? I would rather recommend you to go somewhere else, especially if you live far away.

text: Fui a probar el "Strawberry Split". La última vez que vinimos, casi al cierre, ya no tenían casi nada. Entré y me alegré de ver el "Strawberry Split"! Era enorme. Mi esposo pidió el "Expresso Chocolate" y mi amiga, que es una adicta al chocolate, optó por el "Triple Chocolate Threat" después de que se decepcionara al no tener el "Chocolate Euphoria" ese día. Ambos tenían donuts de bizcocho, y nos pareció que no eran nada particularmente especiales. Mi amiga comentó que el "Chocolate Threat" no era ni siquiera lo suficientemente chocolatoso, y yo estoy de acuerdo. Yo vine por el "Strawberry" y no me decepcioné. El donut tiene una corteza un poco dura, como un croissant. Preferiría uno más suave, pero a mi esposo y a mi amiga les gustó la "corteza" tal como estaba. Mi esposo también comentó que le recordaba a un pastel de cumpleaños chino. Yo me sentí satisfecha con lo que había estado esperando... meses o incluso años...
text_en: I went to try out the “Strawberry Split”. The last time we went there, just before closing time, they didn’t have much left. I entered and was glad to see the “Strawberry Split”! It was huge. My husband ordered the “Expresso Chocolate”, while my friend, who is a chocolate enthusiast, chose the “Triple Chocolate Threat” after being disappointed not to get the “Chocolate Euphoria” that day. Both of them had cake donuts, and we thought they weren’t particularly special. My friend said that the “Chocolate Threat” wasn’t even enough chocolatey, and I agree. I came for the “Strawberry” and wasn’t disappointed. The donut has a slightly hard crust, like a croissant. I would prefer one with a softer crust, but my husband and my friend liked the crust as it was. My husband also said it reminded him of a Chinese birthday cake. I was satisfied with what I had expected… months or even years ago…
original: Came by for the Strawberry Split. Last time we came at almost closing time and they were pretty much out of everything. I walked in and was so happy to see the Strawberry Split! It was huge! My husband got the Expresso Chocolate and my chocoholic friend went for the Triple Chocolate Threat after being disappointed that they didn't have the Chocolate Euphoria today. Theirs were both cake donuts and we felt they weren't anything too special. My friend commented the Chocolate Threat was not even Chocolatey enough and I agree. I came here for the Strawberry and I was not disappointed. The donut is bit crusty like a croissant. I would prefer like a soft donut but my husband and friend enjoyed the "crust" the way it was. My husband also commented that it reminded him of a Chinese birthday cake. I felt satisfied with what I had been waiting for....months or years...

text: Oh, Sprinkles, adoro seus cupcakes. No entanto, desta vez finalmente tive a oportunidade de visitar a loja de sorvetes e biscoitos. Seus preços podem ser um pouco altos para algumas pessoas, mas, considerando o tamanho, vale a pena comparado a outras boutiques de cupcakes. O sabor também é sempre consistente. O local é muito limpo e os funcionários são muito simpáticos. No entanto, não está localizado na principal rua, mas você pode virar e caminhar um pouco. Na verdade, eu não o encontrei na primeira vez. Basta procurar o letreiro do Linq e, em seguida, procure a loja mais adiante, no beco, onde há várias outras lojas.
text_en: Oh, Sprinkles, I love your cupcakes. However, this time I finally got the chance to visit the ice cream and cookies store. Their prices might be a bit high for some people, but considering the size, it’s worth it compared to other cupcake shops. The flavors are also consistent every time. The place is very clean, and the staff are very friendly. However, it’s not located on the main street; you just need to turn around and walk a little. Actually, I didn’t find it the first time. Just look for the Linq sign, and then find the store further down the alley, where there are several other shops.
original: oh Sprinkles how I love your cupcakes. However, this time I finally got a chance to visit the ice cream and cookies shop. Your prices might be a little high to some people but for the size, its worth it compared to some of the other cupcake boutiques. Taste is always consistent as well. Very clean and the employees are very nice. It's not located on the strip though but you have the turn and walk down a bit. i actually missed it the first time. Just look for the Linq sign and then its further back down the alley with a bunch of other shops.

text: Me encantó la decoración de la panadería y me recordó mucho a Nueva York. Desafortunadamente, llegamos cuando solo había una opción de postre vegano (me habría gustado probar otras opciones). Sin embargo, este cobbler de arándanos era delicioso, así que no me puedo quejar. ¡Definitivamente vale la pena visitarlo para disfrutar de algo delicioso!
text_en: I loved the decor of the bakery; it reminded me a lot of New York. Unfortunately, we arrived when there was only one vegan dessert option (I would have liked to try other choices). However, this raspberry cobbler was delicious, so I can’t complain. Definitely worth visiting to enjoy some tasty food!
original: I really liked the bakery decor and reminded me very much of NYC. Unfortunately we got there when there was only one vegan dessert option (would've liked to have been able to try a couple more). However, this blueberry cobbler was to die for so I'm not mad . Do stop in for a tasty treat!

text: "¡Las mejores donas del mundo!" De verdad, superan todas las expectativas de esta cola. Probé la dona con rollos de canela y tocino de arce... Y la dona de crema brûlée, ¡y ambas son mis favoritas! Muy recomendables.
text_en: “The best donuts in the world!” Really, they exceed all expectations for this brand. I tried the donut with cinnamon rolls and maple bacon… And the cream brûlée donut—both are my favorites! Highly recommended.
original: "Best donuts in the world!" They truly exceed the expectations of this line! I had the cinnamon roll with maple bacon... And the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut and these two are my favorites! Highly recommended

text: Sabores deliciosos y divertidos que cambian cada mes. El dueño es un excelente creador de sabores de helado.
text_en: Delicious and fun flavors that change every month. The owner is an excellent ice cream flavor creator.
original: Delicious and fun flavors that rotate every month. The owner is a great ice cream flavor creator!

text: Pequenos e fofos nuvens de puro paraíso. Estes são os melhores donuts que já experimentei. São pequenos, o recheio está na parte externa e são incrivelmente frescos. São super macios e muito superiores a qualquer outro. Nem mesmo a Krispy Kreme se compara! Apoie os negócios familiares e vá comprar uma dúzia ou mais! Você não ficará desapontado.
text_en: Small and adorable clouds of pure paradise. These are the best donuts I’ve ever tried. They’re small, the filling is on the outside, and they’re incredibly fresh. They’re super soft and far superior to any other donuts. Not even Krispy Kreme can compare! Support family businesses and buy a dozen or more! You won’t be disappointed.
original: Little billowy clouds of pure heaven. These are THE best donuts I've ever had. They are small, they filling is on the outside and they are melt-in-your-mouth fresh. They are super moist and far superior to any others. Even Krispy Kreme ain't got nothin' on them! Support family owned businesses and go get a dozen or two! You will NOT be disappointed.

text: El mejor lugar en Pittsburgh para disfrutar de helado tipo "soft serve". Siempre hay mucha cola, pero son muy eficientes y el servicio es rápido. Me encanta que utilicen tantos ingredientes locales, como las galletas de Nancy B y el pastel de almendras quemadas.
text_en: The best place in Pittsburgh to enjoy soft serve ice cream. There’s always plenty of syrup, but it’s very efficient, and service is quick. I love that they use so many local ingredients, like Nancy B cookies and burnt almond cake.
original: Best place in Pittsburgh for soft serve. The line is always long, but they are very efficient & it moves quickly. I love that they incorporate so many local ingredients-Nancy B's cookies & burnt almond torte.

text: El té de leche tenía un sabor característico y agradable, similar al té de leche negro tradicional, pero era demasiado dulce. Los crepes se mantenían unidos, el helado de matcha y el helado de frijoles rojos tenían buen sabor. Se podría añadir más pasta de frijoles rojos a los crepes. La masa para los crepes era básica, pero sabrosa. El servicio fue bueno y había algunas mesas disponibles para sentarse. Regresaría por sus crepes y probaría el té de leche con la mitad de azúcar.
text_en: The milk tea had a distinctive and pleasant taste, similar to traditional black milk tea, but it was too sweet. The crepes stayed together well, as was the matcha ice cream and red bean ice cream—both tasted good. More red bean paste could be added to the crepes. The dough for the crepes was basic, but flavorful. The service was good, and there were some tables available for sitting down. I would return for the crepes and try the milk tea with half the sugar.
original: Milk tea had a familiar, proper black milk tea flavor but it was too sugary. Crepes held together, matcha ice cream and red bean had good flavor. Could use more red bean paste in the crepe. Crepe batter was basic but tasty. Service was good and there were a couple tables to sit down at. I would come back for their crepes and try the milk tea at half sugar.

text: Si estás en la zona de Venetian, cerca de la entrada del ascensor del hotel, entonces Bouchon Bakery es un lugar imprescindible que deberías visitar para empezar el día. Generalmente hay una fila considerable, pero el servicio es bastante rápido. Ya sea que tengas ganas de un macaron, una baguette o un café, Bouchon Bakery hace que la espera valga la pena. Normalmente, suelo tomar pequeñas porciones porque siempre estoy de movimiento, y este lugar es conocido precisamente por eso. No esperes una comida francesa completa aquí, pero sí hay un Bouchon en la zona donde puedes comer. En cualquier caso, el servicio es confiable, rápido y amable. Como en todo lo francés, la calidad es excelente y el precio es relativamente alto. Solo está abierto hasta las 2 de la tarde, así que llega temprano para disfrutar y satisfacer tus antojos de pastelería.
text_en: If you’re in the Venetian area, near the elevator entrance of the hotel, then Bouchon Bakery is a must-visit place to start your day. There’s usually a long line, but service is quite fast. Whether you want macarons, baguettes, or coffee, Bouchon Bakery makes the wait worth it. I usually order small portions because I’m always busy, and that’s exactly why this place is famous for that. You won’t get a full French meal here, but there’s a Bouchon location where you can eat. In any case, the service is reliable, fast, and friendly. Like everything about French cuisine, the quality is excellent, and the prices are relatively high. It’s only open until 2 p.m., so come early to enjoy the treats and satisfy your pastry cravings.
original: If you're in the Venetian toward the hotel elevator entrance, then Bouchon Bakery is an essential stop you'll need to make to start your day. There's usually a decent sized line, but it moves somewhat fast. Whether you're in the mood for a macaron, baguette or coffee, Bouchon Bakery makes the wait worth it. I usually like to grab small bites since I'm always on the go, which is what this spot is pretty much known for. Don't expect a full on French meal here, but there is a Bouchon in the area that you can dine at. Either way, the service is dependable, quick and friendly. As with anything French, it is of great quality and comparatively pricey. It's only open until 2 PM, so get here early to enjoy and satisfy your patisserie cravings!

text: Déjame lamerte de arriba a abajo, hasta que digas "¡basta"! Permíteme hacer todo lo que quiero... Deja de pensar en cosas inapropiadas, porque estoy hablando del helado que compré en Melt. Helado. Se derrite en mi boca. Se derrite en mi mano. Se derrite en mi corazón... Las combinaciones más originales las encontrarás en Melt. Probé el helado de galleta de limón y el de chocolate, romero y pistacho. ¡Estaba delicioso y el sabor era algo que nunca había probado antes! La próxima vez que esté en la zona, me aseguraré de ir a Melt para probar algunos helados irresistibles.
text_en: Let me kiss you from head to toe, until you say “enough”! Allow me to do whatever I want… Stop thinking about inappropriate things, because I’m talking about the ice cream I bought at Melt. Ice cream. It melts in my mouth. It melts in my hand. It melts in my heart… The most unique combinations can be found at Melt. I tried the lemon biscuit ice cream and the chocolate, rosemary, and pistachio ice cream. It was delicious, and the flavor was something I’ve never experienced before! Next time I’m in the area, I’ll make sure to go to Melt to try some irresistible ice creams.
original: Let me lick you up and down, til you say "stop"! Let me do all the things I want to do... Get your mind out of the gutter because I'm talking to the ice cream I got at Melt! Ice cream. Melts in my mouth. Melts in my hand. Melts my heart... The most unique combinations are at melt. I had the Lemon Cookie and the Chocolate Rosemary Pistachio ice cream. It was so good and the taste was nothing I've ever had before! The next time I'm in the neighborhood, I'll make sure to head over to get a dose of some finger licking ice cream!

text: Average pastries coupled with the poor service makes this place worth skipping. They could also improve on their efficiency. Really poor way of doing business. If you're a fan it's worth going ONCE.
text_en: Average pastries coupled with the poor service makes this place worth skipping. They could also improve on their efficiency. Really poor way of doing business. If you're a fan it's worth going ONCE.

text: A pesar de que nunca he probado nada de los deliciosos postres que ofrecen, Amelie's ofrece una excelente experiencia en una panadería y cafetería. Buena conexión Wi-Fi, y generalmente se puede encontrar un enchufe cerca si se necesita. El personal suele ser joven, y a veces pueden parecer un poco impuntuales (pero quizás simplemente son tímidos/confundidos). El ambiente es moderno y amplio, el café es bueno, y si pueden mantener baristas comprometidos, también hay esperanza para el café espresso. Después de haber pasado tiempo y dinero en panaderías parisinas en numerosas ocasiones a lo largo de décadas, Amelie's me parece un poco caro en cuanto a la panadería. Sin embargo, dado que es algo raro en Charlotte, parece que existe una dinámica de oferta y demanda que justifica el gasto.
text_en: Although I have never tried any of the delicious desserts they offer, Amelie’s provides an excellent experience as a bakery and coffee shop. The Wi-Fi is good, and it’s usually possible to find an outlet nearby if needed. The staff are usually young, and sometimes they may seem a bit late (but maybe they’re just shy or confused). The atmosphere is modern and spacious; the coffee is good, and if they can keep the baristas committed, there’s also hope for espresso drinks. After spending time and money in Parisian bakeries many times over the years, Amelie’s seems a bit expensive compared to other bakeries. However, since it’s rare in Charlotte, it seems there’s a supply-and-demand dynamic that makes the cost justified.
original: Despite the fact that I never, never eat anything out of the amazing dessert cases, Amelie's provides a great bakery and coffeehouse experience. Good WiFi, and you can usually cozy up to a power outlet if you need to. The staff is typically young, and can sometimes come off with an unfriendly attitude (but maybe they are just shy/confused). The vibe is funky and sprawly, the coffee is good and if they are able to retain commited baristas, there is hope for the espresso as well. Having spent time and money in Parisian bakeries on many occasions spanning decades, Amelie's seems a bit pricey on the bakery side to me. But with it being such a rarity in Charlotte there is a supply/demand thing at work here that seems to justify the expense.

text_en: I came here for a coffee, and I was very satisfied with the quality of the coffee. I ordered an almond latte. I arrived around 9:30 in the morning, and there was a wide variety of pastries available—and no wait time. Definitely a good time to visit.
original: I came here for coffee and was definitely satisfied with the coffee. I got the hazelnut latte. I came here around 930 am and there were plenty of pastries in stock and no line. This is definitely a good time to visit.

text: They were extremely crowded on a 3 PM Friday afternoon how to draw a number to get service ended up getting quite a selection as there are a lot of items to choose from. I feel bad being so critical because it was a really beautiful store and the desserts are all very aesthetic but I just don't think it was worth it especially for the price which ended up being about $36. The quality was like a grocery store.

text: Este helado es increíble. Los sabores, la cremosidad, la textura. Podría seguir hablando. Pedí el capuchino macchiato y el helado de galletas. Y ambos me encantaron. Una de las mejores partes fue observar el lago congelado cubierto de nieve a temperaturas de 0-15 grados mientras lo comíamos. Y luego, nos adentramos en el lago. ¡Fue muy divertido!
text_en: This ice cream is incredible. The flavors, the creaminess, the texture… I could talk about it all day. I ordered the capuchino macchiato and the cookie ice cream. Both were great. One of the best parts was watching the frozen lake covered in snow at temperatures of 0–15 degrees while we ate. Then, we went deeper into the lake. It was really fun!
original: This ice cream is incredible. The flavors, the creaminess, the texture. I could go on and on. I got the cappuccino macchiato and the cookie dough. And I loved them both equally. One of the best parts was looking at the snow covered frozen lake in 10°-15° while we ate it. And then we walked onto the lake. So fun!

text: We checked out Churn on their grand opening and were pleasantly surprised by the number of delicious options available. From coffee, to lattes, to milkshakes and arctic swirls, and homemade scoops and cones, there's something here for everyone. We both enjoyed our lattes, and the menu of available flavors is quite lengthy! We also tried the S'mores ice cream, which was a perfectly soft and light consistency, almost like a gelato, and had chunks of graham cracker and chunks of chocolate. You can sample any flavor, so you can't go wrong! We'll definitely be back, and often!

text: Siempre vengo aquí cuando estoy en el Hotel The Venetian. La última vez que vine aquí fue un domingo, el 20 de marzo de 2022, antes de las 9 de la noche, y solo había una persona delante de mí. Los cannolis son imprescindibles, no son demasiado dulces, crujientes y son mi favorito. También pedimos el cheesecake, que era una porción generosa y tenía muy buen sabor. Si les gusta el pastel, prueben el pastel de confeti y el pastel de red velvet, son deliciosos.
text_en: I always come here when I’m at The Venetian Hotel. The last time I was here was on a Sunday, March 20, 2022, before 9 p.m., and there was only one person in front of me. Cannoli are essential—they’re not too sweet, crispy, and they’re my favorite. We also ordered cheesecake; it was a generous portion and tasted very good. If you like cakes, try the confetti cake and the red velvet cake—they’re delicious.
original: I always come here when I'm at The Venetian Hotel. The last time I came here was on a Sunday, 03/20/22 before 9pm and there was only one guest ahead of me. The cannolis is a must, not too sweet, crunchy and my go to. We got the cheesecake which was a good size portion and tasted good as well. If you like cake, try the confetti cake and red velvet cake, they are delish.

text: Fui a la sucursal de Lakewood después de pasar por ella varias veces. Nos atendieron casi de inmediato, a pesar de que estaba concurrida. El "árbol de algodón de azúcar" es mágico, y uno de los mejores que he probado. Los cupcakes de fresa me recordaron a la infancia. Considerando todo lo que compramos, pensé que sería más caro. Realmente, una experiencia muy agradable, con una excelente calidad en el algodón de azúcar, palomitas y panadería, a un precio razonable. Definitivamente volveremos, especialmente después de haber estado decepcionados con muchos cupcakes de otras panaderías. Lo recomiendo mucho. :-)
text_en: I went to the Lakewood branch after visiting it several times. They served us almost immediately, even though it was busy. The “sugar cotton candy” is magical—one of the best I’ve ever tried. The strawberry cupcakes reminded me of my childhood. Considering everything we bought, I thought it would be more expensive. But really, it was a very pleasant experience, with excellent quality in the sugar cotton candy, popcorn, and bakery items, at a reasonable price. We will definitely go back, especially after being disappointed with many cupcakes from other bakeries. I highly recommend it. :-)
original: Went to the Lakewood location after passing by it numerous times. We were waited on almost immediately even though it was busy. The cotton candy tree is magical, & some of the best I've ever had. The strawberry cupcakes took me back to childhood. For everything we bought, I thought it would be more expensive. Truly a pleasureable experience, & great quality candy, popcorn & bakery for what they charge. We will definitely be back, especially after being disappointed by many bakery cupcakes in the past. Highly recommend. :-)

text: I have been to this location twice now! Probably the best ice cream in town. Prices are reasonable and they have so many unique flavors to choose from. My friend and I are obsessed with this place! I don't think we've ever gotten a bad flavor. The staff has always been very kind and attentive as well. My personal favorites are the chocolate peanut butter and the salted caramel. Love Handel's!

text: Le doy a Handel 5 estrellas porque siempre busco un helado de cheesecake con arándanos y nunca encuentro lo que quiero. Y el helado de arándanos de Handel es perfecto. Es delicioso. Helado cremoso y dulce con remolinos de arándanos y trozos de galleta/pastel. ¡Estoy muy contento!
text_en: I give Handel 5 stars because I always look for a cheesecake with raisins ice cream, but I never find what I want. And Handel’s raisin ice cream is perfect. It’s delicious. Creamy and sweet ice cream with swirls of raisins and chunks of cookie/cake. I’m very happy!
original: I give Handel's 5 stars because I always search for a blueberry cheesecake and never get what I want. And Handel's Blueberry Cobbler ice cream hits the spot. So delicious. Blueberry swirls and rich creamy sweet ice cream with cookie/pie pieces mixed in. I'm a happy camper

text: Então, minha avaliação se baseia no café. Quando estive em Las Vegas com meu marido, estávamos tentando evitar as cafeterias da Starbucks, pois eram, na verdade, mais caras do que as da Nova York. Na maioria das vezes, sou a primeira a acordar, então, em uma das manhãs em que fui do TI para o Venetian para tomar um café, encontrei este lugar. Os doces pareciam ótimos, mas não posso dizer como eram, pois nunca experimentei nenhum. O café estava bom, e os funcionários foram simpáticos. A própria padaria é bem pequena, pelo menos a que visitei. Não há muito espaço para sentar, então você simplesmente pega seu pedido e leva para fora ou de volta para o seu quarto de hotel. Pela manhã, havia um homem de rua, bastante fedorento, sentado na área de lobby da ponte/passarela do Venetian, bem em frente ao Bouchon. Então, se ele ainda estiver lá, definitivamente recomendaria pegar seu pedido e ir embora.
text_en: So, my evaluation is based on the coffee. When I was in Las Vegas with my husband, we tried to avoid Starbucks cafes, because they were actually more expensive than those in New York. Most of the time, I’m the first to wake up, so one morning when I went from the IT room to the Venetian to get some coffee, I found this place. The desserts seemed great, but I can’t really describe them, since I’ve never tried any. The coffee was good, and the staff were friendly. The bakery itself is quite small, at least the one I visited. There isn’t much space to sit, so you just take your order and go outside or back to your hotel room. In the morning, there was a smelly man sitting in the lobby area of the Venetian bridge/promenade, right in front of Bouchon. So, if he’s still there, I definitely recommend taking your order and leaving.
original: So my review is based on the coffee! When I was in Vegas with hubby we were trying to avoid the Starbucks because they were actually higher priced than the NY Starbucks. Most of the time I'm the first one awake so one of the mornings that I went across to the Venetian from TI to grab some coffee I found this place. The pastries looked fantastic but I can't say how they were because I never sampled or tasted any. The coffee was alright, and the staff was nice. The bakery itself is pretty tiny, at least the one that I visited was. There's really no room to sit so you just grab your order and take it outside or back to your hotel room. In the mornings there was a very smelly homeless man hanging out in the Venetian bridge/skywalk lobby right outside the bouchon. So if he's still there I definitely would recommend walking away with your order.

text: O café estava bom, pedi um café com leite, então não posso criticar muito. A variedade de alimentos é excelente! Fiquei muito impressionado com a seleção sem glúten! Os bolos sem glúten foram ótimos para o café da manhã, e levei alguns macarons para viagem. A textura dos macarons é um pouco arejada (é preciso batê-los na assadeira antes de assar), e eles usam bastante corante, mas são gostosos e saborosos. Em termos de ambiente, este lugar é fantástico. A decoração é linda e charmosa, e às 5 da manhã estava tranquilo, mas imagino que seria o lugar perfeito para conversar ou trabalhar, especialmente porque está aberto 24 horas por dia! As atendentes no balcão foram simpáticas e prestativas com todas as perguntas sobre opções sem glúten. Se não fosse de fora, certamente voltaria aqui.
text_en: The coffee was good; I ordered a coffee with milk, so I can’t criticize much. The variety of foods is excellent! I was very impressed by the gluten-free options! The gluten-free cakes were great for breakfast, and I brought some macarons along for the trip. The texture of the macarons is a bit airy (you need to press them on a baking sheet before baking), and they use a lot of colorant, but they’re delicious and tasty. In terms of the atmosphere, this place is fantastic. The decor is beautiful and charming, and at 5 a.m., it was quiet. But I imagine it would be the perfect place to chat or work, especially since it’s open 24 hours a day! The staff at the counter were friendly and helpful with all my questions about gluten-free options. If I weren’t away from home, I would definitely come back here.
original: Coffee was good, I had a cafe au lait, so I can't judge too harshly. The food selection is awesome! I was a big fan of the gluten free selection! The gf tea cakes were great for breakfast with coffee, and I took a couple macarons to go. The macaron texture a little airy (need to be tapped on the cookie sheet before baking) and they are heavy handed on the dye, but nice and flavorful. Atmospherically speaking, this place was fabulous. The decor is lovely and charming, at 5am it was quiet, but I would imagine this would prove the perfect place to chat or work from, especially because it is open 24/7! The girls at the counter were pleasant, and helpful with all the gluten free questions. If I wasn't from out of town, I would definitely come here again.

text: My son and I stopped in this late evening for a sweet treat after attending the Phoenix Symphony. I checked Yelp for nearby places and stumbled on Novel. We both agreed to give it a try and sure glad we did! There was a short line which extended out the door, but once we got inside it smelled like heaven. You can see all the fresh donuts and the gentleman that helped us (sorry, can't remember his name!) offered us samples of anything we'd like to try. While making our requests he made small talk with us which was nice! Asked our names and how we heard of Novel. We went outside to enjoy our treats where they have several places to sit down. We'll be back again! Parking sucks, but it's downtown Phoenix so it comes with the territory.

text: We paid our second visi to this location of Sprinkles yesterday, and I guess I'm a fan! Service was young, sweet, and eager to please while it was surprisingly slow yesterday. We stopped in at around 8:30 after a ride on the high roller and picked up a chai cupcake, lemon coconut, vegan red velet, and vanilla minis. The minis are so cute and perfect for kids if you don't want them bouncing off the walls from the sugar. My favorite was the lemon coconut of our selection, although the chai was also quite tasty with its strong chai spices. Vegan red velvet is made with coconut oil and my friend (who is vegan) said it was very moist and delicious. I'd say the Sprinkles here are up to par with the locations I've visited in California with the exception of one thing: I have yet to see the SALTED CARAMEL cupcake at this location. Salted caramel is hands down, the best Sprinkles cupcake flavor ever, so please carry it soon. Thanks!

text: Eu queria dar apenas 2 estrelas a este lugar, por causa do serviço terrível que tive, mas o sorvete também não é dos melhores. Os sabores não são criativos, e o sorvete é apenas medíocre. Nada de especial aqui. Na última vez que fui, o serviço foi muito lento, e era evidente que os funcionários não gostavam do trabalho. Eu pedi um sorvete em um cone de açúcar, e ela deixou cair metade do sorvete na geladeira, e então colocou a metade torta no cone. Tentei pedir um prato para colocar o sorvete, mas ela claramente estava ocupada. Chamei outra funcionária, que me deu um prato, e então pediu para ela limpar a bagunça, mas não me ofereceu desculpas – ou a outra metade do meu sorvete. Provavelmente, não voltarei. Não brinquem com o meu sorvete!
text_en: I would give this place only 2 stars, due to the terrible service I experienced. The ice cream isn’t very good either; the flavors aren’t creative, and the ice cream itself is just mediocre. There’s nothing special about it. Last time I was there, the service was very slow, and it was clear that the staff didn’t enjoy their work. I ordered ice cream in a sugar cone, but she dropped half of the ice cream onto the fridge, and then put the broken part back into the cone. I tried to ask for a plate to hold the ice cream, but she was clearly busy. I called another employee, who gave me a plate, but then asked her to clean up the mess—without offering any apology, or for the other half of my ice cream. Probably, I won’t go back. Don’t play with my ice cream!
original: I wish I was giving this place just 2 stars because of the kind of terrible service I had,but the ice cream just isn't that great either. The flavors are not creative, and the ice cream is just mediocre. Absolutely nothing special here. The last time I was there the service was very slow, and it seemed obvious that the employees did not enjoy their jobs. I ordered a one scoop in a sugar cone, and she dropped half of the scoop into the freezer, then plopped the half of a scoop lopsided on the cone. I tried to ask her for a bowl to put it in, but I was clearly bothering her. I got the attention of another employee who gave me a bowl, then asked her to clean up the mess, yet didn't offer me an apology - or the other half of my scoop. I probably will not be visiting again. Don't mess with my ice cream!

text: Experimentei os macarons da Bouchon Bakery pela primeira vez há cerca de 6-7 anos, na unidade de Nova York. Foi apenas neste fim de semana, quando estive em Las Vegas, que tive a oportunidade de saborear novamente esses deliciosos macarons. Eles são, e continuam sendo, os melhores macarons que já provei. São grandes, o recheio é cremoso e leve, e os biscoitos são crocantes, mas cheios de sabor. Minha mãe adora e diz que também são os melhores que ela já comeu. Lamento não ter comprado mais caixas e também não ter experimentado outros produtos assados da Bouchon. Até a próxima!
text_en: I tried the macarons from Bouchon Bakery for the first time about 6–7 years ago, at the New York branch. It was only this weekend, while I was in Las Vegas, that I got the chance to taste these delicious macarons again. They are, and still remain, the best macarons I’ve ever tasted. They’re large, the filling is creamy and light, and the cookies are crispy yet full of flavor. My mother loves them and says they’re also the best ones she’s ever eaten. I regret not buying more boxes, and also not trying other baked products from Bouchon. See you next time!
original: I had my first taste of Bouchon Bakery's macarons around 6-7 years ago from the New York location. It wasn't until this past weekend I was in Vegas that I got to taste the sweet macarons once again. They were and still are the best macarons I've ever had. They're large, the cream is smooth and light, and the cookies are flaky but packed with flavor. My mom loves these and says they are the best she's ever had, too. I regret not getting more boxes of these and also trying more of their other baked goods. Until next time!

text: Estoy muy contento de que finalmente haya una panadería de 85 céntimos aquí en Las Vegas. Ya no tengo que conducir hasta el sur de California para conseguir "pan fresco". Esta panadería es mucho más pequeña que las que he visitado. La calidad del pan y el café con sal marina helado es igual a la de otras panaderías. ¡Por favor, mantengan así! Le doy una calificación de 3 estrellas debido a su falta de eficiencia en la gestión de inventario y en el control de la fila, además de su política de "sin hielo" en sus bebidas. Inventario: Las estanterías suelen tener uno o dos panes, o estar vacías. Pero se puede ver una estantería llena de pan, fría, en una esquina. Sugiero asignar a otra persona para entregar esos panes. Control de la fila: Esta tienda lleva abierta 2-3 meses, todavía hay una larga fila, y la mayoría de las veces es incluso fuera de la tienda. Entiendo. Todo el mundo en Las Vegas quiere su pan. Una vez, vine el martes por la noche alrededor de las 8 de la noche, pensando que podría evitar la larga fila. Bueno, logré hacerlo. Evité la fila para comprar pan. Pero la fila para pagar era larga, y tomó mucho tiempo. Solo tenían 2 cajeros, cuando había más de 20 personas en la fila. Definitivamente necesitan más ayuda: asignar a otro cajero o a alguien para empaquetar el pan, a fin de agilizar el proceso al pagar.
text_en: I’m very happy that there’s finally a bakery offering 85 cents per loaf of bread here in Las Vegas. I no longer have to drive all the way to southern California just to get “fresh bread”. This bakery is much smaller than those I’ve visited before. The quality of the bread and the iced coffee with sea salt is just as good as those from other bakeries. Please keep it this way! I give it a 3-star rating due to their lack of efficiency in managing inventory and queue control, as well as their “no ice” policy for drinks. Inventory: The shelves usually have one or two loaves of bread, or they’re empty. But you can see a shelf full of cold bread in a corner. I suggest assigning someone else to deliver those loaves of bread. Queue control: This store has been open for 2–3 months now, yet there’s still a long queue, and most of the time, it’s outside the store. I understand. Everyone in Las Vegas wants their bread. Once, I went there on Tuesday night around 8 p.m., thinking I could avoid the long queue. Well, I managed to avoid the queue for buying bread. But the queue for paying was long, and it took a lot of time. There were only 2 cashiers when there were more than 20 people in line. They definitely need more help: assign another cashier or someone to pack the bread, so the payment process can be faster.
original: I'm pretty stoked that Vegas finally has an 85c bakery here. I no longer have to drive all the way to SoCal for "fresh bread". This bakery is a lot smaller than the ones I've been to. The quality of the bread and iced sea salt coffee is equivalent to the other bakeries. Please keep that up! I'm rating this a 3-star because of their inefficiency on inventory and line control, plus their "no ice" policy on their drinks. Inventory: The shelves would have one or two bread left or it'd be empty. But you'd see a fully loaded bakery rack chilling in the corner. I'd suggest assigning an additional person to deliver those bread. Line control: This shop has been opened for 2-3 months now, there's still a long line, most of the time it's even out the door. I get it. Everyone in vegas wants their bread. I once came on a Tuesday night around 8pm, thinking I'd bypass the long line. Well, I kind of did. I bypassed the line to grab bread. But the line to pay was long, and it took forever. They only had 2 cashiers when there were 20+ people in line. They definitely need more help; assign an additional cashier or a person to bag up the bread to expedite the process upon check out.

text: Antes era increíble. Sin embargo, hoy no fue así. Los brownies estaban secos, el pastel de fresas era espantoso. La cocina estaba sucia.
text_en: It was incredible before. However, today it wasn’t so. The brownies were dry, and the strawberry cake was awful. The kitchen was dirty.

text: Minha esposa e eu fomos aqui, pois recebemos muitas recomendações para visitá-lo durante nossa estadia em Cleveland. É apenas uma sorveteria comum. O sorvete estava meio derretido. A loja em si era charmosa. Fiquei decepcionado. O cone de waffle também não parecia muito crocante ou fresco.
text_en: My wife and I went here because we received many recommendations to visit it during our stay in Cleveland. It’s just an ordinary ice cream shop. The ice cream was somewhat melted. The store itself was charming, but I was disappointed. The waffle cones also didn’t seem very crisp or fresh.
original: My wife and I came here as we were highly recommended to come here while visiting Cleveland. Just an average ice cream place. The ice cream was half melted. The shop was cute though. Disappointed. The waffle cone did not feel very crisp or fresh either.

text: Eu pedi o sanduíche de sorvete com donuts. Achei que seria bom. O donut tinha um sabor semelhante ao de um donut barato da Walmart. Esse foi o problema, e depois aqueceram o sanduíche. Bom, isso acabou por arruinar a experiência. Mas o sorvete estava bom.
text_en: I ordered a ice cream sandwich with donuts. I thought it would be good. The donut had a flavor similar to that of a cheap Walmart donut. That’s the problem—then they heated up the sandwich. Well, that ruined the experience. But the ice cream was good.
original: I got the donut ice cream sandwich. It was just on. I had high hopes. The donut tasted like a cheap Walmart glazed. That's what was the downfall and then the nuke it to warm it. Eh, kind of ruined it. But the ice cream was nice.

text: ¡Este lugar es increíble! Sus cupcakes son espectaculares y saben igual de bien de lo que parecen. También tienen frascos de masa para galletas comestibles. Creo que cuesta 5 dólares por frasco. Me pareció un precio excelente. ¡Incluso viene con una cuchara! El dueño fue muy amable y servicial. Incluso ofreció prepararnos algunos productos que estaban agotados. Tienen una gran variedad de dulces que no pude encontrar en ningún otro lugar de la zona.
text_en: This place is amazing! Their cupcakes are spectacular, and they taste just as good as they look. They also have jars of edible cookie dough. I think it costs $5 per jar. It seemed like a very good price. It even comes with a spoon! The owner was very kind and helpful. He even offered to prepare some products that were already sold out. They have a wide variety of sweets that I couldn’t find anywhere else in the area.
original: This place is super cool! Their cupcakes are out of this world and they taste just as good as they look!! They have jars of edible cookie dough. I believe it's a pint for 5 bucks. I thought that was a great price. It even comes with a spoon! The owner was super nice and accommodating. He even offered to make things for us right away that were sold out. They have a great selection of treats that I couldn't find anywhere else in the area!

text: He estado aquí tanto para disfrutar de helados en verano como de ramen en invierno. Mason's ofrece una variedad de sabores únicos, incluyendo cardamomo y té tailandés, que cambian diariamente. El área al aire libre es ideal para los meses más cálidos. En los meses de invierno, probé el ramen vegetariano, que se basa en champiñones. También tienen opciones de cerdo y pollo. El caldo y el huevo cocido eran de un sabor excelente. Los propios champiñones eran un poco demasiado masticables para mi gusto. Aún así, fue una excelente comida y perfecta para una fría noche de invierno. Fui alrededor de las 6 de la tarde un sábado, y solo tenían suficiente ramen vegetariano para dos órdenes más para el día, así que ten en cuenta eso si quieres la opción vegetariana.
text_en: I’ve been here to enjoy ice cream in summer and ramen in winter. Mason’s offers a variety of unique flavors, including cardamom and Thai tea, which change daily. The outdoor area is ideal for the warmer months. In winter, I tried the vegetarian ramen, which is made with mushrooms. There are also options with pork and chicken. The broth and boiled eggs were delicious. The mushrooms themselves were a bit too easy to chew for my taste. Still, it was an excellent meal, perfect for a cold winter night. I went there around 6 p.m. on a Saturday, and they only had enough vegetarian ramen for two more orders that day. So, keep that in mind if you prefer the vegetarian option.
original: I've been here for both ice cream during the summer and ramen in the winter. Mason's has a variety of unique flavors, including cardamom and thai tea, that change daily. The outdoor seating is nice for the warmer months. In the winter months, I had the veggie ramen, which is mushroom based. They also have pork and chicken options. The broth and soft boiled egg were super flavorful. The mushrooms themselves were a bit too chewy for my liking. Still a great meal and perfect for a cold winter evening. I went around 6pm on a Saturday and they only had enough of the veggie ramen for two more orders for the day, so keep that in mind if you're wanting the vegetarian option.

text: Como un gran aficionado al helado durante mis vacaciones, el objetivo de mis primos era llevarme a los mejores lugares para comer helado. Sweet Republic apareció en el programa "La mejor cosa que he comido" de la Food Network. Aunque el helado era delicioso, no creo que lo clasifique como la mejor comida que disfruté durante mis vacaciones. Ambos pedimos los mini-sundaes en sus famosas teteras. Probablemente, fue la experiencia más interesante: pudimos ver al trabajador preparando las teteras frescas justo delante de nosotros. ¡Eso sí que era un extra y delicioso! En general, el lugar era excelente, pero esperaba algo más, debido a la publicidad del programa, y me decepcionó un poco.
text_en: As a big ice cream fan during my vacation, my cousins’ goal was to take me to the best places to eat ice cream. Sweet Republic appeared on the Food Network show “The Best Thing I Eated”. Although the ice cream was delicious, I don’t think it could be considered the best meal I had during my vacation. We both ordered mini sundae cups in their famous teapots. It was probably the most interesting experience: we could see the worker preparing fresh teapots right in front of us. That was really nice and delightful! Overall, the place was excellent, but I expected more due to the program’s advertising, and it was a bit disappointing.
original: As an ice cream aficionado while on vacation, it was my cousins goal to take me to note worthy ice cream spots. Sweet Republic was on the Food Network's show "the Best Thing I Ever Ate." While the ice cream was delicious, I don't think I would classify this as the best thing I ate on vacation. We both got the mini- sundaes in their note worthy waffle bowls. This was probably the coolest thing, you watched the worker make the waffle bowls fresh right in front of you.. now that was an added perk and yummy! Overall the place was great but I expected better since the hype from the show and was slightly disappointed.

text: ¿Por dónde empiezo siquiera? Imaginen las combinaciones de helados más creativas y originales, y tendrán a Jeni's. Desde helados sin lácteos hasta helados con sabor a "cream puff", Jeni's seguro que les encantará. Ubicada en una pequeña tienda con un estilo retro, Jeni's ofrece degustaciones ilimitadas. De verdad, ¡prueben todos! Además, Jeni's tiene una excelente oferta de dos porciones a $5 (como se muestra en la foto), con tanta cantidad de helado que son básicamente dos porciones completas. Recomiendo encarecidamente una combinación de vainilla con miel y "brambleberry crisp".
text_en: Where should I even start? Imagine the most creative and unique ice cream combinations—and that’s Jeni’s. From dairy-free ice creams to those with “cream puff” flavors, Jeni’s is definitely going to appeal to you. Located in a small, retro-style shop, Jeni’s offers unlimited tastings. Really, try them all! Additionally, Jeni’s has an excellent deal: two servings for just $5 (as shown in the photo). There’s so much ice cream that it’s basically two full servings. I highly recommend a combination of vanilla with honey and “brambleberry crisp”.
original: Where do I even begin? Think of the most amazingly creative ice cream combos and you've got Jeni's. From non-diary ice cream to cream puff flavored ice cream, Jeni's is sure to please. Located in a cute little shop outfitted with retro patterns, Jeni's offers unlimited samples! Seriously, try them all! Moreover, Jeni's has a great two half scoop deal for $5 (featured in the photo) with so much ice cream it's basically two full scoops! Highly recommend a combo of honey vanilla bean and brambleberry crisp.

text: Split a Cannoli with my partner after dinner at Mia Bella's. So good! Not too sweet - Just right.
text_en: Split a Cannoli with my partner after dinner at Mia Bella's. So good! Not too sweet - Just right.

text: El servicio al cliente fue increíble. La cajera nos guio a través del proceso de pedido. Pedimos el helado Ahboong con sabor a Ube. ¡Estaba delicioso! No es demasiado dulce y se puede apreciar el sabor a Ube. El waffle de pescado combinó muy bien con el helado. Era suave y caliente. Definitivamente volveré a pedir.
text_en: The customer service was incredible. The cashier guided us through the ordering process. We ordered the Ahboong ice cream with Ube flavor. It was delicious! It wasn’t too sweet, and the Ube flavor was clearly visible. The fish waffle paired well with the ice cream. It was soft and warm. I definitely will order again.
original: The customer service we got was amazing! The cashier walked us through the ordering process. We got the Ahboong with Ube flavored soft serve. It was amazing! It's not too sweet and you can taste the Ube flavor. The fish waffle went well with it. It was soft and warm. I definitely will be back for more!

text: ¡Delicioso! Después de que un amable joven detrás del mostrador me preguntó si quería probar algo, pedí el helado de caramelo con sal. Servicio amable y helado delicioso. Una sola porción era enorme.
text_en: Delicious! After a kind young man behind the counter asked if I wanted to try something, I ordered the caramel with salt ice cream. The service was friendly, and the ice cream was delicious. A single portion was huge.
original: Yummy! I had the salted caramel after the nice young man behind the counter asked if I would like to try anything. Friendly service and yummy ice cream. A single scoop was huge.

text: Quiero ser completamente honesto, yo soy celíaco. No como donas. Sin embargo, a mi esposo y a la mayoría de mis amigos les encantan las donas. No, no me compadezcáis (¡Vale, quizás un poco!). Bueno, volviendo al punto principal de esta reseña... A todo el mundo realmente les encantan estas donas. De hecho, a casi todo el mundo. Mucha gente dice que estas son sus donas favoritas. Para casi todas las personas que conozco que comen donas, estas están entre sus tres preferidas. Probablemente podría darles 5 estrellas basándome en las opiniones de mis amigos. Sin embargo, soy un "celíaco gruñón" y tuve que quitar una estrella por la falta de opciones sin gluten. Me encantaría que tuvieran donas sin gluten, pero no espero que suceda.
text_en: I want to be completely honest: I am a celiac. I don’t eat donuts. However, my husband and most of my friends really like donuts. No, don’t feel sorry for me (okay, maybe a little!). Well, back to the main point of this review… Everyone really loves these donuts. In fact, almost everyone does. Many people say these are their favorite donuts. For almost all the people I know who eat donuts, these are among their top three favorites. I could probably give them 5 stars based on the opinions of my friends. But I’m a “grumpy celiac”, and I had to take one star away because there are no gluten-free options. I would love if they had gluten-free donuts, but I don’t expect that to happen.
original: I Will be completely honest right now, I am gluten-free. I do not eat donuts. However, my husband loves donuts as do most of my friends. No, don't feel sorry for me (OK, maybe a little sorry I do love sympathy ) Anywho... getting to the actual point of this review... Everyone seriously loves these donuts, Like, everyone. A ton of people say that these are their favorite donuts. For basically every one I know who eats donuts this is in their top 3. I probably could give them 5 stars based on all of my friends' reviews. However, I am a GLUTEN GRINCH and I had to remove a star for their lack of gluten free options. I would SO love them to get a GF donut but I'm not holding my breath

text: Small bakery in the middle of the Venetian, behind the escalators going down around the Phantom Theater. After going to the Napa location numerous times, this one is sad to stop by and give 2 stars to =(. But they only had 4 types of macarons, service was kind of weird/awkward, and the cappuccino was not worth $4 (it was watered down/really weak). Chocolate almond croissant was dry. text: Una encantadora y deliciosa tienda de dulces en el corazón del centro, junto a Fifth Avenue Place. Esta pequeña tienda es muy limpia y cuenta con varios mostradores llenos de dulces que te harán querer probarlos todos. Palitos de pretzel cubiertos de chocolate con diferentes toppings, trufas, caramelos, ¡y la lista sigue! ¡Una reciente sorpresa: masa para galletas!!!! Pensé que era una vitrina de helados, ¡pero en realidad es una vitrina de masa para galletas con 6 sabores diferentes! Probé un poco de la masa para galletas de chocolate y estaba absolutamente deliciosa. Si buscas satisfacer un antojo dulce, no busques más.
text_en: A charming and delicious candy store right in the heart of the downtown area, next to Fifth Avenue Place. This small store is very clean, and there are several counters filled with candies that will make you want to try them all. Pretzel sticks covered in chocolate with various toppings, truffles, caramels—and the list goes on! A recent surprise: cookie dough!!!! I thought it was a ice cream display, but it’s actually a display of cookie dough in 6 different flavors! I tried a little bit of the chocolate cookie dough, and it was absolutely delicious. If you’re looking to satisfy a sweet craving, don’t look anywhere else.
original: A delightfully sinful sweets shop in the heart of downtown, next to Fifth Avenue Place. This little sweet shop is so clean and has several counters full of candies that you want to try them all! Chocolate covered pretzels with different topping, truffles, toffee treats, list goes on and on!! Recent discovery - cookie dough!!!! I thought it was a gelato case when in fact it is a cookie dough case with 6 different flavors of cookie dough!!! Sampled a spoonful of the traditional chocolate chip cookie dough and it was absolutely delicious! If you're looking to fill a sweet craving come no further.

text: Esta sorveteria chega muito perto de ser excelente, mas a textura do sorvete era muito aguada e cheia de cristais de gelo. Eu gostei muito da variedade de sabores oferecidos e achei que muitos eram muito criativos. No entanto, muitos faltavam em intensidade de sabor, parecendo um pouco sem graça. Além disso, havia algo estranho na consistência do próprio sorvete. Muitos dos sabores que experimentei pareciam um pouco aguados e não tão cremosos quanto poderiam ser. O sorvete aqui é, em geral, de qualidade média, especialmente se comparado com o sorvete da Jeni's.
text_en: This ice cream shop is very close to being excellent, but the texture of the ice cream was too watery and full of ice crystals. I really liked the variety of flavors offered, and many of them seemed very creative. However, many lacked in flavor intensity, making them seem a bit dull. Additionally, there was something unusual about the consistency of the ice cream itself. Many of the flavors I tried seemed a bit watery and not as creamy as they could be. Overall, the ice cream here is of average quality, especially compared to the ice cream from Jeni’s.
original: This ice cream shop comes really close to making the mark, but the ice cream texture was very watery and full of ice crystals. I thoroughly enjoyed the variety of flavors of ice creams offered and thought many were very creative. However many were lacking in intensity of flavor, coming off as a little bland. In addition, there was something off with the consistency of the ice cream itself. Many flavors I sampled felt a little watery and not as creamy as they could be. The ice cream here is about average, especially if you compare the product to Jeni's ice cream.

text: I LOVE SPRINKLES CUPCAKES AND ICE CREAM! Living in California, I've had the luck of being near several locations so I was pretty excited when they opened another one in Vegas. This one is a combo of both cupcakes and ice cream, yay! They're connected so if you can't decide like me, you can easily view the goodies in both stores. Their cupcakes are always delicious! I've had the Black and White, Red Velvet (both sugar and sugar free), Peanut Butter, Smores, Margarita, Carrot, and Dark Chocolate at various visits. Their Margarita cupcake (made for a limited time during Cinco de Mayo) is the only one I haven't throughly enjoyed to the very last crumb. I decided on ice cream this time. Sprinkles makes their own ice cream and allows you to have it alone, in one of their delicious waffle cones (regular or red velvet), cookie sandwiches, cupcake top sandwiches, and a number of unique toppings. The cupcake top sandwich is bomb, as you can choose two different of the day's flavors, but I opted for some dark chocolate ice cream sprinkled with red velvet cupcake crumbs. So good, as the woman who helped me agreed! Sprinkles is a famous brand, so the cupcakes and ice cream combos are more than the average similar establishments, but for the occasional treat I think it's more than worth it!

text: While I was in Paris, my boyfriend was in Las Vegas...oddly enough in the fake Paris hotel...you can guess who won the battle of emailing Eiffel Tower pictures. I decided he too needed to smuggle baked goods in his luggage. I think he did a better job than me. I only asked for bouchons, but I was also given a chocolate tart. I think my heart stopped for a couple seconds while eating it, and I'm not sure if it's because I shouldn't have eaten the whole thing by myself or because it tasted of chocolate heaven. Even though it had been in the freezer for a couple days, it was still pretty damn amazing. The bouchons were just not that amazing in retrospect after the tart. They were good, but I can make a glorified brownie too if necessary. I am far too lazy for a tart. I would eat everything again though, and then some more, don't get me wrong.
