I decided he too needed to smuggle baked goods in his luggage. I think he did a better job than me. I only asked for bouchons, but I was also given a chocolate tart. I think my heart stopped for a couple seconds while eating it, and I'm not sure if it's because I shouldn't have eaten the whole thing by myself or because it tasted of chocolate heaven. Even though it had been in the freezer for a couple days, it was still pretty damn amazing. The bouchons were just not that amazing in retrospect after the tart. They were good, but I can make a glorified brownie too if necessary. I am far too lazy for a tart. I would eat everything again though, and then some more, don't get me wrong.

text: Una panadería pequeña y agradable, esperé en la fila afuera porque también había gente esperando dentro. Quería probar el pastel de queso, pedí el de Nueva York, estaba bueno, con una capa de limón muy agradable. Me gustaría que fuera un poco más denso como el que preparan aquí. Tenían varios sabores para elegir. Sigo buscando el mejor. El pastel de crema italiana que pedí estaba un poco seco y la galleta de avena era dura. Quizás simplemente tuve un mal día. La variedad de macarons era impresionante.
text_en: A small and pleasant bakery. I waited in line outside because there were people also waiting inside. I wanted to try the cheese cake; I ordered the New York version. It was good, with a very pleasant lemon layer on top. I would like it to be a little thicker, like the ones they make here. There were several flavors to choose from. I’m still looking for the best one. The Italian cream cake I ordered was a bit dry, and the oat cookies were hard. Maybe I just had a bad day. The variety of macarons was impressive.
original: Nice small bakery, waited in line outside since there were people waiting inside as well. Went to try the cheesecake, got the New York it was good, nice lemon topping, I like mine a little more dense then prepared here. They had several flavors to choose from. Still trying to find the best!! My piece of Italian creme cake was a bit dry and the oatmeal cookie was hard. Maybe I just went on a bad day! The selection of Macaroons was impressive.

text: ¡Guau, estoy completamente enganchado al caramelo salado! Si tienes la oportunidad, pruébalo, especialmente en helado.
text_en: Wow, I’m completely obsessed with salty caramel! If you have the chance, try it out, especially in ice cream.
original: OMG I am obsessed with the salted carmel@!!!! When ever you can find they try the ice cream.

text: Depois de ouvir tantas coisas boas sobre o Carlo's Bake Shop dos meus amigos, decidi que era algo que eu precisava experimentar em Las Vegas. Algumas pessoas jogam, outras bebem – eu como. Carboidratos não contam nas férias, certo? Esta avaliação é de alguém que não assiste ao programa "Cake Boss". Embora eu adore programas e competições de culinária (o Food Network é o meu favorito), nunca consegui me interessar pelo "Cake Boss". Meus amigos sempre falam muito sobre o programa e sobre a confeitaria, então decidi que precisava saber o motivo. Depois de passear pelas lojas do Venetian Canal Shops, seguindo os sinais para a confeitaria (e para o Buddy V's, que fica ao lado), finalmente encontrei o corredor, que estava bastante cheio de pessoas. Em algumas fotos do Yelp, parece um caos – mas talvez eu tenha tido sorte, porque não era tão ruim assim. Havia uma fila e demorou cerca de 15 minutos para chegar à frente. Havia alguém supervisionando a fila, o que foi bom, pois ele realmente impedia as pessoas de cortar a fila. A fila fica em frente à cozinha, onde você pode ver os confeiteiros decorando os bolos. Na época, eles estavam trabalhando em torres de cannoli. Pareciam ótimas, então eu já estava convencida! Tive que pegar uma. Assim que você entra na confeitaria e faz o pedido, acontece uma correria de pessoas olhando para as vitrines, tentando decidir o que comprar. A pessoa na frente de mim estava indo e vindo, tentando decidir quais biscoitos comprar. Acho que um cardápio com fotos dos produtos disponíveis faria maravilhas por aqui! Seria útil ver um cardápio, para que, quando você chegar à frente da fila, já saiba o que quer pedir. Não havia lagostas na vitrine, então optei por uma caixa de biscoitos de Natal, que já vinham embalados, alguns biscoitos e uma torre de cannoli. Meu pedido ficou em torno de 40 dólares. 40 dólares e uma hora depois, a única coisa que consegui pensar era "meh". Não estava à altura das expectativas. A torre de cannoli estava ok, mas achei que estava um pouco encharcada e não tão saborosa quanto eu esperava. Os biscoitos estavam bons, mas não era algo que eu esperaria esperar na fila novamente. A caixa de biscoitos foi um presente, mas a pessoa que recebeu abriu a caixa depois do jantar e nós experimentamos um dos biscoitos de manteiga, e estava bom. Definitivamente não era tão saboroso quanto outros biscoitos de manteiga que eu já provei em confeitarias menos famosas. Se você é fã do programa, entendo por que você viria aqui. Mas, se você é como eu e só queria um bom cannoli, eu continuaria procurando.
text_en: After hearing so many good things about Carlo’s Bake Shop from my friends, I decided it was something I really wanted to try in Las Vegas. Some people play games, others drink – I like eating. Carbs aren’t part of vacationing, right? This review is from someone who doesn’t watch “Cake Boss”. Although I love cooking shows and food competitions (Food Network is my favorite), I never really became interested in “Cake Boss”. My friends always talk a lot about the show and baking, so I decided I needed to find out why. After wandering around the shops at Venetian Canal Shops and following the signs toward the bakery (and the Buddy V’s nearby), I finally found the hallway, which was quite crowded with people. In some Yelp photos, it looks chaotic – but maybe I was lucky, because it wasn’t that bad. There was a line, and it took about 15 minutes to get to the front. There was someone watching the line, which was good, as they really prevented people from cutting in line. The line was in front of the kitchen, where you could see the bakers decorating the cakes. At that time, they were making cannoli towers. They looked great, so I was already convinced! I had to pick one up. As soon as you enter the bakery and place your order, there’s a rush of people looking at the displays, trying to decide what to buy. The person in front of me kept coming and going, trying to decide which cookies to buy. I think a menu with photos of the available products would be great here! It would be useful to have a menu, so that when you reach the front of the line, you know exactly what you want to order. There were no lobster dishes on display, so I chose a box of Christmas cookies, which were already wrapped up, along with some cookies and a cannoli tower. My order cost around $40. $40 and an hour later, the only thing I could think about was “meh”. It didn’t live up to expectations. The cannoli tower was okay, but I felt it was a bit soggy and not as flavorful as I expected. The cookies were good, but it wasn’t something I would expect to get back in line for again. The box of cookies was a gift, but the person who received it opened it after dinner, and we tried one of the butter cookies – it was good. Definitely not as flavorful as other butter cookies I’ve tried in less famous bakeries. If you’re a fan of the show, I understand why you’d come here. But if you’re like me and just want a good cannoli, I’ll keep looking.
original: After hearing such great things about Carlo's Bake Shop from friends, I decided that this was on the top of my to do list in Vegas. Some people gamble, some people drink-- I EAT. Carbs don't count on vacation right? This review comes from someone who does not watch Cake Boss. While I love, love, love cooking shows and competitions (Food Network is my jam), I just never could get into Cake Boss. My friends always rant and rave about the show, and now the bakery, so I decided that I needed to know what the hype was about. After walking around the Venetian Canal Shops, following the signs to the bakery (and Buddy V's located across the way) I finally spotted the hallway that was pretty busy with people. In some of the Yelp photos, it looks like a zoo-- but maybe I got lucky, because it wasn't THAT bad. There was a line and it took maybe 15 minutes to get to the front of the line. There was someone who was monitoring the line which was nice because he actually stopped people that were trying to cut in line. The line waits in front of the kitchen where you can watch them decorate cakes and such. At the time, they were working on a cannoli towers. They looked great so I was sold! I had to pick one up. Once you get into the actual bakery and they take your order, it turns into a frenzy of customers looking into the cases trying to decide what to get. The lady in front of me was going back and forth trying to figure out which biscotti's to get. I think that a menu with pictures of the items for sale would do this place wonders! It would be helpful to see a menu so that when you get to the front of the line, you already know what you want to order. There were no lobster tails in the case, so I opted for a box of Christmas cookies that was already prepackaged, a few cookies and a cannoli tower. My order ran about $40 bucks. $40 dollars and an hour later, and all I could think was "MEH". It didn't live up to the hype in my book. The cannoli tower was decent, but I thought it was rather soggy and not as rich or flavorful as I was expecting. The biscotti was alright, but it wasn't something that I would wait in line for again. The box of cookies were a gift, but the recipient opened the box after dinner and we did try one of the butter cookies and it was okay. Definitely not as rich as other butter cookies that I have had from less popular bakeries. If you are a fan of the show, I can see why you would come here. But if you are like me and just wanted a good cannoli, I would keep looking.

text: Worth the extra calories! Hands down the best pastries outside of France. Flaky and delicious chocolate almond croissants, a moist and doughy take on the classic cinnamon bun, and strawberry danish that was sublime! Tasty, not greasy. The coffee is fine, but the pastries are where it's at. Avoid long lines at breakfast and stock up for your stay by buying in bulk.
text_en: Worth the extra calories! Hands down the best pastries outside of France. Flaky and delicious chocolate almond croissants, a moist and doughy take on the classic cinnamon bun, and strawberry danish that was sublime! Tasty, not greasy. The coffee is fine, but the pastries are where it's at. Avoid long lines at breakfast and stock up for your stay by buying in bulk.

text: ¡Magdalenas fantásticas! Incluso las más sencillas son especiales y deliciosas. Personal amable y muy limpio. ¡Ahora es nuestro lugar favorito cuando pasamos por Las Vegas!
text_en: Fantastic muffins! Even the simplest ones are special and delicious. The staff is kind and very clean. Now it’s our favorite place when we visit Las Vegas!
original: Fantastic donuts! Even the most basic "models" are special and delicious. Friendly staff, super clean. Our new "must stop" the next time we pass thru Vegas.

text: Me encanta este lugar. Todo es excelente. Antes tenían la mejor ensalada de pollo, pero cambiaron la receta o algo así. Ya no es tan buena. Mi favorita es el brownie de caramelo salado y la tarta de frutos rojos. Solo voy de vez en cuando porque todo es muy alto en calorías. Pero definitivamente es un lugar genial para comprar dulces. Buen estacionamiento. Ubicación fantástica. Abierto las 24 horas. Personal amable. Un lugar ideal para relajarse y conectarse a internet. Hay algunas personas interesantes que frecuentan este lugar. Es divertido observar a la gente. He escuchado algunas conversaciones muy interesantes mientras estaba allí, haciendo lo que tenía que hacer.
text_en: I love this place. Everything is excellent. They used to have the best chicken salad, but they changed the recipe or something like that. It’s not as good anymore. My favorites are the salty caramel brownies and the fruit tart. I go there occasionally because everything here is very high in calories. But it’s definitely a great place to buy sweets. Good parking. Fantastic location. Open 24 hours. Friendly staff. An ideal place to relax and get online. There are some interesting people who frequent this place. It’s fun to observe the people. I heard some very interesting conversations while I was there, doing what I had to do.
original: Love this place. Everything is good. They used to have the best chicken salad but they changed the recipe or something. It's not as good. My fave is the salted caramel brownie and mixed berry tart. I only try to go once in awhile because everything is so high in calories. But def a great place to get sweets. Good parking. Awesome location. Open 24 hours. Nice staff. Great place to come chill and get online. Some interesting characters frequent this place. It's fun to people watch. I have overheard some of the wildest convos while I'm sitting there minding my business.

text: ¡Este lugar NO vale la pena! Pedí el helado de cumpleaños y, lamentablemente, quedé decepcionado. Mi helado tenía un sabor extraño y salado, y no sabía nada como un pastel de cumpleaños. Después de comer todas las chispas, simplemente lo tiré, lo cual fue una pérdida total de dinero. Definitivamente no valía los $6.50. También probé el helado de leche y cereales, y tampoco era mucho mejor. El helado literalmente sabe a leche, sin ningún indicio de dulzura. Ahorra tiempo y dinero y busca otro lugar.
text_en: This place is not worth it at all! I ordered the birthday ice cream, and unfortunately, I was disappointed. My ice cream had a strange, salty taste, and it didn’t even resemble a proper birthday cake. After eating all the ice cream, I just threw it away—it was a complete waste of money. It definitely wasn’t worth $6.50. I also tried the milk and cereal ice cream, but it wasn’t much better either. The ice cream literally tastes like milk, with no hint of sweetness at all. Save your time and money and find another place to go.
original: This place is NOT worth the hype! I ordered the b-day soft serve and was sadly disappointed. My soft serve had a weird salty flavor and tasted nothing like a bday cake. After I ate off all the sprinkles, I just threw it away which was a complete waste! It was definitely not worth $6.50! I also tried the milk and cereal soft serve and that wasn't much better. The soft serve literally tastes like milk with zero hint of sweetness. Save yourself the time and money and go elsewhere!

text: Este podría ser mi nuevo lugar favorito para comer helado. Tienen una gran variedad de sabores deliciosos y únicos. Los dueños son increíblemente amables y atentos. Además, todo el helado se produce localmente.
text_en: This might be my new favorite place to eat ice cream. They have a great variety of delicious and unique flavors. The owners are incredibly kind and attentive. Moreover, all the ice cream is made locally.
original: This might be my new go-to ice cream spot. They have so many yummy and unique flavors. The owners are incredibly friendly and kind. The ice cream is all locally made too.

text: Great Ice Cream every time I have been there the ice cream is awesome the customer service is great 5 stars all the way
text_en: Great Ice Cream every time I have been there the ice cream is awesome the customer service is great 5 stars all the way

text: Estou muito feliz por ter encontrado este lugar para satisfazer meus desejos por doces! Eles têm um waffle com formato de peixe, com um recheio delicioso, simplesmente incrível! E o iogurte congelado também é delicioso!!! Os biscoitos de waffle são feitos diariamente, assim como os cones de waffle ;-) Eu pedi para recheá-los com Nutella e ficaram maravilhosos! O iogurte congelado de Ube combinou perfeitamente com o recheio de Nutella no cone de waffle, até que pude adicionar um topping sem custo adicional (usei coco ralado). É simplesmente delicioso, e vale a pena experimentar! Com certeza voltarei aqui para satisfazer meus desejos por doces. Recomendo muito, você vai adorar! Já é o meu lugar favorito por aqui!
text_en: I’m very happy to have found this place to satisfy my cravings for sweets! They have a fish-shaped waffle with a delicious filling—simply amazing! And the frozen yogurt is also delicious!!! The waffle cookies are made daily, as are the waffle cones ;-) I asked them to fill them with Nutella, and they turned out wonderful! The Ube frozen yogurt paired perfectly with the Nutella filling in the waffle cone, until I added a topping at no extra cost (I used shredded coconut). It’s simply delicious, and worth trying! I will definitely come back here to satisfy my sweet cravings. I highly recommend it—you’ll love it! It’s already my favorite place around here!
original: Im so glad i found this spot for my sweet tooth cravings! They have the most unique fish shaped waffle with filling thats to die for lol and the frozen yogurt is delish!!! The waffle cookies are freshly made as well as there waffle cones ;-) I got them filled with nutella and they were amazing! The Ube frozen yogurt went amazingly well with the waffle cone nutella filling i even was able to add a topping free of charge ( i got coco flakes) SOOO GOOD ITS A MUST TRY !!!! I will def be coming here for my desert cravings. I highly recommend it too you will love it! new local fav!

text: Um lugar pequeno e agradável, com um belo pátio ao ar livre. Eles variam os sabores. Eu experimentei o café vietnamita com amêndoas e chocolate. Gostaria de experimentar outros sabores e combinações. Eles também oferecem algumas opções diferentes de sorvetes. Além disso, têm biscoitos e doces. Os doces são muito nostálgicos, me lembram da minha infância. Parece que este lugar fica bastante cheio, pois, depois de pedirmos nossos sorvetes, a fila começou a se estender pela porta.
text_en: A small and pleasant place, with a beautiful outdoor patio. They offer various flavors. I tried the Vietnamese coffee with almonds and chocolate. I would like to try other flavors and combinations. They also have several different ice cream options. In addition, they have cookies and desserts. The desserts are very nostalgic; they remind me of my childhood. It seems like the place is quite crowded, as after we ordered our ice creams, the line stretched all the way to the door.
original: Great little place with a nice outdoor patio. They rotate their flavors. I had the Vietnamese Coffee with chocolate almonds. Would like to try other flavors and combinations. They also have a few different options for cones. They also have cookies and candy. The candy is very nostalgic, reminded me of my childhood. Seems like this place gets very crowded because once we got our ice cream the line started to make its way out the door.

text: Eu adoro este restaurante. Sou confeiteiro e descobri este lugar, pois fica perto de casa, na área divertida de NODA, e simplesmente me apaixonei. Amei a decoração, a variedade de produtos, a linda vitrine com todos os deliciosos itens, eles têm chás e bebidas de frutas excelentes, além de uma iluminação muito especial e artística. Experimentei muitas coisas aqui, desde os croissants crocantes e amanteigados, as mini tortas de frutas, e tudo mais. Adoro os pequenos bolinhos de chá, as tortas de chocolate, sempre compro os macarons em diversos sabores, as cores e a variedade são amplas e emocionantes. Eles oferecem opções de refeições, desde saladas frescas e criativas até o que eles chamam de "Tartines", que são sanduíches abertos, e o meu favorito é a torta de figo com bacon e brie. Não consigo contar quantas vezes pedi a quantidade completa e comi tudo de uma vez. Toda vez que vou, aproveito o que pedi e sempre experimento um novo item da vitrine. O único problema para mim é que, se você não chegar neste lugar no horário certo, a fila pode ter 20 pessoas ou mais, embora eles tenham uma equipe razoavelmente grande, não é suficiente para lidar com filas tão longas. Mas você consegue entrar e sair com bom atendimento, comida excelente e muitas coisas para apreciar. Eles têm mesas dentro e fora, e oferecem tudo para levar, e os recipientes são bem pensados, para que a sua comida chegue em casa segura e com ótimo sabor. Eu recomendaria este restaurante a qualquer pessoa que não esteja controlando as calorias, que ama doces e que deseja experimentar novos sabores e gostos. Novamente, este é um lugar popular, e existem alguns locais para visitar. Um novo está chegando em breve, e eles estão chamando-o de sua "loja principal". Mal posso esperar para visitá-lo!
text_en: I love this restaurant. I’m a confectioner, and I discovered this place because it’s close to my home, in the fun area of NODA. I just fell in love with it right away. I really liked the decor, the variety of products, and the beautiful display with all those delicious items. They have excellent fruit teas and drinks, along with very special and artistic lighting. I tried many things here—crunchy croissants, mini fruit cakes, and more. I also love the small tea cakes, chocolate cakes, and always buy macarons in various flavors, colors, and varieties. It’s exciting and diverse. They offer a range of meals, from fresh and creative salads to what they call “Tartines” – open sandwiches. My favorite is fig cake with bacon and brie. I can’t count how many times I ordered a full portion and ate everything at once. Every time I go there, I enjoy everything I order and always try something new from the display. The only problem for me is that if you don’t arrive at the right time, the line might be 20 people or more. Although they have a decent staff, it’s not enough to handle such long lines. But you can enter and leave with good service, excellent food, and many things to enjoy. They have tables inside and outside, and they offer everything to take away. The containers are well-designed so that your food arrives safely and with great taste at home. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who doesn’t want to control their calories, who loves sweets, and who wants to try new flavors and tastes. Again, it’s a popular place, and there are other places to visit. A new restaurant is coming soon, and they call it their “main store”. I can’t wait to visit it!
original: I love this restaurant. I am a pastry chef and came across this spot as it is near my home in the fun area of NODA and just fell in love. I loved the decor, the product selection, the beautiful case with all the goodies, they have great teas and fruit drinks, plus the lighting is very special and artistic. I have tried many things here from the crunchy buttery croissants, the mini fruit tarts and I have had them all, the mini tea cakes, chocolate tarts, i always purchase macaroons in many flavors the colors and selection is wide and exciting. They have meal options from fresh creative salads to what they call Tartines that are open faced sandwiches and my FAVORITE is the Fig with Bacon and Brie I can't tell you how many times I have ordered the full order and ate the whole thing in one sitting. Every time I go I enjoy what I order and always try a new item from their case. The only issue for me is if you do not hit this spot at the right time the line can be 20 or more deep while they do have a decent sized staff it is not enough to always handle the long line. But you do get in and out with good service, great food and many things to look at. They have seating indoor and outside and offer all ToGo and the containers are well thought out and your food gets home safe and sound and tastes great. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone that is not watching their calories, loves pastry, loves sweets and wants to try some new fun tastes and flavors. Again, this is a popular spot and there are a couple locations to check out. A new one is coming soon and they are calling it their "Flagship" shop can't wait to check it out!

text: Eu gostaria de saber quantas vezes já estive aqui. Mas será que algum de nós consegue? Este é um dos meus lugares favoritos para levar convidados que vêm de outras cidades (é claro, durante a temporada). O fato de o sorvete ter o mesmo sabor delicioso que eu tinha quando criança (e, quem sabe, até melhor) é, obviamente, o principal atrativo. Eles sempre têm uma grande variedade de sabores divertidos e todos os tipos de sobremesas de sorvete, desde os clássicos até os mais modernos, e até coisas que não se encontram em outro lugar. Prepare-se para esperar na fila, pois é um lugar muito popular... mas a espera vale a pena!
text_en: I wonder how many times I’ve been here before. But can anyone of us really count that? This is one of my favorite places to bring guests from other cities over (of course, during the season). The fact that the ice cream has the same delicious taste as when I was a child—and maybe even better—is obviously the main attraction. They always have a wide variety of fun flavors and all kinds of ice cream desserts, from classic ones to more modern ones, and even things you don’t find anywhere else. Be prepared to wait in line, because it’s a very popular place… but the wait is worth it!
original: I wish I could count how many times I've been here. Can any of us though? This is one of my favorite places to take guests visiting from out of town (in season of course). The fact that the soft serve tastes as good as it did when I was a kid (if not better) is obviously the main attraction. They always have so many fun flavors and all kinds of different ice cream treats from the classics to the modern and even things you can't get anywhere else. Be prepared to wait online because it's a hugely popular spot...but well worth the wait!

text: Foi absolutamente incrível! Os donuts são enormes! E são tão gostosos quanto parecem!!!
text_en: It was absolutely incredible! The donuts are huge! And they taste just as good as they look!!!
original: It was absolutely amazing! The donuts are huge! And they are just as good as they look!!!

text: A qualidade é excelente. O único ponto negativo é o tempo de espera, pois às vezes ficam muito cheios, mas o atendimento é bom e os sabores e a qualidade do sorvete compensam. Já estamos viciados!
text_en: The quality is excellent. The only negative point is the waiting time, as sometimes it gets very crowded. But the service is good, and the flavors and quality of the ice cream make it worth it. We’re already addicted!
original: The quality is so good. The downside is the wait, and they get busy sometimes, but they're nice here and the flavors and quality of the ice cream are worth it. We're addicted now!

text: Desafortunadamente, en los .3 segundos que tardé en inhalar este increíble sándwich de helado, olvidé tomar una foto. Estoy realmente impresionado, no solo por los sabores, combinaciones y el donut que acompañan al sándwich. Me sorprende genuinamente que alguien como yo, que no es fan de los dulces (¡ni siquiera como mi propio pastel de cumpleaños!), haya descubierto este sándwich de helado. Definitivamente, he encontrado una excepción en esos .3 segundos. Confío en que no se decepcionará. Necesita esto en su vida. ¡Gracias, Novel!
text_en: Unfortunately, in those 0.3 seconds it took me to inhale this amazing ice cream sandwich, I forgot to take a photo. I’m really impressed—not just by the flavors, combinations, and donuts that come with it. It’s truly surprising that someone like me, who isn’t a fan of sweets (not even my own birthday cake!), discovered this ice cream sandwich. Definitely, I’ve found an exception in those 0.3 seconds. I hope you won’t be disappointed. You need this in your life. Thank you, Novel!
original: Unfortunately, by the .3 seconds that I took to inhale this awesome ice cream sandwich, I forgot to post a photo! I'm impressed, not only by the creative flavors, combinations, and doughnut with the sandwich.. I'm genuinely impressed that someone like myself that isn't a fan of sweets at all (I don't even eat my own birthday cake!) I've definitely grown an exception in the .3 seconds it took me to inhale this ice cream sandwich.. don't think about it, just trust me; you won't be disappointed. You need this in your life. Thanks novel!

text: I heard so much about this place, I had such high expectations... I ordered a chocolate cereal milk (milkshake) and it literally tasted like baby food, I couldn't eat it anymore... I had to throw it away. I felt like the people working there didn't know what they were doing. The place is overrated and overpriced, not worth it.
text_en: I heard so much about this place, I had such high expectations... I ordered a chocolate cereal milk (milkshake) and it literally tasted like baby food, I couldn't eat it anymore... I had to throw it away. I felt like the people working there didn't know what they were doing. The place is overrated and overpriced, not worth it.

text: A "cabeça de lagosta" é, na verdade, uma espécie de "pão de creme" mais crocante. É crocante, macio e tem um delicioso creme (novamente, é creme, não creme de confeiteiro) dentro, mas não me impressionou tanto, e não acho que vale a pena esperar na fila só para experimentar novamente. A fila é exagerada, e nem mesmo o seu canoli mais famoso me convenceu a voltar.
text_en: A “shrimp head” is actually a kind of crunchy “cream pie”. It’s crunchy and soft, with a delicious cream inside (again, it’s just cream, not confectionery cream). But it didn’t impress me much, and I don’t think it’s worth waiting in line just to try it again. The line was too long, and even its most famous canoli didn’t convince me to go back.
original: The lobster tail is a basically a crispier cream puff. It's flaky, crispy, and has delicious cream (again, it's cream, not custard) inside, but it didn't blow my mind and I don't think I'd wait in line just to get it again. The line is ridiculous and not even their most famous canoli convinced me to come back.

text: Quiero decirles, fue un verdadero placer descubrir este lugar. Vengo de una familia de panaderos y este lugar me recuerda a mi hogar. ¡Es muy difícil encontrar lugares así! Diría que mi selección favorita son las tartas (especialmente las de nuez). Pronto empezaré a ir a desayunar porque me dijeron que también tienen buenos sándwiches. Es increíble cómo están abiertos durante tanto tiempo y cómo siempre hay gente allí, a cualquier hora de la noche.
text_en: I would like to say that it was truly a pleasure to discover this place. I come from a family of bakers, and this place reminds me of my home. It’s very difficult to find places like this! I would say my favorite item is the cakes—especially those with nuts. I will soon start going there for breakfast, as they also have good sandwiches. It’s amazing how they’re open all the time, and how there’s always people there, at any hour of the night.
original: I tell you what. It was a real treat discovering this place. I come from a Bakery family and this place reminds me of back home. It's very hard to find locations like this! I'd have to say the Tart selection is my favorite (pecan especially). I will soon start stopping for a breakfast sandwich b/c I heard those were good too. Its amazing how long they're open and how people are there at all times of the night.

text: En general, es una panadería increíble, ubicada en una zona imprescindible de Cleveland. A veces, las colas pueden ser largas, y he esperado hasta 30 minutos, pero la comida vale la pena. Una excelente variedad de pasteles y postres más grandes. Creo que la barra de limón es uno de sus mejores postres. Sus canolis son buenos, pero no los mejores que he probado. Si estás en el barrio de Little Italy, definitivamente deberías visitarla.
text_en: Generally, it’s an amazing bakery located in a crucial area of Cleveland. Sometimes, lines can be long; I waited for 30 minutes, but the food is worth it. They offer a great variety of cakes and larger desserts. I think the lemon bar is one of their best desserts. Their cannoli are good, but not the best ones I’ve tried. If you’re in Little Italy neighborhood, you definitely should visit them.
original: Overall, this is an amazing bakery in a must visit part of Cleveland. The lines can get long at times, and I have waited as long as 30 minutes before, but the food is worth it. Excellent assortment of pastries and larger desserts. I think the lemon bar is among their best desserts. Their canolis are good but not the best I've had. If you're in the Little Italy area definitely go visit.

text: A nova localização é ainda MELHOR, pois agora estão abertos por mais tempo. Se eu pudesse dar 6 estrelas, eu daria! De verdade, estou cheio de elogios!
text_en: The new location is even better, as it’s open for longer periods of time now. If I could give it 6 stars, I would! Really, I have so many compliments about it!
original: The new location is even BETTER because they are open longer now. If I could give then 6 stars, I would! I MEAN ALL OF MY SUPERLATIVES!

text: Um pequeno e charmoso sorveteria. Eu comi um sorvete, mas os membros da família pediram sorvete de coco, de nozes e amêndoa, etc. – todos muito cremosos e com um ótimo sabor! Os toques de marshmallow e macaron são vale a pena pedir e adicionam um toque especial ao seu doce!
text_en: A small and charming ice cream shop. I ate some ice cream, but the family members asked for coconut, nut, and almond ice creams, etc. – all very creamy and with great flavors! The touches of marshmallow and macarons are worth ordering; they add a special touch to your dessert!
original: Great little ice cream shop. I had a sorbet but family members ordered the coconut ice cream, butter pecan, etc. very creamy w/ great flavor! Their marshmallow and macaron touches are worth ordering and add nice touch to your dessert!

text: This is the only reason to go to Las Vegas. Who cares about the bright lights, the big buildings, when you can eat delicious ice cream!?!? I went here on a Friday night around 7:30 PM. There were four people working and the line was into the street. However, the line move fairly quickly and even if it was longer I would've waited. I decided on a fourth Cooper sampler which is by and large the best option on the menu. I had blueberry cobbler, chocolate marshmallow, banana cream pie and Keylime pie. The person who took my order was knowledgeable about all of the ice cream's and knew what was in each of them. I like the banana cream pie ice cream the best followed by the Keylime pie followed by the blueberry cobbler and chocolate marshmallow tied. I also thought that the four items sampler was super affordable based on how delicious it was and how much ice cream there with us. There is no reason to ever go to Las Vegas and not stop here for ice cream even if it is a little bit out-of-the-way. The only other tip is to my knowledge there are no bathrooms and there isn't much seating outside so that could be a challenge.

text: TIP: They have an upstairs and downstairs location! Had to say that first because I waited in line downstairs for like 15 minutes. I was heading to Treasure Island so I took the elevator next to Bouchon and found they had another bakery counter upstairs with no line. Anyways, I love love love their macarons. So far it's a tie between the pistachio and salted caramel. They are a little pricey ($5 each) but they're about 2.5x the size of a normal macaron and they're just amazing. My second favorite thing to get here is a vanilla chai latte, goes perfect with a macaron :D. Coffee prices are comparable to starbucks. Sad to say I actually haven't tried anything else here. I really have only been able to come here while taking a long walk on the strip. Again, sad to say I don't ever stay the Venetian hotel where it would be much more convenient.

text: Me considero un experto en pasteles. Carlos no defraudó... a pesar de la gran variedad de opciones y los precios. He ido tres veces en las últimas semanas, y en cada ocasión he pedido galletas de merengue, pastel de fresas y cola de langosta. Si les gustan los pasteles crujientes, cremosos y dulces (¿cómo podrían no gustarles?), entonces tienen que probar la cola de langosta. La crema que hay dentro de este pastel similar a un croissant es perfecta: no es demasiado dulce y es absolutamente deliciosa. El servicio al cliente es excelente, pero tengan paciencia, ya que está ubicado dentro del Venetian.
text_en: I consider myself an expert in pastries. Carlos didn’t disappoint… despite the wide variety of options and prices. I’ve been there three times in the last few weeks, and each time I ordered merengue cookies, strawberry pastries, and lobster tail. If you like crunchy, creamy, and sweet pastries (how could you not like them?), then you must try the lobster tail. The cream inside this pastry, which resembles a croissant, is perfect: it’s not too sweet, and it’s absolutely delicious. The customer service is excellent, but please be patient, as it’s located inside the Venetian.
original: I consider myself a connoisseur of pastries. Carlos didn't disappoint...nevermind the endless selections you have or the prices. I've gone three times in the last few weeks, and each time I get the meringue cookie, strawberry shortcake and LOBSTER TAIL. If you like flaky, crunchy, creamy, and sweet (how could you NOT) you must get a lobster tail. The cream inside this croissant like pastry is perfect, not too sweet and absolutely decadent. Customer service is great...but be ready to wait, as it's located inside the Venetian.

text: Eu venho aqui desde a inauguração e posso dizer que é tudo bem. A padaria tem seus momentos, dependendo do dia em que você visita. A variedade de pães é limitada, e sempre que venho aqui, a maioria dos itens acabam rapidamente. Sou fã de tortas de frutas, e a torta de frutas vermelhas que eles têm aqui é boa. Na última vez que visitei, fiquei impressionado com o chá gelado de morango, pois sempre que vejo esse em outros lugares, tenho receio de experimentar. Tenho medo que ele tenha o gosto do Nesquik! (risos). Surpreendentemente, esse chá acertou no ponto. Ele continha pedaços de morango, o que é um bônus. Os outros chás com leite, honestamente, simplesmente têm o gosto de leite com creme, que não é do meu agrado. Além disso, um dos meus chás favoritos é o café gelado com sal marinho! Recomendo para qualquer amante de café, não é muito forte – é simplesmente o café gelado perfeito para o dia a dia, com um toque de creme de sal marinho. Se estiver calor, recomendo experimentar o chá verde gelado de grapefruit! Esse lugar merece 3 estrelas.
text_en: I’ve been here since the opening, and I can say that everything is fine. The bakery has its ups and downs, depending on which day you visit. The variety of breads is limited, and most items run out quickly whenever I come here. I’m a fan of fruit cakes, and the red fruit cake they serve here is good. The last time I visited, I was impressed by the strawberry cold tea—since I usually avoid trying other places’ cold teas. I’m afraid it might taste like Nesquik! (laughs) Surprisingly, this tea hit the mark. It contains pieces of strawberries, which is a bonus. As for the other teas with milk, honestly, they just taste like milk with cream, which isn’t my favorite. Additionally, one of my favorite teas is cold coffee with sea salt! I recommend it to anyone who loves coffee—it’s not very strong; it’s simply the perfect cold coffee for daily use, with a touch of sea salt cream. If it’s hot, I recommend trying the green grapefruit cold tea! This place deserves 3 stars.
original: I've been going here since the soft opening and all I can say it's ok. The bakery is a hit or miss depending on the day you visit. It is limited with the breads they have and every time I come here and most things run out very fast. I'm a big fan of fruit tarts and the berry one they have here is ok. The last time I came here, I was impressed with the Fresh Strawberry Milk Tea because whenever I see this at other places I am hesitant to try it. I'm afraid it might taste like Nesquik! LOL. Surprisingly, this drink hit the taste buds on the right spot. It included strawberry bits which is a bonus. The rest of their milk teas honestly just taste like half and half milk, which I am not a fan of. Also, a drink I usually get and love is their iced sea salt coffee! I would recommend this for any coffee lovers, it's not too strong-- it's just the perfect everyday iced coffee with a kick of sea salt creme. If it's a hot day, I recommend to try the iced grapefruit green tea! This place deserves a 3 star.

text: La dicotomía entre palomitas de maíz con queso y con caramelo está completamente exagerada. Sin embargo, las palomitas de maíz con queso cheddar y jalapeño son excepcionales. Los "cupcakes" en forma de trufas – especialmente los de boda, los M&Ms y los de nuez pecan – son geniales y, además, no son muy caros, ya que cuestan menos de un dólar cada uno. Estoy deseando probar todas las otras variedades que se mencionan en su página web. Para aquellos que no lo sepan, los "cupcakes" de Grandma Campbell son los mismos que los de Grandma Frieda en el West Side Market. Parece que los propietarios están realizando una reestructuración para mantener la consistencia.
text_en: The dichotomy between popcorn with cheese and with caramel is completely exaggerated. However, popcorn with cheddar cheese and jalapeño is exceptional. The “truffle-shaped cupcakes” – especially those for weddings, M&Ms, and those with pecan nuts – are great, and they’re not very expensive either, costing less than a dollar each. I can’t wait to try all the other varieties mentioned on their website. For those who don’t know, Grandma Campbell’s cupcakes are the same as those made by Grandma Frieda at the West Side Market. It seems like the owners are making some changes to maintain consistency.
original: The dichotomy popcorn - cheese and caramel - is entirely overrated. However, the cheddar cheese jalapeno popcorn is to die for. The cupcake truffles - especially the wedding cake, the M&Ms, and the buckeyes - are great, and not too bad on your wallet at less than a dollar each. I look forward to trying the millions of other flavors listed on their website. For those who don't know, Grandma Campbell's cupcakes are the same as Grandma Frieda's in the West Side Market. Apparently the owners are doing some rebranding for consistency.

text: O Amelies é como o meu refúgio. Eu como lá quase todos os dias da semana. Este lugar é incrível, e os funcionários da unidade no centro são muito simpáticos. Todos estão sempre muito alegres e elogiam muito. Sempre há um funcionário que me informa sobre os novos produtos e guloseimas disponíveis. É um lugar muito agradável para ir e relaxar. Os preços também são razoáveis. Eu sempre tiro as fotos mais bonitas lá!
text_en: Amelies is like my refuge. I eat there almost every day of the week. This place is amazing, and the staff at the center are very friendly. Everyone is always cheerful and gives lots of compliments. There’s always someone who informs me about new products and snacks available. It’s a very pleasant place to go and relax. The prices are also reasonable. I always take the best photos there!
original: Amelies is like my safe place. I eat amelies like every day of the week. This place is awesome and they have the sweetest workers at the uptown location. Everyone is always so happy and full of compliments.. there's always a worker keeping me updated on all the new goodies and Treats that are in. This place is such a comfy place to go to and just relax. The prices aren't bad either. I always take the cutest pictures in there!

text: First of all, the building itself is really quaint and cute. After that you have some pretty delicious hand crafted ice cream! They even have vegan options and ice cream sandwiches. I had the churro ice cream sandwich with french toast ice cream and Ohio maple syrup on top, and that was pretty amazing! The staff is beyond friendly and helpful! Also, they are all about the samples which i love, because you never know if you will truly like something, as good as it may sound. Stop by if you are in the Ohio City, Hingetown area and you wont be disappointed.

text: Este negocio local es uno de nuestros lugares favoritos en la zona para disfrutar de helados. Ofrecen una variedad de sabores únicos. La calidad del helado es fantástica. Mis sabores favoritos son el caramelo salado y el de café expreso (utilizan granos de café recién tostados aquí en Tempe). Si están buscando helados de alta calidad y quieren apoyar a un negocio local, deberían probar Sweet Republic.
text_en: This local shop is one of our favorite places in the area to enjoy ice cream. They offer a variety of unique flavors. The quality of the ice cream is fantastic. My favorite flavors are salty caramel and express coffee flavor (they use freshly toasted coffee beans here in Tempe). If you’re looking for high-quality ice cream and want to support local businesses, you should try Sweet Republic.
original: This local business is one of our favorite places in the area for ice cream. They have an adequate number of unique flavors. The quality of the ice cream is fantastic. My favorite flavors are salted caramel and espresso (has grinder coffee beans freshly roasted here in Tempe). If you are looking for some high quality ice cream and support a local business you need to give sweet republic a try.

text: O sorvete de limão e framboesa estava excelente. Ótimo atendimento, bom serviço e ambiente agradável. Voltaremos ao Oberweis novamente. Recomendo que você experimente.
text_en: The lemon and raspberry ice cream was excellent. Great service, good quality, and a pleasant atmosphere. We will visit Oberweis again. I recommend you give it a try.
original: The lemon blackberry ice cream was excellent. Good staff, good service, good stuff. We be back to Oberweis again. You should check it out

text: Un lugar encantador, con gente amable y excelente servicio. Lo mejor fueron las galletas de macarrones y el malvavisco asado. ¡Es una experiencia que no se puede perder si visitas Scottsdale! Las calles principales son Mc Dowell y Miller. ¡Definitivamente lo recomiendo! A los niños les encantó ver cómo se asaban los malvaviscos directamente delante de ellos. ¡Gracias por este delicioso capricho!
text_en: A wonderful place, with friendly people and excellent service. The best parts were the macaroni cookies and the roasted poppy seeds. It’s an experience you shouldn’t miss if you visit Scottsdale! The main streets are Mc Dowell and Miller. I definitely recommend it! The kids loved seeing how the poppy seeds were roasted right in front of them. Thank you for this delicious treat!
original: Hidden Jewel nice people great ! The Best was the macaroon cookie and the fired marshmallow. A must try when in Scottsdale! Mc Dowell and Miller is the cross streets. It's truly a recommendation! The kids loved seeing the marshmallows fired right in front of them. Thanks for the treat today!

text: Always wanted to try this place but the lines were always so long. We lucked out on this day as there wasn't a line so we walked in and ordered the 4 pc cake deal for 26 bucks We got a red velvet, a chocolate, a confetti birthday, and a rainbow cake with strawberry frosting. Cakes were good, I think the chocolate was made on site, the rest were in a sealed container so north sure They were all yummy

text: ¡Guau, estoy enamorada! Me encanta que Las Vegas tenga un lugar así. Me recuerda a algo que verías en un pueblo más pequeño y en la costa este. Me encantan estos pequeños lugares de helados. La mejor oferta es la degustación de cuatro sabores. ¡Obtienes cuatro porciones de helado por solo $4.25! ¡Qué ganga! Compré esta y probé helado de galleta con chispas de chocolate, de pistacho, de chocolate con mantequilla de cacahuete y otro sabor a mantequilla de cacahuete, ¡pero el nombre se me escapa! (¡ay, perdón!) Me encantó el de pistacho, sin duda, uno de mis sabores favoritos. Este lugar no tiene espacio interior, así que prepárate para esperar afuera. También puede estar muy concurrido: la última vez que fui, tuve que esperar más de media hora. Sería ideal que tuvieran más personal para atender a tanta gente, ya que la última vez solo había dos personas trabajando.
text_en: Wow, I’m in love! I really like that Las Vegas has such a place. It reminds me of something you might find in a smaller town along the East Coast. I love these small ice cream spots. The best offer is the four-flavor tasting – you get four servings of ice cream for just $4.25! What a deal! I bought this and tried the cookie with chocolate chips, pistachio, chocolate with peanut butter, and another flavor with peanut butter too… but I can’t remember the name! (Oh, sorry!) I really liked the pistachio flavor; it’s definitely one of my favorite flavors. This place doesn’t have any indoor space, so be prepared to wait outside. It can also be very crowded – the last time I went, I had to wait over half an hour. It would be great if they had more staff to serve all the people, since last time there were only two people working.
original: Omg in love! I love that Vegas has a place like this. It reminds me something you would see in a smaller town and back on the East coast. I love little ice cream places like this. The best deal is the four scoop sampler. You get four scoops of ice cream for $4.25! What a steal. I got this and tried chocolate chip cookie dough, pistachio, chocolate peanut butter and another peanut butter flavor but the name escapes me! (oops :) ) I loved the pistachio-one of my favorite flavors for sure. There is no inside to this place so be prepared to wait outside. It also can be very busy-I waited over a half hour last time I was there. It would be nice if they were better staffed to accommodate the large crowds because last time they only had two people working.

text: Eu estava realmente animado para experimentar o Milk Bar. Assisti a um programa chamado "The Mind of a Chef" há algum tempo, e as partes com Christina Tosi foram as minhas favoritas. Nós não temos um Milk Bar aqui em Vancouver, então quando descobri que havia um em Las Vegas, eu disse à minha irmã que precisávamos ir lá antes de ir embora para comprar alguns biscoitos para levar para casa. Minha irmã e eu fizemos uma parada especial no Cosmopolitan, apenas para eles. Eu comprei um de cada tipo: biscoito de composto, cream cheese com mirtilo, marshmallow de milho com chocolate, biscoito de chocolate duplo e biscoito de milho. Eles não eram baratos, para ter certeza, e, considerando a taxa de câmbio, eram ainda mais caros. Por isso, eu tinha grandes expectativas. No entanto, fiquei um pouco nervoso ao vê-los pré-embalados e não assados no local, mas esperei o melhor. Infelizmente, fiquei decepcionado. Compartilhei os biscoitos com meu marido e meus pais. Entre todos eles, o biscoito de composto foi o meu preferido, mas não era nada de especial. Talvez fosse porque eu esperava um pouco de crocância dos pedaços de pretzel e batata palha, mas havia quase nenhuma crocância. O segundo biscoito que mais gostei foi o de milho, mas eu teria preferido um sabor de milho mais forte e talvez alguma textura de farinha de milho. O biscoito de mirtilo estava ok. Era macio, o que era bom, mas simplesmente tinha um sabor muito doce e os mirtilos pareciam artificiais para mim (nós temos bastante mirtilo fresco durante todo o verão). O biscoito de chocolate duplo não gostei nada. Eu já asso a receita do Tartine Bakery para biscoitos de centeio com chocolate salgado. É um biscoito de chocolate muito bom. Este biscoito não tinha nenhum sabor profundo e simplesmente tinha gosto de cacau com um sabor amargo que não conseguia tirar da boca. O marshmallow de milho com chocolate foi bom. Os milhos adicionaram um pouco de crocância e os marshmallows me fizeram lembrar da minha infância, porque tinham um sabor parecido com os marshmallows que encontramos em cereais. Quem sabe... talvez, se fossem assados frescos, direto do forno, a história seria diferente. Mas, infelizmente, o sabor não correspondeu às expectativas (ou ao preço).
text_en: I was really excited to try the Milk Bar. I watched a program called “The Mind of a Chef” some time ago, and the parts with Christina Tosi were my favorites. We don’t have a Milk Bar here in Vancouver, so when I heard there was one in Las Vegas, I told my sister that we should go there before leaving to buy some cookies to take home. My sister and I made a special stop at the Cosmopolitan just for them. I bought each type of cookie: compound cookie, cream cheese with raspberries, corn marshmallow with chocolate, double chocolate cookie, and corn cookie. They weren’t cheap, and considering the exchange rate, they were even more expensive. So, I had high expectations. However, I felt a little nervous when I saw them packaged neatly but not baked on site, but I hoped for the best. Unfortunately, I was disappointed. I shared the cookies with my husband and parents. Among all the cookies, the compound cookie was my favorite, but it wasn’t anything special. Maybe it’s because I expected some crunch from the pretzel and cornstarch pieces, but there was almost no crunch at all. The second cookie I liked the most was the corn one, but I would have preferred a stronger corn flavor and maybe some texture from corn flour. The raspberry cookie was okay. It was soft, which was good, but it just tasted very sweet, and the raspberries seemed artificial to me (we have plenty of fresh raspberries throughout summer). The double chocolate cookie didn’t appeal to me at all. I already know the recipe from Tartine Bakery for rye chocolate cookies with salted chocolate. It’s a great chocolate cookie. This cookie didn’t have any deep flavor; it just tasted like cocoa with a bitter taste that couldn’t be removed from my mouth. The corn marshmallow with chocolate was good. The corn added some crunch, and the marshmallows reminded me of my childhood, because they had a flavor similar to those found in cereal. Who knows… maybe if they were baked fresh, right out of the oven, the story would be different. But unfortunately, the taste didn’t meet expectations (or the price).
original: I was really excited to try Milk Bar. I watched The Mind of a Chef awhile back and my favorite segments were of Christina Tosi. We don't have a Milk Bar here in Vancouver and so when I found out there was one in Las Vegas I told my sister that we HAD to go there before we leave to pick up some cookies to take home. My sister and I made a special stop at Cosmopolitan just for them. I bought one of each kind: compost cookie, blueberry cream cheese, chocolate cornflake marshmallow, double chocolate, and corn. They weren't cheap that's for sure and with the exchange rate even more so. Thus I had some high expectations. I was a bit nervous though seeing them pre-packaged and not baked on site but hoped for the best. I was sadly disappointed. I shared the cookies with my husband and parents. Out of all of them I preferred the compost cookie but it was meh at best. Maybe it was because I was expecting a bit of crunch from the pretzel and potato chip pieces but there was barely any crunch. Second favorite was the corn cookie, but had wished for a stronger corn flavour and maybe some texture from cornmeal. The blueberry cookie was okay. It was soft which was nice, but it just tasted really sweet and the blueberries tasted fake to me (we're a bit spoiled here with fresh blueberries all summer long). The double chocolate cookie I did not like at all. I've baked Tartine Bakery's recipe for salted chocolate rye cookies. That is a damn good chocolate cookie. This cookie lacked any depth of flavour and just tasted like cocoa with a bitter after taste (if that makes sense) that I could not get out of my mouth. The chocolate cornflake marshmallow was good. The cornflakes added a bit of crunch and the marshmallows took me back to my childhood because it tasted a bit like the marshmallows you found in cereal. Who knows...maybe if they were fresh baked, right out of the oven, it would be a different story. But, unfortunately the taste did not live up to the hype (or the price).

text: Solo he estado aquí una vez, pero el helado era delicioso y los sabores eran originales y variados. Pedí dos sabores: Nutella y fresa. La fresa era increíble, con sabores dulces y refrescantes. La Nutella tenía un sabor un poco más suave; parecía que tenía un ligero toque de Nutella. En realidad, se parecía más al sabor del "chocolate frosty" de Wendy's que al sabor intenso de chocolate y avellanas que esperaba. Sin embargo, tenía una textura excelente.
text_en: I’ve only been here once, but the ice cream was delicious, and the flavors were original and diverse. I ordered two flavors: Nutella and strawberry. The strawberry flavor was incredible, with sweet and refreshing tastes. The Nutella flavor was a bit milder; it seemed to have a slight Nutella taste. In fact, it resembled more the “Chocolate Frosty” from Wendy’s than the intense chocolate and hazelnut flavor I expected. However, its texture was excellent.
original: I've only been here once but the ice cream was rich and the flavors were creative and expansive. I ordered two flavors: Nutella and strawberry. The strawberry was amazing, sweet and refreshing flavors. The Nutella was a little muted; it tasted vaguely of Nutella. It was much closer to the flavor of a Wendy's chocolate frosty than the rich hazelnut chocolate flavor I wanted. Still, it had great mouthfeel.

text: ¡Soy un gran fan de Mason's Creamery! Me encanta que tengan una variedad de sabores únicos y diferentes a los típicos. Siempre disfruto visitando para probar nuevos sabores. Me encantó el helado de ube, que tiene un sabor sutilmente dulce y cremoso. La última vez, probé el helado de caramelo salado: no es demasiado extravagante, pero no pude resistirme al sabor salado que contrasta con la dulzura del caramelo. Es uno de mis favoritos. También vi en Facebook que a veces tienen una tienda de ramen temporal. Aún no he ido, pero he escuchado opiniones mixtas de amigos que sí han ido, pero me encantaría probarlo cuando esté disponible. El ambiente de este lugar es encantador y moderno. Es una pequeña heladería con muchos asientos al aire libre. Vi que han abierto una zona en la parte trasera con mesas largas bajo una carpa con luces bonitas. También me gusta mucho el tipo de cucharas de plástico que usan para servir el helado: ¡cambian de color según la temperatura!
text_en: I’m a huge fan of Mason’s Creamery! I love that they offer a variety of unique flavors that are different from the usual ones. I always enjoy visiting to try new flavors. I really liked the berry ice cream—it has a subtle sweet and creamy taste. The last time I went there, I tried the salty caramel ice cream: it isn’t too fancy, but I couldn’t resist the salty flavor that contrasts with the sweetness of the caramel. It’s one of my favorite items. I also saw on Facebook that they sometimes have a temporary ramen shop. I haven’t been there yet, but I’ve heard mixed opinions from friends who have visited. I would love to try it when it’s available. The atmosphere at this place is charming and modern. It’s a small ice cream shop with many outdoor seats. I noticed they’ve set up a area at the back with long tables under a canopy with nice lights. I also really like the plastic spoons they use to serve the ice cream—they change color depending on the temperature!
original: Huge fan of Mason's Creamery!!! I love that they have a variety of flavors that are unique and not your typical. I always love coming to try out new flavors they have. I really liked the ube ice cream and its subtly sweet and smooth flavor. Last time I got the salted caramel - it's not too out there but I couldn't resist the salty flavor against the sweetness of the caramel. It's one of my favorites. I also saw on facebook that they sometimes have a pop-up ramen shop! I haven't gone myself and I've heard mixed reviews from friends who have went, but I would really like to check it out at some point when they have it. The aesthetic of this place is cute and trendy. It's a small ice cream shop with lots of outdoor seating. I saw that they just opened up in area in the back with long tables under a tent with cute lights. I also really like the plastic spoons they serve the ice cream with - they change color depending on the temperature!!

text: Ambiente familiar excelente y gente amable. La comida también era muy buena. Pedimos el "Fat Elvis", el "samoa freezi" y el "s'mores sundae". El "Fat Elvis" y el "s'mores" valieron la pena. Mi esposa no volvería a pedir el "samoa", pero sí disfrutó del delicioso sabor a coco tostado (no le gustaron las galletas/caramelo que venían en él).
text_en: Excellent family atmosphere and friendly people. The food was also very good. We ordered the “Fat Elvis”, “Samoa Freezi”, and “S’mores Sundae”. The “Fat Elvis” and “S’mores” were worth it. My wife wouldn’t order “Samoa” again, but she enjoyed the delicious roasted coconut flavor (she didn’t like the cookies/caramel that came with it).
original: Great family atmosphere and friendly people. Food was great also. We got the "Fat Elvis" sundae, samoa freezi, and smores sundae. Fat elvis and smores were worth it. My wife wouldnt get the samoa again, but it had a great toasted coconut taste (didnt like the cookie/caramel in it).

text: Resumo: A comida é excelente, o café estava delicioso, mas a experiência do cliente/tempo de espera é péssima. Fui aqui com alguns amigos e cada um pediu um café e um sanduíche, além de alguns doces. Os doces foram oferecidos quando pedimos, pois acabavam de sair do forno, o que faz sentido. Os cafés que pedimos estavam deliciosos, mas quando a barista os entregou (um de cada vez), ela confundiu três deles, dizendo "este é de caramelo, sem leite", quando na verdade continham leite, etc. No final, depois de um pouco de "jogo do café", todos conseguimos identificar qual era qual. Todos os itens que pedimos estavam muito saborosos, incluindo o sanduíche de carne assada, o sanduíche de frango com tomate seco, um sanduíche de salsicha, ovo e queijo, e uma quiche de bacon. No entanto, esperamos literalmente cerca de 40 minutos para que a comida fosse preparada. Além disso, como é um local sem mesas devido à pandemia, não há assentos internos. Se for óbvio que as pessoas estão se acumulando esperando pela comida, deveria haver algum tipo de sistema de notificação, como um toque ou mensagem, para que você seja avisado quando a sua comida estiver pronta. Isso seria razoável para uma melhor experiência do cliente em geral, e, com a pandemia, ajudaria a reduzir o tempo em que as pessoas ficam em um espaço pequeno, esperando para serem chamadas.
text_en: Summary: The food is excellent, and the coffee was delicious. However, the customer experience and waiting time are terrible. I went here with some friends—each of us ordered a coffee, a sandwich, and some desserts. The desserts were served right when we ordered them, since they had just come out of the oven, which makes sense. The coffees we ordered were also great. But when the barista delivered them one by one, she mixed up three of them, saying “this is caramel, no milk,” when in fact they contained milk. In the end, after a bit of “coffee game,” we all managed to figure out which ones were which. All the items we ordered were very tasty, including the grilled meat sandwich, the chicken sandwich with dried tomatoes, a sausage sandwich, egg and cheese sandwich, and a bacon quiche. However, we actually waited about 40 minutes for the food to be prepared. Additionally, since there are no tables due to the pandemic, there are no seats inside. If it’s obvious that people are waiting in line, there should be some kind of notification system, like a tap or message, so you’re informed when your food is ready. This would help improve the overall customer experience, and during the pandemic, it would also reduce the time people spend in a small space waiting to be called.
original: Summary: Food is great, coffee was delicious, the customer experience/wait time is atrocious. Went here with a few friends and we each got a coffee and a sandwich along with some pastries. The pastries were given to us as we ordered because they just came out of the case, which makes sense. The coffees we ordered were all tasty, but when the barista gave them to us (one at a time) she misspoke to 3 of them which was which. Meaning she stated "this is caramel, no milk" when it in fact did have milk in it, etc. Eventually after playing some coffee roulette we all figured out which was which. All the food we ordered were very tasty which included the roast beef sandwich, the sun-dried tomato chicken sandwich, a build your own sausage, egg, and cheese, and a piece of bacon quiche. However, we literally waited about 40 minutes for the food to be made. And its not a sit down place due to covid so there is only seating outside. If its obvious that people are piling up waiting for their food, there should be some type of buzzer or text confirmation where you can get notified that your food is ready. This is both reasonable for a better customer experience in general but with covid, it would help alleviate people standing in a small space waiting for their name to be called for 30+ minutes.

I hoped the donuts there would be a little drier, since they’re located in a zoo, but they weren’t.

I had expected donuts there to be slightly stale, being out at the zoo, but they weren't.

text: Ironic that I'm giving Bouchon BAKERY such high marks, considering I am NOT a fan of Bouchon restaurant (eaten there twice and not impressed nor satisfied both times). I have yet to try the MUCH reviewed macarons here. However, this is what I have tried: 1. Strawberry croissant...AWESOME. Fresh made strawberry jam inside a buttery, flaky croissant that's dusted with confectioner's sugar.. Not TOO sweet IMO and OH SO enjoyable. 2. Chocoloate Bouchon...Imagine the best brownie you ever ate, but more moist and less dense; then add some semi sweet chocolate chips in the middle, dust it off with some confectioner's sugar and you have a chocolate Bouchon. They clearly used a very high quality dark chocolate, could be a Valrhona 60%+ dark baking chocolate. Who knows? But I do know that I will be buying more of these bit sized treats. 3. Almond Brioche...The edges have a slightly stale and burnt taste to them. While some may prefer this texture and flavor combination, I did not. After discarding the edges, I was left with an amazing piece of soft and moist brioche bread with a wonderful almond paste and sliced almonds. I thoroughly enjoyed it. 4. Pretzel sticks...Personally, I love pretzels and pretzel bread. So while this was nothing special, I still enjoyed it quite a bit. If I could take it home and heat it up in the oven and dip it in some great mustard or cheese dip...then it would be GREAT! There are still many things I plan to try soon, will update this as I try them.

text: Todo shopping precisa de um lugar como o Eataly. A La Pasticceria é a seção de doces, com opções como tiramisu, tortas de frutas e cannolis. Fui lá no meu último dia em Las Vegas para tomar um café, pois estava exausto. Todas as bebidas de café estavam disponíveis quentes ou geladas, e tinham três tamanhos diferentes. Em termos de preço, era um pouco mais caro que a Starbucks, com um café gelado no menor tamanho custando US$ 4,90 (antes dos impostos). No entanto, a qualidade era excelente. Era forte, suave e cremoso. Além disso, eles tinham canudos de papel disponíveis. Las Vegas ainda está um pouco atrás em relação às suas iniciativas de conservação (sem coleta seletiva), então os canudos de papel são um passo positivo.
text_en: Any shopping trip needs a place like Eataly. La Pasticceria is the dessert section, offering options like tiramisu, fruit cakes, and cannoli. I went there on my last day in Las Vegas to have a coffee, as I was very tired. All coffee drinks were available hot or cold, and there were three different sizes. In terms of price, it was slightly more expensive than Starbucks—a cold coffee in the smallest size cost $4.90 (before taxes). However, the quality was excellent: strong, smooth, and creamy. Additionally, they had paper straws available. Las Vegas still falls short in terms of conservation efforts (no recycling), so paper straws are a positive step.
original: Every mall needs an Eataly for real. La Pasticceria is the pastry section with things like tiramisu, fruit tarts, and cannolis. I came by on my last day in Vegas for a caffeine pick me up because I was exhausted. All of their espresso drinks came in hot or iced and had 3 sizes to them. Price-wise it was slightly more than starbucks with their iced latte in the smallest available size being a 12oz for $4.90 before taxes. It was very good though. Strong, smooth, and creamy. As a bonus they had paper straws available. Vegas is kind of behind with respect to their conservation initiatives (no separate recyclables) so the paper straw is a nice step.

text: Don't hate me but I much prefer a cookie or a brownie over a cupcake but I have to tell you right now that if I must have a cupcake...I'm going to Sprinkles. Luckily there is a location in Chicago!!! When I woke up on my first morning in Vegas, I saw the new High Roller Ferris Wheel and thought it was the coolest thing I have seen on the strip in a long time! My colleague and I were looking for something to do after dinner one night and he suggested the new Ferris wheel. I didn't really realize the shear size of it until I got closer. I think it was about half way down the Linq right around Sprinkles. I made a mental note of the place on our way to the Ferris wheel and after our insane ride up there, I needed a little something sweet to nibble on so I suggested we stop at Sprinkles on our way back. He had already eaten dessert so I was on my own, but didn't hesitate to walk in here to explore what they have to offer. I noticed an array of ice cream flavors and the line out the door for the ice cream and I jumped in line for a cupcake. I glanced at what they had left and since I couldn't decide what to order, I went for the classic Black & White....a chocolate cupcake with vanilla icing and chocolate sprinkles. I asked for it to-go and received it in a brown bag with a wooden fork attached with a sticker. It was adorable!! I actually had to take a photo on site. The girls behind the counter were just as sweet as can be. They were so kind and friendly. These are the kind of customer service people that belong in a cupcake shop!! All smiles, giggles and they knew cupcakes!! Trust me, I quizzed them. ;) I also grabbed a bottle of water while I was there and my total was about $5 or so. Not bad for a quick snack on the strip! When I got back to my hotel room, I ate my cupcake in bed like a little kid. It was delicious. Very fresh, but there was a slight bit too much frosting, if I have one complaint. I will definitely hit up the cupcake ATM in Chicago next time we're in the city. I have heard all about it from friends and now that I have experienced Sprinkles, I gotta take the hubs!

text: I was very underwhelmed with my latest purchase from Page. The Hot Nancy B - a great concept with warm chocolate chip cookies, hot fudge, ice cream, and whipped cream - suffered greatly from a lack of execution in three of the four components. Page continues to have the best texture of soft serve ice cream around, hands down. The flavor and sweetness were lacking which provided a very weak base for the rest of the sundae. The fudge, although deep and luxurious in appearance, again lacked flavor... it's amazing what a little salt and sugar could do to transform this into something great. The whipped cream is left unsweetened... this is a great concept to contrast a sundae that is exceptionally sweet, but in this application it simply fell flat. The cookies were far and away the best component... a thick and crispy exterior with large, melting gobs of chocolate inside and a balanced sweetness to contrast the thick, velvety ice cream. This will not prevent me from returning, but I hope the next time is a bit more satisfying.

original: how can you go wrong with a french bakery!? salted caramel brownies are the jam from here but i like to try different things every time...and also get the salted caramel brownie...sinful!! :)

text: Melhor...padaria...de todos os tempos...Eu nunca imaginei que gastaria US$ 50,00 em doces. Ainda não experimentei as outras duas filiais, mas a preparação cuidadosa e a grande variedade de opções (os pratos especiais mudavam diariamente) fizeram deste um ótimo café da manhã.
text_en: The best… bakery… of all time… I never imagined I’d spend $50 on sweets. I haven’t tried the other two branches yet, but the careful preparation and wide range of options (the special dishes changed daily) make this a great breakfast.
original: Greatest...Bakery...Ever...I never thought I'd spend $50.00 for pastries. I've not yet tried the other two branches; however, the meticulous preparation and the vast array of offerings (their specials changed markedly each day) made this a terrific breakfast.

text: Sorvete, nós gritamos, e todos nós gritamos por Rewind Ice Cream!! Adoro o sorvete fresco, feito sob encomenda aqui. Meu favorito é o de aveia com mel e biscoito de mel. Meus filhos adoram tudo! Dessa vez, experimentei o de matcha e não fiquei desapontada. Ambiente muito relaxante e a parede de plantas é, obviamente, perfeita para fotos no Instagram! Eles também têm bebidas. Eu também gosto, não é muito doce, então prefiro o de coco com matcha. O limonada de borboleta é muito bonita, mas certifique-se de misturar bem a bebida, caso contrário, o xarope estará no fundo.
text_en: Ice cream! We shouted, and we all shouted for Rewind Ice Cream!! I love fresh ice cream that’s made to order here. My favorite is the oats with honey and honey cookies. My kids love everything! This time, I tried the matcha version, and I wasn’t disappointed. The atmosphere is very relaxing, and the plant wall is obviously perfect for Instagram photos! They also have drinks. I like them too—they’re not too sweet, so I prefer the coconut with matcha version. The butterfly lemonade looks really nice, but make sure to mix it well, otherwise, the syrup will end up at the bottom.
original: Ice cream, you scream we all scream for Rewind Ice Cream!! I love the fresh made to order ice cream here. My favorite is the honey bunches of oats with honey teddy graham. My boys love it all! This time I tried their matcha and it did not disappoint. Very laid back atmosphere and the greenery wall is of course IG perfect! They also have drinks. I like again, not overly sweet so I prefer the coconut with matcha. The butterfly lemonade is very pretty but make sure you mix the drink well or else the syrup is at the bottom.

text: He escuchado muchas cosas sobre lo buenas que son sus galletas, gracias a mis amigos que disfrutan horneando, así que me emocioné al encontrar la barra de galletas y helado mientras paseaba por el Strip. El helado era muy tentador, pero no era una opción, ya que la cena estaba a menos de una hora, pero el personal aquí fue muy amable e incluso me ofreció una muestra. El helado estaba definitivamente delicioso, pero también un poco caro. Opté por comprar algunas galletas porque podía llevarlas conmigo, y compré una galleta de compost, una de galletas de copos de maíz, chocolate y malvaviscos, y una de arándanos y crema. Tenga en cuenta que las galletas son más baratas si se compran 3 o más (3 por $3 o 3 por $8)! La galleta de compost fue mi favorita de las tres. Dulce y salada, con muchas texturas y sabores diferentes en una sola galleta. ¡Delicioso! A mi esposa le gustó más la de copos de maíz, chocolate y malvaviscos. A ambos nos pareció que la de arándanos y crema era un poco demasiado cremosa y no tan sabrosa como las otras dos, en nuestra opinión.
text_en: I’ve heard many things about how good their cookies are, thanks to my friends who enjoy baking. So I was excited when I found the cookie and ice cream stand while strolling along the Strip. The ice cream was very tempting, but it wasn’t an option, as dinner was less than an hour away. However, the staff here were very kind and even offered me a sample. The ice cream was definitely delicious, but also a bit expensive. I decided to buy some cookies since I could take them with me. I bought a compost cookie, a cornflake cookie, chocolate cookie, and a raisin and cream cookie. Keep in mind that cookies are cheaper if you buy 3 or more (3 for $3 or 3 for $8)! The compost cookie was my favorite of the three. Sweet and salty, with many different textures and flavors in just one cookie. Delicious! My wife preferred the cornflake, chocolate, and raisin cookie. Both of us thought the raisin and cream cookie was a little too creamy and not as flavorful as the other two, in our opinion.
original: I've heard a lot about how good their cookies are from my cookie loving friends who enjoy baking, so I was excited to run across the cookie/soft serve bar while walking around the Strip. The soft serve was very tempting, but it wasn't an option, given the fact that dinner was less than 1 hour away, but the staff here was very nice and even gave me a sample taste. The soft serve was definitely tasty but a little pricey as well. I opted to buy some cookies since I could take them with me and I got a compost cookie, cornflake-choco chip-marshmallow cookie, and the blueberry & cream cookie. Note that the cookies are cheaper if you buy 3 or more ($3 each or 3 for $8)! Compost cookie was my favorite of the 3. Sweet and salty, so many different textures and flavors all in one cookie. Yum! My wife enjoyed the cornflake-chocolate chip-marshmallow one the best. We were both lukewarm on the blueberry and cream, a little too creamy and not as flavorful as the other two in our opinion.

text: Always loved going to their San Diego location when I lived there. Perfect place to grab pastries for any gathering. All their pastries are made fresh (fresh bread!!!) and kept in display boxes for you to grab with tongs. My favorite things to grab there are the ube breads, chocolate, and their hot dog rolls. Sorry I'm not sure of the exact names but it's pretty self explanatory. They do have a selection of drinks as well to help wash down all their delicacies. Unfortunately the location they are at in China town smells of fresh sewage which severely takes away from the sweet aromas that should engulf you when you walk home. Other then that, some of the workers are a bit rude, even the supervisor (it says so on her badge) gave me attitude because I couldn't hear her through her mask. #covidperks other then that, I'll still come here when I'm in the area to treat myself to a few pastries and try not to over do it.
