text: Sim, voltamos à inconsistência. Alguns produtos podem ser mais difíceis de preparar do que outros. Tenho tido experiências negativas com outros estabelecimentos devido às minhas avaliações, MAS não tive nenhuma experiência negativa com eles. E gostaria de manter essa situação. Se eles servem algo e não gostar, eles corrigem. Eles se esforçam para fazer um bom trabalho. E eu entendo. É algo feito em casa e servido à mão, então nem todos os produtos podem ser perfeitamente iguais. Mas é frustrante comprar um pote ou uma jarra ou algumas porções e chegar em casa e perceber que não é o que você esperava. A avaliação geral de 4,5 estrelas mostra que muitas pessoas *estão* satisfeitas, então leve minha avaliação com cautela. Se o sabor parece atraente, experimente (especialmente na terça-feira) e *você* provavelmente vai gostar. Esta avaliação reflete apenas minhas impressões – não deve ter mais peso do que as inúmeras avaliações de 5 estrelas para este local.
text_en: Yes, we’re back to inconsistency. Some products may be more difficult to prepare than others. I’ve had negative experiences with other establishments due to my reviews, but I haven’t had any negative experiences with them. And I would like to keep this situation the same. If they serve something that isn’t good, they correct it. They try their best to do a good job. I understand that it’s homemade and served on the spot, so not all products can be perfectly identical. But it’s frustrating to buy a pot or jar of food, get home, and find out that it’s not what you expected. The overall rating of 4.5 stars shows that many people are satisfied, so take my review with a grain of salt. If the taste seems appealing, give it a try (especially on Tuesday), and you’ll probably like it. This review reflects only my impressions – it shouldn’t carry more weight than the numerous 5-star reviews for this place.
original: Yeah it's back to inconsistency. Some mixes must be harder to get right than others. I've had bad interactions with other businesses because of my lackluster reviews BUT I haven't had a bad interaction with them. And I'd like to keep it that way. If they serve you something, and it's not to your liking, they'll fix it. They try to do a good job. And I get it. It's homemade and hand-scooped so all the servings can't be uniformly good. But it's frustrating to buy a quart or a pint or some scoops and get home and it not be what you wanted. The 4.5 star overall rating shows that plenty of ppl *are* getting what they want so take my review with a grain of salt. If the flavor sounds appealing try it (especially on Tuesday) and *you* will probably like it. This review is just a reflection of how I feel - not a anything that should carry more weight than the multitude of five star reviews for this spot.

text: Este lugar tiene los sabores de helado más increíbles y un personal muy amable y atento. ¡Estoy muy contento de estar a solo 5 minutos de este lugar, porque Handel's es el mejor!
text_en: This place has the most incredible ice cream flavors, and the staff is very friendly and attentive. I’m really happy to be just 5 minutes away from this place, because Handel’s is the best!
original: This place has the most amazing icecream flavors and such an awesome friendly staff!! I'm so glad I'm within 5min of this place because Handel's is the best!

text: I've received a few recommendations from friends about this spot! It's close to my home but slightly off the main Central shopping area. You'll see it on the other side of hwy 74. The shop itself is small, cute, and smells incredible! Park in the open gravel lot and enjoy your pastries on the picnic tables, no inside seating. The employees were helpful when I shared it was my first time and wanted to try the "favorites". They recommended the tiramisu, lemon bar, s'mores bar, or slice of cheesecake. There was cookies, puff pastries filled with cream, brownies, macarons, and more! I wanted everything. The lemon bar was great, the s'mores bar was del delicious, and the lobster tail was awesome! I can't wait to come back and try more.

text: Ice cream was great. Price not so much, but I guess that is what happens when you ask for homemade ice cream. I ordered 7 "Dips" of ice cream expecting a solid amount but that was not the case. No matter how I look at it, I feel gypped. It felt like just barely one scoop from the Sugar Bowl in comparison. That is my only gripe. If you are looking for great homemade ice cream this is the spot, but expect to pay for it. Sadly, I don't think I will be back but it was definitely worth a try.

text: Esta reseña se centra principalmente en el "vaso de galletas". Es extremadamente caro. Entiendo, pero es bastante pequeño, especialmente en comparación con otras fotos que se muestran aquí en Yelp. Además, solo es un lado de la galleta de macaron, así que debería ser menos caro. Podría haber comprado una porción grande en Cold Stone y me habría sentido mucho más feliz. El "marshmallow" (o "nata de caramelo") es demasiado salado. Ni siquiera creo que haya notado dulzura, solo sal. Así que simplemente lo devolvimos. Por lo tanto, si no te gustan los dulces salados como a mí, no lo compres. La persona que trabajaba allí fue amable y servicial, y el helado estuvo bastante bien, pero el "marshmallow" básicamente arruinó la experiencia para mí. Un dato adicional: ¿por qué un café de 16 onzas cuesta $3.25? Eso es más de lo que cobra Starbucks, y este no es un lugar especializado en café, así que no debería ser tan caro.
text_en: This review mainly focuses on the “biscuit cup”. It’s extremely expensive. I understand, but it’s quite small, especially compared to the other photos shown on Yelp. Moreover, it’s just one side of the macaron biscuit, so it should be less expensive. I could have bought a larger portion at Cold Stone, and I would have been much happier. The “marshmallow” (or “caramel custard”) is too salty. I don’t even think there was any sweetness; just salt. So we simply returned it. Therefore, if you don’t like salty sweets like me, don’t buy it. The person who worked there was kind and helpful, and the ice cream was pretty good, but the “marshmallow” basically ruined my experience. Another thing: why does a 16-ounce coffee cost $3.25? That’s more than what Starbucks charges, and this isn’t a specialty coffee place, so it shouldn’t be so expensive.
original: This review is more for the cookie cup. It's crazy expensive. I get it, but it's kinda small especially like someone else had said about comparing it to other photos here on yelp. Also, it's only one side of the macaron cookie so it should be less. I could've gotten a huge scoop at cold stone and would've been sooo much happier. The marshmallow is so salty. I don't even think I tasted any sweetness to it, just salt. We just took it off. So if you don't like salty sweet like me, don't get it. The lady working was nice and helpful and ice cream was pretty good but the marshmallow basically ruined this for me. Side note, why the heck is a 16oz coffee $3.25?!? That's more than what Starbucks charges and this is no hipster specialized coffee brewing place, should not be that much.

text: Entonces, ¿cuándo podremos encontrar uno en Detroit? Descubrimos este lugar después de ir al West Side Market, y aunque ambos estábamos llenos, decidimos parar a tomar un helado. ¡La mejor decisión! Tienen una buena selección de helados, y se sirven a la temperatura perfecta... ligeramente derretidos para que se puedan apreciar todos los sabores. Yo pedí el doble de chocolate, que tenía grandes trozos de chocolate. Además de tener un helado excelente, la tienda es muy encantadora, e incluso puedes sentarte y observar cómo preparan el helado en la parte de atrás.
text_en: So, when can we find one in Detroit? We discovered this place after visiting the West Side Market. Although both places were full, we decided to stop by for an ice cream. It was the best decision! They have a great selection of ice creams, and they’re served at the perfect temperature—slightly melted so all the flavors can be appreciated. I ordered double chocolate ice cream, which had big chunks of chocolate. Besides having excellent ice cream, the store is also very charming; you can even sit down and watch how the ice cream is prepared in the back area.
original: So, when can we get one in Detroit? We stumbled upon this place after going to West Side Market and even though we were both stuffed, we decided to stop for a scoop of ice cream. Best choice ever! They're got a nice selection of ice cream and it's served at the best temperature...slightly melty so you can taste all of the flavors. I had the double chocolate which had massive slices of chocolate in it! In addition to having great ice cream, the shop is super cute and you can even sit and watch people make the ice cream in the back.

text: Un delicioso pastel de melocotones que se derrite en la boca. Me encantó muchísimo. Una porción generosa, bien caliente, con helado de vainilla.
text_en: A delicious peach pie that melts in the mouth. I loved it very much. A generous portion, warm, with vanilla ice cream.
original: Melt in your mouth peach cobbler that was just divine. I absolutely loved it. Nice portion, hot, with vanilla bean ice cream

text: I usually go to the Sprinkles location near my home in Newport Beach. When I met with family in Las Vegas I was so excited to show them my favorite cupcake spot. I was extremely disappointed with the service we received. It was extremely disorganized and the staff seemed too flustered to properly take care of the customers in the store. There was no clear line and we were told to wait somewhere else after having stood there for some time. The associate took the order of someone who had entered after us and we waited patiently for a cupcake to be brought from the back that associate forget to even give us. I'm so use to such a great experience at my home location! Sad I couldn't show my family that.

original: Great coffee!! Pastries look delicious! The owners are extremely friendly, highly recommend this spot!

text: Helado absolutamente increíble. Un lugar agradable para sentarse en la parte exterior, en las mesas de picnic, durante nuestro excelente clima primaveral. El personal fue amable y dispuesto a permitirnos probar cualquier sabor antes de comprarlos. Probamos el helado de limón, que era cremoso y tenía el equilibrio perfecto entre lo ácido y lo dulce, el de pistacho, que tenía una buena cantidad de pistachos picados, el de hibisco, que era increíblemente fresco y no demasiado dulce, el de chocolate y plátano, que tenía deliciosos trozos de chocolate crujiente y el equilibrio perfecto entre plátano y chocolate en una base cremosa, y el de "Black Forest", que tenía un sabor a chocolate intenso, trozos de cerezas y trozos de chocolate crujiente. Definitivamente volveremos. Vayan en grupo para tener una excusa para probar la degustación de helados.
text_en: Absolutely incredible ice cream. A pleasant place to sit outside, at the picnic tables, during our wonderful spring weather. The staff were friendly and willing to let us try any flavor before buying it. We tried the lemon ice cream—it was creamy with the perfect balance between sour and sweet. There was also pistachio ice cream, which had plenty of chopped pistachios. The lily of the valley ice cream was incredibly fresh and not too sweet. The chocolate and banana ice cream had delicious crumbly pieces of chocolate, with the perfect balance between banana and chocolate in a creamy base. And there was “Black Forest” ice cream—it had a strong chocolate flavor, pieces of cherry, and crumbly chocolate pieces. We will definitely come back. Go in groups so you have a reason to try all the ice creams.
original: Absolutely amazing ice cream. Nice location to enjoy sitting out front at the picnic tables during our great spring weather. The staff was friendly and more than willing to let us taste any flavors prior to purchasing. We had the lemon custard, which was creamy and had the right balance of tart and sweet, the pistachio, which had a nice amount of chopped pistachios in it, the hibiscus sorbet, which was amazingly fresh and not too sweet, the banana chocolate crunch, which had delightful little crunchy chocolate bits and the right balance of banana and chocolate ribbon in a sweet cream base, and the black forest, which had a deep chocolate flavor, bits of cherries, and chocolate crunch. We will definitely return. Go with a group so you have an excuse for trying the ice cream flight.

text: Compré un pastel de arcoíris para mi hija. Le encanta ver "Cake Boss". Era muy dulce, con muy poco otro sabor. Costó alrededor de 10 dólares. No creo que haya muchos niños que no disfruten de pasteles muy dulces. Tres estrellas porque a ella le gustó mucho.
text_en: I bought a rainbow cake for my daughter. She loves watching “Cake Boss”. It was very sweet, with very little other flavor. It cost about 10 dollars. I don’t think there are many children who don’t enjoy very sweet cakes. Three stars because she really liked it.
original: Bought a rainbow cake for my daughter. She loves watching the Cake Boss. It was super sweet with very little other flavor. It costs around $10. I don't think there are too many kids don't like super sweet cakes. Three stars because she enjoyed it.

text: Algunos datos interesantes: 1. Estuve en la ciudad solo durante unos 5 días completos. 2. Soy intolerante a la lactosa (pero tomo Digestive Advantage - comprimidos para la intolerancia a la lactosa, que me ayudaron a disfrutar de lugares como este!!). 3. Vine aquí 3 veces y cada vez compré un helado o dos. La creatividad y la riqueza de cada sabor nos hicieron volver. Más allá de un helado normal: Helado simple, con azúcar, con waffle, con waffle en cuenco, con cobertura de chocolate, helado con cobertura de chocolate, helado con cobertura de chocolate, con waffle en cuenco, y para los helados y cuencos con cobertura de chocolate, incluso algunos estaban cubiertos con chispas. Cualquier cosa con fudge, caramelo, café o espresso como parte del helado - ¡Pruébalo! "Decadente" es una descripción muy suave. Es un lugar muy popular, donde la gente se agolpa para ver qué sabores están disponibles. Solo ten cuidado de no pisar a nadie ni a niños pequeños que corran... o incluso a adultos pequeños que corran. Gira lentamente y con cuidado, nadie quiere hacerse daño :) El personal es amable y rápido al servir. Hay un área de asientos con pequeñas mesas. Hay baños que están cerrados con llave. Pide las llaves que van con el cucharón. Esto estará en la lista de razones por las que recomendaría una visita a Madison, Wisconsin :) Gran servicio, excelente ubicación para caminar y HELADO EXCELENTE. Todavía pienso en los helados con cobertura de waffle...
text_en:
Some interesting facts:  
1. I only stayed in the city for about 5 full days.  
2. I’m lactose intolerant (but I take Digestive Advantage – lactose intolerance tablets – which helped me enjoy places like this!!).  
3. I’ve been here three times, and each time I bought one or two ice creams. The creativity and variety of flavors made us want to come back again. It’s more than just an ordinary ice cream: there are simple ice creams with sugar, ice creams with waffle, ice creams with waffle in cups, chocolate coatings, ice creams with chocolate coatings… Even some were covered with sprinkles. Anything with fudge, caramel, coffee, or espresso as part of the ice cream – try it! “Decadent” is a very gentle description. It’s a very popular place where people line up to see what flavors are available. Just be careful not to step on anyone, especially small children who might run around… or even small adults. Move slowly and carefully – no one wants to get hurt :) The staff is friendly and quick in serving. There’s a seating area with small tables. There are bathrooms that are locked with keys. Ask for the keys that come with the spoon. This will be one of the reasons I recommend visiting Madison, Wisconsin :) Great service, excellent location for walking, and EXCELLENT ICECREAMS. I still think about those ice creams with waffle coatings…
original: Some telling facts: 1. I was only in town for about 5 full days 2. I am lactose intolerant (but I have Digestive Advantage - Lactose Intolerance Pills that were meant to help me enjoy places like this!!) 3. I came here 3 times and had a single or double each time! The creativity and richness of each of the flavors kept us coming back. Beyond a regular cone: Plain, Sugar, Waffle, Waffle Bowl, Dipped (in chocolate) Sugar Cone, Dipped (in chocolate) Waffle Cone, Dipped (in chocolate), Waffle Bowl and for the Dipped (in chocolate) cones and bowls - there were even some dipped and coated with sprinkles. Anything with Fudge, Caramel, Coffee, Espresso as part of the ice cream - TRY IT! Decadent is an understatement. It is a popular stop with crowds craning and stretching to see what flavors are available in the case. Just be careful not to step on toes or small children running about...or even small adults running about. Turn slowly and carefully no one wants to get hurt :) The staff, were friendly and QUICK on the scoop. There is a seating area with small tables. There are restrooms that are locked. Ask for the keys with the scoop attached to it. This will be on the list of reasons of why I would recommend a visit to Madison, WI :) Great Service, Great walkable Location and GREAT Ice Cream. I still think about the coated waffle cones....

text: Lo peor de Mitchell's es la larga fila, que suele comenzar tan pronto como entras. La variedad de helados de temporada es una excelente característica, y funciona en cualquier época del año, ya sea invierno, verano, primavera o otoño. Elegir entre un cono o una taza será la decisión más fácil una vez que llegues al mostrador y veas todas las opciones disponibles; la siguiente pregunta será si tomar una o dos bolas.
text_en: The worst thing about Mitchell’s is the long line, which usually starts as soon as you enter. The variety of seasonal ice cream options is a great feature, and it works throughout all seasons—whether it’s winter, summer, spring, or autumn. Choosing between a cone or a cup will be the easiest decision once you reach the counter and see all the available options; the next question will be whether to get one or two scoops.
original: The worst part about Mitchell's is the long line, usually starting as soon as you walk in the door. The rotation of seasonal ice creams is a great feature, and they work, wether it be winter, summer, spring or fall. Cone or cup will be the easiest decision you make, once you hit that glads counter and see all the flavors your next road block will be one scoop or two

Okay, I'm done ranting about ice cream heaven, and I mean Mitchell's. This ice cream and its facility are just simply superb.

text: One of the more charming destinations in Ohio City. You go to Mason's Creamery to be around friendly employees and uniquely plush ice cream and sorbet flavors. Taro, lychee, Rising Star, Nutella...all good. The place is also dog friendly! So much so that they'll even hook your pet up with some ice cream as well. The outdoor seating under the awning and the patio underneath the string lights only add to this already endearing handmade ice cream shop. Just go already!

text: Fui ao Villanis hoje. Paul e Amanda são ABSOLUTAMENTE os melhores! Um lugar muito charmoso e acolhedor. Ótimo lugar para parar e comprar um doce delicioso depois de saborear um sanduíche cubano, que fica a poucos passos de distância. Experimente os muffins de frutas mistas ou o croissant de queijo pimento... simplesmente delicioso! Com certeza voltaremos!
text_en: I went to Villanis today. Paul and Amanda are absolutely the best! It’s a very charming and welcoming place. A great spot to stop and buy a delicious dessert after enjoying a Cuban sandwich, which is just a few steps away. Try the mixed fruit muffins or the cheese-pimento croissant… simply delicious! We will definitely come back!

Great place to stop and grab a sweet treat after enjoying a Cuban sandwich just a short walk away. Try the mixed berry muffins or the pimento cheese croissant...one word DEVINE! We will definitely be back here!

text: Eu queria ir à padaria Bouchen, mas não conseguia lembrar qual padaria tinha os melhores cupcakes. Um dos funcionários me disse que essa era a única padaria na região. Agora, percebo meu erro. Eu experimentei o brownie, o cupcake de manteiga de amendoim e um pudim de Oreo. Amei o brownie. Era muito rico e cremoso. O cupcake também estava bom. Gostei muito da cobertura. O pudim de Oreo estava ok, mas não valia o preço. Não voltarei, pois a fila estava muito longa. Da próxima vez, vou à Bouchen.
text_en: I wanted to go to Bouchen bakery, but I couldn’t remember which bakery had the best cupcakes. One of the staff members said it was the only bakery in the area. Now I realize my mistake. I tried the brownie, the peanut butter cupcake, and the Oreo pudding. I loved the brownie—it was very rich and creamy. The cupcake was also good. I really liked the topping. The Oreo pudding was okay, but it wasn’t worth the price. I won’t go back, as the line was too long. Next time, I’ll go to Bouchen.
original: I meant to go to the Bouchen bakery instead,but I couldn't remember which bakery had the best cupcakes.This is where one staff said the only bakery stuff there was.Disappointed now I realize the mistake. I did try the brownie, peanut butter cupcake and an oreo pudding. I loved the brownie.It was so rich and creamy. The cupcake was good too.Liked the frosting lots. Oreo pudding was okay, not worth the money. Not going to come back as the line was too long. I'm headed to the Bouchen next time.

text: Já fomos algumas vezes e há alguns pontos positivos e negativos nesta padaria. Pontos positivos: Ótima localização, com uma grande variedade de produtos de panificação, especialmente cheesecakes e outras opções de panificação italiana, que são mais difíceis de encontrar. O atendimento é muito rápido e amigável. Seus horários são mais longos do que as padarias próximas, o que torna ótimo para conseguir um lanche ou café para levar no final da noite. Pontos negativos: Realmente, não há lugar, seja dentro ou fora, para sentar e desfrutar da comida. Como o negócio parece estar voltado principalmente para casais e famílias que passeiam pelo bairro, é estranho que não haja bancos ou mesas de piquenique para sentar e comer. A qualidade de alguns dos produtos não parece ser tão consistente quanto a da Sunflour, que fica a algumas quadras. Por exemplo, o recheio de creme/custarda de alguns itens parece quase como pudim, e os cinnamon rolls ficam expostos ao ar, o que os faz parecer secos. Outro problema é o preço. Tenho certeza de que, como são novos no bairro, isso se resolverá com o tempo, mas, por enquanto, são significativamente mais caros do que as padarias próximas (novamente, a Sunflour e a Nova's). Pagar $4 por um muffin ou biscoito de chocolate parece caro (embora os produtos de panificação não tanto :-). Espero voltar de vez em quando para ver o que há de novo, mas provavelmente esperarei antes de torná-la a padaria preferida do bairro.
text_en: We’ve been there a few times, and there are some positive and negative aspects about this bakery. Positive points: Excellent location, with a wide variety of bakery products—especially cheesecakes and other Italian-style baked goods, which are hard to find elsewhere. The service is very fast and friendly. Their hours are longer than those of nearby bakeries, making it great for grabbing a snack or coffee to take home after dinner. Negative points: There really isn’t any place inside or outside where you can sit down and enjoy your food. Since the business seems to target couples and families who walk by in the area, it’s odd that there aren’t any benches or picnic tables for sitting and eating. The quality of some products isn’t as consistent as Sunflour, which is just a few blocks away. For example, the filling in some items looks almost like pudding, and the cinnamon rolls are exposed to air, making them seem dry. Another issue is the price. I’m sure that as they become more established in the area, this will improve over time, but for now, they’re significantly more expensive than nearby bakeries (again, Sunflour and Nova’s). Paying $4 for a muffin or chocolate biscuit seems expensive (although the bakery products aren’t that costly :-). I hope to visit again occasionally to see what’s new, but probably I’ll wait before making it the favorite bakery in the neighborhood.
original: We've been a couple times now and there's some definite pluses and minuses to this bakery. Pros: Great location with a huge variety of baked goods, especially cheesecakes and harder to find Italian baked good options. The service is very prompt and friendly. Their hours are longer than nearby bakeries, making it great to snag a late night nibble or coffee to go. Cons: There really is no place, either inside or outside, to sit and enjoy your food. Since their business seems to be oriented to couples and families walking around the neighborhood for the most part, it's odd that there aren't benches or picnic tables at least to sit and eat. The quality of some of the items does not seem to be as consistent as Sunflour a few blocks away. For example, the cream/custard filling of certain items looks almost pudding-like and the cinnamon rolls sit open air, making them look dried out. The other issue is pricing. I'm sure since they are new to the neighborhood, this may hash itself out, but as of now, they are significantly ($1-2 per item) more than nearby bakeries (again, Sunflour, and Nova's). $4 for a muffin or chocolate chip cookie is hard to swallow (though the baked good not so much :-). Look forward to popping in every once in a while to see what's new, but will probably wait and see before making it the go-to bakery in the 'hood.

text: Love it! OMG! This little Italian dessert shop inside of Eataly is phenomenal! You're going to have some decisions to make when you get here! Everything looks delicious (and probably is!)! We liked it so much, we went twice in one day! My favorite out of everything was the tiramisu pudding/dessert. It's the best! It had small pieces of tiramisu cake mixed in the pudding. The taste wasn't too sweet or bitter, it was just right. All of the desserts are authentic. Eating dessert here took me back to the days when I visited Rome and other Italian cities some years back. They also have a small coffee shop. I ordered a tiramisu iced coffee. It was good too but not as good as the dessert. It had a little bit of booze in it. Imagine...coffee and booze together at around 9 am? Lol. I also ordered a slice of chocolate cake with hazelnut mixed in. It was tasty as well but a bit dry. I took a couple of bites from my bf's desserts. Very good as well. We don't recall the names of them. Sorry! He ordered a hot chocolate in the morning and it was delicious! The taste wasn't too rich or sweet. Definitely stop here if you're in the area and into sweets. It's really close to New York New York and the MGM Grand. It took us about eight minutes to walk here from MGM. Aside from this shop, there's a variety of Italian foods and products to choose from in the other shops. There's also a casino in the back. I say any dessert you choose from here will probably be delicious. It's the tiramisu that does it for me! By the way, they change up some of the desserts they have in the morning during the afternoon. The service here is impeccable. I would give this spot more than five stars if I could. Totally recommend! :)

text: Presti's é um lugar muito charmoso para tomar um café. Os doces são bem gostosos, melhores do que os pratos principais (sanduíches, massas, strombolis, etc.) que eles oferecem. A comida é ok. Essa é a única palavra que consigo pensar para descrevê-la. Acho que é apenas um lugar mais agradável para sentar (ou ao ar livre) e tomar um café e comer alguns doces. Mas, por algum motivo, sempre saio desse lugar com um cheiro característico de Presti's. É nojento! 3 estrelas para o Presti's, viva!
text_en: Presti’s is a very charming place for having a coffee. The desserts are really delicious—better than the main dishes they offer, like sandwiches, pasta, strombolis, etc. The food is okay. That’s the only word I can think of to describe it. I guess it’s just a pleasant place to sit (or outdoors) and have a coffee and some desserts. But for some reason, I always leave this place with a distinctive smell from Presti’s. It’s disgusting! 3 stars for Presti’s, vive!
original: presti's is a really cute place to go for coffee. their baked goods are pretty good, better than the savory lunch food types of things they have there (sandwiches, pastas, strombolis, etc.) and the food is aiight. that's the only word i can think of that would most appropriately describe it. i think it's just a nicer place to sit in (or outside) for normal coffee and cookies and such. but i've always come out of that place smelling like a walking human presti's for some reason. gross! 3 stars for presti's, hip hip hooray.

text: Los postres eran caros, pero no los probamos. No esperaba mucho de su comida salada, ya que solo quería una comida rápida, pero mi padre y yo pedimos una pizza, que estaba bien, pasta, que estaba buena, y el stromboli era increíble!!! Simplemente lo tenían a un lado y dijimos: "¡pues lo calentamos nosotros!", pero al final resultó que sabía de maravilla. Los strombolis de carne son buenos, pero por alguna razón, me encantó especialmente el de verduras. Lo recomiendo mucho.
text_en: The desserts were expensive, but we didn’t try them. I didn’t expect much from their salty food, as I just wanted something quick to eat. But my father and I ordered a pizza—it was good; the pasta was delicious, and the stromboli was amazing!!! They simply left it aside, and we said, “Let’s heat it up ourselves!” But in the end, it turned out to be absolutely delicious. Meat-based stromboli is good, but for some reason, I especially liked the one with vegetables. I highly recommend it.
original: Sweets were pricey but didn't try. I didn't expect anything out of their savory food because I just wanted a quick bite for dinner but my dad and I got a pizza which was ok/solid, pasta which was good, and the stromboli was amazing!!! It was just presented on the side of the place and we said screw it just microwave it for us but it ended up tasting super good? Meat strombolis are good but for some reason I reallllly liked the veggie one. Highly recommend.

text: Okay so I'm not one to normally post reviews but OH MAN THIS PLACE!!!!! I've had their ice cream twice. The first time my roommate brought me home just a cup of strawberry ice cream. It was probably the best strawberry ice cream I've had! The second time, I went to the ice cream shop. It is in a cute little hidden village of shops. When we first walked in we were greeted immediately by the nice owners! They let us try all the flavors we wanted. I tried the Fat Elvis (peanut butter ice cream w/ caramelized bananas and bacon). It was delicious. I also had to try the honey lavender because I have heard great things and it was so light and yummy. But I was there for one thing. The donut melt!!!! Donuts + ice cream?! What could be better?? I got the Cookie Monster (blue cookies and cream flavor with chocolate chip cookies, Oreos and vanilla wafers). They warm up the donut sandwiches and they are so perfect. And you get one free topping! My boyfriend got the Leslie Knope which is a European waffle ice cream sandwich. He chose the Fat Elvis flavor. It was also delicious! I would much rather support a local small shop and this is just the place I will be picking. If you haven't already, GO TRY IT!!! You won't be disappointed!

text: No soy muy fan de los otros tipos de donuts que ofrecen. Me encanta el donut tipo Pop-Tart. Pero mi favorito absoluto son los donuts de "French toast" (rebanada de pan con huevo) y los donuts de "queso a la parrilla". Son donuts con un sabor muy particular. ¡Me encantan!
text_en: I’m not very fond of the other types of donuts they offer. I really love Pop-Tart-style donuts. But my absolute favorite are “French toast” donuts (a slice of bread with an egg) and “grilled cheese” donuts. They have a very unique flavor. I love them!
original: not really a fan of the other donuts they have. I love the pop tart donut. But my all time favorite ? are the French toast donut and the grilled cheese donut. Very unique tasting donuts. I love it.

text: ¡Qué bien por las heladerías locales! Este lugar es increíble. Después de una rápida visita a la heladería de al lado, tuvimos que ir aquí, especialmente porque era un día de agosto caluroso. Un lugar muy bonito con una gran variedad de helados. ¡Hacen sus helados desde cero! ¡Eso es lo que quiero decir! Probé el de fresa con cilantro, que era una opción de temporada, y estaba muy refrescante y delicioso para un día de verano caluroso, me recordó un poco a una paleta mexicana. Mi esposo pidió el de plátano y le encantó, ¡tenía trozos también! Sirven el helado en cajas o conos de comida china. ¿Mencioné que están abiertos hasta la medianoche? ¡IMPRESIONANTE! Volveremos sin duda.
text_en: What great local ice cream shops! This place is incredible. After a quick visit to the nearby ice cream shop, we had to go here, especially because it was a hot August day. It’s a very nice place with a wide variety of ice creams. They make their ice creams from scratch! That’s exactly what I mean. I tried the strawberry with cilantro ice cream, which was a seasonal option. It was very refreshing and delicious for a hot summer day; it reminded me a little bit of Mexican flavors. My husband ordered the banana ice cream, and he loved it—it also had chunks! They serve the ice cream in boxes or Chinese food cones. Did I mention they are open until midnight? IMPRESSIVE! We will definitely come back.
original: Yay for local ice cream shops!! This place rocks! After a quick visit to their beloved jobot's next door we had to hit this place up especially since it was a friggen hot August day! Such a cute place with great selections of ice cream. They make their ice cream from scratch! That's what I'm talking about! I had the strawberry cilantro which was a seasonal one, and it was very quenching and delicious for the hot summer day, kind of reminded me of a Mexican paleta. My husband got the banana and he loved it, there were some chunks in it too! They serve the ice cream in Chinese take out boxes or cones. Did I mention that they're open until midnight?! AWESOME! We will be back for sure!!

text: Os sabores do sorvete eram realmente únicos, como o "Gansito", e, claro, o conceito também é original. Eles estão no meio de uma mudança de local, então não havia cones e muitos dos sabores disponíveis naquele dia estavam acabando ou já não estavam mais. Eu pedi uma porção do sorvete de muffin de mirtilo, mas, como não havia o suficiente, eles adicionaram pedaços de frutas! No final, funcionou muito bem para mim! Com certeza voltaria assim que tudo estiver de volta ao normal.
text_en: The flavors of the ice cream were really unique, like “Gansito”. Of course, the concept itself is also original. They’re in the middle of a move, so there weren’t any cones available, and many of the flavors on offer that day were running out or no longer available. I ordered a portion of raspberry muffin ice cream, but since there wasn’t enough, they added pieces of fruit instead! In the end, it worked very well for me! I definitely will go back once everything returns to normal.
original: The ice cream flavors were really unique, like Gansito, and of course the concept is unique as well. They're in the middle of moving locations so there were no cones and many of the ice creams being served for the day were low or gone. I ordered a single of the blueberry muffin ice cream but because there wasn't enough, it was topped with fruity pebble! Ended up being a win for me! I'd definitely go back once everything is reestablished.

text: Desafortunadamente, la publicidad no cumplió con las expectativas. Ya había probado Milk Bar en Nueva York, pero volver a probarlo en Las Vegas me recordó por qué no anhelo estos dulces caros que, en realidad, no son tan buenos. Pedí: 1) Crack Pie: 2/5, bueno, pero ¡demasiado pequeño para el precio! 2) Compost Cookie: 3.5/5, probablemente mi opción favorita de esta lista. 3) Cookie de maíz, 2.5/5, simplemente aceptable. 4) Cookie de Confetti: 2.5/5, un poco demasiado dulce para mí. 5) Helado de leche de cereales: 3/5, de nuevo, si no fuera por el precio, le daría una calificación mucho más alta. Demasiado caro – en definitiva.
text_en: Unfortunately, the advertising didn’t meet expectations. I had already tried Milk Bar in New York, but trying it again in Las Vegas reminded me why I don’t crave those expensive sweets—they’re actually not that good. I ordered: 1) Crack Pie: 2/5, okay, but too small for the price! 2) Compost Cookie: 3.5/5, probably my favorite on this list. 3) Corn Cookie: 2.5/5, just acceptable. 4) Confetti Cookie: 2.5/5, a little too sweet for me. 5) Cereal Milk Ice Cream: 3/5, again, if it weren’t for the price, I would give it a much higher rating. It’s too expensive—in the end.
original: Sadly, the hype did not live up to the expectation. I had Milk Bar in NYC before, but having it again in LV reminded me why I don't crave for these expensive sweets that are mediocre. Ordered: 1) Crack Pie: 2/5 Good but SO SMALL for the price! 2) Compost Cookie: 3.5/5 probably my favorite item on this list 3) Corn Cookie, 2.5/5 eh, just okay 4) Confetti Cookie: 2.5/5 a bit too sweet for me 5) Cereal Milk Soft Serve: 3/5 again, if it weren't for the price, I would've given it a much higher rating. Overpriced--bottomline.

text: Tried this place after hearing about the hype. Had to wake up extra early so try all the flavors before they sold out. This was not worth the hype, we got a dozen doughnuts since we don't live in Vegas. The special doughnuts weren't anything special. The creme brulee didn't have enough filling nor did the other flavors. All the doughnuts tasted normal, flavors weren't special or "wow" about them compared to most normal doughnut shops. I've had better doughnuts in the east coast. This was such a disappointment.
