text: Me encanta esta panadería. Me enamoré de ellos cuando estaban en Concord y ahora camino hasta Charlotte para visitarlos. Siempre pido una porción de pastel de chocolate... (sí, vale la pena el viaje de 30 minutos en cada sentido)... y salgo con otras 3-4 cosas. A menudo compro cosas que están fuera de mi zona de confort habitual y me han encantado todo lo que he probado. No puedo decir lo suficiente sobre ellos. (Además, ¡regresen a Concord! jaja)
text_en: I love this bakery. I fell in love with them when they were in Concord, and now I drive all the way to Charlotte to visit them. I always order a portion of chocolate cake… (yes, it’s worth the 30-minute trip in either direction)… and I also get 3–4 other items with it. Often, I buy things that are outside my usual comfort zone, and everything I tried was amazing. I can’t say enough about them. (Also, come back to Concord! haha)
original: I love this bakery. I fell in love with them when they were in Concord and now I drive all the way into Charlotte to see them. I always go in for a slice of Chocolate cake... (yes, worth the 30 minute drive each way)... and I walk out with 3-4 other things. Often I buy things that are outside of my normal food comfort zone and have loved everything I've tried. I can't say enough about them. (Also, come back to Concord. haha)

text: Fatty Daddy's es una pequeña tienda en una plaza tranquila. Soy de Filadelfia, y esta sería una joya si estuviera en la ciudad, ¡con colas interminables! Los sabores de helado son realmente divertidos y todos están deliciosos. El personal es muy amable y servicial, explicándonos los sabores y ofreciéndonos muestras a mis amigos y a mí. Compré un helado de Fatty Daddy's y ¡estuvo increíble! Helado de Lucky Charms, macaron de Fruity Pebbles y un malvavisco perfectamente tostado. ¡Consigue un 10% de descuento en Yelp! Totalmente vale la pena, concepto original, buen servicio al cliente y postres deliciosos.
text_en: Fatty Daddy’s is a small shop located in a quiet square. I’m from Philadelphia, and it would be great if it were in the city—with endless queues! The ice cream flavors are really fun, and they’re all delicious. The staff is very friendly and helpful, explaining the flavors to us and offering samples for my friends and me. I bought an ice cream from Fatty Daddy’s, and it was incredible! An Lucky Charms ice cream, a Fruity Pebbles macaron, and a perfectly toasted malvavisco. Get a 10% discount on Yelp! It’s absolutely worth it—original concept, great customer service, and delicious desserts.
original: Fatty daddy's is a small shop in a quiet plaza. I'm from Philadelphia and this would be such a gem with lines wrapped around if it were in the city! Really fun ice cream Flavors and all very yummy. The staff were really friendly and helpful in explaining the flavors and giving my friends and I samples. I got a fatty daddy's and it was so good! Lucky charms ice cream, fruity pebbles macaron, and a perfectly toasted marshmallow. Check in on Yelp for 10% off! Totally worth the price, cool concept, good customer service, delicious desserts!

text: Um ótimo lugar, com alguns dos melhores croissants que já comi desde a França. Os biscoitos também são excelentes. Ainda não experimentei as tortas de frutas, mas elas parecem incríveis. O espaço é divertido e confortável. É um antigo armazém em Noda que foi renovado. Isso significa que eu estarei por perto todos os dias no meu caminho para o trabalho! :-) Mas falando sério, os croissants são realmente... leves, crocantes, e você consegue sentir o sabor do manteiga!!!!
text_en: A great place, with some of the best croissants I’ve ever eaten since France. The biscuits are also excellent. I haven’t tried the fruit tarts yet, but they seem amazing. The space is fun and comfortable. It’s an old warehouse in Noda that has been renovated. That means I’ll be nearby every day on my way to work! :-) But seriously, the croissants are really… light, crispy, and you can taste the butter!!!!
original: Great place with some of the best croissants I've had since France. The cookies are equally as good. I haven't had the fruit tarts yet, but they look amazing. The space is fun and comfortable. It's an old warehouse building in Noda that has been renovated. This means I'll be by there everyday on my way to work! :-) But seriously, the croissants are super...light, flakey, and you can taste the butter!!!!

text: Cuando era niño, solía venir aquí con frecuencia, pero han pasado unos 50 años y sigue estando aquí. Cada vez que visitamos la ciudad y pasamos por aquí, siempre hay una cola. Incluso en medio de un día laborable, no era tan malo, así que decidimos parar. Yo pedí un postre similar a una tormenta de nieve y su helado es de verdad, no ese helado artificial. Mi esposo pidió un batido y estaba tan espeso, ¡era delicioso! ¡Aplausos por seguir manteniendo un negocio exitoso durante tanto tiempo!
text_en: When I was a child, I used to come here frequently. But about 50 years have passed, and it’s still here. Every time we visit the city and pass by here, there’s always a long line. Even on a regular working day, it wasn’t too bad, so we decided to stop. I ordered a dessert that resembled a snowstorm—its ice cream is real, not just artificial stuff. My husband ordered a smoothie, and it was so thick; it was delicious! Applause for keeping a successful business going for so long!
original: When I was a kid I used to come here all the time, but it's been about 50 years and it's still here. Every time we visit the City and drive by there is a line. In the middle of a weekday, it wasn't so bad so we stopped. I had a blizzard type treat and their ice cream is the real deal, not that ice milk garbage. My husband had a milkshake and it was so thick, it was yummy. Thumbs up for continuing to run a successful business for so long.

text: ¡Amantes de los pasteles! Un excelente y pequeño panadería con café y pasteles deliciosos. Hay mucho espacio para aparcar, hay mesas al aire libre y el personal es amable y conoce todos sus productos. :) ¡Recomiendo especialmente el pastel de chocolate!
text_en: Lovers of cakes! An excellent and small bakery with delicious coffee and cakes. There’s plenty of parking space, outdoor tables, and the staff are friendly and know all their products well. :) I especially recommend the chocolate cake!
original: Love villanis! An excellent little bakery with delicious coffee and pastries. Plenty of parking, outdoor seating is available, and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable about all their sweets. :) Would especially recommend the chocolate cake!

text: Sí, el sabor es bueno, pero la espera suele ser demasiado larga y el precio es demasiado elevado para que valga la pena.
text_en: Yes, the taste is good, but the wait is usually too long, and the price is too high to be worth it.
original: Yeah it tastes nice but the wait is frequently too long and the product too expensive to bother.

text: ¿Sabías que el chocolate Ghirardelli es igual de delicioso derretido sobre el helado y en la base de un sundae, como en una barra de chocolate decadente? Si nunca has experimentado lo maravilloso que es el chocolate Ghirardelli caliente, definitivamente deberías probarlo. Siempre llevo a mis hijos a cualquier heladería de Ghirardelli. El helado es cremoso y delicioso, y simplemente complementa cualquier topping que elijas. El servicio es profesional y las porciones son proporcionales al precio. ¡Siempre estoy dispuesto a aumentar mi consumo de calorías por Ghirardelli!
text_en: Did you know that Ghirardelli chocolate is just as delicious when melted on ice cream or at the base of a sundae, as it is in a decadent chocolate bar? If you’ve never experienced how wonderful hot Ghirardelli chocolate is, you definitely should try it. I always take my kids to any Ghirardelli ice cream shop. The ice cream is creamy and delicious, and it simply complements any topping you choose. The service is professional, and the portions are proportional to the price. I’m always willing to increase my calorie intake because of Ghirardelli!
original: Did you know that Ghirardelli chocolate is just as good melted and on top of ice cream and on the bottom of a sundae cup as it is in a decadent candy bar? If you've never experienced how wonderful hot Ghirardelli chocolate is, you absolutely need to. I make a point to take my kids to any Ghirardelli Ice cream location. The ice cream is creamy and delicious and just adds to whatever toppings you decide to enjoy. The service is professional and the serving proportions equal the cost. Always happy to increase my calorie intake for Ghirardelli!

text: Os sorvetes são excelentes. O gerente, Stephen, foi uma pessoa muito atenciosa, que demonstrou orgulho pelo seu trabalho e tinha facilidade em lidar com as pessoas. Este lugar é caro, como quase todos os lugares na Strip.
text_en: The ice cream is excellent. The manager, Stephen, was a very attentive person; he showed pride in his work and had an easy way with people. This place is expensive, just like almost all places on the Strip.
original: The ice cream sundaes are great. The manager Stephen was a great guy, clearly taking pride in his job and a "people person". This place is expensive like almost anywhere on the Strip.

text: Na primeira vez que experimentei o Fatty Daddy, só provei o sorvete de sabor Captain Crunch. Com base nessa experiência, eu daria apenas cerca de 3 estrelas – para ser honesto, é apenas "ok". No entanto, hoje comprei um dos seus potes de biscoito e, meu Deus, são incríveis! Eu comi o meu com uma bola de sorvete de chocolate com avelã e uma bola de sorvete de manteiga de amendoim, com uma macarron de coco e um marshmallow tostado por cima. Eles usam um soprador de cozinha para tostar o marshmallow, e ficou realmente delicioso, parecia um marshmallow tostado em uma fogueira. Descobri uma sobremesa nova favorita! :)
text_en: The first time I tried Fatty Daddy, I only tried the Captain Crunch flavor ice cream. Based on that experience, I would give it only about 3 stars – to be honest, it’s just “okay”. However, today I bought one of their cookie packs. Oh my God, they are amazing! I ate mine with a chocolate almond ice cream ball and an peanut butter ice cream ball, along with a coconut macaron and a toasted marshmallow on top. They use a kitchen stirrer to toast the marshmallow, and it was really delicious – it looked like a marshmallow roasted over a fire. I’ve found a new favorite dessert! :)
original: First time I had Fatty Daddy's I only tried the captain crunch flavor ice cream. Based on that experience I would have only give about 3 stars -- its really just meh, to be honest. Today, however, I got one of their cookie cups and holy cow those are amazing. I had mine with a scoop of hazelnut chocolate and a scoop of peanut butter ice cream topped with a coconut macaroon and toasted marshmallow on top. They use one of those kitchen blow torches to toast the marshmallow and it was really good, tasted just like a marshmallow toasted over a camp fire. I have found a new favorite dessert! :)

text: Experimentei o "peanut butter cup" e o "pretzel coberto de chocolate com pasta de amendoim". O pretzel estava duro e quase quebrei um dente, mas ambos estavam deliciosos. Voltarei e pedirei um pretzel de brinde.
text_en: I tried the “peanut butter cup” and the “pretzel covered in chocolate with peanut butter paste”. The pretzel was hard and I almost broke a tooth, but both were delicious. I’ll go back and order a pretzel as a bonus.
original: Had peanut butter cup and peanut butter chocolate covered pretzel. Pretzel was hard and almost broke my tooth but both were delicious. Will be returning and getting a free pretzel.

text: My first visit since I'm not usually in this part of town but I totally get the hype. Way better than B&R in cost and taste! I'll be back! Oh and definitely try the black cherry ice cream, it's a flavor explosion in your mouth!
text_en: My first visit since I'm not usually in this part of town but I totally get the hype. Way better than B&R in cost and taste! I'll be back! Oh and definitely try the black cherry ice cream, it's a flavor explosion in your mouth!

text: Los donuts aquí son buenos; son densos, a diferencia de muchos otros lugares que los venden. Se nota que se esfuerzan por hacerlos. Sin embargo, el donut de crème brûlée fue muy decepcionante. La publicidad no correspondía a la calidad. Creo que la gente estaba más interesada en el sonido que hacía al romperse que en su sabor. Sin embargo, los otros donuts fueron geniales.
text_en: The donuts here are good; they’re dense, unlike many other places that sell them. It’s clear they try their best to make them right. However, the crème brûlée donut was very disappointing. The advertising didn’t match the quality. I think people were more interested in the sound it made when it broke apart than in its taste. But the other donuts were great.
original: The donuts here are good; they're dense, unlike a lot of other donut places. You can really tell thy put effort in making them. However, the creme brulee donut was very disappointing. The hype did not match the quality. I think people were just excited about the cracking noise rather than its taste. However, the other donuts were great!

text: Mi primera experiencia aquí fue increíble. Hace unos meses, probé un delicioso pastel de zanahoria con forma de whoopie pie. Pero cuando volví recientemente, descubrí que ya no lo tenían. ¡Y no había ninguna alternativa! A las 8:30 de la mañana, esta sucursal no tenía Better Nutters, TKOs ni Oh-Ohs. Así que, pedí una galleta de avena y nueces, un macaron de pistacho y un macaron de caramelo salado. La galleta de avena y nueces estaba realmente seca. Normalmente, Bouchon vale la pena las calorías, pero no esta galleta. El macaron de pistacho también era bastante soso, aunque era mejor que la galleta. El macaron de caramelo salado, como siempre, estaba delicioso. Pero no estoy seguro de si volveré a este lugar solo por ese macaron.
text_en: My first experience here was incredible. A few months ago, I tried a delicious carrot cake shaped like a whoopie pie. But when I returned recently, I found out that it wasn’t available anymore. And there was no alternative! At 8:30 in the morning, this branch didn’t have Better Nutters, TKOs, or Oh-Ohs. So, I ordered a oat and nut cookie, a pistachio macaron, and a salty caramel macaron. The oat and nut cookie was really dry. Usually, Bouchon is worth the calories, but not this cookie. The pistachio macaron was also quite boring, although it was better than the cookie. The salty caramel macaron, as always, was delicious. But I’m not sure if I’ll go back to this place just for that macaron.
original: My first experience here was amazing. I had a delicious carrot cake whoopie pie a few months ago. But when I went back recently, I found out that it had been discontinued. With no replacement! At 8:30 AM, this location didn't have any Better Nutters, TKOs, or Oh-Ohs. So, I got an oatmeal pecan cookie, a pistachio macaron, and a salted caramel macaron. The oatmeal pecan cookie was realllly dry. Usually Bouchon is worth the calories, but not this cookie. The pistachio macaron was similarly bland, though it was better than the cookie. The salted caramel macaron was delicious as always! But not sure if I'll be back here just for that.

text: Almond Croissant - It was hard and over baked. I had huge hopes but was very disappointed. This must be fluke, must be a one time mistake because I saw a picture of one of their half eaten croissants with airy hole pockets. But if they had messed up a batch, why not just throw it out? Where is the quality control? It really is not worth tainting their brand name.
text_en: Almond Croissant - It was hard and over baked. I had huge hopes but was very disappointed. This must be fluke, must be a one time mistake because I saw a picture of one of their half eaten croissants with airy hole pockets. But if they had messed up a batch, why not just throw it out? Where is the quality control? It really is not worth tainting their brand name.

text: Este lugar manejó muy bien la situación durante la pandemia. Aunque había mucha gente cuando fui a la tienda, los empleados eran rápidos y eficientes en atender a los clientes. Fui durante la última hora, y aún estaban reponiendo los estantes con panecillos. Compré alrededor de seis y todos estaban deliciosos.
text_en: This place handled the situation during the pandemic very well. Even though there were many people when I went to the store, the staff were quick and efficient in serving customers. I visited during the last hour, and they were still restocking the shelves with bread rolls. I bought about six pieces, and all of them were delicious.
original: This place did great managing things during covid! There were lots of people while I was in the store but the workers were fast and edgy in getting people in and out. I went during the last hour, and they were still stocking the shelves with buns! I grabbed about a half dozen and all were good!

text: Nossa, este é o sorvete mais rico e delicioso que já provei. Vimos este lugar no caminho para o jantar e todos concordamos que seria o sobremesa. Na noite de segunda-feira, havia cerca de 10 pessoas na fila quando chegamos. Quando finalmente nos sentamos com a nossa porção padrão (2 e 1/2 bolas), eu escolhi bolo de manteiga e chocolate amargo, e minha amiga escolheu bolo com geleia de pêssego e chocolate. Ambos estavam deliciosamente servidos em um prato de waffle, que era preparado em uma máquina de waffles antiga, na nossa frente. Os preços são muito razoáveis (6 dólares para 2 e 1/2 bolas e um prato de waffle). Mal posso esperar para voltar e experimentar a degustação de sorvetes.
text_en: Wow, this is the most rich and delicious ice cream I’ve ever tasted. We saw this place on our way to dinner, and we all agreed it would be the perfect dessert. On Monday night, there were about 10 people in line when we arrived. When we finally got to sit down with our usual portions (2 and a half scoops each), I chose butter cake with dark chocolate, and my friend chose a cake with peach jam and chocolate. Both were served beautifully in a waffle dish, which was prepared using an old waffle machine right in front of us. The prices are very reasonable—$6 for 2 and a half scoops and a waffle dish. I can’t wait to go back and try the ice cream tasting again.
original: OMG this is some of the richest and decadent ice cream I've ever had. We eyed this place on our way to dinner and we all agreed this would be dessert. On a Monday night there were about 10 ppl in line when we joined. By the time we sat down with our Standard cup (2 1/2 scoops), I chose gooey butter cake and darkest chocolate and my friend got P&J and chocolate cake. Both were deliciously served in a waffle bowl that was cooked in an old fashion waffle iron in front of us. Prices are very reasonable ($6 for 2 1/2 scoops and a waffle bowl). Can't wait to go again and try the flight of ice creams

text: Love this place, best ice cream in Scottsdale. Solid service and an ever changing selection of delicious flavors. Try the bacon ice cream, no joke!
text_en: Love this place, best ice cream in Scottsdale. Solid service and an ever changing selection of delicious flavors. Try the bacon ice cream, no joke!

text: Estas opções estão longe de serem como as "crêpes de rua de Paris"... vamos ser honestos, são panquecas de Cleveland, mas com ingredientes que custam cerca de 89 centavos, e cobram 8 dólares... Como outros comentaram, o atendimento do Hipsters é o pior, e os que têm barba não usam luvas ou redes para a barba (para evitar contaminação das crêpes)... Eu evitaria este lugar... Ouvi dizer que o "Holy Crêpes" de Columbus está abrindo em breve dentro do mercado, e espero que isso seja verdade... mais crêpes, menos problemas e muito mais barato!
text_en: These options are far from being like “Parisian street crêpes”… To be honest, they’re Cleveland pancakes, but with ingredients that cost about 89 cents, yet cost 8 dollars… As others have said, the service at Hipsters is terrible, and those with beards don’t wear gloves or masks for their beards (to avoid contaminating the crêpes)… I would avoid this place… I heard that “Holy Crêpes” in Columbus is about to open in the market soon, and I hope that’s true… More crêpes, fewer problems, and much cheaper!
original: These are far from a Paris Street CrÃªpes ... call it like it is, it's a Cleveland Pancake that has about .89 cents worth of ingredients but they charge you $8.00 ... Like others have said the Hipsters offer up the worst Service and the bearded ones don't wear gloves or beard nets (pubic crepe) ... I'd skip this place ... I hear Holy CrÃªpes from Columbus is opening soon inside the market and I hope that's true... more crepe less crap and a lot cheaper!

text: Sorvete delicioso, mas a fila de espera não vale a pena. Se realmente precisar, compre um pote no Publix. Quando a popularidade diminuir e a fila ficar menor, voltarei. Gosto das pequenas porções de diferentes sabores, para poder experimentar mais opções.
text_en: Delicious ice cream, but the waiting line isn’t worth it. If you really need it, buy a container at Publix. When its popularity decreases and the line gets shorter, I’ll come back. I like the small portions of different flavors so I can try more options.
original: Great ice cream but the line is not worth it. If you really need it, go buy a pint at publix. When the hype passes and the line dies down I will go back though. I like the small portions of different flavors so I could try more.

text: I asked for two scoops and I got one scoop to equal two and they charged for two scoops. The scoops keep getting smaller and smaller. Although the ice cream is good, the portion sizes need to equal the amount you pay for.
text_en: I asked for two scoops and I got one scoop to equal two and they charged for two scoops. The scoops keep getting smaller and smaller. Although the ice cream is good, the portion sizes need to equal the amount you pay for.

text: La comida y los postres son excelentes. El ambiente es divertido. La gente es terrible. Dado que es un lugar muy turístico, hay todo tipo de personas, incluyendo algunas molestas y groseras, así que es mejor ir en horarios menos concurridos, ya que está abierto las 24 horas.
text_en: The food and desserts are excellent. The atmosphere is fun. However, the people are terrible. Since it’s a very touristy place, there are all kinds of people around, including some annoying and rude ones. So it’s better to go during less busy times, as it’s open 24 hours a day.
original: The food and desserts are great. The ambiance is fun. The crowd is awful. Since it's such a tourist spot there are all types of people, including the annoying and rude, so try to go during off hours since it's 24/7

text: Você precisa parar aqui! Sorvete incrível em uma loja divertida, com um ótimo preço! O proprietário é muito simpático e claramente ama o seu negócio! Experimentei o sorvete dentro de um donut recheado – delicioso!!!
text_en: You need to stop here! Amazing ice cream in a fun store, at a great price! The owner is very friendly and clearly loves their business! I tried the ice cream inside a filled donut – delicious!!!
original: You must stop here! AMAZING ice cream in a fun shop at a great price! Owner was very friendly and clearly loves his business! Had the ice cream stuffed donut- YUM!!!

text: Sorvete delicioso com uma grande variedade de sabores que mudam constantemente. A Mason's Creamery é bastante conhecida localmente pelo seu conceito de sabores únicos, e, na minha opinião, cumpre bastante as expectativas. Já experimentei os sabores de ube e taro (tenho uma preferência moderada pelo taro – o de ube começou a ter um sabor um pouco pastoso nas últimas colheres), mas também vi sabores de goiaba e milho doce, entre outros. Os sabores de ube e taro eram fortes, mas não tão intensos a ponto de dominarem o sabor, e o sorvete tinha uma consistência satisfatória. O local em si é mais como um quiosque. O prédio contém uma pequena área interna que inclui a cozinha e espaço para a fila de espera, mas não oferece assentos imediatos. Ao sair, há assentos internos na forma de uma tenda próxima com mesas e cadeiras, além de algumas bancas ao ar livre.
text_en: Delicious ice cream with a wide variety of flavors that change constantly. Mason’s Creamery is well-known locally for its unique flavors, and in my opinion, it meets expectations quite well. I’ve tried the mango and taro flavors (I have a moderate preference for taro—the mango flavor started to taste a bit mushy after a few scoops). I also saw flavors like guava and sweet corn, among others. The mango and taro flavors were strong, but not so intense that they overpowered the overall taste; the ice cream had a satisfying consistency. The place itself is more like a kiosk. The building has a small interior area that includes a kitchen and space for waiting, but there are no immediate seating options. When leaving, there are indoor seating areas in a tent nearby with tables and chairs, along with some outdoor benches.
original: Great ice cream with a strong variety of rotating flavors. Mason's Creamery is pretty well known locally for its unique flavor concept, and I think it more or less lives up to the hype. I've tried the ube and taro flavors so far (moderate preference for taro - the ube did start to taste a little paste-y by the last few spoonfuls), but I've also seen guava and sweet corn, among others. The ube and taro flavor were strong but not to the point where they were overpowering, and the ice cream had a satisfyingly thick consistency. The restaurant itself is more of a stand. The building contains a small indoor area that contains the kitchen and space for a line, but it doesn't offer immediate seating. When you walk outside, there is indoor seating in the form of a nearby tent with tables and chairs, as well as a few outdoor benches.

text: O biscoito de manteiga de amendoim era delicioso. O recheio era muito suave e cremoso. Eu gostaria de ter pedido alguns para levar na minha viagem de volta para Seattle. O bolo de chocolate também estava muito bom. Também experimentei o biscoito de cenoura, que era mais como duas porções macias de bolo de cenoura, com recheio de cream cheese... estava delicioso. Por alguma razão, o croissant simples e o pain au raisin estavam sem graça e secos naquele dia. Compramos por volta das 11 da manhã... que pena, tivemos que jogar a maior parte fora.
text_en: The peanut butter cookies were delicious. The filling was very soft and creamy. I would have liked to order some to take back with me on my trip back to Seattle. The chocolate cake was also really good. I also tried the carrot cookie—it was more like two soft pieces of carrot cake with cream cheese filling… it was delicious. For some reason, the simple croissant and pain au raisin were boring and dry that day. We bought them around 11 a.m… unfortunately, we had to throw most of them away.
original: The nutter butter cookie was heaven. The filling was so smooth and creamy. I wished I ordered some to go for my trip back to Seattle. The red velvet cake was very good too. I also tried the carrot cake cookie which was more like two soft carrot cake muffin tops with cream cheese filling inside...yummy. For some reason, the plain croissant and the pain au raisin tasted stale and dry that day. We purchased it around 11 am...bummer, we had to throw most of it away.

text: food: i love bouchon and i love their bakery. i come here whenever i'm in vegas for the TKO, macarons (all flavors!), carrot cake sandwich and of course, the bouchons. i also love that you can buy thomas keller's amazing jams at the bakery. service: nice and patient final thoughts: hard to find but worth it. it's great :)
text_en: food: i love bouchon and i love their bakery. i come here whenever i'm in vegas for the TKO, macarons (all flavors!), carrot cake sandwich and of course, the bouchons. i also love that you can buy thomas keller's amazing jams at the bakery. service: nice and patient final thoughts: hard to find but worth it. it's great :)

text: In a very unassuming location, but great ice cream!! Location is also a bar, study spot, and food cafe. The ice cream is the creamiest I've had in Phoenix so far (way better than Sweet Republic). I had a biscotti flavor, Nutella, and Kentucky chocolate/vanilla. Served in a Chinese takeout box with a homemade fortune cookie!
text_en: In a very unassuming location, but great ice cream!! Location is also a bar, study spot, and food cafe. The ice cream is the creamiest I've had in Phoenix so far (way better than Sweet Republic). I had a biscotti flavor, Nutella, and Kentucky chocolate/vanilla. Served in a Chinese takeout box with a homemade fortune cookie!

text: O Churn é, sem dúvida, a melhor sorveteria da cidade!!! Seus biscoitos e sorvete de menta são incríveis! Recomendo muito que vocês experimentem! O estacionamento na frente pode ser difícil, mas há estacionamento ao lado do complexo!
text_en: Churn is undoubtedly the best ice cream shop in town!!! Their cookies and mint ice cream are amazing! I highly recommend you give it a try! The parking in front might be difficult, but there’s parking next to the complex!
original: Churn is by far the best ice cream in town!!! Their cookies and mint is incredible! I highly recommend checking them out! Parking in the front is tough but there's parking to the right of the complex!

text: I am gluten free so my options were limited, but I was happy there were options at all! The gluten free birthday cake truffles were AMAZING!!!
text_en: I am gluten free so my options were limited, but I was happy there were options at all! The gluten free birthday cake truffles were AMAZING!!!

text: El pastel de vainilla que he probado en este lugar fue el más delicioso. Me gustaría que hubiera una sucursal de Sprinkles en Charlotte. Está ubicada en el LINQ Promenade. Es muy conveniente para ese hotel y el Flamingo. Si buscas el mejor postre dulce, definitivamente deberías venir aquí.
text_en: The vanilla cake I tried here was the most delicious. I wish there were a Sprinkles branch in Charlotte. It’s located at LINQ Promenade. It’s very convenient for that hotel and the Flamingo. If you’re looking for the best sweet dessert, you definitely should come here.
original: The tastiest cupcake I have consumed was at this place. I wish there was a Sprinkles in Charlotte. It's located in the LINQ Promenade. Very convenient to that hotel and Flamingo. For the best sugar fix, seriously stop here.

text: Went to this location on a Saturday and night and man it was packed at midnight like it was peak hours. It was smaller than the other locations I have been to and a lot of items were sold out as well. I wanted fruit tart but they didn't have any. The long was line too considering it was midnight but i guess that may be the norm for this location.
text_en: Went to this location on a Saturday and night and man it was packed at midnight like it was peak hours. It was smaller than the other locations I have been to and a lot of items were sold out as well. I wanted fruit tart but they didn't have any. The long was line too considering it was midnight but i guess that may be the norm for this location.

text: Mis amigos y yo decidimos ir al NODA en la calle 36, y mientras estábamos en el vestíbulo, decidimos ir a la panadería francesa "Amélie" desde allí. Pensamos que sería genial, sin colas, ¡pero no! La cola era enorme, ¡pero me encantan sus pasteles y el sopa de cangrejo! Es un lugar fantástico, abierto las 24 horas, y puedes llevar tu portátil. Si estás a dieta, déjalo en la puerta.
text_en: My friends and I decided to go to NODA on Street 36. While we were in the lobby, we decided to head over to the French bakery “Amélie” from there. We thought it would be great—no lines at all! But no! The line was huge. However, I absolutely love their cakes and crab soup! It’s a fantastic place, open 24 hours a day, and you can bring your laptop with you. If you’re on a diet, just leave your laptop at the door.
original: Friends and I decided to hang out in NODA at 36th Street, as we sat in the atrium we decided to go to Amelie's French Bakery from the atrium, we thought great no lines, NOT, the line was out the door, I love the treats and the she crab soup, awesome 24 hours, bring your laptop. If you are on a diet, leave it at the DOOR.

text: Sem dúvida, os melhores donuts que já experimentei. Comi um com minha amiga e foi delicioso. O sabor é perfeito, e sempre quero voltar. A equipe é maravilhosa, e adorei o donut de chocolate.
text_en: Without a doubt, the best donuts I’ve ever tried. I ate one with my friend, and it was delicious. The flavor is perfect, and I always want to go back. The team is amazing, and I really liked the chocolate donut.
original: Hands down the BEST donuts. I had them with my friend once and it was delicious. The taste is immaculate, and I always want to come here again and again. Staff is wonderful and I loved the chocolate donut.

text: O pesadelo de um diabético, mas, por amor a todos os donuts... um lugar realmente especial. Café coado em diversos sabores, mas o latte é o ideal para saborear. Bacon com cobertura de maple em um donut... incrível!
text_en: A nightmare for a diabetic, but because of all the donuts… it’s a truly special place. Coffee brewed in various flavors, but latte is the perfect choice to enjoy. Bacon with maple topping on a donut… amazing!
original: A diabetic's nightmare but for the love of all donuts...a true gem of a place. Drip coffee in all sorts of flavor but the latte is the one to get for sipping. Maple glazed bacon on a donut...o.m.g!

text: Como grande fã de Christina Tosi, fiquei muito animado para experimentar o Milk Bar. Infelizmente, fiquei bastante decepcionado. Comprei uma fatia de bolo de aniversário, trufas de bolo de aniversário, um biscoito de milho e uma fatia de "crack pie" (um tipo de torta). O bolo de aniversário foi o que menos gostei. A cobertura tinha um sabor estranho, parecido com limão. As trufas de bolo de aniversário tinham uma textura arenosa, pareciam ser semelhantes às "cupcakes" de bolo de aniversário da Starbucks, mas com chocolate substituído por areia. O biscoito de milho estava extremamente salgado. Parecia que alguém substituiu o açúcar por sal. E a "crack pie" estava ok. Era muito doce e difícil de comer mais de uma mordida. Tinha o sabor de uma torta de nozes, mas sem as nozes. Considerando toda a expectativa e o preço, eu esperava algo melhor.
text_en: As a big fan of Christina Tosi, I was very excited to try the Milk Bar. Unfortunately, I was quite disappointed. I bought a slice of birthday cake, birthday cake truffles, a corn biscuit, and a slice of “crack pie” (a type of cake). The birthday cake was the one I didn’t like the most. The topping had a strange taste, similar to lemon. The birthday cake truffles had a sandy texture; they seemed similar to Starbucks’ birthday cake cupcakes, but with chocolate replaced by sand. The corn biscuit was extremely salty. It seemed like someone replaced sugar with salt. And the “crack pie” was okay—it was very sweet and hard to eat more than one bite. It had the flavor of a walnut cake, but without the walnuts. Considering all the expectations and the price, I expected something better.
original: Being a huge fan of Christina Tosi I was beyond excited to try Milk Bar. I was sadly disappointed. I got a slice of birthday cake, birthday cake truffles, a corn cookie and a slice of crack pie. The birthday cake was my least favorite. The icing had a weird lemon like flavor. The birthday cake truffles were sandy in texture, tasted like a birthday cake pop from Starbucks, but the chocolate replaced with sand. The corn cookie was extremely salty. Like someone replaced the sugar with salt. And the crack pie was alright. It was super sweet and hard to eat more than one bite. It tasted like pecan pie without the pecans. With all the hype and how expensive it was I was hoping for more.

text: El personal fue increíblemente amable y servicial, y se aseguraron de que obtuviera exactamente lo que quería. ¡No me arrepiento de haber gastado el dinero aquí!
text_en: The staff were incredibly kind and helpful, and they made sure I got exactly what I wanted. I don’t regret spending the money here!
original: The staff was so incredibly nice and helpful of getting exactly what you wanted! Didn't regret spending the money here!

text: No estoy seguro de por qué había tanta expectación, ya que está en una zona poco recomendable. Pagué 6 dólares por un helado para niños, y probablemente no volveré.
text_en: I’m not sure why there was so much expectation, since it’s in a less recommended area. I paid $6 for a children’s ice cream, and probably won’t be back again.
original: Not sure what all the hype was it's in a sketchy area and I paid $6 for a kid size ice cream prob won't come back.

text: I'm a fan of David so I really was looking forward to trying the Milk bar. Based on the reviews, I decided to try the crack pie and the cereal milk soft serve. Crack pie? Whack pie. It was gushy and felt like I was biting into something made with a cup of powdered sugar. If you have a super super sweet tooth, then I can see why it's good but if you're looking for flavor and not just plain sugar, pass on this. Cereal milk soft serve? Worth it. Creamy, nostalgic, and great on a hot day! :)
text_en: I'm a fan of David so I really was looking forward to trying the Milk bar. Based on the reviews, I decided to try the crack pie and the cereal milk soft serve. Crack pie? Whack pie. It was gushy and felt like I was biting into something made with a cup of powdered sugar. If you have a super super sweet tooth, then I can see why it's good but if you're looking for flavor and not just plain sugar, pass on this. Cereal milk soft serve? Worth it. Creamy, nostalgic, and great on a hot day! :)

text: Eles oferecem donuts veganos! Hummm... parei lá durante a hora de promoções e comprei muitos donuts por um preço muito baixo! Os donuts estavam deliciosos! Não consegui notar a diferença, já que eram veganos.
text_en: They offer vegan donuts! Hmm… I stopped by during the promotion time and bought many donuts at a very low price! The donuts were delicious! I couldn’t tell the difference, since they were vegan.
original: They offer vegan donuts! Nom nom nom... stopped in during happy hour and got a ton of donuts for a low price! The donuts were great! couldn't tell the difference since they were vegan

text: Se você ainda não conhece bem o bolo de aniversário da Milk Bar, isso deve ser sua próxima prioridade. O melhor bolo de todos os tempos. E a fatia do local em Las Vegas não decepcionou. O chocolate também estava delicioso. O sorvete de leite com cereais é ótimo, mas o bolo é o destaque. Os biscoitos também são incríveis, mas, por enquanto, estou preferindo o bolo. O atendimento foi amigável. Estava movimentado. Cheio de gente. Mas tudo bem. Tudo vale a pena.
text_en: If you haven’t yet gotten to know Milk Bar’s birthday cake well enough, that should be your next priority. It’s the best cake ever. And the slice from the restaurant in Las Vegas didn’t disappoint either. The chocolate was also delicious. The milk ice cream with cereal is great, but the cake is what stands out. The cookies are also amazing, but for now, I prefer the cake. The service was friendly. It was busy—full of people. But it’s okay. Everything is worth it.
original: If you're not yet deeply acquainted with the Milk Bar birthday cake, that should be your next priority. Best. Cake. Ever. And the slice from their Vegas outpost didn't disappoint. Chocolate was also delicious. Cereal milk soft serve is great, but the cake is where it's at. Cookies are also amazing, but sticking with my cake for now. Service was friendly enough. Busy. Crowded. But fine. All totally worth it.

text: Eu vim aqui para uma festa de chá de bebê de uma colega e fiquei muito impressionado com o espaço, a comida e os funcionários. Se você nunca passou além da vitrine de doces na frente desta unidade, está perdendo uma experiência incrível. O espaço é muito grande, é difícil acreditar. Há tantos pequenos objetos decorativos para apreciar que você nunca ficará entediado. Também não sabia que era possível alugar o local. Alguém me disse que ele poderia acomodar uma festa de casamento para 80 pessoas! Nós alugamos apenas algumas salas no fundo para cerca de 20 pessoas, e o espaço foi mais do que suficiente. A Amelie's nos ofereceu uma quiche Lorraine, que estava deliciosa, além de uma quiche de espinafre, seus famosos doces, café e suco de laranja. Fiquei tão impressionado com a comida que levei alguns para casa para meu marido, que provou tudo quase, pois não conseguiu decidir o que comer.
text_en: I came here for a baby tea party organized by a colleague, and I was very impressed with the space, the food, and the staff. If you’ve never seen anything beyond the candy display window in front of this location, you’re missing out on an amazing experience. The space is really large—it’s hard to believe. There are so many small decorative items to enjoy that you’ll never get bored. I also didn’t know that the place could be rented out. Someone told me it could accommodate a wedding party of 80 people! We rented just a few rooms at the back for about 20 people, and the space was more than enough. Amelie’s offered us a Lorraine quiche, which was delicious, along with spinach quiche, their famous desserts, coffee, and orange juice. I was so impressed with the food that I brought some home for my husband; he tried almost everything, as he couldn’t decide what to eat.
original: I came here for a coworkers baby shower and could not have been more impressed with the space, the food, and the employees. If you've never been beyond the pastry case in the front of this location you are missing out. It extends so far back it's hard to believe. They have so many little nick-knacks to look at you'll never be bored. I also didn't realize you could rent the place out. Someone told me that it could hold a wedding party of 80! We only had the back rooms rented out for about 20 people and it was plenty of space. Amelie's provided quiche Lorraine which was wonderful, as well as a spinach quiche, their famous pastries, coffee, and orange juice. I was so impressed with their food I took some home to my husband, who took literally a bite out of everything because he couldn't decide what to eat.

text: Experimente o sundae com Toffee Banoffee. O sorvete regular é ótimo, mas se você quiser a experiência completa e o melhor custo-benefício, peça um sundae. Você não vai se arrepender.
text_en: Try the sundae with Toffee Banoffee. The regular ice cream is great, but if you want the full experience and the best value, order a sundae. You won’t regret it.
original: Must try the Toffee Banofi Sundae. The regular ice cream is great, but if you want the full experience and moneys worth get a sundae. You wont regret it.

text: Staff is so lovely and really take care of you. Even during the pandemic they managed to stay sweet. Recommend this ice cream shop over any.
text_en: Staff is so lovely and really take care of you. Even during the pandemic they managed to stay sweet. Recommend this ice cream shop over any.

text: Siempre es un buen lugar para tomar un café, disfrutar de un almuerzo agradable o cenar algo dulce.
text_en: It’s always a good place to have a coffee, enjoy a pleasant lunch, or eat something sweet for dinner.
original: You can't go wrong with Amelie's. Always a great place to grab coffee, a nice lunch or late night dessert.

text: Levei minha filha hoje... um lugar muito legal e moderno, com donuts por toda parte! Pedimos o cheesecake de morango e os donuts com Nutella... estava delicioso!
text_en: I took my daughter today to a really cool and modern place, with donuts everywhere! We ordered strawberry cheesecake and donuts with Nutella… it was delicious!
original: Brought my daughter in today... very cool, modern place with donuts everywhere! We had the strawberry cheesecake and the Nutella galore... so good!

text: Uau! Acabei de sair deste lugar e foi a MELHOR experiência! Os donuts são incrivelmente deliciosos, os sabores do sorvete são únicos e o atendimento é excelente! É ótimo encontrar pequenos negócios tão apaixonados pelo que fazem, obrigado!
text_en: Wow! I just left this place, and it was the BEST experience ever! The donuts are incredibly delicious, the ice cream flavors are unique, and the service is excellent! It’s great to meet small businesses that are so passionate about what they do; thank you!
original: Wow! Just left this place and it's the BEST! The actual doughnut is so delicious, the flavors of the ice cream are so unique and the customer service is amazing! Love to find small businesses this passionate for what they do, thank you!

text: Can't get enough of this place. Wish they had another location this place is always pack and very hard to find parking. This is located in a big plaza with dozen of other restaurants. Worth the wait just to have the salt bread. So very buttery and a hint of sea salt. Ham and cheese is a great snack for on the go. The custard bread is really good too if you need something sweet. The bite size cheese cakes are so cute and delicious. I tried their mango slush and that was really good too and not too overly sweet.
text_en: Can't get enough of this place. Wish they had another location this place is always pack and very hard to find parking. This is located in a big plaza with dozen of other restaurants. Worth the wait just to have the salt bread. So very buttery and a hint of sea salt. Ham and cheese is a great snack for on the go. The custard bread is really good too if you need something sweet. The bite size cheese cakes are so cute and delicious. I tried their mango slush and that was really good too and not too overly sweet.

text: A pocas cuadras del centro, este lugar de donuts ofrecía una selección interesante de variedades. Probé el "Big Papa", el "queso a la parrilla", el "crème brûlée" y el de Nutella. El "Big Papa" era grande y dulce, ¡tenía un "pop tart" de tamaño normal dentro! Lo recomiendo por la oportunidad de tomar fotos y por la experiencia. Creo que el "queso a la parrilla" era bueno como combinación de sabores salados y dulces. Eran dos donuts de azúcar calientes con queso entre ellos; eran grandes y fácilmente compartibles entre mis dos amigos y yo. El "crème brûlée" lo pedimos porque el empleado nos dijo que era uno de los más vendidos. Lo encontré decente, pero no particularmente impresionante. Tenía una capa de caramelo crujiente en la parte superior y crema en el interior. Probablemente sea una cuestión de gustos personales, pero preferiría el "Boston crème" por la experiencia de chocolate y crema. Finalmente, el donut de Nutella no tenía un sabor a Nutella muy pronunciado. Es difícil transmitir el sabor de la Nutella sin usarla realmente. El café está bien, pero preferiría un café de una cafetería. Sin embargo, fue agradable acompañarlo con los donuts. Tienen una zona con terraza donde se puede comer en la parte trasera, y un acuario muy divertido en el interior. El ambiente es más para ir y disfrutar, que para quedarse y relajarse. Fue una parada agradable y rápida por la mañana.
text_en: Just a few blocks from the center, this donut shop offered an interesting selection of varieties. I tried the “Big Papa,” “grilled cheese,” “crème brûlée,” and Nutella donuts. The “Big Papa” was large and sweet—it even had a normal-sized “pop tart” inside! I recommend it because it’s easy to take photos and it offers a great experience. I think the “grilled cheese” was good as a combination of salty and sweet flavors. It was two warm sugar-filled donuts with cheese between them; they were big enough for me and my two friends to share easily. We ordered the “crème brûlée” because the staff said it was one of the best-selling items. I found it decent, but not particularly impressive. There was a crispy layer of caramel on top and cream inside. It might be a matter of personal taste, but I would prefer the “Boston crème” due to the chocolate and cream combination. Finally, the Nutella donut didn’t have a very pronounced Nutella flavor. It’s hard to convey the Nutella taste without actually using it. The coffee is okay, but I would prefer coffee from a café. However, it was pleasant to enjoy it with the donuts. They have a terrace area where you can eat in the back, and a fun aquarium inside. The atmosphere is more about enjoying it quickly rather than staying and relaxing. It was a nice quick stop in the morning.
original: A few blocks away from the downtown strip, this donut place had an interesting selection of donuts! I tried the Big papa, the grilled cheese, the crÃ¨me brule, and the Nutella. The big papa was large and sugary, it had a full size pop tart inside! I recommend it for the photo op and experience. I thought the grilled cheese was good as a salty sweet combo! It was 2 warm sugar donuts with cheese in between, its massive and was easily shared between my 2 friends and I. the crÃ¨me brule we got because the employee told us it was a best seller. I thought it was decent but nothing super impressive. It had a hard caramel crunch on top with crÃ¨me on the inside. It is probably personal preference but I would have rather had the Boston crÃ¨me for the chocolate and crÃ¨me experience. Lastly, the Nutella donut did not have a super strong Nutella flavor. Nutella is a tricky flavor to get across without actually using Nutella. The coffee is ok, I would have rather had coffee from a coffee shop. It was nice to have to go with the donuts though. They have a patio area where you can eat in the back and a super fun fish tank inside. The ambiance is more to go than stay and chill. It was a nice quick stop in the morning.

text: Probably the best ice cream place I've gone to in Phoenix and I've been to a lot of ice cream places this year. The flavors are always delicious, the customer service is always fast and efficient and friendly and the prices are very reasonable. I return quite often. The cookies and milk ice cream is to simply die for.
text_en: Probably the best ice cream place I've gone to in Phoenix and I've been to a lot of ice cream places this year. The flavors are always delicious, the customer service is always fast and efficient and friendly and the prices are very reasonable. I return quite often. The cookies and milk ice cream is to simply die for.

text: These are donuts for people who think they don't like donuts. Why? Because once you've tried one you'll say, "Wow--this must be what donuts are supposed to taste like." Or maybe even a "Oh, so this is why everyone goes nuts over these things." Don't get me wrong, I'll alway be a bagel gal, but these donuts are the top of the line. I had one--just one!--and it shook my world. And get this... It was only a glazed one. I know. That little 'ole glazed donut was airy, light, not too sweet, perfection in my mouth. It's mind-boggling that I didn't even eat it hot and it was still that good. Anyways, I'm going back and I'm not even waiting for a cheat day. It's worth the extra day of exercise, trust me--and these 5-stars.

text: Sprinkles é sempre uma ótima opção! Já experimentei os cupcakes deles antes, mas esta foi a primeira vez que provei o sanduíche de sorvete deles na unidade do Strip em Las Vegas. A loja está localizada no centro do Strip, então é um local conveniente para um lanche. Além disso, fica perto de uma fonte e de uma roda gigante, o que permite comer ao ar livre e apreciar a vista e o clima. Eles oferecem uma grande variedade de opções de sobremesas: sorvete, sanduíche de sorvete, sanduíche de biscoito, etc. Eu queria experimentar o sanduíche de sorvete, então, é claro, pedi o sanduíche de "red velvet" com sorvete de "red velvet". Delicioso! Com certeza, vale a pena experimentar o Sprinkles se você estiver na área!
text_en: Sprinkles is always a great choice! I’ve already tried their cupcakes before, but this was the first time I tried their ice cream sandwich at the Strip location in Las Vegas. The store is located right in the center of the Strip, so it’s a convenient place for a snack. Additionally, it’s close to a fountain and a giant carousel, allowing you to eat outdoors and enjoy the view and atmosphere. They offer a wide range of desserts: ice cream, ice cream sandwich, biscuit sandwich, etc. I wanted to try the ice cream sandwich, so naturally, I ordered the “red velvet” sandwich with red velvet ice cream. Delicious! Definitely worth trying if you’re in the area!
original: Sprinkles is always a good idea! I've had their cupcakes before but it was my first time trying their ice scream sandwich at their Las Vegas Strip location. The store is located in the right in middle of the Strip so it's a convenient stop for dessert. It's also right by a fountain and a ferris wheel so you can eat outside and enjoy the view and weather. They have a wide range of choices for dessert: ice cream, ice cream sandwich, cookie sandwich, etc. I wanted to try the ice cream sandwich so of course I ordered the red velvet sandwich with red velvet ice cream. YUM. Definitely give Sprinkles a try if you're in the area!

text: So glad Jeni opened a location in Charlotte. Amazing, tasty ice cream Several unique flavors, my favorite is the brown butter almond brittle, so tasty and crunchy. Amazingly delicious
text_en: So glad Jeni opened a location in Charlotte. Amazing, tasty ice cream Several unique flavors, my favorite is the brown butter almond brittle, so tasty and crunchy. Amazingly delicious

text: In terms of price, selection, portion and taste -- Milk Bar is a flat 2.5 out of 5. The concept has so much potential, but the execution falls short. My boyfriend and I came by last night for a pre-Marquee treat. We noticed the "Fancy Shakes" -- classic milkshakes with alcohol included -- and decided to try a couple. He went with the Cereal Milk White Russian, and I went with the Chocolate Malt. Both were $12 each, both had vodka and kahlua. Maybe we should've gone with something else, but these were pretty lackluster. They were extremely sweet, even for milkshakes, and the alcohol didn't seem to complement the taste at all. Hard to finish, and they were tiny to begin with! Rounding up because they have a delicious variety of cookies and other drinks. Plus, they're open late. Wish they had more than 4 flavors of shakes, though. We will not be back.

text: Adoro o sorvete com a sobremesa "s'more". Não gosto do sanduíche de sorvete com chocolate. O primeiro pedaço estava delicioso, mas ambos os biscoitos tinham muito sal, o que não consegui suportar. Em seguida, o sal se espalhou pelo meu sorvete e ficou tão salgado que não consegui comer. Foi um momento triste, pois o sorvete é realmente delicioso. Também adoro o atendimento ao cliente, os funcionários são muito simpáticos. Voltarei para experimentar o sorvete em formato de cone de pretzel. Os sorvetes que mais gosto são o de menta e o de café vietnamita.
text_en: I love the ice cream with the “s’more” topping. I don’t like the ice cream sandwich with chocolate. The first piece was delicious, but both cookies had too much salt, which I couldn’t tolerate. Then, the salt spread throughout my ice cream, making it so salty that I couldn’t eat it. It was a sad moment, as the ice cream is really delicious. I also really appreciate the customer service; the staff are very friendly. I’ll go back to try the ice cream in pretzel cone shape. My favorite ice creams are mint and Vietnamese coffee flavor.
original: I love the s'more ice cream sundae. I dislike the chocolate chip ice cream sandwich. The first bite was delicious but both of my cookies had so much salt on them that I couldn't handle it. Then salt got all over my ice cream and it was so salty I couldn't eat my ice cream, a sad moment because the ice cream is down right delicious. I also love the customer service, pretty nice employees. I will be going back because I want to try the pretzel ice cream cone. The ice cream I love are the mint cookie and the Vietnamese coffee.

text: Um delicioso café da manhã com inspiração francesa, preparado com maestria pelos padeiros do Bouchon. Pão de epice com manteiga e geleia. Pão de chocolate. Macaron de chocolate e um latte. Vou sonhar com essa combinação até a próxima vez que estiver com eles nas minhas mãos.
text_en: A delicious breakfast with French inspiration, expertly prepared by the bakers at Bouchon. Crusty bread with butter and jam. Chocolate bread. A chocolate macaron and a latte. I’ll dream about this combination the next time I have them in my hands.
original: Perfect French inspired breakfast made possible by the skilled Bouchon bakers. Pain d'epi with butter & marmalade. Pain au chocolat. Macaron chocolat and a latte. I'll be dreaming of this combination until the next time I'm clutching them in my excited little hands.

text: Pedí cupcakes para celebrar el cumpleaños de un amigo. No solo estaban muy bien empaquetados, sino que también estaban deliciosos. No había estado en Sprinkles en años y olvidé lo buenos que son estos cupcakes... sin duda, siguen siendo los mejores.
text_en: I ordered cupcakes to celebrate a friend’s birthday. They weren’t just well-packaged, but they were also delicious. It had been years since I’d been to Sprinkles, and I forgot how good these cupcakes are… undoubtedly, they’re still the best.
original: I ordered delivered cupcakes for a friends birthday celebration. Not only were they packed so nicely but they were absolutely delicious. I hadn't been to Sprinkles in years and forgot just how darn good these cupcakes are.... by far you remain the next.

text: Tendrás que pagar un precio elevado por su nombre. 8,95 $ por una rebanada de pastel que es mediocre. Los cannoli estaban bien. El personal no es nada amable. Prepárate para gastar unos 50 $ por 4-5 postres diferentes.
text_en: You’ll have to pay a high price for its name. $8.95 for a slice of cake that’s mediocre. The cannoli were good. The staff isn’t very friendly. Be prepared to spend about $50 on 4–5 different desserts.
original: You will pay high price for his name. $8.95 for a slice of cake that is mediocre. Cannoli was okay. Staff is not friendly at all. Be ready to drop $50 for 4-5 different pastries.

text: El "helado de atardecer en el Pacífico" y el helado de galletas y crema son los mejores que se pueden encontrar en la ciudad. A mi novio y a mí nos encanta venir a comprar helados para llevar, junto con nuestro postre para esa noche. ¡Sois los mejores y el dueño es muy amable! Solo hay una cosa... la cantidad de veces que hemos tenido antojo de un helado o de unos cuantos cubos después de las 8 de la noche es increíble. Esperamos que podáis encontrar una manera de quedaros abiertos más tarde, sabemos que en Arizona mucha gente no sale hasta que se pone el sol. Para el verano, quizás deberíais considerar esto, ya que el sol se pone a las 8 de la noche. ¡Estamos deseando disfrutar de vuestra deliciosa comida de nuevo!
text_en: The “Pacific Sunset Ice Cream” and cookie-cream ice cream are the best ones you can find in the city. My boyfriend and I love going there to buy ice creams to take home, along with our dessert for that night. You’re the best, and the owner is very kind! There’s just one thing… the number of times we feel like having an ice cream or several scoops after 8 p.m. is incredible. We hope you can find a way to stay open later; we know that many people in Arizona don’t go out until sunset. For summer, maybe you should consider this place, since the sun sets at 8 p.m. We can’t wait to enjoy your delicious food again!
original: The pacific sunset snow-cone and the cookies & cream ice cream are the best you'll find in town. My boyfriend and I love coming in for pints of ice cream to-go, along with our dessert for that night. You guys are the absolute best and the owner is so nice! Theres just one thing....the amount of times we have been craving a snow cone or some scoops of ice cream after 8pm is insane. We wish you guys would be able to find a way to stay open later, we know in Arizona a lot of people don't come out until the sun goes down. For the summer you should look into this maybe as the sun will be going down at 8pm. We can't wait to enjoy your delicious food again.

text: É um lugar incrível para desfrutar de sorvetes realmente deliciosos. Gosto muito da decoração do local. É muito agradável, pois se pode ver o sorvete sendo preparado diante dos próprios olhos. Suba ao segundo andar para ter uma vista panorâmica da fábrica. Há uma grande variedade de sabores para escolher, definitivamente um ótimo lugar.
text_en: It’s an amazing place to enjoy truly delicious ice cream. I really like the decor of the place. It’s very pleasant, as you can see the ice cream being prepared right in front of your eyes. Go up to the second floor for a panoramic view of the factory. There’s a wide variety of flavors to choose from—definitely a great place.
original: This is an awesome place to enjoy some really good ice cream. Really like the dÃ©cor of the place. It's so nice one can see the ice cream being made in front of one's eyes. Head to second floor to have a nice bird's eye view of the factory. Plenty to great flavors to choose from , definitely a great spot.

text: Cheguei cedo, com a esperança de encontrar pães e doces frescos, mas descobri que os produtos estavam frios e pareciam ter sido feitos no dia anterior.
text_en: I arrived early, hoping to find fresh bread and sweets, but I found that the products were cold and seemed to have been made the day before.
original: Went early and hoping for freshly baked pastries however the pastries were cold and tasted day old.

text: Ok, então, por que esse lugar manteve esse segredo comigo por tanto tempo? O segredo de Summerlin. O sorvete desse lugar é perigoso. Os sabores são intensos, são cremosos e realmente têm o sabor que se espera. Já experimentou algo chamado "morango..." ou "ameixa...?" mas quando você prova, sente que foi enganado? No entanto, isso não acontecerá no Handel's. Adoro o Graham Central Station, com pedaços de biscoitos de biscoito Graham, um sabor de baunilha com canela e uma quantidade incrível de sabor... um verdadeiro pecado! Mas, só ligue para o 911 depois de experimentar o bolo de aniversário deles. Eu gostaria que não tivesse granulado, mas a cobertura e o sabor são realmente excelentes. Minha sugestão é que você experimente o "sampler" de 4 sabores. A única coisa é que, se estiver calor lá fora, você melhor comer rápido, haha.
text_en: Okay, so why did this place keep this secret from me for so long? The secret of Summerlin. The ice cream here is dangerous. The flavors are intense, creamy, and truly match what you expect. Have you tried something called “strawberry…” or “quince…?” but when you try it, do you feel like you’ve been deceived? However, that won’t happen at Handel’s. I love Graham Central Station—with pieces of Graham cookies, a vanilla-cinnamon flavor, and an incredible amount of taste… a real sin! But only call 911 after trying their birthday cake. I wish there wasn’t that granule in it, but the topping and flavor are really excellent. My suggestion is to try the “sampler” of 4 flavors. The only thing is, if it’s hot outside, you’d better eat it quickly, haha.
original: Okay, so why was this gem hidden away from me for so long. Summerlins little secret. The ice cream at this place is dangerous. The flavors are rich, they're creamy and truly taste like they should. Have you ever had something called "strawberry something" or "cherry whatever" but when you taste it you feel like you've been duped? Well that won't be the case at Handel's. I love the Graham Central Station, with chunks of graham cracker cookies, a cinnamon-y vanillaish flavor with oodles of goodness in there... good greif call 911. But only call 911 after you've tried their Birthday Cake. I wish it didn't have the sprinkles in it but the swirls of icing and the actual flavor are so good. My suggestion is that you get the 4 scoop sampler. The only thing is that if it's hot outside, you better eat up quickly, lol

text: Stopped in this Sunday morning to pick up breakfast to go. Despite what other reviews suggest, the line was quite short and my food was served promptly. The pastry options were beautiful and extensive, but I chose to go with a croissant egg and cheese breakfast sandwich and a cappuccino. Let me tell you. I think I made the right choice. The sandwich was buttery, flaky, and hearty without being greasy, which is truly an art. A simple delight. And the cappuccino was fabulous, and topped with cinnamon and cocoa. Next time, I'll definitely have the cappuccino at the restaurant, as I think it would have been even better piping hot. It's Little Italy in Cleveland, so parking is a challenge, but Presti's is well worth a few drives around the block.

text: Si disfrutas del "milk and cereal" de Afters en California, también te encantará este lugar. Tienen su propia versión con galletas de maíz sobre helado de leche, y es un capricho realmente delicioso mientras estás en Las Vegas. Lo que me gustó es que el helado no era demasiado dulce, y el sabor salado de las galletas de maíz combinaba muy bien. Probé todas sus galletas (excepto la de confeti) y mi conclusión final es que la de "BLUEBERRY AND CREME" es la MEJOR. Las demás, para mí, sabían exactamente como las galletas de chocolate normales. La de "BLUEBERRY AND CREME" realmente destacó. Además, tiene un equilibrio perfecto de dulzor. De hecho, sabe exactamente como un helado de leche con arándanos. Si alguna vez vuelvo a visitar Milk en Las Vegas, probablemente sea por las galletas.
text_en: If you enjoy the “milk and cereal” dessert at Afters in California, you’ll also love this place. They have their own version with corn cookies on milk ice cream, and it’s a truly delicious treat when you’re in Las Vegas. What I liked was that the ice cream wasn’t too sweet, and the salty taste of the corn cookies combined very well. I tried all their cookies (except the confetti one), and my final conclusion is that the “BLUEBERRY AND CREME” cookie is the best. The others tasted exactly like regular chocolate cookies. The “BLUEBERRY AND CREME” cookie stood out especially. Moreover, it has a perfect balance of sweetness. In fact, it tastes just like a strawberry milk ice cream. If I ever visit Milk in Las Vegas again, it’s probably because of the cookies.
original: If you enjoy milk and cereal from Afters in California, you'll enjoy this place as well. They have their own version with cornflakes on top of milk ice cream and it's a really nice treat to have while in Vegas! What I liked was that the ice cream wasn't too sweet, and the saltiness of the cornflakes went well with it. I tried all their cookies (besides the confetti) and my final verdict is that the BLUEBERRY AND CREME is THE BEST ONE. The others tasted just like regular chocolate chip cookies to me. Blueberry and creme really stood out! Also perfect balance of sweetness. Really does tastes like a blueberry milk ice cream. If I ever visit Milk in Vegas again, it'll most likely be for the cookie.

text: ¡Ah! ¡Qué bueno! No esperábamos nada igual cuando entramos, pero el ambiente es genial y hay muchísimas opciones. También tienen decoraciones muy bonitas. En general, una experiencia excelente.

text: Prós: doces deliciosos, muitos detalhes e trabalho são investidos em cada doce, preços ótimos, funcionários amigáveis e atendimento rápido... Contras: espaço pequeno e pode ficar muito cheio... No geral, um lugar imperdível em Las Vegas se você gosta de doces... eles dedicam muito esforço e atenção em cada doce que sai da cozinha... Importante: Carlo é o pai do Buddy V e está localizado ao lado do restaurante Buddy V. Demonstra muito respeito por Carlo, pois ele se preocupa com seus clientes e os detalhes são importantes.
text_en: Pros: Delicious desserts, many details, and great care is put into each dessert. Great prices, friendly staff, and quick service… Cons: Small space and can get very crowded… Overall, a must-visit place in Las Vegas if you like desserts… They put a lot of effort and attention into each dessert that comes out of the kitchen… Important note: Carlo is the father of Buddy V, and the restaurant is located next to Buddy V’s restaurant. They show great respect for Carlo because they care about their customers and pay attention to details.
original: Pros: great pastries, lots of detail and work go into each pastry, great prices, friendly staff, and fast service... Cons: small inside and gets crowded... Overall, a must place to visit in Las Vegas if you love pastries...they put so much effort and detail in every pastry that goes out of the kitchen...FYI Carlo is Buddy V's dad and is located across Buddy V's restaurant...much respect for Carlo because he cares about his customers and the details matter...

text: Você não pode errar com o sorvete da Handel's. Este é o 4º local da Handel's que visitei (Northridge, Carlsbad, Redondo Beach), mas os sabores aqui são os mais inconsistentes. O sorvete de creme de banana e a barra de limão tinham uma quantidade excessiva de base de biscoito Graham e faltava o sabor da fruta. O atendimento ao cliente foi amigável e eficiente, assim como nos outros locais da Handel's.
text_en: You can’t go wrong with Handel’s ice cream. This is the 4th location I’ve visited at Handel’s (Northridge, Carlsbad, Redondo Beach), but the flavors here are the most inconsistent. The banana cream ice cream and lemon bars had too much Graham cracker base, and the fruit flavor was missing. The customer service was friendly and efficient, just like at the other Handel’s locations.
original: You can't go wrong with Handel's ice cream. This is the 4th Handel's location I've been to (Northridge, Carlsbad, Redondo beach) but the flavors here are the most inconsistent. Banana cream pie and lemon bar were heavy on the graham cracker crust and lacked fruit flavor. Customer service was friendly and efficient, just like the other Handel's locations.

text: Decidimos probar la máquina expendedora de cupcakes durante un viaje a Las Vegas en diciembre. Se puede entrar en la tienda y pedir su golosina, pero, ¿dónde está la diversión en eso? Es algo que hay que experimentar al menos una vez. Se realiza el pedido, se introduce el pago y luego se puede ver cómo los brazos robóticos toman el dulce de una pantalla de ordenador. La máquina enfatiza que no se cobran cargos hasta que el postre está en la mano. Vienen individualmente empaquetados en pequeñas cajas con el logo de "sprinkles" (chispas). Mi esposa pidió una galleta de mantequilla de cacahuete y yo pedí un cupcake con glaseado de mantequilla especiada. Ambos eran de un buen tamaño y el precio era razonable. Espero ver más de estos lugares en California. Si los hubiera, serían un éxito. También tienen mesas y sillas justo afuera, lo cual fue muy práctico.
text_en: We decided to try the cupcake machine during a trip to Las Vegas in December. You can enter the store and order your treat, but what’s the fun in that? It’s something you should experience at least once. You make the order, pay, and then watch the robotic arms pick up the dessert from a computer screen. The machine emphasizes that no charges are applied until the dessert is in your hand. They come packaged individually in small boxes with the “sprinkles” logo. My wife ordered a peanut butter cookie, and I asked for a cupcake with spiced butter frosting. Both were of decent size, and the price was reasonable. I hope to see more of these places in California. If they exist there, they would be a success. There are also tables and chairs right outside, which was very convenient.
original: We decided to use the cupcake atm during a vegas trip back in December. You can go into the shop and order your snack, but where's the fun in that? It was one of those things that you have to experience at least once. You place your order, enter your payment and then you can watch the robot arms grab your treat from a computer screen. The machine emphasizes that no charges are made until your dessert is in hand. They come individually packaged in little boxes that have a sprinkles logo on it. My wife ordered a peanut butter cookie and i ordered a cupcake with a spiced butter cream frosting. Both were a good size and the price was reasonable. I hope to see more of these spots pop up in California. You'd have yourselves a regular if you did. They also have tables and chairs right outside which was convenient.

text: Una sola palabra: macarons. Perfectamente masticables, dulces y lo suficientemente grandes para satisfacer cualquier antojo. Aunque son un poco caros, los macarons de este lugar valen la pena. Siempre vengo aquí para comprar una caja cada vez que estoy en Las Vegas, y seguiré haciéndolo. Me encanta el macaron de café, y el de pistacho es una excelente segunda opción. Todos los demás sabores también son deliciosos. El croissant de almendra también es muy rico si quieres darte un capricho.
text_en: Just one word: macarons. Perfectly chewy, sweet, and big enough to satisfy any craving. Although they’re a bit expensive, the macarons here are worth it. I always come here to buy a box every time I’m in Las Vegas, and I will continue to do so. I love the coffee macaron, and the pistachio one is an excellent second choice. All the other flavors are also delicious. The almond croissant is also very tasty if you want to treat yourself.
original: One word: macarons. Perfectly chewy and sweet and large enough to fulfill your sweet tooth. Although pricey, the macarons here are well worth it. I come here to bring home a box every time I visit Vegas, and will continue to do so. I love the coffee macaron, and the pistachio is a close second. All other flavors are delicious as well. The almond croissant is also yummy if you're feeling a little indulgent.

The bakery is quite small, so I can understand why there are so many lines. The cannoli were definitely worth the wait! And also, the chocolate cookie (half white, half chocolate). Delicious!
original: I'm only giving it 4 stars because of the lines they get. You would think if they get a lot of people, they would get just a tad bit more staff. The bakery is very small, so I guess I understand why the long lines. The cannoli was soooo worth the wait! That, and the chocolate dipped cookie (it's half white, half milk chocolate). Yum yum yum!
