original: This place is so tasty! Really beautiful presentation and even better taste!! The owners are really friendly and made us feel at home when we went in. I definitely recommend this bakery if you're looking for quality desserts in concord.

text: Un lugar excelente en Lawrenceville. Fui aquí porque dos de mis amigos pidieron su pastel de bodas aquí (¡y estaba genial!). El espacio en sí es muy interesante, tienen un estilo de decoración ecléctico. Ofrecen una variedad de productos, algunos un poco inusuales, pero en general, creo que la mayoría de la gente podría encontrar algo que les guste. También tienen una buena selección de bebidas (café, espresso, etc.). Pedí el pastel de arándanos y rosas con crema de mantequilla de vainilla. Su glaseado es fantástico, pero el pastel, en mi opinión, estaba un poco seco. Los precios son un poco elevados. Definitivamente volvería a este lugar.
text_en: An excellent place in Lawrenceville. I went here because two of my friends ordered their wedding cakes there (and they were great!). The space itself is very interesting; they have an eclectic style of decoration. They offer a variety of products, some of which are a bit unusual, but overall, I think most people can find something they like. They also have a good selection of beverages (coffee, espresso, etc.). I ordered the raspberry and rose cake with vanilla buttercream frosting. The frosting is fantastic, but the cake, in my opinion, was a bit dry. The prices are a little high. Definitely would go back to this place.
original: A solid spot in Lawrenceville. Went here because two of my friends had their wedding cake from here (it was great!). The space itself is cool, they have an eclectic style of decor inside. They have a nice variety of offerings, some a little strange, but overall I think most people could find something here. They also have some great beverage options (coffee, espresso, etc.). I had the blueberry rose cake with vanilla buttercream. Their icing is fantastic but the cake was a little dry for my liking. Prices are a little steep. Would definitely try this place again.

text: Eu realmente gostaria de gostar... Já estive lá duas vezes, pois quero dar uma segunda chance... Para quem gosta de sobremesas, a experiência não foi muito satisfatória... Em ambas as ocasiões, alguns pratos estavam secos, enquanto outros faltavam sabor... O ambiente é ótimo e o atendimento é muito bom, mas a qualidade da comida não corresponde.
text_en: I really would like to enjoy it… I’ve been there twice, because I want to give it another chance… For those who love desserts, the experience wasn’t very satisfying… On both visits, some dishes were dry, while others lacked flavor… The atmosphere is great and the service is excellent, but the quality of the food doesn’t match that.
original: I really want to like it... Been there twice cause I want to give it a second chance... For someone who loves desserts it just wasn't there... Certain things were dry other things were lacking flavor both times ... Great Decour and really nice service but the food quality is just not there

text: Este lugar é incrível! Os donuts são perfeitamente feitos, com um nível de detalhe e sabor impressionantes. Os preços refletem a qualidade, mas, no fim das contas, vale a pena! Não é possível encontrar donuts como este em qualquer lugar. Além disso, eles oferecem leite com morango em máquina... Quem faz isso?! Obrigado, "donut bar", por oferecer isso!
text_en: This place is amazing! The donuts are perfectly made, with impressive detail and flavor. The prices reflect the quality, but in the end, it’s worth it! You can’t find donuts like these anywhere else. Moreover, they offer strawberry milk from a machine… Who does that?! Thank you, “Donut Bar”, for offering this!
original: This place is great! The donuts are perfectly crafted and put together with amazing detail and deliciousness. The prices definitely reflect it, but hey, it's worth it! You can't get donuts like this just anywhere! Plus, they have strawberry milk on tap... Who does that?!?! Thank you donut bar, for doing that!

text: Cinco palavras: CULINHA DE MERANGUE COM SORVETE EM FORMATO DE PALITO!!! Sério, a melhor coisa em Las Vegas, especialmente em um dia quente de verão. Mas é preciso ir cedo, pois eles acabam rapidamente. Então, além desse delicioso palito, também compramos alguns donuts normais. Mas, claro, estes não são "normais"! Pedimos o "oh-my-bday-cake-Oreo", cheesecake de mirtilo, cheesecake de mirtilo com limão Meyer, coco torrado, bolo de aniversário e chocolate Twix. Meu favorito (além do palito de merengue com sorvete de baunilha E molho de chocolate por cima) foi o cheesecake de coco e mirtilo. Todos estavam ótimos, mas, de verdade, eu não conseguia parar de pensar naquele palito de merengue! COM SORVETE! MEU FAVORITO! Adoro sorvete de baunilha! E colocar isso em um palito de merengue é simplesmente genial! Voltamos alguns dias depois, mas chegamos tarde demais! Quase chorei quando vi que já não tinham mais! Este é um lugar DEFINITIVO se você estiver visitando Las Vegas ou se mora lá. Mas vá cedo, pois eles acabam rapidamente, e já no almoço você pode ter azar! Definitivamente vale a pena acordar cedo e pegar esses donuts e sorvete!
text_en: Five words: Meringue ice cream on a stick!!! Seriously, the best thing in Las Vegas, especially on a hot summer day. But you need to go early, because they run out quickly. So, along with that delicious stick, we also bought some regular donuts. But of course, these aren’t “regular” donuts! We ordered “Oh My Birthday Cake Oreo”, raspberry cheesecake, raspberry cheesecake with Meyer lemon, roasted coconut, birthday cake, and Twix chocolate. My favorite (besides the meringue ice cream on a stick with vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce) was the coconut and raspberry cheesecake. All were great, but really, I couldn’t stop thinking about that meringue stick! WITH ICE CREAM! MY FAVORITE! I love vanilla ice cream! And putting it on a meringue stick is simply amazing! We came back a few days later, but it was too late! I almost cried when I saw that they were gone! This is a MUST-visit place if you’re visiting Las Vegas or living there. But go early, because they run out quickly, and you might have bad luck during lunch! Definitely worth waking up early and getting those donuts and ice cream!
original: Five words - CHURRO DONUT ICE CREAM CONE!!! Seriously the best thing in Vegas especially on a hot summer day. But you have to go early bc they run out of their yummy goods so fast! So besides this delicious cone, we also got a few regular donuts. But of course these are far from "regular"! We ordered the oh-my-bday-cake-Oreo, blueberry cheesecake, blueberry with Meyer lemon, toasted coconut, birthday cake, and chocolate twix. My favorite (besides the donut cone with the vanilla soft serve AND chocolate sauce over the top) was the coconut and blueberry cheesecake. They were all good but seriously, I could not get over that darn churro cone! WITH SOFT SERVE! MY FAVORITE! I love soft serve ice cream! And to put it in a churro donut cone is freaking geeeenius! We went back a few days a later but went too late! I seriously almost cried when I saw the sold out on the window!! This is a DEFINITE stop if you're just visiting Vegas or if you live in Vegas. But go early, they run out of everything pretty darn fast, by lunch time, you're gonna be outta luck! Def worth it to wake up early and get that donuts and ice cream!!

text: Bastante normal para nosotros. Muy caro en relación con lo que se obtiene. Prefiero la calidad a la cantidad, pero pagar más de cuatro dólares por una porción muy pequeña de helado es excesivo. Compré el helado de caramelo salado y sabía a congelado. Era muy cremoso, pero prefiero el helado batido de Culver's.
text_en: It’s quite normal for us. It’s very expensive compared to what it offers. I prefer quality over quantity, but paying more than four dollars for a very small portion of ice cream is excessive. I bought the salty caramel ice cream, and it tasted like frozen ice cream. It was very creamy, but I prefer the blended ice cream from Culver’s.
original: Just average for us. Very expensive for what you get. I'm all about quality over quantity but over 4 bucks for a very small scoop of ice cream. I got the salted caramel and it tasted like freezer burn. It was very creamy but I prefer Culver's frozen custard.

text:
Meu amigo recomendou fortemente a La Pasticceria pelos seus doces, então decidi visitar este lugar para experimentar. UAU. Esqueci o quão agradável pode ser observar os doces enquanto espero na fila. Fiquei muito tentado a comprar todos, mas meu bolso não gostaria. Para a minha primeira compra, decidi experimentar o croissant de pêssego e o croissant de Nutella. E não me decepcionei! Estavam deliciosos, e voltei no dia seguinte para comprar alguns antes de voltar para casa. Meu colega de quarto aceitou com prazer o "souvenir" incomum de Las Vegas: P. COMIDA:
* Croissant de pêssego - leve, com sabor de fruta. Gostaria que o geleia de pêssego estivesse distribuída de forma uniforme no croissant.
* Croissant de Nutella - não há erro com a Nutella, mas... (ler a próxima linha)
* Croissant de chocolate - se tivesse que escolher entre o croissant de Nutella e o de chocolate, escolheria o de chocolate. Não sei o porquê, mas gosto mais.
* Croissant com creme - recomendado por um estranho que estava na fila na frente de mim. Delicioso!
ATMOSFERA: Localizada no Eataly, estava tranquila pela manhã, entre 8h e 9h, quando fui. Voltei para jantar em outro restaurante, e lá estava muito movimentado e barulhento. Os funcionários eram muito simpáticos e prestativos. Eles foram muito pacientes. Bônus: A sacola de papel é muito fofa: P. É um pouco caro, mas não há problema em se dar um capricho quando se está em Las Vegas, certo? A melhor forma é compartilhar com a família/amigos, para experimentar um pouco de tudo. Além disso, a manhã deve ser menos agitada!
text_en:
My friend highly recommended La Pasticceria due to its desserts. So I decided to visit this place to try them out. Wow! I forgot how pleasant it is to watch the desserts while waiting in line. I really wanted to buy them all, but my wallet wouldn’t allow it. For my first purchase, I decided to try the peach croissant and the Nutella croissant. And I wasn’t disappointed! They were delicious, and I went back the next day to buy some more before heading home. My roommate happily accepted the “unusual souvenir” from Las Vegas: FOODS:  
* Peach croissant – light in texture, with a fruit flavor. I wish the peach jam was spread evenly across the croissant.  
* Nutella croissant – there’s no mistake with Nutella, but… (read next line)  
* Chocolate croissant – if I had to choose between the Nutella croissant and the chocolate one, I would pick the chocolate one. I don’t know why, but I like it better.  
* Cream-filled croissant – recommended by someone who was in line in front of me. Delicious!  
ATMOSFER: It was quiet during the morning, between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m., when I visited. I went back to another restaurant for dinner, and it was very busy and noisy there. The staff were very friendly and helpful. They were very patient. Bonus: The paper bag is really cute. It’s a bit expensive, but there’s no problem in treating yourself when you’re in Las Vegas, right? The best way is to share it with family/friends so you can try a little of everything. Also, the morning should be less chaotic!
original: My friend strongly recommended La Pasticceria for the pastries, so I made my trip here to try those out. WOW. I forget how eye-pleasing it could be when checking out the pastries while waiting in line. I was very tempted to get all of them-but my wallet would cry if I did. For my first try, I decided to get Apricot Croissant and Nutella Croissant. I did not disappoint! Those were so good and I came back the next day to buy some before heading home. My roommate gladly accepted the untraditional souvenir from Vegas :P FOOD + Apricot Croissant - light, fruity. I wish the apricot jam was evenly spreading out in the croissant + Nutella Croissant - can't go wrong with nutella, but... (read next line) + Chocolate Croissant - if I have to choose between Nutella Croissant vs. Chocolate Croissant, I'd pick Chocolate. I'm not sure why, I just like it better + Cream Croissant - recommended by a stranger who lined up in front of me. Yummy! AMBIANCE Located in Eataly, it was quiet in the morning at 8-9am when I stopped by. I came back to dine at another restaurant later for dinner and it was really loud and crowded. Service Staffs were sooooo friendly and nice. They were very patient too. Bonus The paper bag is really cute :P It's on the pricier side, but it's nothing wrong to treat yourself when you are in Vegas, right? Best way is to share with family/friends so you can try a little bit of everything. Also, morning should be less hectic!

text: Sí... estos donuts están, sin duda, pensados principalmente para Instagram. Compré una docena de donuts diferentes para la familia (pre-ordenados en línea), y a pesar de los sabores interesantes, ninguno destacó realmente. Los donuts estaban bastante secos y con una textura similar al pan (los compré a las 9 de la mañana). Algunos de ellos resultaron sorprendentemente insípidos. La única cualidad positiva es el personal: gente muy amable.
text_en: Yes… these donuts are undoubtedly designed mainly for Instagram. I bought a dozen different types of donuts for the family (pre-ordered online), and despite their interesting flavors, none stood out really. The donuts were quite dry and had a texture similar to bread (I bought them at 9 a.m.). Some of them were surprisingly bland. The only positive aspect is the staff: they’re very friendly.
original: Yep.....these donuts are definitely mainly for Instagram. Donuts were really dry and bready (I picked up the donuts at 9 am). Some of them were surprisingly bland. The only redeeming quality is the staff; super friendly people.

text: A Mason's Cremery é uma pequena loja charmosa, localizada na beira de Ohio City. O atendimento foi excelente. Como visitante pela primeira vez, a atendente gentil me incentivou a experimentar todos os sabores de sorvete e me forneceu informações sobre o local, o que foi muito interessante. O sorvete estava apenas bom. Nada excepcional, e provavelmente escolheria um "frozen yogurt" em vez de uma porção. A textura era boa, mas após a primeira mordida, o sabor não era tão interessante. Experimentei o chocolate triplo e o sorvete de marshmallow e arroz Krispies, e não foram tão impressionantes quanto eu esperava. No entanto, provavelmente voltarei. Eles mudam seus sabores com frequência e pude perceber que têm um toque único. É difícil para uma sorveteria local se destacar em uma cidade com uma rede como a Mitchell's, mas eu escolheria a Mason's.
text_en: Mason’s Cremery is a small, charming store located on the edge of Ohio City. The service was excellent. As a first-time visitor, the kind staff encouraged me to try all the ice cream flavors and provided information about the place—which was very interesting. The ice cream was just good; nothing exceptional. I would probably choose frozen yogurt instead of a portion. The texture was okay, but after the first bite, the flavor wasn’t as appealing. I tried triple chocolate ice cream, marshmallow ice cream, and Krispies rice ice cream—none were as impressive as I expected. However, I might come back. They often change their flavors, and it seems they have a unique touch. It’s hard for a local ice cream shop to stand out in a city with a network like Mitchell’s, but I would still choose Mason’s.
original: Mason's Cremery is a cute little shop on the edge of Ohio City. Their customer service was great. As a first-timer, the sweet girl at the counter encouraged me to try all the flavors of ice cream and told me information about the establishment, which was cool. The ice cream was just ok. Nothing super great and I would probably choose fro-yo over a scoop. The texture was good but after a bite the flavor was no longer exciting. I got the triple chocolate and the marshmallow rice krispie and they didn't live up to their names as much as I had hoped. But I will most likely be back again. They change their flavors often and I could tell they had a unique flair. It's hard for a local ice cream shop to push through in a town with a Mitchell's but I would choose Mason's.

text: Super happy to have finally given this place a try. I went to a very similar shop in NYC & was only hoping for this take on ice cream to spread. I got Frosted Flakes ice cream topped with snickers & teddy grams--soooo good! I was nervous the Frosted Flakes would be really sweet, but it wasn't too much at all. Honestly some of my favorite ice cream now--everyone should try it!

text: Fui para Phoenix para o Fiesta Bowl com minha família e meu namorado no fim de semana passado e estava em busca de uma sobremesa deliciosa após um dia inteiro de festas e petiscos. Pesquisei no Yelp e encontrei o Fatty Daddy's, e fiquei encantada quando vi os marshmallows tostados e os macarons! O Garrett estava trabalhando e conseguiu impressionar meus irmãos, meu namorado e eu com um gelato incrível! Eu pedi uma combinação de sorvete de leite condensado e coco, com um macaron de caramelo, e foi simplesmente divino. Meu namorado adorou tanto que pediu outro! Resumindo: se você estiver em Phoenix, não deixe de ir aqui!
text_en: I went to Phoenix for the Fiesta Bowl with my family and boyfriend last weekend. I was looking for a delicious dessert after a whole day of parties and snacks. I searched on Yelp and found Fatty Daddy’s. I was thrilled when I saw the toasted marshmallows and macarons! Garrett was working, and he managed to impress my brothers, my boyfriend, and me with an amazing ice cream! I ordered a combination of condensed milk ice cream and coconut ice cream, along with a caramel macaron—it was simply divine. My boyfriend loved it so much that he asked for another! In short: if you’re in Phoenix, don’t miss out on going here!
original: Came to Phoenix for the Fiesta Bowl with my family and boyfriend last weekend and was on a mission for a good dessert following a day full of tailgating and apps. Yelped and found Fatty Daddy's and was sold when I saw the toasted marshmallows and macaroons! Garrett was working and he hooked my brothers, my bf and I with amazing gelato! I had a combo of malted milk ball and coconut gelato topped with a caramel macaroon and it was heaven. My bf liked his so much he ordered a second one! Long story short if you're ever in Phoenix, go here!

text: El antojo de algo dulce volvió a aparecer, así que nos dirigimos a "Batch Bakehouse", un lugar con una apariencia discreta (casi imperceptible), pero que no debe engañarte, ¡porque los productos que ofrecen son realmente excepcionales! Después de luchar contra mis propios impulsos para no llevarme todo, decidimos conformarnos con algunas tartas de manzana, un pastel de mantequilla con fresas y crema, y un cupcake de "Black Bottom". Las tartas individuales de manzana son perfectas si quieres evitar el esfuerzo de preparar una porción grande. La masa era deliciosamente mantecosa y la base se mantenía muy bien. El relleno tenía trozos de manzana en lugar de rebanadas, y eso funciona para una "mini" tarta como esta. Los sabores y los niveles de dulzor eran perfectos. El pastel de mantequilla parecía un primo más elegante que un muffin :). Suave, con el queso crema derritiéndose en la boca y un toque agridulce de la fruta que estimulaba el paladar de vez en cuando... ¡Estupendo! Finalmente, el cupcake de "Black Bottom", que, si lo miras bien, es su versión de un pastel de lava. ¿Y quién no lo disfruta? Agradecí que el chocolate, aunque oscuro, no fuera demasiado amargo, y que la corteza exterior no estuviera demasiado seca. No es de extrañar que este lugar tenga tanto éxito y sea una visita obligada.
text_en: The craving for something sweet came back again, so we headed to “Batch Bakehouse” – a place with a discreet appearance (almost imperceptible), but don’t be fooled, because the products they offer are truly exceptional! After fighting against my own impulses to take everything, we decided to settle for some apple tarts, a butter cake with strawberries and cream, and a “Black Bottom” cupcake. The individual apple tarts are perfect if you don’t want to go through the trouble of making a large portion. The dough was deliciously buttery, and the base stayed firm. The filling consisted of apple pieces instead of slices, which works well for a “mini” tart like this. The flavors and levels of sweetness were perfect. The butter cake seemed more elegant than a muffin: soft, with melted cream cheese in the mouth, and a slightly sour-tart flavor from the fruit that stimulates the palate from time to time… Great! Finally, the “Black Bottom” cupcake – if you look closely, it’s actually a version of a lava cake. And who wouldn’t enjoy it? I appreciated that the chocolate, although dark, wasn’t too bitter, and that the outer crust wasn’t too dry. No wonder this place is so popular and a must-visit.
original: The sweet tooth craving struck again and off we went in search of another dangerously good sin maker :). Batch Bakehouse has a very low key appearance (blink and you'll miss kinds) but don't let that fool you coz the goods they have on offer are anything but subtle!! So after fighting with my inner self from not taking EVERYTHING on there, we decided to "settle" for a few Apple Pies, a Strawberry and Creme buttercake and a Black Bottom cupcake. The single serving apple pies are perfect if you wanna avoid the hassle of portioning a big one. The crust was delightfully buttery with the base holding up very well. The filling had bits of apple instead of chucks or slices and that works for a "mini" pie such as itself. The flavors and sweetness levels were spot on! The buttercake felt like a upmarket cousin to a muffin :). Silky with the cream cheese melting in your mouth and the tartness from the berry hitting your taste buds every once in a while..Niceeeeee Lastly the black bottom cupcake which if you look at it is their take on molten lava cake. And who doesn't like that!!! I did appreciate the fact that the chocolate, though dark, wasn't too bitter and outer crust wasn't overly dry. It's no surprise that this place does so well and is a sure shot must try ones!

text: Vale... ¿por qué nadie me había dicho que en Charlotte existe una panadería que está abierta las 24 horas? Es un lugar genial para ir después de cenar y tomar algo. Tienen una gran variedad de cosas deliciosas para probar. ¡Quizás me lleve años probar todo lo que ofrecen! Consejo: ¡tienen colas muy largas! Pero vale la pena esperar, y generalmente el servicio es bastante rápido. La única queja que tengo es que es difícil decidir qué pedir cuando llegas, y te sientes muy apurado porque hay mucha gente esperando. Probé el "Napoleon", que estaba increíble. También pedí un petit cake de vainilla y un brownie de caramelo salado. El brownie fue mi favorito. Además, preparan un buen capuchino que combina muy bien con sus productos de panadería. Tiene un diseño muy bonito y muchas opciones de asientos.
text_en: Wow… why hadn’t anyone told me that there’s a bakery in Charlotte that is open 24 hours a day? It’s a great place to go after dinner and have something to drink. They have a wide variety of delicious things to try. Maybe it would take years for me to try everything they offer! Tip: the lines are really long! But it’s worth waiting, and generally the service is quite fast. The only complaint I have is that it’s hard to decide what to order when you arrive, and you feel rushed because there are so many people waiting. I tried the “Napoleon” – it was incredible. I also ordered a vanilla petit cake and a salty caramel brownie. The brownie was my favorite. Additionally, they serve a nice capuccino that goes well with their bakery products. It has a very beautiful design and many seating options.
original: oK... so why did no one tell me that there is a 24/7 bakery in Charlotte? This is such a great spot to come to after dinner and drinks. They have lots of amazing goodies to try. It might take me years to taste everything they offer! Tip: They have really long lines! But it is worth the wait and it usually moves pretty quickly. The only complaint I have is that its hard to decide when you get up there to order and you feel very rushed because there are so many people behind you. I had the Napoleon-amazing. I also had the vanilla petit cake and the salted caramel brownie. The brownie was my favorite part. They make a good cappuccino which really complements their baked goods. It has a super cute design and lots of seating!

text: I am sure that the pastries must be good, but when they don't observe their advertised hours, one might never know. text: Duas palavras: Copo de biscoito!!! O copo de biscoito é composto por dois biscoitos de macaron, com duas bolas de sorvete, e finalizado com um marshmallow assado. Você pode escolher dois sabores diferentes de sorvete para as duas bolas. Se você se sentir aventureiro, pode adicionar o primeiro acompanhamento por US$ 0,75, e cada acompanhamento adicional por US$ 0,50. Os acompanhamentos incluem biscoitos de aveia, Oreo, granulado colorido e granulado de chocolate, para citar alguns. Os funcionários foram simpáticos e prestáveis. Por ser uma pessoa muito indecisa, não me senti pressionado a escolher um sabor imediatamente. Eles estavam realmente dispostos a me permitir experimentar todos os 24 sabores de sorvete, já que não havia fila atrás de mim. Experimentei apenas dois sabores, e me apaixonei pelo mocha java yaya e pelo sorvete de menta. Ri bastante com os nomes dos sabores, como "Netflix & Chill". Com certeza experimentaria alguns sabores enquanto me divertia. A melhor parte foi ver o marshmallow sendo assado por uma chama bem na nossa frente. Se você procura algo mais leve, também têm bolas de sorvete disponíveis. Este lugar não recebeu as cinco estrelas da minha parte, devido ao preço e ao excesso de açúcar. As primeiras mordidas do copo de biscoito foram incríveis. No entanto, as mordidas seguintes foram excessivamente doces. Além disso, o preço é um pouco elevado – US$ 7,50 pelo copo. Já comi sanduíches de macaron com sorvete com ótimos sabores por apenas US$ 4,50. No geral, este lugar é ótimo para crianças. Há uma estação de água gratuita perto dos guardanapos. Se você pretende comer seu doce no local, há algumas mesas dentro e algumas mesas do lado de fora. Não se esqueça de verificar o Yelp para obter um desconto de 10% na sua compra. Eles também têm um cartão de fidelidade: compre 9 bolas de sorvete e ganhe a 10ª de graça.
text_en: Two words: Cookie cup!!! The cookie cup consists of two macaron cookies, with two ice cream balls on top, and finished with a baked marshmallow. You can choose two different flavors of ice cream for the two balls. If you feel adventurous, you can add a first topping for $0.75, and each additional topping for $0.50. The toppings include oats cookies, Oreo, colorful granola, and chocolate granola, to name a few. The staff were friendly and helpful. As someone who’s very indecisive, I didn’t feel pressured to choose a flavor right away. They were really willing to let me try all 24 ice cream flavors, since there was no line behind me. I tried just two flavors, and I fell in love with Mocha Java Yaya and Mint Ice Cream. I laughed a lot at the names of the flavors, like “Netflix & Chill”. I would definitely try some flavors while having fun. The best part was watching the marshmallow bake right in front of us. If you’re looking for something lighter, they also have ice cream balls available. This place didn’t get five stars from me because of the price and too much sugar. The first bites of the cookie cup were amazing. However, the subsequent bites were overly sweet. Also, the price is a bit high—$7.50 for the cup. I’ve already eaten macaron sandwiches with ice cream in great flavors for just $4.50. Overall, this place is great for kids. There’s a free water station near the napkins. If you plan to eat your dessert there, there are some tables inside and some outside. Don’t forget to check Yelp to get a 10% discount on your purchase. They also have a loyalty card: buy 9 ice cream balls and get the 10th for free.
original: Two words: Cookie cup!!! The cookie cup is composed of two macaron cookies sandwiching two scoops of ice cream, and topped with a roasted marshmallow. You can choose two different flavored ice cream for the two scoops. If you're feeling adventurous, you can add on the first topping for $.75, and each additional topping for $.50. The toppings are graham crackers, oreos, rainbow sprinkles, & chocolate sprinkles to name a few. The workers were friendly and easy-going. Being an extremely indecisive person, I did not feel rushed to pick a flavor right away. They were really willing to have me sample all 24 ice cream flavors since there was no line behind me. I tried only two flavors, and fell in love with the mocha java yaya and mint chip. I was cracking up at some of the names for the ice cream, such as "Netflix & Chill". I would definitely try a couple of samples while having fun at it. The best part was seeing the marshmallow roasted by a torch right before our eyes. If you're looking for something lighter, they also have scoops of ice cream available. This place did not quite get the five stars for me because of the price and sweetness. The first couple of bites into the cookie cup was out of this world amazing. However, the subsequent bites were truly sweetness overload. It's also treading on the pricey side - $7.50 for the cup. I have eaten larger macaron ice cream sandwiches with great flavors for only $4.50. Overall, this place is great for kids. There is a complimentary water station by the napkins. If you're planning to eat your dessert on site, there are a handful of tables inside and a couple of tables outside. Remember to check-in on yelp for 10% off your order. They also have a stamp card, buy 9 scoops of ice cream and get the 10th scoop free.

text: Eles são muito simpáticos e prestativos aqui! Eu era cliente pela primeira vez e eles me deram opiniões úteis para que eu pudesse escolher um sabor. Optei por um drink com boba, manga com bolinhas de morango. Nunca usei um canudo de papel para boba, então foi legal que eles tivessem essa opção. Meu drink estava um pouco doce demais para o meu gosto, mas acho que foi apenas uma questão de preferência pessoal. Com certeza voltaria e experimentaria algo diferente!
text_en: They’re very friendly and helpful here! I was a customer for the first time, and they gave me useful recommendations so I could choose a flavor. I chose a drink with bubble tea and mango with strawberry balls. I’ve never used a paper straw for bubble tea before, so it was nice that they offered that option. My drink was a little too sweet for my taste, but I think it’s just a matter of personal preference. I would definitely go back and try something different!
original: They are super nice and helpful here! I was a first time customer and they gave me helpful opinions so I could choose a flavor. I went for a boba drink, mango with strawberry popping boba. I've never used a paper boba straw so that was cool they had that. My drink was a little too sweet for me, but I think that was just my personal preference. I would definitely come back and try something different!

text: El mejor helado de Cleveland. Me encanta el personal y estoy muy contento por su éxito.
text_en: The best ice cream in Cleveland. I love the staff, and I’m very happy about their success.
original: best ice cream in Cleveland. Love the owners and so happy for their success.

text: This bakery has become a weekly visit for me. Absolutely love the atmosphere, very retro and quaint at the same time. I usually go around 10-11am so there's not a line. They are known for their salted caramel brownie bars, so if you go...make sure to order one! I stick with the gluten-free one since it's a little healthier and the taste is no different than their classic. Seating is accommodating for groups of people or people like myself who go alone to enjoy some quiet alone time with a latte and pastry. Other yummy options are their berry salad, liver pate on a baguette sandwich, and their BLT croissant. Highly suggest! Oh and they're apparently open 24/7!

They are known for their salted caramel brownie bars, so if you go...make sure to order one! I stick with the gluten-free one since it's a little healthier and the taste is no different than their classic. text: ¡Me encanta este lugar! Es pequeño al principio, pero cuando das la vuelta, se convierte en un espacio increíble con decoración y más asientos. Decidimos sentarnos afuera. En Phoenix, Arizona, no hacía demasiado frío (especialmente viniendo del noroeste del Pacífico). Al entrar, hay una gran variedad de dulces clásicos como Razzles y pequeños juguetes. Me hizo sentir como un niño de nuevo. El helado me recordó a "cold stone", pero con un ambiente más tranquilo. Los sabores eran excelentes, y me encanta que hagan todo su propio helado. En general, fue una experiencia realmente agradable después de comer en el delicioso "Bruschetta Bar" de la calle de al lado. La próxima vez que visite Phoenix, definitivamente volveré.
text_en: I love this place! It’s small at first, but once you turn around, it becomes an amazing space with great decorations and more seats. We decided to sit outside. In Phoenix, Arizona, it wasn’t very cold (especially coming from the northwest Pacific region). When you enter, there’s a wide variety of classic sweets like Razzles and small toys. It made me feel like a child again. The ice cream reminded me of “Cold Stone,” but with a more peaceful atmosphere. The flavors were excellent, and I really like that they make their own ice cream. Overall, it was a really pleasant experience after eating at the delicious “Bruschetta Bar” on the street next to it. The next time I visit Phoenix, I will definitely come back.
original: I love this place! It's very small in the front, but you turn the corner and it's just an amazing wall decor and more seating. We decided to sit outside. In PHX, AZ it wasn't too cold at all (especially being from the PNW). When you walk in they have many different old school candy like Razzles and little knick knack toys. It's like I was a kid all over again. The ice cream reminded me of cold stone, but more small town feel. The flavors were great, and I love that they make all their own ice cream. It was overall a really great experience getting dessert after eating at the really yummy Bruschetta Bar across the street. When I visit Phoenix again, I'll definitely come back!

text: We went here yesterday for honey lavender ice cream and watermelon sorbet. It was wonderful to get out for a little break and see everyone practicing social distancing and happy to have customers. It was a real treat. The sorbet was light and refreshing and the ice cream was rich and delicious. They are no longer giving samples so make sure you know what you want when you get there. They have lots of creative choices.

It was wonderful to get out for a little break and see everyone practicing social distancing and happy to have customers. It was a real treat. The sorbet was light and refreshing and the ice cream was rich and delicious. They are no longer giving samples so make sure you know what you want when you get there. text: Delicious milkshakes, friendly staff and fun cake pops Really like the red velvet chocolate milkshake and the apple pie pumpkin with cinnamon milkshakes. Conveniently located on the corner of Penn and 9th for a pre-theatre snack.
text_en: Delicious milkshakes, friendly staff and fun cake pops Really like the red velvet chocolate milkshake and the apple pie pumpkin with cinnamon milkshakes. Conveniently located on the corner of Penn and 9th for a pre-theatre snack.

text: Sorvete incrível. Fui aqui depois do almoço com colegas de trabalho. Minha assistente jurídica pediu o copo com biscoito (na foto) e o cheiro do marshmallow queimado era delicioso. Eu pedi o sorvete de limão com merengue; estava maravilhoso. Outra amiga pediu o sorvete de morango com goiaba e comeu tudo em cerca de 30 segundos. Com certeza voltarei.
text_en: Incredible ice cream. I went here after lunch with colleagues from work. My legal assistant ordered a cup with cookies (in the photo), and the smell of burnt marshmallows was delicious. I ordered lemon ice cream with merengue; it was wonderful. Another friend ordered strawberry ice cream with guava, and ate it all in about 30 seconds. I will definitely come back.
original: Amazing ice cream. Went here after lunch with work friends. My legal assistant got the cookie cup, pictured, and the smell off of the flamed marshmallow was ridiculous. I got the lemon meringue ice cream; amazing. Our other friend got the strawberry guava and finished it in about 30 seconds. Will definitely be back.

text: Este lugar es difícil de encontrar. De todas formas, tenía ganas de probar algunos macarrones. Mi acompañante es un gran aficionado a los postres, así que me animó cuando mencioné este lugar. Pero terminamos decepcionados. Él pidió una tarta de chocolate y yo pedí tres macarrones. Visualmente, los macarrones parecían atractivos y el tamaño era generoso en comparación con otras opciones en la zona. El sabor era demasiado dulce (un macarrón de limón no debería ser dulce). La tarta de chocolate era simplemente como comer una barra de chocolate. Y los precios eran exorbitantes (2 bebidas con café + 1 postre y 3 macarrones, por un total de 26$!). Creo que hay mejores opciones en la zona, así que busquen en otro lugar.
text_en: This place is hard to find. Anyway, I really wanted to try some macaroni. My companion is a huge fan of desserts, so he encouraged me when I mentioned this place. But we were disappointed. He ordered a chocolate cake, and I ordered three pieces of macaroni. Visually, the macaroni looked appealing, and the size was generous compared to other options in the area. The taste was too sweet—macaroni with lemon shouldn’t be sweet at all. The chocolate cake was just like eating a bar of chocolate. And the prices were outrageous: 2 drinks with coffee + 1 dessert + 3 pieces of macaroni, for a total of $26! I think there are better options in the area, so maybe look elsewhere.
original: This place is hard to find. Anyway I was in the mood for some macaroons. My partner in crime is dessert fanatic so was game when I mentioned this place. Boy were we disappointed. He had a chocolate pie and I had 3 macaroon. Visually the macaroons looked appealing and the size was generous compared to other offering on the strip. Taste was too sweet (a lemon macaroon is not supposed to be sweet) The chocolate pie was just like eating a chocolate bar. And the prices were outrageous (2 espresso drinks + 1 dessert and 3 macaroons for total of 26$!) I think there are better offering on the strip so look elsewhere.

text: I had an excellent experience at Churn. The dessert I had was phenomenal. I tried the lil Dragon freezie and it was delicious. I'm located on the west valley but I will definitely be making the long drive for Churn again. I highly recommend it. Fun staff and awesome environment, plus unique and tasty desserts!
text_en: I had an excellent experience at Churn. The dessert I had was phenomenal. I tried the lil Dragon freezie and it was delicious. I'm located on the west valley but I will definitely be making the long drive for Churn again. I highly recommend it. Fun staff and awesome environment, plus unique and tasty desserts!

text: Siempre excelente. Recomiendo encarecidamente, ofrecen un producto de calidad, con un excelente servicio al cliente y prestan atención a los detalles. No importa en qué ubicación vaya (y estoy dispuesto a ir a varias!), Mitchell's es lo mejor. ¡Gracias, Mitchell's!
text_en: Always excellent. I highly recommend it. They offer high-quality products, exceptional customer service, and pay attention to details. No matter where I go (and I’m willing to go many places!), Mitchell’s is the best. Thank you, Mitchell’s!
original: Always good! Would highly recommend, they provide a quality product, with great customer service and pay attention to detail! No matter which location I go to, and I'm inclined to go to several! Mitchell's ROCKS! Thank you Mitchell's!

text: Ooh, Sweet Republic! I've read so many good things about their ice cream and the bar was set pretty high! We're walking around First Friday when we saw their groovy tangerine van. My hubby got the Belgian Chocolate and my little guy couldn't resist the Butter Caramel. "This is so good!", he exclaimed. White Rose intrigued me. I love the smooth and creamy consistency with a touch of rose syrup. It's worth the $3 for one scoop!
text_en: Ooh, Sweet Republic! I've read so many good things about their ice cream and the bar was set pretty high! We're walking around First Friday when we saw their groovy tangerine van. My hubby got the Belgian Chocolate and my little guy couldn't resist the Butter Caramel. "This is so good!", he exclaimed. White Rose intrigued me. I love the smooth and creamy consistency with a touch of rose syrup. It's worth the $3 for one scoop!

text: Limpio, rápido, amable y DELICIOSO. ¡Mi objetivo es probar todos sus sabores y rellenos!
text_en: Clean, fast, friendly, and DELICIOUS. My goal is to try all their flavors and fillings!
original: Clean, fast, friendly & DELICIOUS I'm on a mission to try all their flavors & fillings!

text: Pedí el helado de "red velvet" con trozos de brownie y una galleta de "marshmallow" casera tostada encima. En general, me gustó mi postre. Helado: buen y cremoso, tenía un sabor increíble. Toppings: le quité una estrella por esto, no tenían muchas opciones de toppings. Los brownies no eran mi "¡necesito esto!" pero sí mi "bueno, vamos a probar esto porque es lo mejor de lo que ofrecen" opción. Definitivamente podrían mejorar en este aspecto. Marshmallow: excelente, sabor perfecto, tostado en la medida justa. En general, me encantó el lugar. Volvería cuando esté en Scottsdale.
text_en: I ordered the “red velvet” ice cream with brownie pieces and a homemade toasted marshmallow cookie on top. Overall, I liked my dessert. Ice cream: good and creamy; it had an amazing taste. Toppings: I lost one star because there weren’t many topping options. The brownies weren’t my “I need this!” choice, but they were definitely my “let’s try it since it’s the best they have” choice. They could definitely improve in this area. Marshmallow: excellent, perfect taste, toasted just right. Overall, I really enjoyed the place. I’ll come back when I’m in Scottsdale.
original: I got the red velvet ice-cream with a topping of brownie chunks and a toasted homemade marshmallow on the top. I liked my dessert overall.. Ice-cream: good and creamy, tasted amazing. Topping: I took away one star just for this, they did not have a lot of choices in toppings, brownies were not my "OMG i gotta have this" choice but it was "okay let's get this because it's the best among what they have" choice. They can surely improve on the topping. Marshmallow: Great, perfect taste, toasted the right amount. I loved the place in all. Would go again when I am in Scottsdale.

text: Tudo o que experimentei aqui, gostei muito. O "monkey bread" (pão com massa amanteigada), os croissants recheados e os muffins com cobertura de açúcar são meus favoritos. Se você quiser o "monkey bread" nos fins de semana, vá lá antes das 9:00 da manhã para ter certeza de conseguir um, pois às vezes pode haver muita gente. (Então, quanto mais cedo, melhor!) Com pães, biscoitos e doces como este, você entenderá por que há uma fila. Os funcionários são sempre simpáticos, então dê uma gorjeta, pois eles trabalham duro! (especialmente aos sábados e domingos). Obrigado, Batch, por estar presente e por não ser "Be-atches"!
text_en: I really liked everything I tried here. The “monkey bread” (bread with buttery dough), filled croissants, and muffins with sugar topping are my favorites. If you want to get “monkey bread” on weekends, go there before 9:00 a.m. to be sure you can get one, as sometimes there are many people. (The earlier, the better!) With breads, biscuits, and sweets like this, you’ll understand why there’s a line. The staff are always friendly, so give them a tip, as they work hard! (Especially on Saturdays and Sundays.) Thank you, Batch, for being there and not being “Be-atches”!
original: Everything I have tried here, I have liked. The monkey bread, filled croissants,sugar topped muffins are my faves. If you want monkey bread on the weekends, get there before 9:00 am to be sure you get one, as it can sometimes can be a bit of a mob scene in there.(So the earlier the better!) With bread,cookies,and pastry like this, you will know why the line is there. Counter help is always friendly, so tip them a buck cuz they work hard!(especially on sat/sun) Thanks for being there Batch, and not being Be-atches!

text: Maple cake donut. Smiley donut. Both are the must haves. One bite and you get, a mouthful of icing and fried warm cake - and I'm not talking just the royal icing, but a creamy dollop of additional frosting covering the "hole" of the round donut. This is a must when I visit Cleveland, and Weight Watchers isn't going to stop me! A new addition: Maple Bacon Cake Donut, absolutely divine.

text: El donut caliente, el helado frío y la cuchara en el centro son deliciosos. Los donuts recién hechos, calientes y deliciosos... ¡simplemente perfectos! ¡Me encantó el helado de "Cookie Monster"!
text_en: The hot donuts, the cold ice cream, and the spoon in the middle are delicious. The freshly made donuts, hot and tasty… simply perfect! I loved the “Cookie Monster” ice cream!
original: There hot donut cold ice cream scoop in the middle is to die for. fresh made in house hot donut yum just yum ! I loved the cookie monster ice cream !

text: Paramos aqui no caminho de saída depois de ver o espetáculo do Blue Man Group, pois queria comprar alguns doces para o meu marido tomar no café da manhã do dia seguinte. Comprei duas croissantes de chocolate e duas danishes de queijo. Meu marido achou que as croissantes de chocolate do M Resort (Babycakes) eram melhores, mas admito que eu prefiri as de Bouchon. Mas, como eu não como muito açúcar e gasto mais tempo provando e comprando para o meu marido, a opinião dele é mais importante! As danishes de queijo eram diferentes, mas não de forma ruim. Era quase como se fossem assadas da mesma forma que as croissantes, e também eram crocantes. Eu pessoalmente prefiri as danishes às croissantes. Se eu voltar ao Venetian, já que não faria um esforço para vir aqui, vou experimentar os macarons.
text_en: We stopped here on the way out after watching the performance by the Blue Man Group, because I wanted to buy some sweets for my husband to eat at breakfast the next day. I bought two chocolate croissants and two cheese danishes. My husband thought the chocolate croissants from M Resort (Babycakes) were better, but I admit that I prefer those from Bouchon. However, since I don’t eat much sugar and spend more time trying out and buying things for my husband, his opinion matters more! The cheese danishes were different, but not bad. They were almost like croissants, cooked in the same way, and they were also crispy. Personally, I prefer the danishes over the croissants. If I go back to the Venetian, since I wouldn’t make the effort to come here, I’ll try the macarons.
original: Stopped here on the way out after seeing the Blue Man Group, as I wanted to get my husband some pastries for breakfast tomorrow. I bought 2 chocolate croissants and 2 cheese danishes. My husband thought the chocolate croissants at the M resort (Babycakes) were better, but admittedly I liked these better from Bouchon. But as I'm not really a huge sugar eater and spend more time tasting and buying for my husband, his opinion counts more than mine! The cheese danishes were odd, but not in a bad way. It was almost like they were baked like the croissants, and flaky in the same way. I personally liked these better than the croissants. If I'm at the Venetian again, since I wouldn't go out of my way to come here, I'll try the macaroons.

text: Não tinha percebido que este local está aberto 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana! Cheguei bem cedo para tomar um sanduíche de café da manhã. Estava delicioso, mas um pouco caro.
text_en: I didn’t realize that this place is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week! I arrived early to have a breakfast sandwich. It was delicious, but a bit expensive.
original: Didn't realize that this location is open 24/7! Came in super early for a breakfast sandwich. It was delicious, but a bit pricey.

text: Absolutamente delicioso. Todos son muy amables y se adaptan a todas tus necesidades. La comida es increíble, y además, puedes obtenerla rápidamente, lo cual es una ventaja. Es un lugar ideal para trabajar, siempre y cuando tengas tiempo, ya que a menudo me concentro tanto que pierdo la noción del tiempo, trabajando en mi ordenador durante horas sin darme cuenta.
text_en: Absolutely delicious. Everyone is very friendly and can meet all your needs. The food is incredible, and moreover, it’s available quickly—which is a advantage. It’s an ideal place to work, as long as you have time. I often get so focused that I lose track of time, working on my computer for hours without realizing it.
original: Absolutely delicious. Everyone there is so nice and they cater to your every need. Fhe food is amazing and you can get it quickly which is aleaus a plus. This is a great place to bring some work to do. But only if you have time bscauxr I often get soaked up in it and losw track of time often workinv on my computer for hours without even realizinv it.

text: Their 4 scoop sampler is great for trying many flavors. My favorites are banana cream pie, New York cheesecake and cookie and creme. The syrup they use for strawberry cheesecake is a little too sweet for me.
text_en: Their 4 scoop sampler is great for trying many flavors. My favorites are banana cream pie, New York cheesecake and cookie and creme. The syrup they use for strawberry cheesecake is a little too sweet for me.

text: **REVISADO - ATENÇÃO, DONO: LIES EMOCIONAIS E IRRELEVANTES. Eles só comentam quando alguém não responde. No entanto, em seu comentário, afirmou que eu havia respondido. Isso diminuiu minha confiança. Que mentiroso! Não conseguem aceitar críticas ou assumir a responsabilidade por seus funcionários e seu atendimento ao cliente RUÍM! Não vale a pena. É irritante como eles não reconhecem ninguém que está esperando e como as pessoas à sua frente, que são extremamente indecisas, recebem amostras gratuitas em abundância. Alguém já disse "sinto muito, estarei com você em breve? Ou você gostaria de experimentar um sabor?" Não, definitivamente não. Ah, e a organização da fila para essa pequena barraca? Tenho certeza de que, considerando o número de pessoas lá dentro, também não está em conformidade com o código do bombeiro. Talvez o dono deva resolver isso e talvez devamos também reportar isso. É seguro dizer que perdi 15 minutos esperando na fila por uma família de 4 pessoas à minha frente. É seguro dizer que nunca voltarei. Eu não sabia que 4 pessoas precisariam de 15 minutos para escolher seus sorvetes, para que eu pudesse esperar 15 minutos para escolher meu sorvete de $5 que, na minha opinião, está muito caro. text: Estaba muy emocionado al ver Carlo's Bakery en las tiendas del Venetian. Había visitado la ubicación original en Hoboken y me había impresionado mucho los postres y el personal. Esta ubicación tenía un estilo similar. Se estaba aplicando el distanciamiento social, con solo unos pocos clientes entrando a la pastelería a la vez. Caminé hacia las vitrinas y revisé los productos. Un miembro del personal se acercó a mí para tomar mi pedido. Pedí dos cupcakes (ambos con bizcocho blanco - uno con glaseado de chocolate y el otro con glaseado de vainilla), dos galletas con chispas de chocolate y dos brownies. El miembro del personal no habló mucho conmigo y no parecía muy amable. Incluso si llegué en un momento tranquilo, podría haber sido un día ajetreado. Después de hacer el pedido, me indicaron que esperara a que me llamaran para recogerlo y pagar. Esperé unos 5 minutos antes de que me llamaran. Todo estaba bien empaquetado para que pudiera sobrevivir el trayecto de 5 minutos hasta mi habitación en The Palazzo. Mi total fue un poco menos de 30 dólares, lo cual parece un poco caro para 6 artículos. Cuando volví a mi habitación, no pude esperar para probar un cupcake. ¡Estaba delicioso! El bizcocho era jugoso y el glaseado era perfecto. Exactamente como lo recordaba de mi visita a Carlo's Bake Shop en Hoboken. Después de comer el cupcake, no pude resistirme y también comí una galleta con chispas de chocolate. Era muy suave y tenía un sabor intenso a chocolate. Estas galletas eran tan buenas como las que traje de vuelta de Carlo's Bake Shop para que mi familia las probara. ¡Muy ricas! Lo único que no me gustó fue el brownie. Tenía un sabor extraño. Normalmente me encantan los brownies de chocolate, pero no pude terminar este. Tenía ese sabor a chocolate polvoriento. El glaseado encima estaba bien. En general, me encanta esta pastelería. Los cupcakes y las galletas son, con diferencia, mis favoritos tanto de esta tienda en Las Vegas como de la de Hoboken. ¡Definitivamente lo recomiendo!
text_en: I was very excited to see Carlo’s Bakery in the Venetian stores. I had visited the original location in Hoboken, and I was really impressed by the desserts and the staff. This new location had a similar style. Social distancing was being enforced, with only a few customers entering the bakery at a time. I walked around the displays and checked out the products. A staff member came up to me to take my order. I ordered two cupcakes (both with white cake – one with chocolate icing, the other with vanilla icing), two chocolate chip cookies, and two brownies. The staff member didn’t talk much to me, and didn’t seem very friendly. Even though I arrived during a quiet time, it could have been a busy day. After placing my order, they told me to wait until they called me to pick it up and pay. I waited about 5 minutes before they called me. Everything was well packaged so that I could survive the 5-minute journey to my room at The Palazzo. My total cost was a little less than $30, which seems a bit expensive for 6 items. When I got back to my room, I couldn’t wait to try one of the cupcakes. It was delicious! The cake was moist, and the icing was perfect. Exactly as I remembered from my visit to Carlo’s Bake Shop in Hoboken. After eating the cupcake, I couldn’t resist and also ate one of the chocolate chip cookies. They were very soft and had a strong chocolate flavor. These cookies were just as good as those I brought back from Carlo’s Bake Shop for my family to try. Very tasty! The only thing I didn’t like was the brownie. It had a strange taste. Usually, I love chocolate brownies, but I couldn’t finish this one. It had that dusty chocolate taste. The icing on top was okay. Overall, I really like this bakery. The cupcakes and cookies are definitely my favorites, both at this store in Las Vegas and in Hoboken. I definitely recommend it!
original: I was very excited to see Carlo's Bakery at the Venetian Shops. I had visited the original location in Hoboken and was blown away by the desserts and staff. This location was set up similarly in style. There was social distancing being enforced with only a few customers entering the bakery at one time. I walked over to the cases and browsed the goods. A staff member came up to me to take my order. I ordered two cupcakes (both with white cake - one chocolate icing and the other vanilla icing), two chocolate chip cookies, and two brownies. The staff member didn't speak much to me and didn't come off as very friendly. It could have been a busy day even if I arrived at a lull. After ordering, I was instructed to wait for my name to be called for pick up and to pay. I waited about 5 minutes before my name was called. Everything was packaged nicely so that it would survive the 5 minutes walk to my room at The Palazzo. My total was a little less than $30. Which seems a bit pricey for 6 items. When I got back to my room, I couldn't wait to dive right into a cupcake. It was delicious! The cake was moist and the icing was perfect! Just as I remembered from my visit to the Hoboken Bake Shop. After eating the cupcake, I couldn't help myself and I ate a chocolate chip cookie. It was so soft and chocolatey. These cookies were as good as the ones I brought home from The Hoboken Bake Shop for my family to try. Very tasty! The one thing I disliked was the brownie. It tasted off. I normally love fudge brownies, but I couldn't finish this one. It had that dusty chocolatey taste to it. The icing on top was okay. I was a bit disappointed with this dessert. Overall, I love this bakery! The cupcakes and cookies are by far my favorite from both this Vegas shop and the one in Hoboken. Definitely recommend!

text: Bem – eles não economizam nos ingredientes como a DQ tem feito ultimamente. Passei por aqui quando me perdi na entrada do estacionamento do Whole Foods e decidi que precisava entrar para experimentar o sorvete de creme "artesanal". Principalmente depois de ler tantas boas avaliações de outros clientes. Normalmente, não compro um milkshake quando compro sorvete, pois são tão rápidos e fáceis de beber que não duram tempo suficiente para mim. Mas decidi experimentar aqui, pois as fotos que vi mostravam que eles eram deliciosos. Escolhi Oreo como cobertura e sorvete de chocolate. Vi a atendente colocar uma grande porção de sorvete na máquina, com uma grande quantidade de pedaços de biscoito Oreo e um pouco de leite, e parecia que eu comeria por dias. Mas depois de tudo ser misturado, foi colocado em uma xícara de 12 ou 16 onças, com uma polegada no topo para que ela pudesse adicionar ainda mais pedaços de Oreo, então não havia muito shake. Seria ótimo se ela tivesse me dado a versão com acompanhamento, como a que se encontra em recipientes de metal em restaurantes, em vez de simplesmente descartar os deliciosos restos. E nunca imaginei dizer isso, mas foi simplesmente muito Oreo para mim. Também acho que perdi a experiência deliciosa do sorvete com alto teor de gordura, que todo mundo fala, ao colocar no milkshake. Da próxima vez, e certamente haverá uma próxima vez, vou pedir um sorvete, talvez com Reese's misturado.
text_en: Well – they don’t save on ingredients like DQ has been doing lately. I came by here when I got lost at the entrance to Whole Foods’ parking lot, and I decided I needed to enter to try the “handmade” cream ice cream. Especially after reading so many good reviews from other customers. Usually, I don’t get a milkshake when I buy ice cream, because they’re so quick and easy to drink that they don’t last long enough for me. But I decided to try it here, because the photos I saw showed that it was delicious. I chose Oreo as the topping and chocolate ice cream. I saw the staff put a big amount of ice cream into the machine, along with lots of Oreo cookies and some milk, and it seemed like I could eat it for days. But after everything was mixed together, it was poured into a cup that holds 12 or 16 ounces, with an inch on top so they could add more Oreo pieces. So there wasn’t much shake left. It would be great if they had given me a version with toppings, like those in metal containers in restaurants, instead of just discarding the delicious leftover. And I never thought I’d say this, but it was just too much Oreo for me. I also think I missed out on the delicious experience of high-fat ice cream, which everyone talks about, when mixed into a milkshake. Next time, and definitely there will be a next time, I’ll order ice cream, maybe mixed with Reese’s.
original: Well - they don't scrimp on the toppings like DQ has been doing lately. I drove by here when I missed my turn into the Whole Foods parking lot and decided that I needed to go in and check out the "craft" soft serve ice cream. Especially when I read so many good reviews from other yelpers. I don't normally get a milkshake when I get ice cream, as they are so quick and easy to drink that they don't last long enough for me. But I decided to get one here as the pictures I saw made them look soooo good. I went with Oreo as my topping and chocolate ice cream. I saw the clerk put a huge scoop of ice cream in the drill machine with a big pile of Oreo cookie crumbles and some milk, and it looked like I would be eating for days. But after it was all blended, it went into a 12 or 16 ounce cup with an inch on the top for her add even more Oreo chunks, so there was not a lot of shake. It would have been great if she had given me the sidecar like you get in the metal containers at diners rather than just throw out the yummy leftovers. And I never thought I would say this, but it was just too much Oreo for me. I also think I missed out on the yumminess of the high fat ice cream experience that everyone talks about by having it put into a milkshake. Next time, and there will be a next time, I'll get an ice cream cone, maybe with Reese's mixed in.

No era demasiado dulce ni demasiado insípido.
text_en: An excellent ice cream place! The portions are huge! I love the variety they offer, along with numerous cereal options. The rose milk tea was quite good; I definitely recommend it to anyone who loves ice cream. The ice cream had a very balanced taste—not too sweet, nor too bland.
original: A very great ice cream place, the portion is hugeeeee! Love the different variety they give, mixed with numerous selections of cereals. The rose milk tea was pretty good, definitely would recommend for the ice cream lovers to come and try! Ice cream definitely tasted very balanced. Not too sweet not too bland!

text: Cuatro palabras: HELADO VEGANO DE CHOCOLATE. De verdad, es uno de los secretos mejor guardados de Cleveland. No es necesario ser vegano para disfrutarlo (y yo lo sé). También he recomendado este helado a mis amigos y familiares, y suelen incluirlo en sus helados. Normalmente tienen dos sabores veganos disponibles y, sinceramente, son los mejores helados sin lácteos que he probado. En realidad, son mejores que la mayoría de los helados "normales" y son súper cremosos. Definitivamente, confíen en mí y prueben una cucharada la próxima vez que estén por allí – incluso mis compañeros de trabajo, que normalmente no son fans, lo disfrutan. Vale, vale, ya basta. Además del increíble helado, otro beneficio de Mitchell's es que es un excelente ejemplo de un negocio local encantador. Me encanta la decoración interior. Está ubicado en un antiguo teatro, y al mirar hacia arriba, se pueden ver los viejos vigas de madera que se cruzan con una gran pared de cristal, desde la cual se puede ver a los trabajadores preparando diferentes lotes de helado. He visto cómo lavan y preparan fresas frescas, lo cual es muy refrescante en un mundo lleno de sabores artificiales. Si se toman el helado vegano de chocolate, les recomiendo que también compren un helado, porque se derrite bastante y las porciones son muy grandes, así que normalmente lo llevo a casa y lo guardo en el congelador. Si están en el mercado o comiendo en Ohio City, ¡definitivamente deberían pasar a probar un postre delicioso!
text_en: Four words: Vegan Chocolate Ice Cream. Really, it’s one of the best secrets in Cleveland. You don’t need to be a vegan to enjoy it (and I know that). I’ve also recommended this ice cream to my friends and family, and they usually include it in their ice creams too. Usually, there are two vegan flavors available, and honestly, they’re the best dairy-free ice creams I’ve tried. In fact, they’re better than most “regular” ice creams, and they’re super creamy. Definitely trust me and try a spoonful next time you’re around here—even my coworkers, who aren’t usually fans, enjoy it. Okay, enough. Besides the amazing ice cream, another advantage of Mitchell’s is that it’s a great example of a charming local business. I love the interior decoration. It’s located in an old theater, and when you look up, you can see the old wooden beams intersecting with a big glass wall, from which you can see the workers preparing different batches of ice cream. I’ve seen them wash and prepare fresh strawberries, which is very refreshing in a world full of artificial flavors. If you order the vegan chocolate ice cream, I recommend also getting an ice cream with it, because it melts quickly and the portions are quite large. So, I usually take it home and store it in the freezer. If you’re in the market or eating in Ohio City, definitely give it a try for a delicious dessert!
original: Four words : VEGAN CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM. Seriously one of the best kept secrets in Cleveland. You don't have to be vegan to like this (I would know). I've turned my friends and family onto it as well and they usually make it one of the flavors in their cup. They usually have two vegan flavors on rotation and they seriously are the best dairy-free ice creams I've had. Honestly, they're better than most "normal" ice creams and is super velvety. Definitely take my word for it and try a spoonful next time you're in - even my disgruntle steelworkers like it. Okay, okay, I'll stop. Other perks of Mitchell's, aside from the amazing ice cream, is that it's a prime example of a gorgeous local business. I love the aesthetics on the inside. It's in some old theater and you can look up and see the old wooden beams intersecting a giant glass wall that let's you watch the workers mix up batches of ice cream. I've watched them wash and prepare fresh strawberries which is so refreshing in a world full of artificial flavors. I will say if you get the vegan chocolate grab a cup cause it's pretty melty and the servings are so big I usually take it home and stick it in the freezer. If you're at the market or eating in Ohio City definitely swing by for a sweet treat!

text: Creo que Sprinkles es la mejor de las cadenas de pasteles individuales. En general, son muy consistentes. Este lugar no es una excepción, y probé un pastel de fresa y uno de "blanco y negro", que estaban tan buenos como en la ubicación original en Nueva York. Creo que lo que hace que estos pasteles sean tan especiales es el bizco. Los bizco son muy sabrosos y húmedos, y siento que realmente destacan. El glaseado es bastante básico, pero no de manera negativa, sino que realmente realza el sabor del bizco. Me esforzaré por venir aquí... y luego me di cuenta de que tienen un cajero automático en el aeropuerto, ¡qué bien!
text_en: I think Sprinkles is the best chain for individual cupcakes. Generally, they’re very consistent in quality. This place isn’t an exception—I tried a strawberry cupcake and a “white and black” cupcake, both just as good as those from their original location in New York. I believe what makes these cupcakes so special is the cake filling. The cake filling is very tasty and moist, and it really stands out. The frosting is quite basic, but not in a bad way—it actually enhances the flavor of the cake filling. I’ll try to come here again… and then I noticed they have an ATM at the airport—what a great thing!
original: I think Sprinkles is the best of the cupcake chains. For the most part they are very consistent. This one is no exception and I had a strawberry cupcake and a black and white, just as good as the original location in NYC. I think what makes these cupcakes so special is the cake. The cakes are so flavorful and moist, I feel like they really stand out. The frosting is very basic, not in a bad way, but it makes the cake really shine. I will go out of my way to come here.....then I realized they have an ATM at the airport yum.

text: Meh... Nada destacable. Un donut caro. No vale la pena conducir 20 minutos para probarlos.

original: Meh... Nothing special. Expensive donut. Not worth driving 20 min to try them out.

text: Estranho, incrível e muito, muito peculiar. Diria que o sorvete é razoável (não espetacular), mas a apresentação e as crepes são incríveis. O matcha tem um sabor muito intenso/mais amargo – atenção. Mas o mochi por cima foi divertido e adicionou uma ótima textura. Ah, e quem não gostaria de beber chá de leite de taro em um abajur?
text_en: Strange, amazing, and very, very unique. I would say the ice cream is decent (not spectacular), but the presentation and the crepes are incredible. Matcha has a very intense/bitter taste – be careful. But the mochi on top was fun and added great texture. Oh, and who wouldn’t love to drink taro milk tea by a lamp?
original: Weird and amazing and very very extra. I'd say this is pretty decent (not spectacular) ice cream but the aesthetic appeal and crepes are amazing. The matcha is very intense/on the more bitter side - be warned. But the mochi on top was fun and added great texture. Oh and who doesn't want to drink taro milk tea out of a light bulb?

text: Una noche, después de una cena abundante, mis amigos y yo fuimos a este lugar y lo probamos. Lo más difícil es encontrar un lugar para aparcar, ya que el centro de la ciudad puede ser bastante complicado de recorrer. Melt era bastante pequeño y, en general, bastante limpio. Lamentablemente, no había baños públicos para mí. ¡Y yo estaba listo! Los productos lácteos también ayudaron... ¡Bromas aparte! Pedimos una porción de pepino, que estaba muy refrescante, e incluso el gato del vecindario lo notó. Y también pedimos una porción de "Cookie Monster", que mis amigos consideraron que era la cantidad perfecta de dulzura y textura de galleta. Y el color azul era increíble. En general, es un lugar pequeño y fantástico, y recomendamos encarecidamente que lo visiten hoy. ¡Incluso el gato lo recomienda, ¡está hambriento!
text_en: One night, after a rich dinner, my friends and I went to this place and tried it out. The hardest part is finding a parking spot, as the city center can be quite tricky to navigate. Melt was quite small and, overall, very clean. Unfortunately, there were no public bathrooms for me. And I was ready! The dairy products also helped… apart from the jokes! We ordered a portion of cucumber salad, which was really refreshing, and even the neighborhood cat noticed it. We also ordered a portion of “Cookie Monster,” which my friends thought was the perfect amount of sweetness and texture of cookies. And the blue color was amazing. Overall, it’s a small but fantastic place, and we highly recommend visiting it today. Even the cat recommends it—it’s hungry!
original: One night after a big dinner, friends and I stopped by this place and gave them a try. The hardest part is finding a parking spot, since the downtown area can be quite hard to navigate. Melt was quite small and overall quite clean. Unfortunately no public loo for me to try. And I was ready!!! The dairy products helped too....Jk We got a scope of cute-cumber which was very refreshing, even the neighborhood kitty thought so. And a scope of Cookie Monster which my friends thought was the perfect amount of sweetness and chewiness from the cookie and stuff. And the blue colour was amazing. Overall a great and fantastic little place, and we highly recommend you come here today. And the cat does too, she's hangry!!

text: Un postre helado que pocos pueden igualar. Últimamente, he estado disfrutando mucho de los "sándwiches" de helado, así que cuando salí a Scottsdale para un fin de semana, tenía que probar este lugar. Los refrigeradores estaban llenos de sabores únicos, y como tengo una gran preferencia por el menta o el chocolate, decidí probar esos. Opté por un helado de menta con trozos y un helado de chocolate doble, ambos cómodamente ubicados entre una galleta de avena con pasas y, en el otro lado, una galleta de macadamia con chocolate blanco. Las galletas, aunque de un tamaño superior al habitual, no eran mi primera opción, pero eran las únicas que quedaban. Llegué al final de la noche, así que no puedo culparlos por la falta de variedad. El helado era delicioso, cremoso y me refrescó. Recomiendo encarecidamente este lugar a cualquiera que busque un helado y galletas en un paquete sabroso.
text_en: A frozen dessert that few can match. Recently, I’ve been enjoying “ice cream sandwiches” very much. So when I went to Scottsdale for the weekend, I had to try this place out. The refrigerators were full of unique flavors. Since I really prefer mint or chocolate flavors, I chose those. I ordered a mint ice cream with chunks and a double chocolate ice cream. Both were placed comfortably between a oat milk biscuit with raisins on one side, and a macadamia nut biscuit with white chocolate on the other. Although the biscuits were larger than usual, they weren’t my first choice, but they were the only ones available. I ended up at the end of the night, so I can’t blame them for not having many options. The ice cream was delicious, creamy, and gave me a cool treat. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for tasty ice cream and biscuits in a package.
original: A frozen treat only few can beat! I've been on an ice cream sandwich kick lately, so when I cruised out to Scottsdale on a weekend getaway I Had to check this place out. Unique flavors filled the chilly coolers and with a strong bias towards anything mint or chocolate I had to go with that. Mint chip, and double chocolate ice cream comfortably snuggled in between one oatmeal apricot raisin cookie and on the opposite side a white chocolate chip macadamia nut cookie. The above average sized cookies wouldn't have been my first choice but that is all they had left. I showed up towards the end of the night so they are not entirely to blame for the lack of selection. The ice cream was delicious, creamy and chilled my bones. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for some ice cream and cookies frozen up in a tasty package.
